Tranchez pour survivre à une journée de travail typique en incarnant le serviteur surmené et peu apprécié de Dracula ! Quels beaux moments sanglants vous passerez en saccageant La Nouvelle-Orléans à la recherche de nouvelles victimes pour votre patron narcissique.

The age of heroes is passed, yet an ancient evil rises again. Follow the adventures of Karden, a blacksmith on the path to mastering his craft, forced to take a stand against Talameq, an ageless entity bent on devouring the world.

Terror and mystery meet in Home Sweet Home Sweet Home Episode 2, the sequel to last year’s cult-hit first-person horror game, Home Sweet Home. Immerse yourself in a world where evil hides behind every corner, in a world inspired by Thai folklore and mythology.

2D Casual fighting game where you can create and customize your fighter (80 slots to save your avatars) with tons of different options and get ready to fight into the Championship. Final Slam 2 is a PC fighting game that allows you to create your own fighter and win the Final Slam championships or play through the official Final Slam...
"Red Spider2" is a Hong Kong Noir-themed Visual Novel. There are 6 story routes with the different characters(approximately 200,000 words in total).

Practice soccer and other sports the way they are meant to be played: sitting on a couch with your friends! Soccertron is a local multiplayer sports game for up to 4 players with a simple premise: Kick the ball or your friends to win the match!

titre: Tibetan Quest: Beyond the World's End
description: Plongez dans un monde mystique de légendes tibétaines !

Max, an Autistic Journey is a retro style top-down turn-based RPG filled with mini games, monsters and most of all, heart. Developed by a devoted dad who made a game with his son about his son's autism.

Hyper Fighters brings back the rail shooter as you know it from the arcade: fast, explosive, addictive, and easy to learn: but so hard to beat the number one highscore! Fourteen trigger-happy arcade-fun stages are now available for one or two players: Shoot dozens, hundreds, or even thousands of enemies out of the sky and water with...

Awaken as a soul from the Underworld. Discover who you are and explore an ever-changing open world full of mystery. Battle beasts and gods, or forge alliances with them. Die and be reborn in this adventure.
Saute, balance-toi et explore des mondes colorés dans cet adorable jeu de plate-forme !

8-Bit Invaders! est un jeu de stratégie rétro et intense en temps réel pour PC. Contrôlez la puissance militaire du corps des marines galactique ou commencez votre invasion avec la puissance dévastatrice des Cranioids ! Minez, construisez et luttez jusqu’à la victoire ! Conquérir le multivers n’a jamais été aussi facile.

titre: Warriors: Rise to Glory! Online Multiplayer Open Beta
description: Des combats multijoueurs en ligne au tour par tour, aux éléments de JDR. Crée ta lignée de guerriers d'élite, et dispute d'épiques combats de gladiateurs avec ou contre tes amis. Amène gloire et richesse à ton clan, et prépare-toi à distribuer de très nombreuses raclées... ou à en recevoir parfois.

Savior of the Abyss is a horror adventure game. To avoid sudden death, always pay attention and be suspicious of things around you. Collect and use a variety of tools to get to the surface. Please lead the protagonist safely so that the protagonist can achieve his or her purpose safely.

Dark Scavenger is a bizarre point-and-click RPG adventure with a focus on exploration, gaining loot, and meaningful choices. Filling the role of a powerful space traveler, you find yourself stranded on a mysterious alien planet. Will you save the world or just yourself?

A band of aliens led by the careless Prince FaceBox have invaded the future city of Nucleusport, bombarding it with radioactive waste from their own polluted planet. Only one man has the tech and the cojones to fight back. Take on the role of Doc DuBrane and wield his super-powerful Prisma Cannon in this endless arcade-style shooter.

You will play as a Trainee Death, harvesting Souls to pay off your debt. Random choice events offer you various options: Lie in bed and slack off since the debt is endless anyway, Or follow your senior to earn some extra Souls, collecting outfits to switch up your style.
Elemental Heroes is MMO RPG with classical turn based combat and free world PVP.

An addictive fast paced twin stick arena shooter with banging electronic sound track, nostalgic nods and a barrage of flashing lights and bullets. Your task is simple, kill drones, free humans, don't die!
The classic retro arcade game! Discover thrilling tables with challenges and missions, including dragons, space, casinos and our Classic Wonderland table complete with original illustrations.

Vivez la vie d'un footballeur professionnel sur et en dehors du terrain. Entraînez-vous, jouez des matchs, gérez votre vie sociale, gravissez les échelons de votre carrière et dépensez votre argent gagné. Décorez votre vie avec luxe tout en gérant vos relations et vos finances.

titre: A Quiet Place: The Road Ahead
description: A quiet place : the road ahead est un jeu d’horreur et d’aventure en solo inspiré par la franchise à succès du film éponyme. Survivez en silence.

titre: TouHou Makuka Sai ~ Fantastic Danmaku Festival
description: Fantastic Danmaku Festival is a Touhou Project fanfiction STG with colourful danmaku, beautiful remix music and original music. Besides the characters we know in Touhou Project, there is also a brand new original character named Nix in this game! With the Scarlet Devil mansion as their stage, the girls are soaring in the sky of Gensokyo!

Bulwark mélange expérience de construction créative casual avec des aspects de stratégie à grande échelle et d’exploration. C’est un jeu expérimental au delà des genres, à la fois expérience de construction casual et conquête épique faisant s’affronter dirigeables, oiseaux de guerre et forteresses.

Build your biome! With an empty biodome as your canvas, add plants and animals from three different ecosystems. Observe interactions like hunting, blooming, and even decomposing! Will your biodome last for decades, or will it experience a total ecosystem collapse? You’re in control!

Darksburg est un jeu de type roguelite dans lequel vous devez vous échapper d'une cité médiévale générée de façon procédurale et envahie de morts-vivants. Battez-vous aux côtés de vos amis, éliminez les Revenants et fuyez tant qu'il est encore temps !
A short visual novel about meeting with a stranger on the beach.
Mortal Blitz applique les jeux de Gun Shooting des centres de jeux d'arcade dans la plate-forme VR, et il vous permet d'expérimenter la toute nouvelle expéerience de 1ère personne VR action Shooter

Reloader: test_subject is an experimental "Bullet Counting Reload Action" game. Experience being a Reloader: having legendary shooting skills and engaging in Close-Quarters Combat(CQC). You just have to remember how to use the gun you’re holding.

Nettoyez les déchets océaniques dans ce court jeu relaxant ! Recyclez, gagnez des pièces et améliorez votre bateau. Explorez de nouvelles zones, nettoyez des déversements plus importants et différents types de déchets !

Arcanium is an Open-world, Strategy Card Adventure that merges Roguelite and Deckbuilding genres like never before. Control your party of three heroes, craft your deck, unlock a vast amount of cards and items and save the world of Arzu from corruption!

Black magic in the age of pike and shot! Reload your musket after every blast in “Heidelberg 1693”, a challenging 2D action adventure set in a dark and twisted vision of Germany in the late 17th century.
Deep Despair is a Minecraft-style survival sandbox. Travel, collect resources, craft items, dig, build, grow crops and survive. Freedom of action is limited only by your imagination!

titre: 告死天使的审判 Death Angel Trial
description: This is a game about online violence, all of which are based on the personal experience of the producer and shared with netizens. As far as possible to reduce the reality of one after another bloody cruel phenomenon. Today's victims may only be a little-known person, and the next It could be you.

The Bounty V2 is a retro-inspired competitive RPG, with an East meets West approach, deviously combined with an arcade high score sensibility. An experience that will challenge your wits as you push to survive, uncover a multitude of secrets, and earn the high score.

Une secte de cannibales, un clan guerrier de suprémacistes humains ou un couvent elfique qui protège toute forme de vie : Noble Fates est un simulateur de royaume de fantasy dans lequel vous créez le royaume de vos rêves et regardez des histoires émerger des ambitions et souvenirs de vos mortels.

Participez à un spectacle mystérieux, se déroulant loin de la civilisation. Le roman visuel Roll of Fate vous donnera l'occasion de prendre des décisions dont dépendra la vie participants du spectacle. Ne tentez pas de sauver tout le monde - ce n'est pas un fait que tu peux te sauver.

Dans Trackmania² Lagoon, évoluez sur des pistes surplombant une île tropicale remplie d'activités démentes. Le jeu comprend une campagne solo exclusive, un nouveau mode, un multijoueur intense et un monde de possibilités pour créer vos contenus.

Spate is a surreal experience set in a world that seeks to draw the player into its reality. Spate is a dark, brooding, and beautifully crafted emotional journey that is seen through the eyes of a struggling addict.

You are Jillian Cleary: an ex-spy on the run, framed for treason and hunted by your former agency. You must move in secret, survive off the grid, and find a way to clear your name. Old friends and new allies will lend their support; but with the eyes of the world upon you, who can you trust?

Take on the role of a Dark Elder God and lead your agents to bring about an apocalypse in a fantasy world. Work in the shadows, avoiding the heroes who will try to stop you, as you bring about plague and famine, ice age and volcanic destruction, madness and never ending night.

Créé par une seule personne, un jeu d'aventure open world rempli de personnages fous et de terribles secrets. Explorez les forêts, trouvez des chemins cachés, hackez et coupez à travers des monstres étranges, et essayez très fort de ne pas briser la réalité. Ou ne le faites pas. Faites ce que vous voulez.

titre: Reaper: Les Contes de Lame Sombre
description: Entre dans un monde débordant de magie et de monstres ! Devient Lame Sombre et découpe des milliers d'ennemis dans ce RPG d'action épique !
Can I float in life without becoming trapped in the mire of the dirt , is myconfidence。Charm them with your personal charm
Libérez l'énergie de votre fond d'écran! Changez de couleur et créez des effets qui réagissent à votre souris. Parfait pour les PC personnalisés.

Become a Legend in Jacob's Quest Anniversary Edition, a JRPG that anyone can pick up and play. Save the four crystals of the world and prevent a vile plot from unfolding. With epic battles and world progression, Jacob's Quest is the RPG of choice. Now remade from the ground up for modern gaming!

Canary in a Crater is an asteroid-delving 2D platformer about digging deep, uncovering valuables, and fighting off hungry alien snails. Spend your hard-earned credits on a wide variety of unlockable gadgets and upgrades to get you deeper and deeper!

Aces Wild is a fast-paced, hardcore, aerial beat 'em up!Engage in insane aerial martial arts combat against countless opponents!It utilizes a 'Wild Meter' which increases the power of your attacks butalso makes enemies more aggressive!
Dead Drop is a tense two-player game of espionage and deception, where one player has to blend into a crowd and mimic AI movement to avoid detection from the other player.
The incremental tree striking platformer, strike trees, collect them, die and make the numbers go up.

Devenez chef d’un culte et libérez une puissance divine dans ce RPG stratégique de dark fantasy. Vous êtes le méchant : commandez vos adeptes, déjouez vos ennemis en combat et façonnez le destin de la cité déchue en réveillant les Dieux Morts — Colère, Désir et Folie.

A time-limited survival game infused with rogue-lite elements and an adorable art style! The world has plunged into darkness, and you are its sole beacon of hope. Will you endure until dawn, or succumb to repeated deaths in your quest? Fear not, for you can collect more coins to arm yourself!

You awaken in a field of snow with no memory of even your name. The local monstrosities nearly devour you before you meet your rescuer, a beautiful girl named Kuon—who has animal ears and a tail. She names you Haku⸺ The Japanese hit tactics-RPG visual novel series returns to PC at last!

B-1LL1 est un platformeur post apocalyptique qui intéressera les joueurs les plus hardcore. Incarnez B-1LL1 à la recherche d’orbes d’énergies dispersés partout dans votre environnement et traversez un monde détruit par une catastrophe que vous apprendrez à connaître.
100% Free 'Hip-Fire' Arcade Shooter! Instead of using crosshairs or sights on gun, Vaccine19 has the player visualize shot trajectory. Don't Get Infected!
AUDICA™ is a VR “rhythm shooter” that combines Harmonix’s award-winning music gameplay with precision shooting mechanics and a 33-song soundtrack, all set in a mesmerizing cosmic arena.
At Dead Of Night is part horror film, part horror game and part ghost hunt. It blends live-action and graphics to create a unique immersive horror experience like no other.

"Elmarion : Temps du Dragon" est un jeu de rôle dont le personnage principal est le dragon ! Beaucoup d'aventures et de tâches à accomplir en contrôlant non pas un personnage humain, comme dans la plupart des jeux de rôle, mais un dragon volant ignivome, attendent le joueur.

FIT Food is a multiplayer card game with a new battle mode called CUBE RUN. We developed it to make nutritional education in schools, universities, companies, and healthcare organizations more engaging.

In the second game of this fantastic series, after a strange abduction, Digueliro, Bartolomeu and Rubens are obligated to work togheter. Following the tracks of Dr.Chanislavski they need to retrace his steps to get out of this place. Are our heros capable of this prowess and get out safely?

titre: Lost Lands: The Golden Curse Collector's Edition
description: Susan, qui est déjà célèbre dans toutes les Terres Perdues, retourne dans ce monde mystérieux ! Cette fois-ci, elle devra affronter l'ancienne malédiction des druides. Et plus...

Lancez des dés magiques et constituez une équipe de puissantes chimères afin d'arrêter un mystérieux mal dans cette aventure tactique roguelite. En tant qu'invocatrice, recrutez et créez l'équipe ultime de créatures mythiques que vous mènerez à la victoire à l'aide de mécaniques de dés uniques.

Inspired by arcade game experiences, Drive By Hero is an apocalyptic shooter game. Shoot enemies, kill bosses, use new weapons and try to survive in this horrific action game. Alone with your car and your gun, you are not the hero they deserve but the one they need.

titre: Connected Hearts: The Full Moon Curse Collector's Edition
description: Une humble guérisseuse est accusée de sorcellerie et pourchassée tandis que son bien-aimé est infecté et deviendra bientôt un loup-garou. Ce couple malchanceux pourra-t-il résister à la tempête et atteindre le bonheur ensemble ? Jouez au jeu et découvrez-le !

Rendezvous is an adventure game set in a futuristic Indonesia. For Setyo to save his sister from sharing his own fate, he must return to the streets of Neo-Surabaya before it's too late. Is it truly possible to redeem the sins of your past?

Concevez un centre d'arcade impressionnant, achetez une gamme de machines d'arcade, gérez le personnel difficile dans ce jeu coloré et humoristique. Inspiré de Two Point Hospital, Prison Architect et Planet Coaster.
Antenna Dilemma est un court point and click plein d'esprit dans lequel vous suivrez C432632, un cube gris pointilleux et prêt à tout pour ne pas rater le début de son émission favorite.

Un jeu de plateforme et d'énigmes d'un autre monde aussi beau que complexe ; découvrez deux âmes liées par un même destin, une fille et son âme sœur, vouées à traverser un monde d'une élégance envoûtante.

Take the title for the fastest Jumpah alive, and in the process make your friends hate their lives! Parkour, Spleef, Rage, anger, frustration, despair, depression, and lots of colors! What more could you ask for? New maps and game modes coming soon :)
What has Bunny done? Why does everyone want to kill him? And why is Carrot so delicious? You’ll find all the answers in this game…
Pictopix est un jeu de réflexion dans lequel vous utilisez la logique pour colorer les cases d'une grille dans le but de révéler des images.

Journey to the dark heart of the Edgewood Home for Lost Children in this fiendishly difficult action RPG!When her teacher stepped out of the classroom a month ago, Cordy never imagined he would be gone for good. Now her fellow students have turned on each other as the school descends into chaos.

Une puissance maléfique millénaire s'est réveillée et la lutte pour sauver l'humanité a commencé ! Agent d'élite de l'organisation spécialisée en chasse au monstre Prodigium, vous allez utiliser une multitude d'armes, d'améliorations, d'objets magiques pour défendre l'humanité des hordes surnaturelles de la Princesse Ahmanet.

The game is a first person Gothic action adventure game set in the medieval kingdom of Uhorsko. You play Dominik, a young alchemist summoned to protect the kingdom from a ravenous beast. Dominik's goals soon change as he discovers he has been bitten, and cursed to become the very thing he has set out to stop.

KR-17 is a 32-bit, story-driven, side-scrolling action puzzle-platformer which follows the story of a military robot on a mission to subdue a rogue agent operating out of an installation on the planet Valiant. It will be the first in a multi-genre series of games centered around the story of Terrius, KR-17's home.

A twin stick shooter without the twin stick, Gunlocked is a sci-fi action roguelike about careful positioning and upgrade selection. Manage unique targeting systems across multiple weapons and upgrades, as you battle legions of alien ships, and then do it all over again!

Meatgrinder est un FPS chaotique et rapide. Utilise l'agilité et les armes à feu pour te frayer un chemin à travers des niveaux insensés en plus des camions, des trains et des avions qui accélèrent. Pas de cinématiques ou de scénarios, juste de l'action pure.

Le "wenjia" est une plate-forme de jeu d'aventure, le joueur peut faire la navette entre deux mondes différents (le monde physique et le monde d’énergie) dans un monde différent avec différents organes d'aventures et de t'attendre à explorer.

Travel back in time and witness the horrors of slave trade firsthand. You will be working as young slave steward on a ship crossing the Atlantic. You are to serve the captain and be his eyes and ears. What do you do, when you realize that your own sister has been captured by the slave traders?
🥖👩‍🍳🍔 Un jeu de cuisine relaxant et sans stress ! Préparez des burgers pour d'adorables chats-robots et des extraterrestres. Jouez en solo ou avec jusqu'à 7 de vos amis !
Tire pleinement parti de commandes sophistiquées (mais sans bouton de saut) pour explorer des mondes rétro créés à la main dans ce vibrant hommage aux collectathons de l'ère N64 !

Voilà le quartier ! Incarnez la star d'une émission télévisée effrontée qui se venge de son horrible voisin en lui faisant constamment des farces à la maison et dans le monde de la manière la plus créative et la plus ridicule.

Join Sunday, a 14-year-old boy who moves with his family to Calendar Town, where mysterious deaths and suicide cases seem to occur. Tragedy will come when one of his relatives is found dead in his home. Help Sunday and his friends on this visual novel rpg with dreamcore and aesthetic style.
A programming workplace horror comedy. Ascend through an eldritch tower. Input your movements ahead. Dodge unknown entities. Complain in the private chat. Get back to work.

"Escape First" est un jeu de puzzle multijoueur pour réalité virtuelle ou PC de bureau ! Il comprend [3] différentes salles d'évasion [/] [/] au choix et peut être joué en compétition, en coopération ou en solo.
A 10 minute horror experience of a girl walking home alone at night.

AI: Art Impostor is an AI drawing party game for 3-8 players. You are a progressive artist who commands AI to generate images, and you don't need aesthetic talent to draw good artwork. It only takes 5 mins to play, and multiplayer between Steam, Android, and iOS is supported!

Watch your videos in virtual reality with Simple VR Video Player, an easy to use video player with full motion control support and an intuitive interface. Simple VR Video Player can play your saved video files with 2D/180°/360° and 3D/SBS/OU support.

You awake to discover yourself no longer in the company of good men or a fine seafaring vessel. Treasure... you remember something about treasure. Wayward is a challenging turn-based, top-down, wilderness survival roguelike. Explore, build, and most importantly survive in these unforgiving lands.
SugarWinds: sail, establish a colony, make it thrive, and defend it from attacks. Trade worldwide. Enjoy and chill!

KW2B ajoute d'énormes sièges et de la survie à la stratégie médiévale. Explorez une histoire épique et un système de fabrication complexe tout en survivant à des sièges brutaux ainsi qu'à des combats contre d'autres joueurs et contre des hordes de zombies.

Her future, as well as of the whole world depends on her ingenuity and bravery. The path to her fiancé is blocked by ghosts, dragons, demons and other creatures from beyond. Will she overcome her fears? Will she find her beloved? Play "Cursed" and find out!
Jouez pour la justice avec jusqu’à 3 amis dans ce jeu de tir multijoueur coopératif en évolution. Explorez des biomes, découvrez des mini-jeux, trouvez des coffres et terrassez des boss et ennemis.

A modern-day open-world RPG about a secret world. With the help of your companions, some demons, some cats, and any supernatural entities you can bend to your will, all the different ways to solve problems, you may still fail to save the world. Life is simply unfair. But, will you stop trying?
Toggle Cubes is a game where you have to guide people to the stars by toggling cubes on and off. You have to overcome monsters, fireballs, and spikes by using keys and teleports.

titre: Nancy Drew®: Shadow at the Water's Edge
description: Confront Terrifying Secrets in a Haunted Japanese Inn!

Jet Lancer est un jeu de combat aérien dans lequel vous traquez des pilotes ennemis, démantelez des robots géants et défiez la mort à une vitesse supersonique en incarnant un mercenaire intrépide dans un futur proche.
Une fantastique histoire de détective sur un chat extraterrestre nommé Ash et son assistante virtuelle, vivant dans une métropole gouvernée par une intelligence artificielle.
Golden Dungeons - is a simple hardcore platformer game, the goal to get out of the cave. Try to pass all levels and not die!
Nayu is a fox who lives in a strangely cozy world.Go on a little adventure with Nayu ♪ in this adorable clicker-like game for everyone to enjoy.

The Complex IV is a turn-based RPG set in the world of Dungeons & Dragons. Using a subset of the SRD 5.1 ruleset, play solo or compete with up to 5 other players in scenarios designed to test your sword and sorcery skills against a relentless horde of monsters.
A cute game where you care about a green anime girl!
You have command of paramedics, fire brigades, police and disaster relief. Send your teams out on tense real-time missions to deal with disasters in Europe's major centres.
Sillonner la galaxie et traquer le mal : tel est le quotidien de Mighty Goose!
Code of Princess offers players an exciting yet unconventional experience, deftly blending the combo-heavy fighting gameplay of beat ‘em ups with the stat-boosting character customization of RPGs.

With Live2D VR Girls, you can experience VR experience with lively animated characters by Live2D. It is a game aimed at telling the charm of character expression with two scenarios and easy operation.

Astérix & Obélix XXL 2 est l’expérience ultime proposée par le jeu initial. Les nouveaux graphismes font honneur à la bande-dessinée et le gameplay a été totalement réajusté pour parfaire les bagarres contre les romains !
Blast aliens to pieces and start a rebellion in this fast paced pixel art top down shooter where sprinting kills.

titre: Alex Kidd in Miracle World DX
description: Avec de nouveaux graphismes en HD, des améliorations du gameplay et des animations, redécouvrez tous les niveaux du jeu original ainsi que de nouveaux qui développent l'histoire d'Alex Kidd.

Incarnez un enquêteur paranormal, explorez une forêt hantée en coopération avec jusqu'à 5 joueurs, levez la malédiction, découvrez une histoire tragique, décidez ensemble. Survrez-vous ou perdrez-vous votre âme ?
Gravity Cat - it's a puzzle-platformer. You play as a cat who has an ability to change the gravity.
Juliet, la légendaire chasseuse de zombies, est de retour en 4K !

Stan, un plongeur professionnel dans la Mer du Nord, lutte pour surmonter une disparition lors d'une longue mission sous-marine. Coincé dans la solitude qu'il s'est imposée, il commence à vivre d'étranges événements et devra faire le choix le plus important de son existence...

Plank Builders est un jeu de construction à la fois captivant et relaxant. Des billes magiques ont la capacité de donner vie à des petits singes en peluche. Ensemble, vous construisez bâtiments à partir de petites planches de bois. Trouvez tous les petits singes cachés et aidez-les à prendre vie!
New colours are constantly spawning - sort them faster than they arrive to win the round. Survive variations, purchase items, and even discover pets! Supports up to 4 local players.
Découvrez en Lozère, Javols, la capitale du Gévaudan antique entièrement reconstituée en réalité Virtuelle
Exit From - is a first-person horror-stealth game with quest and procedural generation elements where you have to get out of the old Soviet house, which changes every new game.

Codename: Panzers is an incredible real-time strategy thrill ride. Nerves of steel are required when you're a tank driver. One direct hit and you're done for, but you must throw yourself into the battle, because without your support, many will die. You are the tank commander - make the hard decisions that win wars!
Dark Void™ est un jeu d'aventure et de science fiction qui combine action et combats dans un univers parallèle appelé"The Void".
Un jeu d'évasion et de puzzle / aventure! Aidez Vala à réaliser son rêve et à devenir astronaute!
Surviving is the key point of this game, you need to act as a prisoner and escape from that place in a first-person perspective.

titre: 3D Earth Time Lapse PC Live Wallpaper
description: Fond d'écran 3D Interactive pour Windows 10/11. Et si vous pouviez contrôler la Station Spatiale Internationale (ISS) depuis votre fond d'écran?
A team based PVP game where groups of up to 8 players must work together to operate a tank!

titre: За Закатом Неминуем Рассвет - Интерактивный Роман
description: The Dawn is Inevitable is an interactive crime drama/neo-western novel inspired by classic RPG games. A mysterious stranger is forced to hide in a village called Rassvet. This place is isolated from the outside world for the whole winter and keeps many dark secrets.

AVRACH is a hack&slash game where you can also develop your racing skills using the robot avatar . Odds are stacked against him and strange creatures are challenging his every step, will Avrach ever save his beloved wife? Is he the chosen one? Will he fulfill the prophecy ? Let's play and find out.
Beltmatic is a casual factory game where you combine numbers using mathematical operations.
RYB is a logic puzzle game that plays like a combination of sudoku and minesweeper.
Chess game.
You've been elected as the new Bunker Warden! Now you must take control over a group of fellow bunker residents and try to make them last until the surface becomes habitable.

Emerald seas! Blue skies! Sandy beaches! An island adventure in the ocean sounds like a trip to paradise. However, the place is a nightmare with no one to provide any blood for Raylan to feed on after he turned into a vampire by accident, especially since he has another hungry vampire at his side.

Bienvenue dans le mondre incroyable de Supermagical, un jeu de puzzle et d'aventure amusant. Combattez les hordes de Minix, améliorez vos puissants sorciers, choisissez judicieusement votre animal de compagnie et votre chapeau, domptez un dragon épique et parcourez les trois continents du monde à la recherche de vos Soeurs Sorcières...
studio: Super Awesome Hyper Dimensional Mega Team

description: Le tout premier PUNCH & CLICK ! Brok est un jeu d'aventure innovant combiné à des éléments de beat 'em all et RPG. Dans un monde sinistré où les animaux ont remplacé l'humanité, quel genre de détective serez-vous ?

Vade Retro est un jeu PvP d'exorcisme jusqu'à 4 joueurs. Incarnez un démon et faites vivre l'enfer à vos adversaires, ou rejoignez l'équipe des exorcistes en choisissant une spécialité pour sauver les victimes de l'emprise du diable dans cette expérience pleine d'action.

READY FOR CRAFTING VIRTUAL WORLDS ON YOUR PC?The acclaimed world-building game featuring a unique mission-based approach is coming onto PC via Steam Early Access. With over 16 million players on mobile & tablets versions and 1,500,000 pixel blocks creations shared in the Online Gallery to date, this PC version is taking world...

Depths of Peril est un jeu d'action et de rôle avec des éléments de stratégie. Vous jouez en tant que chef d'une faction qui a pour mission de protéger une cité Barbare, Jorvik, des assauts de monstres terrifiants. Vous aurez également à remplir des quêtes et à combattre d'autres factions pour le contrôle de la ville.

Kindergarten secret - detective, horror and puzzle in one game. You will be able to play as several characters in the frame of one game, complete twenty unique quests and uncover the main secret of the story.
Le démineur, mais les règles changent d'une partie à l'autre !
Explore dungeons with your own army and try to make the most efficient corps.
Navigate the player to the landing pad through twenty increasingly difficult levels within the time limit and with enough fuel.

Neuf divinités. Neuf héros. Et seulement un champion. La Grèce mythique. Terre des dieux, des poètes, des héros mais aussi d'atroces monstres et créatures.Numen est un jeu de rôle à l'action tridimensionnelle qui prend place dans la mythologie grecque.
Devenez un pro de l'évasion.

Je me souviens de Scary Movie, oui ;) Alors… Dans la vie de chaque femme, il arrive un moment où elle pousse la mauvaise porte… Le dernier souvenir que j’ai, c’est une soirée costumée dans une boîte de nuit, et un grand type musclé avec un accent biélorusse qui a proposé de m’offrir un cocktail…

Mysteries of Perception est un jeu d’enquête dans lequel vous verrez une même scène au travers des yeux de différents personnages. Révélez leurs secrets en analysant tous les indices. Alternez les points de vue pour découvrir tout des artéfacts du Lointain et des morts dans leur sillage.
The Alpha-Draconian army to which you belong is one of the most powerful of the Galaxy, and you are one of the most capable pilots of this army having fought in countless battles...

H.I.A: Horror Investigation Agency is a fun multiplayer horror game in which you and co-players have to investigate exciting horror cases. Among finding victims and evidence of the horror event that has taken place, you will be faced with jumpscares and scary monsters along your investigation.

You are the last hope of a ruined world, capable of restoring the severed Ley Lines. Throughout the ruined temple of Miria's Heart, attune to and master five unique powers, allowing you to alter gravity, slow time, shift space, and much more.
Trouvez le moyen de détruire les artefacts anciens !

Clouds of war are shaping over the endless Folvos desert. You cannot wait any longer. Choose your side and take command! Lead your soldiers, tanks and aircraft to victory through Folvos varying landscapes across dozens of battles.
Ghost case is a horror adventure game.
Qu’ est-il arrivé aux habitants de Rockytown ? Venez vous amuser à la kermesse du village, avec 4 mini-jeux passionnants.

A dark horror MMO inspired by the writings of H. P. Lovecraft. Infinite dungeon exploration, boss raids, guilds, PvP, leaderboards, and the destruction of your soul by an uncaring immortal e̵̺̙̺̥̅͆̾̽̈̇̇̂̑̊͊̽̕͜͝lde̸̮͔̞̮͖͖̙̍̒̽̓r̶̨̹̠̪̫͓̻͍̥͇̄͌͂̋̊̚ g̶̩̮̙̾̎̌̋̎͌͘͠oḓ̸̛̮̦̮͎͖̖͖͕͊͋̉̂́͛ slowly devouring the universe.

Vous avez été embauché comme maître de donjon par la Compagnie des Donjons. Votre mission est simple : protéger leurs donjons ! Legend of Keepers : Prologue est une alpha jouable qui vous aidera à vous familiariser avec les mécaniques de jeu.
Wealth. Women. Wildly offbeat jokes. Lie, cheat, steal, and embrace your inner rogue. Being bad has never felt so good.

SpiderPunks is a unique blend of three-game genres: Builder/Defense, Action, and Puzzle. Earn money and spend it on new spider's web connections. Buy new spiders or heal injured ones. Get experience to develop more spider's skills to fight against toxic soap bubbles.

Citadelum est un jeu de construction de ville qui se passe dans la Rome Antique. Construisez votre propre cité, rassemblez des ressources et faites-en une magnifque ville. Explorez le monde, commercez et menez vos légions dans des batailles épiques. Gagnez la faveur des dieux ou défiez-les.

Vous avez effectué un atterrissage forcé sur une dangereuse planète extraterrestre. Vous n'avez ni nourriture ni médicaments, et vous êtes un peu à l'ouest... mais une chose est sûre : vous avez absolument besoin d'amis !

Millions of players worldwide have flown, built, and fought their way through Captain Forever. CF Trilogy brings Captains Forever, Successor, and Impostor to Steam with a beautiful new renderer, new modules, and a reimagined world written by acclaimed novelist Cassandra Khaw.

Penelope Barker and Aaron S. Reid are agents of the extra-governmental Pandora Global Corp, which works in parallel with the CIA. Unbeknown to them, they are also guinea pigs in an ambitious and dangerous project...

Prenez commande d’un mécha pour repousser une invasion extraterrestre dans StarVaders, un mélange explosif de deckbuilding et de tactique. Créez des combos dévastateurs, remontez le temps et protégez l’avenir de l’humanité dans ce roguelike au potentiel de rejouabilité infini.
Become an inventor and expert in robotics! Construct, program, play.
Fight For Eden is a fantasy action-RPG VR game where you will follow the story of a young orc enrolled to fight against the half elves' oppression.
Panzer Ball is a fast-paced 3D platformer inspired by the classic surf and bunnyhop game modes. Jump in and see how fast you can complete the courses in both single and multiplayer.

Bienvenue dans la révolution industrielle ! Menez à bien votre activité en plein essor, construisez et développez de nouvelles industries, multipliez votre revenu et ne vous faites pas avoir par vos adversaires. Montrez à tout le monde que c’est vous qui tenez les rênes.

South of Midnight est le nouveau jeu d'action-aventure de Compulsion Games. Laissez-vous emporter dans les mythes du Sud profond et affrontez d'étranges créatures dans ce conte moderne. Maîtrisez un pouvoir de tissage ancestral et surmontez des obstacles pour dévoiler les secrets de votre famille.

titre: SUPER DRAGON BALL HEROES WORLD MISSION
description: Super Dragon Ball Heroes World Mission est un jeu de cartes tactique avec des combats palpitants, une stratégie digne des meilleurs jeux de cartes et une histoire incroyable qui se déroule dans l'immense univers de Dragon Ball Heroes !

NVL - un jeu d'aventure incroyable dans le genre de RPG. Un système de tour de combat intéressant comme dans JRPG. Magnifiquement filles anime avec pantsu. Avec votre fille fidèle, vous allez à de nouvelles terres. Aidez les gens des villages et des villes. Combattez épaule à épaule avec votre petite amie sexy.

Un jeu de survie et de jardinage dans le désert. Partez d'une source minuscule et cultivez un jardin florissant. Explorez un vaste monde couvert de sable. Parviendrez-vous à vous défendre contre l'étrange corruption spectrale, pour raviver la vie dans un monde en perdition ?

Argentum Online, a 2D MMORPG, offers epic quests, dungeon delves, and battles in a fantasy world. Emphasizing community, it features alliances, PvP, and a player-driven economy, all within a vibrant open-world setting.
Explore dead civilizations, write about what you find, and share your stories with the universe: a game about writing fiction.
Killer 19 is a storyboard game created by skyline studio. Its highlight is the story. Unpredictable plot, more hidden levels, waiting for your experience.

Zuma girl is a casual marble shooting game, which integrates RPG skills and strategies with traditional Zuma playing methods. You will meet three beautiful girls in the battle. Who is stronger or weaker? Only the brave survive to the end!
Ultimate Live Wallpaper is an amazing lightweight live wallpaper engine with stunning 3D animation effects and mouse interaction.

A darkness has fallen over the town of Lorwich. Monstrous hordes emerge from beyond the realm of nightmares to sow chaos on the land. As one of four heroes, you must battle the minions of the old ones with the force of arms, and the power of illumination.

Garage est un shooter sanglant inspiré des l'ère des films de série B en VHS. Vous jouez sous les traits d'un dealer de drogue nommé Butch qui doit à lui tout seul dégommer des hordes de mort-vivants pour sauver une fille.

Compete against friends in games filled with unpredictable twists and turns. Roll the dice to gather resources and test your adaptability. Lead your kingdom to success through military power, religious knowledge, or architectural ingenuity.
Arcadian Atlas est un Tactical RPG sur les choix que font les gens au nom de l'amour et du pouvoir, et comment ces décisions déchirent un royaume tout entier.
欢迎来到原石计划，你已成为计划的一部分。在这个计划里，你将带领辛西娅逃出危险的地下研究所，战棋+卡牌+roguelike+DBG的玩法和丰富MOD将给你带来独特的全新体验

This is a very challenging war chess + roguelike game, with random mazes, free combination of teams, and turn-based combat. In the game, players will lead all kinds of undead to counterattack the human world!
studio: Sichuan Fruit Interactive Technology Co., Ltd.

description: Terrassez le sorcier pour sauver votre fille !

La suite du jeu RV le plus juteux de tous les temps ! Constituez votre collection de lames et d'arcs. Franchissez des niveaux et des mini-jeux uniques. Explorez le monde vibrant de Fruitasia et devenez un maître de Fruit Ninja !
为各位皇家学院的新学员精心准备了兑换码： 1. XXUK8XPTHM 2. 6BE263F33X 3. PT7KHG2VR6 时之扉官方网站：www.chronoportal.cn 时之扉官方QQ群：460219387 时之扉官方微博：时之扉手游 时之扉官方公众号：时之扉重启手游

How long has it been? A man sits in a distant getaway cabin waiting for his wife Serena. Where is she? Things in the cabin evoke memories, and the husband comes to a disturbing realization... This short point-and-click adventure is the result of a massive collaborative effort between dozens of fans and designers of adventure games.
Evolve through the history of video games in this fun-filled blast from the past.
Take the stage in Shining Song Starnova!

To End All Wars est un nouveau jeu de stratégie centré sur l'un des plus grands conflits de l'histoire : la Première Guerre mondiale. Dans ce titre de Grande Stratégie, les joueurs peuvent prendre le contrôle de l'une des grandes alliances qui ont combattu de longues années durant, en Europe et sur le reste du globe.

titre: The Lords of the Earth Flame
description: The Lords of The Earth Flame is a novel game created in the best traditions of interactive fiction and text-based role-playing. Non-linear structure, rich text core, and the “analog” feel of times past are certain to provide unforgettable gaming experience for hours on end.
Langoth (Old English) means a very specific yearning, when a person had a vision of Paradise – and it was gone, but the rest of his life he was looking for it reflections.

titre: Mortadelo y Filemón: Terror, Espanto y Pavor
description: Mort and Phil travel to the world of horror cinema in this adventure, thanks to Dr. Bacterio (of course!).
Lipstick Assassin is a Pulp, Sci-Fi, Action, Glam game. An action packed spy world of the future.

Robowars is back on Steam! Fight off troops of droids for freedom and honor in our classical tower defense game. Lead the forces of the Solar Union to protect the peaceful planet of Praymos from the aggressive Trade Confederation.
Use clues to power up generators, find weapons to kill zombies, and utilize items to escape the bunker maze!

In Taphouse VR, you are the bartender! Run your own taphouse, give drunk dwarves their fill of delicious ale or drench the bunch by mixing delicious cocktails! Everything around the counter is yours to mess with - including your paying customers.
Rediscover MSI Electric City as you pilot a fighter ship with the mission to defend the city. Maneuver and blast away the enemy swarm in this VR bullet hell arcade shoot ’em up.

titre: Les aventures de Pedro en espagnol [Apprendre l'espagnol]
description: Êtes-vous prêt pour l'aventure ? Apprendre peut être amusant ! Tous les textes et les sons sont en espagnol. Grâce aux images et aux animations, vous n'aurez pas besoin de traduction pour apprendre.

Shell City est en état d'urgence après avoir subi l'attaque des forces dévastatrices PHANTOM. L'armée nationale peine à repousser PHANTOM, et elle ne voit plus qu'une seule solution pour sauver Shell City du chaos : le mastodonte coriace qui ne fait qu'une bouchée de ses cacahuètes et des méchants... TEMBO THE BADASS ELEPHANT!

Discover the secrets of the estate, as you look for answers among the violent inhabitants. A strange and repelling madness took hold of the servants roaming the halls, and they will attack on sight, for their madness is one rooted in a deeper understanding of cosmic insignificance.
Shoot rubber ducky arrows, pound enemies with a rhino hammer, and help Beethoven get his groove back in the last totally normal high school themed RPGvania you’ll ever want.
Get prepared for the FIRST EVER shooter game based on Rage Comics ! Rage Wars is a well-made action game with a variety of weapons, worlds and enemies to challenge with.

"Warbanners" est un jeu au tour par tour mélangeant stratégie tactique avec des éléments de jeu de rôle. Tout en gérant une escouade de mercenaires, le joueur pourra faire l'expérience d'une histoire s'étalant sur une campagne de 42 missions, avec pour objectif ultime de se faire une place parmi les légendes anciennes.

H-Hour: World's Elite™ is a TPV tactical, team-based multiplayer, military shooter in which cooperation among players is required for success on the battlefield. Designed by David Sears as a spiritual successor to the early SOCOM games.
Explore an ANGRY city, meet the WORST people, and beat 'em up with STYLE! Pick your fighter, FREEZE TIME, build custom combos, and knock out your enemies, all to save the president.
Let's go battle. Just enjoy it.
Tour par tour, Création de decks, Battle Royale. Jeu en solo ou en multijoueur simultané. Facile à jouer. Difficile à maîtriser. Découvrez le Battle Royale tactique.

Vous êtes un voyageur sans nom, perdu dans une ville de l'Ouest maudit. Utilisez votre intelligence, vos talents et votre artillerie. Construisez une ferme, travaillez la terre et survivez face à des monstres dans ce jeu de survie unique en son genre, seul ou entre amis !

Upon answering a mysterious phone call, you awaken in an unfamiliar place filled with new faces… Through intricate relationships and thoughtful introspection, will you be able to unravel the reason you are here?
OMNIFATE is a short little turn-based RPG with differences to tropes commonly used in its genre.
The Fantasy Board-game Engine that powers Kings&Catapults Free Cyvasse.

Asura est un jeu indépendant de Hack'n Slash, par niveau, situé dans un monde imaginaire inspiré par la richesse de la mythologie indienne. Il présente de puissants éléments de Rogue-like et un arbre de compétences procédural unique qui change à chaque partie.

titre: just a game to test your lQ
description: Wanna know about yourself better? Apply for a free lQ test provided by a Nobei Prize-winning doctor! The world's best experts will visit your house. You just need to solve a simple quiz.

titre: Stable Orbit - Build your own space station
description: Design, build and control your own space station. Mission command and control is in your hands and only careful planning and vigilant supervision will keep your crew and space station safe.
Cube Runner is a 3d action platformer that's simple to learn, exciting to play, and deep enough to challenge even the greatest gamers.

Wasted Pizza is an Online Multiplayer shooter game where you will be playing as an untouched pizza in a room full of all the other pizzas but be aware you aren't the only untouched pizza out there. Your mission is hiding amongst the other pizzas, spot and shoot tomatos on the other untouched pizzas.
Card-en-Ciel est un jeu de cartes roguelite avec plus de 300 cartes différentes et 50 chansons uniques !
QuiVr is the defining archery experience, made from the ground up for Virtual Reality. Grab your bow, arrows, and some friends to fight the enemy onslaught.

Imagine one day you wake up in the middle of a jungle without knowing who you are and what are you doing there. That's where the story of WAIDH begins. Try to survive the elements of the infinite jungle and of course, try to find the answers for those questions to solve the mystery of the game.

Strategy & Tactics: Wargame Collection regroupe trois jeux de stratégie historiques au tour par tour, où vous prenez le commandement des armées des plus grandes batailles du Moyen Âge ou des nations engagées dans la Seconde Guerre mondiale !

You are the sword; cut down your foes with steel and thunder. You are the wings; explore the skies and uncover unreachable mysteries. Embark on a journey through a vicious world ruled by darkness and imperial tyranny - the lands of Blackmist.

The unique word puzzle which combines the skill of Sudoku with the knowledge of Scrabble®. Lexica has been featured in a number of UK daily newspapers but is now available for the first time in an interactive form.

Une incroyable suite d’une histoire d’apprentissage dynamique et intéressante dans le Golden Shower Order! Des filles animées flashy et juteuses vous attendent! Un jeu simple mais fascinant avec un mélange de Visual Novel et Match3.

With a completely new and simple hide and shoot gameplay, it will help players have a good Action experience without having to get tired from moving too much. Players will go through 16 campaigns in 16 different locations to confront enemies, bosses and zombies.

Les ninjas sont cool, c'est une réalité de l'univers. Les robots nazis de l'espace ne sont pas cool, ils sont même à l'opposé. Attention car Robot Hitler recherche le premier ninja du monde, c'est-à-dire vous !Vous avez 10 secondes pour détruire tous les robots nazis proches. C'EST... PARTI !

A serial killer is terrorizing the city, and Sara's deadbeat boyfriend hasn't done the laundry. Can Sara survive a late-night trip to the laundromat, or will the Womb Ripper perform an early delivery?

Ultimate Admiral: Age of Sail est un jeu de guerre tactique développé par les créateurs de la série Ultimate General. Le jeu se situe au cœur des campagnes navales épiques à l'époque de la Révolution américaine et des Guerres napoléoniennes.

PESTICIDE is a raw reflex action FPS that puts a heavy emphasis on total mayhem against nasty humanoid man-eating cockroaches. Exterminate them all through the desolate and filthy city districts, collect trophies and skins, find secrets and save adult actress Pussy Katty from their clutches.
La Nation est en danger et seul le président Michael Wilson peut encore déjouer les plans machiavéliques du vice-président Richard Hawk et de ses légions mécanisées.
L'homme qui se tient dans le coin de votre chambre d'hôtel veut que vous cliquiez sur quelque chose. Il veut vous regarder cliquer.

Polity est un MMORPG décontracté et multiplateforme. Gouvernez votre colonie, rejoignez d'autres colonies et maîtrisez des compétences comme l'agriculture et la pêche. Profitez de quêtes, réussites, puzzles, mini-jeux, artisanat et personnalisation. Tracez votre propre chemin dans ce monde dynamique

Marisa was suddenly summoned to a different world! It seems this world was invaded by alien. But the truth isn't simple. Now Marisa is in total isolation. She must fight to survive. Can she expose the truth, save the world and Reimu, finally return to Gensokyo?

"2021" is an interesting and innovative small game, simple operation, just use 4 digital keys to control the ball, think carefully, make a reasonable jump in a random scene, reach the end to finish the game.Tired of playing big works, you might as well calm down to enjoy this different small game.
Abode is an escape room puzzle game. You will have to find, combine and utilize tools and furniture in the room to unveil all its secrets.

titre: Making History II: The War of the World
description: What if Germany won the Battle of Britain? What if Moscow fell in 1942?You’re in charge. Anything can happen and history will never repeat itself in this classic WWII grand strategy game MAKING HISTORY II: The War of the World. Are you ready to battle for global dominance?

Comprenez le Tir. Comprenez le JeuRetrouvez des actions de chasse rapide à la poursuite des plus gros trophées d'un bout à l'autre de l'Amérique du Nord, Canada et maintenant du Massif Bavarois!Folie d'Étendue Sauvage !
OPG: Clan Wars — jeu d’action multijoueur avec des éléments de survie. Arène de tir, monde ouvert, fabrication et lutte pour les ressources — combats, progresse et survis seul ou en équipe.
A space trader & combat sim meets squad-RPG, large scale conquest, choice driven gameplay with fluid & punchy tactical real-time combat set in a dynamic open-world sandbox.

Crypt Custodian est un charmant metroidvania sur le nettoyage de l'au-delà. Incarnez Pluto, un chat malicieux ayant perdu la vie et condamné à devenir le concierge du monde de la vie après la mort. À JAMAIS ! Côtoyez d'autres fantômes, combattez des bêtes et explorez un vaste territoire.
There is time to explain, I just don't wanna.
V696 is a first-person horror-thriller game. It contains a cult subject of veiled beings. Even if everything seems clear at first glance, it has a gripping story that will throw you a curve.

The game adopts a real-time combat system, allowing players to choose to join the navy or pirate guild, presenting a legendary life of the navy fighting against pirates. The game has a rich trading system.
FLASHBACK™, the hit action-adventure game with over 2.2 million units sold, is back!
Prenez le contrôle des sept péchés capitaux pour forger votre destin dans une quête pour l'humanité.

Arcane Assembly is a fantasy metroidvania where you create spells using a visual programming language. Unlock new instructions, upgrade your powers, and fight epic bosses on your journey to becoming the most powerful wizard who ever lived.

Le nouvel épisode de la série Gunvolt, jeu d'action en 2D ultra-rapide, arrive enfin avec Azure Striker Gunvolt 3. Mêlant une intrigue passionnante et un gameplay stimulant, Gunvolt 3 est l'épisode le plus extravagant de la série à ce jour !

In the far-off year of 20XX, constant attacks and hostility from an evil secret society have caused several private defense companies to spring up around Japan. Determined to get revenge for the destruction of her hometown, Haruka joins the public defense corp!

Station Commander is an economy strategy game that has you take control of a futuristic space station. Your goal is to build ships, gather resources, and trade with neighboring planets to upgrade your station and ships. Upgrading your station gives you access to better ships and ship abilities.

INFESTSTATION is a multiplayer Sci-Fi horror game. Board danger-filled abandoned space craft, work together to complete objectives, and sever the dimensional gateways that have allowed horrifying threats to take over and infest these now derelict spaces.

iBomber Defense combine le jeu de défense avec des tourelles avec l'action et la stratégie. Contenez l'invasion ennemie avec différentes armes : du canon explosif à la mitrailleuse en passant par l'artillerie anti-aérienne !

A grim sequel to the puzzle of guessing words. The rules are the same - you need to guess the word, and you have the right to make a mistake 6 times, otherwise the man will be in the noose. And be careful - the game contains many secrets...
A colorful and relaxing puzzle game with calming sounds and visuals.
Orb of Creation is a non-idle incremental-puzzle game in which you recreate the world with nothing but magic and ingenuity. Conjure resources, buy upgrades, and become an all-powerful wizard!

Shift into high gear and defend the moon! In this top-down rougelike vehicle shooter, gun down monsters and upgrade your Polycar to fend off against increasingly difficult waves of alien invaders! Do you have what it takes to win?

titre: Carlos III y la difusión de la antigüedad
description: "Charles III of Spain and the antiquity" tells the story of how Charles III funded the excavations that discovered the ancient cities of Herculaneum and Pompeii, spreading the knowledge acquired throughout Europe and America.

titre: 牧剑：化神书(Tale Of Swords: Mystery Scroll)
description: 《牧剑：化神书》是一款3D即时战斗的仙侠风格角色扮演游戏。故事从主角李朔在三清山悠闲的日子开始，突然闯来求助的金丹门弟子，宣告了主角幸福日子的完结。然而走出师门，李朔才发现，这世界上，还有另一张巨大的网似乎已经逐渐张开。玩家也将跟随李朔一起，一步步踏足这个充满未知的世界。

fault - milestone two side:above is a Cinematic Visual Novel that takes place right after the events of milestone one. Please note that this novel is a direct sequel to fault - milestone one and contains massive spoilers of the first story. Play through of the first title is highly advised.

Conçois ta station spatiale de rêve dans Space Architect ! Maîtrise l'automatisation ou 'engage' une armée d'équipage pour gérer la production. Exploite des astéroïdes, fabrique des biens et commerce pour rembourser la menaçante Big Evil Corp. Parviendras-tu à prospérer dans l'espace ?

A turn-based strategy game set in ancient Greece. Lead your very own Greek forces to victory in this simple but endearing game of ingenuity and tactics. Master the command of your troops, dominate the field, and prove your mettle as a general.

Play as Scarlett, a freelance cyborg ninja, in a neon city filled with corporate drones. Use her top of the line sword and bio enhancements to dash throughout the city and chain your dashes through drones. Make sure to watch your health, too many mistakes and you might Flatline.
WIN THE GAME: DO IT! - is a hardcore game. Try to finish the game without spending your nerves.

1883, SANTA FE. la paix est brisée par un kidnapping. Rassemblez les hommes et partez à la chasse aux hors-la-loi. Bagarres au saloon, duels et détournements de trains en perspective. A vous les espaces du Far West.

Nothing beats the excitement of playing against friends. In Wacky Wheels, you can do just that. Play with a friend in split-screen mode, play head-to-head using a modem connection or play via serial (null-modem) cable. Race against challenging computer opponents with adjustable difficulty settings.

Sink Again est un jeu de pirates humoristique et mixant les genres : de la tactique au tour par tour, de la découverte de donjon, des combats navals... Recrutez un équipage, nommez un capitaine et lancez-vous dans l'aventure d'un monde entièrement créé pour l'occasion.

Partez pour un voyage épique avec les vieux héros, ces champions légendaires autrefois célébrés dans tout le royaume et désormais oubliés... Jusqu'à cette nouvelle quête du Roi, la plus épique de toutes : EMMENER LES PRINCESSES JUMELLES À L'ÉCOLE !

Dim Glow est un jeu décontracté où vous contrôlez une sphère sombre et vous devez tirer sur les ennemis, pour chaque coup vous obtenez un point. Vous avez également un nombre limité de balles et 4 vies qui vous sont enlevées si vous êtes touché. Et combien de fois pourrez-vous frapper des ennemis?

A retro shooter with a new power: the power to become any ship.Lost in the depths of space, you are a being of pure psychic energy with the uncanny power to take over and control anything you see in order to survive.Built for PC, Enemy Mind lets you battle your way through 70+ waves of challenging enemies.

A single-player 2D top-down pixel game with space physics. Mine asteroids in the middle of an asteroid field using manual controls or by directing mining drones. Protect the outpost, buy from trading ships, mine as much ore as you can and survive as long as possible! Do you have what it takes?

Tinker Racers is a Survival Racing Party Game. Drive mini RC cars through tracks built around the house with common, everyday items. Forget the finishing line and just try to stay in sight! Up to four friends can join forces or compete with each other on local multiplayer!
Imagine a world where death is no longer final, where precious memories are saved to enjoy forever, where your soul is immortal. Master Reboot is a haunting first-person sci-fi adventure.
It is WAR!Team up with your comrades to stand against the pesky aliens.

titre: Nightork Adventures - Beyond the Moons of Shadalee
description: Nightork Adventures - Beyond the Moons of Shadalee is an arcade shooter game. You fly with a spaceship through procedurally generated caves and fight against evil demons using magic colors. There is a campaign of 30 levels and 6 boss monsters. It also comes with a level editor, so you can create your own caves and missions.

Nick is a free wave defense survival game—all in virtual reality. Built in Unreal engine, this first-person, room-scale VR experience lets users take control of a variety of weapons and tools to fight off endless waves of evil robotic elves.
The Flaws of Gravity is a first-person puzzle game where you change the direction of gravity to solve puzzles and uncover secrets in a labyrinth.
终年雾气笼罩的山区，封闭化管理的神秘高中，张泊岩作为转校生来到这个世界。凶案发生，自称雾之境主的凶手游荡在校园中。死亡步步逼近，反抗还是逃离？您将通过主角张泊岩的视角，最终揭示真相。

Palallel est un puzzle platformer 2D coopératif pour 2 joueurs. Vous êtes bloqués dans un tableau, sans voir votre partenaire. Vous devrez échanger des objets en les sortant de votre écran, ou activer des mécanismes pour vous échapper. Mettez votre communication à l’épreuve !
To start the game, select a level from the suggested ones. Start your journey and defeat the boss to go further.

Pride of Nations is a turn-based historical strategy game set in the colonial era of the 19th century, where the player takes control of a country and guides it through industrialization, military conquest, and colonization.
ABE VR is an intense experience that recreates the horrifying story about a misguided robot seeking the unconditional love of humans…at whatever cost.
A challenging puzzle platformer in which you clone and teleport.

Last Inua is an immersive and emotional platform adventure game developed by Glowforth. A captivating experience, Last Inua tells the tale of an Inuit family’s fight for survival in the harsh elements of the mythical Arctic. The Tonrar, a demonic trickster, has awoken in the arctic.

Final chapter of the trilogy. In a world where memory can be controlled, everyone is selling their souls. "I" have left everything behind, except the girl named Yin who still remains in my mind. At the end of my life, should I die with a beautiful fantasy, or go in search of sad memories of her?

titre: Ludo Online: Classic Multiplayer Dice Board Game
description: Ludo Online est un jeu de stratégie sur plateau qui se joue de deux à six joueurs, dans lequel les joueurs font la course avec leurs quatre pions, de leur case départ à la case d’arrivée, selon les résultats d’un seul dé.
Killer Queen Black est un jeu d’action-stratégie en équipe ultra-rapide. Deux équipes s’affrontent dans une arène arcade chaotique pour gagner avec des baies, l’escargot ou la domination militaire.

Bienvenue dans "Purple Place - Classic Games", un jeu amusant dans lequel vous vous lancerez dans trois aventures passionnantes comme au bon vieux temps ! Préparez-vous à vous immerger dans le monde de la créativité et du défi.

Racine est un Deckbuilding Autobattler Roguelike. Utilise tes cartes pour déclencher d'incroyables pouvoirs ou augmenter les stats de ton héros, trouver des artefacts et de nouvelles cartes pour développer ton propre style de jeu !

Hazel Sky est l’aventure poignante d’un jeune ingénieur affrontant sa destinée et ses désirs. Réparez des machines volantes déglinguées et sautez, grimpez, balancez-vous et glissez à travers ce beau et merveilleux monde.
Killon is a retro shooter that features exhilarating combat, manic enemies and a charged cannon waiting to be unleashed. Fly a starship across the universe and restore the future today.

La série pionnière de jeux de combat en 3D continue d'évoluer : Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage débarque sur Steam ! Avec à l'affiche la prise en charge du cross-play et du netcode rollback, un tout nouveau mode solo intitulé « World Stage », et bien plus encore !

Are you used to being a noble knight in shining armor who protects the weak and punishes the evil ones? Sure, you might answer, everybody wants to see oneself as one - especially in a game. But did you consider which price you would have to pay for it in your real life?

titre: El Ministerio del Tiempo VR: El tiempo en tus manos
description: ¿Do you want to delve into one ol the best TV series? ¿do dou want to become a member of the ministry of Time as a patrolperson? Dare you live a virtual reality experience to test your expertice as a time-traveller.

ULTROS est un metroidvania psychédélique dans lequel vous vous réveillez échoué sur le Sarcophage, un utérus cosmique qui enferme un être démoniaque immémorial. Piégé dans la boucle d'un trou noir, vous devrez explorer ce lieu et croiser ses hôtes pour comprendre votre rôle...
It's time for a 16-bit beatdown! Enjoy the Card Game, Trials, chatting, and rockin' to some awesome music as you fight in retro-style battles up to 9v9! Also-- it's FREE!

Lotos Abstraction. A Beautiful woman with a keen mind and a big gun, living in a destroyed 21st century. Someone has taken her memory and her freedom. Now she must kill or be killed, while trying to find whoever or whatever is controlling her.
fast parkour game that is as hard as me hehe parkour game that is good for speedrunning. pls check it out

Overclocked is a free-flowing action game that blends combat and platforming to create a fluid and rhythmic experience. Take on the role of Amber, a glass-cannon vigilante, as you fight to uncover a plot that threatens to tear your home apart.

Nourris ta passion pour le café dans Coffee Caravan ! Prépare et teste de délicieuses recettes et construis le café sur roues dont tu rêves. Sers les clients, débloque de nouvelles saveurs, achète des appareils et profite de ton voyage généré aléatoirement dans ce jeu roguelite
Gunman Tales is an old-school action adventure game for 1-4 players set in the wild west and inspired by the legendary game from Amiga Moonstone: A Hard Days Knight and Cabal
Minimalist hardcore one click\press direction changer game.

Zotrix est une approche moderne des jeux de tir d’arcade classique de type shooter. Le jeu introduit une économie d’échange de ressources et un système d’amélioration entre les différentes stations spatiales, vous offrant une expérience classique dans la génération moderne.

titre: 九劫曲:诅咒之地 NineTrials Test Server
description: There are immortals everywhere in Shenzhou. One day, A curse comes. The cursed people will have a mark on their body, known as "indescribable mark". Until the full moon night, the cursed person will be inhaled into the alien world. Players play one of the immortals and start their own journey to survive.
studio: 深圳市爱玩游戏科技有限公司

description: 高中入学试的当天，主人公被施加了诅咒。 这个诅咒会使美少女的分辨率降低到只能看到一个■的程度。 如果提高女孩子的好感度画质也会变高，就可以解除诅咒了。

titre: Accel World VS. Sword Art Online Deluxe Edition
description: Le monde accéléré a commencé à fusionner avec Svart ALfheim. Dans le chaos qui s'ensuit, Yui disparaît sans laisser de traces. Pour la retrouver, Kirito n'a d'autres choix que de défier les Sept Rois des couleurs pures.

Gnomoria is a sandbox village management game where you help lead a small group of gnomes, who have set out on their own, to thrive into a bustling kingdom! Anything you see can be broken down and rebuilt elsewhere.
Fractal Fury is the first online shooter with strategic dismemberment. Free to play for up to 16 players online or locally.

Prove your skills as a pilot in this action-packed multiplayer dogfighting game. Take part in 4 vs 4 battles and outmaneuver opponents, master a variety of jets and weapons, support allied ground troops, and land on the runway. Only a well-orchestrated team of pilots can bring down the enemy bases.

titre: ZONE OF THE ENDERS THE 2nd RUNNER : M∀RS / アヌビス ゾーン・オブ・エンダーズ : マーズ
description: ZONE OF THE ENDERS THE 2nd RUNNER - M∀RS Remasterisé en 4K et VR. Installez-vous aux commandes de l’Orbital Frame JEHUTY et volez dans le ciel de Mars !

Threefold Recital is set in an oriental fantasy world where the metropolis of Bluescales faces turmoil after a long golden age. The mix of magic, modern, and ancient technologies challenges governance, while tensions between humans, beastlings, and dragons grow. In the shadows, a crisis looms...

titre: Märchen Forest: Mylne and the Forest Gift [Legacy ver.]
description: Freely roam a fully 3D-rendered mystical forest together with Mylne, a young girl employed at a magical apothecary shop!
The end of the world is coming, face the endless attacking zombies, please live to the end...

Lost in a series of endless train station hallways, find your way to the exit Platform in this First-Person Anomaly Spotting game set in the Midnight Monitor universe. Watch out for anomalies - If you see any, turn back immediately! Can you find your way out of Aldercourt Station?

Jeu de tir d'arcade Sci-Fi 3D. Détruisez les astéroïdes et les extraterrestres. Tirez sur eux tous !Tireur d'arène 3D avec plusieurs mondes. Simulateur de vaisseau spatial et jeu de style arcade shmup.

When a murder is committed under mysterious and supernatural circumstances, the Inspector arrives on the scene, ready to interrogate witnesses, decipher riddles, and fend off attackers seeking their next victim. Ready your spyglass and sword as you take on these two murder mystery RPGs.

Action adventure with an apocalyptic touch. In Aztecalypse you explore a newly discovered area with remnants of an ancient culture. If you like First Person Action games set in mystic places, in an Open World with neat places to visit aside the story, you will definitely love this game!

Chroma Blast is a fast paced twin stick shooter with many different styles of play where you fight through waves of enemies while constantly leveling up your ships colorful arsenal. Beat your friends and challenge yourself in the leaderboards, or seek out a true test of skill for those good enough to find it.
Hidden object game in the cartoon city style. Animation and puzzles. Very large location. Ultra hard! Really very difficult!

Zafehouse Diaries 2 is a game of survival, exploration and relationships. Every hour, designate tasks for your handful of characters - each with their own skills, motivations and prejudices - and try to outlast the zombie apocalypse.

titre: コンプレックスループ
description: Complex Loop is a sci-fi themed visual novel. This is a story of time loops between past and future. Within a time limit of 20 minutes, your mission is to save a mysterious girl died from an explosion accident one year ago. Solve puzzles and reveal the truth behind the tragedy. An adventure awaits!

Single player, sci-fi, minimalist Real Time Tactics game. Strategy without the stress: complex movement, damage, and detection replaces intense micro and economy management. Units are selected and outfitted before battle. Emphasises tactical choices over mechanical skill.

Une arme. Un caractère. Un coup - un meurtre. Des conditions égales pour tous. À tout moment. Trouvez et éliminez votre ennemi sans vous faire toucher dans une expérience PVP tactique et atmosphérique dense avec un rythme calme. La seule chose qui fait la différence dans DHP, c'est vous.
Explore the world , collect resources , craft items , build a fortified house and kill other players to survive. BUT don't forget about cyborgs...
Join the Martian battlefields and fight as the Alliance or the Rebels in a competitive fast-paced FPS.
Dominate is an abstract strategy board game played on a 8x8 board.
IdleCoin est une simulation de minage et gestion de crypto-monnaie en temps réel.
Une voiture... en gelée ! Un jeu de course et de plateforme tactile, délirant et imaginatif où la physique se déforme.
Intense Puzzles Game - Explore the twisted and troubling world of Ahnayro, where your dreams are haunted by mysterious figures.
Inertia is a first-person platformer with free-running aspects. Inspired by various other free-running and movement based games/game-modes.

Sons of Valhalla est un roguelike stratégique à l’époque des vikings. Construisez des forteresses, rassemblez des guerriers, assiégez les places fortes et trucidez vos ennemis pour piller et conquérir toute l’Angleterre.

Silver Knight is a unique isometric mini-RPG with randomized enemy spawn placement that offers a challenging new experience each time you play. Any second can become your last in this dangerous land. Think twice before making your move — lives are extremely hard to come by in these parts.

You, who was born in a world full of darkness, should wander this hollowed land to find the Relics for a person who created you. However, fallen and lost souls with trap-filled trials await in your course of doing so. Can you survive in this crumbling world and start a new era?

E.E.R.E.I is a open world TPS.In a modern magic world, play the role of three fully armed spirit girl from the eastern and western mythology, entering the dangerous war zone, using a variety of modern small arms and tactical equipment to complete their respective missions!
Découvrez la magie de slavdom !
« Summer in Mara » est un jeu d'aventure avec de l'agriculture et de l'artisanat mécanique qui consiste à prendre soin de sa propre île et explorer l'océan avec son bateau.

Berlin, janvier 1933. "Adolf Hitler est chancelier !" Nous savons tous où mènera ce message, des horreurs se manifesteront dans le monde. Trop peu se dressent contre le Reich allemand. Le ferez-vous ? Dirigez un groupe de résistance clandestin à travers les temps les plus sombres.

Travel to the old train station and hotel, abandoned since 1947, following the 'disappearances'. Unravel the mystery that binds this place, by communicating with the ghosts of the long since dead, both in your time and theirs.
This is a simple and very addictive multiplayer game where you can fight tank battles with your friends, acquaintances and strangers.

Having inherited an old forge, it is now up to you to run the shop. Gain riches and fame, upgrade your forge and gain access to new resources to expand your product selection. One day, word of your skill may reach the ears of more than just commoners.

'Next Hero' is a Roguelike-shooting action RPG that explores dungeons, acquires weapons and equipment, and kills monsters. Find a girlfriend kidnapped by the dragon and rebuild the destroyed village to become a hero in the village!

Step into a world over run with Mycha, a strange mineral with seemingly magical powers. Clear monster-infested environments and protect researchers on your own or with up to three other players online. Welcome to The Federation.

Arrogation: Unlight of Day is a psychological horror game set in World War II. You will play as a lone reporter searching for his lost family in an abandoned village from 80s China. Beyond darkness, you will find nightmarish creatures and secrets from the long lost Imperial Japanese Army.

In Fear I Trust est un jeu d’énigmes et d’aventures à la première personne, salué par la critique. Explorez des lieux sinistres, résolvez des énigmes et révélez la sordide vérité derrière une expérience secrète soviétique dans ce thriller psychologique scénarisé.

Marble Skies is a fast paced 3D-platformer where you control your marble through various levels and try to get the best time for each one. Complete all the levels in your own time, or challenge your friends to get on top of the leaderboards!

Un jeu paisible de choix et de hasard. Explorez le donjon : combattre ou fuir ? Boire la potion ou le lait ? Ouvrir le coffre ou pirater les homards ? Porte gauche ou droite ? À vous de décider dans ce hack'n'slash stratégique !
An inconvenient electrical failure turns into an unspeakable nightmare as Dietrich becomes trapped in an abandoned subterranean mining town full of horrid creatures.
This first-person horror detective. You are a spiritgrapher, your camera can see what is beyond the reach of the human eye. Head to an abandoned hospital and shoot a report about supernatural events.

On a deserted island, a recurring phenomenon of large numbers of infected individuals appearing and disappearing continued. It was discovered that the cause was a virus, and efforts to uncover the virus and eradicate it have begun.
"Phanotia I: Escavive" is an ARPG game using pixel style. Players will play the role of "Connecticut" to find rescue in the wilderness and make the Mobile Fortress "Oslou" out of danger.

Exception is a game about AI programming. During the game, the player assists the units to defeat their enemies in the virtual world. However, the player needs to control the units by programming instead of controlling them directly.

Touch Arcade –"Upcoming 3D Space RTS Galaxy Reavers Looks Promising" Pocketgamer –"Galaxy Reavers is a spectacular looking strategy space-sim" L'univers est un champ de bataille galactique géant! Conquérir la galaxie et prendre vers le bas les rivaux! Bienvenue dans le monde de "Galaxy Reavers!"

titre: That Time I Got Reincarnated as an Orc
description: Okubo Tatsuya is a 35-year-old convenience store clerk. He is an introvert, has no friends. One day, he received a text message signed "The Goddess": "Do you want to be a hero in another world?" Accidentally, he reincarnated in another world and became an orc—

New era of gladiator battle shows has come, era of robots! And you have a chance to participate in it! Drone Gladiator is an arena shooter, where you upgrade your drone, fight giant bosses and participate in random events.
The Last Dance Saloon is a VR/PC rhythm shooter. Fight off bounty hunters with your trusty revolvers as you groove to the rhythm of the universe.

titre: Little Witch Academia: Chamber of Time
description: Découvre les mystères de l'Académie de Luna Nova et le monde magique de l'animation japonaise selon Studio Trigger dans Little Witch Academia: Chamber of Time.
Jeu de stratégie temps réel en ligne Déchaînez-vous dans Arcane Showdown !

Mine asteroids, salvage space debris, design your own small or massive spacecraft using individual functional components, complete missions, and engage in battles against enemies in a vast galaxy with realistic physics based on orbital mechanics or in a classic physics mode.
With Gamindustri on the brink of destruction, Nepgear and the Candidates must band together and restore order!
UNWORTHY is a hardcore combat-focused metroidvania without jumping. Explore a grim universe, discover new weapons and abilities, and defeat the vile creatures that plague the land.
Make friends or frenemies! Be a savvy schemer in this hybrid RPG party game!

Vos robots se sont retournés contre vous ! Vous êtes leur maître, alors éradiquez-les avant qu'ils n'aient la même idée. Dégainez vos flingues high-tech de votre ceinture et préparez-vous à démonter ces tas de ferraille ingrats !

Lance-toi dans l'aventure palpitante de Tri Peaks Solitaire (aussi appelé TriTowers, Triple Peaks, Three Peaks ou Pyramid Solitaire). Les niveaux palpitants, les nombreux bonus et boosters, les cartes insolites, les graphismes exceptionnels et la musique sublime rendent ce jeu encore plus passionnant.

titre: Google Spotlight Stories: Age of Sail
description: Age of Sail VR is the story of William Avery (Ian McShane), an old sailor adrift and alone in the North Atlantic. When Avery rescues Lara, who has mysteriously fallen overboard, he finds redemption and hope in his darkest hours. Directed by ACADEMY AWARD-winning filmmaker John Kahrs.

Fortix 2 pourrait être décrit comme un jeu de Tower Defense inversé. Incarnant Sir Fortix, le chevalier, vous devez conquérir des châteaux tout en évitant tourelles et redoutables monstres.Frayez-vous un chemin à travers les comtés de l'île d'Artalom et partez à la conquête de tous les châteaux.

With lightning-fast gameplay fully exploiting all three dimensions of motion, CAGE is a shooter unlike any other. The "tether" allows for unprecedented freedom and agility of movement, creating explosive action.

Bright Lights of Svetlov is a short, story-focused first person quest about a Soviet family facing harsh trials. Set in a fictional provincial town, it carefuly recreates the atmosphere and vibe of mid 1980s.
Cave Crawler is a short horror game where you pilot a drone into a cave and discover something horrible.
A logic game for all ages. Fit the blocks in the pyramid following the logic to complete the challenge. The Math Puzzle Alpha Challenge game was designed to stimulate logical thinking.

titre: planetarian ~the reverie of a little planet~
description: In time for the 10th anniversary since its original release in Japan, planetarian is an engaging and emotional visual novel from legendary game studio, Key. A sub-brand of VisualArts, Key are also famed for creating Kanon, AIR, CLANNAD, Little Busters!, Rewrite, and Angel Beats!

Tout premier « jeu cinématique interactif » de son genre, dans lequel vos décisions dirigent le déroulement et impactent le dénouement de l’histoire. Un thriller de science-fiction sous forme de film interactif, écrit par Kazutaka Kodaka, le génial et tortueux créateur de la série Danganronpa.

BloodRayne is a dhampir, born from the unnatural union of vampire and human. Blessed with the powers of a vampire but cursed with the thirst for blood and a weakness to sunlight, Rayne is challenged with her most personal battle yet as she hunts down her siblings.

Saint Kotar est une aventure d'horreur psychologique se déroulant dans une ancienne ville rurale de Croatie. Incarnez deux hommes de Dieu tentant d'élucider de terrifiants événements occultes et la disparition de leur parente. Découvrez votre humanité... ou sombrez dans la folie et dans la mort.
Field of Glory: Empires is a grand strategy game in which you will have to move in an intricate and living tapestry of nations and tribes, each one with their distinctive culture.
