The protagonist is trapped inside a prison, please help the protagonist to escape this place by making sentences and unravel the secrets of this prison.

Bienvenue dans le monde de Phalania. Explorez le monde à la recherche de secrets anciens et sauvez le monde d'un malheur imminent ! Pour l'instant, vous pouvez explorer les différentes zones. CE JEU EST EN ALPHA, TOUTES LES MÉCANIQUES DE JEU NE SONT PAS ENCORE PRÉSENTES !
Le jeu qui a révolutionné le genre du jeu de course.

Follow the Meaning est une aventure en pointer&cliquer prenant place dans une ville étrange, dont les habitants se sentent menacés par l'autorité toujours croissante de l'Hôpital et de ses médecins. Que se passe-t-il de l'autre côté du mur ? Aide le détective Paul Trilby à résoudre cette crise !

SIX FRUITS BARE THEIR FANGS AT THE WORLD. --The academy was their orchard. In this place of learning, protected by high walls from the outside world, there arrived a single young man who'd lost his purpose in life. He'd lost sight of what he wanted to protect.

Dans ce roguelite exigeant et effréné, chaque mort est l'occasion de réécrire le destin et de sauver la Perse ou de périr en essayant. Maîtrisez un combat et un parkour fluide et acrobatique, et explorez votre royaume pour réparer vos erreurs !

Eschalon: Book III brings the trilogy to a climactic end as you seek to uncover the mystery of your past, the secrets of the Crux stones, and who the Orakur really are. You’ll traverse miles of virtual wilderness and dungeons, filled with secrets and danger, in an unparalleled role-playing experience designed to feel like a true...

Dungeons of Edera est un action RPG rogue-lite avec des donjons et zones générées de façon procédurales. Peu importe où vous irez, des ennemis plus ou moins coriaces et des boss vous attendent avec des récompenses à la clé. Ferez-vous parti des aventuriers les plus courageux et inspirés ?
A dark medieval first person hack and slash with procedural elements. Navigate the darkness and shed light on what lies below.

Survivors, Adventurers, Explorers! Prepare for the journey of your life and experience one of the world’s most mysterious regions! The Bermuda Triangle is notorious for the vanishing of countless ships and airplanes. Will you survive long enough to reveal its secret?
Lost Daughter is an open-world action game which tells the story of Sawyer trying to find his daughter.

Galactic Crew II est un jeu roguelike d'exploration de l'espace inspiré de FTL et des classiques XCOM. Explorez une galaxie hostile avec votre valeureux équipage, du centre aux confins de l'espace. Devenez un pionnier galactique à travers la colonisation, le commerce et le combat.
Conquer the world and build your empire! Lead one civilization to glory through sophisticated trade, diplomacy, espionage and conquest.

titre: DEUS VULT | Online VR sword fighting
description: Fight against other medieval warriors all around the world! Deus Vult is an online medieval fighting game which uses cutting-edge weapon physics to make you feel like a real knight. Discover a world full of mystery, customize your character and FIGHT FOR GLORY!
MSI Electric City is a virtual reality sci-fi seated experience where you are transported to a futuristic city never seen before. Discover magnificent scenery and soar through wondrous architectures.
Life Gallery est un jeu de réflexion au style graphique unique fait d’illustrations, qui entraîne le joueur dans un monde d’une horreur profonde.

Le NecroDancer revient avec un nouveau jeu de rythme ! Dans un monde étrange, Cadence va devoir affronter les monstres de la Faille dans des combats musicaux intenses ! Survivez aux Failles Rythmiques, où chaque pulsation est un défi, sur une bande-son originale de Danny Baranowsky et ses amis.

Miami City. 2054. Ichido Corporation crée des robots biologiques (réplicants). La révolution commence et les réplicants vous aident à vous échapper de la société, car vous n'êtes pas non plus un homme, vous avez été élevé dans un tube à essai comme une arme à utiliser plus tard.
The third game within the Space Empires series brings the dawn of a new age of exploration. Your race keeps running through the fabric of space and moves to other solar systems beyond your own.

War Identity is a team-based first person shooter set in chaotic events. You play as a Survivalist or UMSC in competitive multiplayer game modes. Linking the gap between arcade shooters and realistic military battles.

Turn the crank, rotate the gears, push the levers, Use the catapult, explode it, or fly it...From grilling sausages with a pulley, gears, rubberbands and a candle to firing a cannon with a basketball, these wacky brain-teasers will light up your imagination with creative and addictive fun.

From Glory To Goo is a Sci-Fi survival RTS set on an alien world. Serve as humanity's bulwark by establishing a colony and supporting your colonists still in orbit. But beware, for The Goo, a relentless and shape-shifting force approaches from all sides, even above and below.

Desperados 2 est la suite du titre primé Desperados - Wanted Dead or Alive. Par rapport à son prédécesseur, ce jeu ouvre de nouvelles perspectives tactiques avec pour cadre le far-west. Passez d'une vue isométrique à une vue subjective quand bon vous semble.
Amass independently powerful upgrades that synergize into world shaking phenomena, and use them to lay waste to countless entities across a dying universe.

MirrorMoon EP is a game about mystery and exploration set in outer space. These space travels begin on a red planet and its unique moon and extend across galaxies. The single player part of MirrorMoon EP blends adventure and exploration with navigation-based puzzle solving.

WARNING! This game has an Age Restriction of 18. Vapour is an experimental horror game, that fuses elements of both old school and modern horror titles with the frantic game play of classic First Person Shooter titles. Blending horror, shooter, action, puzzle and platformer in a dynamic yet cohesive combination.

Neon Sundown is an extremely challenging arena-shooter that mixes fast-paced action with roguelite elements. Take on increasingly difficult arenas as you unlock new ships, upgrades, synergies, and more! Think you have what it takes to survive?
Arcade action save-'em-up with a chill summer vibe

Design your own skyscraper with more than 100 Floors. Rent offices, apartments or shops and build a financially lucrative skyscraper. Build cinemas, bars or a theater to satisfy your visitors and create an effective transport system with elevators and stairs.

titre: NEO AQUARIUM - The King of Crustaceans -
description: YOU GET TO CONTROL UNIQUE CREATURES LIKE LOBSTERS, CRABS AND BARNACLES, IN A WILD WATER WORLD THAT EXCEEDS ALL HUMAN SENSE.
Les créateurs de The Stanley Parable et The Beginner’s Guide nous présentent Wanderstop, une histoire pleine de douceur sur le thé et le changement.

Join a long lineage of Hunters as you run and gun through the Wild West in this action rogue-like. Take on Bounties, Unlock powerful weapons, and come face-to-face with a gallery of terrifying monsters. Developed by Voyager Softworks, as a part of our final year at University.

HEAT REBORN is a free massively multiplayer online first-person shooter. Completely re-created the original HEAT PROJECT with modern game engine. Brings you the improvement of graphics, game balance, and even with numbers of new game mode for you!
Les chatons de Dame Tallowmere se sont mis à se comporter bizarrement. Pourtant, le rituel du donjon doit avoir lieu. Malgré les circonstances inhabituelles, combien de temps tiendrez-vous?
Only armed with a double barrel shotgun, go through waves of hell spawns to get your book back! A bullet hell arena shooter!

Arriverez-vous à survivre ?Death Track: Resurrection est un jeu de course et d'action qui emmène le joueur dans un univers post-apocalyptique dans un futur proche où les sports traditionnels ont été remplacés par des divertissements plus violents. Il va falloir survivre à ces courses qui se déroulent dans les plus grandes cités du monde.
Enter the world of Roll'd where rolling comes in at a new degree.

Choisissez votre propre planète et soyez témoin de ses origines, de ses transformations, de ses cataclysmes et de ses renaissances qui durent des milliards d'années. Votre fond d'écran sera toujours différent, unique et tout simplement magnifique.

Un hack-and-slash où la maîtrise technique règne. Survivez à des hordes de morts-vivants et des boss titanesques en esquivant, parant et brisant leurs combos mortels. Pas de progression d'équipement : seul votre art du combat décide de la victoire. Forgez votre légende dans l'abysse d'acier.

Beer Factory est un jeu de simulation et de gestion d'entreprise. Relève le défi, gère ton usine de brassage de bière, tes employés, tes lignes de production ainsi que l'import et l'export de marchandises.

Puzzles Under The Hill features Pamela Possum taking a stroll to visit her best friend Sammy Squirrel. Along the way, Pamela collects shiny jewels unveiling wonderful jigsaw challenges, featuring beautiful imagery from the National Gallery of Art.

H. P. Lovecraft rencontre le cyberpunk dans ce monde dystopique. Menez l'enquête à travers le dôme pour comprendre ce qui vous arrive. Résolvez des énigmes, piratez des systèmes, connectez-vous pour explorer d'autres dimensions et découvrez la vérité sur votre existence.
An RPG inspired by the classics, and based upon a series of published stories. A deep, character-driven adventure, in a Fantasy-Steampunk world of betrayal and intrigue.

Un jeu d'exploration au grappin en vue subjective. Parcourez les ruines d'un monde déchu et découvrez les secrets millénaires qu'il abrite. Conçu pour être entièrement jouable en réalité virtuelle avec le HTC Vive ou l'Oculus Rift, mais reste captivant en version basique.

Richard and Alice are prisoners. Both their cells have a leather sofa and a state-of-the-art computer. But only Richard’s has a TV. Outside, the snow falls. It has done for some time. Elsewhere, they say, parts of the world have been rendered an inhospitable desert, the earth parched and cracked. People live in the zones now.
Take the role of a manager or CEO of a record label, and try to make your mark on the music industry!
The Fall of Lazarus is first person exploration and puzzle game. A deeply narrative scifi mystery game based on the exploration of an abandoned cargo spaceship about redemption and second chances.

titre: Twin Mind: Murderous Jealousy Collector's Edition
description: Go on a new exciting adventure following a story of two twin investigators! Complete puzzles, solve riddles and demonstrate your intelligence to discover all the secrets that are hidden in this mysterious case.

When a domestic terrorist resurfaces it falls on an overburdened police department to discover his plot and put an end to it, and as a washed up detective leading the renewed investigation things begin to not appear as they seem.

Do you think you are an astute observer — an experienced hidden-object-finder? Try one of the most difficult games of this genre: Little Hidden City! Here you will find tons of well-hidden objects in six different, very detailed and varied levels.
This is a clicking adventure that simulates the real-life tapping of a Mayo Jar! You will unveil its story and (maybe) you will learn from it!
Naev is a game about space exploration, trade, and combat in a large and vibrant universe. Players travel the galaxy and earn money by trading, fighting, and performing missions.

This is text adventure game of survival of the astronauts on the orbital station that is lost in time. You will have to take care of the rescue of the station's crew, and lots of complicated riddles and situations will make this adventure even more interesting.

MotoGP™14 est de retour avec un moteur graphique totalement amélioré. De nouveaux modes de jeu, tous les pilotes des saisons 2014 et 2013, ainsi que des pilotes légendaires de l'histoire du MotoGP™ vous offrent l'opportunité d'incarner un véritable pilote.

Forêts, déserts, petites villes, bords de mer, il y a beaucoup de beaux endroits sur notre planète. Ce sont tous des dons de la nature à l'humanité. Si vous ne pouvez pas vous rendre en personne dans ces endroits, alors entrez dans notre jeu et commencez une expérience relaxante et agréable.
Santa Soccer is a casual soccer shooting gallery type game. Featuring a golf mode and a present, if you can manage to hit it. Have fun!
MMORPG Storm Riders is not just a game, it is a legend that has come to life, where you will get an opportunity to become a kung-fu master and fulfill your destiny.

titre: Ego In A Coma (自我、状態、昏睡。)
description: A world... where the existence of ego has faded One day, the One of Insomnia received a powerful sleeping pill. She swallowed the pill in the bathtub... and fell into a coma, Can the One who has fallen into the spiritual world escape from coma? Can the ego grow after getting out?
SWARMRIDER OMEGA is an "endless runner"+"twin stick shooter" ARCADE mashup. Based on SWARMRIDERS(2016), OMEGA is a darker and faster version, featuring the Saint from UBERMOSH Vol.5.
Vanquish and recruit youkai in randomized dungeons in Kagura Genesis: Kuon's Story, a replayable roguelike RPG!

The Armchair Historian présente un jeu stratégique tour par tour à l'époque victorienne. Les mousquets deviennent fusils et l'infanterie affronte une artillerie modernisée. Adaptez-vous à un champ de bataille changeant. Une ère de Sang et de Fer, non de courage et chevalerie.
Développez votre propre ferme par vous-même, ou coopérez avec vos amis dans cette suite tant attendue de cette expérience agricole confortable et relaxante !
Language Learning Simulator - Alphabet est un jeu éducatif qui permet aux joueurs d'apprendre de nouveaux alphabets facilement et de manière amusante !

Soul of Savarog comprend quatre des jeux de thriller d'horreur mobile de Twisted Universe. Toutes ces pièces racontent l'histoire de Savarog. Jouez respectivement à Savarog, Savarog 2, Rule et Savarog 3.

Do you like puzzles, fruit and the notion of crossing a snake with a bird for no good reason? If the answer to at least one of those questions is yes, then Snakebird might be the game for you. Solve your way through this headscratcher of a puzzle game and help the snakebirds sate their hunger.

Entre hommage nostalgique et réinvention, découvrez l'univers fantastique d'une grande chanson de geste. S'inspirant de Ghosts 'n Goblins et de Ghouls 'n Ghosts pour donner naissance à un titre inédit, Resurrection est digne de son nom. Ne vous laissez pas duper par les splendides graphismes de ce monde féérique !
Part man, part blade, all badass – help Fist Slash defeat the evil Dr. X and recover the mystical mirror shards before they're used to wreak ultimate destruction on the world!

In this indie horror game, you must escape the Siren’s Forest! Use multiple means of transportation to aid your escape. Unearth what truly happened in the forest by interacting with certain objects that could provide you with the answers you need. But be careful… There’s something out there!
The elders have entrusted you, an elite vampire courier, to deliver their secrets. Can you outrun the hunters, the other drivers, and the rising sun?

Only you, Plutus, lowliest of the Phantom Club's superheroes, can save the once-proud Club from the clutches of the evil Zarg! Use your mighty 'Brainstorm' power to fight such fearsome enemies as the terrifying 'transforming beings' and the loathsome 'man-spiders'!

titre: The Bard's Tale IV: Barrows Deep
description: The Bard’s Tale IV : Barrows Deep est le grand retour d’une des séries RPG les plus emblématiques de tous les temps. Plongez dans un système de combat tactiquement riche qui récompense la créativité, déchiffrez des énigmes pour gagner des avantages, et découvrez un monde soigneusement construit.

Kidz is 2D Side Scrolling style, featuring different mechanic each episode, including Action Horror, Point & Click, and Parkour! 3 kids from the different universe face the same issue. Let's explore their story!

On your maiden voyage with the Heroes Guild, your ship was capsized by an enigmatic maelstrom, stranding your party on Respite Island. Navigate your way through pirates, ferocious beasts, and shady alchemists as you unravel its mysteries.

Typing Ritual is a first-person psychological horror game where players perform a summoning ritual by typing ancient texts. As the ritual progresses, the environment changes, and tension builds. Mistakes have consequences, and time is limited.
Welcome to the world where mysticism and reality, past and present, good and evil are united in a single whole!
A vampire mage has acquired a magical relic with the power to enslave humanity. Are you brave enough to stop him?

titre: 東方紅夜狂宴 ~Red Empress Devil.
description: "Touhou ~Red Empress Devil." est un jeu d'action roguelike de type bullet-hell shooting. Dans le manoir du diable écarlate, les habitants de Gensokyo se déchaînent !

Le jeu de simulation de combat s’est détraqué ! Tous les participants sont emprisonnés dans le système et paralysés sur le champ de bataille et les androïdes sont devenus des machines à tuer ultrasophistiquées ! Trois vaillants guerriers doivent à présent sauver les otages et détruire l’unité centrale du système, Brain.

Masked Forces is an action-packed game where your main purpose is to eliminate your enemies using any means necessary. You have a great singleplayer campaign and multiple online game modes that you can use to show your might.
This is a casual Sokoban game. The player needs to use the keyboard to control the male character through the level to find the female character.

The Quest is a beautifully hand-drawn open world role playing game with old school grid-based movement, turn based combat and intricate quests. Explore a huge world, full of challenging mysteries and dangerous monsters!

titre: Nancy Drew®: Mystery of the Seven Keys™
description: A thrilling blend of adventure, mystery, and history! Play as Nancy Drew to uncover the truth behind the theft of a client's heirloom necklace. Solve challenging puzzles, uncover a sinister web of cyber crime, and sleuth through Prague's mysterious streets entwined with medieval legends and alchemy.

titre: The Gleam: VR Escape the Room
description: The Gleam is an escape the room game for the HTC Vive. Solve puzzles, decipher code, and unravel the mysteries of the "gleam" in order to escape from this claustrophobic hell.

7,62 Hard Life is a fan made enhanced version of the original tactical sim 7,62 High Calibre. We hope you'll enjoy this version, that is available to all owners of the original game on Steam at no extra cost.

Todd Rex wants steak. Todd Rex wants YOUR steak. Are you gonna let him take it? No way! Go Home, Dinosaurs!Prevent hordes of marauding Dinos from crashing your party in the world’s premier BBQ defense simulator! Unlock powerful towers that act like little weaponized puzzle pieces.

Gemini: Heroes Reborn est un jeu d'action et d'aventure à la première personne qui permet de se mettre dans la peau de Cassandre, au cours d'un voyage qui lui permettra de déverrouiller des pouvoirs incroyables, uniques dans l'univers de Heroes.

Super Cyborg is an old school non-stop hardcore run'n'gun action game! You are an elite battle cyborg who is sent in to investigate a series of anomalies on a mysterious island. The merciless alien known as the 'Xirxul life form' has been awakened by unwitting scientists and now: all humanity is in danger!

A game axed on imagination, creativity and community. Logic, attention and perseverance are needed. It is a ludic circuits simulator with a game approch. Convinient and intuitive, it will accompany you in your electronic learning quest. Electrify is here.

Vous avez déjà rêvé de concevoir et gérer votre propre hôtel ? Alors ne cherchez pas plus loin ! Avec ses innombrables outils de personnalisation, ses multiples pièces et son incroyable palette de clients, Hotel Magnate vous permettra de réaliser vos rêves hôteliers les plus fous !

Seal the Gate Of Doom forever! Gate of Doom is a classic arcade multiplayer action RPG originally released in 1990. You and a friend take on the role of one of four heroes of prophecy, the knight Carl F. Graystone, the wizard Fraya Edirne, the bard Riger Hawk, or the ninja Kirikaze.
A music-driven puzzle adventure where sound shapes the world. Solve mysteries, escape the Human Wheel, and experience the album by GRIGS in PALINGENESIS.

Wild Guns est un jeu de tir à l'action rythmée de style arcade, qui allie l'atmosphère du Far West à celle du steampunk. Vous pouvez y incarner Clint, Annie, Doris ou Bullet le chien avec son drone sentinelle. Rassemblez un groupe d'amis et amusez-vous ensemble en faisant une partie à quatre !

Gideon Ragnason was banished from Ruti's party because he was "not strong enough." Since then, he has retired from the front lines of battle and changed his name to Red. Now, he has opened an apothecary in the frontier land of Zoltan, and hopes to live a slow and happy life there!

CYBRID is the action-rhythm VR of the Cyber Future! Swords and Pistols are in your hands. Slash and Shoot! Don't let this stop you! Run, dodge, and jump among the neon lights of the city to a powerful soundtrack!

Plongez dans le cauchemar de Evil Nun. Piégé dans une école maudite, échappez à Sœur Madeline. Astucieuse, elle explore chaque coin, vous attire et communique selon vos actions. Résolvez des énigmes, créez des objets et découvrez le mystère dans ce jeu d'horreur aux échappatoires variées.

Play as Ghoul Kid, a mischievous ghost who possesses household objects to scare visitors to death. In this wave based game, Ghoul Kid cannot be seen by humans. Use your wits and abilities to manipulate household objects so you can scare people to death! Happy haunting!
Infection is an abstract strategy board game played on a 7x7 board.
Memories swirl all around you...Or are these memories? Familiar faces and places you think you remember but somehow now seem so different. Why are you here? Where is here?

Vous êtes seul(e), terrifié(e) et avez été emprisonné(e) dans un immeuble de bureaux par quatre poupées, un mannequin, un diable à ressort, et une fille semblable à un zombie nommée Émilie. Vous vouliez simplement livrer votre commande de sandwichs puis retourner au restaurant, mais ils veulent jouer.
An epic adventure filled with loot, and monsters. Enter the world of Emperium!
Day of Invasion: Reloaded is a First Person Zombie-Shooter that takes place within the Horton-Genetics Disaster of Milespring. Find Weapons to fight your way through hordes of Infected!
Hunt the largest and most ferocious animals known to man – the Dinosaurs!

Eleusis is a 3d first-person adventure game for Windows developed by Nocturnal Works using the technology of the unreal engine. It takes place in a seemingly abandoned village in Greece where the player character, while trying to seek refuge, finds himself in the center of a whirlwind of mysterious events.

Lonely Knight is a story that immerses you in an epic adventure in the medieval era. Avenge your wife as you battle invading forces, go on game-changing quests, and make influential choices. Fight in brutal battles where you will experience fast-paced combat, castle sieges, and more.

A super fast paced, clock ticking down, puzzle solving FPS shooter with hundreds of levels and an endless challenge mode. No blood or killing, just problem solving, bullets spraying crate destruction.
"Black & White" is a dystopian visual novel + war chess game: black and white, sensibility and reason, freedom and order: follow your beliefs and join your camp.
Little Big Adventure 2 est un jeu d'action-aventure culte sorti en 1997. Après avoir sauvé le monde du terrible Dr. Funfrock, Twinsen doit affronter une menace venue d'un autre monde.

Un jeu de deck-building roguelike et de tower defense qui change de d'habitude. ORX, c'est un peu comme si vous jouiez à Carcassonne sur un plateau en feu. Composez votre deck idéal, utilisez de puissants artefacts et maîtrisez 3 factions uniques. Prouvez que vous êtes le roi de votre château !
A puzzle game with great challenges and enjoyable environment. Simple and intuitive with easy interactions.
Gagnant du concours "Make Something Unreal" 2010, The Haunted: Hells Reach est un jeu d'horreur haletant où votre but est d'exorciser des endroits maudits et de survivre à l'assaut de l'Enfer.

It's off the rails! In Rail World, you establish your own railroad empire. Plan your own track network, transport passengers and goods, and meet a cast of quirky characters in this exceptional city building game. Download Rail World now!
Race across low gravity sci-fi sandbox circuits and explore levels for shortcuts! Features unique ramping mechanics - ramp across entire levels! Wholesome high speed fun for everyone :)

Multiwinia est un STR rapide d'inspiration rétro, mêlant action arcade et stratégie. Commandez des armées de Multiwiniens dans des batailles multijoueurs intenses. Avec des commandes simples et un gameplay dynamique, il offre un défi sans fin pour tous les joueurs.

Wells, pitfalls, houses, villagers, monsters (!?), anything around you can be a weapon! An action RPG that you've never seen before, you can fight with all the objects you see in the game. There are more than 300 kinds of weapons.Aim to complete the weapon gallery!
1-4 player co op roguelike with turn based combat and an emphasis on exploring randomly generated dungeons in order to find loot and complete missions
The craziest, weirdest game in the universe,

Growing up with his paternal grandmother, George emerges from the spiral of alcohol addiction by meeting his fiancée Hanna. But his childhood traumas will soon return to haunt him, pushing him into the abyss of despair.
Action shooter with story elements.

Inspiré par Allison Road, SUPERNORMAL est un horreur dans un appartement ordinaire cachant des secrets. Incarnez le détective Wyatta, résolvez la disparition de la fille de Masato Sakamoto. Cherchez des indices, découvrez la vérité sinistre.

Explore a vibrant world where ancient religions fuse with technology in this character-driven JRPG. Master deep turn-based combat as you battle with divine magic against beasts with mecha parts. Embark on a grand adventure to retrieve the sacred Babel code needed to face your Gods.

Nanobotic is a free to play first person shooter multiplayer online battle arena extravaganza (FPS MOBA). In Nanobotic you can craft weapon elements on the spot and switch between them with ease, you can also craft different types of artificially intelligent (AI) minions and control their actions.
Regular Human Workshop is a 2D physics simulation sandbox. There are no predefined goals or objectives. Simply throw objects into the world and interact with them in various ways.

titre: Heroes of Might & Magic V: Hammers of Fate
description: Prenez part à cette nouvelle aventure qui se déroule dans le royaume d'Ashan avec cette extension 'Hammer of Fate' et faites l'expérience d'une nouvelle façon de jouer à Heroes of Might & Magic V. Comprend : Une nouvelle faction : celle des nains. Ils viennent des montagnes du nord.
DEFECTIVE는 퍼즐 요소가 가미된 단편 어드벤처 게임입니다. 고철 폐기장에서 깨어난 간호 로봇 '온누리-480'은 길 잃은 소녀 '설'을 부모님에게 데려다 주어야 합니다.

Astrometica est un jeu amusant sur la survie dans l'espace. Vous devez utiliser vos compétences et vos outils pour rester en vie. Il y a de nombreux défis à relever, et vous devez vous battre pour survivre. Vous devez également construire une nouvelle base dans l'espace.
Undeads Winter's est un jeu de tir zombies fps avec une petite histoire basée sur "o5 l'homme ordinaire" utilisant le "scp 108".

titre: 红石遗迹 - Red Obsidian Remnant
description: A Roguelike gameplay and action system combined dungeon game.
已下架

RWBY Deckbuilding Game is a new breed of digital card game where you build your deck to defeat an array of deadly foes, or join forces in raids to take down powerful villains. No packs or boosters to chase. Each expansion is a complete experience.
Mugen Souls features a free-roaming battle map, turn-based combat, and massive amounts of customization and growth to maximize the fun players can have with the game.

Not a single jumpscare. Pure psychological terror.Unique horror experience.The kids of the neighbourhood tells a story about a man made out of paper that lives inside the forest. Solve the mystery. Find the truth about that “Paperman”.
Don't lose the signal to get out of here.
某一天，一觉醒来的朵琳，发现自己正置身于这个陌生的小岛上， 独自在树林里走着，没走多远，她遇上了一个哭得很伤心的女孩子，她叫杰西卡……

Soccer Rage est un jeu de sports/action qui comprends un engin hybride de soccer et de combat. La cadence de jeu y est rapide et dynamique. Les cartes rouges, les hors-jeux, et les remplaçants y sont absents. Les fautes brutales sont permises ainsi que les combats.

Dragon Awaken est un jeu héroique fantasie semi tour à tour dans lequel vous devrez collectionner des Dragons, améliorer vos armures, acquerir de nouvelles compétences et recruter de légendaires Héros.
Doug The Digger is a casual, single-player mining and crafting game where you aim to escape a crash landing by crafting a rocket. The gameplay is simple but addictive—play at your own risk!

titre: Cursed Digicam | 呪われたデジカメ
description: You receive a cursed digital camera that captures ghosts from a strange website. The website allows you to liberate your loved ones by uploading images of their spirits using the camera. You decide to go to the nearest park where your girl was last seen.

Scavenger SV-4 is a highly replayable atmospheric first-person science fiction game. Part simulator, part roguelike, it has elements of action, combat, resource management, and a dash of horror. It is not quite like any game you have played before.
A trailer for the 8-episode narrative VR The Abbot's Book.

Plunder your way to the top and claim the title of Pirate King. This humorous mix of adventure and strategy lets you unite pirate factions, manage strongholds, and dominate land and sea battles. Raid, recruit, and wreak havoc across the Caribbean in your quest for ultimate infamy.

Arms Trade Tycoon: Tanks est un jeu unique de simulation d'entreprise et de conception de tanks. Il vous place à la tête d'une entreprise d'armement de la Première Guerre mondiale à l'ère moderne. Concevez des tanks, vendez-les et suivez leur progression en combat pour réécrire l'histoire !

In the seas of the distant future, humans have all but disappeared. In your current, newly-awakened state, you are no more than a piece of seafood. However, you have been blessed with the talent for leading your allies into battle. Do whatever it takes to become the Ace of Seafood.

Prenez les commandes des sous-marins modernes les plus meurtriers au monde : trois sous-marins différents à travers deux campagnes aussi uniques que difficiles. Doté d'un radar de pointe et d'un armement dernier cri, repérez, suivez et éliminez l'ennemi. Vous pouvez même lancer des missiles Tomahawk sur des cibles terriennes.
The spaceship carrying quantum energy. The player received a mission to collect quantum fragments.

Fight your way through an unexplored dungeon in this deck-building, turn-based roguelike focused on dice combinations! Deal with enemies by combining powerful dice on your board, boost their effects with synergies, and risk it all hoping for a good roll.

City of Fools a une histoire complètement non-linéaire avec un monde virtuel ouvert à explorer. Le jeu propose environ 50 endroits amusants, des scènes d'objets cachés non obligatoires, une variété de mini-jeux et des jours de gameplay en mode Expert.

titre: Pixel Puzzles Illustrations & Anime Jigsaw Puzzles
description: Pixel Puzzles, votre numéro un pour les puzzles numériques.
Une nouvelle légende commence…
Le jeu de réflexion acclamé par la critique, produit par Tetsuya Mizuguchi, le créateur légendaire, arrive sur PC.

The unstoppable alien force known as The Creeper has returned, devouring thousands of worlds in its path, and yours is next. Battle against the Creeper fluid in a groundbreaking pixel-level simulation to prove that humanity will rule the galaxy forever!
Block Blowout offers original brick-breaker arcade action inspired by the timeless classic. Blast your way through 84 challenging levels and collect useful upgrades and weapons of mass-destruction.

Bienvenue dans le monde de Burn Zombie Burn, ou le zombie se déguste au BBQ. Le but est simple : garder Bruce en vie alors qu'il tente de garder Daisy en vie. Faites le meilleur score possible. Une horde de zombie sans fin se retrouvera forcément sur votre passage.

Living the Nightmare is a fast-paced, turn-based, Horror Roguelike about a Slasher who just met his end. Be the Faceless, a Killer slain by a would-be victim and cast into a dark, purgatorial realm. There may be a way out... but there's a lot of monsters to turn inside out first.
The origin of the series, the abnormality of the fighting game genre, now returns... HEAVEN or HELL？LET'S Rock！
Explore, craft, and fight in this minimalist survival game. Play alone or with a friend!

Midvinter is a cozy little point-and-click game, which invites you to explore Swedish folklore using puzzles and riddles as well as compelling music and voice over. In it, you as a player take on the role of gnome - the guardian of the farm - and get to interact with various dark and fantastical creatures.

In La Rana, players explore the lost Rain Temple of Rana. Play as a small spirit frog who is the temple's last remaining caretaker. Traverse its grand chambers and winding passages to restore its former power and revive your fellow frog spirits along the way.

titre: AGON - The Lost Sword of Toledo
description: Search the Spanish city of Toledo with Professor Hunt and reveal the secrets behind a mysterious sword!

Real Warfare 2: Northern Crusades est le nouvel épisode de cette série réaliste de stratégie en temps réel qui se déroule du moyen-âge jusqu'à nos jours. Ce titre permet aux joueurs de vivre la période des chevaliers teutoniques au XIIIème siècle partis pour évangéliser la Prusse. Toutes les batailles forment une campagne.

Godless est un roguelike au tour par tour où vous ne sauvez pas le monde — vous l’anéantissez. Remodellez le champ de bataille hexagonal, invoquez des sbires mortels, explorez des stratégies infinies et écrasez les héros mortels avant qu’ils ne détruisent votre sanctuaire divin !
The Serpent Rogue est un jeu d'action-aventure conçu autour de l'exploration d'un monde médiéval dans un univers fantastique, de la maîtrise de l'alchimie, et du domptage de créatures sauvages.

Tidal Therapy is a travel novel game for tired adults. A tired office worker heads to the sea. The setting is a quiet and beautiful sea town with a seaside park, warehouse district, and tower condominiums.
Des figurines tendance animées par un moteur physique, combats automatiques, mouvements personnalisables, amenez vos amis et combattez des criquets en ligne !

In Nemesis: Lockdown, you're part of a team exploring an alien-infested space base. Craft, hide and fight to make it out of its dark, threat-filled corridors. Fulfill your objective even if it means betraying your allies, but remember - this time, you are not the hunter. You are the PREY.

Un joli paragraphe qui tente de charmer le lecteur. Le but c’est de retenir l’attention avec un dégueulis de mots-clés du genre « shooter de ouf » et « meta-progression extensive », dans une vaine tentative de faire croire que ce jeu n’est pas le même que sa concurrence.

Évadez-vous d’une base lunaire secrète de TranStar. Les ennemis à affronter, les dangers à éviter, les objectifs à accomplir et le butin à récupérer sont différents à chaque partie. Avec ses décors aussi dangereux que changeants, la campagne Mooncrash de Prey offrira un défi mémorable et une rejouabilité infinie.

Incarnez un tout petit champignon perdu dans la forêt, loin de chez lui. Explorez des environnements uniques à votre propre rythme, discutez avec les locaux bienveillants, et vivez plusieurs aventures pour rentrer chez vous !

Façonnez l’histoire du cinéma hollywoodien dans ce jeu de simulation économique. Produisez les films que vous avez toujours voulu voir, formez une équipe de rêve, dotez-vous des technologies dernier cri et dominez le box-office. Parviendrez-vous à vous hisser au sommet de tout Hollywood ?
Paw Paw Paw was a peaceful and prosperous kingdom. Until one day, when the King had decided to enforce everyone to wear pants. We are the resistance. We are the Antipants.

Dans ce jeu de tir roguelite riche en action, vous incarnez un mécha sympathique mais mortel en quête de son pilote introuvable. Choisissez vos missions et récompenses, utilisez des extensions et des plugins, ajoutez des mods à vos armes, personnalisez votre mécha et survivez à des hordes d'IAs.

Hell Architect est un jeu qui consiste à construire et à gérer son propre enfer. Tu joues le rôle d'un gestionnaire de l'enfer et es chargé de développer le monde souterrain d'une manière qui ferait tomber Lucifer lui-même de sa chaise.

Hospital 666 est un jeu d'évasion d'horreur pour 1 à 4 joueurs. Parcourez d'étranges niveaux d'hôpital tout en observant l'apparition d'anomalies et en choisissant le bon ascenseur. Certains patrons anormaux vous poursuivront à mort et vous devrez trouver le bon moyen de leur échapper.

Bienvenue dans le monde déjanté de Big Helmet Heroes, un jeu de baston épique qui combine des graphismes magnifiques, des animations dignes des plus grands films et des combats palpitants ! Jouez avec un ami en mode coopération pour sauver la princesse au travers des royaumes fantastiques !

En tant que gouverneur de la Reine, il vous incombe de construire un empire colonial en Son nom. Revendiquez des îles, collectez des ressources, construisez des usines et transformez un avant-poste abandonné en une métropole rebelle et animée au cœur d'un empire commercial du Nouveau Monde !

You find yourself in a house that the owners have long since abandoned. But something lurks in the shadows, watching your every move. Explore the rooms, solve the mysteries, and find a way to banish the evil... Before it gets to you.

Virginia est un thriller solo à la première personne qui se déroule dans une petite ville avec un secret. Vivez l’enquête d’une personne disparue à travers les yeux de l’agent du FBI tout juste diplômé, Anne Tarver.

Doll Impostor is a horror game where 1-4 players take on the role of guardians of possessed dolls. Work together to identify the impostor doll before 9 a.m, or face dire consequences. Every hour counts in this tense, fear-filled race against time.

Bienvenue dans le Projet "Gold Express"! Jeu multijoueur asymétrique de style cyberpunk dans lequel vous pourrez vivre une toute nouvelle expérience de survie avec vos coéquipiers. Vous aurez diverses capacités sur différentes cartes stratégiques.

Retournez dans le monde de TRON avec TRON RUN/r, un nouveau jeu d'action/aventure ultra-rapide ! Affûtez vos compétences au DISQUE et au CYCLE, puis défiez vos amis dans l'épuisant programme FLUX qui vous envoie continuellement des combinaisons de modes et de niveaux jusqu'à ce que vous vous écrasiez. Combien de temps survivrez-vous ?
Rotate and navigate a colorful world.

Zhao Sheng, a retired postman, has been suffering from dementia over the past years. He insists that his partner Qi Mei is waiting for him under a peach tree. Zhao Sheng’s family didn't want him to leave with any regrets and decided to go and find that peach tree he had been talking about...
Casual game for attentiveness

Welcome to the world of Ctrl CV, a find-the-image platformer puzzle game. You are surrounded by countless clones of yourself, and your goal is to find the source of these doppelgangers. Try not to lose yourself in the midst of "yourselves".
An open multiplayer sandbox game; includes tools, props, levels, NPCs, character models, game-modes and much more! Make your own using our mod kit!
The true strength of The Real Driller is his wisdom.
Reveal the secrets of the past, find ancient scrolls, and find out about the prophecy ancestors! Decipher ancient spells and find magic keys to mastering the power of all the elements!
Izeriya was a powerful city…but forces of evil captured it. The little man named Trix is heading to this city to destroy the evil within.
Cavesweeper is a unique roguelike puzzle game that is easy to play but difficult to master. Battle deadly monsters and get powerful loot in this addictive, replayable RPG puzzler!
Play Astroflux - a retro styled, action packed MMO space shooter.
Would you believe one of your friends is a killer? Return home in this 2.5D horror story.
Emmenez Storm pour une aventure magnifique dans une tasse de thé. Un monde féerique imaginé par Storm's brother Cloud.
Jump back to the good old days of arcade machines with Void Invaders: a colourful, chaotic and explosive arcade shoot-em-up game inspired by classics such as Galaga and Space Invaders!
Want to race without the constraints of the ground? Then Neon Wings is your game! Neon Wings: Air Race is an adrenaline-filled, fast-paced air racing game with a lot of single and multiplayer fun!
Uncrewed is a real-time strategy game with the ability to design units from scratch. Unlike in more traditional RTS, units obey the laws of physics, making design choices especially important.
TOTALLY FREE card game! NO annoying restrictions. NO pay-to-win. NO timers. NO "energy bars". You can purchase your skin only.

Do you ever want to revisit the good old days of bouncing screen savers? Well not only can you do that you can also add whatever images you'd like to it, customize its background to whatever you'd want it to be, and even play around with them as you brain blast your last few brain cells!
Jeu d'aventure innovant combiné à des éléments de beat 'em all et RPG. Dans un monde sinistré où les animaux ont remplacé l'humanité, quel genre de détective serez-vous ?
EPOCH - Post-apocalyptic Robot Combat
Jeu de plateformes à défilement horizontal qui s’inspire de l’âge d’or des jeux d’action 16 bits, Vengeful Guardian: Moonrider vous propulse au cœur d’une quête de vengeance effrénée.

Your girlfriend seems to be hiding something. Will you respect her privacy or pry into her secrets? Don't worry, though. This is a horror dating sim with a time loop, so you can try again...and again...and again...
Revivez Praetorians, le célèbre jeu de stratégie en temps réel, repensé en haute définition. Praetorians se déroule au cœur des machinations politiques d'un Empire romain en pleine émergence.

Cosmic Awakening VR is a first person VR survival exploration horror game. A game about immersion, exploration, and terror. It is a collection of horror scenarios set on a sci-fi stage. Explore the mysteries in a short linear experience, or try to survive as long as you can against unknown horrors.

《Entrepreneurial tycoon》 is a tycoon like game that breaks away from the traditional round playing method of tycoons and builds on the basis of three-dimensional city. The abundant props and events in the game can definitely bring players an unprecedented experience.
studio: 泉州市兰梦网络科技中心（有限合伙）

description: Red Ronin is a Turn-based but fast paced dash 'n slash game where a bloodthirsty ronin and her companion bot search for revenge.

titre: A Book of Beasts and Buddies
description: A Book of Beasts and Buddies is an interactive beastiary of curious creatures.

Create a politician and start your legacy. Run in national and local elections. Create and vote on legislation. Respublica is an online roleplay game, where users can run for office and control the outcome of the world within the game.
Open-World Puzzle Adventure

In Sea of Survivors, you can sail your ship in any direction but you can never stop moving. Evade and destroy hordes of pirates and sea monsters to gain experience, level up and choose upgrades for your ship. Explore oceans filled with mysterious curses, unlock treasures and fight for survival.
Détendez-vous dans ce jeu de puzzle pour vous garder de bonne humeur
Lucid Dream is Point and Click horror game. The girl dream of being trapped in a weird place even though you fell asleep as always. Collect the item and Find clues! Escape and wake up from the dream!

Plongé dans l'ambiance rétrofuturiste des années 1990, Inertial Drift propose une expérience de conduite absolument unique en son genre, ainsi que des mécaniques de dérapage à deux joysticks si incroyables qu'elles méritent d'être vécues.

Teria: an action quest 3D game for science fiction fans. However, on June 17, 2143, the crisis center of the Central Astronautics Agency picked up a distress signal from small planet Teria, which was then forwarded to Alex. Alex is a private detective who at that time happened to be not far from Teria.
You will embody a fly, a spider, a bee or a human. Your mission thus is to survive or to slap the fly !

Alex Young se réveille prisonnière d'un étrange manoir rempli d'énigmes, de pièges et de caméras qui la surveillent. Dans ce mystérieux thriller à la première personne, vous devez trouver la raison de son enlèvement ainsi que de celui de ces camarades. Leur destin est entre vos mains.
Search for secrets, solve puzzles, get ready to survive a series of dangerous nights in this action adventure full of challenges and difficulties. Will you be able to escape from the Cursed island?
Tower of Waifu is a Tactical match 3 puzzle game. Learning spells, upgrading your stats and creating your own tactics, conquer the tower, defeat bosses.

In this horror game, you must do everything you can to escape the demon’s clutches alive. Your soul is at stake. You will be saved or you will be damned forever. Remember, in the game, your choices can affect the people most important to you. Protect them and your mental state! Fight to the end!

This exciting TPS mecha action game is set in the future of Seoul, offering a unique experience that combines intense combat with strategic depth. Defend, destroy, and take over apartments with the cool robots you build!

Pour pousser les utilisateurs à installer des logiciels malveillants, des éditeurs sans scrupules cachent habilement des pièges dans les installateurs de logiciels légitimes. Saurez-vous éviter leurs ruses et installer uniquement des logiciels purs sur votre ordinateur ?

Build and run your own casino empire — alone or in 1-4 player online co-op. Deal blackjack, poker and roulette yourself, spin real slot games, hire staff, expand your building, buy houses and cars in a living city… and outsmart every cheater who walks in.
Jumpala : Tryouts Edition is being phased out - please visit the main Jumpala Steam page for the full experience of this easy to learn and hard to master competitive action puzzler.
Pilot your plane and battle giant robotic monsters with unique capabilities in tenfantastic settings. Then, take to the skies in online multiplayer dogfights and showthe world who's boss.
With the world descending into chaos, will you protect the light, or consume it? Which side will you choose and what forces will you take under your command?
Steno Arcade is a suite of arcade games designed to teach and drill steno fundamentals in an immersive, addictive, responsive, and interactive way.

Jouez à un jeu de réflexion avec des amis du monde entier ! Découvrez une expérience palpitante et la satisfaction de rester incognito jusqu'à la fin. Différents modes sont disponibles, comme « Gendarmes et voleurs » et « Trouvez le joueur ».

Dans cette aventure malsaine en vue subjective se déroulant dans une université de médecine abandonnée, testez votre intelligence en élucidant un mystère vieux de 20 ans. Échappez à votre destin de cobaye humain, prisonnier d'un scientifique morbide. Dans The Crow's Eye, la fin justifie les moyens.
Just make a cake.
Une aventure-post nucléaire dans laquelle vous contrôlez 3 Geeks névrosés et échappés d'un asile de fou...

Aide Franky F. Frank à combattre les terribles cardesiens, zombies et robots pendant que tu libères tes compagnons emprisonnés. Bullshot est un jeu Run and Gun cherchant à récupérer l'essence des classiques des années 90 comme Abuse, Contra (Probotector) ou Metal Slug.

Dungeon Drafters est une aventure donjon mystère qui se déroule dans un monde où la magie est cartes. Explorez des ruines anciennes, pillez des cartes rares et employez des combos astucieux pour abattre vos ennemies et bâtir le deck de sorts legendaires qui pourra sauver le monde.
This isn't a horror game. Nothing will jump out at you.

titre: Adventure Time: Finn and Jake's Epic Quest
description: Fais équipe avec Finn et Jake dans une aventure en 3D aux proportions épiques ! La Terre de Ooo a été changée en un jeu vidéo géant, et BMO a été enlevé. Traverse le Jardin de la sorcière, le Royaume des glaces, le Royaume des flammes et même la Terre des morts à la force du poing pour sauver BMO et démasquer le cerveau maléfique qui est...

Shoot from affar or get nibble away up-close and personal in a boss-rush, bullet-dodging revival of the 1982 Atari classic title, Yars' Revenge. Take on 60 unique enemy encounters alone or with a friend in local co-op.

Dustland Delivery is a post-apocalyptic survival business simulator. Scour the wastes for profit, complete missions to grow your trading empire, and assemble a rag-tag band of adventurers to turn your city into the capital of the Dustlands. Danger lurks around every corner—but no risk, no reward!

La princesse du Royaume des Fleurs a disparu. Elle a été enlevé par Ghulibas du Nord, et c'est désormais au courageux Zee Tee de la sauver. Dans sa quête, lui - et vous - allez découvrir les terres cachés de ce paisible royaume, et vous retrouverez face à d'inquiétants secrets.

"Journey to the West Survivors" is a survivor-like game. You can choose from 12 interesting characters and combine various playstyles among over 200 skills. Additionally, you can get married, cultivate crops, build structures, recruit partners, and work together to fight against enemies.
Launch a rocket. Extend the Antenna. Set your internet service price and start making money. Oh and shoot down asteroids if they threaten your satellites.
天缘传说是一款超仙气超唯美国风的武侠类的角色扮演的战斗手游，游戏以精美的东方设计了独特的武侠人物，丰富的副本剧情，来完成挑战，获取坐骑战宠，神装，精彩不停，互动结交，还可结姻缘，携手仙侣共度此生，修仙之路不寂寞。
Claymation action adventure in an odd world of talking pumpkins, blue trees and stuff like that.
A mysterious trip to gorgeous and surreal lands, players explore the unknown and harness mystical powers which have been hidden in the valley for centuries.

Disappearing cows, strange visitors, talking trees... What is going on here...? Is the end of the world, the cowpocalypse really here? Discover the mysteries trough this puzzle filled, 2,5D, point & click style adventure game.

The Apocalypse shattered a world in disarray. Facing his impending death, a young boy named Sid crossed paths with Torii, a girl who feeds on the energy of time. In the harbour town of Astella, a mysterious adventure is about to unfold along with the investigation of an unusual crime...

Crookz - The Big Heist est un jeu de stratégie tactique baignant dans l'atmosphère groove-funk des années 70. Déployez tout votre art de l'escamotage en choisissant soigneusement votre équipe, vos outils et le déroulement de l'opération.

At the height of World War 2, take command of German, Russian, British, American and Imperial Japanese armies on battelfields across the globe. Sudden Strike 2 expands on all aspects of the classic RTS game with new units, maps and epic campaigns.
Narumi Kouki, our hapless protagonist, writes a risque romcom for a weekly manga magazine. Due to its content, he's kept it a secret from everyone except the two closest to him: Mihiro and Toa.

Everyone can kill monsters, but have you tried to be friends with them? In this world, any monster can be tamed and made your ally. He will help both in PvP and PvE and grow with you! Choose a class and become the hero of this world in an absolutely free classic MMORPG!

Chart a course for mystical adventure in this fusion of Tactical Turn-Based RPG and Strategy. Become a Wanderer - explorer, warrior, leader and tactician all in one. This is a small tactical adventure where you have to go through the prologue of the main Story.

Bronana is a thrilling and hilarious survival roguelike. Embody the spirit of a fearless banana warrior to take down waves of vicious snack monsters. Through a rich variety of random events, grow stronger, evolve abilities, and face off against challenging bosses to save the homeland.

3079 is a futuristic, open-world action first-person role playing game. All areas, buildings, items, quests and characters are randomly generated. You will find unique lands & challenges. I hope you enjoy it!

WorldHorrorStory est un jeu de survie horrifique coopératif où vous devez bannir le mal avant qu'il ne vous détruise. Dans le jeu, vous pouvez communiquer avec des fantômes et des démons en utilisant votre voix, mais soyez prudent; si les fantômes répondent, cela ne signifie pas qu'ils sont amicaux.

Hé, alors tu es l'élu ? Bienvenue dans votre nouvelle maison, votre village ! Construisez-le, développez-le, répondez aux besoins de ses habitants et combattez le mal qui hante votre village. Mais surtout, saurez-vous résoudre le mystère du village ?

Box's Dream is an elegant puzzle game where you'll have to push boxes into the correct positions, but it won't be easy, as various challenges such as ice floors, holes, pistons and many others await you in this exciting and unforgettable experience.

BEHOLD THE KICKMEN is a football game made by someone who has no understanding of, or interest in, what is affectionately known as "The Wonderful Game". Start at the bottom of the Big Boring Football Spreadsheet and grind your way up to become the best at the football anyone's ever seen.
Absent is the first freeware release from FNGames. Originally released in 2013, the game makes its' Steam debut this year.
Dethrone the Zodiacs, revive the Golden Age and purge the Heretics that swarm the galaxy as Virgo, the queen of Purity, in this unforgiving timed actions turn-based JRPG.

TurnTack is an adaptation of Aztec mythology. In Aztec mythology, the world perishes every 4,000 years. It's been destroyed four times so far, and TurnTack covers the fifth world. One day, the girl with white hair runs away from the Aztec.
PixelJunk™ Shooter Ultimate est un jeu de tir avec deux sticks truffé d'action et d'énigmes à résoudre.
A retro FPS set in a faux norse-celtic fantasy world in the midst of a war with the dead. Grab an axe, get revenge.
Ed broke the curfew to visit his friends in order to find out the truth of his granddaughter's disappearance, but the truth was far more terrible than he thought.

Control a fully armed Mech and fight through cyberpunk cities, military bases and industrial ruins. Capture and defend territories, build turrets and structures, and wage war against powerful enemies!
Space Voyager est un jeu solo d'adresse et de réflexion au gameplay simple et efficace. Tracez votre route à travers l'espace en essayant d'économiser votre carburant.
Shoot or die. New shooter in two view modes. Post-apo maps, enjoy with your friends !
Magic Quest is a tower defense game with towers, mighty enemies, bosses and heroes with unique abilities.

The poker master-class. Casino Poker offers the ultimate guide to learning the art of playing and winning a great hand of poker, all without risking a penny. Learn all the play styles at your own pace and then bluff with the best at the biggest casinos in the world.

'Sentimental K' est un jeu vidéo Rogue-like basé sur des actions 3D. Armes, compétences, artefacts, configurations de donjon, les boss changent au hasard à chaque jeu. Faites des choix passionnants qui peuvent conduire à la synergie et profitez du jeu inattendu et stimulant!

titre: Debugger 3.16 // Recoded // Despair of the Developer Edition
description: The developer messed it up, his games are full of errors and bugs and he lost all hope that somebody will buy it! Take control of Debugger 3.16 and try to delete all the bugs the developer produced in this 2D-Platformer for up to four players.

Paddle Combat est un jeu d'arcade au rythme rapide où vous contrôlez la pagaie qui doit éviter les ennemis tout en leur faisant rebondir le disque. Jouez à travers 60 niveaux de variété contre plusieurs types d'ennemis distincts.

titre: Starship Turd Nugget: Too Cool For Stool
description: A retro-arcade-inspired space shooter with tongue-in-cheek humor, a focus on exhilarating powerups, and score attack.
PewPew! - move, shoot and upgrade!

titre: Cry Babies Magic Tears: The Big Game
description: Le Grand Jeu est une aventure amicale et amusante, parfaite pour les jeunes joueurs. Rejoignez Lady, Coney, Dreamy et leurs amis dans une toute nouvelle aventure et participez à un tournoi passionnant en plusieurs étapes pour gagner la légendaire sucette d'or !

Experience a colorful world full of vibrant characters through the eyes of Letha, a young warrior on the hunt for district masters in her pursuit to become Proeliums new emperor in this anime style turn-based RPG.

You are Zack. Juggle balls with unique properties through platforming puzzles to a goal at the end of each stage. Help Zack fill his treasured book of stickers to unlock optional challenge levels, where you race against the timer to destroy targets as fast as possible.

NORSK: Epistle is an experimental singleplayer game. Set in the atmospheric abandoned Siberian town the game will introduce how to solve puzzles using second dimension in 3d world to understand what happened with humanity.
Command ships, submarines and aircraft in the South Pacific during WWII.

The fate of a captured princess lies in the hands of a single woman. Using the power of the spirits and a variety of items, the female knight Jeanne must explore the kingdom that's been thrown into chaos to save Princess Lily in this classic-style action RPG.

‘Dark Eden’, the real R.P.G game, will provide you a new experience you did not have from the other games before. Welcome to the world of ‘Dark Eden’ themed in Vampire which isdifferentiated from the typical fantasy world.

Un jeu de construction de colonie mêlé à de la grande stratégie. Incarnez un chef de tribu et guidez votre peuple de l’Âge de Pierre à l’Âge du Bronze. Survivez, prospérez… et livrez bataille contre d’autres nations anciennes pour le contrôle des terres.
Devenez un explorateur sous-marin sans peur et atteignez le fond de la fosse des Mariannes pour gagner 20 000* VRAIS DOLLARS!

Food Drive: Race against Hunger is a fun driving adventure into food bank awareness. By collecting food and making timely deliveries you can work your way through 3 levels of driving, delivery, and fun.

Vous êtes perdu dans le Vide des Bermudes, un océan infini et de rares terres. Fabriquez votre navire et survivez en haute mer. Trouvez de nouvelles terres, campez, chassez des trésors, marchandez et défendez votre navire contre les redoutables pirates de cet étrange royaume !
Entre dans la peau d’un vrai général à la tête d’une véritable armée. Rejoint la bataille, capture les châteaux ennemis et augmente la puissance de ton armée. Mène ton clan à la victoire !

Battez-vous dans la bataille divine finale, en conduisant votre équipe comme une Divinité ou en combattant pour la gloire comme un Chasseur. 3 équipes, 15 joueurs, une règle: Gagner. Il n'y a pas des secondes chances dans cette Aréne de Bataille de Stratégie en Ligne avec le support de Réalité Virtuelle asymétrique
Fallen Region est un jeu bac à sable de survie à la troisième personne, dans un monde ouvert post-apocalyptique.

titre: Lost Eidolons: Veil of the Witch
description: Veil of the Witch est un RPG de stratégie roguelite à la progression non linéaire. Recrutez un groupe de cinq vagabonds, obtenez des compétences tous les niveaux, et adaptez votre tactique à chaque partie dans des combats en tour par tour. Que les Dieux reconnaissent votre bravoure et votre sagesse.
Le Palace of Cards est la plateforme dédiée aux amateurs de jeux de cartes classiques. Sur notre site, joue en ligne au Skat, Rami, Patience, Mau-Mau, Doppelkopf et Schafkopf.

Suivez l’aventure vertigineuse de Theo dans “The Free Ones”, jeu de plateforme à la première personne. Transpercez les airs avec votre grappin, frayez-vous un chemin au milieu des canyons et prenez part à une histoire hors du commun.

"Ghoul League" is a doomsday treasure brush shooting game. Any corpse ghost seen in the game can be caught against humans. "Two person game is the future". The game also supports multi person mode. You can break through customs and brush suits with your partners!

Chasses pendant la journée, soyez chassé pendant la NUIT ! Mists of Noyah est un jeu de survie en co-op, avec des mondes générés au hasard et de nombreux éléments RPG. Combattez des factions qui évoluent au fil des jours et des monstres bizarres qui vous terroriseront la nuit !

Unbox: Newbie's Adventure is a 90s style 3D platformer about the ultimate postal service, self-delivering cardboard boxes! Unbox: Newbie's Adventure has giant worlds full of challenges, collectibles and boxy boss battles!

You wake up on a dirt road, holding on to your last memory of your family screaming for help in front of you. Now, with all odds against you, you must complete challenging and dangerous quests to gain help from the villagers of Bartrone. How far are you willing to go to find your wife and son?

This driver enables customization of certain features of your VR Ink, such as changing parameters for the analog inputs (tip and primary), changing the activation threshold of the grip buttons and reviewing the status of the stylus.

New Star™ GP est un jeu de sport automobile arcade intense et doté de superbes graphismes rétro. Au fil de votre carrière, traversez les décennies tout en améliorant votre véhicule et votre écurie... ou tentez de décrocher le meilleur score en championnat, en solo ou jusqu'à quatre en écran partagé !

Un héritage maudit réveille quelque chose d’ancien, révélant une réalité terrifiante qui n’aurait jamais dû être vue. Suivez la piste de votre oncle disparu, découvrez des secrets interdits et affrontez une horreur cosmique lovecraftienne dans cette aventure à la première personne.
Slash It 2 is a 2D colorful arcade game. The goal is to press letters, numbers and type words in the right time and direction.
Hack your way out of a government-controlled city!

The year is 2023, and you are a head of private space launch company. You are driven by the only ambition: to reach the stars. Build rockets from wide variety of components, improve them, study new technologies to forge more and more powerful spacecraft.

Devenez la vedette de la saison 2018 de MotoGP™ ! Défiez tous les champions de MotoGP™ en tant que pilote professionnel sur les 19 circuits officiels. Profitez d'une expérience de jeu encore plus immersive grâce aux nouvelles fonctionnalités du jeu.

Galactic Missile Defense is a shooter and tower defense game, where you must protect Earth from the invading Martians that declared war on our planet just because a space rover accidentally ruined their picnic!
You are a space trooper. Your crew finished the cleaning mission and left you alone by accident. Now you are surrounded by aliens. Persist them as long as you can.

titre: 木夕镇的午夜轮回 Midnight cycle in Muxi Town
description: What kind of work is this? This is an experimental multi storyline game. The work tells a science fiction story about consciousness implantation and simulated biological experiments. The work consists of a mixture of 24 storylines, 3 types of reincarnation endings, and 1 main ending.
Winexy is a realistic 3D rolling ball game with a simple gameplay and entertaining action.

Lords of Xulima est un jeu de rôle ambitieux qui se déroule sur le continent mythique de Xulima, où les hommes et les dieux vécurent jadis côte à côte. Lancez-vous dans ce JDR original comptant plus de 100 heures de jeu, et découvrez l'une des épopées les plus épiques jamais racontées.
Risky Rescue is a demanding arcade game with flat design graphics and innovative controls. Fly a helicopter and do dangerous missions rescuing people.
Find you car somewhere in the garage by finding clues, before the time runs out. But you are not as alone as you think...

Complete your character design, plot manipulation, and worldbuilding all in one place. Designed to be a revolutionary tool for writers to plan out their stories, Campfire Pro has exactly what novelists and screenwriters need to go from the seed of an idea to a detailed plan that’s ready to be executed.

Blending galaxy conquering with quick and easy gameplay. Pick one of five races and set out to expand your one world into a vast empire. Research new techs, build colony ships, and begin to spread out, but be careful you aren't the only race on the rise.

Le tyran Ceville règne sur le royaume de Faeryanis. En fait il "régnait" sur le royaume de Faeryanis, jusqu'à ce que les gens se révoltent et le chasse du palais. La bonne reine Gwendolyn monta sur le trône et présida à la destinée des ses sujets. L'histoire aurait pu s'arrêter là avec un : "Et ils vécurent heureux...

Dots eXtreme est un jeu de puzzle classique avec des tableaux larges et des niveaux de difficultés élevés. Raccordez les couleurs et les formes correspondantes dans le nouveau puzzle de points avec des tailles de tableau allant jusqu'à 20 x 20.

Since the dimensional portal to the Outer Worlds was opened, a terrible evil has been invading our world. The dark armies of the Outer Worlds, led by the demon named Pompolic, have overrun most of our planet.
游戏传承《御龙在天》端游经典玩法，游戏以GVG泛国战玩法为核心，画面恢弘壮丽，真实再现了东汉末年群雄割据、万人鏖战的史诗战争场面。
studio: 深圳墨麟科技股份有限公司

description: Team-based action game with insane physics-driven power-ups. Shoot, duck behind cover, and coordinate with teammates...all in glorious VR! Play both Singleplayer Story Mode and Online Multiplayer!
人氣經典策略RPG遊戲《三國立志傳二》，不僅強化一代深受歡迎的特色，更加入多項新玩法！戰鬥模式新增騎馬打仗、機關車、特殊計謀，並加入天候與風向增添謀略性！重要的將領還會隨著成長改變造型，更高自由度的開放劇情，劉備、曹操與孫權三國主君任你選，吳蜀魏三國名將英雄伴你重寫新三國！

Après avoir dévasté la Terre, nous avons quitté la surface et peuplé les océans. Aqua - la mer - est notre nouveau monde. Pilotez un vaisseau de combat et explorez un monde sous-marin dystopique, déchiré par des luttes de pouvoir. Entrez dans le monde impitoyable d'Aquanox Deep Descent.
Dark Wish is an adventure role-playing game set in a harsh desert. Explore 'The Dust', a strange and unusual place filled with dangerous animals, bandits, and wanderers who pass on by.

titre: A Magical High School Girl / 魔法の女子高生
description: "The magic beckons you." A Magical High School Girl is a magic crafting rogue-like RPG! The only weapon you possess is the magic you conjure from within. You can freely name your magic. The elemental properties and effects are generated automatically with what you typed in.

Aquarium Designer t’offre la possibilité de créer l’aquarium de tes rêves ! Deviens un vrai professionnel dont le travail consiste à concevoir, construire et remplir un aquarium avec la faune aquatique diverse ! Tout type, toute taille - ta créativité est la seule limite !
Outside the Lines is a free top-down shooter where drawing utensils compete to cover a coloring book with their color.
Customize your own "Space Galaxy" in video game development for computer or mobile devices.

titre: 東方天空璋 ～ Hidden Star in Four Seasons.
description: 桜を見ながら西瓜を割り、紅葉を見ながら鍋をつつく こんな季節に誰がした！ イレギュラーでシーズナルなシューティング幻想！
3 Coins at School is a turn-based game similar to soccer but played with coins on a desk.

2d space combat like no other. From the perspective of a single crew member, explore the fully destructible interior of any ship in a massive living world. Engage in space combat with no hitpoints where you know your enemy is dead when you see them fall out of their ship into the cold dark of space.

Retour dans le monde d'Eschalon avec le suite du RPG très populaire de 2007. Le fléau de la guerre menace désormais le monde d'Eschalon et le seul espoir pour la paix réside dans le secret de votre passé.

Ether One is a first person adventure that deals with the fragility of the human mind. There are two paths in the world you can choose from. At its core is a story exploration path free from puzzles where you can unfold the story at your own pace.

VR horror rouge-like game where the player will need escape a purgatorial environment by completing a set of objectives and finding useful tools and equipment while avoiding and out-smarting hostile monsters and traps.
Jeu célébrissime qui a révolutionné le monde de l’arcade en 1987, Double Dragon s’impose indéniablement comme le beat'em up coop de référence.
Stealth your way through the shadows and uncover a corporate conspiracy. Become a cyber-augmented agent in this gameplay-focused stealth game that brings classic sneaking to the modern era.

titre: Rebel Reenactment: Battle of the Wilderness
description: Fight in massive line battles in this brutal shooter set during the American Civil War, in the Battle of the Wilderness of May, 1864.

Meeple Station est un jeu de simulation de station spatiale coopératif. Fortement inspiré par les jeux Dwarf Fortress et Rimworld (avec un soupçon de Space Station 13). Un jeu dans lequel la complexité d'un jeu de simulation se mélange avec la nature amicale et plaisante d'un jeu de Stratégie en Temps Réel.

Esquivez et frayez-vous un chemin à travers des créatures marines terrifiantes contrôlées par la Mort, un Kraken vicieux contrôlant l'esprit qui hante chacun de vos mouvements. Trouvez des trésors cachés pour débloquer des armes et des améliorations. Chaque plongée révèle un nouveau cauchemar.

titre: State of War : Warmonger / 蓝色警戒 (Classic 2000)
description: Enjoy an unforgettable blast from the past with this classic real-time strategy experience. This all-inclusive bundle includes the original 22 missions from State of War (2000), and 16 additional missions from its sequel, State of War: Warmonger (2003).
Fight through the battles like a ninja god in a first-person, cyberpunk-style and melee-heavy arcade arena world.

OBEY is an asymmetrical multiplayer game. In many games you send commands to teammates or AI units. In OBEY you command your (human) opponents, or are commanded by them. Players are always free to obey/disobey. And everyone deals with the consequences of their own decisions.
Alisa est un jeu d'action-aventure avec une trame de fond horrifique, c'est une véritable expérience authentique qui rend hommage aux années d'or des jeux en 3D, les années 90.

One of the highest rated Xbox Indie Games is now available for PC! How long can you survive in this online co-op wave based shooter? Featuring 35 characters, over 100 weapons, 30 stat-boosting hats, and 6 levels, Zombie Estate 2 is a frantically fun experience to share with friends!

titre: Poor Man's Adventure: Narco Sub Simulator
description: Join a small community of rejects, try to survive in hospitable world of peak capitalism. As a modern pirate you will scavenge wrecks of rich peoples' yachts for resources, grow weed and manage automated factories.
Swiftly is a very challenging platformer game. It has simple graphics and easy to understand rules, but you are going to have a hard time completing the levels.

Você monta um elenco formado pelos seus amigos, personagens ou celebridades favoritas, enfia todo mundo numa casa, e assiste o circo pegar fogo. IRMÃO Grande & Brasileiro 2 é o mais Grande e mais Brasileiro simulador de cárcere privado competitivo que o dinheiro pode comprar.
Recruit monsters to battle in tactical, turn-based combat. Create the ultimate team through careful fusion to pass on powerful abilities and save this kooky hand-drawn world.

The Insignia Project is a horror game that delves into an alternate universe within our multiverse where it has been corrupted and broken beyond repair. UO#-405 is now an ever-consuming universe where all of your nightmares come together into one place. Our universe has just been added to the mix.
Explore and investigate every corner and detail of this highly interactive apartment to unveil all its secrets and restore power to the city. An "escape the room" puzzle game.

Angle Of Attack is the aerial combat action companion title to All Aspect Warfare. It features high-octane air combat against air, land and sea threats over vast planetary regions. See the action from a different perspective and get in on the action!
This is a dramatic deep social point&click adventure about tough childhood and self-sacrifice.

Splasher est un plateformer 2D exigeant, plein d'humour et de surprises. Armé d'un canon à fluides, lancez vous à l'assault de l'usine de peinture Inkorp pour sauver vos compagnons les Splashers et mettre un terme aux plans machiavéliques de son big boss : l'infâme Docteur.

Bonjour, cher/chère employé(e). Vous êtes chargé(e) de trier les échantillons génétiques de CorpoNation Ringo. Avec vos crédits, vous pouvez acheter, jouer et payer vos factures. Des employés véreux pourraient vous inciter à trahir votre employeur bien-aimé, mais votre dévouement est incontestable.

Five souls, brought together in a simple rescue mission, come to learn that they are more connected than they had believed. Classic RPG goodness and intriguing storyline with this RPG from Valkyria Studios.

Un City Builder axé sur l'écosystème dans un monde unique. Construisez votre colonie, gérez vos travailleurs et optimisez vos ressources. Faites des choix cruciaux pour votre civilisation. Analyser votre environnement, propager de nouvelles plantes et les récolter sont les clés de la prospérité

The dead walk with a metallic clunk! Run, jump and shoot your way past mechanized zombies in an endless series of graveyards. It's up to you, Professor Selene Gasket, to put a stop to the menace and save the terrified villagers from the minions of Baron Richter von Sprocket.

Kart Racing Pro is a realistic karting simulator. The aim is to create a software useful as a training tool for real drivers, based on a scratch built physics engine that accurately simulates kart dynamics and setup options.

Trudge through haunting halls and desolate rooms, teleport through the darkness and hide in the shadows as you plan your escape. Feel your heart race as your doom looms ever closer. Find a way out before your fate is sealed.

Tirez sur des choses dans un monde de pixels parfait, combinez des objets, construisez des armes, mourrez à chaque fois ! Jeu de tir twin-stick roguelite où la magie et les technologies futuristes post-apocalyptiques se croisent. Vainquez le maléfique seigneur Dracula et sauvez tout le monde !

The hidden game society is a digital escape room experience. You have been invited to be a member of this mysterious club. You will find yourself alone and trapped in this curious board game-themed room full of atmosphere. Use your wit and deduction skills to find a way out.

Hexoscope is a new puzzle game that challenges your skills to create from Chaos. You should arrange the chaotic combination of hexagonal Chips to create a Chain from Power Source to Power Receiver. You should swap Chips with each other to combine their pins into solid Chain from Source to Receiver.
Échappez aux monstres et fuyez la maison !
Build up a haunted house in this Halloween themed Idle Clicker game!

Villagers is a beautifully illustrated and richly detailed town-building game where you build a thriving community using the people and resources around you. Success or failure depends on your ability to create a town that can grow and prosper, and overcome the harsh realities of medieval life!
Dyscourse is an interactive choice-based narrative adventure game where you journey through a stylized world of choice and consequence. Choose wisely.

titre: Hector: Badge of Carnage - Full Series
description: L'Épisode 3 - Beyond Reasonable Doom est disponible !

Gil's Lucid Dreams is a FPS horror game based on the story and exploration. Gil use lucid dreams to get away from his unsatisfacting life. He will lose the control of his dreams, becoming completely succubus of his nightmares. Will Gil be able to face his Alter Ego?

Panel houses, snow, overcast sky, tiny kitchen, shabby staircase… It's Winter is an indie game which genre could be classified as sandbox, post-soviet, sad 3d, russian sadness. Nothing awaits you: there is no chance to get out, no room for adventures and breathtaking plot.

In this game, you can do whatever you want, not necessarily follow the story of the game, you're not some dirty farmer, right? And for whom did this pathetic, boring, and generally unbearable story come up, because you don't always have to follow it right?
文字ADV《异界双子-twins-》是星律动画和鲲影互娱联合出品的复古类叙事互动游戏，随着叵测迷离的剧情推进，进而会出现互动选项，选项将会大幅度影响玩家能否触发重要剧情，及解锁收集向剧情CG，如果选择不妥甚至也会直接导致走向死亡结局。当你解锁众多支线拼凑所有细节就会发现这个世界的真貌远远超出你的想象。

In the world where all answers were told the great enemies confronted each other. The time has come. Time to defeat Obama once and for all. Will the world be free from racism or you will start a new era? It is up to you. But keep in mind... Obama has no chill.
The world, THIS IS JAPAN.

Un jeu de minigolf en vue de dessus incluant différents modes et objets. Jouez avec jusqu’à sept amis ! Choisissez entre un mode de jeu classique, dynamique ou extrême. Utilisez des objets pour empêcher vos amis de gagner. Créez vos niveaux dans l’éditeur de jeu et publiez-les sur Steam Workshop.
2020: THE RIDE is a year in review in the form of the world’s scariest VR roller coaster.
1-16 Player COMBAT ZONE & 1-4 Player COOP Zombie Wave Survival in Comic style. Singleplayer and Multiplayer Playthrough. Get ready for GUNWATCH: Conflict Survival!

titre: 子夜之章:历史的终局～MidNights of Desperado～
description: The protagonist of this lonely life is you. You leave your hometown and come to a strange world. The world is prosperous and cold, strange but real. You may like it or wish you could tear it to pieces. The good news is, you have the choice!

Dungeon of Zaar est un jeu de stratégie compétitif prenant place dans un ancien et énigmatique Donjon, théâtre de combats incessants entre les Explorateurs venus y chercher fortune et gloire. Actuellement en BETA.

titre: Train Simulator: East Coast Main Line London-Peterborough Route Add-On
description: Une des lignes les plus fréquentées du réseau de chemin de fer d’Angleterre est l’East Coast Main Line London-Peterborough qui se trouve dans le Train Simulator incluant le train à grande vitesse HST et la Class 365 EMU pour le trafic de banlieue.
Fancy a relaxing drift through magical waters? Enjoy this seafaring voyage in search of the sunset!

Trade and loot in real time world of post-apocalyptic Arizona. Join gangs and create unique vehicles! Engage in massive battles and choose from hundreds of customizable vehicles and guns, trade in drugs, pr♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥s, and slaves. Make your fantasy work, just like in an old school game!

titre: Path of Hero. Story of Dartes
description: This fun jRPG will immerse you in a fantasy world. The game makes fun of the clichés of old jRPGs, essentially being a funny parody of the games of our childhood. Immerse yourself in complete absurd satire. Learn professions, hire mercenaries and perform feats as if you were a Hero (Probably).
