Caligo est l'obscurité dans laquelle tout le monde descend d'une manière ou d'une autre, et pour chacun d'entre nous, elle représente quelque chose de différent. Pour certains, c'est une aventure courte mais palpitante, certains le verront comme un endroit pour se détendre.

Harry, a bank robber aims to rob a government bank, so he choose the day that the bank is open to visitors, and takes the opportunity to carry out the robbery. Upon arriving at the bank, learns some routines, of how things work and then begins to put his plan into practice.
Can you and a friend escape from a motel before the toxic tide swallows it?
An interactive audiovisual experience where you blow the fluids of music vibes. Generate maps and effects from your own music and videos. Enter flow state with adaptive mouse inertia blade control.
Nightmare Hunter falls in the range of fantasy VR shooting games. You need to hunt Incubuses to crack the nightmare, and become stronger within the cycle of battle and death.
Katy and Bob: a new chapter in the adventures of Katy and Bob. Head into the safari park and grow your business!

Serious Sam 3 VR: BFE est un glorieux retour à l'âge d'or des jeux de tir à la première personne, où les hommes étaient des hommes, où seuls les amateurs se mettaient à couvert et où appuyer sur la détente faisait tout exploser.
Felix The Reaper est une comédie romantique sur la vie de la Mort, une aventure 3D où puzzles, manipulation des ombres, danse, défunts et amour dangereux se mêlent et s'entremêlent.
The Summoner is a classic 2D traditional JRPG that puts you on the role of Freya, a simple scholar who was chosen to be The Summoner.
WELCOME TO ULTRA THUNDERBALL!!!! Are you ready for the greatest arcade challenge yet? Equip your Gun-Bat and try to defeat the evil geometrics. See you in the tournament!
《刺沙》是一款还原传奇单职业特色的游戏。游戏中主角色战士，带领宠物征战玛法大陆。野外地图BOSS，副本BOSS，各种精英BOSS等你去挑战。野外战斗，激情PK，炫酷觉醒，各种玩法带你领略传奇不一样的体验！
Welcome to The Outer Rim, where fast paced action and space combat meet. The Outer Rim: Survivor missions are free to download and play...Pure Action, Pure Mayhem - How long can you last?

Get ready to tilt and bounce your way through Rolled Out!, a marble-rolling game with charming characters and precise controls. All you need is one joystick to roll to the goal; with over 150 hand-crafted stages to tackle, there's always a new challenge around the corner!
This is a romantic visual novel about her struggles to find love and acceptance in a hostile world, with a Match3 Jewels mini-game to break up the action.

titre: STORY OF SEASONS: Pioneers of Olive Town
description: Bienvenue à Oliville, une communauté paisible établie par votre grand-père et ses amis précurseurs. Maintenant que vous avez repris sa ferme, vous devez perpétuer son héritage. Plantez des cultures, élevez des animaux, nouez des relations et faites connaissances avec vos concitoyens !
Something terrible happened in the forest! Someone frightened all Bugs! What happened? You are the only one who can find it out!
Investigator is a first-person exploration game with horror elements, where the events take place in a world of extreme weather cataclysms.
A hard, mind bending platformer based on imagination and quick reflexes.

Résolvez des énigmes, escaladez de vertigineuses parois et réfléchissez la lumière pour vous frayer un chemin à travers les tours et les donjons de TRI. Le mystique TRI vous permettra de créer vos propres voies dans ce monde très étrange.

titre: 黎明为歌 - Melody before the Dawn
description: 居住在极北之地的少女瑟里卡，每晚都会在睡梦中进入另一个世界—— 这里有着她未曾见过的风景，鲜活的友人，以及一场奇迹般的邂逅。 懵懂的感情为之觉醒，却被提醒一切只是幻梦…… 梦与现实究竟有什么联系，她们的命运又会发生怎样的转变呢？ 迷雾笼罩身周，她将舒展梦境的羽翼，为黎明献上歌唱。
Echappez-vous d'un piège temporel !

Suzanne Auver was a successful painter once, until her sister went missing. Blaming herself, she was persistent on finding her. But with frequent nightmares involving the disappearance of her sister, this wasn't an easy task.
Puzzle Ball is a physics-based puzzle game with a flexible and user-friendly level editor.
Lynne est une histoire courte traitant de la chose la plus effrayante en ce monde : l’adolescence.

Défendez-vous contre des hordes de zombies dans ce jeu de tir en vue de dessus amusant. Construisez et améliorez votre base, débloquez des armes puissantes et affrontez des boss difficiles avec jusqu'à 4 joueurs en coopération en ligne. Survivez à l'apocalypse zombie une nuit à la fois !

Steam Marines is a squad based Roguelike set on a steampunk spaceship. It features tactical play focused on positioning and careful use of resources. Built to keep you on your toes as you progress through the decks of your besieged ship while clearing enemies and trying to reach each level's elevator.

The second chapter in one of the most loved and respected Japanese shooting game series ever:The Tale of ALLTYNEX by Japanese indie developer SITER SKAIN. Carefully crafted play experiences, destructive fun, and absorbing gameplay have made the ALLTYNEX trilogy renowned in shooting game communities.

Choose your Spells, Perks, and Traits, then let the Wizard do all of the work in this unique Idle RPG! Tap Wizard 2 is a fusion of the Idle, Incremental, ARPG, and Twin-Stick Shooter genres, resulting in a game like no other!

titre: Brink of Consciousness: Dorian Gray Syndrome Collector's Edition
description: To free your beloved from captivity, you must venture into a maniacal world in this Special Collector's Edition of BRINK OF CONCIOUSNESS: DORIAN GRAY SYNDROME; an immersive tale of chilling surprise that's chock full of extras including bonus gameplay, concept art, soundtrack, and much more!

Have you ever dreamed of building your very own video games. but don’t know how to code? If so, then we have a tool specially designed for you to make video games of your dream. You can play games created by others or share your creations with others. The game is constantly updated

Modern-warfare RTS/sandbox game inspired by the real conflicts in the Middle East. Fight a counter-insurgency war, protect the civilian population, casevac your wounded and decide how the world sees your struggle. And remember - no one gets left behind.
An atmospheric retro survival horror game. Your first night on the job as a mall cop gets rudely interrupted, and you must survive somehow.
Découvrez Timber Tennis: Versus, un tout nouvel ajout à la famille Timberman, des jeux qui comptent plus de 30 millions d'utilisateurs de par le monde !

titre: Might & Magic: Heroes VI - Shades of Darkness
description: Un siècle après les tragiques événements de Might & Magic Heroes VI, qui scellèrent le destin héroïque d'une dynastie, Shades of Darkness raconte, en deux campagnes originales, les épisodes clés de la sombre histoire d’Ashan. Ceux-ci détermineront l'avenir d'un peuple secret et décideront du sort du culte de la Reine Araignée.
Top down puzzle game about manipulating the tracks to redirect the trolley to save the victims. Solve the trolley problem in various forms of tiny puzzles.

Affliction is a survival horror shooter designed to engage players with a thrilling storyline, surreal environments, merciless foes, a chilling atmosphere, and an unforgettable gameplay experience. Players must explore, scavenge, and fight in order to survive and live to tell the tale.
Un nouveau volet de la série Bravely ! Quatre nouveaux héros de la lumière, un nouveau monde et une nouvelle histoire !

Plain Sight est un jeu d'arcade multijoueur mettant en scène des robots ninjas kamikazes.Volez dans l'espace, sautez sur les petites planètes et détruisez vos ennemis à l'aide de votre katana. Tuez d'autres robots pour voler leur énergie si délicieuse.

Battle Cry of Freedom propose des combats brutaux en temps réel à la première et à la troisième personne dans l'Amérique du XIXe siècle, offrant aux joueurs la possibilité de revivre la guerre de Sécession dans la peau de l'Union ou des Confédérés.

The Legend of Crystal Valley est un jeu d’aventure point and click indépendant, axé sur l’histoire et l’exploration, se déroulant entre deux mondes où la réalité, la fantasy et la science-fiction s’entrechoquent.

A fright-filled Adventure that transpires in the heart of Transylvania. London 1904. Seven years after the slaying of Dracula, you play as Jonathan Harker, (the protagonist from Bram Stoker's original novel) and soon discover your wife, Mina has fled London for the Count's castle in Transylvania. Has Mina fallen prey to vampires?

titre: The Legend of the War Axe
description: The Legend of the War Ax is a real-time, third-person PvP combat. Choose a hero and fight other players in various arenas. Dynamic sword fighting, archery, magic and bombs. Now there are 10 heroes for which you can play.
Boodunnit?! is an adventure-sandbox game where you play as a ghost that has to solve the mystery of her own murder!

THE SPY WHO SHRUNK ME is a stealth game where you are a superspy armed with a shrink ray! Shrink enemies and feed them to paper shredders - or shrink yourself to get past enemies. Sneak in 1980's Moscow and sabotage operations in a stealth game unlike any other.

L’expérience d’horreur psychologique à la première personne dans toute son effroyable gloire, emblématique de toute une époque. Tous les chapitres du jeu en un coffret qui vous permet de parcourir les profondeurs de la folie à la poursuite de la sublimation artistique.

titre: A Chair in a Room : Greenwater
description: Explore your surroundings as the protagonist of your own horror story as you immerse yourself in this tense VR thriller set in America’s Deep South. Navigate your way through your memories, piecing together the clues and puzzles, to solve the mystery of how you have awoken in the sinister Greenwater Institute, known only as Patient No.

You are a patient of a psychiatric clinic. You don't remember anything about your past. A certain orderly helped you escape, because he knew that you were here by mistake. You need to find out the real reason of it.
Do you like cats? Then this is the purrfect game for you!
An independent story-based cinematic FPS game describing the drama of a student 's. Story is based on experienced emotions.

Kaisuo is a single-player puzzle game about opening Chinese puzzle boxes that unlock surreal worlds. Journey through a strange landscape and discover new uses to familiar objects. Slide open panels, discover secret compartments and change the way you see the world.

Trois jeux d’action aventure incroyables de la série des Castlevania font leur retour pour la première fois ! Mais ce n’est pas tout ! Voici venir la sortie de Haunted Castle Revisited, une version réimaginée du tout premier Castlevania sur arcade !

Enjoy sitting back at the classic feel of the turn-based RPG's you grew up and fell in love with. Follow the story of Tyra, a War-Axe Wielding Spellslinging Half-Elf and her friends to discover the dark past of magic and the mysterious history of her parents.
Incarnez un légendaire héros Perse, dans sa quête de vengeance pour récupérer la masse d'arme mythique de ses ancêtres que lui ont volé les Deevs. Achetez avant le 16 mai et économisez !

He got close a few times, but never won the Trashpit Championship. As skilled behind the wheel as your father was, there was something missing. Maybe it was instinct, maybe ferocity, or the hummingbird beat reaction times that success on the track demands.
Bright Bird is designed to be a seamless side-scrolling world full of challenging puzzles. Begin your exciting journey, find the bright bird to save the world!

Glitchspace is about reprogramming the game to solve puzzles. Trapped in an abstract cyberspace world, your way forward uses visual programming to edit environmental geometry, whilst unlocking key programming concepts along the way.
Devenez un chef de guerre redoutable !

Expérimentez des courses d’hydro-jets illicites nouvelle génération, où les pilotes blindés effectuent des cascades périlleuses par-dessus des chutes d'eau immenses, évitent les flics et filent sur des vagues déferlantes.

Ayant perdu tout contact avec son amie exploratrice Virgi, notre héros alien sans peur et sans reproche, Spidy, se dirige vers la Terre pour la retrouver. Alors qu’il entre dans l’atmosphère, son vaisseau tombe soudain en panne et force Spidy à se poser d’urgence sur cette étrange planète.

titre: Castle: Never Judge a Book by its Cover
description: A hidden object mystery that will immerse casual players into the thrilling exploits of famous mystery novelist Richard Castle and Detective Kate Beckett.

You are Korda, the Chronomaster. You must re-start time and right the wrongs of a war-plagued past in this epic quest for vengeance. Journey through man-made "pocket universes" full of cyborgs, pirates and witches who provide deadly puzzles. It's up to you to return justice to the stars.
Soothing game. Created to relieve psychological stress in people of different ages. Helminth Valera, Horse Anton Bober Vasily return!!!

BlazeRush is a dynamic arcade racing survival game with no health, no levelling and no brakes! You can assemble a team of friends to play in local or online multiplayer, choose a car to your taste and chase, blow up and cut off! Adapt your style and tactics to new enemies, obstacles and tracks.

Death Rabbit Arena is a fun first person and third person shooter that takes place in real world locations. Play with friends online or offline against the computer or by yourself and explore big open world maps.

The incredibly challenging and addictive Super Splatters! With elastic suicidal blobs and extraordinary liquid physics that actually affect the way you play, Super Splatters delivers fresh gameplay, ripe with tons of tricks to explore.

Principia: Master of Science is a simulation game with the theme of European science in 17th century. Choose one of 12 real scientists from the era of Isaac Newton and proceed with your research. It is a time when even the term "Science" did not exist. Who can be the master of science?
"Only an Alien Going Up!" is a difficult 3D platformer where your only goal is to climb to the top, without checkpoints.

titre: Chronicles of a Dark Lord: Rhapsody Clash
description: Experience the battles of the Chronicles of a Dark Lord series in this rhythm-based combat game.

For the first time, suit up in an off-the-wall multiplayer adventure where iconic Disney characters and legendary Disney worlds collide. Discover the mixed-up humor of this ever-expanding universe as you team up with friends to overcome challenges and defeat enemies.

MORE STORY THAN GORY! A HYBRID OF ALTERNATIVE HORROR AND CREEPYPASTA...Welcome to the Halloween Edition v1.03! Take a deep breath, dim the lights, put on your headphones...Non-linear first-person gameplay lets you explore Grimhaven Orphanage and discover the characters who once lived there – voiced by Dan Bull, Chuck Huber and Raychul...
GARDIEN D'ANIMAUX RECHERCHÉ. Un jeu d'adventure et d'horreur point-and-click. Arrose les plantes, nourris les animaux et n'éteins PAS la lumière.
"Choose your own adventure" style nightmares

Teddy Floppy Ear is a main character of series of adventure games for the children, based on the on famous Polish cartoon. Send your kid onto an unforgettable journey with the world’s most charming bear!
Live your childhood nightmare and try to survive against the Boogeyman. Equipped with only your flashlight, survive each night until the morning light.
"Tropicalia: a Brazilian Game" est un RPG basé sur la mythologie Tupi-Guarani. Le tout premier bRPG !

With some special reasons, Tang Sheng, a human being, fell into a world of monsters between the underworld and the human world. At the same time, he found that he had lost his memory. He learned that he had to find all the " belongings " when he fell down to return to the world.

titre: VEGAS Movie Studio 14 Platinum Steam Edition
description: Découvrez le montage vidéo de haute qualité – avec VEGAS Movie Studio Platinum – Steam Edition.Créez de fantastiques films en un temps record, même si vous débutez !
Point culminant de la série des jeux SWORD ART ONLINE, Last Recollection offre la plus grande liste de personnages jouables de SAO et propose plusieurs histoires secondaires !
Guess Who ? is a quiz game, you will see 5 image of animals, 1 target and 4 options. Just select the animal of the same species with the target animals

This is a survival game. After the coronation, human beings had to move into the underground. Fifty years later, some people thought the disaster was over and organized a survival competition on the surface. Some brave people took part in the competition . You are one of them.

Dogfight Time is an aerial racing game with shooting mechanics. Race your opponents into the finish line, picking up objects to destroy opponents planes or protecting your plane from damage. Earn in-game money by completing matches, unlock new planes to race with.
Naviguez dans des labyrinthes psychédéliques sur des rythmes électorniques. Imaginez un mélange entre Super Meat Boy et Geometry Wars.

titre: Go Home Annie: An SCP Game
description: Un thriller psychologique et inédit dans l'univers des SCP. En tant qu'employée de la Fondation SCP, vous devez tester des phénomènes paranormaux conçus artificiellement, résoudre des énigmes, interagir avec des anomalies et découvrir les secrets de la Division de réplication.
Do not buy, about to be taken down, don’t waste your money!

To commemorate the 15th anniversary of the sword fighting action game series Onee Chanbara, the events of THE Onee Chanbara and THE Onee Chanbara 2 have been completely remade in full HD. The evolution of this high-speed action game cannot be missed!
Defeat your enemies , take their body parts to replace yours and become another strong boss yourself.
Ready for something new? Trackday Manager introduces a new category of skill based race car management in a multiplayer online environment.
Build a town in a post-apocalyptic world. Gather resources to expand and survive. Express your moral and ethical views by setting laws that affect how people live. What kind of society will you make?

Progettato integralmente per VR, Wanderer offre un amalgama di rompicapi in stile escape room, sensazioni tattili nelle interazioni e sequenze di azione arcade per farti vivere un'avventura nel tempo superiore. Te la senti di seguire le orme di coloro che se ne sono già andati?

Orczz is a fantasy tower defense game set in the fantasy Kingdom of Whiteleaf, famous for its delicious honey wine – the mead. The player controls the Knight Order of the Mug, protectors of Whiteleaf and the mead, who are once again called to defend the land against an invading horde of orcs.

Vous n'avez pas demandé à commander cette expédition et pourtant, vous voilà bloqué dans les glaces, sans capitaine, à des lieues de toute civilisation et quelqu'un doit prendre les choses en main. Gérez ressources, sécurité et moral pour réussir à traverser l'enfer blanc de The Pale Beyond.

With its great production values, beautiful art, intense narrative drama and epic fantasy adventure, Burning Faith is a Tactical RPG in the classic style of Feda the Emblem of Justice and Shining Force, that will satisfy the itch of T-RPG and RPG fans alike.

The latest iteration of the 10th anniversary "SAMURAI WARRIORS" series is here at last! Naomasa Ii appears as a playable character for the first time, and the various personalities of the age are explored in more depth in "Story Mode", which is now focused on individual characters.

Embark on an 8-bit style JRPG quest to save Earth. Battle in unique party-based combat mixing real-time action and strategic commands. Join Gio and a team of lively characters as they unearth bizarre global events, forgotten legends, and battle mythical foes to unveil the secrets of Geo Mythica.
There is a belief that wars are won by soldiers. But sometimes, wars are won long before even beginning. Have mode 1v1 to play with friend at evening.
《白雀》是一款有轻度惊悚要素的解谜游戏，玩家需要扮演主角白雀，在陌生而诡异的异空间中找到逃离的方法，以及隐藏在这之下的故事……
Kalymn Nox is the Albino Hunter; even his pretentious and slightly racist title can keep him from waking up broke after a night of drinking.

Partez à la chasse aux araignées dans Kill It With Fire 2 ! Exterminez l'envahisseur à huit pattes en solo ou en coop, déployez un arsenal d'armes déjantées, semez le chaos et relevez des dizaines de défis dans sept dimensions infestées d'affreux arachnides.

Plonge dans un jeu de plateforme et de puzzles environnementaux imaginés pour l'exploration et la compréhension de structures à la gravité relative. Tu y incarnes un être sans voix, né dans un monde dans lequel t'attend une voix sans corps. Il est temps de découvrir ta raison d'être.
Dōkyūsei is a seminal classic of the dating sim genre that first blew Japan's mind in 1992. This updated remake adds HD art, optional modern features, and for the first time ever, a global release.

titre: Hero of the Kingdom: The Lost Tales 1
description: Plonge dans ce RPG d'aventure pittoresque et vis un conte chaleureux. Prends sous ton aile le petit orphelin Brent, rassemble des provisions et tends la main à ceux dans le besoin. Découvre des paysages sereins et savoure une exploration paisible à deux, en toute quiétude.
For Tan Yan, there is little hope his life will change. It's like his whole life is trapped inside a snowdome, unable to escape. But, what if, one day, he's given the chance to make a change?
A fantastic FPS to play together with your friends or alone.Go into the savage world of Operation Breakout and get yourself to the top!A great game without Pay2Win!

Pressed for time?! Same for this rat, but he can manipulate it! Join RedEyes the Rat on the heist of his life. Sneak into the bank, steal the diamond, evade the guards . . . and then get out! But most of all, be clever, trick time, and take back what’s ours from the Pigs who control all the banks in Swine Island City.
Set sail and join yer crew in search of treasure and glory!

Tinting Time is a Japanese-style crafting game. Play as a creator who can create all kinds of solutions, and spend some leisure time in the city of Folest. The game's creation system that combines crafting and complex resource management gameplay is eye-catching.

System Under Surveillance (SUS) is a charming stealth puzzle adventure, where you have to avoid and trick enemies rather than fight them. Take control of Adam and his little robot, TURBO. Use their unique abilities to navigate a maze-like dystopian city. Do you have what it takes to escape?

The first short story from PolyCity. A point and click adventure delving into the dark and dirty polygonated corners of the City of angles... mostly right angles. The Affair follows a soft boiled/over easy private detective as he unpicks an organised crime syndicate operating across the city.
Barnyard Mahjong 3 vous emmène dans une grande aventure autour de la ferme, à résoudre des casse-têtes mahjong stimulants avec des animaux de la ferme tels que des chevaux, des vaches et des poules.

In a quiet Canadian town with a population of 17 thousand, people start disappearing; especially women and children. A spouse of a disappeared woman discovered what happened, and returns from his business trip. Once he comes back, he realizes that his family was not the only one to disappear.
A private-eye must deceive a rich family into revealing their darkest secrets, before the killer amongst them silences everyone.
A comedic gorilla RPG wherein you must save all life from humanity through intense combat.

Cosmic Sugar is an elegant, GPU driven simulation space. Vive wands become attractors or repulsors which allow you to craft nebulas. The controls are very simple, but it takes some time to explore all of the possibilities. Thanks to East Forest for the trailer music.
A dream-like sandbox that just might have a mind of its own.

A sci-fi flying person vs. robot battle game. A stolen asteroid on this flyland contains a labyrinthine mine named Not Yours Mine, and may still have murderous minedroids and a security force-- but certainly does have poison-gas-spewing spiderbots. You have to destroy them all!
Hentai Killer - a third-person shooter in which an anime girl fights against an anime zombies for saving own life.
Defuse a Toxic Plot and Reveal the Truth Behind Kate Drew’s Death!

Scrapnaut est un jeu de survie descendant et de construction de base avec des éléments steampunk. Explorez un monde ouvert avec différents biomes, gérez l'oxygène, gérez vos fermes, produisez de l'électricité, construisez votre maison et bien plus encore !

titre: The Aquatic Adventure of the Last Human
description: Explore the ruins of the human race and discover the thriving wildlife that blossomed after our extinction in this underwater action/adventure. Encounter monstrous creatures and let curiosity guide you through an inevitable voyage of extinction.

This is a short hardcore enthralling puzzle-platform game about a lonely robot, which tries to find his master. To go all the way you'll have to look for the master in two dimensions at the same time. Parallel world module will help to overcome any obstacles!
Every strike is lethal in this blood-soaked sword fighting game. Slash, clash, parry, dodge and watch limbs fly. Choose your move carefully - the first cut is also the last.
Chill is a relaxing, minimalist maze game.
Throw on your nostalgia goggles and travel back in time with Super Win the Game, a retro-core explosion of exploration and platforming action!!
This is a sample game created in "RPG Maker MZ" by Douraku. Equip souls to unlock new powers and fight the aliens in this traditional RPG.

DRAGON QUEST HEROES II est un RPG d'action de type hack and slash qui vous lance dans une nouvelle aventure. Ramenez la paix dans un monde autrefois tranquille rempli de monstres et de combats épiques. Dissipez la menace qui plane sur les Sept royaumes ! Jusqu'à 4 joueurs en multijoueur coopératif.
Deus ex Machina is a VR room escape game where you solve puzzles in the lab of a crazy scientist. Become a member of DEM ( Deus Ex Machina ) and save the world in danger.

Writer's Rush is a writer life simulator where you compete with other authors for the title of the world's greatest writer. Craft articles, books, scripts, and fanfics. Complete publisher contracts, unlock new skills, and level up your literary talents.
qop 2 is a minimalistic puzzle which goal is to get the cube to finish using 4 directions in space.

Regalia est un RPG tactique se déroulant dans un monde fantastique sympathique peuplé de monstres et regorgeant d’or. Constituez votre groupe, partez à l’aventure, gérez votre royaume, faites-vous des amis et affrontez vos adversaires dans des combats difficiles au tour par tour.

Le vieux royaume est en péril. Les 4 éléments qui maintenaient l'équilibre pendant des siècles ont été corrompus par les forces du mal et l'autel ne contient plus l'énergie vitale. Il vous revient la mission de trouver et de débloquer les 4 grimoires magiques et de collectionner les 16 cartes mystérieuses qui rendront la vie au royaume.
Break through ceilings, rescue princesses and escape boiling lava as you slash your way to the top of the Knightmare Tower!

Contrôlez des robots géants et battez-vous dans ce jeu de combat en 3D. Des combats épiques vous attendent en mode Versus local et en ligne, en coop 4 joueurs (où chacun contrôle une partie d’un robot), et en campagne un joueur. Chaque robot possède ses propres styles, techniques et coups décisifs.

It’s 2065, and you are an interrogator-model android tasked with rooting out deviants among your own kind. You must probe for lies, monitor and exploit emotional spikes, earn the trust of your subjects, and make the final call: release, or destroy?
The endros need your help to survive in this world of endless monsters that keeps appearing. Make the endro species last for eternity and help them defeat the evil.
DOWNFALLEN is a short adventure game that tells the story of a civilian in a battlefield where everything takes a turn for the worse.

Le joyau des jeux de stratégie et action fantaisie heavy metal arrive pour PC en HD. Menez vos armées depuis les lignes de front, en donnant des ordres stratégiques à vos forces tout en vous immergeant dans une bataille d’action hack n ‘slash.

Magnetic: Cage Closed is a first person puzzle game where the player manipulates magnetic forces to accomplish their goals. The mechanics are focused around a single tool: The Magnet Gun which allows you to create electromagnetic fields with either positive or negative charges.
Vinyl is a dynamic indie music game created by graduate students at the University of Utah EAE program, that experiments with the aesthetic distance between gameplay and music.
You don't know what do to? Just ask Hana! You can chat with Hana, ask her any question and as an oracle she will answer you. Enter specific keywords and she will tell you different stories!
Nouveau jeu des créateurs de Worms, Flockers est une version revisitée du célèbre genre réflexion, agrémentée d'une pincée d'humour noir.
Get the final episode in the Fated Souls series! Cut bushes, jump, kick, push stones, solve logic puzzles and more!

At Bernard Cinemas we work harder not smarter! Work may feel like a loop but once you get infected, we'll take care of you! During the vaccination process please make sure to cover majority of your immune system's field. Good luck!

The Hive est un jeu de stratégie avec des éléments de jeu de rôle dans lequel vous commandez un esprit-essaim insectoïde. Construisez et développez votre colonie souterraine, rassemblez des ressources et faites évoluer votre essaim grâce à l'ADN. Survivrez-vous dans ce monde souterrain aussi hostile que magnifique ?

Visual Novel and Walking Simulator style game with multiple endings. A love letter to the classical horror stories about old haunted houses, basements and ofcourse attics. Psychological horror inspired by author's experience with OCD-like symptoms and intrusive thoughts.

titre: Redneck Joe Vs The Swamp Zombies
description: In this exciting third-person shooter, play as brave Joe, a typical Redneck who must fight against hordes of zombies and scary monsters.

Possessed est un tireur de première personne à survie axé sur l'histoire répartis dans 3 régions pleines d'action. Il comporte des personnages spirituels, des créatures terrifiantes et une forte concentration sur la physique et l'interaction mondiale.

Mindcop est un jeu policier non linéaire de type polar mêlant aventure scénarisée et jeu de match-3 en temps réel. Vous incarnez le célèbre Mindcop qui peut plonger dans l'esprit des suspects pour découvrir leurs secrets et démêler leurs mensonges.

Construisez et gérez le premier programme d'exploration extra-planétaire de l’humanité. Aménagez vos infrastructures souterraines, recrutez des spécialistes du monde entier et envoyez-les explorer les confins de l’univers à travers l’Exogate.

This is a Interactive Live-Action Game. You will travel back in time to become a noble Highness and experience the local customs and practices of ancient times. A series of your choices will influence the development trajectory of this world.

titre: Scientifically Accurate Dinosaur Mating Simulator 2022: American Revolution 1775 - 1786
description: Fake history. Real dinosaurs. From the creators of Ghost of Joe Papp 2 comes another narrative adventure about the creation of art. This time, that art is Dinosaurs in the American Revolution.

The Spiritual. The Supernatural. The Skeptical. All are touched upon in Nostradamus: The Last Prophecy. The player is immortalized as a profiler of sorts in this treasure hunt game - a brilliantly vivid historical rendition of the acclaimed quatrains of Nostradamus.
A young moustache enthusiast goes on an adventure, to climb the highest flying mountain in search of a magical moustache gel!

Dash and roll your way through 60 fast-paced levels to try and find the way back home after a magic exam goes wrong, leaving a young mage stranded in a strange dimension. Marble Mage offers classic marble-rolling platforming with a unique twist: Charge up and release to blast off in any direction!

This is a turn based stealth game set in a cyber city. Help the hacker infiltrate the system by sliding the 5x5 tile system. Avoid detection, collect powerful implant upgrades and weapons. Brace yourself for endlessly thrilling playthroughs, as each session unveils procedurally generated labyrinth.

Transformez vos adversaires en alliés à l'aide de la magie interdite de l'Épée du Nécromancien et aidez Tama à atteindre le cœur du donjon pour acquérir le pouvoir de ramener Koko d'entre les morts.Constituez-vous une armée de monstres et équipez-vous d'armes et de reliques pour vaincre les gardiens

Guide Pronty and its Javelin partner Bront as it defends the once great city of Royla. Explore the deep sea, fight mutant sea creatures, and discover the secrets behind this new Atlantis in this beautiful action-packed adventure.

Army of One is a first and third person shooter style game based on teams and solo confrontations, with melee combat and objective-oriented multiplayer gameplay. Prove to everyone that you are the best, that you are literally a one-man army, for rewards and abilities.

Évadez-vous dans un monde de jeu de puzzle fantastique avec des créatures et des armes extraordinaires ! Un gameplay addictif combiné à un jeu de rôle immersif dans la suite du très récompensé Puzzle Quest !
Manage your own bunny park! Give snacks and toys to your bunnies. Improve and decorate your park to increase its popularity and collect all the bunnies!

Necroking est un jeu de deckbuilding profond comme un roguelite tactique au tour par tour. Vous incarnez le Maître Nécromancien. Construisez votre deck de crânes, relevez squelettes et autres monstres pour vaincre les colonies souillées par la vie.

You wake up and find yourself trapped in a dream. Only thing in your mind is to wake up. The key to wake up lies within 3 Dream Stones which are awaiting at the end of puzzles you encounter through the game in different dream chapters.
Over or Under? A simple game of gambling with your life.

South of the Circle est une expérience narrative forte sur la relation entre Peter et Clara, des universitaires de Cambridge impliqués dans le conflit politique. L'histoire se concentre sur les promesses faites entre carrière et grand amour, où nos choix en lien avec le passé sont illusoires.
GalaxIverse is a top down fast paced vertical blastathon, Battle Fleets and formations of aliens with the occasional boss thrown in for good luck.
You are a chef in VR who need to satisfy your customers in a limited amount of time. Share the experience with a friend in local multiplayer mode. Chaotic levels are waiting for you!

NASCAR 21: Ignition redéfinit les standards du jeu vidéo officiel tiré de la discipline de stockcar la plus populaire au monde. Grâce à ses graphismes inégalés et son gameplay immersif, NASCAR 21: Ignition apporte un degré inédit d'authenticité et de fidélité à l'atmosphère de la NASCAR Cup Series.

A giant cathedral of flesh has appeared in the middle of the ocean on a dying world. A small group of scientists are secretly investigating it when a mysterious woman appears, facing an impossible task.

Without doubt flying virtual aircraft from your PC is one of the most interesting simulations – at the same time, it is one with a very steep learning curve. Holiday Flight Simulator, though, makes it especially easy to relive the last holiday trip from the cockpit’s view.
Bondissez et frappez, dressez votre armée, apprenez de puissants combos et récupérez vos terres !
Multiplayer Shooter FPS is an advanced multiplayer first-person shooter game.

As the manager of Dusk Pub, you have to put in a lot of efforts to run your own worn-down bar and expand your business to other parts of the land Brendt. Meet a variety of cute girls and recruit them as servers, helping them develop their business talent and know them inside out.
目前只有第一人称射击模式，穿越时空，在虚幻宇宙，与不可描述的力量作斗争，各种类型的怪物，消灭纳粹丧尸，清理被核废水感染的怪物，抗击小丑资本家，在各种异空间中不停的战斗，你有无限子弹无后座力的双持AK，高级的人工智能，怀中抱妹，各种状态

Song of The Prairie est un jeu de ferme relaxant en 3D. Un héros qui a vaincu le démon commence une nouvelle vie rurale. Expérimentez le plaisir de l'exploration de la petite ville, Récoltez d'énormes fruits, occupez-vous d'animaux magiques et rendez-vous avec vos personnages préférés.

This is a side-scrolling shooting game in which you take control of the "Drainus", the Kharlal Empire's most cutting-edge fighter with the ability to absorb energy bullets, and take down the enemy ships zipping through space.

Ripout est un jeu de tir à la première personne horrifique et coopératif où les joueurs parcourent des épaves de vaisseaux générées de façon procédurale et remplies de mutants capables de reconfigurer leur corps.
Alien robots are attacking.
Mahjong Deluxe 3 est le dernier jeu issu de la franchise Mahjong, une série de Casual Games populaire produite par le développeur primé EnsenaSoft.
Le choix est simple : l'Univers ou rien!
Guide Let Poco-chan à l'objectif! Ce jeu est un jeu de labyrinthe simple. Retirez les objets avec un revolver.

Graviteam Tactics: Mius-Front - tactical battalion level combat simulation. Action takes place in the summer of 1943 at Mius river and Saur-Mogila tumulus area of over 140 sq. km. Four large-scale operations for the Red Army and Wehrmacht.

Steel & Steam takes the best elements from the fantasy JRPG’s of old, such as great stories, awesome characters, and classic monsters, and combines them with a touch of steampunk. It’s like taking Lord of the Rings and mixing in the Wild West.
A physics sandbox game for people who like to play with digital toys. Create, control toys and define your goals.

-This game is based on russian movie "Green elephant" or "Zeleniy slonik". This is a platformer/shooter game with quest elements and a lot of humor and fun moments. -The goal of the game is to find a key on diffent levels and run away from dangerous enemies and defeat powerfull bosses at the end of each level!
Vous vous retrouvez à l'intérieur de votre rêve, qui se transforme en un cauchemar continu.

Puppet House est un jeu d'aventure et d'horreur avec des éléments de puzzle et d'escape room. Un rituel crée une marionnette tueuse, qui assassine tous ceux qui entrent dans le manoir du ventriloque. Rick, à la recherche des habitants disparus, est bientôt confronté à sa plus grande horreur.

Take control of the hoverboarding robots, explore the desolate world, defy gravity, dive into the oceans and ride with the sandworms on the dunes! Stylish graphics and groovy soundtrack will take you to an epic adventure in this action/racing game.

A visual novel in the setting of Slavic folklore in which you will walk through the forest at night when the line between the world of the living and the dead is thinner than ever. Look carefully at your feet and, perhaps, you will see the dawn.

Make a customized estate plan with these essential legal documents: • Will • Health Care Directive • Durable Power of Attorney • Executor Documents • Final Arrangements • and more for you and each of your family members!

A horror-themed stock market simulator where the player must make enough money to pay their debt in time. Buy, sell and short shares in fictional companies, earn dividends, pay taxes and follow the in-game news for possible hints on what to invest in. No previous experience in stock market required.

Headbangers est un jeu de Battle Royale rythmique qui fait la part belle au fun ! Vous et 29 autres pigeons bataillerez ferme pour accomplir votre quête : remporter le sacro-saint titre tant convoité de « Maître de Headbanger » !
Pilot the last vessel of a fallen civilization into the vast expanse of space. Collect resources and search for a new world to call home in this minimalist space exploration and survival game.

titre: Vestaria Saga I: War of the Scions
description: A prince in flight, charged with defending the last of the royal family, determined to secure a future for his kingdom, unaware he would be fighting for stakes greater still.

Experience fast-paced over-the-top multiplayer action in The Showdown Effect: Reloaded. Join players from around the world to engage in high-octane battles filled with bullets, explosions, and one-liners!

Journey through the Nine Circles of Hell in this atmospheric puzzle game, which closely follows the epic poem "Inferno" by Dante Alighieri. Each circle has its unique mood and mechanics, and interspersed between the over 100 puzzles are plenty of artwork and quotes from the original poem.

Enhanced and updated for modern systems, this is the definitive edition of Rayne’s second adventure: a blood-soaked rampage of vengeance against the Cult of Kagan, a group led by Rayne's half-siblings that seek to carry out their father Kagan's legacy by creating a new era of vampire supremacy.

Another Farm Roguelike is a 2D farming & crafting game with rougelike elements where your job is to earn as much money as possible to pay the rent. Start from scratch and build the most profitable farm you can make as soon as possible. Work hard to be able to afford the rent.

titre: Art of Murder - Cards of Destiny
description: Un tueur en série redoutable fait régner la terreur a travers toute l‘Amérique. Il massacre ses victimes et laisse sur la scene du crime, une carte a jouer en guise de signature. Plus inquiétant encore! il semble bien connaître Nicole Bonnet, jeune agent du FBI et n‘hésite pas a la poursuivre.
PhysDrive is a great physic simulated racing game with a giant map! Go through a big loops, falling blocks, destructible walls, fans, rails, stairs, spikes, traps and more!

titre: Oceanhorn 2: Knights of the Lost Realm
description: La suite du jeu d'aventure et d'action acclamé par la critique. Faites l'expérience d'une nouvelle vue magnifique en 3D et à la troisième personne et embarquez pour un voyage épique qui dévoilera les mystères de ce qui s'est passé 1000 ans plus tôt.

L'abominable homme des neiges, le monstre du Loch Ness... des créatures que les cryptozoologues s'emploient à traquer et à étudier. Une de ces bêtes apparaît aussi dans les légendes du peuple Ashanti du Ghana.
When Yokoshima finds out his office crush, Hazuki Ichinose, is transferring overseas, he realizes that he needs to act and finally ask her out.

Desktop Girlfriend est un jeu de petite amie interactif de bureau qui permet aux utilisateurs d'interagir avec leur petite amie virtuelle de diverses manières, comme des mini-jeux interactifs, la personnalisation de sa coiffure, de la couleur de ses cheveux, de ses yeux, des scénarios à fins multipl

After being sent into space, Laika find herself exploring some asteroids, meeting weird characters and solving puzzles to figure out what the hell is happening to her. She will lose herself in time, space and even in herself, if that makes some sense for you. The big question is: is she dead?

When Cooper was on a mission in the cloud cosmic terminal, the double line army sent another agent, Captain Blanc. He and the protagonist Cooper were sworn enemies, but for the safety of all mankind, he had no choice
Point & click aboard a private luxury yacht on a dark and stormy night with funny evil witches and sandwiches Features rain effects, exploration of an entire ship, puzzles, and monsters

Pulvérisez les rochers avec votre foreuse-mitrailleuse ! Amassez pierres précieuses, minerais et artefacts, améliorez votre vaisseau et débloquez de nouvelles capacités. Découvrez les mystères des profondeurs et survivez aux dangers qui vous guettent !

The Ouroboros King combine la profondeur stratégique des échecs avec la variété de construction et la rejouabilité des jeux roguelike. Assemblez une formidable armée, découvrez de puissantes reliques et achetez des gadgets surprenants pour vaincre le Sabbat.

Pêchez autour du monde avec flotteur, fond, spinning ou casting, et capturez plus de 60 poissons réalistes ! Jouez en solo ou en ligne, explorez des lieux superbes, utilisez la caméra sous-marine et remplissez votre salle des trophées !

Experience the Viking way of life. Sail, explore, trade, build a fleet, and lead your fearless army to raid and conquest. Write your own story of the golden Viking age. You have many choices, and a leader can always find his own.

This is a story about her and him. This is also a story about meeting and parting. Perhaps it is a very simple story. It may be a very complicated story. A simple FAREWELL ...... And not a grand farewell. If you can feel the joy and sorrow we pour in, it is a great encouragement to us.
"Battle Fantasia", the fantasy RPG themed 2D Fighting game is now appearing on Steam, and "REVISED" with the latest balances and improved visual effects! Comes with FREE Soundtrack DLC!

What Comes After est une aventure en side-scrolling et une courte histoire réconfortante qui parle d'apprendre à comment s'aimer soi-même. Aidez Vivi durant son voyage vers la lumière à la fin du tunnel et son retour.

The Territory of Egg is a unique twist on tower defense game. You need to build defense lines with egg warriors to protect the Holy Egg, the core of all eggs. Remember to upgrade your Tech Tree with the resources you've collected and unlock more skills to fight against the evil monsters.
A free to play FPS game brought to you by Ryan Laley Games. Shoot your weapons and throw your grenades to take down your opposition. Welcome to Fireteam soldier!

Shades of Sakura is a casual physics-based puzzle game. Challenge yourself to get 10 animated scenes with Live2D. Go on a fascinating journey through ancient Japan and our Samurai girls. Connect the balls by drawing lines to win!

The Pioneers offre une expérience de survie spatiale profonde et innovante. Construisez votre station spatiale, gérez votre équipage et explorez l’environnement hostile de Io, la lune la plus intime de Jupiter. Êtes-vous assez brave pour survivre ?
Explore a new, larger world, full of secrets and hidden locations in this direct sequel to Shining Plume featuring 3 different endings!

Last Command is a fast-paced Snake x Bullet Hell action game. Maneuver through enemies’ barrage of attacks, collect Data Points to deal damage! Mix and match skill chips as you progress, overcome intense Boss battles, and uncover the secrets of their program world...
經典武俠經營策略遊戲《天下霸圖》，結合門派經營、弟子養成及戰略元素，玩家可扮演武當、峨嵋、丐幫、魔教…等12種各具特色及獨門武學的掌門人，招收弟子因材施教、採集資源煉丹練功、擴大地盤設立分舵，不論是消滅其它門派一統江湖，或以聲望讓各派歸順，都能享受成為一代武林霸主的快感！
Рыбалка никогда не была скучным занятием и она никогда не была на столько весёлой и иммерсивной! Присоединяйся к рядам настоящих скуфов, лови рыбу и веселись

titre: FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves
description: FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves, est sur le point de faire son arrivée 26 ans après le dernier épisode ! Offre un style artistique unique qui exhale les sens et un système REV innovant pour des moments de jeu intenses. Ici, enfin, une nouvelle légende est sur le point de voir le jour...

Junkbots, lasers, balls and rage! A 2.5D multiplayer game where two teams of junkbots clash in a battle of cannon shots to bring the ball to the goal. Frantic gameplay with 5 minutes matches, 2vs2 or 1vs1, online and local. Moreover: train with bots and play stupid minigames!
Stop the New World Order in this challenging game!

LONESTAR est un jeu de stratégie, de construction de deck et de vaisseau spatial roguelike. Votre mission : capturer les criminels aux quatre coins de l'univers. Remportez des combats Shockwave pour partir en vacances. À bord de votre vaisseau, bâtissez votre légende !

Have you always dreamed of searching for gold? Then start your own adventure now - alone or together with friends. Explore a huge map and dig for gold using a variety of methods, vehicles and wash plants.
Steampunk Syndicate est un tower defense avec des éléments de jeux de cartes.
Alone at night, working at a petrol station deep in the American wheat belt. Something feels off... are you sure you're alone? A short 10-15 minute horror game with multiple endings.
NITE Team 4 is a military hacking simulation game that explores the world of cyberwarfare and features realistic mission scenarios.

Contrôlez une variété de robots et détruisez les envahisseurs de l'espace afin de sauver la Terre détruite ! "GAIA Survivors" est un jeu de science-fiction rogue-lite casual de type 'Shoot 'Em Up' avec une vision rétro-futuriste du monde.

The Veiled Ones is a horror stealth game about a Muslim exorcist trying to save his son from a jinn possession. In this game players will reveal the story behind their son's possession, while avoiding the jinn that haunts them.
Le gouvernement confie la résolution des enquêtes criminelles aux citoyens sur internet. French Crime est un jeu réaliste et immersif d'enquêtes criminelles.

Récupérez et affrontez plus de 200 créatures uniques dans cet auto-battler roguelike. Faites progresser et évoluer vos Kādomon pour créer l'équipe ultime, en développant des synergies incroyables afin de triompher des boss REDOUTABLES !
Battle hordes of monsters in Goblin Defenders: Steel 'n' Wood!

Sunset Mall is a Bitesize Vaporwave + Mallsoft walking sim / adventure game set inside a 90's Shopping Mall. Explore a randomly generated mall in search of iconic 80's - 90's Music, Movies, Toys, Consoles and Games all while you enjoy the aesthetic style and music.

L'ultime aventure de combats furtifs où tout le monde est invisible ! Risque et récompenses guident votre parcours au travers de campagnes solo intégrales et d'une expérience multijoueur locale/en ligne. Soyez attentif car selon les environnements, traces de pas et autres surprises pourront vous démasquer.

The Swordsmen X is an adrenaline-fueled free-roaming competitive action game that pits 100 players against each other in a battle royale. Players can wield a diverse arsenal of martial weapons, including bows, daggers, and other ranged attacks, in their fight for survival.
studio: 上海杜昂网络科技有限公司

description: Marble combat is a physics based multiplayer game for 2 - 8 people. Players compete as magical marbles racing and fighting to dominate capture points and collect power ups.
Tu es seul. Personne ne te sauvera et le pire, c’était ton choix...
Un nouveau SAMURAI WARRIORS commence. Après une attente de 7 ans, un nouvel épisode de la série d'action tactique "SAMURAI WARRIORS" est enfin là !

titre: The Lord of the Rings: Adventure Card Game - Definitive Edition
description: Construisez un deck de héros iconiques et défiez les forces de Sauron dans ce jeu tactique palpitant. Explorez des lieux célèbres, accomplissez des quêtes narratives et forgez votre propre légende en Terre du Milieu. Mais prenez garde à l'Œil de Sauron.

Contagion VR: Outbreak will immerse you into the middle of a zombie apocalypse. Relive stories of the survivors in the Single Player campaign, take your time in Free Roam, or check out the Firing Range!

Participez ou attention ! Des profondeurs du cimetière surgissent ceux qui en veulent à votre cerveau ! Lorsque les zombies font leur apparition au bowling il est temps de les remettre à leur place ! Les zombies occupent vos pistes de bowling favorites, renvoyez les au cimetière ! Choisissez un personnage à votre goût et atomisez-les.
REVIVEZ L'AVENTURE ! GRANDIA HD Remaster vous offre des graphismes améliorés tout en conservant les célèbres musiques d'origine et l'incroyable système de combat.

Building the game as Open World so you are able to go on in your speed - just to tell, only the ones who want to explore will find out the ultimate ending. Traveler contains 9 different themed worlds you are able to explore by your own.

Thirdperson shooter and survival game, where player is gangsta criminal. Mission to rob and collect hidden money bags. Also avoid or kill different enemies like zombies, mutants and cyborg soldiers. Also use armored vehicle
Godus Wars mixes tactical Real Time Strategy gameplay with the mechanics of the God-Game genre.It’s fun, it’s simple and it’s brutal.
Hero who wants to be a commando has to pass difficult tracks. Finish the track fast and enter the Leaderboard.

Exit Limbo : Opening is the first chapter of a neo-retro side-scrolling beat ’em up with adventure elements, elaborated fighting mechanics, memorable enemies and a truly unique setting and visual art style

Un jeu de deck-building roguelike avec un système de combat semi-réel unique. Enfilez les chaussures d'un ancien gladiateur et faites de votre mieux pour survivre dans le Colisée. Combinez différentes compétences et équipements et battez tous les ennemis pour devenir le prochain champion !

The Last Worker est une aventure narrative immersive qui raconte la défiance d'un travailleur solitaire face à un monde de plus en plus automatisé. Kurt travaille pour l'un des plus grands détaillants au monde et va devoir choisir entre capitalisme ou activisme.

Groovy est une boule robotique qui existe dans le monde abstrait et fou de mécanismes. Le monde du jeu est divisé en deux modes - Arcade et Survivre, chacun a son environnement unique, ses défis et ses ennemis.

Aidez le Prince des Ténèbres à réveiller sa douce Mina avec l'aide du docteur Van Helsing et du bossu Igor. Traversez de multiples épreuves de Varsovie à Venise, en passant par Paris. Parcourez le monde afin d'éliminer vos éternels ennemis et trouvez le remède pour redonner vie à votre femme.

Monde post-apocalyptique rempli de zombies, d'envahisseurs, de criminels et de fous, essayez de survivre et de sauver ceux qui en ont besoin, créez une communauté ou rejoignez une communauté déjà prête, ne laissez pas non plus le virus et les maladies Arretez-vous.

Nimbus est une combinaison unique de course et de puzzle. Le joueur doit utiliser son environnement pour atteindre un but. Parcourez le monde pour retrouver votre amour perdu. Nimbus offre plusieurs heures de détente et de challenges.

Dans ce jeu d'énigme aquatique vous contrôlez Max Flounder et Tina Guppy, des poissons qui sont également agents secrets.Un cas apparemment anodin se transforme en véritable lutte avec un mystérieux ennemi et les ficelles sont tirées par des gens haut placés.

Les pigeons complotent pour détruire votre toit - il est temps de se défendre dans Don't Shit On My #!$@& Roof ! Affrontez des boss, collectez de puissants artefacts et soyez plus malin que la horde de pigeons dans cet hilarant jeu de pixel art roguelite en 2D.
100 pilots battle with lasers, plasma, and missiles in Allspace.

Block Legend DX is a retro puzzle JRPG. Travel through different regions as a wide cast of characters, fighting monsters, visiting towns, and completing quests. The DX version introduces improved and additional features and soundtracks!
A very basic cyberpunk action game.

Construisez votre spa de capybara dans ce jeu de simulation pointer et cliquer relaxant! Cultivez des fruits, fabriquez des savons et des serviettes pour chouchouter les capybaras. Meublez la montagne avec des jardins, des bains et des décorations pour créer le meilleur spa de capybara!

Free trapped water bears by rerouting, remixing, and redirecting water flows in a sunny 3D island environment. This charming VR game will have the entire family giggling as they solve puzzles and frolic with these loveable creatures.

Fendez les airs à bord d'un oiseau de guerre majestueux, explorez un monde océanique spectaculaire et engagez-vous dans des duels aériens épiques, dans ce jeu de combats aériens nominé aux BAFTA du développeur en solo, Tomas Sala.

Slave Zero X est un jeu d'action stylisé en 2,5D qui se déroule dans l'univers biopunk de Slave Zero (1999). Courez et tailladez votre chemin dans un futur dystopique dans ce jeu d'action qui plaira aux fans de Devil May Cry, Strider et Guilty Gear.

Unpredictable horrors lurk around every corner, forcing you to find the missing people while desperately clinging to survival. In this experience even your own mind can become your enemy. Stay vigilant and keep your voice hushed, or risk becoming another victim of the forest's darkness
Embarquez avec Heileen dans un voyage inoubliable vers le Nouveau Monde ! Rencontrez de vieux amis et faites-en de nouveaux. Trouvez l'amour, évitez les dangers et vivez votre vie au maximum !

Part 1 of arcade epic 198X. A coming-of-age story told through multiple games and genres. Experience the thrill of shooting, driving, jumping, fighting and role-playing in 5 full-blown arcade stages – combined with cinematic pixel-art storytelling.

rooMaze is a first person hardcore roguelike with voxel graphics and procedurally generated levels! All of this is powered by Unreal Engine 4. Don't let acute-angled cubes deceive you as behind a simple visual style lies the all-consuming hardcore.
Create a snail and join the battle. Take control of the backyard with Battle Snails! Climb walls, hang upside down and move anywhere. Team up with your friends for a tank game unlike any other!

"GODSOUL" is a story-driven,Hyper-visually RPG. Team with "rebel" girls who love gaming and drawing（and more）, resist villains and enjoy a mix of cyber reality, fantastical worlds, and card game action.

titre: HEBEREKE!: March! Red Army Girls' Brigade
description: On September 1939,The biggest war in the history, WWII broke out.You are a commander of Soviet Union Independent Girl Brigades.Fight over 5 years battle against Nazi, and bring Victory to the mother country!Урааааааааааааа!!!
Do you think 1 + 1 = 0 is correct? So what do you think about "black + black = white" statement?

Blood Hunting est jeu d'horreur et de survie à la première personne développé par Holcomb Entertainment LLC. Une véritable expérience d'horreur qui explore à quel point la vengeance peut être dangereuse… si vous arrivez à en sortir vivant.
A tactical roguelike RPG inspired by our favorite tabletop games that lets you create any ability, item, villain, hero, and game imaginable.

HIGH SPEED ZOMBIE TACTICS - Fight mobs of undead attacking from all sides in this streamlined turn-based tactics that emphasizes unit placement and synergies. Help the survivors live through fights and manage their rations to avoid permanent death, and they just might be able to reach the Sanctuary.
Survive high risk gameplay as you are pursued by a terrifying monstrosity throughout a perilous open environment. You work to uncover secrets and escape the growing nightmare threatening your life!
Block Tower TD 2 is a strategic game in the roguelike style with original innovations. Build worlds from blocks, choose random upgrades, each game will be unique.

The kingdom is on a bad situation, as followers of the rebellion attack, steal, and hurt what Lorelai loves the most: the people of Uboro. The queen must find a solution, and for this she depends upon three friends: Victoria, Alkor and Celine.
TTV3 is the third volume of the retro hardcore maze wanderer minigame series Trip to Vinelands

A Prologue to Whateverland, an upcoming point-n-click adventure set in a bizarrely beautiful hand-drawn world, where everyone gets what they truly deserve. Experience the beginning of the journey of Vincent, an unfortunate thief, who can either find a way out or stay trapped there forever.

An isometric orgy of big smashy pixelart and big smashy chiptunes. Battle your way through corporate architecture and brain dead, buzzword-spewing, middle managers using office supplies as weapons...Fight back against the forces of tyranny and liberate your fellow coworkers from the oppressive evil that dominates them...

Le rogue-like tactique au tour par tour ultime ! Choisissez parmi plus de 350 sorts dévastateurs pour trouver le combo parfait et écrasez vos ennemis dans plus de 70 rencontres uniques. Assumez des choix difficiles, adaptez-vous et affrontez les horreurs qui ont réduit le monde en cendres.

titre: Dracula 3: The Path of the Dragon
description: There is obviously no such thing as vampires... at least according to the official line of the Catholic Church. The trilogy continues as the Prince of Darkness rises again.

Février 17 2023 📅 Une belle inconnue apparait au pas de votre porte. Allez-vous la laisser entrer ? Plongez dans un cauchemar et décidez du destin des gens qui vous entourent dans ce thriller interactif gratuit et mystique.

BALL PIT KING 3D est un jeu de puzzle amusant et addictif dans lequel vous faites tomber, empilez et fusionnez des boules 3D excentriques avec des visages hilarants pour créer l'ultime roi des boules! Jouez et voyez si vous pouvez régner en maître sur le Ball Pit!
Don’t Blink. They’re Always Watching. Enter the haunting corridors of the Fukushima asylum, a short but intense bodycam-style horror game that will leave you breathless.

Rituals is a 3D puzzle-exploration-adventure about the relation between civilisation and nature. It aims to be a gripping, memorable and meaningful experience with story told through gameplay and interaction.
An online 4 player Battle Royale FPS, where each player has an AI teammate.

Vous vous régalerez avec des donjons générés de façon procédurale, une myriade de monstres, un système de greffage et d'artisanat, ainsi qu'une grande sélection d'arbres de talents et d'objets qui vous garantiront une rejouabilité infinie.
Devenez un puissant Magicien et prenez votre destin en main ! Plongez dans un monde magique et détruisez vos ennemis en jetant des sorts de vos propres mains !

Agriculture Simulator 2013 propose de formidables possibilités à tous les fans d’agriculture sur PC : gestion de ferme, cultures et élevage du bétail font partie des principales activités du jeu.Plus de 100 tracteurs et machines agricoles de fabricants renommés sont à la disposition de l’agriculteur.
《随缘修仙》是一款以闭关修仙为题材，以随机词条叠BUFF为主要玩法的单机生存游戏。
A free game inspired by Umberto Eco's novel and Jean-Jaques Annaud's film "The Name of the Rose", and based on the game "La abadía del crimen" by Paco Menéndez and Juan Delcán.

titre: STAR OCEAN™ - THE LAST HOPE -™ 4K & Full HD Remaster
description: Explorez la galaxie, forgez des alliances et provoquez des conflits avec les extraterrestres que vous rencontrez et découvrez un danger qui menace toute la création.

I created Caves of Lore because of my deep love for RPGs. This project took me 6 years to make and I learned a lot about coding, art, and storytelling. If you reach the end then be sure to let me know! Caves has deep combat, classic-styled pixel art, and (of course) LORE! 📖

Enough with games where death is a nuisance that must be avoided at all costs: in Kill Yourself, death is your goal! But beware, it won't be easy: you'll need to work hard to find all the different ways to end the guy's miserable life.
An alien force is threatening to destroy the stability of the galaxy! Play as an unknown creature or a Spacefleet Officer in this Online Sci-Fi Horror!
MyIsland is a relaxed and beautiful survival game,You will drift and survive on the tropical islands, hunt and travel, build houses and development farming, and create your own warm homeland.
A short and minimalist roguelike where every hit is lethal but time slows down whenever you are in danger. Reach the top floor or die trying!

Get ready for a mindbending cyberpunk experience! Figure out more than a dozen puzzles through your manipulation of time based clones and try to get the best time in each level! Dive into Déjà Vu, inspired by puzzlers like Braid and The Swapper.
Unleash your imagination into a vast, savage world, sun-scorched and wind-scraped. This series contains the radiant classics, Dark Sun: Shattered Lands, and Dark Sun: Wake of the Ravager.

Impaler Gold est un jeu de tir en arène minimaliste et rapide - maintenant étendu et amélioré. Invoquez des piques pour massacrer des monstres, construire des barrières, et vous propulser dans les airs. Relevez le défi dans ce jeu de tir rogue-lite hautement rejouable inspiré par les classiques.

Pendelum is a physics-based puzzle platformer with a pendulum that requires patience, skill and creativity.Use only gravity and external influences to reach the goal, create your own puzzles, compare your performance with others and above all - DON'T RAGE!
Plongez dans le monde merveilleux de Bridge It, et créez des ponts à toute épreuve au-dessus de précipices vertigineux !
The recent events in a state prison, involving Jake from Team Hot Guns was a perfect moment for some prisoners to escape - you are one of them.
The adventure of a young, scared, but smart girl.
Humans VS Aliens FPS shooter combined with RTS.
"The Experiment" est un jeu de puzzle multijoueur pour réalité virtuelle ou PC de bureau ! Il peut être joué en compétition, en coopération ou en solo.

La construction de deck est le pilier de cette arène infernale ! Chaque personnage est unique : Prenez un deck de cartes à débloquer pour vous renforcer à chaque bataille ­ "Mon tourbillon balance du feu !". Affrontez des hordes d'ennemis pour devenir une superstar du jeu présenté par JAR-BIS.

HunterNightmare "is a horror survival game suitable for 1-2 players. You have been entrusted to come to this village and need to search for items scattered in the area. Burning three cursed items among numerous items will result in the death of monsters in this area and victory.

As a time travelling Spartan Soldier, you must stop the Cult of the Fallen Gods that are turning people into burger meat. Grab your sword and assault cannon and deal death to these disfigured freaks in the name of humanity.

Step into the virtual world of Graffiti Bombing and become a graffiti writer. Whether you’re a new artist, seasoned veteran, or all-city hero, experience the thrill of graffiti in the (relatively) crime-free safety of Virtual Reality (VR).

Rassemblez des cristaux, réparez/gérez des installations de fabrication, améliorez votre vaisseau spatial, construisez des machines, explorez le monde ouvert, retrouvez votre chemin vers la Terre mère.

Embark on a journey no one has taken before! Your quest begins at the foot of The Great Pyramid of Giza and continues through the Egyptian sands to the mysterious Hanging Gardens of Babylon. Travel through the enchanting Mediterranean islands to the glory of ancient Greece as your voyage continues.

Chainsaw Warrior from Games Workshop is the classic game for one strong-nerved player! It's 2032 and spatial warping has opened a hole into another dimension in the midst of the old municipal buildings at the heart of Manhattan. Bizarre and dangerous creatures are flooding into our dimension.
World's hardest game. Impossible Runner. Try to complete all 10 'Impossible' levels.

titre: Star Trek: Starfleet Command Gold Edition
description: Dozens of missions & more than 50 ship designs put you in the captain’s chair for an amazing real-time space combat experience commanding ships from the United Federation of Planets, the Klingon Empire, the Romulan Star Empire, the Hydran Kingdom, the Gorn Confederation or the Lyran Star Empire!

DUBIUM est un jeu social de survie et de déduction se déroulant dans un environnement de science-fiction à la sauce futuriste. Cinq Frontiers doivent collaborer pour accomplir diverses missions et s’échapper avant qu’il ne soit trop tard. Mais attention : l’un des Frontiers est un Traitor
Tentez de survivre dans ce jeu d'horreur semi ouvert inspiré des graphismes de la PS1.

Draw Rider - a classic racing game, made in 2D. Your goal is to get to the finish line within a certain time. In the game you will find a huge variety of levels, the passage of which will open various options for character customization.
Shiro is an adventure platformer in which you have to find your missing sister

titre: Call of Cthulhu: The Wasted Land
description: Call of Cthulhu: The Wasted Land is a turn-based strategy/role-playing game based on the award winning Call of Cthulhu RPG. Set in the midst of World War One, the game pits your team of investigators and soldiers against an ancient enemy, one older than humanity itself...
In the novel and anime worlds, players could collect apostles and fight against the forces of chaos. Build the legendary team and conquer all the multiverses!
FRONT MISSION 1st: Remake est un RPG immersif aux combats tactiques au tour par tour, qui vous met aux commandes d'impressionnantes machines militaires nommées wanzers.
Islands of the Caliph is an old-school inspired action RPG based on Middle Eastern folklore and Islamic spiritual tradition. A KEYBOARD ONLY 1980s style Dungeon Crawler with an open world.
Relaxing, minimalistic 2d-puzzle game.

Redshirt is the comedy sci-fi sim about social networking aboard a space station, starring the station's most ambitious low-ranking peon: you! Navigate the professional and interpersonal politics of the ubiquitous "Spacebook" to curry favor among friends and colleagues.

Constellation Tango is an interstellar 3D turn-based strategy-tactics game. Organize and lead troops to victory in battles across planets. Push back against an oppressive empire to save the galaxy, while making new allies of various species.

Brand new truck simulation game, experience fun from a variety of truck driving. Drive around the original Chinese map, complete hundreds of specialty tasks through different cities. Meet in the mountains, rivers, lakes and seas. Let’s share your truck life.
You’re a Lawyer who tries to save students from a crazy headmaster. You need to survive a variety of school lessons and fight the different teachers

Wick is a survival horror game where ghost stories are brought to life. Explore a local legend about the long lost children in the woods who can still be seen... but only by those who dare to enter alone by candlelight.

Qvadriga is a tactical game of chariot racing in ancient Roman circuses, where you take control of a four horse chariot team. Choose your preferred upgrade combinations and prove your skills at the arena.
Survive in a world full of darkness. Gain resources. Kill entities. Repeat. But beware, there might be entities lurking around...

Broken Roads est un RPG en groupe post-apocalyptique à l’histoire riche, situé dans l’Outback australien et basé sur un système de morale unique en son genre. Survivez, nouez des liens et faites des choix difficiles qui façonneront votre périple fascinant à travers les contrées sauvages.
Pilot massive weapons of destruction and fight over post-apocalyptic lands in this free-roaming shooter: It is an explosive clash of god-like mech weaponry and team deathmatch gameplay.
The original battle royal game is back and buffed!! No rules, and fights to the finish where anything goes! Over 180 characters and over 250 different special moves!

In the shadow of the Cold War, Fenton Paddock is facing the hardest fight of his life. While the tensions between the superpowers threaten to tear the world apart, the British soldier has to save his family that has been caught by powerful enemies.
Archivist's Curse brings you into an otherworldly harbor of knowledge: The Great Library, although unfortunately, you ended up in the dangerous section of the complex called Hall of Pawnsmoor.

Bienvenue dans le laboratoire de ChromaTec! Tu es ici pour tester la toute dernière technologie révolutionnaire de l'industrie militaire de la couleur : le ChromaGun (licence en cours) ! Depuis la maternelle, tu n'as pas oublier comment on mélange les couleurs ? Félicitation, tu es le candidat idéal !

TinyKeep, a top-down procedurally generated dungeon escape game with permadeath - you die and it's game over. Master the frantic physics-based combat, lure enemies into traps or make them fight each other for dominance. There are many ways to survive in TinyKeep!

Phat Stacks 2 is puzzle platformer, it features completely new gameplay with a new set of characters, the goal of Phat Stacks 2 is to collect and process crystals by knocking them into the right chutes for a payout. Each level gets harder and presents a new challenge as you progress

A tactical, turn-based strategy game in a post-apocalyptic world of eternal winter. As the titular False Prophet, recruit and lead a group of survivors to a promised land. Loot, craft, and make the best of what you find.

Infiltrate, rule and rescue the mind of the father of Psychoanalysis: Sigmund Freud, in this surreal and obscure adventure. Take control of his inner voice, choose his destiny, solve clinical cases, save or condemn your patients, all whilst trying to save Freud from himself.

titre: Into the Dark: Ultimate Trash Edition
description: Expect the ultimate B-Movie Trash experience! Don´t even dare to hope for state-of the art graphics, a proper balancing, professional voice acting or breathtaking script-writing. This here is 100% pure trash, an adventure / shooter hybrid with gazillions of bad jokes, dozens of pop culture references and a hidden, dense net of...

Gladio Mori est un jeu de combat de gladiateurs basé sur la physique, sans barre de vie. Blessez les artères, percez les organes vitaux et amputez des membres. Créez vos combos, peignez votre combattant et affrontez vos amis en ligne avec le cross-play.
You are Ethan! a former felony convicted who needs to deliver the cargo in time for christmas eve. Drive through the city with no morale but beware, The cops are hunting you! Good Luck!

Deadnaut is Screwfly Studios' second game and follow up to cult hit, Zafehouse: Diaries. Deadnauts, so named because they’re unlikely to return, must explore, investigate and fight their way through the derelict ships of dead civilisations. Every mission is unique and no two locations are the same.
Lithium City is a stylized isometric action game set in a neon-drenched world of electricity and violence.

Frederic Chopin – a long time deceased classical compositor – returns back from beyond the grave to fight intense musical duels. In his way stand some of the worlds greatest pop stars charmed with enormous profits that wild commercialization provides

A boy. A laptop. A dream. In this game, you search through a young teenager's laptop, trying to find out his story. Solve hidden puzzles and read between the lines that he wrote in your quest to unravel the mystery of Jay Zhang.

Unspottable est un jeu compétitif en local ou en-ligne de 2 à 8 joueurs. Dissimulez-vous parmis la foule, traquez les autres joueurs et usez des différentes règles spécifiques aux environnements pour gagner la partie. Marchez comme un robot, frappez comme un humain !

Will you become the greatest Head of State ?Play one of the powerful rulers of a nation! . Slip into the shoes of the President of the U.S., or the leader of China, Russia, United Kingdom, or other countries. Expand your influence on the world stage.

Maîtrisez votre environnement, formez une équipe et créez votre deck pour vaincre les hors-la-loi et les forces surnaturelles qui peuplent ce monde fantastique. Regardez le résultat de vos choix tactiques lors de séquences de combat au style unique.

🌾Libérez le fermier intérieur. 🚜 Plongez dans le charme rustique de la vie rurale dans « Farmer's Life », où vous découvrirez la joie et les défis de la vie dans une ferme dynamique. Plantez, cultivez et embrassez un pays vivant dans un vaste monde ouvert.
Defend the village from invading enemies in this third person story based game!

Welcomed by the fluttering of cherry blossom, the main character, Brian, starts a new high school life in Japan. Brian soon starts to get along with two girls in the same class after they start to talk to him. With their help, Brian gradually learns Japanese culture and customs.

Infiltrez, piratez, dérobez - Light combine des mécanismes de jeu originaux, des graphismes captivants et une histoire palpitante pour donner une nouvelle impulsion à un genre populaire. La technologie est votre alliée, et le combat votre dernier recours. Saurez-vous échapper à la capture et résoudre le mystère ?

Lex Mortis is an open-world horror game set on a fully explorable island. The game’s atmosphere is directly affected by the time of day. During the daytime you will study the island and it’s mysteries. But at night the enemies reveal themselves, and the worst nightmare becomes real!

Que la fête commence ! Jouez en solo ou avec vos amis, choisissez une piste, un instrument, et montez sur scène ! La fête est éternelle : importez vos morceaux et prouvez que vous ne serez pas la pire catastrophe auditive.

Arriverez-vous à tenir le rythme? Vivez une aventure au sein d'un Boombox en péril et jouez à l'expérience musicale ultime. Dans ce jeu de plateforme rythmique où toutes vos actions doivent suivre le rythme de la musique, ranimez les musiques électro, disco et dub !

Lorsque l'Esmeralda s'écrase sur Tyson III, un garçon nommé Robin est livré à lui-même. À la recherche de l'équipage perdu, Robin se retrouve nez à nez avec des dinosaures. Il découvre alors que Tyson III est loin d'être le paradis tant attend.

3089 is a futuristic, procedurally generated, open-world action role-playing game. All terrain, enemies, weapons, items, quests & more are uniquely generated. Will you obey your creator, the Overlord, or find your own path?
Chicken Strike®: Cluck Ops™, the action-packed adventure where feathers fly and the claws come out! Join the uprising to liberate FCK!

Un jour, le protagoniste commence à faire des rêves étranges, poursuivi par des poupées bizarres, et son grenier d'enfance semble immense. Il doit naviguer entre rêve et réalité pour comprendre ces rêves. Traite toujours Teddy avec respect ; il t'aime beaucoup et se souvient de tout ce que tu fais.

Grapple is a 3D puzzle platformer. You can fling, swing and climb across everything in Grapple. Different surfaces react uniquely to your gooball. Grapple is as fast paced as you want to play it. With multiple checkpoints and unlimited lives your skill is the only thing slowing you down.

Welcome to the world ruled over by the demons, where mankind edges on the brink of extinction. Men have paid the price in blood, leaving only the young and the elderly behind. It is up to the women to finally pick up their arms and fight for the sake of those who remains..!
Découvrez un pays étrange qui recèle un mystère. Explorez les secrets du passé afin de trouver les vestiges de votre futur. La tempête se lève.
Escape from Poalet (Prologue) is a point & click 3d graphic adventure game for one player. Help our protagonist to escape from Poalet while discovering all its secrets.

Road Not Taken is a roguelike puzzle game about surviving life’s surprises. You play as a ranger adventuring through a vast, unforgiving forest in the aftermath of a brutal winter storm, rescuing children who have lost their way.

Impulsion est un jeu de plateforme en vue à la première personne. Sa difficulté comme sa rapidité sauront jouer avec vos nerfs et vos réflexes ! Frayez vous un chemin à travers les 25 niveaux périlleux d'Impulsion en manipulant la physique à votre avantage !

Crossfire II is an Retro / Arcade / Top-Down Shooter, originally released in 2002 for the AMIGA. The main part of the game is a classic, fast paced, single player story campaign. Fly different space ships and fight, to save the universe as you know it. Also you get a survival and a local PvP mode.

Vrai gamer ? Prouve-le ! Relève le défi impossible – une erreur malheureuse et tu retournes tout en bas. Sois parmi les premiers à atteindre le sommet. Concentration totale en solo ou amusement chaotique avec des amis. Regretter ? Pas une chance.
A simple game with big ambitions. Fight creatures, explore the world and progress your character in this ever changing world.
