DwarfHeim est la nouvelle génération de jeux de stratégie coopératifs en temps réel. Un jeu de stratégie en temps réel unique avec des modes de jeu coopératifs en JcJ et JcE. Choisissez votre classe, récoltez des ressources, construisez votre ville de nains et défendez-la.

Pumped BMX + is a fast-paced arcade BMX game full of tricks, stunts and combos which originates from one of the most well-known BMX franchises in the world. Master over 500 challenges in this breathtaking sports game.

Trade. Gamble. Fight! Test your arcade chops in Null Vector, a twin-stick shooter rogue-lite. Discover and experiment with thousands of weapon combinations, take strategic advantage of machines to trade and gamble for new ship parts, and unleash your own bullet hell upon the Final Boss!
Do you regret a choice in your life This is a game about faith, life and soul...

Bienvenue dans Mars Base, votre pied-à-terre, mais sur Mars ! Participez à une expédition hors du commun en votre qualité de botaniste : créez des cultures fertiles, nourrissez les colons et levez le voile sur les secrets de la planète rouge ! Alors ? Parés à « l’amarsissage » ?

Lancez-vous sur la trace des Bad Guys, planifiez vos assassinats de façon brutale et ingénieuse, et éliminez-les un par un de la surface de la Terre. Gardez en tête que la mort de chaque criminel doit passer pour un accident. + NOUVEAU MODE MULTIJOUEUR
A horror game and walking simulator

SACRALITH: The Archer's Tale est un jeu de tir à l'arc en réalité virtuelle. Aidez vos compagnons IA en explorant différents lieux pour atteindre l'objectif principal du jeu : la pierre magique « Sacralith », qui vous permet de contrôler les dragons.

titre: 3x3 the immersive fiction chapter one : Math awakening
description: 3x3 is an interactive adventure game in 2d cartoon style mixed with narrative and movie sequences. The gameplay dynamic is close from an escape game. An episodic format of nine chapters is planned for the first part of the story call prologue connected with mini TV series from 3x3 whole universe

Dirigez un peloton de panzers allemands en pleine Seconde Guerre mondiale dans cette simulation intense au style anime. Constituez un équipage d'élite, déployez des chars légendaires et survivez à des affrontements où ruse et habileté détermineront l'issue du combat.
Did you ever think how would it be if you were a merchant in the middle ages? You didn't? Well, it would be a fun experience if you ask me. Be ready to be the richest merchant in the Quadia!
Détruisez les monstres pour sauver le monde dans le jeu arcade N°1 Stay Alight®!

titre: 女巫与六便士 the sibyl and sixpence
description: It's a 15-minute experimental visual novel about a love affair as weak as tea. Story consists of two chapters, formed by a mixture of four clues. It tells a love story about the sibyl and the prince.
Battle on the Front Lines with funny, crazy physics. Create your own battles between men and test out everything to the limits.

Nimble Quest! Lead a conga line of heroes to glory against hordes of enemies across an endless number of stages. How many enemies can you defeat? Steer your unstoppable (seriously, you can’t stop) party as they cut a path of destruction through levels filled with different enemies and power-ups.
DUSK '82 is a simple but addictive action-puzzler demake of the cult shooter DUSK, inspired by classics like Chip's Challenge and Sokoban.

epsilon wars is a turn based artillery game set in space. players must use the newtonian gravity of suns, planets, and blackholes to guide their torpedoes at enemy ships, space stations, and freighters. challenge yourself in single player and multiplayer (2-4 players).

Syndrome, un jeu d’horreur de science-fiction de survie qui vous mettra dans un véritable enfer à l’intérieur d’un vaisseau maudit. Découvrez ce qui est arrivé à votre équipage perdu. Courir. Se cacher. Se battre. Survivre.
Death's Hangover is a ball and bat game, featuring horror elements, mature comedy and themes.

Experience romantic Regency England in this sumptuous solitaire game. Play your cards right as you tour historic London, Brighton and Bath, and help Bella create a dazzling ballroom. Unlock gameplay features with your makeover project and improve Bella’s chances of finding true love!

La version portable du jeu extrêmement populaire, avec un nouveau moteur, une interface retravaillée et la prise en charge Steam Deck. Découvrez des énigmes qui bouleversent le monde, des personnages intrigants, des environnements surnaturels et une histoire captivante sur la réalité du jeu.
Chronos: Before the Ashes est un RPG d'ambiance où sont contées les chroniques d'un héros qui a voué sa vie à sauver sa patrie d'un terrible péril.

titre: Princess Isabella: The Rise of an Heir
description: Maîtrise la magie pour sauver ta maman et arrêter la sorcière !

Gumnaam Introduces you to a forgotten and mysterious village. You, a police officer, need to collect all the pieces of evidence to unravel the mystery of this forgotten village. Don't forget to escape as soon as you know the truth because she is always watching. Kids like to play a lot, don't they?

A local multiplayer tactical RPG board game, introducing 16 characters with unique passive and active skills, different game modes, a free for all or tag teams, save yourself or defeat your enemies, and build different strategies to claim your victory.
Faites rouler le rocher jusqu'au sommet.

Préparez-vous pour la guerre du futur.A l'instar des titres similaires Advance Wars et Battle Isle, le jeu propose de faire abstraction de la gestion du micro-management et revient vers les principes de base du pierre-papier-ciseaux.

Detached est un duel interstellaire haletant au cours duquel vous devez faire preuve de sens tactique et de talent pour survivre. Séparé de votre équipage, vous devez prendre des décisions intelligentes et vous mettre à l'abri dans cette exploration viscérale de l'espace lointain.

Gérez une équipe de gladiateurs itinérants dans ce roguelike fantastique au tour par tour. Trouvez les meilleures recrues, expérimentez avec des objets uniques et découvrez des tactiques astucieuses sur le champ de bataille. Le tournoi attend ceux qui désirent la GLOIRE MORTELLE !

Monster In The Dark is a single player first-person game, you will plunge into a world of fear and hopelessness when there is no way out and nowhere to run. The player must find a way out of the dense forest when chased by a monster. The player's task: to run and not stop, exploring this world.

Clodhoppers is an online and local single/multiplayer brawler designed around quick games and big laughs. All the artwork is created using clay models and stop motion animation to give a unique aesthetic.
Premier Manager [/] revient pour une autre saison, avec une présentation révisée et une interface améliorée qui rend le monde de la gestion du football encore plus accessible.

Experience a storyline never before seen in the Ragnarok series. Choose your own path as you unlock the story and truth in Ragnarok: The Lost Memories. A free to play adventure strategy game with a card battle system and character collection system!
Ciel's story in Magical Otoge, a cheesy romantic comedy visual novel series with an overly literal name.
Je m'appelle Luzia....et cette histoire, ce n’est pas mon histoire, mais celle de ma sœur. Vous êtes toujours partant pour que je vous la raconte?
Today my parents went to Mexico for a week, and I’m gonna have to spend seven days alone in our new house.

titre: Touhou Genso Wanderer -Reloaded- / 不可思议的幻想乡TOD -RELOADED- / 不思議の幻想郷TOD -RELOADED-
description: Based on the "Touhou Project" world, Touhou Genso Wanderer -Reloaded- is an addictive roguelike RPG that's easy for beginners to pickup and play, but with tons of advanced options for pros! Explore dungeons with your Touhou favorites characters, collect loot, and battle over the Golden Spheres!

GetMeBro is a real-time head-to-head battle game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Enter the battlefield and knock down your opponents in an unforgiving race for your life. Create the best strategy and ensure your victory by choosing from a variety of abilities.

Aggression is a military real-time strategy game set within a historic context featuring role-playing elements. Play the role of a political leader of Russia, Great Britain, France or Germany. It is up to you to take firm decisions at the crucial period of the European history – the World Wars ages covering 1914 – 1945.
Les têtes couronnées d'Europe ont lancé une campagne militaire pour reconquérir la Terre Sainte. Le moment est venu de rassembler vos armées et de reprendre la Terre Sainte !

Bridge Constructor Médiéval vous fait remonter le temps jusqu'à l'époque des châteaux et des chevaliers. Construisez des ponts robustes pour acheminer les provisions jusqu'à votre ville, ou au contraire construisez des ponts bancals qui s'effondreront sous le poids des troupes adverses pour les précipiter au fond du gouffre.

Three men once manned the lighthouse on Fetch Rock, but they vanished without trace on New Year, 1900. No-one knows what really happened to those three poor souls, and no-one is brave enough to stay in the lighthouse, alone, after dark. Except you...travel to Fetch Rock Island, and discover what really happened...

A Clothing collection ARPG. Create set properties according to your clothing. Hundreds of clothes for the protagonist to enjoy, experience different battle strategies based on different outfits. Dress sexy or suit up like a heavily armoured angel of death.
Vous êtes l'arme ultime avec le compagnon ultime – Rassemblez des objets secrets et obtenez des améliorations pour devenir l'arme parfaite.

Sea Dogs is an epic role-playing game for the pirate in all of us. Return to the age of sail as a young captain looking to make a name in the world. Develop your character from humble beginnings and rise to control all of the islands for your country or yourself.

Discover ST World - the next-generation voxel world! Build stunning high-resolution sandbox worlds with easy-to-use tools and AI features. Explore Riftwalkers' open-world adventures and join a thriving community.
The frog village needs your help to fight against evil mutant alligators.

titre: 听见我的心 Listen to My Heart
description: 如果你胸腔里跳动的心脏，它原本是属于另一个人的，你会怎样面对这样的真相？一个被你当做弟弟对待的男人，是如何一点点的爱上你？温柔深情的男友为何在你人生低谷时弃你而去？当你在传奇电台制作人的压力下战战兢兢工作时，却偶然发现沉稳冷静的他似乎有另一个人格……这是你的人生，你来选择。
studio: 成都乐上网络科技有限公司

description: Since the press discovered multi-billionaire Bob Slayer’s best kept secret, the illegal Glacier Races, there are more applications than ever before for this deadly, crazy race. New contenders have entered the race, their vehicles are faster, stronger and equipped with new, experimental kind of weapons.

Huge indie fantasy role-playing adventure in a massive, underground land. Packed with over 100 towns and dungeons and an epic story. Fight to complete up to three distinct game-winning quests. Master over 60 spells and abilities. Hunt for hundreds of magical artifacts. Over 50 hours of gameplay.
RAILGRADE est un simulateur de gestion ferroviaire autour du secteur énergétique et du transport de ressources se déroulant dans une colonie extraterrestre.
三国佣兵传奇是一款幻想版的策略战棋游戏。玩家将作为蜀汉的传奇佣兵团白耳军的主帅，跟随刘备关羽张飞三兄弟完成匡扶汉室的桃园梦想。玩家需要不断招募在野的佣兵们为刘皇叔效力，并完成一系列困难重重的传奇战役。麴义的先登兵团和高顺的陷阵营等三国英雄在幻想版中都有机会加入玩家的阵营。

Chronicle of Innsmouth is a point'n'click adventure inspired by Lucas' retro classics from the 90s and H.P. Lovecraft's works. Investigate, gather info and solve enigmas to unveil the secrets of the cursed town of Innsmouth, a forsaken place surrounded by horrifying rumors.
Asymmetric space empire builder where you feel like the Emperor, not a logistics officer. No micromanagement, grand scale, fast paced, audiences, assassins, imperial court, disloyal admirals.

Perimeter is an innovative Real-Time-Strategy game that pits players against each other or AI opponents in a life and death struggle to seize territory and establish crucial protective “perimeters.” Players will be introduced to the game’s unique terraforming feature, allowing them to move, build, construct and destroy the map...
Build and fly realistic aircraft. Use free-form fuselage and wing editor tools and tune your engines to recreate aircraft from any era or design your own.

titre: Silent Hunter®: Wolves of the Pacific U-Boat Missions
description: La chasse en haute mer est repartie ! Écumez les mers en tant que capitaine d'un sous-marin allemand, dans un endroit inédit : l'océan Indien. Participez à la guerre contre les lignes de ravitaillement britannique situées près des côtes nord africaines et aidez les japonais dans leur guerre contre la Marine américaine.

titre: Kyiv: from dusk till dawn with Lenovo Explorer
description: VR-tour "Kyiv from dusk till dawn" includes: 6 locations. More than 20 minutes of video content. Interactive games in every location. Full immersive application.

Facile d'accès, immersif et bénéficiant d'une patte graphique originale, Battle Academy vient révolutionner les jeux de stratégie en combinant profondeur de gameplay et mécanismes ultra intuitifs. Ce titre peut se vanter de proposer un nombre impressionnant d’unités et des missions très différentes les unes des autres.
LA Cops is a fast, action packed 3D top down shooter set to a theme of 70s Cops in LA trying to do a tough job in a tough town.

Buoyancy is a city-building strategy game where you build, manage, and move a floating city on an oceanic world. Explore and scavenge resources scattered around the endless waters. Keep your villagers nourished and happy while combating fires, sickness, and pirate attacks.

Damascus is a pixel-art MMORPG created by two guys. Create a unique character and explore the strange and fantastic world that is before you. Train any of your 19 different skills. Chat and trade with other players. Make friends and slay all sorts of Dragons!

titre: WitchSpring3 Re:Fine - The Story of Eirudy -
description: Choose fate. Choose story. The fate of the witches is in your hands.

RPG de survie fantastique en monde ouvert. Difficulté sans frontières basée sur la distance avec un déplacement rapide, une construction modulaire et une gestion de la ville construits par les joueurs.
The dark narrative strategy game about cats slowly taking control of a city. Send your feline crew on dangerous missions, uncover their stories, and guide a rising revolt toward power.
A short, choose your own adventure game about two boys that find each other in a lonely, post-apocalyptic town.

Gagne les coeurs et esprits des électeurs américains et deviens Président avec ce jeu de stratégie politique. Choisis un candidat ou crée le tien, et fais la course contre le candidat du parti adverse ou jusqu'à 4 candidats principaux contrôlés par l'ordi ou d'autres joueurs en ligne.

Wild Woods est un jeu coopératif en local et en ligne, mêlant action et créatures des bois. Un à quatre joueurs incarnent de braves petits chats bien décidés à défendre leur chariot à travers une dangereuse forêt. Ils ne pourront surmonter les obstacles qu'en coopérant !

Coin Push RPG is a unique blend of Semi-Idle RPG and coin-pusher gameplay! Recruit legendary heroes, equip them with powerful gear, upgrade your town, construct buildings, and unlock stunning backgrounds as you expand your influence. Build a diverse and unstoppable team with your own unique style .
Storm over the Pacific is a game that takes place during 1937-1945. It depicts the conflict between the Japanese Empire, the USA and other allies during World War II.

Brick People est un jeu de tir d’action. Le jeu se déroule dans un monde merveilleux de blocs. Ici, tous les ennemis sont faits de blocs. Vous devez les vaincre et enfin sauver la petite fille qui vous a créé.
Ouvrez les gaz, dépassez vos rivaux et terminez premier : ne rêvez plus d'être le nouveau champion, devenez-le avec MotoGP™23, l'opus le plus abouti de l'histoire de la série !

The first game in the Utawarerumono trilogy of story-rich tactics RPGs. Into a world filled with verdant nature, populated by folk with fluffy ears and fuzzy tails, awakens Hakuowlo, a man of masked mien and missing memory.

“TWINKLE STAR SPRITES ”, a competitive 2D top-down view scrolling shooter released on NEOGEO MVS in 1996, departs for new adventures on the Steam gaming platform!Master your shots, and aim for the magical Twinkle Star”!
Faites le ménage et enchaînez les combos, les kills et les bombes à retardement.
Welcome to Alpha 2 of Hello Neighbor. Play against an advanced, self-learning AI in what eventually became Act 1 of Hello Neighbor - the stealth horror home invasion sim.

Rusted Moss is a twin-stick shooter metroidvania where you sling around the map with your grapple, blasting your way through witches and rusted machine monstrosities alike. This wasteland once harboring mankind has since fallen, and Fae long forgotten now knock on humanity's door...

titre: Dark Parables: Curse of Briar Rose Collector's Edition
description: Save Sleeping Beauty!

Absolute Tactics: Daughters of Mercy est un RPG tactique au tour par tour avec des batailles stratégiques, des énigmes et des quêtes. Personnalisez les capacités et les attaques de classe de vos héros pour vaincre les troupes du Père Eldritch sur des dizaines de cartes uniques !

titre: Inexplicable Geeks: Dawn of Just Us
description: Enter a world of ridiculously underpowered superheroes as you navigate a comic and pop culture convention celebrating their history. Gather stories, piece together history, and interact with the denizens of the super and the geek.

titre: Plan B from Outer Space: A Bavarian Odyssey
description: Escape the grasp of the Barbvarians! Plan B from Outer Space is a stellar adventure in the style of an interactive book and takes inspiration from classic science-fiction stories and Bavarian culture. Every decision will affect the outcome of your mission; to leave this strange planet unscathed!

Cette «simulation roguelite de construction de station spatiale» vous met en charge d'une station éloignée en orbite autour d'une planète géante gazeuse. Combattez des flottes et vaisseaux ennemis et des stations rivales pour dominer votre coin d'espace. Survivez aussi longtemps que vous le pouvez.

Prends les rennes d’une opération minière gérée par des élans ! Leur passion ? Extraire des pierres précieuses ! À toi de les aider sur la route du succès. Embauche des mineurs, améliore leur équipement, et construis des rails pour t’aventurer dans les profondeurs en quête des gemmes les plus rares

titre: Atelier Sophie 2: The Alchemist of the Mysterious Dream
description: Une histoire mystérieuse à propos d'un rêve mystérieux... C'est l'histoire de l'une des aventures que Sophie l'alchimiste a vécues après avoir quitté sa ville natale, Kirchen Bell.

Explore, Investigate, Hunt. Become an Occult Investigator who uses new technology to locate, battle, and capture demonic entities. Solve the mystery of this occult case by exploring the academy and picturing evidence. Revenants is a single-player VR Action/ Adventure/ Horror game.
Introducing Fields XY a puzzle platformer featuring 3 unique characters, all interacting at once to complete levels both simple and complex.

titre: METAL GEAR SOLID 2: Sons of Liberty - Master Collection Version
description: Quatrième titre de la série METAL GEAR , le jeu se déroule entre 2007 et 2009, met en scène Solid Snake et Raiden et propose de nouvelles fonctionnalités de gameplay.

Pourrez-vous faire face à une catastrophe inexorable et maintenir votre vaisseau en état suffisamment longtemps pour détruire les envahisseurs ennemis ? Réparez les systèmes, éteignez les incendies, armez les torpilles, évitez les éruptions solaires mortelles, détruisez vos amis et clonez-les ; c’est la véritable vie d’un Catastronaut !
Une aventure de serpent dans un donjon plein de puzzles. Défendez le temple, mangez les infidèles et grandissez, grandissez, grandissez.
Oh Trap! is a couch co-op game for 2 or 4 players. Steal the other team’s treasures! Place traps strategically to either help yourself or stop your opponents.
Avernum 5 est le second chapitre de la trilogie des Great Trials, trois jeux qui racontent l'histoire des luttes de votre terre contres des puissances hostiles.

Rassemblez vos amis et venez visiter Tinkertown, une nouvelle expérience de jeu sandbox multijoueur rafraîchissante ! C'est un endroit magique qui vous attend, dans lequel l'imagination est la seule limite à votre création.

Control:Override is a puzzle game where you must share control between the environment and yourself. Defy Physics. Solve puzzles . Terminate the rogue AI. And perhaps confront the truth about why it went rogue.
A short retro speedrun game in a dark world. Use your spells to deflect and solve puzzle elements.
A nostalgic racing game that combines the charm of classic retro style visuals with the thrill of international rally competitions.
interLOGIC est un jeu simple et atmosphérique de puzzle.

"True Game" is a work of suspense reasoning. The work tells the story that people in trouble are taken to a closed space and ask to get chips from others through different competitions. This work has a high degree of brain burning, exquisite picture and strong sense of substitution.

Take on hordes of frightful foes in this horror-themed beat ‘em up arcade brawler from Data East. You control one of three fighters whose sole objective is to deliver the beatdown to throngs of classic horror monsters. Time to show these abominations what a nightmare really looks like!

This game is a story of a father who is left alone to take care of his chickens. You must use your skill to avoid all sort of forest creatures and to save all 10 chickens. Fight bosses, and be prepared for an epic finale. The game difficulty start from easy to hard making this game last for hours of fun gameplay.

Create and manage your team in a violent, dystopic world of no-rules, fast-paced, arcade-style, ice hockey action. Adjust training regimens, control diets, administer black market pharmaceuticals, and provide healthcare (or not) to a ragtag team of convicts at the mercy of your underhanded tactics.

Play minigames with up to 6 players in this online minigame multiplayer game! Connect up with your friends or strangers as you battle it out to find a champion! All minigames are free to play, so get a friend or 5, what are you waiting for?
PLAY AS WILD ANIMALS OR HUMANS AND FIGHT AGAINST ONE ANOTHER. EITHER AGAINST BOTS, OR PLAYERS.

Instantly get involved in the action by joining the Allied invasion of Europe during the Second World War. Take command of an American battle group during WW2 in this turn based strategy wargame and help liberate Europe from the evil Axis power-base!
Follow Alice during the investigation about her husband
Joue avec tes amis à un jeu de football multijoueur en ligne avec un gameplay 100% basé sur la physique, où tu contrôles un seul joueur.

Un jeu de stratégie rétro au tour par tour sur cartes quadrillées, où vous livrez une guerre techno-fantastique dans le monde d’Etrom ! Commandez des armées puissantes, repoussez les ennemis abyssaux et sauvez votre base dans un désert mourant, à travers des batailles stratégiques exigeantes.

Immerse yourself in the world of the Surrealist master like never before in this encounter, venturing into the towers, peering from them to distant lands and discovering surprises around every corner.

Le jeu de puzzle le plus apprécié au monde est maintenant disponible sur PC. Avec ses 6 modes renversants, ses nouvelles fonctionnalités et un style graphique unique, Le dernier volet de ce jeu emblématique est maintenant un incontournable sur PC.

Colonise solar systems and watch them grow. Explore the galaxy to find its strategic choke points. Build up your empire and your fleet and then use the power of the media to prepare your people for the inevitable war. At the same time watch your opponents, keep on an eye on their own media and watch for threats and opportunities.
Fumpers? Your goal is to complete the track by jumping. Let's See How Quick You Can Be at Doing This.

De notre cœur à tous les enfants du monde entier - Coloriage pour les enfants, une nouveau jeu de coloriage spécialement conçue pour nos petits. Passez du temps avec vos enfants et entourez-les de magnifiques feuilles de coloriage! Illuminez leurs jeunes âmes avec des couleurs! Prenez plaisir!

Fortune favors those bold enough to collect and train tiny monsters.Three brave souls boldly descend into a town ridden with monsters, allies and everything in between. Driven only by the promise of powerful trinkets, unlimited treasure and almost certain death, they venture on.

An interactive Lovecraftian horror story about surviving a family you never knew and their servitude to a dark patron. True to the genre, you retain all knowledge from every play-through. Shape your fate and that of the family. Will you embrace this gift or rid humanity of their taint?

Story of a Father who is in search of his son who has fallen in a cave. You play as Father and fight with monsters,ghosts and deadly animals to save your son. This game has also local multiplayer which can be played upto four players.
A makeover game with 3200 items. Customize gorgeous models with glam fashion clothes, accessories, hairstyles and makeup options.

Joshua's Legs est un jeu unique avec des contrôles sournois à propos d'un arachnide à deux pattes qui espère retrouver sa collection de pattes prosthétiques depuis longtemps perdues. Aventurez-vous dans un monde qui révèlera ses secrets seulement aux vrais grimpeurs endurcis.
Sophie and Mike have been separated by an evil group and must now try and rejoin forces before taking on a great evil. But something more sinister is happening and may change the world forever!

In this game, you can watch as 7 protagonists come to a crossroad, facing their own destiny. You will witness their own choices and the blood-splattering consequence they have on one another. There is no way out except to plunge them into the abyss...
Protégez la méduse de divers obstacles ! Vous êtes seul(e) à pouvoir protéger la méduse.
The underwater world of Aquafish is waiting for you, build a beautiful aquarium buy winning coins in the classic tile-matching puzzle game mode!

titre: 勇者有点太嚣张。™G(No Hero Allowed: No Puzzle Either!)
description: Porting game from PSVita platform.In the game, you will play the lord who takes up the pickel and makes the army of demons to defeat the hero who come to attack the maze,It is recommended to open the sound experience game will be very feeling, the normal world is about 8-10 hours, collecting all the monsters and braver have certain...

Construisez un village nomade et voyagez avec votre tribu vers le centre du monde, appelé l'Œil. Ce roguelike de gestion de ressources au tour-par-tour est composé de situations procédurales et d'événements climatiques. Prêt pour l'aventure ?

The fast paced platforming of Freedom Planet returns! Become a full-time cartoon heroine and use abilities and items suited to your play style to explore the world of Avalice and defend its animal citizens!

titre: Suikoden I&II HD Remaster Gate Rune and Dunan Unification Wars
description: La destinée d’un héros est écrite dans les Étoiles. Les légendaires JRPG de KONAMI Suikoden I et Suikoden II ont été remastérisés en HD !

Get ready for the ultimate adrenaline-fueled showdown with Re-Spawn Tournament, the competitive arena-style multiplayer first-person shooter game. Experience fast-paced, high-energy combat that demands both reflexive skill and tactical thinking.

Nerveux, rapide, profond, impressionnant à regarder et incroyablement amusant ! Combattez dans une période sombre de carnages et de guerres éternelles et menez les Space Wolves dans une lutte pour défendre le dernier bastion de l'humanité.
Jump, jump, jump, swim, swim, swim and help this otter to recover all the trophies that looked so good in his trophy case.
Rogalia is the sandbox with fantasy open world, meal-based character leveling, nice graphics and cozy atmosphere.

Une aventure noire à travers le temps et l'espace. Lorsqu'un triangle amoureux entre des êtres cosmiques se change en conflit amer, un dieu jaloux tire un coup de feu : le Big Bang. Plongez dans l'univers en expansion et trouvez un moyen de détruire la création et sauver votre amour.

Aux armes, Slayers ! Éradiquez la menace des Oni dans ce tout nouveau jeu de chasse et d'action offrant un système dynamique de destruction ciblée ! Découvrez le nouvel épisode de la série "Toukiden". Du champ de bataille au village qui vous sert de base, le jeu vous plonge dans un vaste "open world" (monde ouvert).

Andromeda One Zombies is an First Person Shooter video game featuring zombies. The game take place in the far future where spatial exploration of galaxy is possible. A virus has spread and now zombies are rampant. The hero is in the military and try to bring order in the Andromeda galaxy.

Trahissez vos amis et mentez pour gagner. Le jeu de déduction social multijoueur Eville vous emmène dans un village où les meurtres s'enchaînent. Certains disent que c'était vous... est-ce le cas ? Convainquez les autres de votre innocence pour survivre !

Découpez les robots en VR. Sentez leurs corps se désintégrer sous les coups de votre épée. Vous combattez dans le Crashloop, un tournoi roguelite à mort. Croisez le fer ! Projetez des shurikens depuis votre poignet ! Voici CLONE DRONE... dans l'HYPERDOME !!!

The epic based classic online game Khan takes on where Genghis Khan reached the end of his expedition. The game takes place at small kingdom of Eurasia where Genghis Khan's brutal force was never able to conquer. You will re-visit the history and prepare the battles against the greatest conquer of history.

With a style inspired by the RTS games from early 2000's, a new tower defense combines in a unique way action, tactics, replay value and fun. They are here! Choose your targets, upgrade, replay, discover your enemies and your tactical skills.

Addled Clicker is an idle-clicker game that takes place in the dark and twisted facility of "Chamber 49" -- ran by a mysterious figure called "The Director". Appease the Director's wishes by increasing the button count while surviving what creeps out from the darkness.

titre: Living Legends: The Frozen Fear Collection
description: Can you uncover the secrets that lay buried within the glaciers of the past? Find out in Living Legends: The Frozen Fear Collection.
It's speed dating for the railway-tycoon monopolist robber baron! To obliterate your competition, you must marry a suitable partner before time runs out.

Embark on a thrilling journey in a world of elemental magic. Play as a young wizard mastering the elements to survive against dark forces. Explore haunting landscapes, hone your spells, and unravel mysteries while battling supernatural foes in this captivating adventure
Trip on psychedelics to overthrow tyranny and reclaim your freedom in this trippy action adventure game!
Hidden object game in the cosmic setting. Black and white hand-drawn graphics in a cartoon style. Game for all ages.

The world's finest HU-man simulator! Explore dungeons, slash enemies, collect loot, fight bosses, just like HU-man used to do in their daily lives. Now with a direct uplink to the Compendium for real-time updates!

Survivez à l'apocalypse avec vos amis dans Escape Z. Combattez et planifiez des tactiques pour affronter des hordes de zombies. Choisis ton personnage, ta carte et prépare-toi. La survie est votre seule option.

Realistic simulation of spaceflight in a full sized Solar System, with all the planets and their major moons. using real forces, distances, velocities and time. Chapter 1: The Apollo Days. Incredibly detailed Apollo Program missions starting with Apollo 8 lunar orbit missions.

An eerie horror game set in a weird hotel plagued with bizarre beings and interesting characters. The game utilizes a never-used before environment alongside brand new horror mechanics, one of a kind graphics/art style, and an unnerving story with rich lore to create a unique experience for players.
The game “Locked Up" is the first project developed in 2020 by the studio EMIKA_GAMES consisting of one person.
Découvrez une toute nouvelle façon de jouer au flipper dans ce jeu qui combine le look du flipper numérique et les sensations du monde physique. Pinball FX Classic VR est incontournable sur VR !
Mind Games – un nouveau jeu pour se relaxer et travailler la mémoire en même temps.
A spaceship simulator for aliens, an ever-changing rule discovery puzzle for humans.
Alicemare is a somehow familiar yet totally unique adventure game infused with subtle hints of horror, created by △○□× (Miwashiba) using the WOLF RPG Editor.
싸움은 끝나지 않는다는 약간의 호러 요소가 가미된 어드벤처 게임입니다. 기존의 턴제 RPG 전투의 틀에서 벗어나 주변을 조사하고, 전투 공간과 상호작용하세요.
Play as Birdo in this infinite platformer. Jump on the falling furniture to reach new heights, but don't get squashed or eaten by the monster!

Jump into it with *NEW* EPIC SCUFFED BHOP SIMULATOR 2023 POG CHAMP, a new parkour game which has spicy memes, graphics, and physics engine! Play with up to 10 friends in multiplayer and by yourself in single player!
Nanofights est un "jeu de cartes à collectionner en ligne", conçu pour des parties rapides.

Un briseur de blocs avec un système de power-up basé sur la jauge. Votre vaisseau peut tirer des coups de feu à tout moment, ce qui, combiné aux power-ups, en fait un briseur de bloc offensif. Le niveau de difficulté peut être ajusté pour que chacun puisse profiter du jeu.
What will you do when the zombie apocalypse comes, are you ready to tackle it right now and stay face to face with all the horrors that will appear?

titre: 黑色花与红山羊 / Black Datura & Red Goat
description: 苏醒之时，他正处于昏暗的木屋之中。自己的身份、过去的经历，全都无法想起。很快，他发觉自己正处于一个异常的空间，到处都是谜题和陷阱，还有一些古怪的居民。在前行的途中，也不断与同样被困在此处的人成为了同伴。道路的前方，是救赎，还是绝望？这是一个围绕着“诅咒”与“救赎”的故事。
WhiteClothesは可愛いケモノたちが活躍する高難度のコマンド式のRPGです。 魔王を倒して世界の平和を取り戻そう。 主要キャラクターは全員可愛いケモノ！人間は絶滅させておきました。血沸き、胸揺れるRPG！

Hyperspace Invaders II: Pixel Edition is a hardcore, uncompromising vertical scrolling bullet hell/invader hell shooter (shmup) that doubles as a techno-based lightsynth, triggering bursts of funky invaders at the pulse of a relentless beat.

Espresso Tyoon - un simulateur de café. Créez votre marque, décorez le café, gérez vos employés et prenez soin de vos clients. Utilisez l'éditeur de café en 3D pour créer des recettes de café, commander des fournitures et collecter des points de notation. Développez votre entreprise de café !

Mine and craft your way to orbit, build your own starship and explore a vast, dangerous galaxy alongside your crew. For players who love a meaningful survival progression, a unique and elegant building system, and epic space-opera scale.
Warlock: Tower Defense est un jeu de défense basé sur une histoire, donnant aux joueurs accès à 6 magies élémentaires pour faire face à des défis répartis sur 5 chapitres.

Moebius: Empire Rising is a contemporary adventure that merges classic point-and-click puzzle solving with Jane Jensen’s sophisticated storytelling. Travel the world using Malachi’s unique deductive powers to analyze suspects, make historical connections, and uncover the truth behind a theory of space and time the government will defend...

NARUTO SHIPPUDEN: Ultimate Ninja STORM 2 est un concentré de sensations fortes dans le monde de Naruto. Incroyablement fidèle à l'univers du dessin animé, le jeu permet aux joueurs de revivre l'histoire de Shippuden. Ultimate Ninja STORM 2 a été remasterisé en HD.

An exciting platform game, filled with action, skill, wits and competition that hides a secret inside: A powerful editor that you can use to create your own adventures… and by adventures we don’t mean simple levels… We mean full campaigns, with their world map, NPC’s and your own unique story!
Un jeu d'évasion et de puzzle / aventure! Aidez Vala à obtenir son diplôme de la Space Academy!

Swap Fire is a high-intensity game show based on RQI's latest teleportation technology. Shooting other players swaps your locations. Using this simple principle, players must out-wit and out-maneuver each other in 9 different game types!
Epic Assassin - Bad Dudes are invading the Realm. The Queen has hired an Epic Assassin to Kill Them.

A sci-fi Virtual Reality game focused on high-intensity combat. Experience mythical weapons such as Thor's hammer Mjolnir, Zeus's shield Aegis, and more as you defend against enemies in this action-packed exciting game!

Happy Summer Quest - Vacation is a great time for adventure! Therefore, you decide to go on a journey to find precious stones in distant lands, despite the unpredictable dangers that may meet you on your way.
Prêt pour un voyage psychédélique plein de sons et de couleurs ? 0°N 0°W est une balade à la première personne relaxante pour tous, où chaque partie est une aventure inédite !
Utilisez l'outil de création du Nimbatus pour construire des drones physiquement simulés et les essayer dans un environnement de test virtuel. Avez-vous l'âme d'un ingénieur ?
The Qi has awakened demons, they wreak havoc on our world. You traverse ancient realms with the aid of the "Kunlun Mirror," embarking on a journey of cultivation and acension to gods.

Matthew goes to meet his beloved, who was forced to land on the old base. But there is a catch — he is on a distant planet, where during the breeding phases of the local fauna people see hallucinations.

titre: The Horus Heresy: Battle of Tallarn - Iron Edition
description: The Horus Heresy: Battle of Tallarn is a turn-based strategy game that recreates one of the most important events in Imperial history. Command a vast array of tanks, Dreadnoughts, Knights and Titans across the toxic landscape.

Parcel is a brain-twisting puzzle game where unique character abilities are used in unison to solve interlocking laser conundrums. Switch between members of your colorful team of postpeople and make your way through over 120 futuristic mind-benders!
A relaxing low poly 3d platformer fantasy adventure.

One Hand Clapping est un jeu de plateforme vocal en 2D. Résolvez des énigmes en chantant ou en fredonnant dans votre microphone, et prenez confiance dans le pouvoir de votre voix qui change le monde qui vous entoure.
Minimalistic ragdoll fighting game created in 7 days. Only play this game if you're curious where Drunken Wrestlers 2 came from, or feeling nostalgic.

Ce jeu d'aventure gagnant de nombreuses récompenses raconte l'histoire d'amour entre deux belles âmes sous un humour ingénieux, des énigmes complexes et un style d'animation fantasque, fait à la main, image par image.

Can you create the raddest spaceship? Captain Forever Remix is the spaceship builder roguelike. Voyage across the Solar System and blast apart randomly-generated enemies for spare parts. This is an officially-licensed re-imagining of the indie classic Captain Forever.

Embarquez pour un voyage de survie en monde ouvert inspiré de l'héritage de la Chine ancienne. Ramassez des ressources, cultivez des terres, construisez la maison de vos rêves et défendez-la contre les maraudeurs. Faites équipe avec vos amis pour explorer un monde où l'aventure côtoie la sérénité.
Avoid is a fast-paced arcade game that will test your reflexes!

You are the Warrior on a quest to find and defeat the Slime Gladiator. With a limited movement, you need to think carefully about every step until you reach the door. Use your special power, push boxes, find keys, beware of traps, and slay every slime that get in your way!

Due to a chemical known as pharGONe, the world has been turned upside down. Battle your way through multiple levels, earning upgrades, competing against your friends and more, and find the truth about what has happened to the world.Use a variety of weapons to stop the mutated population, and save yourself from being another victim.

Seed of Evil is an epic adventure to uncover the secrets of the Water City, Somonden. Follow Anna as she explores the upper and lower parts of the city to uncover the truth of the defilement plaguing its inhabitants. You won't soon forget this amazing story filled with mystery, drama, and intrigue.

8-Bit Hordes est la suite du titre d'arcade et stratégie en temps réel 8-Bit Armies. Avec un style coloré et à bloc de pixels, 8-Bit Hordes est un ajout sympathique au monde du RTS, facile à prendre en main et à jouer pour les joueurs de tous niveaux.

Fantastic Checkers 2 is a modern version of the classic strategy board game set in an extraterrestrial environment! The objective of the game is to capture opponent pieces by diagonally jumping over them to eliminate them from the board.

This is a surreal exploration game. Explore a massive fractal with great complexities. You can shrink infinitely to go deeper into the fractal. Or you can become larger by growing. Inner space awaits you in this infinite world.
Breach of Contract Reloaded is the new Multiplayer FPS Game you've been wanting! With game modes Team Deathmatch, Free-For-All, and Bomb Defuse, and 6 maps. Be prepared, it's coming.

Climb aboard an American RAH-66 Comanche, or the Russian KA-52 Hokum B, and prepare to experience low-level helicopter combat like never before! Sharpen your "line of sight" tactics on over 30,000 kilometers of treacherous landscape!

Heroes of the Monkey Tavern est un jeu d'exploration de donjon en vue subjective conçu comme une initiation au genre : règles simplifiées, énigmes et défis équilibrés. Un projet indépendant développé en solo.
Get a new gaming experience as a racer in a shopping cart! Play for the brutal and steep Cart Racer. Overcome obstacles in the city, in the sea, in the ancient castle and the snowy mountains!

Guide Alum on his journey through the "Land of Tide". Help him discover the truth about his city, Kosmos, and the mysterious epidemic known as "The Vague". As the tale unfolds, it will keep you enthralled all the way up to its epic conclusion. Alum is an original point-and-click adventure game.
Hunt squirrels, staple them to a corpse, and meet god.

Create your Religion, raise your Disciples, and guide them to bring you glory! Inspire growth in your Disciples so they may challenge the false gods and convert their followers. Defeat your rivals, and become the One Truth!

Cataclysm destroyed the sky and the earth, but it didn't destroy "Leningrad" - an autonomous underwater city-fortress. It is up to you to take on the role of the Captain of the "Leningrad". The future of the ship and its citizens depends on your actions.

Deck of Ashes est un jeu d'aventure aux combats de cartes tactiques. Un personnage mène une équipe d'antihéros lors d'une quête vers la rédemption. Explorez un monde de fantasy maudit et traquez les cartes les plus puissantes. Composez un deck de combat unique et écrasez vos ennemis !
A party game / arena fighter where balding porcupines with only a single quill left fight to the death for honour, glory, and their enemies' skulls!

You are Isabella Song – a hacker PI. Your job is to hack cameras, phones, and computers, as well as question suspects, analyze evidence and draw conclusions. But don't forget that in Farca city, even criminals can end up victims.
The Tape is a slow and creepy first person horror game, with mystical story and abstract psychological elements.

Raid destructible compounds using explosive gadgets and tactical weaponry in VR! Breach, clear, and dominate in high-intensity raids where destruction is your greatest weapon. Whether you're leading a squad or taking on the challenge solo, precision, strategy, and firepower will decide your victory.
Melody has decided to become a healer in this classic-inspired turn-based RPG about love, anxiety, and fighting funny-looking monsters in dungeons.

titre: RESONANCE OF FATE™/END OF ETERNITY™ 4K/HD EDITION
description: Le fameux « Shooting-RPG » sur-vitaminé a été remasterisé, et vous permet désormais de changer le sort du monde en version 4K/HD. Lancez-vous dans ce périple pour sauver ce qu'il reste de votre planète au gré d'épiques gunfights aériens.
The Call is a horror puzzle game where you are in the role of an american police officer who gets a domestic disturbance call while late on patrol. Once you arrive things get a little bit unusual...

Let’s Sing: The Karaoke for PC. Let’s Sing PC is your chance to bring out your inner-star and pose as Lady Gaga, Maroon 5, Lana Del Rey, Flo Rida, Bruno Mars, Avril Lavigne, LMFAO and many others…Pump up the volume and party in your living-room with friends and family!

SpellKnights is a Third-Person Multiplayer Fantasy Shooter developed with Unreal Engine 4, in which four knights fight with a magical mana (four elements of the nature: Water, Fire, Earth and Wind) to achieve the honour of the Arena.
If you are a fan of Oats Studios and want to support us, then please purchase the Oats Studios - Volume 1 Assets. Zygote DLC now available.
Un jeu d'aventure et d'action qui se déroule dans un monde libre simulé dans lequel les êtres humains n'ont jamais atteint le sommet de la chaîne alimentaire.
Totemori is a free-to-play local-multiplayer brawler where you build towers while trying to topple everyone else’s!
A simple game with big ambitions. Fight creatures, explore the world and progress your character in this ever changing world.
Puppy Dog: Jigsaw Puzzles is the perfect game to dog lovers and jigsaw puzzle game enthusiasts. The game includes 84 challenging jigsaw puzzles with beautiful pictures of irresistible cute puppies.
A physics based twin-stick shooter. Survive as long as possible and get a high score. Use your gravity beam or your gravity mine to destroy endless waves of enemies.
Grace Online is a 3D fantasy MMORPG featuring an immersive experience that allows the players to forge their own paths through exploration and discovery.

"ASTRAL TALE"- Myth of the Stars," a classic Japanese MMORPG, is now officially operating worldwide. A brand-new profession has been introduced, allowing players to embark on a unique journey across the stars together!

Un mal ancien a enveloppé la petite ville de Rabbit Hole, et maintenant Shaun Turner doit résoudre un écheveau d'événements mystiques et sauver sa famille, s'échapper de la ville, qui est devenu un enfer sur terre.
From the Shadows is a cooperative puzzle platformer game where players have to work their way through a mysterious mansion by resolving puzzles that revolve around the mechanics of light and shadow.

GILLES shows the Journey of a Theater Director's 10 years exile to create his Great Work, his Theater Play named The Klown. On this first episode, join him and SamPath on their Journey to show the Great Premiere. GILLES is a story exploration game from Infiniti Studio.
Take control of a huge mech on an alien planet! Shoot and trample the natives, avenge your brother, or forgive his killers? Join the rebels to restore peace on the exotic planet of Eldorado.

Get ready for the good, the bad, and the even worse. As Marshall James Anderson, you'll face a horde of ornery, gun-slinging outlaws. You'll shoot your way through a twisted plot of greed and revenge. You'll arm yourself with firearms, as well as your wits.
Savez-vous ce qui se passe après l'enregistrement des bagages? Vous pensez que vos bagages sont en sécurité dans les tapis roulants de l'aéroport? Maintenant vous pouvez découvrir la vérité!

In Disney Princess: Enchanted Journey, players are transported to environments based on classic films as they discover the courage, trust, and friendship needed to become a real princess, while attempting to save each kingdom from evil.

Get set for a vivid sensory rush as you spin and match explosive gems for shockwaves of fun. Rotate jewels freely to set up electrifying combos, outwit surprising obstacles like Locks and Bombs, and create high-voltage Flame and Lightning gems.

DROPSHIP is a precision, arcade flying game that will test your skills and nerves. A lunar lander with a gravity-bending twist. Navigate through increasingly hazardous environments with your ship intact and get to the landing pad before your fuel supplies run out!
The ultimate space capital ship combat compendium is the evolution of hard core space combat sims. The only game of its kind currently in existence.

Nightork Adventures - Legacy of Chaos is an arcade shooter game. You fly with a spaceship through procedurally generated caves and fight against evil demons using magic colors. There is a campaign of 30 levels and 5 boss monsters. It also comes with a level editor, so you can create your own levels.

titre: Super Monkey Ball: Banana Blitz HD
description: Agrippe tes bananes car Super Monkey Ball: Banana Blitz HD débarque à fond les ballons ! Découvre l'univers magique d'un des titres les plus populaires de la saga, désormais remasterisé en Haute Définition !

La série du best seller Comanche est de retour avec encore plus d'action . 6 campagnes multijoueurs aux commandes de l'hélicoptère Comanche RAH-66 vous attendent. Comprend Combat permanent — combattez des chars, des avions, des hélicoptères, des troupes au sol...

Alors que le 3e millénaire bat son plein, Toru Sumiki devient gérant du bar à chicha Hookah Haze dans une zone en déclin près d'Akihabara. Il y rencontre 3 femmes aux caractères marqués, et dont il découvre peu à peu la face cachée. Le dénouement dépendra de là où son cœur le mène.

Erannorth Renaissance is a text driven gamebook with sandbox elements. Create your hero, build their party, and shape your journey. Set in an open world, it mixes text based narrative, turn based combat, deep character customization, and sandbox freedom.
Venture into the world of The Divergent Series: Allegiant in this immersive 360° 3D VR experience featuring an all-star cast from the feature film
Fear clouds the mind. Fear paralyzes the body. If your hands are shaking with fear, you will remain in this hell forever.

titre: The Lancaster Leak - O'Brien State Park
description: YOU CONTROL THE FOUND FOOTAGE. An FBI intern leaked special investigation tapes before suddenly disappearing. The first tape of the series contains found footage from O'Brien State Park revealing the true events that were covered up in the 1980s.

Tormentor X Punisher est un shooter à double joysticks qui ne fait pas dans la dentelle. Ton objectif : survivre et faire les meilleurs scores. Il suffit d’un seul coup pour tuer tes ennemis. Même traitement pour toi.

11 juin 2009 - Mise à jour !Deux nouvelles classes d'Orcs jouables : Lord (Warrior) ou Shaman.Jouabilité étendue : les Orcs consomment deux fois plus de nourriture, apprennent les arts martiaux plus rapidement, produisent des objets plus lentement et les shamans utilisent des totems pour invoquer des créatures.
Vacuum Pilot est un jeu de course en 2D avec des commandes faciles à apprendre mais difficiles à maîtriser basées sur le mouvement de la souris.

Don't Knock Twice est un jeu d'horreur à la première personne, fondé sur une légende urbaine psychologiquement terrifiante. Pour sauver sa fille éloignée, une mère rongée par la culpabilité doit découvrir une vérité effrayante derrière le conte urbain d'une sorcière vindicative et démoniaque.

Bayla Bunny has discovered a book full of maps to magical treasures and loot, and sets out on an exciting adventure to discover them all. Energized and ready to explore, she takes off running and once she gets going, she rarely stops!

Il s'agit d'une simple tour de défense comme un jeu, cliquez sur le bouton gauche de la souris pour tirer sur les ennemis, assurez-vous de ne pas vous blesser. Battez Neomorph, combattez avec des dames!
Start your engines and join the mayhem in Ragtag Racing. Choose your whacky racer and try to complete all 15 tracks without running out of fuel.

Monstre, une énorme bête aux dents acérées, est le meilleur ami de Quico. Malheureusement, Monstre a un dangereux problème : il est accro aux grenouilles venimeuses. Dès qu’il en aperçoit une sauter quelque part, il l’engloutit et se retrouve plongé dans un accès de rage destructrice.

titre: Making History: The Calm and the Storm Gold Edition
description: Making History Gold Edition is the expanded and updated version of the original WWII grand strategy game Making History: Calm & the Storm. Command your nation and change the course of history.

Prepare to unleash your inner dungeon master in Girl and Demon 1, the ultimate RPG for masochistic gamers. Delight in the dizzying array of complex status effects and mind-bogglingly high numbers that will make your head spin!
A mysterious and fascinating quest in Hidden Object genre.

Offrez-vous le football fantastique paneuropéen en prenant le contrôle de n'importe quel club des quatre divisions anglaises, ou simultanément des deux premières divisions des premières ligues du continent (Espagne, Italie, France et Allemagne).

Kayak VR : Mirage est un voyage magnifique et exaltant à travers de beaux endroits, conçu pour la réalité virtuelle. Manœuvrez le kayak physiquement précis sur le parcours de course et couronnez-vous le plus rapide, ou détendez-vous en mode free roam et profitez du paysage.
A hyper-immersive audiovisual adventure originally created for Burning Man, Soundscape VR: 2017 now lives on as a de-commodified gift to all humans who hold a passion for music & visual arts.

Détendez-vous et prospérez dans cette simulation de colonie sans prise de tête. Créez un refuge pour les naufragés, gérez les ressources, vivez votre meilleure vie sur l'océan. Transformez votre humble colonie en société high-tech.

Play with living, battling characters! Combat Chess takes the basic chess game and adds an imaginative element for players. Beautifully done in rendered 3D graphics, Combat Chess adds stunning animation sequences during gameplay.
Hamlet; is a Turn based Roguelike RPG in an open world with light survival elements.

Oreille attentive. Ami. Thérapeute. À bord de votre taxi sillonnant Paris la nuit, vous êtes plus qu'un chauffeur pour vos clients. Vous avez le don de les inciter à parler, et c'est exactement ce que vous devrez faire si vous voulez mettre la main sur ce tueur en série qui a failli vous ôter la vie.
MURI is a DOS-style shooter from Remar Games and Ludosity. Features PC Speaker sound and 16-color EGA graphics.
Une aventure faite de vitraux inspirée par le conte de la Belle au Bois Dormant.

Un jeu de plateforme et puzzle explosif sur des mondes à l'envers. Appuyez sur un bouton et changez de dimension, résolvez des casse-tête et parcourez les étendues sauvages du multivers dans une histoire sombre et hilarante (et sombrement hilarante) où tout peut basculer en une seconde.

All-Star Fruit Racing propulse les joueurs dans des îles remplies d'action : entre dérapages à travers des loopings, des sauts insensés, et des pistes défiant la gravité, parcours les championnats, les courses et les divers défis dans un monde ultra coloré rempli de décors à couper le souffle !
Indie Game Battle is a multiplayer fighting game for up to 8 players inspired by the Super Smash Bros series. However, IGB features indie characters instead!
You've played this game before. It's a haunted game about a haunted game. You may not remember, but the game remembers you. I remember you.

Dr. Eggman, le scientifique diabolique (alias Dr. Robotnik) a emporté les pauvres animaux de South Island et les a changés en robots. Seul notre héros peut venir à bout de Dr. Eggman et libérer les animaux de son emprise : C’est Sonic, le hérisson le plus rapide au monde !

A satirical dark-comedy parody of WW2, featuring genderbent anime dictators and generals! A ridiculous visual novel with turn-based battles, decision branches based on player choices, romance, drama and lots of fun things to play and unlock...

Simulateur de développement de jeu ! Vivez l'expérience ! Pixel Ripped 1978: An Atari Adventure est une lettre d'amour à ATARI. Emporté dans une folle aventure à travers le temps, vous incarnez un programmeur d'ATARI. ENTREZ dans le monde des jeux vidéo pour empêcher que l'histoire soit réécrite !
It's adorable! It's tactical! The doujin/indie SRPG - Moékuri! 151+ Cute Creatures to try, over a solid grid-based tactical system! Fight through 25 story stages with your own unique strategy!

Lancez-vous dans une aventure metroidvania en 2D inspiré par la philosophie et l'art populaire indonésiens. Contrôlez Kimo et Féefollet qui partent à la recherche de fragments de lumière. Découvrez des ruines cachées, résolvez des casse-tête et liez-vous d’amitié avec les habitants de Lumina.

titre: The Storm Guard: Darkness is Coming
description: The Storm Guard is a challenging turn-based roguelike role-playing game inspired by the Night’s Watch in the Game of Thrones. You assume the role of the Lord Commander of the Storm Guard leading the order during difficult times. An ancient dragon and its minions have returned, threatening the realm of men.

Une expérience de jeu absolument unique où se mêlent simplicité, élégance et défi. Strata a réussi à faire de ce jeu simple, mais brillant, une œuvre sophistiquée où couleur et musique vibrent de concert. Surprenez-vous en réussissant ces structures colorées complexes.

Bienvenue au parc national de Windy Oaks. Une belle et effrayante aventure point-and-click d'horreur. Vous êtes en route pour rendre visite à votre père quand tout va mal, vous laissant pris au piège et isolé.
Play minigames and discover the hidden truth in this retro-style horror game

Old Town, 1927. Ignithium technology has caused a huge leap leading to the dawn of war robots. In a city of smuggling and crime, Rose, an upper class girl, joins the Irish mafia to fight off Rusty Jack's robotic mafia, using advanced weapons in a frantic adventure to write her story in Old Town.
Ce jeu est un jeu de tir spatial en 3D. Jeu de type arcade. C'est un jeu pour tirer beaucoup de missiles.

titre: No Turning Back: The Pixel Art Action-Adventure Roguelike
description: No Turning Back is an indie pixel art randomly generated action rogue-like developed by a new indie developer with tons of player classes, spells, weapons, armour and unlocks!
Your goal is to survive in a city overrun by zombies, team up with friends to mine resources, build forts and explore the abandoned city.

titre: 伊格利亚战记/The Heroic Legend Of  Eagarlnia
description: Lay out your grand strategy on the land of Eagarlnia where humans, elves, orcs, dwarves, and the undead each battle out a corner of land. Manage your territories by navigating complex decisions and grow your economy.
Gather resources by day, build and recruit by noon, defend your village by night! A new minimalism sandbox survival with countless new ideas – Craft Hero

titre: Yokai Art: Night Parade of One Hundred Demons
description: By accident, you broke the seal of the mysterious book, which contains an enormous magical power that allows users to control any Yokai by defeating them and recording their names. This godly power is too much which alerts all the Yokai. You must find your own way to defeat them and survive.
Cyberpunch is a post apocalyptic beat em up game.

Kou Kadokura, a cyber officer, seeks to uncover the truth behind the tragedy that ended his once peaceful life. A war looms, and the answers he’s looking for are locked away in him... So why can't he remember anything? Unravel the mysteries hidden in his lost memories through this fast-paced mech action game!

Incarnez Ryo Hazuki, un adolescent japonais déterminé à retrouver l'assassin de son père, et voyagez au cœur de la Chine rurale. Plongez dans une histoire pleine d'aventure, de mystère, d'amitié, d'arts martiaux, et bien sûr, de vengeance !
Fireboy & Watergirl sont de retour ! Cette fois avec des fées pour vous aider !
An adventure beyond myths. Control the gods and witness the story through Skirnir. Kill them all.

Endless Road: Reborn is a roguelike card game where players use a variety of equipment & skills to defeat vile creatures lurking along a treacherous, endless road. Players will also be faced with choices that will test their decision-making abilities and survival skills.

Clan monsters is a game in which you have to use your dexterity and reliable weapons to destroy monsters that appear from portals. Different types of weapons will be given you for completing levels. Fire, monster a lot of levels with different platforms! There is easy controls system.

In this fully 3D, real-time space flight simulator, you will play a pivotal role in the war between the United Earth Alliance and a vicious alien threat known as the Revi. Strap into the cockpit, get your joystick ready, and join the fight in this retro space sim inspired by the games of the '90's.
"Defence to death" - game in genre "Tower Defence". Defend Your castle from monster! Show Your's strength and wisdom.
Enjoy another classic 16-bit RPG from Warfare Studios of Vagrant Hearts, Ashes of Immortality and Valiant fame, with the epic finale of the Last Heroes saga!

The conjoined twins were bullied and humiliated... Now justice will be served! BLOODY SERVICE is a dark, gory and violent coming-of-age slasher FMV Visual Novel with gruesome deaths and clever one-liners related to tennis. Game, set, machete!

Machinika : Atlas est un jeu de puzzle indépendant et la suite directe de Machinika : Museum. Vous incarnez un chercheur de musée qui vient d'atterrir sur Atlas. Saurez-vous percer les mystères du vaisseau extraterrestre ? Résolvez des énigmes pour découvrir ce qu'il s'est passé !

titre: LEGRAND LEGACY: Tale of the Fatebounds
description: Join the Fatebounds as they travel the world of Legrand in a desperate attempt to stop the Mugna Feud, a war of unparalleled savagery, and uncover the sinister forces behind it!
A hardcore platformer game with 50 levels. Avoid obstacles and collect all the coins to unlock the door to the next level.

Alternativa est une histoire qui va vous emporter dans un monde bien différent de celui que vous imaginez pour l'année 2045. Un monde dictatorial fait de guerre et de révolution.Aventure classique en pointez/cliquez qui est composé d'histoires dans un univers sci-fi/cyber-punk.Meurtre, oligarchie et trahison !

"Infinite jump"is a breakthrough leisure game. Players need to continuously advance through the levels by making the ball jump over obstacles. The difficulty of the game levels will increase as the number of levels progresses.

It all began when you opened that letter. Penned by your late master, it details how you are now heir to his mysterious legacy. You set off for the island on which he'd spent his final years... and so a truly unsettling journey begins, a journey into the deepest secrets of magic and the occult.
Stream One and Series S/X consoles in 1080p

A group of ducklings finds a mysterious 100-in-1 cartridge and are now forced to play all the games to escape the insidious cartridge spirit! 100 microgames, fun and increasing difficulty—what more do you need for an interesting adventure?
Solve classic puzzles in head-to-head PvP. Sharpen your mind and test your wits against other players.
高中2年级的主人公，新学期转学到了新的学校。在兴奋地跑向新学校时，在路转角撞上了一个会说话的■物体。主人公被施了一种「帅哥的分辨率会变低的诅咒」。

Aoba's vibrant cyberpunk world is one of contrasts: high-tech virtual reality battles versus street gang turf wars, ultra-exclusive luxury resorts and tiny junk shops. The choices you make will shape the path of Aoba's journey into the dark secrets lurking beneath the glossy sheen of the city.

Vous vous êtes aventuré jusqu'ici, maintenant il n'y a plus de retour en arrière. Découvrez la sombre histoire de l'île en parcourant des cavernes en ruine et des laboratoires mystérieux, mais soyez averti, certains peuvent ne pas être trop accueillants de votre présence…

titre: 东方大战争 ~ Touhou Big Big Battle
description: just a touhou rts game
A retro space shooter with a twist - now you can rotate your ship and aim diagonally at enemies, adding a whole new dimension to the shoot 'em up genre.

GeneRally 2 is a top-down arcade racing game with a built-in track editor. Challenge the track records in time-trial; compete on the sofa with friends; or race online against people from around the world!

From the creative mind behind The Adventures of Shuggy comes an exciting new retro-styled 2D platformer, a winner of Dream Build Play 2012 and a top 50 game of 2012 according to Game Informer. Grab the gateway guns and explore a huge lab filled with mysterious puzzles in this classic platforming adventure.

I'm going to make you an offer you can't refuse...Have you ever thought about being part of the Mafia?So enter in the world of Family Business,a massive first-Person shooter. Play against other players, earn cash, buy weapons, improve your arsenal and show everyone whos BOSS !

The Walking Zombie : Dead City est un FPS immobile qui comprend un mode coop dans un univers rempli de zombies à éradiquer. Achetez vos armes et améliorez-les, massacrez tous les ennemis au cours de 200 niveaux, et détruisez d'impressionnants boss avant qu'ils ne vous dévorent tout cru !

Ticket to Ride: First Journey est une version issue de la série du jeu de société : Les Aventuriers du Rail. Simple et rapide, les jeunes joueurs pourront désormais rivaliser avec les plus grands. Les Aventuriers du Rail : Mon Premier Voyage inclut les cartes de l'Europe et des États-Unis.
Seiran Island. Even here in paradise, there are those who work in the shadows to bring it down... Confront the tyranny of a twisted system in this long-awaited visual novel adventure.

The story takes place in a future company called "RavenTek". R.O.O.T. - A grid, unit, and signal based computing system. Move the units to create signal links, transmit the signals, and activate other units to generate benefits. Are the benefits generated all for the company, or...?
qop is a minimalistic puzzle which goal is to get the cube to finish using 4 directions in space.

titre: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tactical Takedown
description: Splinter et Shredder sont morts. À l'approche de l'âge adulte, aidez les Tortues Ninjas à affronter de nouveaux dangers mortels dans un beat'em all palpitant au tour par tour !

titre: The Adventures of Mr. Willickers the Rotting Mule
description: Mr. Willickers can never, ever die. He'll chase you until the very ends of the earth.
于1999年年初推出，同时也是《风色幻想》系列作的首部曲。当年以严谨深奥的故事设定以及较偏动漫风格的画风，在国内尚充斥着一遍武侠风游戏的时代里，出人意外的大放光采，同时也奠定了该系列作品往后的热销基础。当然其中描写的极为深刻的角色互动以及让人惊讶的剧情发展，直到现在亦还有论坛津津乐道的讨论着，可见其当年的人气以及受欢迎的程度。
studio: 弘煜科技事業股份有限公司

description: "Princess Maker" pioneered the raising simulation genre with its innovative "raising a daughter" system. The concept of taking in a 10-year-old girl and nurturing her into a mature woman through the player's love and care was groundbreaking at the time and remains popular today.
O Ninja está de volta! Desta vez a procura do Lendário Saco de Batatas Fritas Infinitas!!
Pickaxe ready? Coal, iron, gold & diamond! 18 Miners to unlock! Get chopping in this action packed, arcade style game.
Wildcat Gun Machine est un dungeon crawler tonitruant dans lequel vous devrez éliminer des hordes de monstres abjectes avec votre arsenal d'armes, de mechas et de gentils petits chatons.

Enquêtez sur une île abandonnée et son domaine hanté dans ce jeu d’horreur psychologique à la première personne. Récupérez votre matériel paranormal, ouvrez de nouvelles zones, suivez les indices et découvrez l’histoire d’une présence surnaturelle grandissante.

Your mind will short-circuit in this atmospheric pixel sci-fi puzzler with eight (8) levels of increasing difficulty. Decipher each binary sequence to travel further into the unknown, and unearth a deeper mystery that may never be fully understood.
Build the world as you move, fight monsters and defeat your friends.
The strange cups are hidden on the paper. A difficult adventure for the eyes.
The Twenty-Second : Stories of Underground Kharkiv est une quête et un roman visuel qui vous racontera à la première personne les événements de 2022 dans le métro de Kharkiv.

titre: Maze Of Realities: Fleur De Discorde Édition Collector
description: Plusieurs mondes mystérieux sont restés inexplorés par les humains jusqu'à ce qu'un détective se lance dans une nouvelle enquête sur la disparition d'un groupe d'explorateurs au Groenland.

Lancez votre dé, élaborez des stratégies et accumulez les améliorations pour remporter la victoire dans ce roguelike accessible, ultra-satisfaisant et captivant. Parviendrez-vous à atteindre la fin avant d'être à court de lancers ? CONTINUEZ À MULTIPLIER !

Affrontez les Quatre Cavaliers de l'Apocalypse dans d'épiques combats de cartes ! Cardaclysm: Éclats des Quatre est un jeu de cartes à collectionner à génération procédurale utilisant des éléments action-RPG. Collectionnez créatures et sorts et libérez leur puissance sur quiconque s'oppose à vous !

During lunch one day, Toomi Yuna meets two "Kindred Spirits" on the roof of her school. When they insist she help them nurture young love, Yuna finds herself playing "yuri cupid" to six unique and adorable couples. Can she remain aloof or will the promise of a "yuritopia" reach her too?
Death Ray Manta is an arcade game where you shoot lasers to kill bad guys, flash lights at yourself and move to the next screen to do it all over again. Sorry, no T-Rex.
Nekoview is a simple manga viewer
Jump Dash Soar is a frenetic, fast, and fun movement-based FPS. Build incredible speed with a powerful dash mechanic combined with rocket jumping, strafe running, slope jumps, and bounce pads!

“A dimly lit train cabin … swaying grassy plains … flickering fireflies … a mighty dragon.” Found is an interactive short film experience. Its story speaks to the connection and lack there of between nature, technology and fellow travelers as you make your way through a fantastical yet familiar world.

tanxy is a game where you can program. In tanxy you can write a JavaScript program to control any Unit on your behalf. Manual control is also possible. Your goal is to destroy all enemy Units and to keep yours.

titre: The Floor Is Still Really Cheap Lava
description: Small online multiplayer shooter with friends and customizable gamemodes. Loads of weapons to unlock. Storymode with a final boss; Try to travel as far as possible while avoiding the cheap lava!

Stream Racer is a racing game for Twitch.tv streamers. Build your own tracks, host your own races, stream it on Twitch.tv and have your viewers join you. Engage more with your viewers by giving them a racing car on your stream. Get ready for a hilariously chaotic time for your viewers and you!
The shadow of death hidden in the mansion... Survive from death by overcoming fear. What awaits you at the end of your adventure?

Diner Bros est un jeu frénétique de cuisine et de gestion de restaurant. Préparez et servez les plats le plus vite possible, mais ne vous trompez pas dans les commandes des clients ! Améliorez votre local et vos recettes, embauchez des serveurs ou regroupez jusqu'à 4 amis pour coopérer en local !

Trouvez 100 chats cachés en Italie dans ce joli jeu d’objets cachés dessiné à la main, créé par Travellin Cats – le créateur original du jeu viral de chats cachés ! Serez-vous capable de tous les trouver ?
Golden Treasure is a game for those who carry dragons in their hearts. Hunt, explore, survive, and become Great among the True Children of Sun and Earth.
Allumette tells a story about love, sacrifice and a deep bond between a young girl and her mother.

You like Sci-Fi games? You like FPS? You like games with secret items, collectables? You like short Indie games? Then you will love this game! The game takes place in a big mothership captured by aliens. Your mission is to kill all the aliens, and blow up the mothership.

titre: Find And Kill The Evil King
description: FIND AND KILL THE EVIL KING is a Roguelike designed to be simple, quick, and RNG-heavy. There's an evil king somewhere in this cursed dungeon. Can you find him? Can you kill him? And most importantly...what will you do once you do?

titre: 胡服騎射 Hufu riding and shooting
description: 《胡服騎射 Hufu riding and shooting》is a third-person control RPG Game.From far east mainland, Their are 7 lord in "Zhou" period.This is about 2,200 years ago. you lead your army to ride horses and shoot arrows to expand your land.

Shoot down triplanes and attack tanks with your Sopwith biplane. Simple World War One flight combat simulator with touch controls, airfoil physics, computer-controlled opponents, and destructible environments, inspired by David L. Clark's classic DOS game from 1984.

Super Mega Baseball™ 4 est le terrain de jeu des légendes. Le style arcade et immersif typique de la série est de retour, pour le plus grand plaisir de tous les fans qui pourront retrouver plus de 200 Légendes du baseball et une myriade d’améliorations cosmétiques.

Interstellar Logistics Inc. is an action puzzle game. The player shoots an object from Point A to Point B using the gravity of planets, stars, and black holes while hitting certain points along the way. There's a lot more to the game, but that is the basic idea.
La version améliorée de Memento Mori incluant la bande son intégrale.

titre: Prey with Gun 带枪的猎物
description: Under command of a young boy to complete his plan and dig out the hidden truth and his motivation. (The English Version of this game will release soon)

"Mimic Logic" is an automatically generated logic puzzle roguelike. Listen to the statements of the treasure chests, find the lying mimics, and open the rest of the treasure chests! Opening a mimic results in a game over.

Aim: Warmup is a game to assist your aim in games like Valorant, CS: GO, Quake, and Overwatch. This software has been tested, immediately after using the software a user was able to clutch pistol round in Valorant with excellent accuracy and headshots.

Nyheim is a single-player digital boardgame about rebuilding the titular city of Nyheim after a lethal pandemic. As survivors of the disease, your party must explore the districts of Nyheim, face mutated rats, gather supplies and lead the efforts towards a new society!

L'ESPACE APPARTIENT À TOUS. Dans Next Space Rebels, incarnez un naïf amateur de fuséologie devenant un incroyable activiste spatial qui conçoit, construit et lance des fusées d'une complexité croissante.
Guidez la jeune mécanicienne Mo dans sa quête pour réparer un monde au bord du déclin. Explorez d'étranges îles et leurs labyrinthes.

Le sort du monde libre est entre vos mains dans ce MMO de stratégie où vous devrez vous battre pour conquérir les États-Unis. Reprenez Washington, D.C. aux mains d'un gouvernement renégat, rétablissez l'ordre et reconstruisez la nouvelle Amérique !
Star Merchant is a galactic trading sim where you become a space entrepreneur. Buy and sell items, fight pirates, upgrade your ship and try to meet your goal without going broke!

Inertial Drift vous propulse dans une uchronie inspirée des années 90, à la fois futuriste et rétro, dans laquelle vous devrez piloter des véhicules de manière unique et dévastatrice pour exécuter des drifts exaltants grâce à une transmission à deux leviers de vitesse.

La ligne de séparation entre le bien et le mal n'est plus aussi nette qu'auparavant et les rues ne sont plus sûres. Les allées, les toits, les égouts sont contrôlés par les gangs et les criminels. De plus, Underboss s'est échappé de prison et répand la terreur et le chaos.
MARY - is an adventure shooter with surviving elements where you will survive in zombie apocalypse playing as a girl named Jane.

Maia is a colony building game set in the not-so-distant future. Your colonists make planetfall on a hostile world and you must ensure their survival and their safety, constructing their off-world habitat from almost nothing and sheltering them from a dangerous, often deadly environment.
Dois clássicos do RPG Maker que conquistaram os brasileiros a uma década atrás, agora reunidos em uma única compilação na Steam!
A round based zombie killing experience. Each wave will be harder than the last; with bosses showing up at possibly the worst of times. Good luck you will need it.
Create and control the business empire of your dreams. This in-depth strategy game covers almost every aspect of business that could be encountered in the real world.
Explore a vast world, create your own sky island, the island gives the girl the power. An open world-action RPG that you create more and more and become stronger and stronger.

Inside the art - Oubey Samurai In this VR you’re in a tight space surrounded by the deep red of the painting. Discover “the picture behind the picture” whilst also leaving your own tracks in the painting.

titre: Children of the Nile: Enhanced Edition
description: Children of the Nile™ est un jeu de simulation de construction urbaine.En tant que Pharaon amenez votre peuple à bâtir une civilisation immortelle.Chaque habitant est un individu unique provenant d'une famille spécifique. Prêtres, scribes, paysans et famille royale auront besoin d'être nourris.
Latona Research Station has been destroyed by unknown assailants. The only survivor is a young girl who was rescued by the Starship Quicksilver and her renowned captain.

Adventure Craft is a procedurally generated open-world PvE survival crafting action RPG. Explore, gather resources, hunt monsters, craft weapons and armour, build a home, train companions, and survive a dangerous world that changes from day to night.

GUN GODZ is a first person shooter about gun, gangster rap and the rich culture of Venus. Featuring a fully Venusian soundtrack by Jukio 'KOZILEK' Kallio and a single English track with rap lyrics by Adam 'Doseone' Kidd.

Godsworn is a classic RTS with single-player & co-op focus. Experience an epic fantasy retelling of the Baltic Crusades set in a world inspired by pagan mythology. Choose a divine hero, rally worshippers alongside mythical creatures, and smite the unworthy!
Includes original Blood II: The Chosen and add-on package The Nightmare LevelsAn immersive atmosphere full of dark humor and exciting actionFour playable characters and wide variety of weapons

Xentron Attack is a multi-directional shooter. The evil alien forces called Xentron have invaded your galaxy and spreading dangerous meteors and missiles in the space. Fight with smart enemies who calculates your movements. Turn your ship precisely and use the borderless space wisely.
Визуальная новелла по мотивам мистической книги Н. Гоголя

Find over 70 unique monsters to battle, collect and raise. Your monsters will go through a branching path of evolutions to help you explore a dream-like open world. Let your dreams become a reality or look for a way out.

Développé par deux personnes, Horace offre 15 heures de jeu de plates-formes captivant avec une narration émouvante et des références de culture populaire qui donneront un sourire nostalgique. Un jeu créé par et pour les passionnés de jeux vidéo !

Help the kingdom of Kish conquer all of ancient Mesopotamia in this historical realtime strategy game. Fight all other empires in the region to earn the ancient title of Lugal Kiški: King of the Universe.

Space fight arena is a retro arcade based arena shooter game that was modeled after legendary arcade games. This game retains the fun, addicting aspects of those arcade games while also adding on new, awesome features such as challenges, skins, and a world wide leaderboard.
The ultimate kart racing game with deep customization, realistic physics, and a variety of game modes. Build, tune, and race your way to victory!
