An indie psychological horror experience about surviving infinity. Navigate an endless expanse of rooms, ascend through various levels, gather items and artifacts, avoid going insane, evade corrupted entities, and see just how deep the realm known as The Backrooms goes.

Cartes de l'Egypte Ancienne. Le puissance, la richesse, la foi et la vie. Travaillez votre chemin à partir d'une petite tribu vers un empire florissant. Gagner la faveur des dieux et devenez le plus grand pharaon.
Lilly's Rescue is a Action RPG game, play it your way, improve your skills throughout the game and find your kitten and bring him home.

WARNING: This game requires you to think for yourself! Ziode Shadow is a 2D platform/puzzle game about a hungover planet explorer, and his unwanted bot companion. He must utilize many different objects, and manipulate his surroundings, enabling both him, and his support pod to navigate the terrain.
Detective visual novel about mysteries of rural Russian town in 90-s, anime style.

titre: Psychonauts in the Rhombus of Ruin
description: Psychonauts in the Rhombus of Ruin est une toute nouvelle aventure en réalité virtuelle qui vous permet de retourner dans le monde mystérieux et paranormal des psychonautes pour la première fois depuis plus de dix ans !

titre: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Call of Prypiat - Enhanced Edition
description: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Call of Prypiat retrace l’histoire d’un agent des services spéciaux, le major Degtyarev, alors qu’il enquête sur la disparition d’une expédition.

Centuries have passed since the events of RefleX and mankind has once again attained civilization. Now, ancient technology born of a twisted mind sets in motion a chain of events designed to bring divine retribution down upon mankind.

Mirlo's home has been destroyed, all the forest Beasts are being kidnapped and exploited for their energy. Join her to save her home and her forest friends in a hack & slash adventure. Use Mirlo's attack to push and defeat enemies, jump to avoid hazards, and save all the Beasts.

It is the year 1988. Japan is in the midst of the bubble economy. New buildings are sprouting up everywhere, and the people are ecstatic. This is a story of people who live for one year... in such a little corner of the city.

A rabbit's house is being attacked by reptile menaces from another dimension. With advanced portal technology, they can achieve conquest of the entire planet! In retaliation, the rabbit has decided to gather carrots to exchange for weapons which may allow him to fend off this threat.

L'histoire de Twin Sector se déroule dans un univers post-apocalyptique où les restes de l'humanité ont été placés en hibernation sous la surface polluée de la terre en attendant des jours meilleurs. Vous êtes Ashley Simms, le héros de Twin Sector. Soudainement réveillé par l'intelligence artificielle de la base, O.S.C.A.R.

In a world where most puzzle games are the same, head into outer space to find something new and exciting! Before the descending bricks crush your dreams (and your space ship), use your powerful magnet to move and match same-colored bricks.
Blonde Driver is parking simulator. You need to park your car with minimal hits.

Beyond Citadel is an anime style retro throwback shooter inspired by the classics of the 90's, with realistic gunplay mechanics, anime violence and fast paced combat. Fight your way through the heavily armed mechanical fortress and discover the secret that lies beneath.
A single-developer passion project. A seamless full scale solar system. Thrilling action. Be part of an incredible journey as a Universe is built from the ground up!

Lorsque Quinn se réveille dans une pièce verrouillée avec pour seule compagnie un ordinateur connecté au même salon de discussion en ligne que vous, vous devenez sa seule lueur d’espoir. Vos choix (et votre rapidité) seront son seul moyen de s'échapper... ou de le mener à une fin prématurée.

eXceed 3rd relance l'histoire d'eXceed, l'emmenant dans une nouvelle direction. Dans cet épisode, Rayne Lindwurm, une descendante du Clan Dragon, participe à un tournoi afin de devenir l'un des 7 Cardinaux Seigneurs qui dirigent son monde, Pandemonium.

Darkestville Castle est un jeu d’aventure point-and-click à l’humour noir dans lequel vous incarnez un démon sarcastique. Résolvez des énigmes ingénieuses, manipulez des idiots et ramenez le chaos à Darkestville, car être méchant est bien plus amusant.
Mettez le feu à vos affaires dans les puzzles d'une superbe île en voxel art.
Stardock's classic 2001 real-time economic strategy game, available now on Steam. Dive back into the timeless battle for one of the most ruthless environments ever created: international trade.
Haro works in a cosmetic hospital. He left his job after problems with a nurse. His life changed a lot after that. He meets more beautiful girls. Who will be the most important girl in his life?

Sergeant, last night we received a signal that an unknown aircraft of extraterrestrial origin had crashed in the taiga. The locals assured us that at the crash site they observed five creatures very similar to humans, only with gray skin and large almond-shaped eyes.
Racquetball meets Breakout inside a giant pinball machine! Racket: Nx is a new kind of game that challenges the limits of what you can do with a racket and ball in VR.

Many inhabitants wishing to get the tribute came back to the city. Only the time will show whether the main character will find the riches or he is fated to decorate one of the undercroft corners with his skeleton.
Emmène les joueurs en territoire inconnu, les faisant utiliser des contrôles de type NES pour se frayer un chemin à travers un barrage de Beats dans ce jeu d'aventure rythmique musical.
C'est une triste histoire qui pourrait arriver à chacun d'entre nous.
A retro action martial arts game inspired by classics, like Kung Fu Master and Shinobi with modern elements!

False Shelter is a survival adventure game in which the player takes the role of the young Gaspare Emidio, whose employer suddenly fell ill, and who now has to survive in the wilderness with people whom he doesn't know or trust.
SCP: CONTROL ERROR est un jeu d’horreur psychologique court, où vous participez à une expérience en direct dans une installation souterraine restreinte. Le test commence. On vous observe.
3D metroidvania game Evil Genome is coming! Heroine Lachesis will lead you to explore the vast wasteland world, experience different battles as well as develop your own character!

Aqua Kitty is a fast paced retro styled submarine arcade shooter with optional 2 player local Co-op.Blast through hordes of mechanical sea monsters in your kitty sub and defend the deep sea milk mining kittens!THE MILK MUST FLOW!

Attention, pirates en vue ! Les redoutables filles pirates de l'île du Crâne n'ont pas encore vu toute l'étendue de votre habileté, Capitaine. Pouvez-vous les conquérir une par une avec vos ❤compétences de combat❤ et piller ce trésor précieux sur votre navire ?

Ready for a huge adventure? Welcome to the magical world of Asguaard, and delve into an RPG that can span over 100 hours! Dwarves in the cold region of Roya believe that only a human with a soul can overcome the dreaded Thanatos and its Pandora Box... are you this one?
1Quest is a roguelike, a challenging turn based RPG with high replay value

Frontier Fortress is medieval-themed tower defense game. You are the leader of your nation. In the harsh medieval age you have to defend your land against foreign invaders. Fortify your frontier with defense structures and let none of them pass through your fortress.
Cosmic Tank is a modern take on the classic game Asteroids. Mine your way to riches! Fight off hostile threats! Upgrade your ship and rent a few helpful drones! Survive epic boss fights!

Journey through dungeons and dangers – grow in power as you fight tooth n’ claw to your last flaming breath through 40 procedurally generated levels! Harness the power of Rune Magic to decimate your foes, and take to the air to evade enemies and launch devastating aerial attacks!

Prisonnier dans la zone 51 sur Terre, vous devez résoudre des puzzles calculés pour vous échapper de cette étrange planète. Les puzzles consistent à prenre avantage des comportements des ennemis, déplacer des objets pour bloquer les ennemis, et utiliser des objets qui altèrent les niveaux.
DOOMED is a First Person Shooter with horror elements, heavily inspired by old-school shooter classics.

Experience the excitement of being part of an elite hacking group in this challenging turn-based tactics game. Hack more than 50 servers by exploiting their bugs and making them crash. Live a thrilling hacking story based on chat logs from real hackers.
Build a pirate empire & explore the open seas in this exciting strategy game!
《雪境迷途遇仙踪》是由日本知名美少女游戏品牌 Lump of Sugar 制作的奇幻恋爱作品。本作由知名画师萌木原文武（代表作《游魂》系列）担当游戏原画与角色设计，由多位业内资深写手共同创作剧本，由知名音乐人新井健史担当音乐制作，主题歌由方糖社当家歌姬Kicco与新锐创作型歌手逢濑晶联袂献唱。

Welcome to Hero! A simple 3rd person fantasy action adventure game created by Bakershah Games. The game is meant to be an homage to all the classical action adventure games from the 90's. It is a simplistic adventure game. Give it a try!
Protolife is an unique tower-based strategy game which gives you a direct control over the builder robot in a struggle against the hungry proto-life organism.
Take Thy Throne's main gamemode consists of taking down towers and barricades to make your way towards the enemy team's King.
Be amazed by the best interactive VR movies and more, only on AmazeVR.

titre: Asterix & Obelix XXL 3  - The Crystal Menhir
description: Plongez dans l’univers d’Astérix et embarquez dans une trépidante aventure ! Seul ou en coopération, parcourez les terres de l’empire romain et percez le mystère du Menhir de Cristal et de ses incroyables pouvoirs !
Ein klassisches Rollenspiel, reduziert auf den Zauber des alten Genres: Wortgewaltige Sprache. Fordernde Kämpfe. Drei, die einen Drachen töten – und was sie dazu führen mag. [German language only]
This is a classic tetris game from a different angle. You see the playing field from above and the pieces fall down from you.

QANGA : 750 ans après la chute de l’humanité, survivez dans un monde brisé où la Terre elle-même réclame vengeance. Déchirez le tissu de l’espace pour affronter le Voss, réveillez l'ancienne civilisation, osez défier les Sanglines, nées des entrailles d’un monde qui vous a déjà condamné.
An Economic Adventure awaits! Play this story-driven RPG game to learn new economic skills, make allies, and hopefully not get eaten by bears or lava monsters. Can you survive the Island?

This is an adventure ARPG with great sense of blow.You can collection of stones,wood and straw etc to make the props or equipment you need.You can also take care of the plants of the camp to get food.Maybe you can go fishing quietly,just forget the whole world...Give full play to you!

Quand la fantasy médiévale rencontre le dodgeball.Strikers Edge est un jeu de baston dans lequel d'anciens guerriers s'affrontent à distance. Envoyez lances et dagues dans la tête de vos adversaires, combattez en multijoueur local, atteignez le sommet du classement et devenez le meilleur Striker !

Nazi Labs is a twin-stick top-down action rogue-like game with a random level generator and cumulative power- ups, art and sprites based on the golden age of arcade games with many references to all sci- fi / nerd-universe, classic arcade games with dark theme focused on Nazi secrets and legends.
the office simulation is a first person interactive story driven game. Play as Tim when you wake up in the same office building everyday... but this time something is amok.

Become an Exorcist! Defend your city from evil demons by using cute towers designed as shrine maidens. Fight hordes of demons using powerful Alliances and strategize your way towards victory. Upgrade your defense after each map until you'll be able to face the root of all evil!

Un Roguelite où tu dégommes des monstres sans fin, et adieu l'exploration barbante ! Prépare-toi à des ennemis exotiques et des étapes déjantées, avec un arsenal d'armes et d'items, plus une flopée de fonctions inutiles et détails absurdes. (COMPATIBLE AVEC MANETTE)

You are the last man alive on the planet. Meet and UNDRESS BEAUTIFUL GIRLS to save humanity. Find that special spot to make women AHEGAO. Master your lover skills and ladies will adore you. But be careful where you touch - You might end up with a broken heart, handsome! ♥♥♥
Join the strange misadventures of Robert, the stoic warrior, Ben, the buff, aggressive but friendly sailor, and Lorien, the hot-headed mage girl with reckless behaviour and acute pyromania.

Découvre Uptasia! Fonde ta propre ville au XIXème siècle avec de supers usines de production et entreprises. Viens à bout d‘énigmes d‘objets cachés et de défis. Montre ta capacité de réaction et de stratégie. Télécharge maintenant Uptasia!
Arosia is the Tile Map game based on Strategy and Luck. Use your strategy skills with best of luck to occupy World! Don't stop untill the World is yours.
Muffin Knight is an arena based action-packed platformer with stunning visuals and a myriad of fairytale characters, each with their own unique abilities, which gain strength as you advance.

titre: Chuhou Joutai 3: Three Nights of Scarlet Abscess
description: Pandemonium will break loose if you don't unleash your rage.

A role-playing nonlinear game. 1. Tomb Robbing: Obtain Skeletons and Skeleton Armor. 2. Summon: resurrect bones. 3. Battle: PK between players' skeletons. 4. Market: free trading skeleton. 5. Occupy: occupy the altar of soul power, absorb soul power alone, and upgrade bones.

Create a stunning slideshow from your photos and video clips. Burn to DVD, Blu-ray or as a video file for sharing online or to watch on your favourite device. Simply add your photos, video clips and music to the PhotoVidShow editor. Tweak and customise and then author your video slideshow masterpiece.

Use the elements of the scenery, such as picks and many others to drill the soil to the indicated location. Destructive terrain, fluid mechanics and the laws of physics must be handled correctly to solve the puzzles. Escape the city of Underland!
Space shootouts and fascinating stories.
Les légendaires space shooters arcade R-Type et R-Type II sont maintenant réunis sur Steam !
有些人死了，但没完全死，知道了结局但却未发现真相。 一个人也能玩的海龟汤推理故事。 海龟汤故事通常包含一个极不合理的结果，但不知道其中的过程，您可以自行猜测发生了什么，并提出问题，主持人只会用【是】【否】【无关】来回答你——本该如此，不过她似乎会破例给你些提示，但显然你很高冷，并不为之所动。
Time your jumps from planet to planet, avoid the obstacles thrown in your path and blast off to safety with your rocketship!
Wooden Floor is a first person horror game full of visual trickery ... Not being able to predict what is going to happen next you need to make your way through the haunted house.
CHAOS;HEAD NOAH is now available on Steam!

ATTENTION : Ce jeu contient des calembours, des blagues nazes, des mini-jeux d'arcade dignes de Flappy Bird, brise le 4e mur et égratigne les RPG qui se la pètent. Évitez-le si vous détestez le FUN ou si participer à la quête désopilante de L'Artéfact Légendaire Tueur de Méchant™ ne vous dit rien.

Whether you specialise in grain, fruits or even maintaining your own dairy farm, in Farming World you have the ultimate choice on how you shape your business. With dozens of seed types to choose from and an extensive stock market listing, you’ll have to adapt to become profitable.
The first of its kind, "Pago's Forest" is an educational game: you improve your grammar through the discovery of a heroic fantasy tale.

Fracas is a dungeon crawler that evokes a retro RPG experience and a complex story. In its short duration, it seeks to keep you intrigued as you solve the mystery behind this enigmatic character that has society on the brink of collapse.
Banyu Lintar Angin is a series of experimental illustrations about three siblings, living together independently in a rural Indonesian environment.
A dangerous journey into the ruins of an ancient city await our hero. Help him find the treasure in Gems of the Aztecs!

Tinkr Garage is a Massive Multiplayer Vehicular Sandbox! Customize your own vehicle, race with your friends, roam the landscape, battle against teams and even battle against the hazards of the environment.

《Song of Feathers》 is a deeply immersive post apocalyptic survival adventure game. In this world shrouded in the shadow of the apocalypse, Players will play as the last human in this desperate land, searching for the meaning of survival and the opportunity to rebuild civilization.

Dans ce second opus, « The Dark Lineage », vous incarnez une nouvelle fois l'inspecteur Howard Loreid, un homme tourmenté par les phénomènes paranormaux qui se déroulent autour de lui dans le premier volume « À la poursuite de Loath Nolder ».

titre: 王子斗恶龙(The prince fights the Dragon)
description: s mouvements, des mantras, des armes, et ce jeu vous apportera le bonheur. J'ai fait référence à l'essence de tous les grands jeux, réunis dans ce jeu, jouer étrange, brosser de l'argent, intrigue, riche vision du monde, tout peut vous satisfaire. C'est le premier jeu que j'ai fait avec mon cœur.
The Rail Adventures VR Tech Demo is a free product, showcasing the upcoming action game Rail Adventures.
Plongez dans le monde chaotique de Borderlands en enfilant les bottes d'un chasseur de l'Arche en quête de trésors, trouvez 87 trilliards de flingues, et libérez Pandore du joug du Beau Jack !
Ghost In The Barn House is a 2D Survival Horror game based on the story of an old Haunted barn which was built in the 1800s in Texas.

ICBM est un jeu de stratégie de destruction nucléaire en temps réel. Recherchez de nouvelles technologies, constituez votre réserve nucléaire et utilisez une combinaison de navires, d'avions et de missiles pour frapper au cœur des villes de vos adversaires.

Tales of Graces™f est de retour dans une version plus somptueuse et facile à jouer que jamais ! Elle inclut Lignée & Héritage, un épilogue au scénario principal ! La lame étincelante ouvre de nouveau un chemin vers le futur...

Words for Evil is a fast paced word game combined with a fantasy RPG. It features everything you expect from an RPG, including combat, hero progression, loot and more, all built on top of word game mechanics.

Oraxum Trials is an incremental game where you conduct experiments with the Oraxum, a hexagonal board with magical properties. Harvest souls and use mystical crystals to create wild concoctions. Take on the mantle of soul alchemist and forge your fate, choosing between light and dark forces.
All the pleasure from the 90's Action RPGs put into a quirky infinite procedural dungeon. Explore, find treasures, loot and clear hallways from enemies within.

IS Defense is a game set in politically-fictional 2020 – where the expansion of ISIS went out of hand. The player takes the role of NATO’s heroic machine-gun operator, deployed to defend the shores of Europe.

Un jeu de survie redoutable dans un univers épique de science-fiction, où vous échouerez sur une planète hostile qui veut votre mort ! Avez-vous ce qu'il faut pour survivre seul, ou pour prospérer avec vos amis et sauver une espèce entière de l'anéantissement?
Deity Empires is a 4X, turn-based strategy game with a powerful “just one more turn” feel! Enter an intricate fantasy world as one of many deities posed to become ruler of the world.

Last Tide est un battle royale sous-marin. Affrontez des féroces mégalodons ! Lancez une grenappât sur vos ennemis pour que les requins les attaquent ! Utilisez de l'équipement aquatique unique, grimpez dans les classements et découvrez la liberté des déplacements sous-marin !

Dans Blacklight: Tango Down, expérimentez la fine fleure des progrès guerriers. Participez à la “netwar” : un champ de bataille hyper-réaliste qui vous permet de lutter dans les conflits de demain avec ou contre vos amis dans l'univers de Blacklight.

Play as Leonnor who sets out on a journey to discover everything about his past and his world, things are not always what they seem! Learn special abilities, battle monsters and encounter celestial beings as you explore this beautifically crafted pixel world. This prologue starts a epic journey...

VOUS AVEZ LA BANANE ? Dans ce jeu de plateformes en réalité virtuelle, incarnez un singe acrobate, balancez-vous et projetez-vous librement dans ces vastes aires de jeu. Votre agilité, votre sens du timing et vos compétences en réalité virtuelle vont être mis à l’épreuve !

"Trapped in a cocoon, the silkworm weaves her final dream." Hollow Cocoon is a first-person horror adventure game set in 1980s Japan. Immerse yourself in meticulously recreated environments as you venture into the depths of unspeakable horrors that await you.

This is a FREE FPS Sci-Fi game. Currently 3 levels for playing, each level has different monsters. In the further each level will has a boss-like monster, it will focus on the boss battle. Hope you enjoy it!

As an employee of a mysterious organization your job is to monitor live surveillance camera footage and spot anomalies using your sharp eyes and good memory. Can you survive the entire night shift or will you succumb into paranoia?

Une "petite" simulation d'univers où vous incarnez un trou noir et essayez d'absorber l'univers entier. Ils déterminent la taille et la forme de l'univers. Peut également être utilisé comme référence CPU moins significative.
Maîtrisez des cascades toujours plus complexes, battez les meilleurs temps et montrez vos talents de cascadeur dans Jet Car Stunts.

This is a click&decrypt game. You need dive into the dark dreams of fairy tales, observe the scenes and help the fairy tale princess to escape their difficulties. but sometimes you need to make a little trouble to satisfy your evil desires and start a sweet and dark interaction with the princess.

Club Soccer Director 2021 est un nouveau jeu de gestion de club de football ultra réaliste vous permettant de prendre les rênes d'un club de football existant ou de créer votre propre club et d’entrer dans l’histoire.
You are a Delivery Agent. Your goal is to deliver packages save & sound to our bases, taking care of our people's needs. Dont' worry, you'll be awarded accordingly.
Fight in 3-tiered battles, devour your enemies, and customize your characters in this epic RPG to end the dragon's curse!

Stuck in the Underworld without the slightest clue why, a young fiend has a bit of a mystery to solve in this action/adventure platformer. With a world to explore, a past to uncover, and quite the task to complete, players must embark on a quest filled with monsters, towns, dungeons, bosses, and various platforming challenges.

Essayez-vous à la simulation de réparation de vaisseaux spatiaux ! Réveillez-vous, pointez, réparez des vaisseaux, faites-vous des amis et des ennemis, payez votre loyer, améliorez votre L.O.Y.E.R., réfléchissez à la futilité de l'existence, allez vous coucher... et recommencez.

Take you easy to make a two-dimensional beauty girl, the mode is easy and interesting, from line drawing to coloring, the whole painting process experience, you don't need painting experience to make your wife live~

Hirilun est un jeu de plateformes à la première personne basé sur le contre-la-montre dans lequel tu vas explorer une ville sombre et étrange. Cours, saute, plane, sprinte et accélère pour réaliser le meilleur temps possible, et rivalise avec tes amis dans les classements mondiaux.
HyperDot is a minimal action arcade masterpiece with one rule: dodge everything. A game by Charles McGregor.
A whole new side to the Ashes of Immortality saga! Defeat your enemies and complete sidequests in this compelling 16-bit saga inspired by Final Fantasy and Dragon Quest.
疑案追声粉丝自制，为爱发电，一样的声音推理游戏 在《疑案追了声》中，你将扮演一名拥有特殊能力的侦探，通过收集、分析和解读案发现场的回声，还原案件的真相。每个案件都有其独特的故事背景和情节，你需要仔细聆听角色的对话，观察现场的细节，寻找线索，逐步揭示案件的真相。

Things are not what they seem at your new tech support specialist job. While resolving customer issues, you soon find yourself in the middle of a conspiracy. Will you side with your employer, join a rogue hacktivist group bent on destroying them, assist the police or stand alone?
Star Viking Forever est un puzzle/RPG bourré d'humour développé par les créateurs primés de Chroma Squad, Dungeonland et Relic Hunters Zero.

CONSTRUISEZ et GÉREZ votre propre parcours de golf futuriste. Soyez aux petits soins avec 200 visiteurs uniques. Combattez l'infestation de ronces à l'aide de drones automatisés et tourelles laser. Progressez pour faire de votre parcours un méga complexe duquel personne ne voudra jamais partir !

En tant que membre de la Delta Force — l'unité d'élite secrète des forces spéciales — le mot 'impossible' ne fait pas partie de votre vocabulaire. Dans Delta Force, vous allez conduire des missions en silence sur tous les terrains du globe dans toutes les conditions possibles.
Avadon: The Black Fortress est une épique saga de Jeu de Rôle Fantasy indépendante.
A VR sci-fi sandbox game where you can put your skills to the test to build crazy inventions, with mechanics analogous to real-life electrical engineering.
Jouez aux jeux Steam @ jeux 10.000+ Mo / s :: Charger instantanément avec le logiciel Dimmdrive. Dimmdrive intègre pleinement avec tous les jeux Steam.

A relentless top-down single-player arcade stealth-shooter where you play as contract killer T.J. Trench, seeking to buy your way out of Metro City, the cyberpunk dystopia where everyone wants you dead.
Meet the completely reworked legendary game loved by millions of players worldwide! Alien Shooter 2 - the Legend is an ambitious follow-up to the famous Alien Shooter series.
Powerful Realtime 3D Electronic Circuit Simulator

Bienvenue sur Gamearth, une planète autrefois paisible, mais aujourd'hui menacée par les guerriers de l'espace de Nexgen. À la suite de leur première attaque dévastatrice, un enfant du nom de Rise se retrouve avec le pistolet sacré Shine entre les mains, et avec lui, le sort du monde.

A cartoony mix of peaceful fishing and chaotic bullet hell action, with dozens of fish to collect and over twenty planets to discover! Explore a densely packed galaxy filled to the brim with charming characters and alien landscapes, and work your way toward uncovering SUPER ICK's dark truth.
Last Train Outta' Wormtown est un jeu multijoueur asymétrique et chaotique qui oppose des cowboys et un lombric, lequel ne détecte que les cowboys qui touchent le sable.

Eternal Space is a city builder and space exploration/combat game. Explore the Eternal Space, and manage your city while you fight pirates, or maybe even become a pirate! Keep your citizens happy, and collect taxes from them each year for a little bonus!

Une adorable aventure arachnéenne ! Balancez-vous dans toute la maison, tissez des structures déjantées, amusez-vous avec les lois de la physique et accomplissez vos tâches domestiques avec votre imagination et votre toile pour seules limites dans cette aventure bac à sable hilarante.

Plongez dans un mélange de dark fantasy unique entre jeu de stratégie au tour par tour et RPG narratif. Incarnez Gaius Julius Mento, un habile tribun romain, et menez-le dans sa quête à travers le royaume d'Avalon.

Winnie the Pooh The Video Game is based on the movie of the same name. Following the same story as the movie, Winnie the Pooh is an interactive story book focused on delivering action-driven storytelling and incorporating educational content for children.
Step into the Polydome, a musical environment that changes and progresses when you interact with it.
Turn based, party focused, elemental world, short story RPG.

Strap it on and lock 'n' load in Grass Simulator, where you will Shoot, Loot and MOO! your way through multiple game modes revolved around...GRASS! Grass Simulator will revolutionize the way you look at grass.

This is a spoof plot puzzle game. Click the dialogue to advance the plot. There are many puzzle-solving levels in the game. You can find props by exploring and solve puzzles according to the game prompts
Trouvez la cause de la Brume Rouge qui se répand de nouveau à Gensokyo !

A Tale of Two Kingdoms is a graphical adventure in the style of the classic Sierra games. Set in the world of Celtic mythology and fairy tales, it features many sidequests and alternate endings, and a cast of fairies, a hungry giant, and an evil sorcerer stalking you...

The sequel to the award winning adventure hit Secret Files Tunguska. Famine in Africa, floods in Southeast Asia, economic crisis in Europe, and civil wars in South America, the world is on the brink of disaster.
PewDiePie: La Légende du Brofist. Accompagnez vos YouTubers préférés dans cette aventure épique! Accompagnez vos YouTubers préférés dans PewDiePie: La Légende du Brofist.

Run for President of the United States as one of dozens of past or present presidential candidates or create your own ideal candidate. Give speeches, go on talk shows, hire unsavory operatives, and do whatever it takes to win on election day.

StarDrive 2 représente une nouvelle étape révolutionnaire dans l’histoire de la franchise StarDrive. Dans cette suite tant attendue, les mécaniques principales ont évolué pour incorporer une couche de stratégie au tour par tour, et ce, par l'intermédiaire de batailles spectaculaires en temps réel.
Jeu de survie et d'action inspiré de faits réels, Atomfall se déroule cinq ans après la catastrophe nucléaire de Windscale, dans le nord de l'Angleterre.

Well, we crash-landed that UFO in the desert and Bubba says he wants to go home. Heck, I don't blame him 'cause there ain't no place like Hickston. But according to my map, we're gonna have to blast our way through jack o' lope farms and a riverboat as well as a brothel 'fore we get home again.
Sakura est une aventurière novice, elle a pourchassé Goblin dans les profondeurs. 1500 réalisations + 13 belles filles CG + intrigue + puzzle.

Gods decide to bring the flood of water upon the earth. Salvage what you think is valuable and bring it back to base. It's a psychological test of the apocalypse, also an interactive experiment about trade-offs.
Rechargez pour plus d'action avec GundeadliGne, le second titre la collection Gundemonium

We all know we love snakes, right? Even if you afraid of snakes, u was in love by playing Snake game on your mobile phones while you was young. There was no sensor screen by the way, and all the buttons u press was manually pressed. And it was like playing piano - incredible!

Lost But Found est une combinaison d’un simulateur de métier et d’un jeu de recherche d’objets cachés. Dans une vue de dessus, vous êtes un agent qui supervise les objets perdus dans un aéroport. Organisez ces objets et distribuez-les aux personnes ayant perdu leurs biens.

Dans Marvel: Ultimate Alliance, les joueurs créeront leur équipe ultime en choisissant parmi la plus grande alliance de super-héros, pour s'engager dans une quête qui déterminera le destin de l'univers Marvel.
Ultraviolent, fast-paced, merciless retro FPS action. Slaughter your way through nightmarish industrial mazes, transformed cityscapes, and surreal alien structures to cut down the Growth.

Bâtissez et agrandissez votre monastère, élaborez des recettes et brassez des bières sacrées dans cette simulation de brasserie unique en son genre ! Mais point de recettes toutes faites sur ce terrain de jeu pour véritables alchimistes de la bière. Bienvenue dans Ale Abbey !

Le jeu de gestion le plus fou, le plus blasphématoire et le plus diabolique jamais créé. Aidée par une bonne sœur lascive dans une sombre prison, truquez des exécutions, menez d'ignobles expériences et commettez des actes épouvantables pour élaborer votre remède universel : Le remède de Kindeman.

Labyrinth of the Demon King est un dungeon crawler à la première personne, qui se déroule dans un Japon féodal mythique en proie aux forces démoniaques. Fantassin solitaire et vengeur, vous suivez la piste du roi démon qui a tué votre maître.

Shatter Keep is an asymmetrical multiplayer game where 3 survivor players try to escape the castle and 1 player attempts to eliminate them. Survivors must complete a list of objectives to open the castle exits while arming traps, lighting torches and avoiding the monster before the timer expires.

The Combined Arms Operations Series simulates hypothetical battles between World War II armies. Assemble your forces, out plan, and outfight your enemies to master the art of combined arms warfare in chaotic simultaneous turns where commanders must adapt quickly to an evolving battlefield.

Lancer les dés dans un monde mystique à explorer, plein d'aventures et d'énigmes à résoudre. Voodoo Dice est un jeu de réflexion novateur bourré de défis qui vous taquine les méninges avec des énigmes palpitantes et uniques en leur genre. Partez à l'assaut de l'univers de Voodoo.

Explore the west through the eyes of a writer and confront different civilians, outlaws and criminals with the hope that your conversation skills can make up for your complete lack of combat knowledge in this narratively driven adventure.

Gal-X-E aims to revive the old-school shoot em up genre, and adds modern elements to it! Fight your way through endless waves of randomly generated madness! Collect spaceships and show the enemy who's boss!
Anarcute est le plus mignon des jeux d’émeute, avec un style visuel trop choupi et un gameplay de Beat’em all-foule unique!

Live the Life is the first person life simulation game focused on the deep player's interaction with the environment. Design your apartment using advanced building features, visit stores to buy furniture, food and clothing you like, and more completely free content coming soon

Tourists Kidnapped a Little Bear is a retro 8 bit game with cute five-color-arts, fx-sounds and represents a story of a brave mama bear.Mama bear need's to find and rescue her beloved little bear who was kidnapped by tourists.

titre: 不恋爱就完蛋了Love Curse: Find Your Soulmate
description: Love Curse is a GL visual novel. You’ve fallen under a curse, and the only way to break it is to find your soulmate! The clock is ticking… Will you find true love? And what secrets will you uncover along the way?
Older Neptune and friends shoot and slash through enemies of Gamindustri in this rail shooter!

Entrez dans le monde fumé et séduisant de The Angels Den, un luxueux club burlesque. Entrez dans les talons hauts de Holly, une danseuse talentueuse honorée d'un cadeau unique de télépathie. Aidez-la à une mission désespérée pour sauver un ami de certains malheur.

Alien Age is a chaotic merging single player game. As an alien, you combine and deliver a variety of resources before hopeful towns crumble to dust. Prime your engine and shine your saucer, towns are eager to see what the future holds… and they won't wait forever.

Terrordrome Reign Of The Legends is an indie fighting game set in a world where characters from horror literature, urban legends, cryptids, mythology exist within our modern world. This spiritual successor to Terrordrome Rise of the Boogeymen will be the perfect fighting game for all fans of horror.

Toonstruck combines live action, cell animation, and an all star cast: Christopher Lloyd, Ben Stein, Dan Castellaneta, Tim Curry, and Dom DeLuise, for a not-to-be-missed adventure through a zany cartoon world on the brink of total Malevalation!
A bullet hell with its own set of mechanics and unique bosses. Gameplay oriented and retro themed. Complete with spine-tingling music.
GOLD'S DUNGEON is a modern text-based roguelike with RPG elements. Venture through a randomly generated dungeon while building a new character each run! Are you brave enough to enter GOLD'S DUNGEON?

Backrooms Society is a 1-8 player co-op horror game. Make your way through unique levels of the backrooms while trying to survive and avoid mysterious entities. Scavenge each level for gear and resources, bring it back to The Hub where you can sell valuables and buy/craft new gear.

Deceptively simple... amazingly deep. Creeper World 2 thrusts you into the 14th millennium fighting and enemy that flows and oozes through the terrain. Employ advanced weapons,gravity manipulating repulsors, wormhole like rifts, and your own wit against this never yielding enemy.
Galaxy Citizen est un jeu d'action en ligne avec un monde toujours en évolution, situé dans un monde extraterrestre.
Race Track Builder is a software design tool that has a simple, easy to use interface that allows you to build fantasy race tracks or use Google Maps data to create real-life terrain and roads.

AquaSnap is a powerful window manager that helps you arrange and organize multiple applications on your desktop with minimum effort. It allows you to achieve maximum multitasking, especially if you own a high-resolution monitor or a multi-monitor setup.

A chess-inspired roguelike with flash-inspired graphics. As King, accumulate and command your army across a series of procedurally generated train carts. Outsmart a variety of unique enemies, capture them, and add them to your army... but one wrong step, and you lose them forever!

A collection of horror stories, realized by 9 developers. Each with its own unique take on Analog Horror! Experience these spooky tales through the interactive hub world & choose what to play at your own pace. Just don't die of fright!

Panzer War propose des combats de chars intenses avec un système de dégâts réaliste. Accédez instantanément à tous les véhicules et créez vos propres scénarios grâce à l’Éditeur de Chars et de Cartes.
Solve puzzles by creating portals and manipulating time. Inspired by Valve's Portal and Portal 2.

Bradley, an experienced thief aims to achieve his greatest personal goal, to rob an entire village. And then he goes to a military village in order to steal some items that are there. However, it will not be an easy task, given that there are several armed soldiers guarding the perimeter.
Experience death from the comfort of your seat.

titre: Shinobi™ III: Return of the Ninja Master
description: Ennemis jurés de Joe Musashi, les Neo Zeed sont en train de reconstruire secrètement une organisation au Japon après la bataille de Neo City. Joe (nom de code Shinobi) sent les forces du mal grandir et se met en route pour combattre les Neo Zeed une fois de plus.

One PC. Two players. Two perspectives of view. And many puzzles that can be solved only by working together. Defeat the rebellious robots and find out what happened at the nuclear plant in Two against the Legion. Play online with Steam Remote Play!
Take the Watson-Scott personality test and discover your deepest and darkest fears. 30 multiple-choice questions will tell you if you're more afraid of clowns, snakes, or something more sinister...

Will of the Gods est un jeu de stratégie d’arcade 1v1 dans lequel chaque joueur est un Dieu qui essaie de guider le plus grand nombre possible d’adeptes vers son propre temple, tout en punissant ceux qui choisissent de suivre l’autre Dieu.
Karma Miwa est un jeu de plateforme avec deux oiseaux aptères qui voyagent depuis trop longtemps et décident maintenant de rentrer chez eux.
Simulation de château, mise en place d'une armée de monstres, défense de l'empire du mal
The Heilwald Klinikum used to be one of the most renowned medical facilities in Germany. That all changed when that curious loophole appeared...
As famous bartender working in godforsaken town, you need to save locals from the mighty explosion!
Addictive pixel-art MMORPG! Start playing today!

The city is on fire, and the Devil is to blame - or is it? Two women must solve an occult-themed mystery set in an alternate 1980s while unraveling the secrets of their past. Hunt for clues and interrogate suspects in this interactive yuri visual novel.
Cursed West contains the spirit of Glories of the past, Holding aspects such as Difficulty and Mechanics. Adding more modern visuals in both, levels with traditional 2d gameplay, as in the 3d levels

Skel Dungeon est un jeu de défense stratégique en temps réel. Devenez un petit squelette et défaites les héros qui envahissent votre donjon. Installez et améliorez des salles de pièges, développez votre donjon et renforcez votre squelette pour affronter des héros de plus en plus puissants.

Dans « RECYCLE : Waste Management Simulator », vous êtes à la tête d'une entreprise de gestion des déchets. À ce titre, vous devez non seulement procéder à la collecte des ordures dans une ville animée au volant de vos camions poubelles, extrêmement fidèles à ceux de la vie réelle, mais aussi vous occuper des tâches de gestion attenantes...

Ortus Regni is a new and novel card game inspired by the late Anglo-Saxon period of English history. The Late Anglo-Saxon era in English history is a time of warring Earls. Minor kings all, they claim whatever lands they can. All the while, the Vikings roam not just the sea, but the land.
This is a strategy adventure game. The player needs to help the boy find the safest route to rescue the girl.

Odyssey is an enchanting and innovative science adventure game. Help Kai and her family escape their captors on the Wretched Islands - and learn the history of astronomy, mechanics, and scientific reasoning as you read Kai's journal and solve puzzles along the way!

On A Roll 3D is a fast, colourful 3D platform game. Roll your way through 24 huge levels across six different themes and be prepared to take on spikes, mines, dynamite, conveyor belts, springs, switches, doors, bumpers, lasers, saws, fire, ice, water, electricity, trapdoors and much much more.

Another Perspective is a puzzle platformer following the very confusing adventure of someone looking for something. Swap minds to see the world in different ways! Where one mind sees a bottomless pit, another might not. Where one sees a locked door, another sees a key. To change perspective is to change reality!
Can you defeat the shadow of your kingdom? Play as the last of the survivors of a former glorious dynasty to defeat evil and restore the honor and glory to your land!

"Scary Mine" is an immersive virtual reality horror game that plunges players into the eerie confines of an abandoned mine. With realistic graphics, spine-chilling sound effects, and split-second decision-making, players will unravel the unknown horrors lurking in the darkness.
Detective simulation. Top down open world exploration.

On November 1, 1952, the United States detonated the world's first hydrogen bomb on Enewetak Atoll in the Pacific Ocean. In this VR experience you will feel the effects of “Ivy Mike” 10 km from ground zero. You’ll get to walk on top of a nuclear waste site and meet people living on the atoll today.

Associez 5 ballons ou plus de couleurs et de types différents en les déplaçant sur un plateau de 81 cases. Les mécanismes de jeu changent à mesure que vous avancez vers les niveaux suivants, de sorte que les tactiques que vous avez apprises dans le passé doivent être adaptées pour l'avenir.

In the depths of a labyrinthine ruin, a young girl named Mion rises from a deep sleep. Lost, alone, and with no memory of how she got here or where her parents are, she is greeted by two fireflies—one composed entirely of light, and another who lurks among the shadows.
A "mini" game tribute to Donald J. Trump's amazing and successful run for the U.S. presidency. #MAGA!

Restaurez un ancien motel à côté d'un magasin et d'une station-service. Concevoir, meubler, décorer et louer des chambres. fournir des produits aux clients et du carburant pour les voitures. Embauchez des employés pour vous aider et soyez le patron de votre propre empire.

Turn-based strategy in which you lead a heroic defense of Ukraine under siege by the despicable Russian Z force. Outmaneuver an endless deluge of enemies using combined infantry-and-armor tactics to survive against all odds.

Battle Pixels is a frantic arcade action, point and click shoot 'em up with a 16 bit retro style.Take control of your tanks and eliminate the enemy's turret defences over 25 randomly generated levels.

Game about a blind old man. Who includes street lights. Because the whole world is in darkness. The blind man can only stop, using the space bar. Help him to lighten the dark cities. Avoiding obstacles using the left mouse button.
LightFish est un jeu arcade extrêmement addictif où l'utilisateur contrôle un petit poisson vivant dans les profondeurs abyssales de l'océan... entouré de créatures mortelles.

Magical Stock Princess is a quick to play blend of arcade levels and lite rpg elements. Avoid monsters while you clear the floor in the Acton stages, and interact with quirky characters in the Adventure stages. Enjoy the best of two worlds without the drawbacks. 100% bat caves-free.

Are you ready to found a dynasty which controls the Holy See over the centuries? Climb the hierarchies, hire your relatives, blackmail and bribe to get everything you want in this turn-based political simulator.

Welcome to the IKEA Virtual Reality kitchen experience, where you can make some virtual pancakes. Our IKEA kitchen specialist will guide you through some of the key aspects of a well-planned kitchen. And look out for the instructions that will help you to prepare those perfect pancakes.

Vous êtes Tommy, une star locale du football dans la ville d’East Bend. C’est soir de match pour les Purchase County Turbines et votre copine vous attend sous les gradins. Joignez Tommy pour une nuit que vous n’oublierez pas… Une nouvelle aventure par les créateurs de ‘A Date in the Park!’
Unique RPG that covers what happens after the Big Bad is defeated and the Heroes disband.
Prenez le contrôle d'un commandant de flotte de retour d'exil, montez les échelons des forces unies de la fédération de l'espace et joignez une guerre épique à travers les étoiles.

Défonce des hordes d'ennemis avec tes capacités cybernétiques et magiques. Adapte et combine les compétences magiques et technologiques pour faire face à des défis sans fin et maîtrise tes pouvoirs pour vaincre des poursuivants démoniaques implacables.

titre: Darkness and Flame: The Dark Side f2p
description: Il n’y a personne dans le monde qui pourrait revenir du Côté Obscur intact... «Les Ténèbres et les Flammes. Le Côté Obscur» est un jeu d’aventure dans le genre d’Objets Cachés, avec beaucoup de mini-jeux et de puzzles, des personnages inoubliables et des quêtes complexes.
"Moe Jigsaw" is the definitive version of the digital jigsaw puzzle that collects only "Moe & Kawaii" illustrations, that is one of the Japanese cultures.

Blind Sound is a Game about, Exploration and Puzzle-solving. This is a Linear Story Based horror game which sets in a science facility. You will discover tons of thing and find about the Creepy history of this facility with Full of Creatures That extremely Dangerous.
Ghost is a first-person horror game made in realistic 3D graphics that immerses you in an atmosphere of horror and scares you in every way. The main goal is to survive and be saved.
RPG Sounds is the best audio tool for Dungeon Masters and TTRPG Players.
Incarnez Lieutenant Commandant, crème des pilotes de chasse, alors que vous cherchez un nouveau foyer, combattez un mystérieux ennemi et sauvez l'humanité d'une fin atroce.

Hell Pie est un jeu de plateformes en 3D qui propulse le mauvais goût vers de nouveaux sommets ! Le jeu vous met dans la peau de Nate, le « démon du mauvais goût », qui doit réunir les ingrédients répugnants nécessaires à la préparation de l'infâme tarte d'anniversaire de Satan !

Become Atom Eve and take control of your own path as one of the most powerful superheroes in the Invincible universe! Unravel a mystery and balance the dangers and responsibilities of being a superhero with the relatable challenges of everyday life.

Twilight Memoria: Sun and Moon is a nostalgic RPG about childhood friendship, first love, and proving your worth. Guide two young heroes through quests, alchemy, and real-time turn-based battles in a village full of secrets.

Foncez dans un monde retrowave sublime à l'aide de vos compétences en parkour et un grappin qui vous permettront de grimper et courir sur les murs dans ce jeu de plates-formes 3D rapide. Faites exploser vos ennemis, manipulez l'espace-temps et défiez les lois de la physique pour éviter de tomber.
Fragsurf is a dynamic blend of multiplayer first-person shooter PvP, strafing, surfing, and bunnyhop, allowing players to engage in high-speed maneuvers and combat.

Construisez votre cité dans le ciel et explorez le monde dans ce RPG / city-builder en monde ouvert. Combinez construction et gestion rigoureuses d'un city-builder, mécaniques uniques de portance, équilibre et propulsion d'une cité volante et personnages attachants, dangers et aventures d'un RPG !

STAR-BOX – RPG Adventures in Space!Strap on your gravity boots, power up your laser, and climb aboard your spaceship for a retro-styled, RPG-jaunt into the unknown!Travel an open-world, sandbox universe where you are the architect of your own story.
Based off the 2003 feature film, Disney•Pixar's Finding Nemo, play as Marlin and Nemo in two separate major story lines!

Botan, an apprentice kunoichi, is summoned by the village chief. Her master had been captured. So she is tasked with the mission to rescue her. However, Botan still lacks experience. Will she really be able to save her master?
Stone Age Wars is an RPG arcade game where you assemble a team of prehistoric soldiers, each with unique abilities and go up against waves of vicious enemies.
Take on the role of Lorelai, a young woman of humble means who learns that her true identity is the heir to a powerful empire!
In this narrative-driven sci-fi mystery, investigate across space and time to uncover clues and unravel the secrets of a star system that has disappeared, and the man trying to find it.

Construisez votre propre Super Mining Mech et explorez le sous-sol à la recherche de nouvelles ressources. Personnalisez votre mech avec des pièces à débloquer pour creuser plus profondément - seul ou avec jusqu'à 7 amis en coop en ligne! Alors, qu'attendez-vous? Il y a du minage à faire!
Affrontez le Minotaure !

A 3D platformer where you explore the dark cyberpunk world. You have to get way up from the underground facility to the spaceship. Discover secrets, play with friends, drive cars, and many more in Only High.
You don't know who you are, where you are and why you are here, you know just thing, you want to survive and get out of HELL!
Survive. Build shelter. Build a fire. Scavenge and kill for materials. Craft. Eat and drink. Do what you need to do to survive.

Quand la réalité est un cauchemar, les cauchemars prennent vie. Dans ce jeu d’horreur psychologique, vous luttez contre les terribles créatures qui envahissent votre esprit. Serez-vous capable de recouvrer votre santé mentale ?

X Invader est un roguelite d'action où vous piratez les serveurs de grandes corporations. Utilisez des modules complémentaires de vos camarades hackers pour vaincre les monstres. Des boss puissants et mignons gardent ces serveurs !

Choisissez votre propre destinée dans ce MMORPG dynamique à monde ouvert. Explorez de vastes mondes fantastiques, combattez dans des batailles JcE et JcJ, récoltez des ressources, créez un empire commercial, développez votre ville ou conquérez d'autres villes. Choisissez votre propre voie !

Apporte la gentillesse et la lumière aux habitants de Sainte-et-Claire, en incarnant Lila, une petite souris au grand cœur ! Explore un joli village français, rencontre des amis électrisants et fais de bonnes actions dans ce jeu d'aventure narratif !

Timber and Stone is a procedural city building game set in a medieval fantasy world. With over one-hundred resources to gather and craft, Timber and Stone has the feel of a real time strategy game, but with much more depth and complexity.

Rogue Waters est un rogue-lite tactique au tour par tour. Incarnez le Capitaine Cutter, commandez votre navire et votre équipage dans des rencontres générées aléatoirement. Recrutez, formez, améliorez l’équipage, utilisez des créatures marines et engagez des combats navals et au corps à corps.

"Internet Cafe & Supermarket Simulator 2024" est un jeu de simulation complet qui combine la gestion d'un cybercafé et d'un supermarché. Endossez le rôle de propriétaire d'une boutique, appliquez votre acumen d'affaires et agrandissez votre empire étape par étape.

Live your wildest dreams by splurging on insane amounts of cash you wouldn't have in real life. Play for random number generated loot that is a reflection of the meaningless nature of this game and everything surrounding it.
Epic battles await you in the multi-award winning Trading Card Game, now on Steam. Battle with digital cards and scan tabletop cards into your digital collection for Double the Value!
Malum is the premier C-list horror game. Run from a motely collection of bizarre demons then summon in some guns to turn the tables on them. Best enjoyed with friends.

titre: Brink of Consciousness: The Lonely Hearts Murders
description: HOW FAR WILL YOU GO TO SAVE YOUR ONLY DAUGHTER'S LIFE?

NightmareZ is a side-scrolling platform action game with multiple enemies, lots of fancy features and retro visuals. This is a retro styled platform and action game which will immerse you in a unique world full of good and evil demons.

This is the final game in the "Lord of Darkness" trilogy in the genre of old JRPGs with a turn-based combat system. As in the previous installments, the dramatic story is skillfully combined with parody and satirical notes. These are difficult times.

Save the Dodos! Tout le monde connait la triste histoire du dodo; charmant mais idiot... Mais vous pouvez désormais changer l'histoire et empêcher leur déchirante disparition! Guidez les dodos à travers 100 niveaux casse-tête et empêchez leur extinction.

Customize the Start menu and Taskbar in Windows 10 and 11 with several different layouts, positions, and aesthetic options using Start11 v1! Make the Start menu appear as it does in previous versions of Windows, enhance its functionality, and customize your setup just the way you like it.

Topple Tactics is a physics-based multiplayer tower defense game where one huge player controls the map by placing towers and using abilities, whilst the little players level up their stats and equipment to reach the end of the map and defeat the huge player!

Plongez dans les batailles épiques de Fantasy Kommander, un jeu tactique au tour par tour dans un monde fantasy inspiré de l’Europe médiévale.Dirigez vos armées, maîtrisez un système de combat riche et vivez une histoire à travers quatre campagnes remplies de héros et d’ennemis redoutables.
Play a neon pinball machine in the arcade room and take a look at the released and upcoming JanduSoft games.

An adventurer named Quem is the first person to step foot inside "Heaven's Ladder" in 500 years. But not long after, she's cursed by a strange, shadowy monster. Now she must reach the top of Heaven's Ladder, and hopefully, break the spell.
Colonumbers is a new brain teaser game with numbers and colors!

Thrillville™: Off the Rails lives up to its name with 20 death-defying rides! Players can build incredible coasters to leap from one track to another, launch through the air like cannonballs, blast through a burning rings of fire and more!
Challenge the pinball people! Get shrunk down and play a mad points-scoring game inside pinball machines. Feint, travel, and tackle your way to high score glory — all’s fair under the glass.
A dream-like simulation in which you impersonate Ego, the last of Lilith's children, in a mission down on Earth.

Un shooter top-down compétitif et intense : choisissez votre classe, capturez des tourelles, progressez et dominez l’arène. shooter top-down, shooter multijoueur, shooter d’arène, shooter à classes, shooter sci-fi

Mirages is a 3D narrative and horror game with folk stories. One night, seven brides headed to the Captain Mansion but strayed into a place full of ghosts - Regret City. Horror haunts the small town. Due to destiny, actors, warlords, and offspring of the town are drawn in. They are closer to truth.

A sci-fi adventure full of robot battles, pop music, and emotion. Featuring one of the largest branching storylines ever in a VR game with 15-20 hours of gameplay, Altdeus will place you in the shoes of Chloe, a pilot in humanity's forces fighting massive hostile organisms known as the Meteora.

Swordsman is a realistic sword-fighting game. Customize your warrior, battle different factions in epic arenas, and defeat powerful enemies to unlock their special boss weapons on your journey to save the world from evil.

A.I.M. 2 is the sequel to the epic science fiction first-person action RPG developed by SkyRiver Studios. Its compelling story and unique look lift off exactly where the original ended. New clans led by Mechminds of the Fifth Generation are powerful and well-organized formations with far-reaching plans.

Run your own taxi cab company by hiring drivers, upgrading vehicles and getting behind the wheel to complete fares. Some passengers will even encourage you to break traffic laws to get to their destination quickly, but try to avoid the watchful eye of the police.

titre: 18 Wheels of Steel: American Long Haul
description: Le rêve américain au volant d'un semi-remorque !Les autoroutes nord-américaines vous attendent. Vous êtes votre propre patron.Relevez le défi - Que le meilleur gagne. N'oubliez pas que seul le profit compte !Transport - 45 types de marchandises différentes : bétail, produits chimiques, matériel de construction...
Havocado is ragdoll physics based fighting, with guns, crazy vehicles, weird creatures and more, where mistakes have real consequences. Will you beat the other fighters and become the next champion?

titre: Sucker for Love: Date to Die For
description: Put the ‘love’ in 'Lovecraftian horror!' Avoid the fanatical cultists and survive dangerous rituals to escape the Black Woods with your life in this 90’s anime inspired visual novel!

Simulateur de pompage En tant que membre actif d'une station-service dans une grande ville du monde, vous pouvez jouer avec jusqu'à 10 amis en mode coopératif multijoueur ou en mode solo pour vous aider à comprendre ce que les pompiers traversent, et peut-être vous rendra riche.

XWallpaper is a funny and powerful live wallpaper engine that displays amazing animations and effects on your wallpaper with low CPU usage. It brings life to your static wallpaper with powerful visual designer in one-click.

A fast-paced platformer where you can slash, dash, and control time. Slow down the frenzy of combat and find the right moment to strike! Then, aim the 360-degree dash and zoom away at lightning speed! Master your abilities to maneuver around obstacles and vaporize foes before they can touch you.

Out of nowhere, an army of insect-like creatures from a distant world, using technologically advanced space weapons, ambushed and devastated Earth. In this colorful space shooter from the early days of FMV, it’s up to you to fend off the Sirian race in the cutting edge XF5700 Mantis Fighter!

In the near (and some might say, lucky) future, there is a pandemic transforming the world’s population into zombies. That’s not the lucky part – it’s this: Once bitten by a zombie, the only way to stave off the infection is drinking beer!

TechWars: Global Conflict is the world’s first isometric PVP mecha-action with direct control. Only the strongest player will be able to win in this war of titanic mechs. Use all the features of world’s realistic technology Techwars. Victory in every battle will bring you closer to creating your own death machine.
Un jeu de plates-formes 8-bit rétro amoureusement conçu, qui est bien plus que des pixels et des chiptunes

Une armée de démons a poussé l'humanité au bord de l'extinction. Ce qui s'oppose à elle ? Une femme en noir, avec une arme longue comme un balai magique et les pouvoirs qui vont avec. Massacrez des hordes de monstres et rallumez l’étincelle de la résistance de l’humanité !

Over the world threatened. You - one of the victims after the earthquake turned to the Lord for help. While your house is being restored, you were offered to help the provinces. Something is coming ... save the land of Hinor from the coming evil!

Tempelhof, Berlin, le 8 avril 1949.Un conflit armé majeur s'apprête à éclater entre les blocs de l'est et de l'ouest. L'armée rouge est montée en puissance à la fin de la seconde guerre mondiale et les soviétiques, conscient de leur avantage, s'apprêtent à attaquer a tout moment.

In Myst IV: Revelation, the next chapter in the greatest adventure saga of all time, you'll travel through environments pulsing with life to unearth a treacherous scheme involving two of Myst's most sinister villains.

Camping Simulator vous permet de découvrir ce que signifie camper en préparant judicieusement votre sac à dos pour des conditions naturelles difficiles. Vous pouvez vivre ces expériences jusqu'à 8 amis en mode multijoueur ou en mode solo.
Ready to test your reaction?

Il se passe quelque chose d'effrayant dans l'émission de marionnettes préférée des enfants, Les Gentils Voisins ! Incarnez Gordon, un réparateur envoyé pour découvrir ce qu'il se passe. Repoussez les marionnettes et résolvez des énigmes dans cette aventure de survie et d'horreur.
Un jeu de stratégie post­apocalyptique avec des combats tactiques au tour par tour, dans lequel vous dirigerez votre caravane en quête de vengeance.
Welcome to Tropical Island.

Get into the cockpit of an ace pilot fighting in the galactic war in this sci-fi arcade top-down shooter. Participate in numerous campaign missions to explore the story of Magnificent-1 and enjoy the arcade mode to strive for the highest score.

Cabernet est un jeu de rôle narratif en 2D dans un monde inspiré de l'Europe de l'Est du 19e siècle. Guidez Liza, une jeune vampire, dans sa nouvelle vie parmi les habitants qui ne se doutent de rien. Allez-vous conserver votre humanité ou descendre encore plus bas dans l’horreur ?

The forces of the Forseti and the evil Muspell are in a fight to the death. You are Hawk Winter, plucked from obscurity to pilot Battle Engine Aquila. Airborne or on land, your tactics and Aquila's firepower must combine to blaze a trail to lift the Forseti from oblivion.
Un puzzle-game étonant des aventures de l'inépuisable panda Pew !

Experience epic space battles while piloting a small, fast fighter ship as part of a fleet that lashes out against enemy factions across stunning procedurally generated star systems in Disputed Space.

titre: Zeus vs Monsters - Math Game for kids
description: Zeus vs Monsters est un jeu de mathématiques pour les enfants avec des opérations mathématiques mixtes - addition, soustraction, multiplication et division. Avec 50 niveaux et 10 patrons de vaincre, cela est une véritable aventure de mathématiques. Présentez-vous à beaucoup de plaisir et la mythologie grecque - jouez Zeus vs Monsters.

Venineth is a single-player game focusing on unraveling the mysteries of ancient alien technology, somewhere in the universe via exploration, platforming, and puzzle-solving, in a dangerous, distant worlds.
Play the top-down RPG-Maker version of Dungeon Master and battle your way through over 30 levels and 20 hours of classic dungeon crawling. ZO KATH RA!

Aetheris est un RPG tactique avec d'intenses combats en tour par tour. Dans un environnement immersif et haut en couleur, prenez les bonnes décisions et adoptez la meilleure stratégie pour survivre. Voyagez seul ou en groupe de quatre joueurs - l'aventure vous attend !

Créez un duché de toutes pièces dans ce rogue-lite hybride et novateur. Récupérez des ressources à l'aide de blocs empilés, recrutez les troupes qui affronteront des armées belliqueuses et façonnez peu à peu votre royaume pour le mener à la victoire !

Final Rush is an intense, difficult, co-op multiplayer FPS, where the players fight against waves of hundreds of robotic enemies. Destroy robots to earn experience points which can be used to rank up your player; improving skill, customizing armor, and upgrading weapons.

Puzzler World vous fourni 1200 puzzles selon 8 types jeux différent sur votre PC. Conceptis, en plus des Crossword, Wordsearch, Fitword, Sudoku, Codeword, Spot the Difference et Silhouette, vous apporte également 83 Conceptis Link-a-Pix disponible dans les tailles 10x10, 20x20 et 25x25.

Freedom Fall is a diabolical down-scrolling platformer set in a prison tower so tall it touches the clouds. Presented with hand painted art, its old school vibe mixes with fast-paced free falling action and a story with both dark wit and heart.

Sumetrick is a mind training minimalist design game that's chained to the symmetry. Simple gameplay - you need to fill gameboard in symmetry way by clicking on framed cells. Do that faster and be as good as Chack Knorris. But don't forget to eat sometimes...
Woken up on an uncharted land, it is now up to you to defend the Dreamrealm from corruption. Embark on a folkloric journey and find out what's the source of all evil in this world of fairytales.

Zack Zero takes you on an action-packed platform adventure with incredible 3D graphics and the playability and entertainment of classic 2D games. Help Zack Zero save his beloved Marlene, kidnapped by the evil Zulrog in an effort to obtain the powerful substance that will allow him to travel back in time.

Les pilotes les plus fous sont maintenant dans votre main avec minidrivers! La série animée qui est aimé par des millions de personnes à travers le monde a un nouveau personnage principal: Vous! Créez vos propres magasins ou modifier les règles pour devenir champion du monde.

This is an online Minesweeper game that allows worldwide players to play simultaneously! Across 48 million tiles, each game has over 10 million mines. Dive into a minefield, claim your territory, clear the mines and have fun!
CrocoMars is a top-down shooter about the colonization of Mars by reptilians. A cheerful and arthouse view of the problem of cosmic level.

Take on the challenge and face off against a rogue AI bent on enslaving humanity! Strap on your VR headset, step into the boots of a Galactic Ranger, and tear through waves of robots with explosive blasters, devastating shotguns, and an insane arsenal — just like classic arcade shooters!

Incendies domestiques, accidents de la route et interventions de grande ampleur : vivez le quotidien d'un pompier dans "Firefighters 2014 – The Simulation Game" ! Les adeptes des jeux de simulation de pompiers vont enfin être comblés !
没有无聊的教学关卡？直接开干 爽！爆射敌人的快感？爽！双摇杆射击？爽！大量技能卡牌堆叠升级？爽！强大的增援轰炸让你越战越强统统都有！随机生成任务给你，驾驶机甲大炮战车横扫千军！每一次随机的BOSS战斗都是男人的挑战！

Penarium prend place dans l'arène inquiétante d'un cirque dans laquelle les combattants, tels des gladiateurs, sont forcés de divertir une foule sadique. Dans ce jeu d'arène 2D arcade à 100 à l'heure.
Fend off hordes of enemies in this arcade tower defense roguelite with autobattler elements. Build up a team of powerful synergies and become unstoppable.

NEW TERRA est un jeu de tir spatial multidirectionnel basé sur la gravité stimulant et addictif. Le carburant va vite et est difficile à trouver. La stratégie et la conservation des ressources sont essentielles pour mener à bien vos missions, sinon vous ne survivrez pas.

titre: 攻城与召唤 Siege and Summons 【5分钟一局 策略竞技 】
description: Siege and Summon est un jeu de cartes compétitif au tour par tour se déroulant à l'époque des Trois Royaumes. Les joueurs peuvent utiliser des cartes de soldat et des cartes de compétence pour construire un jeu de cartes afin de défier les joueurs puissants du monde des Trois Royaumes.

Crime O'Clock est un jeu d'enquête et d'exploration du temps à travers les époques et les univers. Enquêtez sur des affaires à travers le temps et des cartes évolutives qui dévoileront une histoire aux liens multiples. Serez-vous assez observateur pour résoudre tous les mystères ?
Defeat Vivian's shadow to reclaim her soul from the Dark Tome.

A champion will rise and change the course of history. As a descendent of King Richard the Lionheart, prepare to battle the forces of evil in an alternate Europe transformed by magic. Choose your race, skills, and abilities, and begin your quest in this darkened alternative world.

Dans ce tout nouveau et totalement remanié LUXOR Evolved, les chaines sont plus rapides, les bonus plus incroyables et les tireurs plus discrets. Dans ce jeu de tir arcade rétro, vous vivrez une expérience LUXOR plus intense, plus rapide, comme jamais vous ne l'avez vu auparavant.

Step into the Warhammer Fantasy world like never before in this short and fun VR experience. As an aspiring hero, you need to prove your worth by outsmarting the cunning Skaven, using your expert marksmanship and keen melee skills. For the Empire!

Bienvenue dans Backfirewall_, une aventure à la première personne conçue pour smartphone. Endossez le rôle de l’assistant des mises à jour. Résolvez des énigmes pour contrer la mise à jour et empêchez l’ancien système d’exploitation d’être effacé. Le destin du système est entre vos mains !
The sequel to "Wooden Floor". Reveal the truth hiding in the dark, haunted mansion of Blackdust Field. A mysterious and horrific adventure game by Pheenix93.

Crankage Games brings you another hilarious tale full of satire and parody! Play as Ronald J. Grump, a secret agent hellbent on deporting illegal extraterrestrials from outer-space off of his home-planet! Follow Agent Grump as he drains the swamp, deports aliens, and makes Earth great again!

Lode Runner Legacy est le tout nouvel épisode de la série culte Lode Runner. Le joueur y contrôle un « Runner » chargé de récupérer l'or volé tout en évitant les ennemis et les pièges. Savourez un mélange savant de puzzle et d'action, de superbes graphismes en voxel et des modes de création poussés.
Balades iconiques, ambiances iconiques ! Revivez l'âme des années 80 avec des supercars rétro, des musiques synthwave et des croisières sans fin dans RetroZen !

Brick Breaker, LE jeu d'arcade devenu culte, revient dans une version améliorée à vous couper le souffle. Son gameplay explosif vous réserve plus d'un rebondissement. Récoltez de nombreux bonus, évitez les pièges et enchainez les niveaux vers la victoire ! Jouable jusqu'à 4 en local.

titre: Nancy Drew®: The White Wolf of Icicle Creek
description: Follow a Trail to Hidden Secrets and Sabotage!
Concevez votre voiture à partir de zéro: du cadre à la suspension et en course!

"Purgatory Overkill" est un jeu de tir et un tower-defense en réalité virtuelle. Vous pourrez construire des tourelles automatiques et des murs pour survivre et repousser des hordes infinies d'ennemis tout en participant activement au combat grâce à vos armes.

Serial Cleaners est un jeu d'action et d'infiltration en vue de dessus, dans lequel vous incarnez un nettoyeur de scène de crime de la mafia dans le New York des années 90. Alternez entre quatre nettoyeurs, chacun avec son style unique, et vivez leurs histoires.

titre: [Chilla's Art] Night Delivery | 例外配達
description: Night Delivery | 例外配達 is a psychological Japanese horror adventure game.

Type to guess the words used to create machine-made artworks, while slowly uncovering the algorithm's reflections on its own work. Come investigate more than 1,500 generated artworks across 7 carefully curated galleries.

titre: UNDER the WATER - an ocean survival game
description: How long do you survive on a small island in the middle of a flooded world?
It's a nice puzzle to move the same numbers next to each other.

Lift It is a fresh and dynamic game where you have to train your character in order to gain stats. Every Gym exercise helps gaining a specific stat. Increasing your stats will help you to beat your enemies when travelling from the main island (Gym Island) to the other islands.
NALOGI 2 - new satirical game in the genre of RPG. The emperor became emperor after the election. Again. For eternity. PAY TAXES!
An unnamed undercover policeman is given a new task, to destroy all aliens on a secret planet.
Silicone-2 - a shooter with a first-person. In the story the player will have to quell the uprising of robots.

titre: Project MIKHAIL: A Muv-Luv War Story
description: Set on an Earth where mankind is being steadily annihilated by the alien invaders known as the BETA, Project MIKHAIL lets you pilot a Tactical Surface Fighter in the war to save humanity!

titre: How To Cope With Boredom and Loneliness
description: Harold Fletcher has been grounded to his bedroom for over 30 years. Join award-winning journalist Nigel Wimble as he discovers how one man has coped with the boredom and loneliness in this one of a kind, FREE, documentary film simulator!
Vivez l'aventure d'un petit robot porteur de lumière dans un monde obscur et intriguant.

titre: Romance of the Three Kingdoms II
description: "Romance of the Three Kingdoms II" is the second in the series and was first released in 1989. Experience the strategies of the Three Kingdom. A variety of strategies brings the world of the Three Kingdoms to vivid life. Players take the role of a Ruler of the time and strategize their way into total control.

Kitchen simulator, The game that turns you into the chef. As the owner and chef of your very own restaurant, you now have the responsibilities to keep your place clean, serving quality meals to your hungry customers, Impressing the high class to get to that fancy five star restaurant,more…

A new multiplayer, third-person, horror experience: Escape from an appaling environment by solving different puzzles with the help of your friends, and hiding from a hideous monster... or maybe becoming one ;) Unlock new maps, cosmetics and skins with the new Horror Night DLCs

Son Korsan est un jeu de pirateship et de guerre 3D MMO. Combattez pour votre propre gloire avec votre alliance contre les ennemis, naviguez sur une aventure, conquérir de nouvelles îles et dominer les grandes mers!
Experience Legend of Numbers, the one of a kind match-3 game that is both new and revolutionary. one that you’ve never seen before!
This time, Motherland sent you to fight vs Nazi forces in the ruins of the snowy Stalingrad. Kill enemies and conquer trophy weapons to get the maximum chance to survive.

In a world of human-like monsters, a young man lives in a quiet, remote village with his sister. However, he is attacked by monsters when he leaves the village. Now he works hard to become stronger so he no longer burdens his sister.

Embarquez dans une aventure captivante avec Agatha, une enfant déchirée entre son amour pour la viande et son amitié pour les animaux. Rejoignez-la alors qu'elle découvre et invente sa propre religion, le Carnivorisme, pour convaincre les animaux que leur sacrifice est le secret du bonheur éternel.

titre: Medicalholodeck – Imagerie médicale, IA et anatomie en 3D
description: Le Spatial OS de Medicalholodeck est le système d’exploitation pour la médecine spatiale. Exécutez simultanément des écrans 3D stéréoscopiques, des casques VR et des écrans 2D standard. Examinez l’imagerie médicale et l’anatomie humaine en véritable 3D.
Тюремные Загадки

From the makers of Death & Taxes comes a turn-based adventure-strategy game, an indie love letter to pixel art, old-school adventure games, mythical creatures and fantasy storytelling. Choose your faction and harness the vast power of magic to save your dying world, shaping your personal storyline.
Stock Car Extreme is a realistic racing game simulating brazilian Stock Car V8 series, also featuring several extra series and tracks covering a wide variety of racing disciplines.
Raviver les ennemis morts et construire votre armée! C’est le jeu d’aventure de Necromancer. Vous pouvez jouer 4 chapitres.

For decades, the U.S. Navy has deployed the river patrol boat (PBR) in the most hostile and claustrophobic type of war: riverine combat. The classic action sim Gunboat lets you fight from all perspectives of your boat's four-man crew in over 20 missions across 3 sweltering combat zones.

Rejoignez la jeune Mako tandis qu'elle s'aventure dans un monde d'exploration sauvage et qu'elle découvre un mystérieux oiseau compagnon. Naviguez dans deux royaumes distincts à l'aide de votre bâton et affrontez une ancienne sentinelle dans ce prologue du métrovania Akatori.
In a dystopian future, as The Judge with immense power, you journey through space to find hope in a divided society. This sci-fi adventure explores hope amidst adversity.

Command an army of 1000 troops. Create squads from a variety of unit types and give them orders to perform devastating strategic maneuvers. Then lead your army into battle and slice the opposing army into pieces.

AffordaGolf is a Multiplayer Online Mini-golf game!In AffordaGolf you can play mini-golf with your friends and up to 127 people on official and user created maps. Also you can customize your ball and trail with any image on the internet.
On Your Hands combines complex puzzle mechanics with a creepy alien atmosphere and terrifying enemies. Can you learn the seven unique magic types to make your way off this strange alien planet?

Meet Sousuke. He's just your average student, living in a rural town. Ever since his father remarried when he was young, he's been living together with his little sister Nanaru. Together with his childhood friend Maho and their other friends, they have fun geeking out in the Otaku Club.
In this 2d pixel art game, it's 1953 and you're playing as an agent hired by the Central Killing Agency to kill Fred Olsen. Experience multiple endings in this short, narrative-driven adventure.

It's bake or die at Cakey's Bakery, where human children are the secret ingredient to strange monsters' delicious pastries. Find the recipe for survival to escape the bakery and it's sweet and scary staff!
You’re the night guard in a locked-down mall. An enraged KAREN is chasing you. Watch the cameras, set traps, grab weapons and vehicles. Survive until dawn!

The young girl Rayne, who became the sacred knight of the kingdom, was entrusted by Jas, the leader of the sacred knights and her lover, to investigate the disturbances occurring in a distant town named "Hakudeti".

Préparez-vous pour une incroyable montée d’adrénaline au fur et à mesure que vous progresserez dans une tour infestée de robots. Manipulez une puissante magie et réalisez des acrobaties si vous espérez reprendre le domaine de l’Alchimiste des mains d’une horde de monstres mécaniques.

Eyes Over Us est un jeu narratif de stratégie surréaliste, généré de manière procédurale, dans lequel vous icarnerez une créature lovecraftienne qui surveille deux humains soumis à des expériences. Le pouvoir de tout changer est entre vos mains... attendez... est-ce que vous en avez même, des mains?

Play WarfareBattle. Land on strategic locations, loot weapons and supplies, and survive to become the last one standing in Battle Royale mode, or prepare to duel in close quarters in TDM or Control modes, and more.
A creative game where your imagination is your limit.

titre: [Chilla's Art] Parasocial | パラソーシャル
description: Parasocial | パラソーシャル is a Japanese horror game about a live streamer.

Make up for lost time with Once Again, If you could travel through time, who’s the first person you’d meet? An interactive story about a boy who spends his summers wandering between past and present... After meeting her, summer will never be the same again...Who is she, and what journey awaits you?
