Hyperspace Dogfights is a juicy jet-combat roguelite in which you blast, dodge and slice your way through masses of technologically inferior baddies. Your jet evolves differently on each run and becomes stronger and weirder by gathering some of the 300+ available items.
《制服女友》是日本视觉小说游戏资深大厂ENTERGRAM制作的一款新时代恋爱模拟游戏。在本作中，玩家可以通过社交软件自由地与穿着制服的各位女主角发展关系，增进情谊。 而你，想与谁相伴，让她成为独属于你的「制服女友」呢？

In Era Of Newborns we will survive with newborns. We will cut trees and explore the mines and we will build our own place. In the wild nature we will feed our stomach, we will create armors and we will find Epic equipment in Mysterious Caves. Are You Ready?
Le jeu de MotoGP™ le plus complet jamais conçu ! Intégrez la Valentino Rossi's VR|46 Riders Academy et entraînez-vous avec lui pour devenir le nouveau champion de la saison MotoGP™ 2016 !
You are the best pilot of Republic. Your mission is cease the launch of enemy nuclear missile.

En jouant à ce jeu, vous vous trouverez dans un monde où il y a de la magie et de la technologie. Aider un scientifique fou à la recherche de l'inconnu, vous pouvez visiter les endroits les plus incroyables: des forêts, des terres sauvages et dangereuses.
A terrible darkness threatens a world of overwhelmingly adorable mares. Can a new cute mare with amnesia save the world or will she lose more than her memories along the way?

L'Humanité est en guerre contre les vampires et les déviants. La dernière ligne de défense des hommes est un groupe d'enfants entraînés dans l'utilisation d'une magie puissante qui peut rivaliser avec les hordes démoniaques, mais au coût de la majorité de leur durée de vie.
The sequel of the successful Unlock The King, now in a tridimensional board. An originally designed puzzle game inspired by chess. Move the pieces and create a path to Unlock the King.
A Third Person Shooter Game where you have to infiltrate the enemy lines and complete the mission.

Hoshina Shuuji has a secret: He has a mysterious power that allows him to perceive the emotions of others. However, he is soon to find out that he is not the only one who has something he doesn't want others to find out about as Ayachi Nene, a classmate, likewise has a secret.

C'est l'heure d'enfiler la blouse en solo ou avec jusqu'à 3 amis en ligne dans cette simulation chirurgicale basée sur la physique avec un mode Création incroyable, dans laquelle vous choisissez la compétitivité extrême ou la coopération. Percez le mystère du centre médical Bossa Labs et sauvez Bob.

Omensight est un jeu d'action/enquête. Vous êtes la Messagère, une puissante guerrière mystique et avez assisté à la fin du monde. Pour empêcher cette destruction, vous êtes destinée à revivre encore et encore cette dernière journée pour résoudre le meurtre de la Prêtresse Sans Dieu.

Vous voulez juste acheter du lait, mais le destin adore glisser des aventures là où vous ne l'attendez pas. A la ferme, vous rencontrerez une laitière qui vous fera jouer le jeu selon ses règles. Jouez au puzzle avec la laitière. C'est la seule façon d'obtenir son lait.

À la frontière du petit village d'Etria se trouve une mystérieuse forêt où s'est ouverte une faille gigantesque, portail vers un insondable labyrinthe. Prenez la tête d'une troupe d'aventuriers et arpentez le donjon en quête de gloire, de fortune et d'aventure !
Relaxing puzzle game in a minimal style.

Rejoignez un FPS ROGUELITE SCI-FI unique conçu pour la RV. Avec une variété d'armes spatiales, une armurerie améliorable, un buff d'amélioration et un superpouvoir inconnu, vous, un soldat sans mémoire, devez combattre les mutants, les cyborgs et les rebelles pour survivre dans l'espace inconnu...

Half a year passed since the world was destroyed by the angels —— Claudia decided to set off for the Demon Continent, but she was attacked by angels on her way. After gaining the power of the divine weapon, she was able to repel the angels.

titre: Chibi Ninja Shino-kun: Treasure of Demon Tower
description: Jump, slide and wall-kick your way through Demon Tower in this 90s-style ninja platformer!
Desire Gambling House is a classic 21-point card game, in which there will be four unique beautiful women as your opponents, they will even use clothes as a bet, do you...continue?

VELVETIST prototype introduces the vision of a third person action open world adventure game set in an old, socialist occupied town of the second half of the 20th century. Prototype contains only a basic structure on top of which we wish to build the VELVETIST: The City Of Machineguns.

Londres, 1964. On a volé un ancien rubis au British Museum. Sur le lieu du crime : une plume de corbeau. Quelqu'un essaie-t-il de marcher sur les pas du Corbeau, le voleur légendaire qui a disparu il y a des années ?

Embark on a challenging feline adventure in the style of Sokoban, moving blocks, avoiding traps, and collecting precious artifacts with our furry protagonist! Get ready to unravel puzzles and explore dungeons full of surprises!

Beat 'Em Down is a First Person Shooter rhythm game where you shoot and play to the rhythm of the music. Select your song and upgrade your weapon through challenges by killing enemies. Are you ready? Beat them down!
Mahluk is a hack and slash platformer game with pixel-art style graphics and retro style addicting gameplay.

CreaVures est un jeu de puzzle-plateforme dans une forêt magique. Vous incarnez cinq différents "Creavures", de minuscules créatures mythiques qui ont chacune une capacité naturelle unique. Votre Creavures doit voyager en profondeur dans la forêt à l'agonie, en utilisant leurs capacités, seul ou en tandem afin de recueillir...

Extremely Realistic Siege Warfare Simulator est un jeu de stratégie tactique basé sur la physique où vous devez diriger une force militaire dans un monde médiéval fantastique. Construisez votre armée. Construisez des équipements de siège. Vivez des batailles épiques.

A few months have passed since the death of my son, Simon. Ever since that tragic day, I find myself falling into the darkest emotions I could ever imagine. I am haunted everyday with what I have done; But sometimes, I am haunted by more than just my emotions...
Lost in Space is an open space survival adventure game. You have received a distress signal from a spacecraft.
Combattez les robots rebelles avec vos amis et sauvez les planètes de l'invasion.

Ittle and Tippsie crash onto yet another island filled with loot, puzzles and mysterious inhabitants! With the help of a magical map, they set out to steal eight pieces of a raft from increasingly improbable locations including beaches, prairies, an art exhibit and some dude's basement.
Become Mori and Avoid the scary nurse! Escape from the hospital!

titre: Mythos Ever After: A Cthulhu Dating Sim
description: Just your average cosmic horror dating sim.

Sequel to the equally-popular Impossible Mission, this classic 1980s action platformer sees you tasked with infiltrating a futuristic fortress, built to keep safe malicious mastermind Elvin Atombender. Now available on Steam for the first time, responsibility for saving the world rests with YOU!

Become the spirits of the land, and defend the island from colonizing Invaders spreading blight and destruction! Your spirits work with the native islanders to increase your power and drive the invading colonists from your island in this strategic area-control game.
Slay monsters. Defeat epic bosses. Collect magical gear. Become a Warlock and save the universe.
Découvrez les obscurs secrets d'une métropole embrouillée et réaliste et affrontez des ennemis diaboliques avec votre fidèle Gunbrella, un parapluie pare-balles doublé d'une arme à feu.

Yarrrrrr! Scarlett is back in an all-new Farm Frenzy adventure that puts the fun back in farming! Guide the red-haired beauty as she sets aside her vacation plans to help the animals of an abandoned island learn to provide for themselves.

Kor is a retro RPG with a variety of eccentric characters, goofy dialog, and turn-based combat where - in addition to strategizing - players must skillfully execute button combos in order to make attacks!

VirZOOM Arcade is a collection of virtual reality sports for the VirZOOM bike controller. Your pedaling and leaning propel you through race tracks, battle grounds, and soaring skies. Play online live or against ghost players.

titre: Why Am I Dead At Sea
description: Why Am I Dead At Sea is an adventure game where you solve the mystery of your own murder. As a ghost, you will have to possess people and use them to investigate your surroundings. But in this place no one is who they seem...and everyone has a secret.

ROOT is a cyber espionage themed hardcore stealth FPS that lets you play it how you want: whether creeping along corridors undetected or bursting into rooms to blow away all adversaries. Cyber terrorism is a dangerous profession, and risks have real consequences.

Wing IDE is a development environment for the Python programming language. Its powerful editor and debugger speed up development of Python code for Maya, MotionBuilder, NUKE, Blender, Source Filmmaker, and other Python-based applications, game engines, and libraries.

Blacktop Hoops is the ultimate VR basketball game and sports experience. Embark on a hoops journey in career mode, ball against bots, hang out with friends in online courts, or climb the rankings in competitive pickup games. Do you have what it takes to become the GOAT?

This game serves as a prequel chapter for the upcoming game 'Lake Haven'. Detective Zeke Reynold is called to investigate what he assumes will be another case he'll quickly forget, but what he finds will be sewn into the fabric of his existence forever.
Funny AntiVirus TD is a Tower Defence Game with 10 kinds of Tower and over 50 kinds of Virus ,you need make a plan of build Tower and pass every level

Grab the Bottle est un jeu de casse-tête que vous devez résoudre à l'aide d'un bras qui s'étire à l'infini, et dans lequel vous devez attraper et lâcher des objets tout au long des différents niveaux.

It's space surf season, year 2183. And as usual, the planet is about to explode! You have only 3 minutes to surf its last wave, get enough energy crystals for your hyper-foil board to get you out in one piece. Will you be able to make it to the next planet?
SuperBrainCube! Your color cube puzzle clicker in space with great soundtrack.

titre: Edna & Harvey: The Breakout - Anniversary Edition
description: C'est le retour d'Edna & Harvey ! Le jeu d'aventure primé revient avec des graphismes haute résolution, une technologie de pointe, des commandes intuitives... Plongez-vous dans la version remasterisée de ce jeu culte et décalé !

“Glimmer in Mirror”,dans un jeu de tir d'action en avion, incarnez le protagoniste Shiro dans le monde immersif dans le miroir pour dérouler une histoire d'aventure émouvante, et continuez à explorer et à découvrir progressivement la vérité du monde poussiéreux dans le miroir.

Command: Modern Operations is the next generation in cross-domain modern wargaming. It enables you to simulate every military engagement from post World War II to the present day and beyond. The scale is primarily tactical/operational, although strategic scale operations are also possible.
A frantic adventure. Welcome to the Upturned Inn: a grand hotel for the dead! You just want to find your room.

Lucent Bounds est un petit jeu de plateforme en 3D qui stimulera vos neurones. Sautez, foncez, glissez et balancez-vous pour explorer une planète aquatique inconnue. Évitez les dangers, récupérez des trésors et repoussez vos limites en allant le plus vite possible.

Dandelion -Wishes brought to you- is a female-oriented game developed by Cheritz. The game was released in South Korea in August, 2012. The English translation for Dandelion was released on Nov, 2012. Dandelion is known as a unique dating simulation with a sensational storyline and charming characters.

We're happy to present a new game in the Alien Shooter universe! Get prepared to unique tactical gameplay, lots of monster types and 8 fighter types allowing you create your own style of completing missions and defeating bosses.

titre: DYNASTY WARRIORS 7: Xtreme Legends Definitive Edition
description: Les nouveaux modes et éléments de "Xtreme Legends", y compris le contenu téléchargeable, ont été ajoutés au jeu d'action à un contre mille "DYNASTY WARRIORS 7" afin de vous proposer un jeu énorme à un prix raisonnable !
Spheria is a simple arcade game where you roll your POWERFUL BALL through stages of mystique and wonder.
Dark Blue Dungeon est un jeu d'aventure inspiré des jeux de rôle de type D&D

This is a platform jumping game with unique gameplay. In the world of punk, you can control and rotate space, but you can never escape the shackles of gravity. Explore secrets, and find out the truth. Release your soul bound by gravity.

Join Renata as she adventures across a world of mystical ruins with the titular FROGUN! Frogun is an old-school platformer with the soul of the PS1/N64 era, in which your frog-shaped grappling hook is a your best friend!
CantEscapeTheBackrooms is a single player horror game. Explore numerous treacherous and dangerous levels, avoid contact with evil entities, and do whatever it takes to find your way out!
Fever Dream: Escape the nightmare 'Ignatius' has trapped your soul in. Survival is key. You aren't alone in the dream, but only you have the power to escape!
What lies beneath the skies? Can the truth be too much to bear? Play as Annie and her friends in this epic old-school RPG developed by Aldorlea Games, and find out!

Action STG with 2 types of perspectives. Commence operations! His only partner “Rose” broke down from the impact of the spaceship’s crash landing. Find a way to repair Rose by defeating enemies with various skills and equipment!

titre: Red Spider3: A Heroine Never Dies
description: Red Spider 3: A Heroine Never Dies is a Kong Noir style Visual Novel.ボイス総収録時間12.9時間！同人ゲームオブ・ザ・イヤーにて【主演女優部門】【熱部門】【泣き部門】【作曲部門】の4部門にノミネート！

La chanteuse virtuelle mondialement connue Hatsune Miku vous invite sur scène dans son jeu de musique VR ! Visez la perfection en chantant et en dansant sur certaines de ses chansons les plus emblématiques.

Starring a cast of beloved Disney characters, The Disney Afternoon Collection takes you back to a golden era of gaming and afternoons filled with adventure. All six classic games feature new and improved visuals and include filtering options that replicate a retro look and feel.

"Alien Marauder" est un jeu de stratégie en temps réel sur le thème de la survie et de la confrontation.Dans ce jeu, vous serez le leader d'une planète extraterrestre dangereuse, construisant et défendant des bases contre les vagues Vexan.Prenez la bonne décision!

Prenez la direction d’une équipe cycliste professionnelle : maîtrise du budget, recrutement des jeunes talents, entrainements des cyclistes, et élaboration de la stratégie de course. Jouez des coudes pour atteindre le sommet du classement mondial !

Vous avez été invité à rejoindre une école de magique. Vous pouvez vous faire de nouveaux amis, apprendre des sorts, subir des examens, participez aux cours et trouver un(e) cavalier(e) pour le Bal de fin d'année.
Create a thriving space station in a lost sector. Face thrilling challenges head-on, from pirate raids to asteroid impacts, as you lead your company to new heights.

For the first time in the West you can experience La Pucelle: Ragnarok, now loaded with lots of extra content including new scenarios, new recruits, and DLC characters! It even has new voices, new music, and quick travel, dood!
That’s a great space puzzle to challenge your brain. Try to get through all of the rooms!

Aventúrate a través de un mundo oceánico en constante cambio que evoluciona la forma en que interactúas con el agua. Únete a tus amigos para nadar, navegar y volar para encontrar nuevas islas con recursos únicos para construir, crear y sobrevivir.

Échappez aux chaînes de la destinée dans ce RPG basé sur les mythes et légendes celtiques. Vivez une aventure palpitante aux côtés de compagnons mortels et d'alliés immortels tout en explorant le monde de The Waylanders.
Feral Fury est un jeu de tir ”Twin stick” de type ”rogue-lite”."Que le sol que nous conquérons puisse nourrir les saintes graines du Grand Bambou"
一份工作，让秦幽羽的父亲从此失踪，紧接着又是母亲的突然离去。虽然从未放弃过寻找，可是事情却毫无进展，直到那天……
Parler de l'histoire "5 millions années d'un mammouth" en 5 minutes.
An easy to use tool which uses free, open art, allowing you to easily make thousands of unique character sprite sheets for your game or project.

Tank Universal is an action FPS tank wargame inspired by Tron and Battlezone. Explore a rich virtual sci-fi 3D world, and take part in large-scale tank combat between your AI allies and the forces of an evil dictator.

titre: SEASON OF MYSTERY: The Cherry Blossom Murders
description: Richard, votre mari, est étendu mort sous les cerisiers fleuris du japon ancestral et la police n’apporte aucune aide. Gravez votre nom dans l’histoire et dévoilez la vérité que personne ne veut savoir. Trouvez des indices malicieusement bien cachés, explorez des lieux exotiques et traduisez l’assassin en justice !

titre: Nancy Drew®: Secrets Can Kill REMASTERED
description: Play the Game that Started the Award-Winning Series!
Die...and then die again in Ocelot Sunrise, the action roguelite with a dark and atmospheric comic art style and extra-galactic weapon combinations! Help is on the way, but can you survive?
1920 ans. New York. Ville de grands espoirs et de rêves brisés, d'amis et de traîtres. Un humble gars, Christopher, le fils d'un travailleur portuaire, peut-il réaliser son rêve américain?
MXGP2 - The Official Motocross Videogame est l'évolution du jeu de motocross précédent de Milestone, MXGP. Le jeu se base sur la licence de 2015 FIM Motocross World Championship.
Antaria Online is a Cross-Platform MMORPG being developed with community feedback.
Tiny Toyfare is a Tower Defense/FPS hybrid with a focus on strategic calm followed by twitch action. Construct powerful towers, recruit adorable squads and fight off the Dino invasion!
Uncover the truth behind a world plagued by monstrosities in a fantasy 2D turn-based JRPG with strategic combat, skill customization, and story-rich exploration.

Supreme Ruler 2020 Gold contient Supreme Ruler 2020 et son extension, Global Crisis:SUPREME RULER 2020 Le dollars chute sur les places boursières et l'effet est mondial. La crise économique s'amplifie et le monde est au bord du chaos. L'anarchie est globalisée et le monde à besoin d'un leader. Le temps est venu pour vous d'agir.
Zombiefielders! Your mission is to open portals to attract stronger zombies and evacuate from the field. Work with your manager to reduce operational risks and get paid for completing your contract
a two-player platform-fighter splattered with neon, kinetic movement, and just a sprinkle of bullet time.
À Monoxide City, là où les voitures ne s'arrêtent pas, un seul homme peut aider ces pauvres enfants à traverser la rue.
Super Neo Tanks is an arcade style local multiplayer game where you battle it out in frantic, bullet-filled combat. Dodge, dash, and line up your shots to be the last tank standing!

L'ennemi se déplace dans l'ombre un peu partout à la surface du globe. En tant que membre de la Delta Force, vous faites partie de l'unité la plus secrète et la plus entraînée des État-Unis. Vous avez les moyens pour mettre fin à leurs agissements. Dans les airs, sur terre comme sur mer, menez votre unité à la victoire.

Kult is prequel to Shadows: Heretic Kingdoms originally released in 2005. It is isometric RPG with action combat, engaging storyline and unique RPG system. Kult has been very positively acclaimed by players and called as a sleeper hit by many...

Destruction massive ! Utilisez des armes nucléaires pour détruire des régions. Conditions météorologiques réalistes. Pilotez l'appareil le plus sophistiqué ou bombardez en mode automatique. comprend Les changements de température affectent les conditions de vol. Les changements météo sont : pluie, neige, grêle et vent.

Dans un passé pas si lointain, l'Île d'Abbot a subi un mystérieux événement, une évacuation. Plongez dans les secrets de cet endroit inquiétant et découvrez le destin tragique de ces filles. Un roman visuel interactif aux accents psychologiques et lovecraftiens.
Shrine is a retro FPS game about a skinless dude killing eldritch monstrosities with his nightmarish arsenal.

“Neighboring Islands” – is an exciting graphic novel, key feature of which is an opportunity to take part in its events, directly influencing the development of the plot. Every decision of the player-reader can change the course of the narrative in one direction or another.

Défiez, foudroyez, gelez, assommez et éjectez vos amis dans le plus divin des jeux de course multijoueur ! Explorez les 28 niveaux mythiques du mode solo ou tentez de devenir le plus divin des dieux avec le mode speedrun intégré ! Alors… Relèverez-vous le défi ?

titre: Art of Murder - Hunt for the Puppeteer
description: Pour tenter d’arreter un mystérieux tueur en série qui seme la terreur aux Etats-Unis et en Europe, Nicole Bonnet, agent du FBI, est amenée a enqueter sur le vieux continent. La police ne dispose que d’un seul indice: d’étranges petites poupées vetues a la mode du 18e siecle sont abandonnées sur les scenes de crime.

Dans ce jeu de plateforme vous incarnerez « : » prêt à tout pour parcourir l’Histoire de la typographie, de la préhistoire jusqu’à aujourdhui ! Surmontez les obstacles, échappez à vos ennemis et collectionnez les astérisques, mais attention, le tout sans tomber ! Sortirez-vous indemne de ce voyage ?

Malkin is a hand-drawn, atmospheric, story-rich RPG. A quest to find the blood of a murderer leads a witch into ever deeper mysteries. Expect intricate storylines with multiple endings and combat that poses a balanced challenge. An OGL game.

Plongez dans un champ de bataille stratégique en temps réel ! Déployez des soldats, améliorez votre armée et anéantissez les ennemis ! Et si ça ne suffit pas, lancez-vous dans un mode Zombie de folie avec des pièges, des améliorations délirantes et un gameplay inédit !

In Space Empires: Starfury you are on a wild intergalactic ride through the Space Empires universe. You are an undercover agent for the TCN (Terran Confederation Navy) trying to determine the cause of a recent escalation of pirate attacks in the Neutral territories.

IT’S HERE, FATE FANS! FATE - The Traitor Soul has arrived on Steam! This third game has more loot, more spells, more heroes and, most importantly, more pets. Hit “add to cart” already! Or read on for more details on this classic game.

Path of Achra is a dark fantasy roguelike of the ancient earth, with a focus on streamlined controls and rapid hero customization. A "broken build sandbox." Fight through the deadly lands of Achra to reach the horrors of the Obelisk, and discover what lies beyond...

Dans un monde ravagé par les conflits, la cupidité et la division, l'espoir vient d'au-delà des étoiles. Les extraterrestres sont venus sur Terre, et ils écoutent tout ce que vous dites et le transforment en réalité. Que ferez-vous de tout ce pouvoir soudain? Serez-vous en mesure de sauver le monde?
Découvrez le secret de la réussite dans le secteur de la restauration.

Card Survival: Fantasy Forest is a card-based deep survival simulator and the next installment in the Card Survival Series. Carve yourself a home in a primordial forest that has a will of its own. A day-to-day life simulator in a world where nature reigns with mystery, beauty and sometimes cruelty.

Colorful match-3 game mixed with Doodle God alchemy and world builder. Unleash the power of elements to perform a miracle of creation! Blast these gems of elemental magic and fill your very own world with wonders and marvel! Create the flourishing life full of color, joy and sweetness!
The DOGE is back!
Course automobile en perspective isométrique a voyagé à travers le temps jusqu'à nos jours, dans une reconstitution fidèle des années 90 style arcade machine

Algotica is an educational puzzle game about programming with cute lowpoly graphics. If you wanted to start learning programming but think that it too difficult to understand or just don't have enough time or not sure that you need it - this game is a good start point for you

Classic strategy game from 2003. Run your own casino in the 1970s. It's classy. It's glitzy. It's all yours. Take a gamble. Start small with a slot machine or two. Employ some staff. People will be talking about your place from coast to coast. Includes The Management Expansion Pack.

titre: Prince Maker美少年梦工厂3：重生
description: AlfaGame的美少年梦工厂系列第3代作品， 在架空奇幻世界的故事背景下 体验创新式多互动全性向育成结局的冒险游戏 玩家可以担任其它两位候选人的导师，了解他们的故事。并且可以亲自外出挣钱，养家糊口

Shoot zombies to relieve stress and go back to sleep. Nothing like a peaceful life in the countryside... Forgetting that they were once people helps ease the anxiety. It feels less guilty blowing the brains out of a "non-human".

Strike is inadvertently transported into the past while attempting to repair a mysterious, abandoned clock tower.  Endeavoring to return to the future, Strike must fix both the time machine and the island’s dysfunctional family who are responsible for much of the clock’s disrepair.

Democracy 3 : Afrique est le nouveau stand-alone réinventant Democracy 3, le jeu de stratégie politique culte. D3:A vous permet de prendre les rênes de nombreux pays africains. Votre objectif ? Conduire votre nation sur la voie de la prospérité tout en améliorant le quotidien de vos citoyens pour maintenir votre cote de popularité au...

Join Captain Eldon and his crew in a epic quest to find the treasure of the legendary Pirate King. The mad king had sealed his treasure by four mysterious crystals. Only by breaking those seals will Eldon and his crew gain access to the cave where the legendary treasure is buried.
Hero est désormais devenu un commando. Il a désormais des tâches à accomplir. Terminez les missions rapidement. Laissez votre drapeau être au sommet.

Ever wanted to shoot poisonous lightning lasers? Freezing fireballs? Turrets that fire waves of miniature suns? How about lasers that shoot exploding black holes that suck out your enemies' life force? You can do that all in Magicmaker, the spellcrafting-focused platformer dungeon-crawler!
Pro Pinball, the world's most realistic pinball simulation is back, better than ever! Featuring the first of the ULTRA editions - Pro Pinball: Timeshock!

Your Quest is a casual 2D Strategy/RPG with progressive gameplay where you gather resources to construct a village, craft new weapons and armor, and try to survive the depths of a procedurally generated dungeon under the surface.
In Drizzlepath you are set on a journey to the top of the Mountain of Fire. It aims to be an atmospheric, relaxed and enigmatic experience. Downloadable soundtrack included.

Victory at Sea Pacific is the exciting game of naval RTS combat set during World War II. Bringing an epic approach to real time strategy war gaming, search and destroy enemy fleets across an open world sandbox in a desperate attempt to change the course of history.
Escape Room: Romy Project is a first-person room escape game. Players need to collect clues and solve problems to escape.
99 Waves to Die is a twin stick arcade shooter, inspired by the arcade games, and 8-bit home consoles & computers of the 1980's.
温柔可人的青梅竹马、倔强高配的女上司，了解一下？游走在花丛之间的都市屌丝渣男究竟是要闹哪样？请看他的表演。

Choisissez votre personnage, devenez plus fort et affrontez des vagues infinies d'ennemis ! Mais le combat seul ne suffit pas—tenez sur le cercle magique pendant un certain temps pour gagner. Déplacez-vous stratégiquement et combinez vos compétences pour survivre !

Woodcutter Simulator 2013 allows the player to control and operate an entire lumber mill. From clearing woods to the evacuation of the logs, the player has to undertake all arising tasks to complete numerous missions – from cutting trees for demanding customers to producing woodchips for heating purposes.

Are you looking for a real challenge? Get ready to ultimately test your abilities in various prebuilt or generated Arenas. Me Vs You is the standard to compete and train your skills against yourself or others.
Zet Zillions est un deckbuilder solo de type rogue-like dans lequel vous utilisez vos cartes pour faire des combinaisons déjantées et exploser des planètes entières !

A first-person search-type horror game developed for developers. Use the night vision, rean, slide and other actions to find eight items in the facility. Content that can be gameplayed in a short time.

titre: 告死天使复仇之夜 Death Angel Nightmare
description: Death Angel Nightmare is a traditional RM horror character adventure game with single story and multiple death achievements. The story length is less than 2 hours.Matsushita and Taojing are a loving couple, but they are caught in the chase. Why is this?

Un nouveau jeu de survie roguelite se déroulant dans l'univers fantastique de Pathfinder. Entrez dans Gallowspire, la légendaire tour des ténèbres de Pathfinder, aux côtés de votre intrépide compagnon. Abattez des hordes d'ennemis, améliorez votre arsenal et terrassez des boss redoutables!

10 year ago, five Demon Lords have been sealed into five Saintess. The Saintess disappeared after that. An adventurer finds the Saintess and defeats them to get Demon’s power to save his life. Let’s conquer all Saintess by cutting their Narutal Power!

Watch Pretty Girls go wild in the all-new “Mahjong Solitaire”. Find pairs of tiles to delete them. Delete all tiles before time runs out to clear a round. As you clear stages, the girls get sexier and sexier!
Wyrmsun is a real-time strategy game which features elements of mythology, history and fiction.

Below the Stone is an extraction roguelike about dwarves on the quest for the deepest depths. A place where each and every descent will lead to new adventures -- and where only the most determined dwarves with many lost lives will be rewarded by the hidden world lying below the stone.
A dungeon escape, action game. Play as a captured human forced to work for demons, but one day you decide to make a mad dash for freedom!
Have your favorite character live as a real-time mascot on your Desktop. Interact with it or have it interact with you.

Dans cette future horreur viking, vous vous réveillez dans un sanctuaire d'acier et de béton, construit pour rechercher et exploiter les mondes d'Yggdrasil, et pour abriter un artefact, enterré dans la terre depuis des lustres. Dévoilez les secrets de la mythologie, les artefacts et les royaumes d'Yggdrasil à Apsulov : La fin des dieux.

titre: The Legend of Heroes: Sen no Kiseki I KAI -Thors Military Academy 1204-
description: The Legend of Heroes: Sen no Kiseki role-playing game series is highly acclaimed by gamers all over the world for its elaborate character portrayals and epic storyline. The Legend of Heroes: Sen no Kiseki and The Legend of Heroes: Sen no Kiseki II have sold over 1 million copies in total.

A new milestone in simulation: Citybus Simulator Munich, the successor of the popular City Bus Simulator 2010 - New York, covering the complete 100 line also known as the museum line. Starting at the main Rail Station Nord it passes 22 museums and other sightseeing spots to conclude its journey at Munich´s "Ostbahnhof".
Survolez, atterrissez et débarrassez-vous des zombies au décollage afin de réussir votre mission de sauvetage.

Obtenez une puissance cybernétique et sauvez l'humanité d'une destruction totale ! Le développeur légendaire, Game Freak, vous présente un jeu d'action et d'aventure unique : manipulez le monde qui vous entoure et réduisez le démoniaque Ajeet en pièces !

Piggy Poggy Pog - is quite a complex, nice-looking 2D platformer in which you must escape from the farm playing for a pig named Poggy . In this game you go through the levels, collecting a certain number of acorns.

If you could save someone, how much of yourself would you be willing to sacrifice?Until I Have You aims to recount a thrilling story of regret, love, corruption, and things gone haywire, under the strong, vibrant neon lights of a metropolitan city that just doesn't give a damn.

Vindictive Drive is an Action/Stealth game about Arris Fern's cold blooded revenge against her father, the president of the most powerful nation, for the assassination of her mother. Consumed by hatred, Arris will use the most cruel methods at her disposal to achieve her goal.
这是一款怪谈类剧情游戏。在宏大的原创世界观下你需要一步步探索盛崖小区的“全貌”，你能做到仅仅是依靠“规则”在这里觅得一线生机。你可以假装无事发生，安然度日；也可以想尽办法，逃出生天；或许你也可以直面它，成为它的一部分……但无论如何，请你记住，保持理智，遵守规则。

Insanity VR combines an immersive and intuitive locomotion system in VR, a compelling horror story and escape the room like puzzles with stealth mechanics. As the new intern at a futuristic institute for mental illnesses you get transported into the mind of a patient to reconstruct his memories.
Color Pixel Heroes is an addictive anti-stress pixel art game. Choose from a variety of fun pixel images and follow the numbers to bring them to life. Pixel Coloring has never been this easy!
Devenez le manager sportif d'une équipe de coureurs cyclistes professionnels, et participez à une grande saison 2016 qui vous fera parcourir le monde sur plus de 200 compétitions.
Scrap hunting season has gone wrong, VHS slasher survival horror.

Play as a supernatural gunslinger with the power to redirect bullets and rewind time in this action puzzle game. Travel across different time periods and slay the Reaper's traitorous Heralds. Achieve mastery over time and projectiles.
Brave the Labyrinth and obtain lost powers to overcome great challenges in this Roguelike Dungeon-Crawler adventure.
RC Quadcopter Racing Simulator - Fly (and crash!) all you want regardless of the weather, all for the price of a few replacement props.

titre: The Gods of the Red Planet
description: Your team must uncover the secrets of the Terraforming Center on Mars and face an overwhelming battle for the future of the Red Planet. But remember: every choice you make will shape the outcome of this fight.

Mondealy vous permet de nouer des relations et d'explorer le monde. Un homme ordinaire d'une ville ordinaire, un jour ordinaire, découvre les secrets d'un royaume souterrain extraordinaire situé sous sa maison. Votre aventure commence!
Leons Identität (Leon's Identity) is a first-person adventure game which rigorously unfolds the drifting-off of a young man into the alt-right radical scene and his unexplained disappearance.

titre: Tyrion Cuthbert: Attorney of the Arcane
description: In Tyrion Cuthbert: Attorney of the Arcane, you play as a defense attorney who practices law in a world of fantasy and wizards. You must defend clients accused of various crimes committed using magic and use the rules of magic to prove them innocent.
Perdue, seule et confuse, que fera Kiara avec le nouveau pouvoir qui lui permet de contrôler l'âge de la flore et de la faune, qui lui a été transmis par un obélisque magique ?
MewnBase is a space-cat survival and base-building game. Scavenge around a barren planet for items to keep you fed. Explore and collect resources. Craft items and grow your base to help you survive.

Enfant, son père disait souvent à Laura qu’elle était spéciale. Mais le père de Laura mourut avant sa majorité et Laura ne sut jamais ce que son père entendait par « spéciale ». En mémoire de son père, Laura conserva une amulette, « L’Attrape-rêves ».

The year is 2033. Your name is Tex Murphy, Private Investigator in San Francisco. You've been hired by the beautiful daughter of a university professor to uncover the facts about his death. As you begin your investigation you uncover the deaths of several prominent members of the scientific community.
Un jeu d’aventure court et atmosphérique sur la recherche d’un sens dans un monde qui en est dépourvu.

Complex Strategy Fantasy card game RPG inspired by board games like Mage Knight or Gloomhaven. Combines elements of RPG, light deck-building, puzzle and strategy. Absolutely no micro-transactions, virtual currencies or any of that, ever. Text to speech support for visually impaired on Windows

titre: My Dream is a Lost Memory
description: My dream is a Lost Memory is a short interactive story about having Déjà vu, realizing that this Déjà vu came to you because of a dream, and then wondering if that dream is actually a memory. It's a story about work, limitations and self-respect.
KARAKARA. It is the sound of aridity. It is the sound of dry asphalt and sandy winds. It is the sound of relentless sunshine, as well as the sound of a withering race.

Araha: Curse of Yieun Island est un jeu de survie où vous explorerez une île en incarnant un garçon à la recherche de sa soeur. En partant de l'hôpital abandonné, vous traverserez l'île maudite et ses lieux sinistres comme le sanctuaire du chaman, le cimetière de montagne et bien plus.

Ultimate Godspeed est un jeu de course festif multijoueur. Place des objets sur la piste et sème le chaos dans la course ! Ton objectif est de créer le chemin le plus court pour toi ou le plus tortueux pour tes adversaires.

Loot Collection Mahjong is the perfect game for the casual player looking for fun and extensive gameplay. The goal of this game is to match open pairs of identical tiles and remove them from the board. The game is finished when all pairs of tiles have been removed from the board.

Earth Space Colonies est un jeu de simulation et de stratégie où Il fait construire des colonies spaciales autour du système solaire. Établissez une première colonie autosuffisante sur la planète rouge avec pour objectif ultime de terraformer Mars.
Idol Hands is a strategy game where you gradually take over the world by guiding your people and defeating other gods.

Embark on an interplanetary adventure as the first robo reporter for the Times & Galaxy, the solar system’s most trusted holopaper. You’re just an intern, but if you can get the scoop, write great stories, and impress your colleagues, maybe you'll get to keep your job!
Running on Empty is a minimal yet deep post-apocalyptic role-playing game with resource management mechanics (in 64x64 retro pixel graphics!)

An addictive physics-based vehicle building puzzle game. Build weird and wonderful vehicles using whatever you can find. Master rockets, balloons, parachutes and more. Save as many Keebles as you can, and be quick - the Whale at the End of the World won't wait forever.
L'equlibre du monde est en danger, le peuple a besion d'un Astellien à s'intensifier et mettre fin à l'invasion démonique.Vas-tu repondre à l'appel?

L'édition ultime de Shantae: Half-Genie Hero vous est proposée avec tous les DLC, modes et costumes sortis jusqu'à présent dans une collection épique !  Comprend un maillot de bain bleu exclusif pour le mode plage !

titre: Super Cane Magic ZERO - Legend of the Cane Cane
description: Récupère de l'équipement, mange des pierres, lance des bananes boomerangs et combats une patate géante! Explore un monde immense, débloque + de 15 persos jouables et trouve des tas d'objets et de bonus dans ce jeu d'action-RPG en coop locale pour 1 à 4 joueurs. 8 arènes JCJ locales.
Viral Virar is an arcade running game with beautiful pixel art. Collect and upgrade 5 different runners with unique powers to reach to the end!

titre: Freddi Fish 3: The Case of the Stolen Conch Shell
description: The Great Conch Shell has been stolen and it's up to Freddi Fish and Luther to catch the culprit!

Experience the hit World War 2 real-time strategy game for the first time in full 3D glory, expanding on all strategic and tactical options. Command joint operations of naval, land-based and airborne units on the largest maps in the series.

Le Hidden Hurleur reprend connaissance dans la forêt, et découvre que son monde a basculé. Saurez-vous sauver les Hiddens de l'extinction, organiser la résistance, et reprendre la situation en main ? Devenez l'ombre impitoyable des forêts dans ce jeu de réflexion tour à tour
飛び出そう、いつも通りの弾幕へ それが結果として世界をひっくり返す事になるだろう プリティでデュアリスチックなシューティング幻想！

HeadHorse is your captor and you have a single mission, escape. He is a very intelligent killer with an unmatchable desire for blood is following every single one of your moves, every step, every glimpse of hope you have of escaping, every instant getting closer to his objective, you!

Hero-U : Rogue to Redemption est un jeu d'aventure fantastique et humoristique de Lori et Corey Cole, créateurs de la célèbre série Quest for Glory. Dans le rôle du Roublard Shawn O'Conner, les joueurs exploreront un château hanté et utiliseront leurs compétences pour s'amuser et en tirer profit.

MINDMIST est un jeu d'histoire à la première personne sur l'exploration du côté obscur de l'histoire humaine. Vous visiterez le passé et assisterez à certains des événements historiques qui représentent la façon dont nous, humains, sommes avides et enclins à nous battre.

Apocalive is a third-person wave based zombie shooter, which comes with several different maps. Collect guns, ammo, health packs and use grenades and shoot at explosive barrels to stop the upcoming hordes. Use your rolling, flipping skills to confuse zombies and avoid their attacks.

Enter the world of Narborion Saga: an epic, high fantasy, role-playing game. A mixture of game-book, tactical combat, rogue-like dungeoneering, minigames, and much more ̶ Narborion Saga will satisfy the fans of narrative, story-driven RPGs.[/b]

Эта история о неведомом Звере, терроризировавшем север французской провинции Жеводан в 1764-1767 годах. За 3 года существо совершило порядка 250 нападений на людей, и более 100 из них закончились летальным исходом жертвы.

Vous êtes membre de l'armée U.S. et vous faites partie de la Delta Force qui est l'unité spéciale destinée à combattre le terrorisme. Lorsque toutes les options sont épuisées c'est à vous que l'on fait appel. Comprend Gratuit NovaWorld™: Jusqu'à 50 joueurs en ligne. Atteignez l'objectif en parachute. Utilisez le terrain à votre avantage.

The year was 1999. Something happened that shook the world and it all ended up in the 2nd Dust district of Hong Kong. Big Pharma, Influential Political figures, OP-SEC Corporations, webs of spies with absence of allegiance. The truth is there, its all documented. Just have to connect the dots...
Astro Emporia is a CASUAL turn based randomised trading game where your objective is to make as much money in a limited amount of turns.

You have been captured by the evil witch and forced to play her sadistic game of cat and mouse. Escape 3 separate mazes while contending with the threat of the evil witch. The jump-scares abound in this creepy and atmospheric horror short.

Strategic Mind: The Pacific est une stratégie pas à pas dont les événements se déroulent pendant la Seconde Guerre mondiale et qui présent la guerre entre les États-Unis et l’empire japonais dans l’océan Pacifique avec une précision historique incroyable et attention aux détails. Deux parties. Deux commandants navals. Deux destins.
The Thing : Remastered est une restauration fidèle du jeu de tir culte de 2002 à la troisième personne, inspiré du film d'Universal Pictures de 1982, The Thing, qui définit le genre.
New Age is a turn-based strategy-RPG with nonlinear quests, team PVP turn-based battles, coop mode and open world.

Prêt à conquérir les rues ? BMX Streets vous met le BMX entre les mains. Découvrez la nouvelle génération de jeux BMX avec une physique réaliste, d’innombrables options de personnalisation et des cartes superbes. Entraînez-vous, expérimentez et explorez pour trouver votre style unique et maîtriser les rues.

Agnis, the Scarlet Demonslayer, is the strongest of the demon eradication warriors battling against the calamities that plague the world. But after losing her powers, the nation is defenseless against the otherworldly attacks! To recover her lost magic, she must depend on her assistants to help her!

A detective narrative puzzler without pre-set options! Raise your questions at will, and an AI-host will answer only with 'yes' or 'no.' Drive the investigation with your curiosity; the path to solving the mystery lies in questions you ask. Can you dig out the truth through your questions?

titre: There Is No Light: Enhanced Edition
description: Battez-vous pour vous frayer un chemin dans le sinistre monde Souterrain dans ce jeu de rôle d'action-aventure brutal. Exterminez des hordes d'ennemis, combattez de dangereux boss et explorez le monde comme bon vous semble !
Crush the darkness that is corrupting time itself. Wield mighty artifacts, forge legendary weapons, and conquer the horrors that seek to break you, in this roguelite, dark-fantasy adventure.

Invite your friends over to play this nice lovely game and then.. BAM! Out of nowhere, you scare them to death, leaving them with nothing but paranoia and trust issues! Run, hide, shoot, scream.. try to survive the cursed mansion's creepy environment in this multiplayer (4v1) Psychological Horror.

Conviértete en un matón medieval en el loco Prólogo de un juego de acción de mundo abierto, lleno de referencias a la cultura pop. ¡Completa alocadas misiones, mata héroes, roba caballos, lucha contra los guardias, roba a los campesinos y mucho más! ¡Todo ello con un desarrollo de juego old-school!

Kakeru and his friends uncover the identity of the mastermind behind the incidents in Shiromitsugawa as the story shifts to focus on Noa Yuuki, a girl with a strong sense of justice. What secrets will they uncover about the Artifacts and the bonds that ties them all together?
天裂妖魔出，众神平息乱。《天仙变》是一款以仙侠题材为背景的经典回合制手游。精美丰富的仙境场景刻画，刺激绚丽的战斗画面，让你身临其境感受神魔斗法的刺激和精彩。经典著名的人物齐聚，一同陪伴你征战仙途，想想就热血沸腾。更有拉风强悍的神仙宠代步，扶摇直上九万里！各路妖神鬼怪层出不穷，为祸苍生，等你征服。快来和我一起斩妖除魔吧！
studio: 上海闪速软件发展有限公司

description: Rogue Fable III is a traditional rogue-like game which combines the depth, complexity, and challenge of the genre classics with a shorter, more tightly focused game length.
IsoCubes is an isometric puzzle game. Your goal is to push the green starred cubes on their target cubes that are also green.
Furnish Master est un jeu relaxant qui consiste à décorer des appartements, maisons, zones commerciales et même des lieux extérieurs ! Créer les designs de vos rêves !

Prise au piège à l'intérieur du Paradise Hotel, vous êtes prête à tout pour retrouver votre sœur. Explorez de sombres environnements, récoltez des ressources, et survivez à des rencontres terrifiantes. Cet intense jeu VR d'horreur-survie solo à la narration riche fera monter votre adrénaline.

Nevergrind Online est le RPG d'exploration de donjons multijoueur ultime axé sur la chasse au trésor et le massacre de monstres SANS microtransactions ennuyeuses ! Créez votre propre héros et commencez à gravir les échelons ! Le mode Hardcore est disponible pour ceux qui recherchent le défi ultime !

A Otome game about romancing monks?! All the romanceable characters are monks?! Sweet yet seductive! The untainted body and soul that only you can touch… PS: The game is set in an alternate history with an alternate religion.

Corgi Warlock is a 1-4 player side-scrolling fantasy action game, where one brave Corgi will take on the Skeleton Bunny King's army! Against the power of Narwhals, Fencing Bears, and Crazed Unicorns, it takes more than your average Corgi to survive the King's onslaught... it takes a CORGI WARLOCK.
Have you ever thought what's inside the mind of Dabiz Muñoz? Would you like to experience dreamlike from your seat? Immerse yourself into the Odyssey of Dabiz Muñoz with virtual reality.
In the shadow of a massive earthquake, you must brave a destroyed city where your choices will determine who survives.

titre: 梦落凡尘 Dreams of falling into mortal dust
description: This is a plot based RPG game. The plot of the game is humorous. It tells the story of the protagonists who like Tang poetry and Song Ci all the way chasing their dreams, defeating the devil and saving the world.
CashGrab is a game which redefines the asymmetric horror genre. Grab some friends and get ready for a trip to #ScaryTown! This is literally the best game you'll ever play.
Hidden in Plain Sight is a local-multiplayer stealth party game. Blend into the crowd of AI characters and eliminate the other players before they eliminate you!
CCCP CALLS! is classic communist match 3 game with beautiful anime girl! Light casual gameplay in the best traditions of the genre on the map of Europe. It's easy to learn, and hard to 3 stars!

titre: Ancient Ocean: The Fall of Atlantis
description: Submerge into the ancient ocean of the Cambrian period! Encounter mysterious creatures of times past in this short-and-sweet platforming adventure. Treat yourself to colorful SNES-inspired graphics and an extensive world to explore. Who knows what awaits you?

Memoriapolis est un city builder historique où votre ville évolue de manière organique à travers 5 âges, de l’Antiquité à la Révolution Industrielle. Gérez les ressources, interagissez avec les factions et guidez votre dynastie vers une Merveille finale, en mode facile, moyen ou difficile.

titre: 東方文花帖 ～ Shoot the Bullet.
description: 天狗と妖怪の日常を覗き見られる小劇場シューティング 妖怪の不思議で美しい弾幕を撮れ！撃て！

Dans Godlike Burger, vous tenez le restaurant le plus dingue de la galaxie ! Assommez, empoisonnez et tuez vos clents de mille façon... Et faites-en de la chair à burger. Ne vous en faites pas, les aliens continueront de venir, le cannibalisme est un mets à part.

Explorez, battez-vous et triomphez d'une cité sous-marine en monde ouvert dans un jeu metroidvania non linéaire à l'univers mystique. Découvrez les ruines d'un monde perdu, ses dieux anciens et ses créatures étranges !

Take a 5 minute break to de-stress with this high-intensity, ultra simple, retro arcade shooter! Take down airplanes. Dig tunnels. Hide and seek shelter. Try and beat the highscore. That's all. Afterwards, you will go back to your life with renewed energy of body and mind.

Learn to fly radio controlled (R/C) models with aerofly RC 7. When it comes to learning and improving R/C flying skills, aerofly RC 7 is the number one choice for R/C pilots. Our state of the art physics simulation gives you a stunning level of realism.

Harvest: Massive Encounter est un jeu de stratégie en temps réel avec des batailles dont les proportions sont homériques. Construisez des usines, des machines pour récolter les ressources nécessaires et des tours de combat pour défendre les exploitations des assauts des extraterrestres.

titre: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon® Island Thunder™
description: Ghost Recon place la barre toujours plus haut en matière de réalisme et de combat moderne avec Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon™: Island Thunder™.Cuba, 2009 : Fidel Castro est décédé et les premières élections libres se déroulent alors que les cartels de la drogue préparent une déstabilisation globale.

Here's your chance to strike it rich! Grab as much loot as you can before your pile of coins reaches the top of the window. If you move fast enough to fill the money meter, you'll score a moneybag. Collect enough bags, and you'll join the ranks of the rich and famous.

titre: Tales of Monkey Island Complete Pack: Chapter 5 - Rise of the Pirate God
description: Alors que vous étiez en train de faire passer un sale quart d'heure au pirate LeChuck, GuyBrush Threepwood rependait le mal vaudou dans l'ensemble des caraïbes sans le savoir. Ce mal menace à présent de transformer les pirates en monstres.

What happens when you let your Youtube community make a game? Well, you're looking at it. Chat tells me what to make and so I build it for them. I have no choice but to fulfill their wishes. Don't judge me.

titre: Nancy Drew®: Treasure in the Royal Tower
description: Follow Ancient Clues to Find Marie Antoinette’s Legendary Secret!

Step inside a colossal war machine and experience what it means to be a mech pilot. Control every switch, weapon, and system from the cockpit, customize your mech for battle, and outmaneuver rival pilots in tactical cross-platform multiplayer combat.
Maid Cafe on Electric Street is a leisurely maid cafe adventure set in the otaku haven of Nipponbashi, Osaka.

titre: Tzar: The Burden of the Crown
description: Tzar: The Burden of the Crown is an RTS classic by Haemimont Games, originally released in 2000

Un jeu de puzzle relaxant à base d'hexagones. Une nouvelle version fascinante d'un grand classique sans les devinettes ! Servez-vous de votre esprit de réflexion et de nos mécanismes stimulants pour progresser parmi des centaines de niveaux !
Zombie Survival Game

The Dungeon Beneath est un autobattler roguelike tactique. Rassemblez vos camarades, descendez dans le donjon et traversez les pièces en combattant d'infâmes ennemis. Récupérez des objets et des éléments d'équipement puissants pour créer d'innombrables stratégies.
An action based shooter based in Australia where everything wants to kill you.

Sofi Origins is an independent adventure, suspense, and horror game created by a single person, where you play as Sofi, a girl with a very sad past, but who has powers in her world. Alongside Sofi, you will experience fear and sadness in a unique way, with a story that will captivate you.

Way out is a VR game for sports.You shuttle in the square arrays to get a way out.To get scores to improve ourselves for better achievement.Get up. Let us get fit in VR world. Let’s enjoy moving and shooting in sky, snow, laboratory.
Jeremy have signed contract with the devil. For whatever reason it might be, now he gotta pay the price. And we all know how expensive a devil loan's interest can be.

Monitor camera feeds, report valuable info, and hand-deliver shady packages. An hourly quota of reports will test your keen eye to spot the differences, while timed deliveries will force you outside unexpectedly. Until you clock out for the night almost nowhere is safe.

Survivez, construisez, fabriquez, chassez et explorez l'océan Pacifique en solo ou avec des amis dans cette expérience de survie en accès anticipé. Chaque île possède ses propres ressources uniques, et aucune île n'est identique à une autre.
8-Bit Styled dungeon-crawler wherein you assemble a party from 12 Classes to brave The Depths in search of the Dragon God's Sacred Treasures!

Tools Up! est un jeu vidéo passionnant de type party game qui met à l'épreuve vos talents en rénovation et votre esprit d'équipe. Peignez des murs, arrachez du papier peint et déplacez des canapés à toute vitesse !

L’eau est coupée. Le loyer est en retard, le chauffage est coupé, les emplois sont rares... Il est temps de devenir riche. Participez à la Slaughter League et bravez les dangers dans ce jeu de course en plateforme conçu comme une expérience unique... ou comme un exutoire à votre soif de sang !

Titanic Shipwreck Exploration is a diving simulator and immersive interactive story. With over 6 hours of game-play it you will leave with a greater understanding of the historic tragedy that unfolded in 1912 leading to the sinking of the worlds most famous ship.

Stick 'Em Up 2: Paper Adventures is a run'n'gun/platform game of stick figure characters fighting through beautiful paper and card levels. Fly across city rooftops firing rockets from a helicopter, leap between pirate ships with a sword, race buggies on the moon, and more!

Explore a dynamic world of politics in this turn-based, political simulator. Create a character, run for political office, write legislation, balance budgets, and more as you move up the political hierarchy.

Militia is a tight turn-based strategy game that brings the thrill of victory to single-player. It's simple to pick up, and from the moment you start, you'll be learning and improving -- building your skills, learning new strategies, and ranking up on the single player ladder.
《自豪！美女全攻略》是一款真情真人互动恋爱视觉小说。你，王自豪，一位“躺平废柴”，好像要触底反弹了！睁眼醒来，世界突然开始围绕你运行了。百亿遗产、各色美女近在眼前，是美梦还是危机，你要如何选择？你将在这十余小时的旅途中，与不同角色在多元世界中，体验真实的笑与泪。入梦吧！少年！
The Last Cargo is a dark survival horror - where your road to independence leads through the hell of imprisonment.

Streets of Chaos is a unique strategy/board game where you become the leader of a resistance in an apocalyptic world. Features a randomly generated world each game, high-res graphics and original music, and an open-ended strategy model that evolves and encourages thought and planning.
Devolver Bootleg contains eight original rip-offs of Devolver Digital games. Pay money for it now.

You are at the nexus of the events of 2020; you will hire agents, run political ads, research topics, use hacking, and more in this turn-based political strategy game. In Electioneering, your goal is to ensure your candidate becomes the next President of the United States.

Vous incarnez un observateur surveillant les images de vidéosurveillance. Ce travail anodin prend rapidement une tournure glauque, car des anomalies commencent à apparaître, avec des meubles qui bougent... ou d'eux. Découvrez un univers d'horreur directement issu de creepypastas!

Blood of Magic is a small open world role-playing game with turn-based battles. Other elements include crafting, town management, recruitment, and exploration which help improve your experience in Auguston.

titre: The Official GamingTaylor Game, Great Job!
description: The world renowned GamingTaylor brings you an action packed first person 3D Zombie Shooter! A once great castle has been infected by the plague, it is up to you to clear out the zombie horde!
Time Loader est un jeu mélangeant puzzle et plateformes basé sur la physique, racontant une belle histoire de voyage dans le temps vue à travers les yeux d'un enfant des années 90.

Soar through the sky at intense speed while gracefully dodging perilously close obstacles. Test your reflexes and precision maneuvering ability as you master the challenging but intuitive skill of flight. Greater risk means greater reward!

Mana Chess is a colorful, turn-based adventure with Roguelite progression. Early Access players traverse three unique areas, and ten stages - collecting randomly offered abilities and items. Manage your resources efficiently to clear stages in as few turns as possible, and earn rewards.
When an ancient curse is awakened in an old library, Alfred Walsh must travel to the strangest of places to seek help from many great heroes (and lesser ones) in an effort to save our beloved tales!

Gérez votre arène de gladiateurs dans ce jeu de gestion ultime. Blackthorn Arena revient avec des graphismes améliorés, du nouveau contenu et tous les DLC inclus. L'expérience définitive vous attend !

Botomy is a challenging strategy game where players program their character to compete in online multiplayer battles. Use the built in Javascript editor or run your own controller in any language/framework you like. Can your bot reach level 30?

A medieval turn-based action game with time traveling elements! Travel with your party across the realms and slay many demons, creatures, and other enemies trying to stop you from defeating the Dark Lord!

Sabotage city takes the idea of a city builder and flips it on its head, making a city destroyer game. You are an average citizen hired to work for a gigantic demolition company, little to find out the cities are less than abandoned…

Look Outside est un RPG d'horreur et de survie au sein d'un immeuble, où un mystérieux phénomène transforme quiconque jette un œil par la fenêtre en monstre grotesque. Fouillez le bâtiment en quête de nourriture, de ressources et d'armes dans ce chaos ambiant ponctué d'étranges rencontres.
A photographer enters the Great Pyramids to photograph Pharaoh Rudamon’s remains, but is soon overwhelmed by a sinister curse, as the ancient tomb awakens dark forces that claw at his sanity.
A very simple shooting game. Destroy those colored polygons!

A global catastrophe has literally torn our planet apart, breaking Earth into many pieces. You are the survivor that explores the remains of our planet and investigates the anomalies that have settled upon it. You start out with only a single item: a broken weapon that also functions as a flashlight.

A single player open world sandbox, crafting and survival FPS game set in a multi-island land where you'll fight to survive. Build your base, hunt and craft to defend yourself from aggressive wildlife, enemies or friends. Do you have what it takes to Hold Your Own?

Nous sommes en l'an 2000 et les Nations Unies ont établi plusieurs zones de quarantaine dans le monde pour endiguer la vague d'une pandémie de virus inconnue. Les Nations Unies ont fait appel à une compagnie militaire privée, à des mercenaires hautement qualifiés pour récupérer les données et découvrir le secret de la zone.
Open world multiplayer sandbox/RPG game. Explore, gather, build, research, and fight to protect what's yours -- by yourself or together with your friends.

Prenez les commandes de votre équipe favorite!Pro Rugby Manager 2015 couvre tous les défis d'un réel manager d'équipe de rugby: garantir le succès aussi bien sur le pré que dans les bureaux, pour gagner les plus grands titres!

This is a modern adventure of young adults seeking love and meaning. Return to 2011's Castor Yard, tap on your keyboard, and make those letters dance: Use your online persona to make meaningful decisions for your clients and yourself.

The Last Leviathan est un jeu de création de bateau et de destruction, basé sur les règles de la physique. Lors de votre voyage pour découvrir où se cache le Dernier Léviathan, vous parcourrez un monde rempli de bateaux ennemis, de monstres mythiques, de débris flottants, de casse-tête basés sur la physique et de trésors cachés.

Ashes Cricket is the officially licensed video game of cricket’s greatest rivalry. Bringing all the fast paced action, big hits and skill that you see in the greatest cricket competition on earth, you’ll be able to play in the men’s and women’s 2017/2018 Ashes tours.

The latest visual novel by Tomo Kataoka, the author of Narcissu 1st & 2nd, has arrived! An empty world with endless rain and only one person. Here there is no hunger, sickness or even death. Just what story does this world's one occupant have?

Islet Online is a sandbox-style MMORPG. It is all about digging and placing bricks to build your own land. And with various materials from wildlife, bricks can be combined to make useful items, too. Whenever you act, your character gets experience.
Embark on an adventure that will take you to discover the story of Silver and his friends, each with their own skills and characteristics. A turn-based strategic combat in pure RPG style.

Drop in to the world of two friendly beetles: relaxed Spoko and angry friend Poko. They need your help to transport a ball to their cottage. Are you ready to help them? Remember to collect all diamonds on the way!

Bienvenue dans le monde du cyber-agent ! Il s'agit d'un jeu de tower defense en 3D facile à jouer et chaudement disputé. Utilisez votre souris pour viser l'ennemi, tirez automatiquement et assurez-vous de ne pas être blessé par l'ennemi ! Et de jolies dames pour se battre avec vous !

P.R.O.T.O.C.O.O.L. It is a multiplayer TPS game with fantastic and colorful graphics, developed by a small team. Fight across multiple game modes and ever-growing maps. Take to the Field, Fight and Survive!

Identity is a new breed of massively multiplayer online role-playing game where hundreds of players interact in a world of absolute freedom. It's the actions of players which determine your fate and the fate of the world you live in.

titre: Red Comrades 2: For the Great Justice. Reloaded
description: Sequel to the amazing adventures of two Russian pop-culture legends: Vasily Ivanovich Chapaev and his fellow aide Petka who fearlessly beat off the alien invasion in a first franchise installment.

HordeZ est un rail shooter VR nerveux dans l'esprit de Doom et House of the Dead : abattez des vagues de zombies et de démons, survivez à chaque niveau et transformez votre casque VR en véritable stand de tir arcade.
Galactic Force is a sci-fi FPS loaded with frantic action and lots of firepower.

Heavily Armed is a 3rd person shooter with unrelenting gun battles. You play an amnesiac cyborg in the futuristic metropolis of Grid City. The goal of the game is to discover your identity and uncover the mystery of your hidden human past.

Artemis is designed for anyone who watched Star Trek and dreamed of what it would be like to sit on the bridge of a star ship. Artemis simulates a spaceship bridge by networking several computers together. You cannot play Artemis single-player!
Empêchez que vos sapins de Noël ne soient dévorés par des nuées d'insectes voraces !

A girl awakens in a castle void of color and time, affixed with the Curse of Thorns upon her back. After meeting a sleeping giant, the two work together to escape. Help them unravel the mystery of the thorns and the history behind the somber castle.

titre: Les Aventures de LinShanhai - Chapitre 5:Les trois arbres
description: A child goes missing after school and their whereabouts are unknown. The only clue is that the child had to walk through a forest to get home. The parents suspect that their child may have gotten lost in the forest.

Trahissez vos amis dans ce jeu de coopération et de tromperie sociale pour 5 à 8 personnes dans l'univers de The Walking Dead. Coopérez pour survivre, mais ne faites confiance à personne ! Les traîtres ont tant de moyens de saboter l'équipe que les rôdeurs sont la menace la plus prévisible.
Toufra is a challenging speedrunning game. Your only companion is your trustworthy grapple to manipulate in air. Take on this challenge throughout multiple immersive levels set in dark enviroment.
Help a cute kitten to save Barsikgrad from unkind looter cats and restore peace in a cozy town.

Undead Hunter est un jeu de tir à la première personne réaliste avec une atmosphère sombre et effrayante, créé sur l'Unreal Engine 5. Prenez les armes et partez détruire les morts-vivants. Des morts aux loups-garous et aux démons.

Planet Iridium is a third person, top-down, fantasy, Sci-Fi game. The game is heavily based around colony, economy and base building. Along with close-quarter combat and unique survival systems that will keep you on the edge of your seat as you unveil the deep dark secrets of Planet B58.
A short immersive Virtual Reality experience placed somewhere between Jupiter's moon Europa and Jonah the biblical story.

Bob s'est écrasé sur une étrange planète, il a perdu un tas de pièces de son navire, et surtout il est en retard au travail!Trouver les pièces perdues et reconstruisez votre vaisseau lors de la résolution du défis basé sur la physique.

Return to the world of 4-player co-op survival horror with classic gameplay, strict inventory management, crushing enemies, horrific difficulty and more as you and a group of survivors try to survive the epidemic.

Airheart est un jeu d'aviation dieselpunk bourré d'action, où chaque niveau coloré est construit par-dessus le précédent, montant jusqu'à la stratosphère. Bienvenue à Granaria, une ville volant dans les nuages. Voici Amelia, une jeune pilote et pêcheuse qui rêve d'atteindre les abondantes limites du monde.

Stuck in a remote, abandoned town, you must lead five survivors with conflicting motivations, fragile relationships and fiery prejudices to safety from the roving undead. A sophisticated engine generates new survivors, towns and content so every adventure is a different experience, and you can use built-in editors to add yourself and...
A Top Down Samurai Rogue Lite. Defend a village from an army of Oni.

Exploration de donjon rétro avec un style minimaliste fou. Participez à des affrontements rapides avec les habitants du gigantesque temple alien et prêtez une attention particulière aux chiffres pour résoudre des énigmes et éviter les pièges.
Atomic Reconstruction is a atmospheric Puzzle game, where you have to use the power of fusion and fission to create and modify specific atoms or groups of atoms.
A first person puzzle shooter. Shoot boxes, push bombs, fend off enemies, find a way out of laser-mechanical traps.
Putrefaction 2: Void Walker is fast-paced, hardcore, arcade FPS, inspired by old-school shooters.

King of Seas est un jeu d'action-RPG composé d'un monde mortel de pirates à génération procédurale. Un univers rempli de personnages extraordinaires et de quêtes à en couper le souffle qui vous tiendront ancré pendant que vous ferez tout votre possible pour devenir le roi de tous les pirates.

La redoutable pirate et amoureuse de créatures petites et adorables Nelly Cootalot se voit confier par l'esprit d'un pirate mort la mission d'enquêter sur la mystérieuse disparition d'une flotte d'oiseaux appelés « les bec-cuillères ».
IFU est un film d'horreur psychologique qui raconte l'histoire d'un jeune homme enfermé de force dans le manoir abandonné d'un chirurgien décédé, avec son âme troublée.

7 Bones and 7 Stones - The Ritual is a multiplayer (4vs1) action adventure game where one player takes on the role of a terrible Monster and the other four players play as Villagers, trying to perform a ritual while hiding and running from the Monster.

Vivez la saga d'Uruz! Une aventure d'action épique et fantastique basée sur la mythologie et la culture Turques d'Asie centrale. Explorez les terres en ruines, aidez les gens, petites énigmes,affrontez les monstres et les créatures spirituelles, le tout dans un style 2D classique dessiné à la main.

Noah's Descent into Madness is a short horror-themed adventure and puzzle game. Make your way through a dark forest of unknown horrors while trying your best to escape the nightmare you've found yourself in.

Vigil: Blood Bitterness vous transporte au cœur d'une ancienne civilisation où vous devrez révéler les secrets de votre passé et assouvir votre soif de revanche contre le mal qui consume votre univers. Votre esprit sanguinaire va cependant vous rapprocher de ce mal que vous chercher à annihiler.

titre: The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker
description: YOU are a psychiatrist, trying to solve a murder whilst treating the unusual patients of the recently deceased Doctor Dekker. Type a question - patients reply in full screen video and have questions for you too but be careful what you say. Your words determine their eventual fates, and your own!

Reflection of Mine is a dark puzzle video game about the dissociative identity disorder. The entire game takes place in the broken mind of Lilly Witchgan and the goal is to discover who is real – Lilly herself or one of her many personalities.
Soldiers of the Universe is a Story-Driven First Person Shooter game that tells the story of a group of soldiers fighting against terrorist organizations in the Middle-East.

Collect and train over 100 "monster girls" that come to life in strategic, card-based battles! Strengthen your cards with the First Crush ❤ Rub mode, taking on a hands-on role to warm them up and gain more artwork!
Aurora Nights is an entertaining educational game for learning to identify the constellations.

Are you ready to save the world from a deadly pandemic? Nemesis: Race Against The Pandemic is an action-packed third-person shooter game where you shoot down the bad guys and save the world from a deadly outbreak.

In Slave's Sword 2, Luna, a former aristocratic knight of the Empire, returns as the main character. Now having escaped and liberated the Free City, she once again finds herself in a terrible predicament. Will she be able to escape again? Find out in this sequel to Slave's Sword!

is a game in which you have to find all the cute cats. Cats will hide in all houses. Come into the house and search every corner of the room, move the pillows, open the nightstands, check the toilet... Cats can hide in the most unpredictable places.
Romance, seduce, and even marry your own drawings! Forget about finding true love; In Doodle Date, you create it!

Explore a ghost island dominated by mystical creatures. This game offers an experience that mixes horror and RPG, allowing you to explore every dark corner, solving puzzles, finding files and meeting strange characters.

7Days Origins est un jeu d'histoire solo où l'intrigue change en fonction des choix du joueur. Vous rencontrerez divers personnages dans le monde des morts pendant 7 jours. Vous pourrez devenir des alliés et partir à l'aventure ensemble ou devenir des ennemis et vous battre.

Pathfinder Adventures translates the best-selling Pathfinder Adventure Card Game into an entirely new breed of digital card game, where players adventure collaboratively to battle monsters and villains, and acquire new feats, items, weapons, and allies.

titre: Lost Lands: The Four Horsemen Collector's Edition
description: Les aventures captivantes d'une femme courageuse dont le destin est de combattre les 4 Cavaliers de l'Enfer dans un monde merveilleux. Après des siècles de paix, une nouvelle calamité menace les Terres Perdues. Jetez-vous dans ce nouveau jeu d'énigmes et d'objets cachés captivant !
MaDevil is a singleplayer adventure-rpg in which you are the last sane survivor of a devil-caused apocalypse.

Un bac à sable ouvert dans un monde de science-fiction, à explorer en solo ou multijoueur ! Construisez et gérez vos colonies spatiales et recrutez des colons aux personnalités et compétences uniques. Assemblez, construisez, minez et récoltez… ou partez à la conquête de la galaxie !

The grim reapers Grimm and Rose need your help to defeat a legion of monsters, ghosts, and evil bunnies using the power of words! Letter Quest Remastered is the remake of the Bacon Bandits' first game, now with an endless mode, new soundtrack, and fully animated monsters!

A Giant Robot Stripper called JoJo has smashed Groove City! She's angry because Dr Swinger stole her Laser-Nipples! Help JoJo reclaim her Laser-Nipples & defeat the Evil Plans of Dr.Swinger, with the help of Pope Boris the Super Sexy!

Mahjong Match is the perfect game for the casual player looking for fun and extensive gameplay. The goal of this game is to match open pairs of identical tiles and remove them from the board. The game is finished when all pairs of tiles have been removed from the board.
RUN, ESCAPE, SHOOT, SURVIVE AND FIND THE 5 BOOKS ! An indie Arcade Horror Game.

L'aventure n'est pas terminée. L'ennemi réel a fait son apparition. Le Dr. Wolf a kidnappé ton charmante amie, et tu ne t'arrêtera que lorsqu'elle sera saine et sauve. Pour accomplir ta mission, tu conquérais toutes les épreuves et courais tous les risques.
In the game you need to solve puzzles, run away from evil spirits, do not be eaten by a bloodthirsty creature

It is your job to save the planet from its decay. Only you can prevent an extraterrestrial species from taking over all of humankind. How? By shooting them back to where they belong - into the depths of hell of course!

You got a problem? Yo, she’ll splode it. At the Big Science after-party celebrating the capture of Splosion Man, a spill of champagne shorts out the safety protocols on the splosionatrix and from it emerges Ms. Splosion Man. The latest creation from Twisted Pixel Games, the creators of Splosion Man, The Maw, and Comic Jumper, Ms.

Explore the most prestigious occult school in North America, The Miskatonic University, in a hilarious dark comedy set after the Lovecraft canon, in which the greatest threat to mankind is its own ambitions.

Ruzh Delta Z is a frenzied shoot-em-up which draws inspiration from classics such as Gradius, DoDonPachi, and R-Type. Shoot your way through perilous stages and wreck thousands of rogue vessels in your quest to become the ultimate pilot.
卡牌与RPG结合的无尽地牢探险之旅！最早融合Roguelike与卡牌的游戏之一。多达14种职业，真人配音+纸娃娃系统，完善的卡牌设计，各类魔物与随机事件等你体验！

Avec des décisions cruciales à prendre à chaque instant et des systèmes de sécurité de pointe à déjouer, The Marvellous Miss Take révolutionne le genre du jeu d’infiltration avec un chaos organisé qui tient les joueurs en haleine !
MyMoney is a lightweight, simple accounting software with an easy interface and minimal functionality, including your most basic accounting needs, easy to record your living expenses.

Seditionis - Tower Defense is a sci-fi based infinite TD game with 190+ upgrades to make your gameplay, units, and towers more powerful. 4 tiers of towers in each line, with 20 upgrade levels each. An introductory story gives you a sense of what you're fighting for. After all, this galaxy needs you.

Découvre ces minous, héros du nouveau jeu de go kart ! Surmonte les difficultés des pistes en dérapant à travers les mines et les bombes, stoppe tes adversaires en les faisant exploser avec du chewing-gum et d'autres armes étonnantes.

Un petit jeu exploratoire dans lequel on peut farfouiller les recoins d'un dépanneur (ou épicerie du coin) et trouver le cadeau parfait avec l’aide de sa propriétaire. À moins que ce ne soit le cadeau parfait qui nous trouve?
"The Durka: You will (not) die" is a visual novel in the genre of fur, the plot of which unfolds on the territory of the Russian Federation, in an alternate reality.
Ninja Hanrei est un jeu de plateforme de run and gun en 2D inspiré du Japon ancien mais avec des super pouvoirs.

This is a lovestory+AVG game. What's more appealing except for exquisite CGs, is the famous CV: Aoni. And the fascinating theme song superbly crafted and produced by teaming with Lantis, the Japanese record company famous for cartoon song production.

titre: Leisure Suit Larry 1 - In the Land of the Lounge Lizards
description: “What’s your sign, baby?” - Larry Laffer “Wrong Way.” -any woman.

You're a survivor of "The Parallax Effect". A government run project which took a dark, unforeseen turn for the worst several years ago. You are now left with no memory and seemingly lost in an abandoned world reclaimed by nature, but you might not be alone...

In an all-new 7 Wonders, you’ll take a fantastic journey to some of the most enchanting sites ever dreamed of. With a team of master builders, you’ll match colorful runes to collect the building blocks needed for Camelot, El Dorado, Atlantis, Shangri-La, and many others.

Stop Online is a multiplayer battle of words game where you compete with several players aiming to challenge them on their knowledge of words, trying to be the quickest to respond in order to achieve the highest rank. The words are in your language and you will challenge players in the same language.
It is said that the last frontier is space, but the crew of the Soviet Frigate, The Peresmeshnik, is about to discover that the sea still hides a terrifying secret. Waiting to be found.

Dark Roll est un jeu solo GRATUIT, dans lequel le joueur traverse une série de niveaux conçus de manière unique. Votre agilité sera mise à l'épreuve ainsi que votre logique. Chaque niveau est conçu pour proposer un défi différent.

Out of the Park Baseball 17 - now officially licensed by MLB.com and the MLBPA - is the best baseball strategy game ever created! Guide your favorite MLB franchise to glory, play any historical season or create a fictional baseball world. Play solo or in online leagues. Own the future - rewrite the past!

Rabbit Hole 3D: Steam Edition is a minimalistic retro puzzle game. The game features 3D word puzzles based on Chapter 1 of Alice in Wonderland by Lewis Carroll. Players must navigate through keywords from the book’s initial chapter.
This is a computer desktop girlfriend, Can be placed on the computer desktop, The character's chest has a physical soft effect, Unlock more game content by improving character attributes !
