description: This is a story about a traveler and a girl born in the iron age. Machinery and steam technology have changed people's lives, but also, this was an era of hope, that "magic" is recognized as "Curse". The story of the "Iron Age" has begun——

Tireur de survie à vagues sans fin basé sur la physique. Explorez pour rechercher des armes et des munitions pour aider à vaincre les ennemis, mieux aussi trouver de la nourriture et de l'eau si vous voulez survivre plus longtemps, mais méfiez-vous des trépieds qui traquent les terres.

Try yourself as a PC builder and build your dream PC from 200+ real components!Complete different PC building and PC repair orders to upgrade your business: build a PC from zero, install popular OS', upgrade computers, install different programs and games, fix PC parts, and much more.
Un signal étrange... un vaisseau d'un autre monde... un voyage interplanétaire défiant la gravité, à travers le temps et l'espace.

SECTOR is a simple hardcore classic shooter game that you play the role of Dimitri, he and ​​another scientists made fail biological tests and the infected enemies took possesion of technology evolution. Survive at this severe place, fighting against creatures and solving problems, now you need to place the order.

Shelly "Bombshell" Harrison est de retour dans un road movie interactif d'action à la 1re personne. Embarquez dans une odyssée à travers les États-Unis et utilisez votre arsenal pour sauver l'humanité des griffes de soldats perfides et de vils mutants.

Play Tafl Champions, an ancient form of chess dating all the way back to the Vikings! Capture the defender's king while they guide him to escape the battlefield and to freedom. Challenge your enemies, customise your shield, play on multiple platforms and become the ultimate Tafl Champion!
The Moment We Met is a galgame with the theme on warm. In the game, you will play the part of the hero named Mr. Heh, and share an extraordinary life with an adorable and girl named Quin.

Armez-vous de votre bâton magique et progressez à travers un large monde afin d'y résoudre des puzzles, combattre les forces ennemies et vaincre leurs chefs pour libérer les terres d'Alwa. Mettez à l'épreuve votre adresse dans ce jeu de plateformes aventures 8-Bit aussi charmant qu'exigeant.

The van of justice is an action casual simulation game that contains many physical interaction elements. Knock all the students who bullied kim out. And it's also a good idea to show them around the police van of the police "J". At final, buy a nuke in kim's home and explode the entire school!

In the midst of their hearts, something is blossoming between two students. Both of whom go about their daily lives at an international school in Tokyo. Just what is flowering? Of course, it's love. Starting your new life after transferring into an international school, you find yourself dismayed when it turns out to be the same as any...

⚔️🏰🎲 Roguelite de fantaisie mignon avec des mécaniques de sac à dos. Combinez des objets pour créer des compétences puissantes et utilisez-les dans des combats rapides. Explorez des donjons générés aléatoirement dans le Royaume Souterrain et découvrez les secrets de ses habitants.

Intake is the new retro-futuristic drugstep arcade shooter from Cipher Prime. In this polychromatic love child of Dr. Mario and Ikaruga, you battle a never-ending barrage of pills, pushing your skill and reflexes to the limit to avoid a lethal dosage.
The heroes are back! This is the direct sequel to the 16-bit style RPG hit "Vagrant Hearts"! Find out what happens to Scarllet and her friends in this exciting adventure full of twists and epicness.

Un jeu d’horreur coopératif terrifiant pour 1 à 4 joueurs, dans un manoir maudit. Utilisez vos lampes torches, trouvez des indices et survivez aux horreurs qui vous attendent. Chaque décision compte. Pourrez-vous échapper avant que la malédiction ne vous rattrape ?

titre: 我在疗养院送人上西天 / Last Stand Delivery
description: This is a new Sokoban-like RPG game.Send people love, wish them well, and mind your own business.————Let's them die.
The beautiful, multi-talented Candice DeBébé returns for the sequel to her minor hit, Candice DeBébé's Incredibly Trick Lifestyle, with another magical action RPG.
Chess Knights: Shinobi is an original turn-based puzzle game inspired by Chess. Become a Ninja in feudal Japan and prove your skills in the art of infiltration, sabotage, and assassination.

Perfect Heist is a round-based online game, where the robber team tries to execute a bank robbery without getting noticed, and the cop team tries to prevent it. Robbers hide in plain sight and try to slowly infiltrate the bank while the Cops try to figure out who is a normal customer, and who is a robber!

Voxelgram est un jeu de nonograms en 3D dans lequel vous aurez l'impression de créer des sculptures en trois dimensions en résolvant des puzzles. Révélez les modèles de voxels au fur et à mesure des défis.

The pretty and talented scientist, Konica Yaegaki, must earn money to save her lab from competing companies and peers who seek to destroy her reputation. However, she won't go down that easily. Follow Konica in this slice-of-life RPG as she tries to save her laboratory!

Imagine Pong with 500 balls instead of 1! You can rotate your bat giving you fine control over which way every ball bounces. There are power-ups to collect including: Invisiball, Inversion and of course IMPOSSIBALL. Up to 4 players can play locally in 3 game modes: IMPOSSIBALL, DODGEBALL & LONEBALL.
Rosa Akuma is in love with her childhood friend, Samon Ribasa. Rosa loves him so much that she is ready to defend her love with her fists, challenging all her rivals to a brutal duel.
Galaxy is on fire! Only you can save it! More than 20 modules and even more weapons and equipment,you can design your own spaceship and defeat the most powerful ships in galaxy!

titre: Wars and Warriors: Joan of Arc
description: Relive the most intense battle scenarios of medieval Europe in this third-person 3D epic saga. Brandish your sword as you slay enemies amidst adrenaline-pumping action while you lead your troops to victory.

Aidez l'humanité à se répandre dans le cosmos en explorant de nouveaux mondes, en construisant des usines spatiales, et en établissant des routes commerciales. Combattez d'autres intelligences artificielles se mettant entre vous et votre objectif : atteindre la mise à niveau finale !
BallFrog is a challenging ball rolling platformer with experimental controls! Use your Tongue to grapple and swing.

titre: Maze of Realities: Reflet de lumière Édition Collector
description: Où se trouve la frontière entre la lumière et les ténèbres ? Une météorite s'écrase en Arizona et crée un portail vers un univers parallèle. Oserez-vous explorer les terres étrangères ?
ENGAGE is a pioneering platform offering immersive virtual reality, mixed reality and metaverse solutions for enterprises and educational institutions.
REJOIGNEZ L'ÉQUIPAGE DU NORTHSTAR. Rassemblez votre équipe de Freegunners, des mercenaires de l'espace et jouez avec vos amis sur PlayStation®5 et sur PC* à Concord.

The Old City: Leviathan is an experiment in first person exploration that focuses entirely on story. All that exists is you and the world. Set in a decaying city from a civilization long past, The Old City: Leviathan puts the player in the shoes of a sewer dwelling isolationist.
This is a first person shooter game, you will accompany the young girl, challenge all kinds of secrets, get weapons, destroy the polluted enemies in the secret. Unlock memories.

Dirigez votre commerce de détail. Entre amis ou en solo, signez des contrats avec de grandes marques, commandez des produits, engagez des vendeurs, développez votre magasin, et ne laissez jamais vos clients repartir les mains vides.
The Deal unravels the story of Cyrus, Myrella, Jonathan and Donna, while they traverse through the colorful continent of Carca, in a 10+ hours enthralling adventure!
Keep her calm. Keep her safe. Keep her in the light.

You find yourself trapped alone in a pyramid, being hunted by an Egyptian God. Break containers to find what you need to survive and escape but stay quiet, Shanubis doesn't like trespassers. Just ask the rest of the research team...

Join us for an epic adventure spanning the six realms of man! Build your squad for thrilling tactical match-3 action! Strife plagues the land, and only one bold adventurer has what it takes to unravel the mysteries overtaking the world.

Farabel est un jeu de stratégie au tour par tour qui vous propose de commencer par la fin de l'histoire, et d’inverser toute l’expérience de jeu. Pour gagner à Farabel, être puissant ne sert à rien. Il va falloir être malin !

Minarchy: Active Shooter is a 2D Top-Down Shooter blended with Bullet Hell and just a splash of Tower Defense - all based on the Minarchy Tabletop Role-Playing Game. This is the first video game project created by Andrew Ayala.
The new Sakura Game from winged cloud, Sakura Agent! Date 2 beautiful girls in this agent adventure.

To Your Stations! is a couch co-op spaceship management game where up to four players work together to crew a spaceship. Coordinate the torpedoes, lasers, and shields of your ship to fight off asteroids, aliens, and other deep space entities.

C'est vous l'patron ! Transportez votre chargement et construisez un empire en affrontant les pires conditions. Prenez le volant et appuyez sur le champignon.Chargements extrême - diamants ou tuyaux de forage... à travers des terrains dangereux. Déposez vos chargements - conduisez 25 camions différents et plus de 30 types de chargements.

The Blackjack master-class. Casino Blackjack is an easy-to-understand and effective way to learn blackjack; the rules, the etiquette and ways to develop your game and eventually beat the bank. Casino Blackjack offers the ultimate guide to learning the art of playing and winning a great hand.
Stack the Love of Captain Marine! A Simple yet Exciting 3D Physics Puzzle Game!
A bullet hell shooting game that you can go back in time and use time lapse to always be successful, go back in time whenever you want and show all your skills.
Experience Terror that is Never the Same Twice with Phantasmal, a Lovecraftian survival horror that evolves every time you play!

Submachine is a hand-drawn puzzle adventure game. You find yourself in a vast network of desolate locations containing puzzles, secrets, notes and items to collect to help you along the way. Follow the story of a banished lighthouse keeper to discover his descent into ruins.

Entrez dans la peau d'un membre de l'équipe spéciale d'assaut paranormal et relevez l'impossible. Monstres, démons, fantômes - vous l'appelez, nous l'avons. PRISE DE BEC. - où notre devise est "Combattre des monstres, être payé, mourir horriblement."
Escape a distant planet before it is swallowed by a black hole

Des anime-girls flashy et juteuses t’attendent ! Oui, toi ! Rejoins l’Ordre de la Douche Dorée et déshabille-les toutes ! Un jeu simple mais fascinant mêlant Visual Novel et Match-3. Facile à prendre en main, impossible à lâcher.

Enter a chaotic courtroom where socks play lawyers, prosecutors, and judges! Use absurd evidence, craft wild arguments, and deliver verdicts in this hilarious online party game. Improvise, strategize, and shout "Objection!"—because in Guilty as Sock!, chaos always wins!
You are kidnapped and locked up in Jail. Can you escape? Well, it's not gonna be easy when the Evil Officer is roaming around!
Lazaret is an atmospheric first-person horror game. You play as a member of a rescue team called out to investigate a distress signal coming from a ship that disappeared 4 years ago.

titre: nofio wireless adapter for Valve Index
description: Introducing nofio, a leading hardware company delivering high-performance, immersive hardware. With unmatched image quality and ultra-low latency, our products unlock true immersive experience.

The Slimeking's Tower is an action/roguelike game where you have to explore a procedural generated tower, collect over 300 different items and slay over 100 different enemies in five different gamemodes to retrieve your people's moustaches back from the Slimeking.

Echoes est un jeu narratif 2D où vous incarnez Ricky Fox, détective hanté par la mort de son meilleur ami, Arthur. Plongez dans Greenhearth, une petite ville pleine de secrets et prenez des décisions qui feront basculer votre enquête. Parviendrez-vous à résoudre l'enquête avant de perdre la raison ?

Gryphon Knight Epic est un Shoot’em up médiéval qui mixe les éléments classiques du shoot’em up, l’exploration et des combats de fin de niveau contre des « Boss ». Le jeu raconte l’histoire de Sir Oliver, le chevalier émérite, et de sa monture Aquila, le loyal gryphon. Sir Oliver s’est distingué dans le passé par ses actes de bravoure.

Planet Cracker is a 2D shooting game features physics engine and 3D environment. You must protect a space station from space debris trying to surpass the line of defence. Destroy all debris, and accomplish the most important mission: SURVIVE!

A 2D side-scrolling pixel art action RPG featuring advanced AI companions that fight and move on their own. A heartfelt story about children’s daily lives and small adventures in a world of swords and magic.
Slap The Rocks is a new Top-Down puzzle which will push your brain to the limit. Slap rocks, avoid bushes and flee from stumps! Can you smash your way to the final level?
Dynamic and hardcore runner. Dare to overcome a unpredictable track with a lot of unique challenges. Can you reach the finish line? Can you survive?

Shanghai Summer is an adventure game set in the millennium. Our protagonist, Baichuan, goes through a series of "anomalies" over the length of twelve days. In his pursuit of the truth, he found that his hopes and regrets from the past finally seem to converge. Will he be able to "fix" it for good?

Noir Syndrome is a procedurally generated Detective Murder-Mystery with a new story every time! Featuring slick pixel art animations and a jazzy soundtrack, the player is thrown right in to a highly stylized vision of film noir.

titre: Skylar & Plux: Adventure On Clover Island
description: Skylar & Plux: Adventure on Clover Island is a passionate homage to the 3D platformers of our youth. Go on an action packed adventure, collect gadgets helping you explore a beautiful paradise and save it from evil.

titre: Tales From Space: Mutant Blobs Attack
description: Tales from Space: Mutant Blobs Attack est un jeu de plateforme de science-fiction aux proportions CATACLISMIQUES. Incarnez un blob d'origine extraterrestre, doté de pouvoirs mutants et d'un appétit insatiable.

"Way back home" is a 2D horizontal board horror puzzle game. It takes the Republic of China period from 1905 to 1926 as the background of the times. With a large number of exquisite original paintings, rich playing methods, excellent music and dubbing, delicate script and narrative game style, it creates a strong historical...

« Ensemble, allons-y ! » est un jeu de plateforme amusant et décontracté où vous et vos amis êtes attachés par une corde. Vous partirez à l'aventure à travers des niveaux créatifs et joyeux. Vous pouvez inviter jusqu'à trois amis pour jouer en local ou en coopération en ligne. Qu'attendez-vous ?
A marvellous romance with a hint of murder, where every playthrough is different! Seek love, friendship, or more... intimate encounters. Help a murdered man find justice. And watch out for the bats.

Deadly Land is being reborn! Experience a massive 2.0 overhaul featuring a new loadout system, dynamic weather, and remade animations. Support the development now: Get immediate access to the Classic version today, and receive the massive Rebirth Update for free upon release!

Indie-game in the genre of psychological adventure with the elements of rogue-like and visual novel. A meditative, thought-provoking simulator of an infinitely lonely old professor who’s life and existence are questionable. Confusion, terror and despair are a part of a routine here.

A turn-based RPG set in a dystopian future. With Earth's population decimated and demons roaming the planet, the governing Council decides to outlaw hunting down the beasts. With their administration having failed them, it falls to a small group of rebellious Hunters to keep innocents safe.

The sinister Milkman holds the city of San Cruces in his nasty criminal grip, and it’s up to legendary black belt neurosurgeon Dr. Karate and the rest of the Fist Puncher team to deliver old-school justice to the lawless streets.

Blackbeard is a brave man who fight for honer no matter what the cost. Help him on his adventure to stand against evil. If you love classic platform games or jungle adventure games, or would you like to return to your childhood memory? Our game Blackbeard the Cursed Jungle is the best choice for you.

This is a world overrun with demons and monsters. Thanks to exorcists, those monsters could be suppressed. The source of an exorcist’s energy, if the mana of an exorcist is taken away, her clothes will be torn apart by the monster, so the body is exposed, especially the between the breasts and legs.

Coin Operated Carnage is a single-player rogue-like complemented by a unique tactical fight mode. Lead up to three lovable heroes at a time through tile-based adventures composed of hundreds of unique unlockable game elements interacting with each other.

Survivez à la prison la plus dure de la galaxie et devenez chef d’un gang ! Explorez, combattez, construisez, échangez et apprenez les histoires de vos co-détenus afin de vous évader. Space Prison est un jeu tactique de survie avec des combats tour-par-tour et des mécanismes sociaux de RPG.

Drunk: Relapsed est une aventure en 3D aussi stimulante que comique. Vous devrez trébucher et bondir à travers des rues et des ruelles traîtresses pour atteindre la sécurité de votre maison. Au cours de votre périple, vous pourrez collectionner des boissons pour débloquer de nouvelles tenues.

Highway Madness is a social VR game where you get to play with old and new friends from all over the world! Pick your character then choose from a selection of fun games including Standoff, Road Crossing, Roof jumping and Shootout! So what are you waiting for? Come on in and join the Madness!
Rip out organs and equip them in your own body. Fight biopunk monsters and drugged-up space bandits. You are a Gajeshian Cultist: A near-mythological being built from the bodies of long-dead saints.
New chapter in history of the legendary game, including 10 story missions.

Soulknight Survivor is a topdown action-roguelite game. Survive the waves of enemies to unlock new areas. Level up your character and loot equipment to gain power. Craft new powerful equipment and upgrade the buildings of your hometown. Follow your way to become the Soulknight.
Shrink Assault is a Sci-Fi game featuring a mix of Infinite Runners and Rail Shooter games! Skilfully control your spaceship to dodge obstacles and eliminate the threat! Can you survive?

titre: Hypnagogia 無限の夢 Boundless Dreams
description: Meet colorful characters, discover mysterious secrets, and reassemble the fractured remains of an ethereal crystal as you explore a series of abstract worlds based on dreams, nightmares, and the places in between.
Tu veux tenter ta chance comme manager de e-sport? ESport Manager est un jeu basé sur le concept des compétitions d'eSport, plus particulièrement FPS et MOBA, les plus populaires.
Bienvenue à faire évoluer votre cerveau, mes adorables idiots. Sérieusement, il s'agit d'un jeu multijoueur décontracté et divertissant, avec un peu de remue-méninges. Amusez-vous avec les autres.

Gungrave G.O.R.E est un jeu de tir stylé à la troisième personne, conçu par le studio sud-coréen IGGYMOB, dans lequel vous incarnez Grave, un malfrat revenu d'entre les morts et l'anti-héros dur à cuire de vos rêves. À vous d’exterminer des tonnes d'ennemis dans un ballet sanglant.
BEAM is a challenging precision platformer with puzzle elements in which you need to manipulate various light beams and tightly maneuver MARBLE in order to save both your lives.

The legendary Phantom of the Opera has returned! As Inspector Raoul Montand, you are the only one who can pursue the Red Death into the past and prevent him from terrorizing the present in this point and click mystery.
Be the worst secret agent in the history of secret agents, in this genre-bending rhythm-based spy thriller.
Reveal the story behind the haunted mansion while looking for Sebastian. LIRE is a survival horror video game inspired by old horror RPG maker games "IB" and "The Witch's House".
Pixel Fodder is a old school platformer with a fully destructible world, a large choise of characters, incredible dynamics and gigaliters of 8-bit meat.
Tenez-vous prêt pour l'adrénaline du MotoGP™ 2017 !

Short Circuit VR is an electronics lab simulator in Virtual Reality. You can build your own electronic circuits with the components provided, learn basic electronics by completing challenges and just have fun while experimenting and making awesome projects!
Rock, paper, scissors meet anime turn-based fights and time travel!
COOP Modular tank combat with Rougelike AI generation.

An arcade style flying game, which takes you through a path into an endless city. Follow the trail as much as possible, but don't get greedy. The longer you stay alive, the more points you will get. Beat the high score!
Gérez vos profits, ramassez des chewing-gum, faites des lessives et obtenez des pièces pour débloquer des bornes d'arcade et transformez la laverie familiale en paradis de l'arcade !
Mind controlled cows are headed straight for you. Scavenge, barricade, and defend as long as you can. How long will you survive the dairy onslaught?
LotSK is a kingdom building game, featuring turn based hex grid combat, exploration and resource gathering.
山中狼族崛起，路过的一名修仙者被怪物重重围住，被困山中，黎明前能否突破重围？来体验以一敌百的仙怪大战吧。
Saiko No Sutoka est un jeu de survie d’horreur où vous en tant que protagoniste, vous devez s’échapper et éviter la fille Yandere fou qui veut votre mort.

You will play a commissioned detective in the game. Your client wants you to help find the treasures of his grandfather: a very special book, The client’s book was stolen from the window one night. When you delve into this matter, you find that there are some secrets in it. Even related to an unspeakable race...
q.u.q. is a surreal visual novel about a somewhat crude girl that wanders a desert.
Aliens are invading Earth and are taking out Earths military assets. Join them in the conquest of planet Earth.

Select three cards from a shuffled deck to get a spread for Past, Present, and Future. See how the chosen cards correspond to the Tree of Life sefirot. Provide your feedback as we work on interactive Tarot characters and locations together. Join us in making a meditative immersive Tarot experience.

Dark Bestiary is a turn-based tactic game with RPG elements. The very core of the game consists of continuous and exciting battles with monsters rather than a deep story. So, you will have to explore a rich combat system and discover your character’s possibilities.

This is a classic beauty Blackjack game, which ensures that you can easily start. You can choose different beauties as your opponents according to your own preferences. As long as you succeed in the challenge, you can let the girls dance a hot dance for you.
Meet your engagements with the ones who keep watch on you. Your memories are sealed and soul binds to soft dolls. When the doll opens its eyes, the castle where it appears is under attack...

titre: Armorik the Viking: The Eight Conquests
description: Armorik is a young, courageous and ambitious Viking. With your help and that of Thor, he will try to conquer the eight territories that will allow him to become a legend.

CasinoLife Poker is the most immersive poker game brings you and your avatar to the best realistic table experience. Compete to win! Do you have what it takes to battle your way to the Top and become a Poker Legend?
Incarnez un explorateur de l'espace indépendant et découvrez les mystères de la galaxie!

Deckadance 2 is a DJ mixing application written by a DJ for DJs. Deckadance 2 provides all the necessary tools and features you need to standout above all others! Deckadance 2 can run VST compliant effects and/or softsynths.

Air Guardians is a flight combat game set in the distant future. A world government is attempting to seal their grip on power, and an air force of advanced fighter craft is called upon to fight them. Fly through several different levels, with cut scenes between missions and in game narration.
Normal SHMUP is a strange shoot em' up game based around classic gameplay. Fight the enemies and regain control of the world again.
Depuis l’entrée en vigueur des lois sur la prohibition de 1920 qui interdisent toute fabrication, vente ou transport de boissons alcoolisées, cette ville est devenue le centre du crime organisé.
A fantasy game that combines Tower defense, MOBA, and RPG elements. Tutorial and five game levels. Single-play only.

Partez à la conquête de nids ennemis et guidez votre colonie à travers les périls de la forêt dans ce STR novateur. Les Fourmis est un jeu de stratégie en temps réel photoréaliste à la troisième personne dans lequel vous commandez des légions d'insectes au cours d'affrontements épiques.

Upon her initiation into the Sisters of Exorcism, Sophie is blessed with a sign from the Lord that she is fated to become the next saint. Now, she must overcome her trials for sainthood and seek blessings from various holy sites.

titre: Labyrinth of Refrain: Coven of Dusk
description: C’est la fantastique histoire de la sorcière du Crépuscule Dronya partie à la conquête d’un labyrinthe énigmatique accompagnée d’un mystérieux grimoire et de soldats marionnettes, à la recherche des secrets enfouis sous les décombres de la ville de Refrain...

Loretta is a psychological thriller that makes the player an accessory to the heroine’s crimes, leading her through a self-crafted nightmare. Loretta’s story revolves around a woman handling betrayal, her husband’s infidelity, and reclaiming her agency during the socially tumultuous 1940s.

Supernatural phenomena are on the rise. In MetaPhysical you and up to 5 other friends can go on the hunt for eerie creatures to put an end to their sinister activities! Whether it's an ordinary ghost or a demon, your task is to identify the rumbling creature and then finish it off.

Reprisal Universe places you in charge of the very elements themselves. Raise and lower land to expand your tribes, harness the power of fire and water. Explore the hidden mysteries of the Universe and gather your people together once again.
Shütshimi est un shoot 'em up aléatoire dans lequel vous incarnez un poisson à la détente facile mais à la mémoire courte.

Lève toi et marche ! Après 20 ans le projet légendaire de "Dark Void" est de retour ! Pour commémorer les origines du jeu, Capcom à commander la réalisation du titre original 8 bits intitulé "Dark Void Zero."

Paper Planet is a planet-defender, arcade roguelike with a doodley, Flash-inspired artstyle. Battle through waves of unique enemies and bosses. Combine items with strange and wacky effects for insanely overpowered runs. Play with 1-4 players, for some chaotic co-op fun!

Transformez votre chaîne Twitch en niveau de jeu ! Grimpez dans votre Maskopod et jouez en direct avec l'activité des tchats Twitch ! Survivez aux vagues de textes, d'Émoticodes et d'ennemis pour tenter de vaincre les Blockbossters et de sauver les Maskotios !

Play What The Pros Play! Officially licensed by MLB, the MLB Players Inc. and KBO, Out of the Park Baseball 23 is the newest in the award-winning sports strategy series. A sports fan’s dream come true - and the only game ever to win Metacritic PC Game of the Year Award TWICE.
Simple Roguelite RPG game with incremental progress

<p>Armé de tout votre argent et de vos connaissances en gestion, développez un centre de loisirs dans les règles de l'art à Las Vegas. Il est de notoriété publique que les clients du Strip de Las Vegas sont difficiles à satisfaire. Saurez-vous gagner les cœurs et les portefeuilles de Vegas ?

The Westport Independent is a censorship simulator taking place in a post-war country, governed by the recently elected Loyalist Party. As the editor of one of the last independent newspapers in the country, your job is to remove and edit the content of your paper, affecting the people’s opinion of both the rebels and the Loyalist...

titre: Ashes of Immortality II - Bad Blood
description: The final episode in the Ashes of Immortality saga! Find out what happens to Orlok and Simona, heroes of the series, in this enthralling 16-bit style RPG full of colorful characters.
Help King Arthur and his Knights defend the realm. Slay the evil entities with a combination of lucky dice rolls and clever tactics.
Griefer - is an arkanoid game where you need to break level and don't lost the ball !

Glover is a puzzle-intensive adventure game made up of 6 worlds with 30 different levels. You control a charismatic glove that walks on two fingers, slaps harder than Steve Austin, dribbles faster than Scottie Pippen, and plays with a bouncy rubber ball.
Winding Road is an arcade scoring game. Move along the winding road, change shape and collect points.
Claire Barnes est sur le point de découvrir quel genre d'horreurs se tapissent dans l'obscurité d'une route déserte. Bienvenue dans une nouvelle dimension d'horreur. Bienvenue dans Midnight Scenes.

Mars is under attack! An unknown enemy is dropping bombs on the peaceful red planet. It is up to you to fight off the onslaught so the innocent can escape. Run (umm...slide), jump and blast your way to freedom in the arcade-inspired goodness that is Martian Law. Save Mars!

Où est votre enfant ? Ouvrez les portes qui séparent votre réalité ordinaire d'un monde funeste pour percer le mystère. Explorez les deux mondes pour trouver des indices et résoudre des énigmes. Infiltrez-vous ou affrontez des ennemis cruels et tenez tête à une institution aberrante.

On rainy nights, the serial murderer is on a killing spree. This scares everyone but one girl, the journalist who keeps digging for a promotion. Dauntless, she gets involved deep and wide, hoping to discover the real identify of the rainy night butcher.
A simulation game making fun of Germans needing 16 years to build an airport. Are you able to do better?

Relive Your Childhood Toys comes to life! Build your Army Toys, make battle scenario, watch the Toys battling each other, and customize your play with Attack on Toys Toy Box. Command your Army Toys to fight againts another toys strategically and keep them alive during battle!

C'était censé être une simple affaire de suicide - une inspection rapide et beaucoup de paperasses. Mais plus on s'intéresse à cette île perdue et aux relations familiales de ses propriétaires, plus l'affaire devient complexe et obscure.

Espionnez à travers les caméras, envahissez des vies privées et découvrez des secrets dans ce simulateur de voyeurisme. Bienvenue dans le futur du Primate Observation Club (Club d’observation des primates). En 2099, la règle d'or demeure : DO NOT feed the monkeys ! : NE nourrissez PAS les singes !

InnerSpace est un jeu d'exploration aérien qui prend place dans l'Inverse, un monde de planètes à l'envers dépourvues d'horizon. Élancez-vous dans les cieux anciens et les océans abandonnés pour découvrir l'histoire perdue de ce royaume, sur le point de disparaître, où les dieux sont toujours présents.
Alpha multiplayer game focusing on the local culture and conflicts found within Brazil.

Incarnez, en VR, un extra-terrestre jovial mais amnésique. Explorez l'environnement et interagissez librement avec les habitants. Résolvez des objectifs, combattez et franchissez les parcours pour trouver la vérité ultime.

Skilltree Saga is the first Rogue-like RPG set in Aventuria - the world of The Dark Eye. Choose to play as human, elf or dwarf and battle randomly generated opponents in over 100 stages, developing a set of magical, enhanceable skills.
A fantasy adventure visual novel series--Welcome to your OTHER reality.
Draw a ship, Fly it. Get creative.

titre: Nancy Drew®: Ransom of the Seven Ships
description: Dive into Danger to Rescue Bess from Kidnappers!

In the backyard of the civilization, left by destiny without any hope, you'll find this house on the hill. It will become your shelter and give you everything you need. But then, the owners of the hill will come. And you will pay for this shelter.

Devil's Island est un mélange de FPS Zombie avec des éléments de survie, maintenu dans une atmosphère d'horreur avec des thèmes post-apocalyptiques dans un monde qui a déjà pris fin. C'est un jeu dont l'histoire combine ce qui a longtemps été oublié avec ce qui peut encore venir.

titre: Zombie Kill of the Week - Reborn
description: Zombie Kill of the Week - Reborn is a challenging, fast paced, 2D survival shooter! Featuring a compelling single player survival mode and cooperative multiplayer for up-to four players, this is one zombie firefight you're not going to want to miss!

Par curiosité, je marche vers « la ville où tous les habitants ont disparu ». Soudain, j’entends un bruit et me retourne juste à temps pour voir un petit animal détaler. C’était… un renard ! Maintenant que j’y pense, quel bruit ça fait, un renard ?"KONKONKON" est un jeu d’aventure.

Eternal Hope: Prologue is the first act of a puzzle platformer game. Follow the story of Ti'bi - a boy who must embark on a journey of love and hope in search of his beloved one's soul. This version presents the beginning of Ti'bi's adventure.
Rogue Trooper, le shooter tactique culte et avant-gardiste adapté du célèbre comics, fait son retour en version remasterisée haute définition.
Can you solve the Mirror Mysteries?
A first-person, open-world, horror indie game made entirely in the Blender Game Engine!
I must kill...: Fresh Meat is a light horror story adventure game based on a sad story of a butcher. One day, one night and one accident will bring his misty past and memories to light.
Roof Rage est un jeu de baston original à la Smash inspiré des arts martiaux, qui se passe sur les toits. Se joue jusqu'à 8 joueurs en locale ou 1vs1 en ligne.

Calm Down, Stalin is a game where you directly control your hands to threaten your enemies with nuclear weapons by moving your finger closer to The Button while signing important state papers, answering phone, dealing with your subordinates and fighting the stress of your job by smoking your pipe!

Protégez l'environnement et préservez-le des endommagements ! Donnez des ordres aux animaux, observez leurs rituels et aidez-les à survivre. Faites face aux différents évènements, réagissez à la présence humaine et aidez le règne animal à s'épanouir dans cette expérience environnementale unique !

Rush: A Disney•Pixar Adventure invites families and fans of all ages to experience the worlds of six beloved Disney•Pixar films like never before. Team up with characters from The Incredibles, Ratatouille, Up, Cars, Toy Story, and Finding Dory to solve puzzles and uncover hidden secrets.
They have briefly left by your ship in an asteroid Hagel theirs. Now you have landed to hostile area. Now you must only survive.
A rock paper scissors MMO. Battle sheep, dragons, and other players. Collect cool gear, and become a rock paper scissors master!

Jeu de Chars (Jeu De Rôle + Jeu De Simulation) en Temps Réel, recréant les chars classiques, l'intrigue fantastique de la Seconde Guerre mondiale, pour vous laisser ressentir l'histoire qui remue l'âme, raviver la passion et la détermination sans faille avec une forte volonté.
Un jeu d'assemblage de méchas dans un univers de science-fiction sombre, avec des combats semi-automatiques contre des armes biologiques extraterrestres mutantes.

Dansez un tango de la mort dans Grabity, un jeu de combat en arène qui allie vitesse et lois de la physique. Combattez des robots à l'aide d'armes à feu pour transformer les objets qui vous entourent en projectiles mortels ou en boucliers de fortune, dans une compétition intense et tactique.
Aetherspace is a game about turn-based battles between outlaw gangs. In space. With starships.
Visual novel. Young and pretty nymph Pumpkin fell in love with her mistress.

10 ans après la sortie du jeu original, Legend of Kay - Anniversary est une version entièrement remasterisée : les textures en haute résolution, les nouveaux modèles plus détaillés pour les personnages et des techniques modernes de rendu donnent un nouvel éclat à ce grand classique.

Escape: Malice is a two-player co-op escape room-style puzzle horror game. Swallowed by a sinkhole, you find yourself trapped in a nightmarish Japanese mansion haunted by a sinister presence. Solve twisted puzzles, uncover dark secrets, make unforgiving choices, and descend deeper to escape Malice…
In a silent world where music is outlawed, play as a singer to shatter the strings of fate and sing the melody of freedom in this unforgiving Turn Based Rhythm JRPG.

Have you ever tried playing cards with a bear? But bears don't know how to play cards... That in this incredible game you will feel yourself in the role of a bear who is trying to play cards, but he does not succeed. All he can do is smash everything around and scream GOOOOOL!
StopGate visual novel is created by the community, without the involvement of professionals. This is not just a fanfiction about the authors of the StopGame game portal.

La mystérieuse déesse Isis vous a engagé pour combattre le dieu Set et ses larbins malveillants. La mission n’est pas simple. Servez-vous de votre scarabée mystique pour tirer sur des sphères magiques et détruisez les sphères colorées en les regroupant par trois ou plus.
The Haunted Tunnel is a 2D Top-Down Survival Horror Game based on the story of the Haunted Subway tunnel located in Ohio.

Partez à l'aventure pour devenir un puissant mage samouraï ! À la croisée de l'aventure, du deck-building et de la stratégie, vous choisirez comment suivre la voie de Mahoken. Explorez les Îles célestes, construisez votre deck, défiez des démons et protégez le pays des forces corruptrices.

NEStalgia is an original MORPG inspired by the glory days of traditional console RPGs. Essentially "Dragon Warrior 3 meets World of Warcraft", NEStalgia is an amalgam of the best generations of RPG gaming. You can play solo, in private games with friends, or online with hundreds of other players!

titre: 東方催狐譚 ～ Servants of Harvest Wish
description: Set off on a journey to an autumnal paradise in this bountiful Touhou vertical Bullethell Shmup fan game made by overseas fans!

Experience a mind-bending, psychedelic sensory overload in Dyad! Blast through a reactive audio-visual tube creating a harmonious synthesis of color and sound as you Hook, Graze, and Lance enemies to master Dyad's 27 unique levels.

Le règne chaotique du Premier Sinistre fait trembler les Londoniens ! Sprintez en l’air, courez sur les murs et mettez des coups de poings explosifs à des sbires criards et des boss bagarreurs avec votre gantelet superpuissant qui vous aide à punir les méchants !
Marble World is a physics sandbox simulator with marbles. Create your own marble races, runs and machines. Customize a variety of tracks, decorations and marbles to create a beautiful world.

The year is 2192AD. 40 years ago, the Stellar-class All-purpose Administrative Computer ALLTYNEX suddenly attempted to enact genocide upon mankind. Commandeering armies of unmanned weapons, ALLTYNEX enacted a massacre so terrible that within only 72 hours of the start of the incident, approximately 85% of the world's population had...

Silverfall, une cité au passé glorieux, se dresse dans le royaume fantastique de Nelwë, où défenseurs de la nature et adeptes des sciences se déchirent. Les premiers signes de ce terrible conflit ont commencé à se manifester physiquement sous la forme d'organismes cyberbiologiques et d'automates à vapeur vivants.
A short, interactive visual novel about waking up in a strange room with a mysterious man. But why are you here? Let Him be your Guide to the truth.

titre: Higurashi When They Cry Hou - Ch.2 Watanagashi
description: Higurashi When They Cry is a sound novel. The music, backgrounds and characters work together to create a world that is the stage of a novel for the user to read. They laugh and cry and get angry. The user takes the point of view of the protagonist to experience the story.
The colorful top-down shooter/bullet-hell

Pilotez un mécha nain et chevauchez un dragon dans ce RPG d’action et de survie axé sur la construction de bases. Explorez des îles flottantes, repoussez des vagues d’ennemis corrompus et percez les secrets d’un monde magique brisé. Jouable en solo ou en coopération.

Guilt Free is a visual novel crossed with a point and click made to offer perspective on mental health and eating disorders. Navigate a couple's rocky relationship and encounter "flaws" or "quirks" that may actually be symptomatic behaviors.
Stratèges, en première ligne !Le remake HD d'un classique de la Nintendo DS.Serez-vous assez fin stratège pour sauver le monde ?
一日中夕暮れに染まっている「黄昏ホテル」。そこは、生と死の狭間を彷徨う魂たちが羽を休めるために存在する場所。ある日、ホテルに迷い込んだ少女が、出会いと事件をきっかけに、自らの運命を大きく切り開くことに。生死の狭間で謎解きに挑む、世にも奇妙な異世界脱出アドベンチャーが登場！

The latest in full-scale Tactical RPG receiving great reviews all around the world is finally on PC Steam! Enjoy the ensemble cast of heroes who fought in ancient Japan and capture the best in Tactical RPG consisting an overwhelming game volume of 142 battle stages and 160 hours in total play time.

The Club™, développé par les fameux studios Bizarre Creations, est un nouveau genre de jeu de tir à la troisième personne combinant armes, déplacements rapides, et environnements destructibles. Vous allez combattre pour votre survie dans un jeu contrôlé par une mystérieuse élite. Prenez le contrôle de 8 tueurs différents.
AGGELOS est un action RPG semblant tout droit sorti de l'ère des jeux 16 bits, mais qui se joue comme une merveille des temps modernes !

Frappez des balles de golf surdimensionnées, affrontez vos amis en ligne et grimpez dans les classements. Déverrouillez des améliorations et frayez-vous un chemin vers la gloire dans ce jeu bourré d'action mêlant course et golf.
Play awesome stories with this 12 in 1 Hidden Object Games Bundle : Investigate, solve mysteries in these games with various themes !

Just Deserts is a sci-fi action dating sim where you play as a soldier who must protect a city from mysterious alien attack, while at the same time you will also be seeking to capture the heart of your dream girl(s)! Theme song by Vesuvia [Ecky], vocal track by iMochi

It Lurks Below est un jeu de rôle de survie orienté vers l'action, dans un monde généré aléatoirement. Combattez à travers un imposant donjon sous-terrain, améliorez et personnalisez vos personnages avec l'équipement que vous y trouverez et découvrez quel genre de fléau se cache dans les entrailles de ce monde.

Myth is a puzzle horror multiplayer game that guarantees an intense and headache-inducing experience with friends. Why the headache, you ask? Well, let's just say the puzzles are so mind-bendingly hard, they should come with a complimentary bottle of aspirin!
The tag-team fighting game based on the original "Umineko When They Cry" series, finally released on Steam, in English and with improved rollback netplay!

titre: Armored Battle Crew [World War 1] - Tank Warfare and Crew Management Simulator
description: Armored Battle Crew is a Tank and Crew Management Simulation game, where your skills as a Tank commander is tested. Customize your tank carefully and make strategic battle choices to achieve mission success! The fate of your crew lies in your hands!
Explore a world full of magic, puzzles and enemies in which the main character is the weakest of the game.
Strange Creatures is a 1 to 4 player couch co-op puzzle game where players are curious creatures that use wacky abilities to solve puzzles and escape the wicked lab.
A chess arcade game where you play against the strongest chess engine in the world.

Jamie's Toy Box is a VR playroom simulator heavily inspired by toys and child-like imagination. Interact with all the fun toys and mystery buttons at your disposal or build your dream structure. But do not be fooled, this is more than just a simple room. Let your imagination run free!

This is an old-school tank shooter set in space. Conquer newly discovered moons for Mega Corporation Mining Industry to earn your paycheck and make your parents proud! Win battles with your drone by blowing up your rivals in this retro pixel art game.
An unusual inn simulator fit on a single screen.

The world of Konung is a unique and spacious fantasy land, that combines parts of known history with classical myths and the legends of the Chronicles, including immortal heroes, magical artefacts and ancient sorcery.
Disc Golf Valley is home to some of the most beautiful and challenging disc golf courses in the world. Fill up your disc bag, sign up for tournaments and challenge every course in the Valley.
Updive is a colorful obstacle course game with constant moving, dodging and timer mechanics. Explore 10 courses with different levels of difficulty and types of obstacles.

titre: Just get in through the door
description: This is a first-person puzzle game. All you need to do here is to get in through the door. You need to interact with cubes, elevators, etc.

You’re a highly trained soldier on a mission to infiltrate an alien space station that goes horribly wrong—find your team and discover the hidden truth. Upgrade, Craft, and Discover technologies, Enhance your character’s skills in this gripping turn-based tactical RPG.
A spirit trapped in the mirror, a girl restrained by her elder sister, a younger sister suffering from serious illness.The second wave of NOeSIS and a story of troubled girls and boys.

Blue Fire: Void Maker est un jeu de plateforme et de création de niveaux en 3D. Concevez des niveaux épiques, incroyablement difficiles ou farfelus et partagez-les avec vos amis ! Les possibilités sont infinies dans ce spin-off GRATUIT du célèbre jeu d'action-aventure Blue Fire.

Whenever mist hangs over Lake Orwell, sailors catch sight of a phantom castle just out of reach. As they draw near, it fades away, leaving only questions for all who have seen this “Castle Strangerock.” Now, you must aid your charge in uncovering its secrets...even if it costs you your very soul.

Construisez, optimisez et explorez à votre rythme dans Scorchlands, un city-builder stratégique et détendu. Gérez vos ressources, façonnez l’environnement et développez votre réseau sur une lune volcanique. Pas de pression, juste une logistique satisfaisante et des possibilités infinies.
Asteroids Belt is an arcade game where you have to fly through the asteroid belt in a spaceship, destroying them along the way.

Dozens of enemy tanks, robots and mutants are attacking your Mars bases! In the game, you drive a special tank equipped with the latest technologies. You have a choice of many types of tanks, weapons and additional equipment and reinforcements from an orbital station that you can use in the game.
Solve dice-based puzzles in this Isometric Zen Puzzler. Take control of the dice, explore each level and find all the hidden secrets this world has to offer.

Containment Initiative is a local co-op VR shooter which can be played by two people on the same PC. Kill zombies alone in VR or have a friend cover you by using the mouse and keyboard. Features include realistic weapon reloading as well as a variety of unlockable guns, upgrades, and loot to find.
aerofly FS vous offre un ticket d'entrée pour un monde aérien d'une qualité jamais vue auparavant.
Project Nimbus is a high speed mech action game set in a post apocalyptic world. Players control 'Battle Frames' - humanoid battle suits armed with an arsenal of weapons.

Pulstar is a fast paced arcade game that brings back the basic of its genre. No nonsense, just kill as long as you can to gain the highest score as possible! This concept gives Pulstar the challenge and high replay value real fans of this genre need!

In an uninhabitable Siberian wilderness, in a wake of October Revolution, a group of passengers survives the mysterious catastrophe of Trans-Siberian railway train. They must endure in a harsh ice-clad climate until rescue arrives. Facing many dangers, their own weaknesses and, their own prejudice.
Malhone game fps coop

Cat Simulator is a fun first person-cat video game. Your goal is to chase rats and mice, break things, eat, and do other things that cats do... You will experience the joy of hunting mice and rats while racking up points by knocking things over. Cause as much destruction as you possibly can!

Her Name Was Fire est un twin stick roguelike Tarotpunk où vous débloquez progressivement des sorts et des améliorations pour vaincre des hordes de créatures du vide. Survivez aux 5 étapes du duel et battez les Allégories Majeures.
Que feriez-vous si vous aviez les clés du zoo? World of Zoo est le seul jeu de simulation de vie qui vous emmène au-delà des clôtures et dans l'univers de votre propre zoo.
Les créateurs du titre primé Hyper Light Drifter présentent aujourd’hui l’univers ultra rapide qui défie la gravité de Solar Ash.
Bomb Escape est un jeu d'adresse et de réflexe. Esquivez les bombes, libérez des personnages et prouvez que vous aurez le meilleur score du monde de Bomb Escape !

The Horologist's Legacy is a deep dive into the absurd to find your mysterious past in this indie first-person psychological horror experience that rips the floor out from under you and takes your mind places you've never brought it before.

Une aventure tropicale en monde ouvert. Grimpez, planez, nagez, et naviguez dans un magnifique archipel dans ce bac à sable basé sur la physique. Prenez le contrôle de tous les animaux et objets que vous trouvez, et grattez sur votre ukulélé entièrement jouable.
Une nouvelle version, remasterisée du jeu Panzer Dragoon - fidèle à l'original, avec des graphismes et des contrôles améliorés, qui convaincront les nouveaux joueurs, comme les anciens.
You find yourself in a big empty house. Around the Christmas lights, but no friends, no family, and only bad Santa. Solve the mystery of the protagonist.
A 3D adventure puzzle game

Spacer: Legacies is a game of turn-based tactical combat between small and large capital ships. Recruit skilled captains to command your vessels and choose the abilities that will make them unstoppable. Pursue vengeance in a gripping campaign across the whole of the Tantalus Cluster.
What happens when someone has no magic in a world where everyone has it? Play this quirky, colorful 16-bit style RPG and find out!

titre: Romance of the Three Kingdoms VII with Power Up Kit
description: "Romance of the Three Kingdoms Ⅶ with Power Up Kit" is an expanded version of "Romance of the Three Kingdoms Ⅶ," which was released in 2000 as the 7th game in the series. With "Enjoy the lives of all the Romance Warriors!
上个年代的偏远小城，看电影的时候收到一个“意外”的快递，诡异随着而来……随着故事揭开，发现自己似乎忘了家人往事，自己的命是借来的？

The original Coq of War returns in a glorious explosion of finger-licking fun; with enhanced controls, new upgrade systems, a full single player campaign in “Part 1: The Cockup” with full VO and OST - and a 1- 4 player campaign in “Part 2: The Rescue” with procedurally generated maps.

The free first episode of a dystopian visual novel with RPG elements. Awaken in a secluded academy where students are stripped of their memories, develop your skills, build relationships, and uncover the truth about your past.

This tough energetic 2D platformer challenges you. The plot is fun and the main hero is terribly cute. Gum Guy lives in the drains with his gum family. But the soul calls for adventures. One day our hero gets lost. You become his guide through the dangers and wonders of the city above his home.

The Divine Deception awaits you in Panthea. Will you be able to find the truth? Deduce, brainstorm, fight, and hack your ways through obstacles. But remember: Panthea's story is a game to be bet on. Nothing more.
Get ready for a voxel art action game featuring an unprecedented level of freedom! A whole range of cute girl monsters are waiting to punch, kick, wrap you up, suck your blood, and eat you right up.

Les créateurs d’ABZÛ présentent The Pathless, aventure mystique d’une archère et d’un aigle dans une vaste forêt. Devenez la Chasseuse, maître archer sur une île mystique qui affronte un sort des ténèbres qui menace le monde.
Aim for 1st place! Collect and customize 20 drivers, race to increase your rank, make a comeback with food items and go insanely fast with 5 engine options!

At the end of 1990, there was a murder in Changzhuang community. Both mother and son were killed. The case is full of doubts. According to the clues, you plan to visit the murder scene alone at night, search for evidence, obtain clues, and crack the truth.

Établissez un empire de récolte de données biométriques à partir de rien dans FACEMINER, un clicker-thriller poignant vous plongeant au sein d'une dystopie en l'an 1999. Classifiez des données, améliorez votre infrastructure de minage et épanouissez l'étendue de votre empire de surveillance.

Tiny Combat Arena is an approachable combat flight simulator sporting a stylized look and various game modes. Dogfight your way in the Arena and in Quick Action or craft your own scenarios and take part in a vast war with objectives and friendly armies to support.

Early 90s. You stayed in a quiet hotel for just one night and the next morning you’ve found out that the old world was destroyed. Alien dreams, secrets of your past and other guests that are turning into monsters. This hotel will not let you to check out.

Découvrez ce jeu narratif d'horreur surnaturel multi-récompensé comme jamais auparavant dans sa version intégrale. Pouvez-vous percer le mystère de la montagne Coldblood et retrouver votre père disparu dans cette région sauvage il y a 25 ans ?
Recrutez aventuriers et monstres pour créer votre propre ville façon RPG !
Coincée dans une base de recherche abandonnée et dans l'impossibilité d'être secourue, il vous faudra affronter un blizzard mortel pour regagner votre base.

The Zachtronics Solitaire Collection is here! Inside you will find all seven Zachtronics solitaire games, updated with new 4K graphics, plus one brand new Tarot-themed solitaire variant only available here.
Hexxagon is an abstract strategy board game played on a hexagonal board.

titre: Vestaria Saga II: The Sacred Sword of Silvanister
description: Vestaria Saga II continues the adventures of Zade, bringing the tales of him and his companions to a thrilling, satisfying end. They will encounter allies both new and old while uncovering more mysteries behind the vile Margulites and their plan to plunge Vestaria into a new age of darkness.

Si les graphismes vous importent plus que le contenu, PDO2 est fait pour vous ! Ce fantastique MMORPG old school vous attend avec ses cités légendaires, ses guerres de villages, ses donjons magnifiques, ses missions caravanes et son système qui n'est pas basé sur le pay-to-win.

Enjoy being a farmer between 1950 and 1970 in the Agricultural Simulator – Historical Farming. The game takes you to the good old days and you will experience the charming farming of the 60's and 70's. Fans of nostalgia and history will be glad to work with original designed machines and to till a field with well known Old-timer Tractors.

Edge of War delivers an isometric, turn-based CRPG where the world reacts to you. All side quests are main quests, as every decision matters and impacts the fate of the Northlands. Explore and complete missions, but keep your heroes on their toes: the wilds do not forgive.

Mahjong Destiny is a challenging mahjong game telling the story of a young maiden on her quest to meet up with her loved one. Join her as she embarks on her adventure solving classic Chinese mahjong puzzles.

Ghostlords is a strategic turn-based RPG that tells the story of a post-apocalyptic haunted Great Britain. Experience the new world, capture wild spirits, and put together a team of ghosts to help you battle the forces of evil.
Rokka is an atmospheric Winter War simulator where you achieve a "defensive victory" by shooting incoming enemy soldiers and tanks. The game features adult humor.

titre: City Legends: Piegée Dans Le Miroir Édition Collector
description: Sur la voie de l'écriture du parfait roman surnaturel, soyez prêt à affronter le danger. Êtes-vous prêt à prendre des mesures aussi désespérées ?

Inside the art – Reise der Monaden This VR takes you to the very centre of the monad universe where you’re totally surrounded by the enchanting diversity of the painting’s elements. And you can touch these elements too, play with them, fly them and let them cavort freely through the depths of space.
There is a world which needs your defense. You are the young mage that has just graduated the mages school and you must pass through several hard tests to become a decent defender.

titre: Penny RPG: Shadows of the Lost - A Blood City Tale
description: After waking up in a strange unfamiliar hospital bed after a two year coma, John Smith decides to salvage what's left of his life and live a quiet and peaceful existence. Journey through Chicago with John Smith in this classic noir RPG/ adventure game thriller.

Silver, un sorcier sinistre et corrompu, règne avec une main de fer sur les terres de Jarrah. Avec l’aide de ses sbires, il a enlevé les femmes du village pour honorer son pacte avec le tout-puissant dieu Apocalypse. Désormais, un seul homme peut mettre un terme au règne de Silver et de ses acolytes.
Affrontez votre propre passé surnaturel !

Run an empire in this simple and enjoyable city builder strategy management game. Build, research, train, battle, upgrade, expand, and sail, all while managing your citizens and resources. Advancity focuses on fun and progression.
Explore the lands of Sirenus Bay, God’s Garden, Whitebleak, Fort Ember, God Snare, and the mysterious Immortal’s Abyss. Are you brave enough for this adventure?

Prisonnier d'un conflit galactique, votre capacité de survie sera conditionnée par vos talents de pilotage. Utilisez votre intelligence et votre expérience pour explorer le mode de Tachyon: The Fringe. Comprend Mode solo — Décidez de vos missions et explorez de vastes espaces dans cet univers inexploré.
Huge RPG in the 16-bit style (Final Fantasy, Breath of Fire etc.), featuring an epic, exciting adventure in a fantasy world and packed full of characters (more than 30!), quests and secrets.

Bienvenue dans la dernière ville sur Terre. Tentez de survivre dans le jeu d'action rogue-like Cyberpunk, avec un coop de 1 à 4 joueurs. Frayez-vous un chemin en taillant dans le cloaque infernal de vagabonds et de monstres cybernétiques peuplant les niveaux inférieurs de Geoshelter Alpha.
Celtic Kings: Rage of War is an RTS classic by Haemimont Games, originally released in 2002. It is the first game of the award-winning franchise Celtic Kings

Super CosmoJet is a 2D physics-based action space game. Master gravity and your ship's thrust controls to navigate hazardous star systems, on your quest to find your missing father. Each star system is procedurally generated at runtime, so no two play-throughs are the same!

41 Hours is a first-person shooter dramatic game that follows the narrative of Ethan, a workaholic scientist in search of his long-lost wife. This is a one-hour prologue of the incredible, action-packed journey.

Bullet Wave Est un jeu de tir à la première personne, tout droit sorti des années 90. Rendez-vous à la station spatiale pour combattre des hordes de zombies, des drones de combat et des démons infernaux.
Frenetic spaceship racing game, inspired by the high speed racing games of the 90s.

FurBalls Racing is a challenging, fast-paced, platforming racing game that's fun for all kinds of players! Roll, wall jump, spin drift, take shortcuts, and... shoot poop?... as a squishy, fuzzy FurBall while rushing towards the finish line!... and avoiding poop.

Fight the ghosts through 50 waves of growing danger. Play as a powerful wizard, a mighty warrior, or a strategic builder to stop the ghost invasion. Evolve your character in the direction you want. Survive until dawn, or die trying.

Dans ION ASSAULT les joueurs disposent de milliers de particulers Ion pour pulvériser ce qui apparaît à l'écran !Jouabilité originale : jeu centré autour de la mécanique des fluides. ION ASSAULT ajoute une touche d'arcade avec un style de jeu de tir de l'espace !
Compete over 13 challenging and diverse environments using whatever means necessary to batter and bruise your opponents into submission, and claim victory for yourself!

To escape the city of Starkham and start your new life, your friend Preston sets up a meeting with the local loanshark, Sweaty Mike. After foolishly borrowing $2,000, you embark on a timed mission to sell as many illicit substances as possible. Based on John E. Dell's 1984 classic game Drugwars.
Being a Dark Flame, the flame goes out quickly, you will have little time to find your way out, be smart or learn fast!
Les plus grands succès d'Alawar en un seul set!

Insight est un jeu d'histoire d'horreur solo enveloppé de mystère. Vous prendrez le contrôle de différents personnages pour résoudre des crimes et dévoiler les sombres secrets qui se cachent derrière eux.
Pourvu de nouvelles aptitudes incroyables, revisitez un monde plein de merveilles et lancez-vous dans une nouvelle aventure avec LostWinds 2: Winter of the Melodias, la suite du jeu primé LostWinds.
Warrior Kings: Battles maintains the excitement that made Warrior Kings a leading RTS. It is a stand-alone title that adds a new strategic and tactical dimension to the series.
As an Ethereal Estate agent, your job is to make a mess out of a mansion and its helpless inhabitants. Never before has a ghost unleashed such devastating chaos... until now!

The Red Lantern is a narrative, dog sledding game about survival. You play as the Musher who, along with her team of 5 sled dogs, must find her way home. Care for your dogs, discover their stories, and learn how to navigate the unknowns of the Alaskan wilderness and prepare for your new life.
From the designer and artists behind "Stranded" comes a short story about the intersection of morality and sentience, in a cyberpunk future where both have become commodities.

Infiltrate the depths of an exoplanet mining facility to scavenge for gear and challenge a corrupt megacorporation. Utilize gadgets and equipment in high-stakes stealth, and hone your fighting skills in breakneck combat in this stylish stealth-action dungeon crawler.
Voxel Tanks - un jeu de guerre complexe avec un gameplay dynamique, des graphiques voxel et de la musique électronique.
Échappez-vous ! Explorez des donjons changeants, affrontez des ennemis redoutables et un boss puissant. À chaque étage, les défis s’intensifient. Montrez votre talent et gagnez votre liberté !

Getaway Island is a visual novel where your decisions determine your outcome. Perhaps you'll find the love of your life, or maybe you will return home a loyal man. This decision is yours to make. Maybe being stranded isn't so bad. We hope you enjoy your stay on Getaway Island!
Meridian 59 was the first 3D massively multiplayer game, released in 1996. It's back, and it's free to play!
Save the magical pets from imprisonment! Travel through the most enchanting scenes of a fantasy kingdom.

Waking up in the midst of a stormy night, a tabby cat named Biscuit finds his mom nowhere in sight. Search for her through the eyes of Biscuit, while discovering his past as a research subject in a heartfelt story full of horror and adventure.

This is a retro RPG game, in which players play the role of world-changing changers, and have a special ability - soul alliance, soul alliance is able to sign a contract with the soul of the monster, the ability to fight together, since the future of the world will be changed by you.

Dodge, dip, duck, click and point your way in this retro-arcade death trap! The invaders are approaching, the Mothership needs your help to defend the home systems. Climb aboard, ready your Navigator 3.1X fighter craft and select some targets for the big guy to blow back to hell.
S'introduire la nuit dans un lieu abandonné en pleine forêt.Constater qu'on est pris au piège à l'intérieur.Essayer de s'échapper pour survivre...

titre: Nancy Drew®: Last Train to Blue Moon Canyon
description: Catch this train — it’s your ticket to solving a century-old mystery!

Andromeda is a hybrid between a Space 4X and an MMO. An online universe sandbox with 2 galaxies full of planets to colonize. Build structures like Mines to generate resources to build ships and engage in fleet battles with NPCs and other players, or just sit and chat with the friendly community.

In Eurofighter Typhoon, you are flying the famous Eurofighter on top of Iceland to fight against Russian troops which invade the country and prevent the outbreak of World War III. Quickly outnumbered, the ICEFOR has been abandoned by NATO but has been able to deploy a small number of the new Typhoon aircraft.

Silverfall Earth Awakening est un jeu de rôle au graphisme unique qui vous emmène à la découverte des territoires de Nelwë. Dans ce monde héroïque ou la nature et la technologie entrent en collision il va falloir choisir prudemment son camp. Incarnez une des 6 races dont 2 sont nouvelles : les nains et les hommes-lézard.

Built exclusively for VR, A-Tech Cybernetic's Story Mode will offer hours of explosive fun, while Swarm Mode will test your grit in a sci-fi nightmare scenario. Stop the mutant invasion at a futuristic megacorp, controlling an arsenal of weapons with real life movements!

Des fragments d'une ancienne tablette de pierre ont fait leur apparition aux quatre coins du globe et le Musée a besoin de vous pour localiser ces fragments et trouver la gemme la plus précieuse du monde... le Diamant Monde. Sous les ordres du Musée, vous devez commencer immédiatement votre chasse au trésor.

Gord est un jeu de stratégie et d'aventure solo. Pour survivre dans ce monde de dark fantasy, vous devrez développer votre colonie, mais pour vous imposer, il faudra conquérir les ténèbres par-delà les portes.
From the creators of Treasure Hunter Claire and President Yukino, comes a Stealth Action game where you must dodge traps and enemies to steal the treasures of those who would oppress society.
It is 1965 and the US ground war in Vietnam is in full swing. As a US Army commander, wage a counter-insurgency (COIN) war to secure the Ia Drang valley, on the border with Cambodia.

The IOTA Project is a VR game where you are thrown into the cockpit of a giant mech. Pilot IOTA as you destroy the enemies who have taken over the city using your two giant robot fists and an array of powerful weapons. This is a pre-alpha free demo.
3D Platformer with some basic combat, also added some Bosses to overcome, climb the rise, impress the outer Gods and Transend
Cold Shell is a top-down, sci-fi, arcade brawler with persistent RPG elements. Bash thugs and change wallpapers.

Pipe Mania is a fast-paced puzzle game in which players lay down a set of pipes on a tiled grid in order to keep the Flooze - a constant flowing substance that speeds up with progression - moving through the pipes as long as possible without overflowing

Apprenez plus de 1 000 mots et expressions dans 12 langues - sans abonnement et sans publicité. Explorez un monde ouvert coloré, battez des mini-jeux de vocabulaire et parlez à des PNJ grâce à la reconnaissance vocale réelle. Un apprentissage des langues qui reste gravé dans la mémoire.

COMBINE WEAPONS in the microscopic roguelite turret shooter with macroscopic depth. Survive 6 modes using an astounding array of turrets, perks, mutations and power-ups on this psychedelic journey to the heart of the abyss. Shmup Mode turns it into a vertical shoot 'em up!
Bleed 2 is a relentless arcade action game featuring air-dodging, bullet-reflecting, and tons of bosses. Now with randomly-generated levels and daily challenges, too!

Scoregasm est un jeu de tir incroyable et varié avec des galaxies à explorer. C'est joli, accessible, marrant et plutôt bon ! Frayez-vous un chemin à travers les niveaux variés de la galaxie et utilisez vos compétences pour changer votre route, trouvez de nouveaux niveaux, de nouveaux ennemis, débloquez des défis bonus et combattez les...
Un petit jeu expérimental sur la solitude. Il a été initialement publié en tant que jeu Flash en 2010.

SuperSmash is a physics base multiplayer fighting game.Character is fully driven by physics engine,and there are lots of different weapons and maps.It will provide you totally different battle experience.

Theatre of War 2 : Kursk 1943, jeu de guerre tactique historique et en temps reel accueille les fans d'histoire militaire dans la bataille qui donne un avantage stratégique à l'armée rouge pour le reste de la guerre.

Dans PHOGS!, vous incarnez deux chiens embarqués dans une aventure palpitante truffée d'énigmes. Reliés par un ventre élastique, aboyez, mordez et sautillez pour contourner les obstacles dans trois mondes à thème, Aliments, Sommeil et Jeux, en mode solo ou coopératif.

Le jeu de puzzle du futur est là ! La franchise du best seller Puzzle est de retour avec de nouveaux modes mélangeant jeu de rôle et puzzle. Prenez les commandes en tant que pilote de vaisseau spatial et résolvez l'énigme qui permettra de sauver l'univers. Construisez une flotte de vaisseaux et ajouter des tonnes d'armes différentes.
Help Mona De Lafitte escape from Baron Shrowdy von Kiefer and return to Paris!

“SHOCK TROOPERS ”, the fan favorite 2D top-down view action shooting game released exclusively on NEOGEO MVS in 1997, returns to the battlefield on Steam!Progress through the battlefield, choosing the best routes and strategy!
Avec une variété de mécanismes de jeu, aventurez-vous dans le monde fantastique de Mira, rempli d'atmosphère et d'aventure, et recherchez sa paix intérieure.
Defend base and accompany truck to evacuation point. A lot of enemies, upgrades, bonuses and super weapons!
manage your ammunition and dodge projectiles. Charge with your bayonet and get the highest score.

Sense of reality has not yet returned after a teleportation experiment. Purple hamsters, girls with tails, medieval knights - a fantastic world of an alien planet, where you will lead special forces soldier Maxx.
BroodStar is a classic arcade shmup with roguelike elements. Acquire crazy item combos, encounter strange events and fight challenging bosses on a quest to destroy the living planet, the BroodStar.

An Environmental Puzzle Game About Family, Grit, and Survival.Grays roam the land, largely in the absence of human interference. These aren't your typical Zed -- theirs is a very different sort of apocalypse. Animals spontaneously transform into twisted, violent beings. The earth decays, collapsing into a network of abysses.

Battle Worlds: Kronos est un jeu de stratégie tour par tour classique, dans la veine de Battle Isle, Advance Wars et Panzer General. Vous êtes vous déjà demandé à quoi ressembleraient ces jeux de nos jours? Et bien nous, oui. C'est ainsi que nous avons décidé de développer Battle World: Kronos.

Inspired by the retro glory days of 8-bit games, Rex Rocket is a traditional 2D platformer brought into the 21st century. Paying tribute to classic NES games like Mario, Mega Man, and Metroid, old-school platformer fans will find Rex Rocket a breath of fresh air.

From the veteran puzzle designer behind the classic game Chip's Challenge, comes Chuck’s Challenge 3D 2020, a fiendishly addictive game that’s packed with features that will tease the brain and challenge the fingers.
The king of breakout games is back in a special 20th Anniversary Edition with high-res boards, new power-ups, online leaderboards, a boardset editor and more!

"Life is like a waiting room, except people don't leave in the order they enter." Narcissu is a thought provoking visual novel series about terminal illness, living, dying, and the relationship between those leaving and those left behind. There are no miracles, no heroes, no villains in this story.
Worldless est un jeu de plates-formes d'aventure en 2D stylisé, avec des combats au tour par tour et une narration interprétative époustouflante.

Did you ever pay attention to the importance of space? Space Between Worlds is a short puzzle game that expresses the concept of proximity and lets the player interpret the context and arc of the story.

Darkwater est un jeu d'extraction d'horreur coopératif pour 1 à 4 joueurs. Commandez un sous-marin piégé sous la glace d'une lune inconnue. Combattez des vaisseaux ennemis et des abominations des profondeurs sous-marines tout en cherchant des ressources. Faites tout ce qu'il faut pour survivre.
Experience the thrill of a shmup game like the arcade classics. With just the right amount of story, lots of action, and many, many bullets.

La ville est envahie par des monstres venus d'Upside Down, un monde maléfique ! Vous êtes le Maître des potions et vous seul pouvez vaincre le mal, sans didacticiel ni mode « simple » pour vous aider. Vous ne pourrez compter que sur l'aide de Fäy, une fée qui vous accompagne… et sur vos potions !

Le premier chapitre d'une aventure point-and-click 2D dessinée à la main. Suivez le voyage d'Herman, un garçon qui a vécu les moments les plus tragiques de l'histoire de l'île de Jeju, en Corée. Explorez la magnifique nature sauvage et vivez l'histoire du passage à l'âge adulte.

Castle Flipper est une chance unique de devenir un artisan royal du Moyen Âge. Bâtissez votre propre royaume et réorganisez le château à votre guise. Donnez une toute nouvelle vie aux anciennes pièces et préparez un grand festin pour le roi !
Trapped in a public restroom. You’re not alone. You make bad decisions. Horror-comedy with multiple endings.

titre: Bubble Jungle ® Super Chameleon Platformer World
description: Bounce into Bubble Jungle, a 3D platform game. Travel with Chuck the chameleon through 9 themed worlds and over 58 beautiful levels. Experience 15 hours of addicting gameplay with up to 4 players! Collect coins, candies, and lollipops to power up Chuck and attack your enemies quicker.

Project Kunai is a super fast FPS/Platformer game which you can use special abilities and Kunai. Reach highest speed and complate levels fastest you can. Learn the truth about Project Kunai and your past.
Dungeon Royale is an action-rpg battle-royale with rogue-lite elements. Slay the other adventurers to win the game or die and rebirth as a monster of the dungeon to get your revenge!
Xiaoqing new fault finding game

L'adaptation officielle de Potion Explosion, le jeu de société de puzzle maintes fois récompensé. Faites exploser des ingrédients pour créer des réactions en chaîne et devenir un as du chaudron. Que le meilleur sorcier gagne !

titre: Leisure Suit Larry in the Land of the Lounge Lizards: Reloaded
description: Leisure Suit Larry was first released by Sierra On-Line in 1987 and became an international phenomenon. The lovable loser Larry Laffer -- a 40-year-old virgin in pursuit of losing his vir….um, finding true love -- and risqué humor were unlike anything anyone had ever seen or played.
4つの属性を的確に配置し、相手の駒を奪いましょう。

Up to Gods est un jeu de plateforme monojoueur qui se distingue par son histoire et sa philosophie uniques. Dans un monde où les dieux ont déclaré la guerre à l'humanité, vous prenez le contrôle de l'envoyé envoyé pour négocier avec les dieux.

Quanero is an experimental VR experience for the HTC Vive and the Oculus Rift. Your goal is to figure out what caused a violent incident in a futuristic bar by manipulating the time. You can slow down time, reverse it or bring it to a halt. Explore the scene, unlock the story's branch points and unravel the mystery.
Can you find love as the only boy in an all-girls school? Find out, in this slice-of-life visual novel game with multiple endings.
Cypher is a first person puzzle game about cryptography.

Race to unearth the mystery of a forgotten civilization and rescue your kidnapped fiancé in this atmospheric adventure, suitable for beginners and diehards alike, which features a haunting blend of puzzle-solving and investigation.

Ça manque peut-être de style, mais... Restez en vie.Mangez ou soyez mangés. TOKYO GHOUL:re [CALL to EXIST] est un jeu d'action et survie en coopération qui vous emmène dans le monde excitant de Tokyo Ghoul et Tokyo Ghoul:re.

Enfilez la biocombinaison de Myo Hyori, une jeune Coréenne aux talents surnaturels devant faire face aux périls du futur. Survivez à de nombreux dangers, explorez une métropole titanesque jusqu'aux confins de ce monde aux bords de l'implosion alors que notre histoire s'approche dangereusement de son inévitable conclusion.

Experience the International Space Station in VR with high-quality images and learn about the inner-workings of the Space Station from the European Space Agency's Samantha Cristoforetti, holder of the record for the longest uninterrupted spaceflight by a European astronaut.

Fall of Light est un dungeon crawler à dimension narrative campé dans un monde de désolation, où un vieux guerrier et sa fille bravent les Ténèbres pour admirer les derniers rayons du Soleil. Ce n'est qu'ensemble qu'ils pourront venir à bout de leurs ennemis obscurs.

Nous vivons dans un monde de plus en plus troublé. Les virus, les conflits militaires, les menaces de l'espace - vous ne savez jamais quel danger attend notre monde demain. Dirigez un réseau d'abris et dirigez la prolifération de la société après une catastrophe mondiale.

Visibility is a platformer that is completely dark until you place your lights. Each level has a limited set of lights which you must strategically place around the level in order to illuminate your path to the exit.
Simple and gripping gameplay most commonly as a classical arcade shooter. The game consists of short levels which is perfect for short breaks to relax.

Découvrez SolarGun, un jeu de puzzle en première personne dans une usine aseptique. Utilisez des orbes d'énergie, esquivez les lasers et activez des mécanismes pour échapper. Avec plus de 20 puzzles, des mini-jeux cachés et un mode speedrun, chaque décision est cruciale pour votre liberté.

Contain est un FPS tactique coopératif. Formez une escouade de quatre joueurs pour affronter les anomalies. Essayez de les "contenir" là où la frontière entre l’ordinaire et l’extraordinaire s’efface.

titre: 勇者救魔神—阿奎拉尼大陆战记
description: The demon god, who maintains the order of the demon world, was attacked by several demon kings, causing a large number of demons to freely travel to the human world. Several protagonists with the ability to save the demon god gathered together and exerted their respective powers to end all of this.

Race against up to 7 other players online and create catastrophic chaos with items beyond insanity. Breaking the tradition of single-player, story-based platformers. Interested? This is the brand new 2D platformer experience you want.
Sakura Succubus is a lewd visual novel about amassing a harem of sexy succubi. Featuring a cute idol, a domineering businesswoman, and a spacey social media star, there’s no shortage of women to woo!
