Virtual game for the whole family. You can become a magician in a marvelous world. Take a lot of obstacles and feed the charming dragon by his favorite candies.

Japan, 2030 A.D. Memories can now be digitized and archived, allowing people to communicate with the deceased. With only one week left before his best friend’s memories are deleted, can Hiroki uncover the truth behind Sorano’s death?
Run a fantasy town for adventurers. Save it from monsters. Save it from itself. Watch it crumble to dust. Do it all again.

World of Speed is a next generation online racing game for fans of high speeds and powerful cars. Modern graphics and responsive controls allow players of any level to feel the thrill of modern street racing.

SURVIVE COUNTLESS HORDES, BE A ONE MAN ARMY, DIE AND RETURN STRONGER. Halftime Heroes is a Survival Rogue Action RPG game with short and intense matches where you learn spells, level up, acquire loot and fight bosses. Each time you die you may upgrade or unlock several features.
Holy Purge est un jeu d'horreur coopératif où les joueurs incarnent des prêtres qui exorcisent des démons dans divers scénarios.

Un futur distant... Les meilleurs spectacles sont de brutaux combats de gladiateurs extrêmement populaires dans toute la galaxie. Vous avez été envoyé sur une planète abandonnée en tant que participant au spectacle.
Evopollution is a business strategy game that incorporates the environment into the game.

Plongez dans une perspective à la première personne, traversez le temps et l'espace, résolvez des affaires étranges, sauvez des victimes innocentes et attrapez un tueur mystérieux ! Vous éluciderez des meurtres, ferez régner la justice et gagnerez l'amour. Êtes-vous prêt ?

Cabals combines the strategic deck building of card games and tactics of a chess like board game. The classic collectible card game is now designed from the ground up for PC. Choose your side, build your perfect deck and battle in the War of Cabals to decide the fate of humankind!

An ancient tomb has been uncovered and it's filled with hidden treasures. Solve 15 sets of ancient puzzles and unlock your way to the bottom of the tomb. Each set contains a three by three and six by six puzzle.

Undead Menace est un jeu de plateforme 2D aventureux où vous contrôlez une fille courageuse qui décide de trouver des trésors dans des grottes anciennes, malgré la légende des gardiens immortels. En chemin, elle doit se battre avec les morts-vivants dangereux, éviter les pièges et surmonter les obstacles dangereux.

titre: Ghost Files: The Face of Guilt
description: Menez l’enquête dans l’au-delà !
TAKANARIA is a very simple game created with Pixel art.
Explore a vast world. Manipulate every tile. Build your kingdom. Conquer the elemental dungeons. The moldable world of Tile Miner is at your fingertips!
A blend of old school gameplay and new school controls. Experience a classically styled roguelike in a way you never have before!
Les aventures spatiales vous attendent!

Erin arrives the town of Azuliris, following the path of a mysterous witch, who is rumored, carries with her a very valuable treasure. But Erin's quest is interrumpted when she finds out the town has been taken by a group of bandits, the ShyGirls.

In Thief of Thieves you play as a cat burglar using stealth, social engineering and team members to pull off some high profile heists across the world. Based on the comic book series by Robert Kirkman, it’s time for Celia to make the leap from apprentice to master.

Galactic Command Echo Squad SE is a high-end and very challenging space/planetary combat game. It offers a thrilling campaign, instant action combat sessions as well as a sandbox mode allowing you to explore the game's universe while battling hostile Insurgent forces among others.

titre: Questerium: Sinister Trinity HD Collector's Edition
description: Financed by the banker, the professor builds an evil machine that causes the meteor’s energy to spin out of control, destroying the city and mutating its plants and animals. Citizens are evacuated, but rescuers fail to find and evacuate two children.

In this classic arcade-like game from 1984, take on the role of the mythical hero Ulysses as he performs a series of tasks, set by the gods to prove his worthiness. Test your might against the slopes of Mount Olympus, the Gorgon, Minotaurs, and other monsters.

The mysterious Chinese Tibetan culture and fantastic punk style from the East are elevated from the Potala world of punk Tibet. All attributes, skills, equipment and food can be created at will. The TIANTI arena ranks first in the world, and 10000 people gather to hunt the world boss

Direct Contact delivers an authentic and immersive first-person, Co-Op tactical experience, built for those who demand realism, strategy, and precision. Operate as Special Forces, utilizing a vast arsenal of real-world weapons and equipment. Engage in dynamic combat.

Un Action-RPG en vue de dessus, dans un New York fracturé où la corruption numérique affronte la guerre des corporations. Personnalisez votre agent, maîtrisez le combat et luttez pour reprendre les Seven Cities, un district à la fois.
They got locked up in a prison for a reason. Try to get the answers in this point and click adventure.

A short interactive story for room-scale VR: Become Caliban, the scion of a broken lineage struggling to understand your dark inheritance. Explore the ruins of the family estate, and the incredible realm below seeking clues to your past, and to the events that severed you from your family long ago.

Experience True HEMA Combat in VR. Step beyond button mashing. Death Duel VR uses physics-based leverage to let you authentically execute historical European martial arts techniques against live opponents. Master real guards, leverage, and tactics in heart-pounding PvP duels to the death.

Découvrez le paisible Parc Haven. Construisez vos campings et aménagez-les pour les rendre chaleureux et accueillants. Rencontrez les campeurs et tendez l'oreille: ils auront peut-être des quêtes à vous donner !

Aide le célèbre explorateur et aventurier Adam Venture et sa complice Evelyn à découvrir des artefacts, à révéler d’anciens mystères, à déchiffrer d’étranges symboles et à résoudre des enigmes sur des sites historiques magnifiques tout droit sortis des années 1920.

Use the elements at your disposal, such as excavators, pumps, plumbing, among others, to drill the soil to the indicated location. The dynamic scenario, fluid mechanics and the laws of physics must be manipulated correctly to achieve the goal. Find the city of Underland!

Une grande aventure pour diriger la ville avec des déesses et des animaux de compagnie. La ville est envahie par d'étranges créatures. Protégez et dirigez votre ville à l'aide d'une variété de créations, notamment des voitures, des vélos, des chevaux, des dragons, des robots et bien plus encore.

A sci-fi themed incremental game which allows you to expand your capitalistic empire across the galaxy! Hire mercenaries to pillage alien planets for resources, with the singular goal of making as much money as possible as quickly as possible! Totally not a playful commentary on real Terran society.
一款电脑、安卓、苹果iOS三端互通的武侠回合制网络游戏。
Welcome to The Horror Story: Rebirth, a remake version from the original Horror Story powered by Unreal Engine 5. Like all horror games, it contains jumpscares, flashing lights, and loud noises.
In Click Space Miner II you take control over a mining company in space. There is a big market, a lot of customers, but therefore also a lot of concurrents so you have to mine fast.

Franchise Wars is a turn-based isometric puzzle strategy game, or puzzegy game. Play as Frog Pop, one of the last remaining fast food restaurants, on a campaign to destroy arch-rival Munch Point. Control various units, each with a unique mechanic, as you set out to best the food service industry.
This game is for players who want to improve their shooting skills in games like Call of Duty.
"Paper Bride 5 Two Lifetimes" is the 5th work in the "Paper Bride' series. Our cast from Zangling Village return to the stage to welcome players back to the world of paper bride...

Welcome to Doodleburg! You play Doodle, a child who has been transported into a cardboard world of their own creation. Not all is well in the Burg of Doodle. An ancient, extradimensional evil has awoken and it's up to you to save this idyllic town from its ravenous rampage.
Simple Tower Defense game in pixel graphics

It’s a challenging 2D arcade game where you are a master of time. Set it to past, present or future to control various mechanisms, and make sure that a mechanical bird will safely reach the end of the level. Prepare to die a lot – you will be sliced, squashed and crushed.
Dans Delicious - Emily's Home Sweet Home Deluxe, vous devez aider les O'Malley à réparer leur maison. En ferez-vous un foyer ? Faites vite avant qu'elle ne soit condamnée !
梦究竟对一个人来说意味着什么？ 我看完《梦的解析》有感而发，利用一个周末创作了这款游戏的原型，然后花了一个周末补充和优化体验，我会在玩家的吐槽中逐渐成长起来的。
Travel through time blending into different lives as you hunt for fakes in the crowd. Chaos slowly takes control as you learn to shoot first, and face the consequences later.

TEMPUS est un jeu de puzzle et d'aventure avec voyage dans le temps. Chaque fois que vous avancez, vous voyez l'île où vous vivez changer au fil des millénaires. Vous ne pouvez voyager qu'en avant, c'est donc un aller simple, jusqu'où irez-vous ?
Code Romantic is a computer science puzzle visual novel wrapped in a science fiction love story.

Amneron's Legacy is a classic style RPG PC game that takes place on a world called Ellis. Heroes must come together to save the realm from darkness while uncovering what happened to the heroes of old.

Phr00t's Software is all about procedural generation, optional VR support and fun! This is a full free game inspired by Metroid Prime: explore randomly generated worlds for new abilities to unlock new ones. Will you upgrade your missile launcher or teleporting abilities? Will you escape in time?
(Technical Prototype) Gifted is a 3rd person, single-player and couch-co-op, role-playing, social/economic simulation and village-building game.
Epic Fun is a collection of theme park-inspired attractions. You'll find a roller coasters with an exclusive rail shooting game, a free fall tower and a Hammer It game entirely for free.
Transformez la lumière en son dans ce jeu, issu des créateurs de Fractal, primé de nombreuses fois !
Stock up on ammo, upgrade your guns, defeat the Crawling Queen's minions and escape the lab.

Prouvez votre capacité à lire les noms à côté des gros boutons rouges! Montrez votre capacité à vous battre pour la vie dans un centre scientifique qui s'effondre sous les conséquences d'une expérience scientifique insensée!
Can you overcome the mysteries of the Millionaire Manor and stop the macabre machinations of a madman?
MoeNovel's exciting new original title, LoveKami -Divinity Stage-, debuts on Steam in English, bringing a fun and energetic tale filled with magic and music!

Star-Pit Starship is an addictive arcade score-chaser. Build your ship and blast some baddies. The longer you last in the pit, the more money you'll earn and the better you can build your next ship. Build-Battle-Repeat!

Feudal Friends est jeu de tower defense compétitif. Chaque joueur a des tâches différentes au sein de tour et ils travaillent ensemble pour produire de nouveaux soldats et déterminer des stratégies pour conquérir tour adverse. Planifiez bien votre stratégie, car cette guerre n'attend personne!

Mr Blaster is a higher-level space adventure with an aim to conquest the universe. It’s a way to test strategic playing skills and the precision of shooting. A galactic war over the conquest of a planet and seizing the opponent’s flag

Redlight is a chilling multiplayer first-person horror experience. Traverse a liminal maze alongside friends while being hunted by a relentless AI-driven terror lurking in the shadows. Work together to activate generators, but remember: survival demands stealth when the lights turn red.

titre: MISTROGUE: Mist and the Living Dungeons
description: MISTROGUE est un jeu d'action/stratégie combinant des éléments du rogue-like avec le développement de compétences. Explorez des donjons et créez un ensemble optimal de compétences avec les ressources trouvées. Avec votre imagination, créez un "build" que nul autre que vous n'aurait trouvé !

Text adventure games. The story happened in the British Isles in the 16th century. Players will experience the storyline from the perspectives of Brand and Lev, exploring personal stories in 16th century British society.
An interstellar cargo ship crashlands on a planet that should not have been there.Explore, solve puzzles and fight your way through ancient ruins to find the portal that will bring you back on Earth.
Set during the early events of World War 2, Fall Weiss is a new successor to the Panzer General
Dungeon No Dungeon is a turn-based roguelike game with a unique hand-drawn art style, with a strategy system based around body parts that you've likely never encountered before.
C'est un jeu pour les joueurs hardcore où vous devez retourner, tourner et esquiver pour atteindre le meilleur score possible.
Multiplayer team-based vehicular combat
Jeu de tir psychédélique au style rétro avec un zeste de modernité, Futuridium EP Deluxe mélange action effrénée, réflexion, esthétique basse résolution et bande son électro tonitruante.
采用了类似《火焰之纹章》的战棋模式，讲述一个佣兵团帮助人们排忧解难的小游戏。
Mindless Running - it's a classic runner with story mode. Explore a randomly-generated world while listening to a unique soundtrack!

S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Clear Sky est le préquel de la trilogie Legends of the Zone. Capable d’influencer l’équilibre des pouvoirs à travers les guerres entre factions, Scar est le personnage que vous incarnerez.

Landinar: Into the Void est un jeu d'aventure spatiale bourré d'action. Vous incarnez un capitaine de vaisseau traversant une mauvaise passe, mais déterminé à ce que cela change. Alors, montez à bord de votre vaisseau, et en route pour l'aventure !
Menez votre clan, votre armée, vos guerres. Devenez le Shogun dominant le Japon. Shogun’s Empire: Hex Commander est un jeu de stratégie par tour avec des mécaniques de gameplay immersives.
An epic and satirical throwback to the internet of yesteryear, made with the help of actress and legendary meme queen Catie "Boxxy" Wayne.
Take on the role of Asumi, a new warrior for the people of Edo. As Asumi you must root out a rebel from within a prestigious samurai academy. Now the assassin must walk in the light for all to see.

Suivez The Midnight Walk dans cette aventure créée par les auteurs de Lost in Random. Sympathisez avec une lanterne perdue et éclairez votre chemin dans un monde de merveilles et d'horreur. Maîtrisez les monstres et admirez les détails surprenants d'un paysage en argile véritable en stop motion.

This game takes place after an apocalyptic attack and you're one of the last survivors. Your goal is to survive, complete quests, explore the huge wild world, eliminate enemies, level up, and create a safe place for the rest of the survivors.
HOW WE KNOW WE'RE ALIVE is an award winning, hour long melancholy, point-and-click narrative mystery set in the bible belt of Sweden.

Construis une nation à n’importe quelle époque de l’histoire humaine et vise la suprématie dans ce jeu de stratégie au tour par tour épique. Joue la diplomatie, mène des guerres et affronte en duel d’autres dirigeants légendaires.
Tametsi is a difficult logic game played on a set of tiles, in which you must use the clues provided to discover and mark hidden mines.

Last Wood est un monde océanique post-Apocalypse. Vous guiderez plusieurs survivants dans l'océan sur des radeaux. Survivre, construire des radeaux, défiez des menaces, explorer un monde inconnu, avoir des enfants, et trouver la vérité du monde.

Addictive, simple gameplay about xoring your way through a maze. You can xor the inner and outer gates surrouding your character with the ones from a cell of your choosing. Hounds will follow you, being bitten will cost points. Use arrows and the invincibility potion to defend yourself.

titre: 东方光耀夜 ~ Lost Branch of Legend
description: Bienvenue à Eientei, combinez plusieurs couleurs de mana pour construire votre deck idéal, défiez les filles de Gensokyo et récupérez le mystérieux trésor de la lune. Profitez d'un Rogue-like imprévisible combiné à du Danmaku fantaisie !
Get precious gem stones for poker combinations coming from the game machine. The dwarf who obtained most valuable gems after 12 turns gets a beer.

titre: ファントムゾーン　クリプトファシア
description: The future is just a toe away, where supernatural phenomena are frequent. Two identical twins, Akihito and Fuyuto Shirahane. They are caught up in a strange phenomenon in Yomori City, a town where various legends swirl around them.
studio: ファントムゾーン観測室

description: Halloween-Bird attack triggered by vindictive biddy !

Set in a post-apocalyptic future, The Signal State puts your logic skills to the test with complex puzzles inspired by modular synthesizers. Repair machines, rebuild an abandoned farm, and be part of a revolution that will change the fate of agriculture once and for all.
A new hidden object adventure in the Far Kingdoms awaits you! Solve the puzzles and search for hidden clues to find who is responsible for King's untimely death.

A frantic and whimsical local multiplayer party game for VR. Takelings have invaded this quiet suburban home and it's up to Hal to exterminate these pests using whatever means necessary! Up to 8 players hide, sneak, attack and cause chaos against 1 VR player in a variety of asymmetric minigames

Super Incursion is a First Person / Third Person Story-Telling Game with a 10-Chapter Story Campaign, IMS & Gemstone Ministry of Defense Launch a Military Operation sending 3 Special forces Teams to Advanced City to do Reconnaissance on & Sabotage Protocol 87, A Deadly Protocol by C.G.T.

Explorez l'incroyable monde alien d'Adelpha, prêtez main forte à ses habitants, les Talans, et surpassez-vous dans des combats effrénés contre une armée de robots envahisseurs dans la suite du jeu d'action-aventure et en monde ouvert devenu un classique du genre depuis sa sortie en 1999.
Look down the barrel of a future where all your everyday needs are solved with guns.
A sci-fi, turn-based RPG. Humanity has reached a point where the majority of people opt to become cyborgs called Roids. However, social inequality is once again at a breaking point.

DeMagnete VR est un jeu d’aventure et de puzzles en réalité virtuelle. Servez-vous de vos gants magnétiques pour manipuler des objets et résoudre des casse-têtes. Plus vous avancerez dans ces dédales, plus vous en apprendrez la voix qui vous guide et sur la raison de votre présence ici.
A secret agent prevents an evil toilet uprising. Follow this path with brutal music and a killer attitude.

YUKI est un nouveau mélange optimiste de jeu bullet-hell et roguelike en VR! Entrez dans l'imagination sauvage d'un enfant et volez à travers un univers anime contrôlant la figurine articulée de Yuki. Esquivez les balles et les obstacles sympas tout en combattant les forces du mal.

Siege of Dungeon is a strategic team-based rogue-lite, where you challenge strong, cunning monsters and combine relics and skills to build up your team in turn-based combat. What’s waiting for you deep in the dungeon? Could it be a rare treasure or the beginning of despair...?

The Royal Game of Ur is an ancient racing game where players try to get all of their tokens across the board first. 3000 years ago this was one of the most popular board games in the world. Play it yourself to find out why!
Golf Galore is an online multiplayer Mini Golf game with crazy mechanics. You can teleport with portals, dodge saw blades, shoot out of cannons, and much more.
The studio needs your help rewriting their next big superhero blockbuster for mass public consumption! What kind of movie will you make?

The train you took, piercing the night sky and galloping under the stars, was refreshing-it was really a great value trip. In the solo journey under the refreshing night breeze, I met casual passengers and the loving and loving flight attendants.

In Dominions 6 you take control of a powerful being that rules a nation and aspires to godhood. The type of Pretender Gods can vary from magically powerful arch mages to old dragons or an enormous tree. Dominions is a deep 4x turn based strategy game with a very large variety of spells and units.
You are the commander of a detachment of Cossacks and you need to clear the forests and mountains from the hordes of fabulous creatures

Hiddenverse: Ominous Opus is hidden object, match-3 storytelling adventure game about Avenlee - a young aspiring writer, who finds her friend buried in the sewers. The tragic accident is quickly revealed to be a cover-up for a murder, and it’s up to you to solve the mystery.

Climb a massive overgrown concrete tower while constantly at risk of falling and losing precious progress. BETON BRUTAL offers a fluid and responsive first person parkour experience through tranquil brutalist architecture.

Lethal VR est un jeu de tir immersif en réalité virtuelle conçu pour le HTC Vive et créé par Three Fields Entertainment, studio à l'origine de Burnout, BLACK et Dangerous Golf.Incarnez une recrue du FBI mise à l'épreuve lors d'une série d'exercices armés. Avez-vous ce qu'il faut pour vous obtenir le rang « Létal » ?

titre: Karl Marx and the Ring of Communism
description: Workers of the world, unite! You have nothing to loose, but, like, less than two dollars. - Karl Marx... would probably say about this challenging platformer. Play as the great thinker, overcome capitalism and return the world to the one righteous state of universal, common, great and equal poverty.

Big Action Mega Fight! est un jeu classique “beat ‘em up” avec une saveur moderne! Le combat hilarant en 2D vous laissera des ampoules aux mains, tandis que vous tabassez des ennemis mémorables à travers des niveaux excitants. Êtes-vous prêt pour la bagarre?
Soul for two is a heroic JRPG about the life of two different people in different worlds, but with different destinies. Will two souls pass all the tests?

A cheerful, family-friendly arcade adventure! Guide your slime through fun retro-style arenas, eat and dodge to survive, and enjoy mini-games along the way. Casual, colorful, and suitable for all ages!
A 2D platform adventure game, in which you must dodge enemy obstacles and pass mobile platforms and various types of terrain that will make your journey more difficult

Shadow Blade is an action-platformer set in a visually striking world where the ancient teachings of ninjas and samurai clash upon a modern landscape. Sprint through stages littered with traps, slaying enemies along your path without hesitation as Kuro, the blade of shadow!
Did you ever wonder how it was like to be on the other side of the fence? In this zoo you can figure it out - take control over the whole area and destroy what kept you in prison for so long.

Cultivating Immortals is a multiplayer game（Only China）, cultivation game, and competitive game. Including: lifespan system, realm system, combat system, magic system, boss system, drop treasure system, chat system, legacy system, and multi scenario PVE.

You are about to uncover four twisted tales of misadventure surrounding people connected, in some way, by the late Dr. Cyrus Stansfield's cloning machine. Within these stories you must face the ethical dilemmas and possible fortune while guiding each character to their own end.
The life of the old stalker Valera began to change radically after the young stalker Sanya stays with him overnight. Experience the incredibly dramatic adventure of two experienced stalker men.

This is a TPS, horror-type action shooting game. The game will draw players into a terrifying dark world with detailed atmosphere rendering and weird story. Here, you are not defenseless, but even with a gun, you can't suppress the trembling from the heart. Game revenue is used for 2.0 development.
studio: 豆丁儿独立游戏工作室

description: Spirit Eyes is a horror game in which, as an experienced exorcist, you take a contract to an abandoned house in Wyoming. Player must discover the type of ghost and try to get rid of it. As you try to communicate with the spirit, you will have to make choices that will affect the course of the game.

In the brand-new GodOrEvil, challenges are more thoughtful. It's no longer just luck to pass the customs quickly. Careful calculation and thinking are indispensable. The choice is between one thought and another. If not? Let's open another one!

In Awaken, a punk world that combines 2D and 3D, the protagonist wakes up unexpectedly. On the way to escape, he shuttles among various forces in the world to complete various tasks. This is an action adventure game with RPG elements, full of surprises, waiting for you to explore and discover.
Deva｜Second-Person Perspective Game is here! Discover a new type of gameplay and a new kind of fear!
Have you ever wondered how difficult is to shoot a ski jumper on the fly with a sniper rifle? :) Ski Sniper gives you perfect opportunity to find out!

Overcrowd: A Commute 'Em Up est une simulation de gestion tactique installée dans le métro de la ville animée de Lubdon Town. Il allie la construction de base, une stratégie en temps réel reposant sur des casse-tête spatiaux.

titre: General Horse and the Package of Doom
description: General Horse and the Package of Doom is a space travel adventure with choice-based resource management, simple yet risky barter system, and full motion video sequences that feature awesome special effects and Oscar-worthy method acting.
Enter a dark wasteland and fight mutants to survive.

Relive is a free sci-fi adventure game about CPR. Its main purpose is to increase the awareness about this topic and encourage people to take a CPR class and be prepared to intervene in case of need. Discover the story and challenge your friends in tournament mode!

Phantaruk combines survival horror with adventure and stealth mechanics. Expect true shivers down your spine as you fight for your life not only facing the dangers of the Purity-02 spaceship, but most of all - when you try to get rid of toxins continually destroying you from the inside.

Prenez le contrôle d'un mécha géant et embarquez pour une aventure dans un monde souterrain. Creusez, collectez des minéraux, achetez des améliorations, découvrez d'anciens secrets et essayez de ne pas vous faire exploser! Allez-vous sauver le monde ou disparaître dans les profondeurs?

For when I weep, then I am strong. Battle through Purgatory as Rei to help save her sister in this Action RPG. Switch freely between four playable characters, and uncover each one of their pasts to see the sorrows they have endured.

《XiuzhenWorld2》is a 3D world where your goal is to level up from a mere mortal into an immortal at the end. Its a semi-idle game with fun immortal cultivation mechanics such as - leveling up to become stronger. - capturing monsters as pets to fight for you. - AFK(Away From Keybourd).

Embarquez pour une enquête dangereuse dans Ultra Mission™, le dernier jeu de Gumbo Machine™. En tant qu'agent de la Stellar Exchange Commission, vous devez traverser les 20 niveaux vertigineux d'Otto Labs, chacun jonché d'automates puissants et d'expériences douteuses. Ça va être génial!

Bulby - Diamond Course is a colorful 3D Platformer inspired by a classic old 16-bit game. Bulby features tons of levels in Story Mode, Coop, Multiplayer, and a built-in Course Editor to create your own courses and share with the internet.

Bienvenue à Snowtopia, un monde d’hiver éternel et d’activités relaxantes. Apprivoisez la montagne et construisez la station de ski idéale. Concevez des pistes et installez des aménagements pour satisfaire au mieux les attentes de vos skieurs.

titre: Monochrome Mobius: Rights and Wrongs Forgotten
description: A new JRPG from veteran studio AQUAPLUS, commemorating 20 years of the multi-media Utawarerumono series. This is the story of a man who will be sung about in legends.

Enter Solune, a world of fantasy and magic! This turn-based JRPG is inspired by the classics, with modern improvements. Challenge yourself with 50 optional puzzles, discover hidden secrets and face off against powerful end-game bosses, all while on an adventure to save the world!
CARDS OF CTHULHU is the Roguelike Card RPG full of madness. Experience the unique combination of strategic deck-building with fast-paced combat and face-off parody monsters from horror B movies.

An open-world 2d platformer, Blessed Surface uses the side-scrolling perspective to create a deep, greatly vertical space with no sky, only endless passages upwards. A functioning ecosystem, equipment customization, dynamic encounters and more form a rich, living world.

Vous incarnez un chercheur aventurier qui parcoure le globe à la recherche d'anciens trésors oubliés.Recherchez des objets cachés et résolvez des puzzles pour découvrir le plus important trésor que le monde ait jamais connu.Un nouveau fragment d'une ancienne carte a été découvert et révèle l'emplacement d'une Tombe perdue en Égypte.

A.I.M. Racing vous souhaite la bienvenue sur la planète Polygon 4, sur laquelle de meurtriers véhicules issus d'un lointain futur font la course à une vitesse folle, en faisant siffler l'atmosphère poussiéreuse de cette planète.

Asimov est un service mécanisé intégré au vaisseau spatial Eidolon. Il transporte des centaines d'humains congelés vers un nouveau monde. Après un problème informatique il revient à Asimov de sauver ses amis robots et le chargement humain. Mr.
A story-driven, open-world, Lovecraftian Horror and Survival game with a scifi twist.

Four Kings One War is a 1 or 2 player strategy game inspired by chess. Each player controls two armies as though they were one and get's two moves per turn. This opens up guerrilla style tactics and hidden attacks. This is strategy for the modern mind, outside the 64th square.

The Great War of Jorth (GWOJ) has the look and sound of a classic 16-bit JRPG. It will satisfy the nostalgic itch of any gamer that remembers playing the greats of the 16-bit era. Our fully voiced game will immerse you in a rich story where the outcome is determined by your choices.

Malzbie’s Pinball Collection presents pinball tables in the style of the 1990s. Completely physically calculated gaming features, realistic graphics, stunning sounds and the animated dot matrix display give the feeling of the good old days back to you!

A dark cyberpunk RPG in a bleak dystopian future. Become a "freelancer" in the heart of Slade City, a sprawling urban nightmare of grimy asphalt and broken dreams where crime and disorder run rampant. - Stay Alert. Stay Armed. Stay Alive. Don't lose your humanity.

King Midas accidentally turned his own daughter into gold! Use his special powers to perform acts of goodness instead of greed. Help Midas connect magical talismans to release gold coins and help the poor. If you help enough people, Zeus will change Midas' daughter back to her old self.

Un jeu de construction d'usines. Survivez à un climat rude, exploitez à ciel ouvert un monde infini et construisez une usine tentaculaire, puis commercez ou entrez en guerre avec des Colons, des Gouvernements, des Pirates, des Rebelles, et plus encore!

Suite à une montée fulgurante du terrorisme, un conflit interne et enfin la destruction nucléaire de Washington D.C., les États-Unis sont divisés en une demi-douzaine de nations-états qui sombrent dans la guerre.

Backrooms Cycle is an immersive exploration RPG/FPS horror set in the backrooms. You will explore and scavenge, build up your arsenal and gain powerful perks. Decide if you want to rescue fellow scientists, build an outpost in the poolrooms or just care about yourself.
《隐世神剑传》是一款神话题材ARPG剧情向单机游戏，以中国上古神话为背景，构造一个充满山海异兽，光怪陆离的玄幻世界。 上古时期盘古开天辟地，天地之间灵气充沛，滋养出大量的仙人神兽和奇珍灵宝。各界之间并未隔绝，后各界主大战，阴阳失衡。

SPAERA is a head-to-head puzzle fighting game, using an unique match-3 cascading mechanic as its core system. The world of SPAERA is heavily inspired by characters, gameplay and themes from games that we loved to play as we were growing up.
You, as a ripperdoc (self-proclaimed), have started your new clinic in a corner of Little China. With your cyberware fixing skill, will it help you to impress the girl?

Fear of The Unknown - Chapter One is a fear inducing horror game allowing players to dive into a long forgotten stream of memories that recalls victims of the dark figure that lurks around you. Will one's soul have the strength required to survive the inevitable...!?

The legendary bullet-hell shoot-’em-up series has come to Steam! DoDonPachi is ressurected after a Blissful Death with enough modes to satisfy the beginner and the expert player alike. Tonight we dine in bullet hell!
The Gardens Between est un jeu d’aventure puzzle surréaliste qui suit Arina et Frendt, deux fidèles amis qui se retrouvent dans un monde mystérieux composé de superbes îles jardins.
Airplane Mode vous promet toutes les sensations d'un vol commercial de 6 heures en temps réel, et en classe économique. Heureusement, vous avez un siège côté hublot... attachez votre ceinture !

Lancez-vous dans une quête épique pour récupérer les trésors volés de l’Égypte ancienne dans Luxor: Mah Jong. Plaisir et défi sans fin et unique en son genre avec 200 mises en page sont disponibles en 3 modes de jeu impressionnants, aventure, unique et traditionnel.
He's back!

titre: Lilly and Sasha: Nexus of Souls
description: Zahhak has Sasha's body and is going to use it to claim the powers of the Immortals. Lilly has vowed to stop Zahhak at whatever cost, even if she has to kill her own sister to do it. Continue your journey from Curse of the Immortals with new puzzles, new skills, runes and trinkets, new characters and 10 new pets, two of which can join...

Combattez Galactoil, une société d'énergie intergalactique dysfonctionnelle et comique malgrè elle, et ses employés plus vrais que nature dans un jeu tactique-furtif qui fusionne un gameplay stratégique satisfaisant et un humour noir dans une histoire solo originale.

Forgez votre royaume au milieu des ruines de Rome dans ce 4X au tour par tour ! Le monde est en train de s'effondrer ; à vous de tracer le destin de votre peuple. Multipliez les prouesses stratégiques et écrasez tous ceux qui se dressent sur votre chemin.

Explore the sky for Boo's missing balloons and return them safely to the fairground landing pad. A simple and short game accompanied by some poetry. For younger children to enjoy as they develop their motor skills.

Save Moses' girlfriend from the clutches of the prince of Egypt, Ramses, in this thrilling adventure across the Egyptian desert. Face enemies and bosses, find items and power-ups scattered throughout a fantastic 2D open world full of challenges, secrets and much more!
Master a new way to fly and fight. Control every movement and engine burn. Simple controls, realistic flight: a game for space fans by a space fan.

Serious Sam: Tormental is a 3D rogue-lite top-down shooter where you blast your way through the tormented mind of demigod of destruction Mental, as he imagines worlds and monsters that stand on your path towards his inner ego. Let the showdown begin!
Beach Buggy Racing 2: Island Adventure est un jeu de course de kart plein d’action à base de compétition en écran partagé et de personnalisation des règles de jeu.
Un roman visuel sombre et psychologique. Nous suivons Iris une jeune fille dans sa quête pour récupérer sa vie!

titre: Maelstrom: The Battle for Earth Begins
description: En l’espace de cinquante ans la Terre a changé d’une planète avec un futur ambitieux à une planète à deux doigts de l’atonie, consommée pas une époque apocalyptique de désastres écologique, guerres mondiales et la chute de la civilisation humaine. C’est l’époque du maelstrom.
Shop Tycoon est un simulateur de magasin. Commencez par un petit magasin, puis construisez un énorme magasin avec des parkings, des bureaux pour les employés, une énorme flotte de voitures.

titre: The Secret Order 5: The Buried Kingdom
description: Explorez l'Antre du Dragon!
The town of Deadwood is being terrorized by the ghost of a murderous outlaw in Ghost Encounters: Deadwood - The Collector's Edition!

You are employed by PAM (Planet Alliance Ministry) to pilot a mech that is used for population control. Land on the designated site, locate the densely populated areas, and destroy them. This will not be easy. Thank you for your dedicated service.

Luminosity is a fast paced arcade game. You take the control of a space ship and your objective is to close off the enemy drones and conquer a certain percent of the map in order to blow them up. Things quickly escalate and you face an increasing number of unique and challenging enemies and environments all trying to destroy your laser...

Des effets physiques détaillés mettent en relief la grande variété de défis que cette grande marque automobile a rencontré tout au long de son histoire. Les voitures et les circuits soigneusement détaillés reflètent les dommages infligés alors que la course suit son cour.

Battle your way through this 2D Action RPG Dungeon Crawler with over-the-top skills, extensive passive trees, and all the randomized loot you can carry! Another Dungeon Game has been designed with casual players in mind, making it quick and easy to dive right in and start slaying from level 1.
Enter the Necromancers' Arena with up to three other players in this cute, dystopian, twin-stick shooter!
Presented by Cracking The Cryptic, YouTube's most popular Sudoku channel, this is the brand new “Classic Sudoku” game that their viewers have been requesting for the last two years!

Quelques mois après le naufrage d'un cargo transportant une importante collection d’œuvres d'art destinée au Metropolitan Museum, une des toiles réapparaît en Hongrie. Serez-vous capable d'élucider le mystère du Dragon?

This is a business simulation + construction game. It tells the evolution history of Internet cafes that began in the 1990s, and imagines the future of internet cafes. There are also some small emotional stories.

titre: 中年失业模拟器When a man lose his job
description: You are a 35-years-old man who struggling in a huge city, the mortgage is pressing you to work day and night. Suddenly ,you got fired! Without income, you have to pay mortgage (15000 G /month) and raise 2 kids! How can you do that? Come on ! Earn money and save your family!

Tower Escape is a reverse tower defense game, where instead of defending against incoming enemies, you play the baddies and guide your minions to the exit. Recruit a team of minions, and collect powerful gems and relics that make each run unique.
Days of War est un FPS en ligne qui réinvente le jeu de tir multijoueur classique sur la Seconde Guerre mondiale en offrant un gameplay par équipe, en corps-à-corps et qui regorge d'action.
Warfare Studios (Ashes of Immortality, Shining Plume) is back with a new tale involving vampires and epic fights with this great RPG.

Throw on your invisibility cloak and put your reflexes to the test in this brutal precision platformer brimming with espionage, intrigue, and betrayal! Featuring an Original Soundtrack by Grammy Award Winner RAC.

A game inspired by classic Magic Carpet, with modern graphics and features. You play as a sorcerer, exploring mysterious worlds, changing them, discovering ancient secrets, creating new spells, fighting creatures and other mages, building and destroying as you please.
A Tower Full of Cats est un jeu d'objets cachés où vous devez caresser des chats à travers toute l'histoire de l'humanité... et au-delà !

titre: 飛天歷險國際中文版(Dream Of Mirror Online)
description: 《飛天歷險》是一款經典MMORPG，故事背景發生在「崑崙鏡」所創造的神器世界，由於崑崙鏡世界的秩序失恆，世界的管理者「鏡王」便召喚玩家前來幫忙。獨特的自由轉職系統與天賦搭配，「善」與「惡」主線劇情等，各種特色玩法等著您前來一探究竟！

Recrutement, budget, stratégie, toutes les décisions passent par vous. Découvrez le nouveau système de repérage des jeunes, de nouvelles options pour personnaliser votre expérience, un peloton plus offensif et bien d’autres nouveautés.
Un robot, un poncho et un périple plein de découvertes ! Explorez ce monde fait de plateformes parallèles pixélisées pour résoudre la grande énigme : qui est Poncho ?
Sudoku for cat people. Cats are wonderful creatures but you better not put them together without proper introduction. So, plan ahead to display them in the right order so they get along!

titre: Tiny Tales: Heart of the Forest
description: Devenez le Héros de Brie !

Terramancer est un jeu de stratégie combinant combos de cartes et placement de travailleurs. Envoyez vos golems collecter des ressources et soyez le premier à terminer votre Tour.. Utilisez des combos de cartes pour adapter votre île aux saisons.
Riddles Of The Past is a Hidden Object game with detective story and post apocalyptic atmosphere.

Dans Jack's Labyrinth, vous incarnez Jack, qui explore des labyrinthes dangereux, recueille des orbes et évite les gardiens qui le poursuivent. Utilisez la stratégie et l'agilité pour contourner les ennemis, collecter des sphères puissantes et progresser à travers des niveaux fascinants pleins de puzzles et de dangers.

titre: Frog Detective 3 - Corruption à Cow-boy Canyon
description: Vous êtes détective, mais aussi une grenouille, et il est temps de résoudre un mystère au Far West.
Vectrix is a rhythmic, techno, top-down shoot 'em up with a synthwave soundtrack and a grid of enemies based on John Conway's "Game of Life" cellular automaton!
A chess-based puzzle game.
CuberPunk 2089 - A game with an open world in a cubical style from the first person! At your disposal the whole city of the future Cube City with a huge bunch of tasks and Easter eggs!

Dispersion est un jeu d'arcade au rythme rapide où vous contrôlez une balle. Cassez les orbes dorés pour gagner des points, mais si vous arrivez à d'autres objets, vous perdrez immédiatement. Combien d'orbes d'or pouvez-vous briser?

Have you ever tried to save your lunch money in order to buy a game or comic book? After so many years, you have grown up, but your colorful life costs all your energies. The unlimited pressure makes you exhausted. Is there anything that could fulfill the void of your heart?
Fight for your life in this state-of-the-art 8-bit platformer!

titre: Detective Case and Clown Bot in: Murder in the Hotel Lisbon
description: Un étrange meurtre s’est produit à l'Hôtel Lisbonne, un homme a mis fin à ses jours avec 14 coups de couteaux dans le dos, tout en buvant calmement son café. Cette enquête, avec ses faits contradictoirs, ne peut être résolue que par l'incroyable duo d’inspecteurs: Jean Bon et Robot-Clown.

Hé humain, on a un gros problème ! Cette ville grouille d'esprits importuns et tu es le seul qui puisses les voir. Alors tu as intérêt à vite remettre en état ces anciens bains publics, peut-être que ça les aidera à retrouver leur calme !

In this world of the future, you've fallen into an island in the middle of the ocean, and here you're building an isolated life from all over the world. It's up to you to collect the necessary supplies and build what's on your mind.

“THE LAST BLADE”, premier opus de la légendaire série de combat à l'arme blanche en 2D de SNK et dont l'histoire se situe au crépuscule du shôgunat Tokugawa, revient pour une nouvelle joute sur Steam !
The legendary monster training duology, “Monster Rancher” and “Monster Rancher 2”, is back!
重磅回歸、經典再現！以三國為背景的超人氣遊戲「富甲天下系列」，有別於傳統大富翁的進行模式，占領城池並非致勝的唯一手段，專心經營一座城池發展人口、稅收、士兵、特產品，透過四處經商、穿梭賭場來籌措資金，招募各種人才為己效力。待時機成熟招兵買馬、攻城掠地，一統天下！

A retro first-person shooter inspired by Blood, Duke Nukem 3D, and Rise of the Triad. REVEREND is a dark, twisted tale with religious undertones, terrifying creature designs and one hell of a personality.
Découvrez le système de combat unique du fameux studio PlatinumGames dans BABYLON'S FALL un nouveau action-RPG coopératif qui vous fera gravir la tour de Babylone en solo ou avec 3 autres joueurs.

Un sandbox de coworking multijoueur cosy, avec personnalisation de personnages, création de pièces et outils de productivité. Concentrez-vous, étudiez, travaillez et détendez-vous avec vos amis et des joueurs du monde entier.
Chaos interstellaire ! Une fille-chat chasseuse de primes ! De l'action funktasmique qui couvre tous les genres ! Vraiment tous les genres, on ne plaisante pas !
Voici l’histoire de la mythique guilde Rush et de ses débuts tonitruants !

Après une série d'événements mystérieux, la seule question qui restera dans votre esprit sera : étaient-ils réels ? Témoin de l'histoire d'une femme seule qui tente de surmonter les souhaits de sa grand-mère et de son nouveau travail en tant que responsable de nuit dans un môtel.

The Lighthouse is a uniquely crafted thriller with glimpses into psychotic, alternate dimensions. Private Investigator James Irvine finds himself lured into a haunting, neo-noir world in search of a missing young woman, named Lily Beaumont.

a Museum of Dubious Splendors, is a storybook from the world of Somewhere. A quiet game about prosaic objects and spurious histories, it is an irreverent rumination on the nature of an archive and forms of recollection.
The Road to Gelendzhik Palace - don't let your enemies enter the domain!
Due to a freak accident at the Fireworks Factory, Putt-Putt® is blasted to the moon!

titre: Nancy Drew®: Ghost Dogs of Moon Lake
description: Hunt for Clues on the Trail of a Pack of Phantom Hounds!

Thrown into prison for an act of self-expression, protagonist Shuichiro must confront both a violent system and his own actions—or else try to find happiness on the inside in this visual novel from the makers of NUKITASHI.
The 99 Dragons Clan has been murdered. Even worse, the ancient artifact they guard, stolen. With its power, one can trap the souls of the living and resurrect those who have crossed over.

Sébastien Loeb Rally EVO redéfinit le niveau de réalisme et d'engagement des courses tout-terrain. Pilotez les voitures emblématiques d'hier et d'aujourd'hui, sur les épreuves les plus palpitantes à travers le monde.

titre: Black Rainbow Mystery : Évasion de l’Amazonie
description: Aidez Helen à s'échapper du village en flammes ; Guidez-la hors des forêts sombres et dangereuses d'Amazonie et révélez l'ancien réveil maléfique !
The fabled land of Agartha awaits your discovery in Esoterica: Hollow Earth!
Explore a realistically inspired Unreal Engine recreation of Australia's south west coast. *will be included as part of the "Lushfoil Photography Sim" compilation, coming soon.

titre: Letters From a Rainy Day -Oceans and Lace-
description: Luscious artwork brings the beautiful streets of Kamakura in June to life in this bittersweet sapphic story of a romance that begins with blackmail... This is a yuri adventure game based on the theme of love between girls at a lady's school in Kamakura, Japan.
Lost and alone, you delve into an intriguing place.

titre: [Chilla's Art] The Radio Station | 深夜放送
description: The Radio Station | 深夜放送 is a Japanese psychological horror game.

Ira is a famed mercenary, called The Oathkeeper. When one of his contracts puts him in the middle of an ancient war of good v. evil and face to face with the woman he begins to fall in love with, he will have to start fighting for more than just money!

An earthquake swallows up the city of Kaldesta and splits it into two. Now many adventurers travel there in search of treasure. However, a curse suddenly appears and starts infecting the adventurers...

Embark on a daring journey with Beatrice as you kick, shoot, and loot through a secret underground lab. In this rogue-lite RPG/ADV, engage in strategic combat and face intense encounters and unspeakable dangers!

Shiny the Firefly is a challenging platform adventure game. Journey through a mysterious garden as Shiny, a brave firefly on a quest to find his children, lost in a terrible accident. Master trials,solve puzzles and use your stealth to guide your children to safety.

Une aventure solo fantaisiste fabriquée à la main. Découvrez un monde délicieux, habité par la Mandragora ludique et généralement serviable. Commandes de prise et de jeu simples, adaptées aux enfants et aux grands enfants!
Open the gate to the egyptian underworld! Hieroglyphika is a roguelike game completely without text but with pictograms.

Un jeu de détective unique dans lequel vous découvrez des affaires entièrement représentées par des cartes, centré sur l'interrogation de personnages sur des sujets. Disséquez les événements conduisant au décès d'Eliott Brown... Puis écrivez et partagez vos propres histoires d'enquête palpitantes !

titre: Nancy Drew®: Secret of the Old Clock
description: Venture into the Past and Outwit a Criminal Before Time Runs Out!

Préparez-vous à combattre l'armée des ténèbres. Joignez-vous à d'autres joueurs et menez vos guerriers à la victoire! Choisissez votre guerrier le plus fort et de prendre un voyage sans fin pour vaincre les créatures des ténèbres. Améliorez vos guerriers, mettre à jour vos articles et progresser dans l'univers infini de Clicker guerriers.
Simple puzzle game. Your goal help yellow circle get to sweet donut

Julian Luxembourg a préparé à dîner pour deux, chez lui, mais les choses tournent mal quand celle avec qui il a rendez-vous n’arrive pas, et qu’il reste seul à l’attendre à table, alors que le tic-tac de l’horloge s’intensifie de façon insupportable.
An exciting adventure in a story of ancient Chinese setting.Visual Novel with multiple endings to explore.

Xpand Rally est un jeu à couper le souffle qui vous offre une expérience réaliste en vous permettant de conduire de puissantes voitures de rallye au beau milieu de paysages plus vrais que nature. Des effets météorologiques réalistes, des plaines à perte de vue et des paysages animés contribuent tous à la perfection visuelle du jeu.
《一人之下寻炁迷踪》是让粉丝充分能参与其中的互动式漫画，进入漫画后，粉丝们就可以变身异人，与全新的用炁高手过招，探秘异人世界！围绕原著展开的多条支线剧情也为粉丝提供了丰富的阅读选择，每一步的决定，都将解锁全新的世界。
studio: 天津鑫鱼科技有限公司

description: Wild West and Wizards is an open world exploration RPG set in a re-imagined new frontier. Pick a class and level up unlocking abilities and exploring a world filled with quests, loot, outlaws, bosses, spells, caves, towns, and other mysterious places.

A beautiful turn-based MMORPG awaits you! Explore a vast world with thousands of quests, dungeons and bosses, a balanced PvP, a guild system and limitless possibilities of character development! Learn your true purpose: become a Dragon Master in Dragon Blood!

There Came an Echo est un jeu de stratégie en temps réel dans lequel le joueur prend le commandement d'une petite escouade en utilisant un système de reconnaissance vocale avancé pour donner ses ordres. Le scénario de science fiction porté sur les personnages bénéficie de la participation de Wil Wheaton, Ashly Burch, Laura Bailey, Yuri...
Kick butt in this retro 2D action-platformer! SEEP Universe is an indie game for PC inspired by the 8-16 bit era!
CryptoClickers is a complex Incremental Game revolved around Cryptocurrencies that's full of unique game modes, upgrades, challenges, events, and a double layer prestige system!

La Lune est hantée - et lorsqu'un astronaute perd le contact avec la Terre, l'aventure commence. Faites le plein d'oxygène, rechargez vos armes et partez pour une aventure FPS interstellaire à travers les étoiles, remplie d'énigmes, combats, d'exploration et d'étranges secrets.
Forme un groupe de rock et mets fin à l'empire EDM dans NO STRAIGHT ROADS, un jeu d'aventure/action au rythme explosif qui mêle combats détonants à la 3e personne et bande-son supersonique !

titre: 寇莎梅特：困世迷情 Consummate:Missing World
description: This is a cure Department of small fresh plot to the chamber of Secrets escape game, rich in 18 kinds of endings, a lot of funny content and hidden secrets.
Retrouvez Jimmy sur le campus. Cherchez des objets cachés, résolvez de petites énigmes et réparez les lieux, sans chrono.
Peasants War is the first competitive medieval shooter, created by one-person development studio New Companion.

Un jeu d'horreur psychologique en pixel art inspiré du mystère des îles Flannan. Gérez un phare isolé, rationnez des ressources limitées et survivez à des événements troublants tout en préservant votre santé mentale. Vos décisions détermineront l’issue. Combien de temps tiendrez-vous ?

titre: The Little Witch Shop: New in Town
description: In this shop management game, acquire new familiars to help cultivate your greenhouse, hunt fantastical creatures, and craft potions or runes to fulfill customer orders. Earn gold to upgrade your magic shop and impress the Witches’ Council.

titre: 烈山海前传之黑帝君临
description: 《烈山海前传之黑帝君临》拥有最多的剧情走向，每个走向都会带来不同的结局，很难有玩家能完成全部结局，敢来挑战吗？
Enter the vanishing cabin and discover its secrets and magic, while avoiding ghastly entities.

A sci-fi first-person shooter where you battle ruthless alien forces in an underground war. Utilize advanced weaponry, master Zendle energy abilities, and navigate treacherous environments. Engage in intense combat, uncover hidden secrets, and fight for survival in a world on the brink of collapse.
Honked! is a short narrative-adventure game about a mysterious world of Clowns where not all is as it seems.

Catch a Lover – Un jeu multijoueur pour 2 à 4 joueurs dans lequel l’un joue le rôle du mari qui devra attraper l’amant de sa femme. Quant à l’autre qui est l’amant, il devra tout faire pour fuir de la maison.
Bonny’s Adventure is a platform game inspired by the old Classics in which the player will help Bonny defeat the powerful wizard Calundú.

Deadly Nightmare: Unwanted Heritage vous ramène dans un monde cauchemar où que votre mission, c’est d'essayer de briser la malédiction avant 6 heures du matin. Dans la première version de Deadly Nightmare, vous jouiez le rôle de John, mais cette fois, vous jouez le rôle de sa grand-mère.

Kill Invaders - Dive into a thrilling multiplayer FPS with an alien storyline. Defend Earth in a battle against extraterrestrial invaders! Single Player, Multiplayer, Deathmatch and Battle Royale Modes !

Fight on the ground and in space around 17 different bodies in our solar system with unique lite orbital mechanics. Recruit armies, build fleets, and conquer the solar system as one of three unique factions in this turn based strategy game!
A virtual reality game project using "redirected walking technology" that can enhance immersive adventure experience.
Panda in the clouds is a grid movement platform puzzle game where your challenge will be to reach the flag and fulfill all the objectives of the level.
A new take on Tower Defence games, with many different strategies and towers. This game contains no in-app purchases or purchasable content.

Immerse yourself in an interactive sonic environment where you build, drop, and jam with your friends and top artists. Remix over 80 tracks and express yourself like never before. Electronauts sets the stage for you to DJ, perform, and make music magic in virtual reality.

VALKYRIE DRIVE -BHIKKHUNI- is the all-new all-action brawler from the creators of SENRAN KAGURA. The girls of Bhikkhuni are infected with the mysterious VR-Virus and the only way to control it is to fight.
DOOMTANK is a fast-paced twin-stick shooter designed to put you in the hot seat. Enter an ever-changing room straight from the depths of Hell and slay its inhabitants.

Réinitialisez une I.A. rebelle alors que vous traversez l'Arc, une station spatiale, dans ce magnifique roguelite d'action au style cyberpunk se déroulant dans un futur lointain ! Commencez chaque tentative dans la peau d'un humain cloné et augmenté pour sauver l'Arc de la destruction !

"If Fusion Were That Easy" est une aventure point-and-click 2.5D humoristique sur la fusion froide et la prévention de l'apocalypse. Explorez un monde diversifié, maîtrisez des énigmes délicates et arrêtez l'inévitable.

Yuria a été envahie et est dirigée d’une main de fer par Death Adder, qui est monté sur le trône en dérobant la Golden Axe™. Trois guerriers courageux relèvent à présent le défi de vaincre Death Adder et ses sbires pour ainsi rétablir la paix dans le royaume.
A giraffe born with slippery feet sets out to find love...
Close Contact is a narrative-driven, sci-fi horror game where you must navigate an advanced underground base whilst avoiding the alien creature that stalks you.

"Superscout" is a live-action interactive movie game where you will unravel the secrets of the girls you meet. The love beyond lifetimes, never let it go; the kindness in this life, engraved in your soul. Your choices will change your loved ones’ fate; those who love you will change yours...

titre: Mystery Case Files®: 13th Skull™ Collector's Edition
description: Uncover the secrets of the 13th Skull!
En tant que mystérieux et puissant "Gardien de la Terre" vos yeux d'acier et votre BRAS À LASER HYPER-PUISSANT doivent protéger les citoyens de la Terre pour des générations.

Green Hell VR est un jeu de survie en monde ouvert qui se déroule dans la forêt amazonienne et qui est basé sur le jeu PC Green Hell. Vous vous retrouvez dans la jungle, sans nourriture ni équipement et personne ne peut vous aider. Pour rester en vie, vous devez apprendre des techniques de survie.

On your journey you will meet a wide variety of heroes who are as different as fire and ice. You will meet brave warriors who risk their lives for their beliefs, but also benevolent magicians who use their powers for the good of others.

Welcome to Noble Private Academy, an institution that cultivates the wealthiest, most well-connected students in all of Japan! At this boarding school, one must be willing to accept all of its refined and dignified teachings or be met with strict opposition!
Relive the original MacVenture Series version of Déjà Vu! Play through the Mac and Apple IIGS versions and discover a classic detective mystery adventure.

A fast paced silly cutegore FPS! Earth has been taken over by demons. A catgirl codenamed MeowMeow fights back! MEOW, GUN, CLAW and BLOW UP hordes of evil demons, zombies, and other monsters in colorful environments with tons of weapons! The game runs on the FTEQW engine.
A cycle of adventure games set in the Lands of Dream, including The Sea Will Claim Everything.

Face terrifying enemies from another planet who want to stop you at all costs in this first-person adventure. Explore terrifying and dark settings, solve puzzles and use the objects you find on the map to progress in your adventure.

Lost Technology is a simulation game in which more than 100 characters belonging to 12 different factions battle to conquer each other’s territories. The faction you choose at the beginning will determine the conversations and events that unfold throughout the game between you and other factions.
Monster named "Meadowman" appears in a peaceful and boring villages. What is the fate of Mischa, a villager who ends up fighting them?
Mouse-based physics strategy game. Take the other team's towers before they can take yours! Features 50 unique levels and four difficulty modes.

"Havoc Runner" is a futuristic action and 2D platform game that will take you to Titan's moon to face killers robots, missile launchers, and automated weapons in a hostile environment where you must find and destroy the Tupan computer, preventing a missile attack on the planets of the solar system.

Demon sigils. Talking dolls. Delve into the dark world of Possession 1881, a point and click puzzle adventure. A game about intellect, art, and the occult in the Victorian Era. Science, history, and art all inspired numerous unique puzzles that will dare your mind to find new connections.

titre: Angry Video Game Nerd II: ASSimilation
description: When a mysterious beam from space transforms the world into a game, the Angry Video Game Nerd must return to put the "ASS" in ASSimilation. Utilize new mechanics, power-ups, abilities, and collectible armor pieces to defeat your most powerful foe yet, and save the world!

titre: Fester Mudd: Curse of the Gold - Episode 1
description: Set in Wild West, FESTER MUDD: CURSE OF THE GOLD is a three-part comic saga of exploration, reunion, and redemption...and a love letter to the classic adventure games of the 90s! Roused from a life of sloth to reunite with his long-lost brother in search of unimaginable riches, reluctant hero Fester Mudd somehow manages to be intrepid...

The protagonist is an early AI robot sent to explore outer planets many years ago. When it returns to the earth after completing its mission, the earth at this time has changed. Click on the hidden props on the screen, and then drag the props in the props bar to the target position .

Japanese “Pretty Girls” gathered for a hot Mahjong battle!23 different sexy girls to choose from!Voices of all girls are included, squealing in ecstasy when they win!Based on authentic Japanese Mahjong rules.
Terrassez le dernier des géants !

titre: The Resurrection Of Amelia : Across two worlds
description: One night, Amelia was involved in a dispute, died in a car accident, and then strangely resurrected. Amelia woke up and found herself in a strange place. She needed to escape here as soon as possible.

Prêts pour un nouveau départ? Créez votre village depuis le départ dans Seeds of Resilience. Apprenez à choisir vos matériaux, comprendre le fonctionnement de l'environnement et utilisez d'authentiques techniques de construction médiévales dans ce jeu de gestion au tour par tour.
Teomim Island Is a Short Singleplayer Experience, You are playing the main character exploring the island as you go, You will need to survive in the harsh island by collecting loot.

The Accumulation of Evil is an ancient book stating that if enough evil energy is concentrated in a single area, a dark force may be born.Humans can sometimes be very horrible creatures - but sometimes, it is taken a bit too far.

“The Robin”tells the story of a school bully who kills a girl named "Robin." Thirteen people involved are kidnapped and embark on a desperate journey to survive. The work revolves around who is behind the black hand and who is responsible for the death of "Robin" these two questions unfold.

Collectez des déchets, gérez une usine avec 29 machines, 33 travailleurs et près de 300 articles, et vendez vos produits dans le magasin Junkcity. Optimisez l'efficacité et dominez le marché dans ce jeu de simulation dynamique !
If you want to relax and rest, this game is for you.Go through the levels collecting all the balls and soon run to the finish.Good luck!
A hilariously terrifying adventure filled with laughs, blood, insanity, and of course... hordes of the undead.
Although it is already the end of the world, we still stay together. all characters are over the age of 18.

Tales of Fablecraft is a virtual tabletop RPG. It’s easy for GMs and players to learn, whether you've slain many dragons or are completely new to the genre. Fablecraft features its own system, gorgeous human-made art, pre-built campaigns that eliminate prep, and a growing list of homebrew tools.

Ho Yu-Chen received his friend Wan Zi-Jin's invitation, and set on to leave the familiar Taiwan to start a new life with Wan's daughter, Wan Yu-Qing, as an accountant, in Indonesia. Yet with the addition of the mysterious girl, Cocoa, what kinds of events shall turn out to be?
A top down 2D space shooter bullethell with roguelike elements awaits you. Dodge, weave and shoot your way through waves of enemies while gaining upgrades trying to survive as long as possible.

This quiz game is a great choice when you want to learn something, when you feel boring, or when you want to kill some free time. Can you find the words for every picture? Train your brain and learn new words by solving guessing the pics.

A collection of very short stories. XOXO Blood Droplets is an absurd, dark comedy, twisted romance Visual Novel about terrible things happening to terrible people. The fun comes not from avoiding the potential horrors, but by seeing just how many ways things can go wrong.
À Neko Beach, les filles ont chaud au soleil et elles vous attendent avec attention et impudeur. Et bien sûr, il y a la mer et les palmiers.

Tomb Keeper Mansion Deluxe Pinball features Tomb Keeper Mansion Pinball, Outergalactic Aliens Pinball, and Neon Nights Pinball. Tomb Keeper Mansion is a fast paced fantasy themed pinball table featuring 8 main missions and 9 side missions.
Une simulation de vie relaxante qui se déroule en bas de ton écran pendant que tu fais autre chose.

Buckle up, adjust your mirrors and get ready to put your driving abilities to the test as you prove your skills on the streets! Choose between driving a traditional car, bus, or truck and prepare to navigate city streets, mountain roads, or scenic highways.
Weave through missiles to generated music, and let the world flow around you.
Sliko is a puzzle game inspired by Sokoban. Slide cubes to their designated locations.
ANIME WAR — Modern Campaign transports you along with the H.E.N.T.A.I. army to one of the hottest hotspots around the globe to take down our №1 threatening enemy.

titre: Xuan-Yuan Sword: The Gate of Firmament
description: The “Xuan-Yuan Sword” is an epic oriental RPG series with 25 years of history.It elaborates on the very heart of this series, the idea of "one, looking at the same thing from different angles, may come to different conclusions. " through a variety of historical incidents in different times.
Beans is a sardonic 'tycoon' simulation game about hipsters running a coffee shop replete with dismal puns, coffee, chiptunes, and mystery!

Dragon Fin Soup mélange savamment les genres pour créer un climat inédit : à moitié RPG tactique basé sur une histoire et à moitié rogue-like palpitant, avec une pincée d'humour légèrement vulgaire, des meurtres et de la folie... Le tout dans un univers de fantasy généré aléatoirement.

Tyrant's Realm est un jeu d'action-aventure roguelite inspiré des graphismes classiques de la PS1. Explorez des mondes de dark fantasy générés de manière procédurale et affrontez des dangers qui évoluent à chaque passage. La mort n'est pas une fin, car la nuit est encore jeune.
ColdSide is a psychological horror first-person game. It takes place in an abandoned underground laboratory that studied anomalous phenomena.

Start with one tiny office and a big idea, and grow it into a global computer company. Design your own CPUs, GPUs and laptops, launch your own OS, and outsmart your rivals. A laid-back tycoon that's easy to get into and hard to put down — made by one indie dev.
THE QUIET MAN™ propose une expérience cinématique narrative et immersive mariant à la perfection scènes filmées d'excellente qualité, images de synthèses réalistes, et phases de jeu pleines d'action.

Take one of the most modern, fun and engaging board games created in recent years. Match it with cutting-edge technology. Add a ridiculously well-crafted art style and a ton of extra content. This is the recipe to one of the most thrilling, charming and captivating strategy games you will ever find.

A young man discovers through a series of hallucinations that he will grow up to become a violent psychopath. How will he respond to these revelations? Can he change his fate? Can you even... change fate...

Deserving Life is a room-scale virtual reality escape game for the HTC Vive and was developed by students in the Media Technology and Design program at the Hagenberg Campus of the University of Applied Sciences Upper Austria. Can you find a way out of your misery?
You're a frog who just got given a brain! 🐸 Point-and-click your way through a hand-drawn world and solve puzzles, collect items and talk to other hexed animals. . . Can you lift the curse?
Insectophobia est un jeu de plate-forme épisodique. C'est l'histoire de John et sa lutte contre les insectes monstres.

《Love n Dream》 is a puzzle game with many kawaii girls. You will be transformed into multiple roles to approach all of our girls. Your job is to unlock their desired, characteristic, favorite, hate by using your skill to solve all the puzzles and understand more about them.

In the distant future, humanity has turned Venus into a livable environment. However, not all is well on Venusian soil as political intrigue pushes the way to help a young girl, the ace pilot known as Sonic Venus, to find the whereabouts of her missing father.
祛魅·格心（祛魅3）是一款小清新像素风回合制角色扮演游戏，祛魅系列历代作品第三部。剧情故事发生在二代入灭事件结束后的东方异大陆。游戏角色们坦荡胸怀的行为从侧面衬托出女主不羁的内心，以及想要亲近大自然的渴望，同时也反应出底层劳动女性在炎热夏天的生存现状。
Choose your route. Take on your developer dream in Catalina City. Make new friends and enemies. Get your game published.

"The True Love Rings" is a scene interactive decryption game. The overall atmosphere is casual and relaxed. Players follow the prompts in the scene to gradually solve the puzzles and help solve the problems encountered in life.

Government Simulator est une simulation économique et politique simple basée sur des données du monde réel. Prenez le contrôle de tout un pays, comme les États-Unis, l'Allemagne, la France, la Russie ou l'Autriche. Changez les lois, les taxes et les budgets, sur base des statistiques et des données du monde réel, et voyez ce qui se passe.

A puzzle-solving horror game about an Unknown person who cannot remember his past and finds himself in a never-ending cycle/loop, trying to find answers about who he is and why he is suffering in this unknown place.

To The Light is a pixel anime horror ACT game Our heroine was struck by a terrible monster on a dark night When she woke up, she found herself in a strange room...... Waiting for her....is death or survival?
Fight off hordes of enemies, slay Bosses, Dash through enemies and push them off the buildings In this shield themed roguelite.
Survive in a limited space of 16 spaces divided into 4x4 spaces, avoiding obstacles with different themes on each stage

1849 est un jeu de développement de ville se déroulant en Californie au moment de la ruée vers l’or. Construisez vos villes afin d’y attirer des travailleurs et assurez-vous qu’ils disposent de suffisamment de maisons, de nourriture et de distractions.

Défiez vos amis dans une bataille navale dans laquelle vous allez devoir piloter, repousser et tirer. Pour survivre, gardez votre navire à l’écran et empêchez-le d’aller se fracasser sur la terre ferme. Jusqu'à 8 joueurs.
Les Aces of the Luftwaffe sont de retour ! Esquivez une pluie de balles et affrontez leurs terribles machines de guerre lors de batailles aériennes et de combats de boss trépidants !

Unravel the mystery of the King's sudden death... Claim your right for the throne. Try to stay alive as long as possible. Will you take the risk? The story for those who are brave enough to dive in a dark story and are able to think reasonably.

Two worlds merged. A feud that lasted for hundreds of years. The flame of destruction slowly pulsates in the gap. Join your legion on a great journey to cut the chains of hatred and save the world from the primordial darkness.

In this action platformer you play as a cat, Bast, running through a dark fantasy world. You’ll be running, jumping and sliding with smooth and precise controls designed to make you feel like a cat. But it wont be easy. In the dark you never know what lies in the shadows.

Embarquez -si vous l'osez- dans une bataille désespérée contre les horreurs inconnues de l'au-delà des dimensions; avec ses éléments de Roguelike, dont une génération procédurale des niveaux et la mort permanente, CTHON combine à merveille affrontements nerveux et construction stratégique de personnage.
正宗台灣十六張麻將一共提供了自由對戰、修業模式、麻將大賽等三種模式，也有一些特殊的道具和法術可以使用，增加了不少趣味。喜愛麻將的玩家一定會很喜歡這款遊戲。
A short Psychological Horror Experience for one night that takes you through the dark corridors of a mental asylum. For best experience a dark room and headphones recommended.

NeoDuel: Backpack Monsters est un auto-battler avec un brin de Dressage de Monstres ! Collectionne des Cosmions et autres objets, et gère ton sac à dos pour créer des combos imbattables lors de duels stratégiques.
Faites votre chemin à travers un monde de graffitis bizarre, où vos exploits dans la résolution d'énigmes font la différence entre la vie et la mort !

Six ans se sont écoulés depuis les événements de 2226 ap J.-C.. Maintenant que les sociétés trans-galactiques ont été expulsé aux extrémités de la galaxie et déchu de leur pouvoir, l’équilibre de la galaxie est rétablie.L’empire, comme avant, continue à combattre les Aliens.

titre: FINAL FANTASY XV WINDOWS EDITION MOD ORGANIZER
description: Le MOD TOOLS officiel pour l'édition Windows de Final Fantasy XV offre de nouvelles possibilités à nos utilisateurs ! Créez des données à incorporer dans le monde de FINAL FANTASY XV WINDOWS EDITION pour une toute nouvelle expérience.
The spy who shot me™ is a comedy retro FPS inspired by classic shooters of the 90s.

In this narrated platformer there's one man who's always out to get you... The Narrator. He's a real jerk, but with determination and a lot of skill MAYBE you can make it through this crazy adventure.
Explore and reclaim the infested castle-city of Kingsvein! Ride into its depths on your trusty wyvern, and lead your customizable party of Knights and Mystics in deep tactical combat.

RideOp puts you in control of some of the biggest and most thrilling theme park rides in the world. Give all your guests the most unforgettable experience! With full control of the ride's motion, you can offer a unique journey every ride. Now it's your turn to create thrilling experiences!
Prepare to accept history's greatest challenge: build the world's most powerful empire over a span of 6,300 years.
A feedback-based logic and deduction game set in the Nordic world. Face to face with the advisor of the gods, prove your worth and earn the right to drink from the well of knowledge.
An invitation from a stranger... There's something evil in this house... Will you survive?
La Gold Edition contient à la fois Panzer Elite Action - Fields of Glory et son extension Dunes Of War !

Embody the ultimate cybernetic corporate agent. Master deadly gunplay, time manipulation, and supernatural abilities. Hack computers, people, even the individual bullets flying at you. Confront the future, and die trying.

Il s'agit d'un jeu d'horreur indépendant à la première personne dans lequel vous vous retrouvez dans un quartier appelé Kowloon à la recherche d'un logement bon marché. Les habitants de cet endroit semblent ordinaires au premier abord, mais en creusant un peu, on découvre leurs vrais visages.

titre: Forgotten Forest: Eye of the Great One
description: A Lovecraft inspired point and click cosmic horror, that takes places in a mysterious forest, where dreadful things happen. Getting closer to the Unknown, you keep becoming more distant fom your true self. Can you survive and reveal the secrets of the ruthless sect and the mysterious forest?
Wathan Games : série de défis interactifs pour streamers et leurs communautés. Découvrez 'Year 4815', le premier quiz captivant dans un monde abyssal. Jouez, interagissez, unissez-vous !

Skin Deep est un jeu de tir immersif à la première personne dans un vaisseau non linéaire, avec éternuements et objets qui traînent. Faufilez-vous, subvertissez et sabotez pour survivre dans ce bac à sable stellaire, en infériorité numérique, moins bien armée et pieds nus. Bienvenue dans Skin Deep !

As an apprentice magician and alchemist, you learn from different alchemy masters. They teach you to mix elixirs, create potions and control them on alchemist table. Prove everyone that you are a born alchemist!

Play the best Online Snooker Game, with Rankings, Stats, Tournaments every few hours, Game bets and Cue Upgrades. Practice or Play other Snooker players from all over the world. Quick and easy game play with realistic physics.

The Great War is a turn-based grand strategy game based on the epic struggles of the WWI era. Experience the battles of attrition and punishing artillery barrages. Play as any nation of the period as the modern world of industrialized warfare replaces an age of kings with a struggle of ideologies.
*** This game is only available in Traditional Chinese *** 玩家扮演一位女性艺人的同时，也要担任自己的经纪人。在三年的时间中，依自己的经营模式，发展演艺事业，迈向最灿烂的巨星旅程。

Une station minière spatiale ne répond plus aux communications. Un détective tente de découvrir ce qui est arrivé à l'équipage. Oculto est un jeu d'action-aventure narratif en zéro gravité, plein de danger et de mystère.

Need more stress in your life? Meet Laura Silver, a paranoid and insomniac detective tasked with researching Slavic mythology. Do you know anything about the Vodnik? Neither does she. Unfortunately, her incompetence won't be your biggest problem in Czechoslovakia.

'Depuis la nuit des temps, le Clan des Gardiens a toujours gardé et protégé les Anneaux Sacrés des Mondes Parallèles, et les deux Tétraèdes Sacrés.'D'anciennes légendes racontent que celui qui pourra réunir ces Anneaux Sacrés avec certains artefacts venus des Mondes Parallèles recevra un pouvoir immense et l'immortalité.

Built on the award-winning Kohan: Immortal Sovereigns gameplay, Ahriman’s Gift is the stand-alone prequel to Kohan: Immortal Sovereigns. Experience the world of Khaldun from a whole new perspective: evil.

Write on! Defend the books in Vellum, a co-op, literary roguelike! Harness class-defining colors, master an inspired spellbook, and influence the growth of your enemy! As a group or solo, you'll craft plot-twisting builds to rewrite the rules in Ink!

Deep underground lies a reminder of Boarkind’s darkest hours. All it takes is one little boar to dig it back up. A block puzzler with an exploratory twist, Full Bore throws the player into an open world of crumbling mines, arcane ruins, and technological wonders with only curiosity to lead the way.
Entrez dans le monde tordu de Forgotten Hill avec une troisième dimension.

Une aventure à la ferme pas comme les autres! Développez votre propre ferme, bâtissez et personnalisez votre maison, fabriquez vos propres meubles, confectionnez de délicieuses confitures et faites muter vos plants pour créer des compagnons loyaux et sans peur à emmener au combat!

In Crazy Plant Shop, players learn about genes and inheritance by breeding zany plants! Special requests from mysterious customers require players to understand dominant and recessive traits and how genetic traits get passed through generations. Use profits to acquire new breeds, purchase shop upgrades, and acquire new customers!

Beat Around the Bush is a series done over YouTube shorts where the top comment got the next addition to the game. Beat Around the Bush is a game where your primary goal is to Beat around the Bush. Once you do, you did it. You won. Therefore, there's no more reason to keep playing this game.
Tranche, coupe et écrase tes ennemis ! Prends le contrôle de héros, de monstres et bien d’autres choses encore pour aider les vikings à sauver leur royaume ! Le Valhalla t’attend !

Xenophage is a fighting game in the same genre as Mortal Kombat. This game features scrolling arenas that also zoom in and out, depending on how far apart the fighters are from each other. This is a unique feature in fighting games. The fighters all come from unique alien planets, so they look very cool and unusual.
Vous vivrez toutes les émotions de la gestion du football dans Premier Manager 2004-2005. Découvrez si vous avez ce qu'il faut…

titre: Nancy Drew®: The Haunting of Castle Malloy
description: Unveil a Ghostly Legend and Find a Vanished Groom!
