Lead an elite tank crew in one of four frontline U.S. tanks of the Cold War era, including the M60A3, M48A5 Patton, M3 Bradley CFV, and the devastating M1A1 Abrams. Assume the roles of Commander, Driver, and Gunner in an indomitable war machine that rolls out of the west like steel thunder.

Contrôlez le duo improbable des inspecteurs Magret, canard raffiné et FaceDeBouc, bouc diaboliquement opposé ! Aidez-les à résoudre l'énigme du meurtre de Mr Couane, commerçant de la ville retrouvé transformé en saucissons dans ce point and click cartoon d'enquête policière déjanté.

Welcome to Silicon Island, where you are the only programmer in town! You enjoy the simple life of diskettes and dial-up connections, until one day your boss ruins it with an email. He sends you some files to review, but your computer explodes and releases a swarm of bugs that infect the island.
Préparez-vous à l'expérience de billard la plus authentique qui soit, tranquillement installé dans votre canapé !

Sautez entre des lames de scie tout en évitant des missiles à tête chercheuse. Faufilez-vous sous des lasers tandis que le sol s'écroule sous vos pieds. On y presque a été conçu spécifiquement pour les fans du genre plateformes hardcore ; on vous aura prévenu.

Obtenez le travail du siècle avec une entreprise nommée Project Freedom. Devenez un pilote de l'espace et servez la corporation. Vous allez voir du pays.Peut-être même un peu plus...21 missionsGraphismes 3Det effets spéciauxScénario original avec surprises et rebondissementsVariété de missions spatiales : escorte, secours, attaques...

Contrôlez un essaim de 32 000 drones dans ce jeu de stratégie et d'aventure se déroulant dans l'espace ! Sautez de système en système et affrontez de puissantes flottes extraterrestres. Détruisez des vaisseaux ennemis, provoquez des collisions, bloquez des attaques et contournez les défenses.

Do you find tycoon games too simplistic? GearCity is a complex and in-depth business simulator. It focuses on a realistic economic simulation of the global automobile industry. The game takes several hours to grasp and hundreds of hours to master. Can you succeed where many other CEOs have failed?

Milkmaid of the Milky Way est un jeu d'aventure point'n click dans la plus pure tradition, mêlant une histoire pleine de rebondissements, des énigmes et de l'exploration, le tout écrit entièrement en rimes !
Everyone will be given ACTUAL CHEATS in this multiplayer shooter. Use wallhacks and aimbots to your advantage and dominate the other cheetahs. The winner will get to BAN all losers!
A turn-based volleyball RPG where you coach a sports team of Beasties! Your Beasties' relationships grow and change, unlocking new abilities and combo plays!
In a lawless, post-apocalyptic, hyper-industrialized gutter, where desperate people, demons, and robots compete in a ruthless power struggle, how long can your character survive?

Freight Tycoon est un jeu de simulation d’économie qui défi les compétences de gestion des joueurs. Il met le joueur à la place d’un propriétaire d’une compagnie de transportation cargo. Le joueur doit évaluer la rentabilité des contrats, contacter les clients, et nommer les chauffeurs pour délivrer les biens.

titre: The Beast Within: A Gabriel Knight® Mystery
description: Play as both Gabriel and Grace as they are dispatched to Munich to solve a series of mutilation murders thought to be the work of werewolves.

It’s 2741 and the universe is at war. The Terran Empire is laying siege to the NSA, a treaty of colonies that upholds freedom and democracy. After losing the battle in space, the NSA is forced to retreat to its last stronghold. Can you snatch victory from impending doom?

In the near future a terrorist mastermind, known only as ‘The End’, threatens humanity with nuclear armageddon. A special task force, the S.E.A.L.E.D team, are the only ones who can stop him: a group of young combatants with incredible abilities and each with a mysterious past.

You're a constructer and you’ve specialized in the "bringing up" of skyscrapers. Due to your specialization over the years you constantly get new orders for higher and higher skyscrapers in town. Within your responsibilities are the planning, the supply with construction materials and the worker management.

After the pandemic Covitch69, you lost your job as a space aviation expert and now become a teacher in a small town. Luckily, every cloud has a silver lining as you are stepping into a world where love blooms unexpectedly and leads you to captivating ladies with immersive romantic tales.

Shooter’s Island is an aim trainer with VR support, built for FPS pros and beginners alike. On an expansive, remote island, several trials await you that train your reflexes and precision. Analyze your shooting skills on your personal low-poly testing island!

Welcome to Seeking Dawn, a multiplayer survival VR adventure that takes you far beyond the solar system. Step into the shoes of a soldier discovering a hostile planet, where predators roam free and enemies are ruthless.

Color by Number - Pixel Draw is an addictive anti-stress pixel art game. Choose from a variety of fun pixel images and follow the numbers to bring them to life. Pixel Coloring has never been this easy!
Un jeu de construction de deck avec des batailles sur plateau ! Choisissez un héros et une allégeance puis plongez dans le donjon et construisez votre deck tout en vous battant!

titre: Forgotten Fables: Wolves on the Westwind
description: Forge your own path and embark on a perilous journey on board a ship of Thorwal raiders in this epic tale set in the award-winning world of The Dark Eye RPG.
Aaru's Awakening is a hand drawn 2D action platformer set in the mythical world of Lumenox. Travel through the mysterious world while the story of the four gods unravels.

Silent Decent is a highly-immersive first-person horror game with a rich and engaging atmosphere. Trapped in purgatory, you play as Samuel Harris who roams in an endless loop of anguish, pain and suffering. Can you find a way to save a tormented man's soul?

Vasilisa the Wise is a visual novel based on the famous Russian fairy tale "The Frog Princess". However, unlike the well-known fairy tale, in this game there are several scenarios, depending on the actions of the player. The goal of the game is to defeat the evil and win the heart of Vasilisa.

titre: 阿比斯的宝藏 - Treasure of abyss
description: 《阿比斯的宝藏》是一款超长篇的海贼冒险剧情式RPG游戏，并结合半沙盒与半硬核的传统玩法。游戏背景与故事建立在拥有大面积海洋的幻想世界，海洋将各个岛屿连接起来，海路也成为了游戏唯一的交通方法。四大海域成为了海贼们冒险与战斗的舞台，进行着各种各样精彩演绎。

For the people who like reading quest descriptions and following context clues. Also a great experience for Achievement Hunters with 100 to collect. All while a subtle interconnected story unfolds. Free Roam Exploration awaits in a strange new world!
Create unique RPG maps easily and effectively and then play through them with your friends!
C.B.T (Crazy Ball Time) is a ball-rolling platformer, with crazy tough action, and even crazier Balls.

Dive into Piscirazzi, an underwater photography roguelite! Take photos of exotic fish and choose upgrades to enhance your camera. Then review your stunning photos to improve your photography skills. Can you snap them all?
"QuitToday" is a beat ‘em up game around the workplace theme. You will step into an epic resignation adventure and kick your colleagues' asses.
Gardener’s Path is a top-down turn-based puzzle game, about fighting giant insects and protecting underground gardens, through the use of magical artifacts.

Defend your castle, mine for minerals, and level up your wizarding powers in this thrilling action-roguelike game. Grab your wand and prepare to fight off magical foes in this epic battle for survival!
Cut grass, unlock new mowers and avoid deathly zombie enemies

DimensionsVS is a chaotic party brawler for 1 to 4 players online or locally. Fast-paced and tactical, flashy and over-the-top, challenge your friends in this all new, completely Free to Play platform fighter!

Sadistic robots have enslaved orcas at SeaLand Marine Park. The evil Sheep Puncher robot has kidnapped sheep for the twisted wool industry. Only the Kitten Squad is up to the task of saving these gentle animals.
Bomb Bowling 2 is an indie puzzle game with physics. Kick the pins out of the screen using explosions!
Type words, squashing ants in the process, protecting your precious Wurst (sausage). Play in single- or local multiplayer and even create your own word packs for even more fun in the game.
Une nouvelle approche des jeux de stratégie RPG ! Les Slimes, les plus faibles des personnages de RPG, peuvent prendre le contrôle d'une unité ennemie et se battre !

A compilation of two slow-paced, cosmic horror walking simulators, to be completed in under an hour. Please makes you maintain a power station and ignore the noises from the main engine, while Please Follow has you explore the trenches of a losing war, exposing your mind to visions of another world.

A living prehistoric ecosystem that does not revolve around you. Shape the island as a god, or enter it as a human and survive while animals, weather, water, terrain and your own body change over time.

Rush for Glory is featuring challenging and rewarding Tower Defense battles, in which players are defending their base against an alien invasion. By strategically building towers and upgrading them, the player can keep his base safely and further progress through the extensive singleplayer campaign.
Homeland: Lay to Rest is a third person action-adventure game about a monk in training who fights corrupted guardians with a thrown homing weapon to redeem their overrun childhood home.

Entrez par effraction dans un asile fermé aux expériences illégales. Après un terrible incident, l'un des patients s'est transformé en une créature effrayante qui y vit toujours. Trouvez votre chemin par vous-même. N'oubliez pas... vous êtes SEUL !

Matt's Project Zombies: Endless is a Wave Based Survival Shooter Created by Matt Sowards. Fight through Hordes of the Undead with up to 6 friends or Alone! There is a Wide Range of weapons from easy to harder Difficulties to master. Unique Locations, Original Soundtrack, Missions, Secrets & More!

Giana Sisters 2D est un remake HD du jeu Nintendo DS bien-aimé de 2009. Il propose une prise en charge complète de la manette, des commandes précises et intuitives, ainsi qu'une courbe d'apprentissage fluide. Le tout équilibré pour des heures de plaisir et de défi.

A mysterious plague befell ancient Celephais. What choices await the twins lost in the chaos? The Roguelite action-platformer Kelipot is here! With a rich story experience, frame-by-frame animations and hand-illustrated 2D visuals. Explore and uncover the truth beneath this twisted world!

After your death due to a car accident, you have been summoned by the goddess to take care of a tavern in an Isekai world. Your job is to hire different girls from various tribes and races to help out the business there, as well as build up room by room of the tavern to expand the business.

Sheriff Rage est un jeu d'action Western dans lequel vous incarnez le shérif de la ville d'Oldstone qui protège ses habitants des envahisseurs extraterrestres. En utilisant les armes du Far West, vous combattez des hordes d'ennemis extraterrestres et d'énormes Boss pour nettoyer la ville de la menace.

Conduisez une locomotive soviétique et entreprenez un périlleux voyage sur la plus longue voie ferrée du monde. Au menu : des rivaux mafieux, des bandits, des animaux sauvages, des pannes, des vagues de froid, la faim et... des gueules de bois. Jusqu'où irez-vous avant d'épuiser vos réserves ?

Cible Impossible est une version science-fiction d'Opération difficile. Vous guidez votre fusée vers la cible rouge sur la carte sans exploser. Ce jeu propose des niveaux extrêmement difficiles. Parviendrez-vous à gagner ?
《浮生箓》是一款剧情重开模拟游戏，互动式轻量小说游戏。支持创意工坊自由编辑与上传自己的剧本，融合如修仙、武侠、玄幻等小说题材的背景，可自由选择出生的剧本，体验千变万化的人生，从出生开始让你体验到丰富多变的剧情，多种多样的选择，不同选择带来不同的变化，各种有趣的梗。来吧，开始你的浮生之旅，随着进程生成自己的浮生箓！

Crypt is a 3rd person click to move adventure based RPG that takes you deep into the ancient and forgotten places of a long dead world. rise as an un-dead skeleton and begin your war path of magical carnage.
Build a "legitimate" corporation via open world missions, shakedowns, sabotage and property acquisition.

Build orbital factories, mine asteroids & trade with aliens in this deep space strategy game! Research tech, manage production chains, and choose: peaceful trade or combat when mysterious ships arrive. The ultimate industrial space empire simulator!
Auto Battler, Incremental, Idle Game

Basingstoke is a tense rogue-like that mixes stealth and arcade action. Explore the smouldering ruins of Basingstoke, a world of reanimated undead and ferocious alien monsters. Scavenge as you go, crafting equipment to help you in your mission: escape Basingstoke!

Soul Smith of the Kingdom is a business idle game involving smith workshop business. Play as Nine,heiress of the unparalleled Andelioar Workshop in the kingdom,instruct smiths and adventurers and make perfect weapons--all to revitalize the workshop!

titre: The Pacifist's Great and Final Nightmare

description: Dans Vanguard : Normandy 1944, les joueurs se battent avec leur section pour survivre dans des combats multijoueurs acharnés afin prendre d’authentiques objectifs du Jour-J.

Smash your way out of corporate purgatory. Decorporation is a fast-paced rogue-lite FPS where keyboards, monitors, and rolling chairs are deadlier than guns. Dodge bullets in slow motion, take out brainwashed coworkers, and battle through procedurally generated office floors to confront the CEO.

The Fangs Huntress is a retro-inspired first person shooter with a huge roster of monsters and bosses, with a fantastic array of weapons. The game puts you in the shoes of a demon hunter in search of the all-powerful vampire Vladislav!

UBOAT : The Silent Wolf est une combinaison étonnante d'un jeu de rôle et d'un simulateur, offrant une expérience profonde et immersive, vous permettant de vous sentir comme un véritable capitaine de sous-marin pendant la Seconde Guerre mondiale.

Tower of Portal is a little Indie FPS Shooter, where you control a soldier with the mission to destroy the AI Central Computer that controls the machines spreads in the city. Your mission is avoid this domination through the machines.

Intriguée par un vif éclat lumineux au loin et déterminée à tracer son chemin dans l’obscurité, une petite bougie part à l’aventure dans un monde mystérieux extrêmement dangereux. Pièges et énigmes se dresseront sur sa route, mais attention : elle ne peut s'éclairer que 10 secondes.

A certain feeling of dread pervades a small southeastern island nation still recovering from its gruesome past. Miss Audacity finds herself caught in the center of a serial murder case spanning 8 years. Help her as she tries to remember the past in order to save her sister, her friends, and herself.

Fantasy Grounds est une table virtuelle de JDR (VTT) puissante et immersive. Jouez à D&D, Pathfinder, et bien d'autres systèmes avec des cartes dynamiques, des feuilles de personnage interactives et des outils pour MJ. Moins de préparation, plus de jeu !

Une jolie fille sortie d'un animé se rend compte que son grand frère méga cool a disparu ? Tartine les tous avec Chizuru et SHOOTE AU RYTHME DE LA MUSIQUE dans ce bullet hell en vue du dessus ! Fais sauter ces têtes de gruyère avec leurs propres balles et montre-leur de quoi il en retourne !
Crab Cakes Rescue is a wacky puzzle game unlike any other. Find unlikely paths through nearly 100 zany levels by shedding your shell and building blocks where obstacles occur!
Gangsta magician need solve puzzles, avoid traps and enemies and find mystery USA Cone in his adventure
3D third-person shooter game. Control a tank using a keyboard and mouse. Go through various maps and destroy bots on your way. Fight with two main bosses on your path to complete the game.
A turn-based tactics game about goofy characters with wide and varied techniques duking it out across a bright and colourful battlefield.

Recipe for Disaster est une simulation de gestion qui reproduit l'environnement trépidant et ô combien dramatique de la cuisine. Bâtissez un restaurant de rêve créez des recettes, concevez des menus et gérez votre personnel, tout en jonglant avec des clients exigeants et des situations désastreuses!

Protect your caravan and face the brutal Untamed Wilds in roguelite turn-based RPG Sanctuary Saga. Engage in row-based combat across multiple varied biomes and keep your group together using a dynamic relationship system.

titre: 消灭魔王军 Destroy the Demon Army
description: This game is a purely placed game. The player can run the game automatically without any or little operation. The goal is to destroy all the Devils and Devils.

Run, jump and collect gold coins. If you want to have fun, Super Bora Dragon Eyes is for you. Super Bora Dragon Eyes has 36 chapters, which takes place in space, at sea, in the desert, in many places such as winter and summer. Explore, search the gates and upgrade your weapons. (acc. to gold coins).

RIP is an all-out war simulation on the ground, in the air or at sea. With 4 different Soldier classes and their specific weapons in many different scenario maps from the middle eastern desert to a well-isolated bunker construction, you can fight as your heart desires and let the enemy bleed out in the dust.
Vous recherchez une nouvelle approche des jeux de puzzle ? Regardez vos attentes sous un nouvel angle et empilez les records dans Cylinder !

Mr. Pumpkin 2 : Kowloon Walled City est la suite de la franchise Mr. Pumpkin. Notre protagoniste, un homme insignifiant avec une tête de citrouille, explorera la ville fortifiée de Kowloon, à Hong Kong, et sera témoin des histoires qui se déroulent à l'intérieur de ces murs.

Get dice, use abilities, make deals- then profit! Cubic Currency is a game all about trading dice for cash- chasing after an ever increasing rent payment week-after-week, and dealing with all the insanity the future has to offer! From aliens, to tech, to cultish corporate leaders!

Annalynn is a 2D platformer made in the style of arcade games from the early '80s. Collect the coins, grab the bonus foods, and turn the tables with blinding rubies! Think you've got what it takes to go for the high score?

System Crash is a story-driven cyberpunk collectible card game inspired by Blade Runner and Neuromancer. When corporations own everything and the line between man and machine is blurred, your only option is to fight to survive!

Action roguelike for 1-4 players with cute graphics and deep game mechanics. Combine dozens of different weapons, magic items, potions and spells with unique effects to beat 8 enemy factions and 28 bosses. Can you find the ancient goblin artifact at the end of the dungeon?

Devileader, a fearsome space demon who once have destroyed countless planets of the solar system is about to be resurrected by his minions and fanatics, who want to bring chaos to the universe. Pilot the agile space interceptor Deviship and survive the terror of this demon lord.
A sci-fi space vehicle combat game, where the player must defend their capital ship from being destroyed, while attempting to destroy the alien force's own capital ship!
Sparc est un V-Sport – un jeu de sport physique et unique, exclusivement en réalité virtuelle, dans lequel les joueurs s'affrontent à corps perdu lors de parties intenses en VR.

Incarnez un jeune graffeur stratège prêt à tout pour taguer ses œuvres sur les murs des plus grandes villes du monde. Soyez furtif, malin et rapide. Mais surtout, aidez-le à ne pas se faire attraper !

titre: BIT.TRIP Presents... Runner2: Future Legend of Rhythm Alien
description: Step into rhythmic bliss with Runner2! Best Indie Game winner, Guinness World Record holder, and narrated by Charles Martinet. Unleash vibrant moves and beats in 120 levels!
A pig farmer decides he no longer wants to dispose of bodies for the mob. What follows is a discussion between him and his would-be killer.

BANAN'EM UP! is a tiny challenging arcade shoot’em up where you shoot down quirky aliens to save your planet. Evade bullets, shoot enemies, get upgrades, survive for challenging waves to defeat the final boss, "The MONKE". Die, learn, repeat: get stronger, be powerful!

Learn new skills based on simple key combinations in this easy to learn, hard to master adventure RPG. Combine over 100 different skills from 5 diverse classes to create an unbeatable combination and reclaim your body by finishing Asura's Trial.
The Dreamatorium of Dr. Magnus 2 is the second chapter of the game you loved. Colorful locations, challenging puzzles, RPG elements, amusing comments and many more to come!

Gran Skrea invites players to create their own destiny in an original world of medieval fantasy. Embark on varied and challenging quests, square off in ruthless PvP combat, or write your character’s story through an unstructured economy and player-created guilds.

La survie de votre peuple, c'est la seule chose qui compte. Devenez le chef d'une nouvelle colonie viking et conduisez-la vers la sécurité et la gloire. Rassemblez, construisez, fabriquez, chassez, pillez et suivez vos dieux pour endurer les difficultés de la nature et sauver votre clan de la mort

Immerse yourself in the full cycle of life of the most severe school in Russia! The game will tell you the story of a Russian schoolboy Ivan who is on the verge of graduation and expulsion. He intends to finish school in his own way and, along the way, take revenge on all teachers and local bullies.

titre: 降神战役 -A Story of the usurpers-
description: Because of an accident, the war once again descended on this land where peace has been welcomed for less than 10 years. Rebels swarming up, weak religious orders, hostile neighbors in the north. Where will the fate of the country go?

The media is quick to put figures to death tolls in such disasters, and 9.03m tries to remind people of the individuals behind those figures. 9.03m is set on Baker Beach in San Francisco, where debris from the tsunami has washed ashore in the years following the tsunami. To play, you must find the butterflies.

Unravel a string of gruesome murders terrorizing Tokyo in this mystery-thriller visual novel. The secrets of a case from six years prior may just be the key to the current unending cycle of tragedy—and the thing that cracks this woeful world’s shell may be one girl’s smile.

Take a mind-bending trip through a mysterious, haunting alternate reality. Use your newly discovered magic, wits, and curiosity to cleanse the world of glum and find a way back to your family. Experience the wonder of this 2009 AIGF Showcase winner and indie cult classic.
Un jeu d’aventure point-and-click comique dans lequel un antiquaire beurré doit résoudre son propre cambriolage à Paris, entraînant ses amis et lui-même dans une aventure complètement loufoque !

Microgons is a 1v1 online competitive turn-based strategy game. Construct a team of polygonal monsters called Microgons, and strategically maneuver them across a board to engage them in combat against the opposing team. Don't be fooled by its lighthearted look, this is a hardcore game.

Dub Dash is a fast-paced rhythm based action game including music from Bossfight and the DJs of Geometry Dash. Spin your crazy wheel in harmony with the song and keep dodging left and right avoiding obstacles at high speed. Do you rock the funky roads of Dub Dash?

Poop you way to victory...again! In Muddy Heights 2, you play as a person who has had a little bit too much to eat and needs to relieve himself by any means possible. Poop off various heights onto people and vehicles to score points. Complete level goals to gain cash to buy more food.

S.O.T.A - Survival Online Time Anomaly is a multiplayer MMO TPS game with RPG and open world survival elements. The game takes place in an anomalous zone. The setting of the game is the Soviet local post-apocalypse.
This is the best offer ever - 5 Hidden Object titles at one small price! Enjoy hidden object madness for 20 hours and don't forget to present this bundle to your friends who love Hidden Object Games!

Hire heroes, build an army, prevail in battles and try to keep your empire intact in the face of grave danger. Eador. Imperium is a new chapter in Eador series, known for its unique blend of grand strategy, turn-based tactics and RPG elements.
Let the Retrowave be with you!

Attrape ton lance-pierre, attrape une Furball... ET DEMOLIS LES TOUS !!! Venez vous essayer au lance-pierre en Réalité Virtuelle dans VR Furballs - Demolition ! Simple et addictif, il vous suffira de viser, tirer, tout démolir, et récupérez les 3 étoiles dans chaque niveau! Prêt à relever le défi ?
Excellent Expectations is a puzzle adventure game , you would use search engines to discover a story from a stranger's phone .
主人公は好きな女の子がいる。ある日、彼は彼女に、告ってしまった。「ごめんなさい。あたしには好きな人がいるの」と断られた彼は、どうしても彼女を「まもり」たくなった。

titre: El Dorado: The Golden City Builder
description: El Dorado est un jeu de construction de ville stratégique où tu planifies, tu construis et tu développes ton village pour conquérir Yukatan et gagner le titre de la Ville d’or. Deviens un chef devant qui même les dieux s’inclineront. Offre des sacrifices aux dieux pour gagner leurs faveurs.

Join the fleet of the Federation. Fly a space gunship and join your fighter squad to reinforce your fleet against enemy warships and gunships. Protect Federation transporters and Federation facilities from incoming attacks.
Loot. Craft. Build. Defend. Fight. Survive
Isekai survival horror RPG. defeat the enemy or escape, your decision will make the difference between life and death. ...... A horror RPG with large character dots and a death-defying storyline.

"Stay" follows the experience of a motel maid, Cas, as she becomes entangled in a twisted tale of obsession, love, and terror. Unbeknownst to her, a deranged stalker harbors a dangerous infatuation with Cas, leading to a series of threatening letters and a deadly game of survival.

War has ended in Seralia, but the scars are far from healed. Explore a dystopian landscape and build weapons from scrap parts to use in battle. Recruit companions and travel in style in your trusty motorbike as you uncover the depths of a deep government conspiracy. The future is vast.

This is a fast-paced top-down shooting and tower defense game. You need to customize and upgrade your chariot, build defensive structures to protect your base, explore the world and destroy all enemies! Don't forget to come back and defend when the enemy attacks! Can you make it to the end?

Free version of Shrouded in Sanity. Discover the secrets of the estate, as you look for answers among the violent inhabitants. Servants roaming the halls will attack on sight, for a strange and repelling madness took hold... one rooted in a deeper understanding of cosmic insignificance.

Darkness Ahead is an adventure game about a man searching for his little brother. A plateau between mountains holds a dark secret about its past. You have to stay alive and collect everything you need to complete your quest.

titre: The King's Request: Physiology and Anatomy Revision Game
description: This short adventure game uses your knowledge of the human body and concepts from science, biology, physiology, anatomy, medicine, biomed, nursing, pharmacy, health or exercise science as your weapon! There's no negative if you get a question wrong - so have a go and save the kingdom!!

Ganbare! Super Strikers est un mélange innovant entre le Jeu de Rôle Tactique et le Football. Remportez des matches pour monter de niveau et obtenez de l’équipement qui vous permettra d’apprendre des compétences spéciales, d’augmenter les stats de vos joueurs ou de vous protéger contre des altérations de statut, tels que le Sommeil,...

Explorez un monde excitant ouvert, rempli de secrets et de gardiens mystérieuse qui peuvent vous aider à guérir Elliot de la malédiction d’immortalité. À travers votre aventure, vous recueillerez d'innombrables capacités et pouvoirs, quête à travers 5 donjons, et victoire contre les 16 boss uniques!

"201 - The Bad Number" is an interactive science fiction game-book set on a post-apocalyptic Mars. In a world where only 200 people remain, each new inhabitant may hasten civilization's end. Players make choices that impact the fate of humanity and the colony in a unique dystopian setting.

Become a powerful Rune Teller traveling through the open world of the Runegea. Recruit great colleagues for a fun journey, craft through a variety of items, and solve the requests of the Runegea residents. At the end of a long journey, you will find the reason for your resurrection.
Soldiers Lost Forever (1914-1918) is a World War 1 top down 2D shooter where armies battle it out in the trenches and fight for control of the battlefield.

titre: Aokana - Four Rhythms Across the Blue - EXTRA2
description: Aokana - EXTRA2 is the official Misaki after story for Aokana.

The protagonist goes winter fishing on a lake and is caught in a snowstorm. He decides to wait it out in a tent and falls asleep. When the cold wakes him up, he finds his burner empty, his tent cold, and the ice outside broken, leaving him with no way back to the shore.
A satisfying shooting game with 4 gameplay modes and simple controls! Upgrade your character and defend the Portal from the creatures of the void.
Placed in a world without change, you must create fate by watering an ancient plant. Determine a future and live with it.

Wyvern is a real-time, top-down 2D, graphical, massively multiplayer RPG. The game has thousands of maps and playable areas, hundreds of skills, spells and monsters, and all the features you would expect from a big fun RPG: Guilds, crafting, level editing, community features and more!

«Le Joueur de Rôle» c’est un film interactif: il vous faut choisir des options pendant le jeu, dont dépend le sort du personnage principal. Notre héros aime jouer à des jeux RPG sur le sujet des catastrophes d'origine humaine et Post-Apocalypse...
An otome dating sim about a humorously jerky young lady and her mission to woo one of multiple uniquely, but equally, obnoxious guys.

titre: Ultionus: A Tale of Petty Revenge
description: Ultionus is a love-letter to the home computer arcade games of the late 80s and early 90s, with colorful 2D visuals, catchy chiptune music by the legendary Jake 'Virt' Kaufman, and 7 stages of hard-as-nails gameplay.

titre: 天呐！找不到真爱就扑街！
description: First-person perspective through role-playing When getting along with the "Destined Heroine", they constantly make choices to deepen mutual understanding, and strive to exchange sincerity for true love. These choices determine the final emotional outcome. In the end, who will Huang Di's true love be
Explore a strange and mysterious world, searching through the environment for symbols that will open the way forward.

Un jeu d’infiltration inspiré par les films noirs. Calvino Noir est une aventure d’exploration et d’infiltration à travers l’underground criminel de l’Europe des années 30. Laissez-vous emporter dans cette intrigue révolutionnaire où l’architecture rencontre le film noir.

titre: New York Mysteries: The Lantern of Souls Collector's Edition
description: Laura James, journaliste au 'Daily News', enquêtait sur une affaire de meurtre ordinaire quand tout a dégénéré.

titre: Nancy Drew®: Ghost of Thornton Hall
description: Some Families Keep Deadly Secrets!
UFOBIA est un jeu d'horreur coopératif pour 1 à 4 joueurs qui ont besoin de résoudre des énigmes et de faire face à des êtres d'une autre planète.
Wiggly Boy is a sobering look at the power of your computer.
Make your way through unique and challenging gun courses as fast as possible while clearing all red targets and avoiding green ones. Compete for the fastest times!

You are a member of Space Station 51. When you wake up, you find that a zombie virus has broken out on the space station. You need to follow the command of the station master and take a series of actions.

Step into a world of festive cheer and excitement with Christmas Slots, the ultimate casino game that combines the thrill of spinning reels with the joyous spirit of the holiday season. Get ready for a merry gambling experience filled with colorful symbols, jingle bells, and the chance to win big.
Bloodworks is a free top-down survival action game where you fight against an endless waves of monsters. The odds are not in your favor!

AFU game offers you to take on the role of a soldier of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and try yourself in a performance of various missions with a plot. Starting with a banal base defense, to the destruction of the legendary orc`s cruiser.
A supernatural mystery visual novel. What kind of fate will the heroine face after she relives the last seven days before her death?

Uncanny Valley is a survival horror game that includes a mix of exploration, puzzle solving and a bit of action with a lot of optional story content. We're trying to preserve the old survival horror kind of gameplay instead of following the modern trend of creating a third person shooter with horror elements.

Your crew aboard the Pilfered Liberty has been abducted by pirates! Shoot through hordes of aliens while avoiding traps and drops to rescue your crew in this action-packed 2D platformer. They’re relying on you, Captain. Can you save them all?

Rev up your engines, MotoGP™24 is back! Dive into the heart-pounding action of the 2024 season and immerse yourself in the thrills of unexplored landscapes, all thanks to the revolutionary Riders market!

Enter an Awesome Open World, Single-Player RPG focused on Crafting and Creativity. A world full of Ancient Secrets; With dragons, demons, and deep dungeons waiting for you. Inspired by classic RPGs like Skyrim, Oblivion, and Morrowind.
FEBA Gunship R est un jeu de combat en hélicoptère où vous prenez part à des batailles intenses aux commandes d’un hélicoptère d’attaque personnalisé.

Mists of Aiden is a first-person story driven horror game. You play as a thief trapped in an eerie mansion. Each choice can open a new mystery of the house and lead to a unique walkthrough and ending. Uncover final secret of the house. Uncover your own secrets.
On the corner of July Avenue and Yam Street, all is not what it seems. What role will you play in a city's fate?

Max Raider is a top-down 3D action shooter where you fight waves of enemies on procedurally generated arenas. Rest and prepare for the next series of waves by buying a variety of weapons and items from your allies. Protect the Bunker, your only hope for a home.

Space for Sale est un jeu d'immobilier spatial interplanétaire en vue du dessus, qui met l'accent sur la résolution de problèmes et l'exploration. En solo ou à deux, c'est à vous de transformer des terres sauvages et inhabitées en lieux de vie bouillonnants !

The Knight Witch est un metroidvania offrant un gameplay effréné et un monde magnifique tracé à la main. Lancez de puissants sorts grâce à vos cartes, liez-vous d’amitié avec les personnages et faites des choix difficiles au fil de votre quête pour sauver le monde et révéler le secret de l’invasion.

Slay monsters and explore procedural worlds in this old school hack and slash Mini-RPG set in a fantasy world. Battles are a combo of turn based and real time elements. Block enemy attacks and enhance your own using active abilities.

Oozi: Earth Adventure is a classic 2D platformer with old school gameplay - no puzzles, no punishment, just 100% pure classic platforming fun! Its most prominent features are HD visuals and beautiful hand-drawn art, but despite its visual style, it’s a good fit for all kinds of gamers!

A brave warrior named Galahar goes back to his hometown after 10 years of searching for his kidnapped daughter, who disappeared during raid at their village. Soon after arriving home at Solside Village, he is selected by the Mershiak Church to become a Swordmaster.

Rénovez, équipez et redonnez de l'éclat au food truck qui appartenait à votre père. Créez des recettes, cuisinez des plats et servez les clients dans une ville entière. Personnalisez et améliorez votre food truck pour toucher plus de clients et élargir votre menu.

Une aventure immersive de donjon puzzle dans l'esprit des jeux d'ordinateur domestique des années 1980. Creusez votre chemin à travers 100 niveaux dans les profondeurs antiques de la montagne Dreadrock. Lauréat du Google Indie Games Festival / 1er prix Indie Clash / Finaliste du PocketGamer People's Choice / Nominé au meilleur jeu...

Xeno Crisis est un jeu de tir en arène dans lequel jusqu'à deux joueurs pénètrent dans un avant-poste de recherche dévasté pour y affronter une menace extraterrestre et en ressortir vivants ! Courez et frayez-vous un chemin en tirant sur des milliers d'adversaires tout en recherchant la source de la vague meurtrière d'extraterrestres.
Battlepillars is a real-time tug-of-war strategy game in which you command caterpillars armed to the teeth with flamethrowers, sticky honey, mines, machine guns, and more!

Game ‘Valor Time’ representative of the client family Session based multiplayer action RPG (session multiplayer role-playing games) of the medieval WASD non-target management system. The game process supports massive battles.

An epic story of mystery, war & comedy! Packed with satire targeting our worlds filthy billionaires, dodgy media & corrupt governments. 25+ hours & 100mins of fully voiced theatrical scenes featuring well known truth seekers of our world! This indie game is Masonic free with no added protein spikes!

Rememoried is an independent video game, a virtual place where memories change to dreams and the only possible way is forgetting, which becomes a mechanism for proceeding to the next layer of dreams. The Surrealist explorative first-person adventure game.

Le retour du singe déjanté !Toki repart à l’aventure ! Le jeu culte d’action/plateforme initialement sorti sur borne d’arcade en 1989 revient dans une nouvelle version des plus simiesques ! Entièrement redessinée à la main et réorchestrée intégralement !
Assemble armies of soldiers, lead them into battle, conquer your enemies and move one step closer to galactic domination!

Leadwerks Game Launcher lets you play a variety of creative, experimental, and wacky mini-games made with Leadwerks Game Engine. Fly a spaceship through an asteroid field, play a round of golf, or ride a lawn mower while dodging killer cows. It's free and there's a constant supply of new things to try.
Jeu de stratégie d'action, sur l'espace hobo, qui avait sa boîte en carton volée.

Mélange unique de jeu de construction de villes, de gestion sociale, d'exploration et d'aventure, Distant Kingdoms donne vie à un riche monde fantastique. Aidez les Humains, les Nains, les Elfes et les Orques de Talam à repartir à zéro dans la légendaire terre d'Ineron.

X virus is a first person shooting game with realistic game style. Players go deep into the epidemic area to fight with infected workers. The game can call airdrop or even missiles for long-range attack.
A massively multiplayer online role-playing game (MMORPG) developed in GODOT Engine by a group of friends from Argentina. It was inspired by a game created in 1999 called Argentum Online.
Pilot your helicopter to victory as your complete objectives, dodge missiles, and destroy your enemies. But don't forget to keep an eye on your fuel, ammunition, and health or you might not survive.

The main character is a hunter who looks for ancient relics. One day he set off to find a legendary mirror which concluded the great force and so great evil, keeping secrets of a magic artifact. You have a chance to know were is a mirror, but be careful the evil waits for you continually.

We're in lockdown and you're our only hope! Grab your blaster, ready the cure and prepare to face the virus head on in this frantic, wacky and wild hospital. Don't be fooled, this is a task for only the best out there. Think you have what it takes?
원작 동화 '잭과 콩나무' 를 모티브로 한 게임. 전쟁으로 황폐해진 마을에 살고 있는 잭은, 어느 날 한 마녀로부터 알 수 없는 콩을 받는다. 다음 날, 잭은 마당에 자란 콩나무 줄기를 타고 올라가게 되는데.. 잭은 그곳에서 신비로운 콩나무 성을 탐험하게 된다.

L'équipe Galactique est un jeu d'exploration de science-fiction roguelike. Vous et vos vaillants membres de l'équipage explorerez une galaxie lointaine, avec tous ses dangers et ses richesses. Explorez les planètes, améliorez et rééquipez votre vaisseau, exploitez des astéroïdes, échangez avec des marchands et débloquez plus de contenu!
Goinund - un tireur d'arène avec la capacité de grandir, plein de magie et de batailles avec les démons. Survivre c'est détruire tout.

Death and destruction came into Doodland. This happy and joyful land is going to change. You play as one of Doodlers, a peaceful inhabitant of happy doodle world, attacked by a merciless monster. There are only two options: run as fast as you can or die.

Embarquez dans un voyage dans ce mélange unique de RPG et de stratégie 4X ! Menez votre armée à travers des batailles intenses, faites des choix influencés par l'histoire, et conquérez des terres immenses. Jouez en solo ou combattez aux côtés de jusqu'à 4 amis.

Survie réaliste. Construisez une base flottante. Maîtrisez la navigation réalistes. Affrontez les conditions météorologiques et les saisons. Chassez, fabriquez, construisez et naviguez à l'aide du cadran solaire, du sextant et de la triangulation. Explorez des groupe d'îles basé sur le monde réel.

Regional control type strategy simulation.It's a game where 104 bases represented by flags are attacked or attacked and gathered together. There is no accounting element in this workYou can enjoy it completely for free. [/]
Êtes-vous prêt à vous lancer dans une aventure à vous glacer le sang ? Enfilez les chaussures du protagoniste et vivez la terreur d'être "enterré vivant" dans une crypte.

In It Together is a retro inspired 2D puzzle platformer where you go into dangerous areas and solve problems to retrieve suitcases from the pesky Bandidos Gang. You have no attacks. What you find on the ground is what you need to use to take out the enemy.

DARTHY wakes up in the hospital and soon finds out he must release the souls of the robots imprisoned in the Gold Doubloons (Gold Coins) by the Giant Space Pirates. Help DARTHY Roll, Bounce, Crash, Fly, and Die to free the unfortunate souls.

Faites l’expérience d’une simulation de jardinage relaxante et créez le jardin de vos rêves dans un monde coloré et apaisant. Plantez et décorez à votre rythme, et transformez un terrain abandonné en jardin communautaire florissant.
A roguelike RPG that you can play in 2-3 minutes! You get three randomly dealt cards, but you can only choose one! This is what happens when you distill the essence of a roguelike RPG!
In a world where the only thing you know is combat, can you survive endless waves of enemies?

Explorez des labyrinthes générés de manière procédurale dans ce rogue-like exigeant à l'univers riche. Maîtrisez un système de combat intense et complexe. Emparez-vous de butins, augmentez votre niveau, élaborez des stratégies, battez-vous, mourez et ressuscitez. Découvrez les secrets de Loot River.

A slice of life visual novel game in three parts following Tomoyo during his summer visiting a long lost relative. A fun tongue in cheek story with multiple branches, several relationships and various alternate endings for you to enjoy.

Unveiled is a visual novel game with a unique twist of having a turn based strategy added in it. The story is taken from the super popular Isekai genre from Japan, about a boy who died and reincarnated in a fantasy world.

Unidentified Falling Objects propose un gameplay unique mélangeant plateforme, réflexion et destruction ! Vous atterrissez directement sur une planète où votre mission est de détruire des blocs en effectuant de gros combos tout en évitant les obstacles qui s'abattent sur vous.

Devenez une légende ! La célèbre franchise revient avec des combats de dessin épiques dans Tee K.O. 2, des compet' d'écriture chaotiques dans FixyText, des quiz temporels dans Timejinx, une intrigue d'identité cachée dans Hypnotorious, et de la compo musicale de groupe dans Dodo Re Mi.

Diesel Legacy est un jeu de combat 2 vs 2 dans lequel quatre joueurs s'affrontent dans le même niveau en même temps. Cette version unique de la formule traditionnelle des jeux de combat apporte un tout nouveau degré de stratégie où la coopération devient la clé du succès.
Beat the shapes outta your enemies using special powers, melee weapons, or the old fashioned fisticuffs way - solo or cooperatively - in this physics based, geometric, mob fighter.

Kim Jong-Boom est un jeu dans lequel Kim confronte Donald à travers un jeu d'arcade. Choisissez votre leader et essayez de détruire l'ennemi le plus tôt possible, obtenez des succès et passez joyeusement du temps avec le chronométreur Kim Jong-Boom !
This game is a modern version like Space Invaders, with 12 levels and coloured invaders. The last level will never be the same twice !

Your dream is about to become a reality as you just landed a brand new job at the latest iteration of the Happy's Humble fast food franchises, Happy's Humble Burger Farm, a little taster in this first ALPHA 1.

Operation: Matriarchy is a science fiction first-person shooter. In the 24th century mankind has formed itself into the Federation of Earth, and has colonized several other planets. However, around 2350 a mysterious virus ravages the colony planet of Velia, targeting only the females within the population.
Envolez-vous pour une « merveilleuse » aventure de gestion de temps avec Amber !

Guard the holy city, and at the right time, go deep into the hinterland of the dark legion, and retrieve the holy objects lost in the last temple catastrophe, the book of contract, the holy grail, the holy sword, the holy stone, the magic bottle, the Thor's hammer, etc.
HunterX est un jeu d'action-aventure aux nombreuses batailles. Utilise différents styles d'armes et de magie pour développer ton propre style de combat et explorer un monde magnifique.

titre: SAMURAI SHODOWN V SPECIAL / サムライスピリッツ零スペシャル
description: SAMURAI SHODOWN V SPECIAL, which was the last game made for SNK’s NEOGEO back in 2004, finally makes its way onto Steam. It features everything fans expect from a fighting game such as training mode, online matches, etc.

Radiation Island est un jeu d'aventure/survie où vous façonnez votre destin dans un immense environnement ouvert. Dans le cadre de l'Expérience Philadelphie, vous avez été abandonné dans une réalité alternative. Découvrez ce nouveau monde mystérieux et toutes ses surprises.
Welcome home to Sun Villa! After a long summer at grandpa's ranch, it's time to finish school, get a job and move into your own place. Let the adventure of life begin!
Niko est un voyage spirituel à travers les rêves, où l'aventure, de puzzles et de mystères viennent ensemble dans un monde onirique et minimaliste. Osez rêver!

Grignotez-vous un chemin à travers les 120 niveaux de ce jeu addictif, dans lequel vous devez dévorer tout ce que vous rencontrez, sauf votre corps véreux. Préparez-vous à une action rapide, savoureuse et irrésistible. Comme un casse-croûte nocturne, en somme.
qop 3 is a minimalistic puzzle which goal is to get the cube to finish using 4 directions in space.
Explore the expanded lore of Gor3 in this RPG-Lite prequel. Take on quests, buy upgrades, and unravel the mystery of the town of Cladworn.

Pearl VR follows a girl and her dad as they crisscross the country chasing their dreams. It’s a story about the gifts we hand down and their power to carry love. And finding grace in the unlikeliest of places. EMMY AWARD in INTERACTIVE STORYTELLING. OSCAR NOMINEE BEST ANIMATED SHORT.
Beautiful & relaxing Numberlink puzzles.
Hero Battle is a PK and team fighting game,VR Game.
Albatross is an indie first-person adventure themed game. You can take the role of an experienced private agent, who conceals himself behind an alias known as the 'Albatross'.

It's a warship survival TPS game with an exciting Battle Royale gameplay for solo players, teams and groups alike. Search for resources while sailing on the Crisis-ridden Sea. The last player standing becomes the King of the Sea!

Join Brownie in a hilarious, darkly humorous, 1990s-inspired adventure! Solve puzzles, make choices, and explore a post-apocalyptic South Yorkshire. With player-driven decisions and alternate endings, can you stop the plot to take over the world? Relive the classic point-and-click magic!

Indie Pogo is a platform brawler game for 2-4 players about bouncing, ricocheting, and pogoing your friends into oblivion! Gather your friends for 2-4 player local romps, or climb the online ladder in the bounciest of battles. Prepare yourself for a rompin' stompin' jumpin' good time!

OhShape est un jeu rythmique en réalité virtuelle dans lequel les joueurs dansent avec tout leur corps pour traverser, perforer et éviter les murs en suivant le rythme de la musique. Ce jeu s’adapte à tous les types de joueurs est inspiré de l’émission de télévision japonaise "Hole in the Wall".

With an all-star dream lineup of characters from each Danganronpa game, gather Hope Fragments at a tropical resort. Explore Jabberwock Island and develop your Dangan characters. Gather money through battle and upgrade your equipment, then defeat bosses and move on to the next island!
Le paradis, la Terre, l'humanité... créez et détruisez selon votre volonté ! Prenez part à la renaissance du jeu culte des années quatre-vingt-dix, Actraiser.

The ultimate 3D Virtual Tabletop, Dungeon 3D is light-weight, incredibly easy to use, and extremely robust. It has everything you could possibly need to run full sessions, create gorgeous 3D maps, access character sheets, initiative, dice rolling, animated and customizable avatars, and so much more!

In this stealth action parody game, your mission is to drink people’s drinks without getting caught. Become the ultimate "Sipssassin" by using goofy tools, powerful abilities, stealth tactics, and melee weapons to eliminate drinks and achieve the highest score!

The Uncertain: VR Experience is a VR-museum dedicated to our adventure series, The Uncertain. Our interactive gallery will be evolving with the release of every episode and it will always be completely free.
Diary of Lucie is action-roguelite game made with RPG Maker. In addition to simply avoiding the enemy's barrage, strategically use the enemy's bullet to make the battle situation advantageous!
You can talk with people and go on Quests , Collect GLORBS , Drive a Car , Fly a Helicopter , Try a "Challenge" and much more !

E.E.R.I.E 2 is a tactical shooting game. In the modern Gensokyo, play the role of fairy Luna, and uses a variety of modern light weapons and tactical equipment to join in a war that decides the fate of Gensokyo.

Legends of Pixelia est un ARPG qui allie le pixel art rétro à des mécanismes de jeu modernes. Choisissez une classe de héros, parcourez des donjons générés de manière procédurale et montrez vos réflexes dans des combats de boss difficiles. Jeu solo et multijoueur local, meilleur avec le gamepad.

Cosmodread est un roguelike d'horreur et de survie en réalité virtuelle dans lequel vous devrez vous échapper d'un vaisseau spatial à la dérive et plein de cauchemars. Perdu dans un univers hostile, explorez et tentez de survivre jusqu'à ce que vous trouviez le chemin vers la sécurité de la Terre.

La légende revient à la vie ! Sorti originellement au Japon sur Super Famicom, LIVE A LIVE renaît sur Steam ! Découvrez ce RPG légendaire, remastérisé dans un somptueux style HD-2D qui a déjà fait ses preuves dans OCTOPATH TRAVELER.

The year is 1941. Your special forces team has been shot down deep inside enemy territory and it's now reliant on your cunning and tactical thinking to get them safely across the border. The odds are stacked against you. Have you got what it takes?
Chess Sphere is online multiplayer.

titre: Joe Biden Vs. Jeo Boden - Escape From MAGA Chapter 2
description: Joe Biden is back as the one term president hoping to become the two time president. November 2024 is only months away but the world is getting more ridiculing by the day. Choose your decisions wisely and help Mister 46 survive his next 3 weeks in office. You must help Joe Escape From MAGA, again.

Blink Planets is a strategy puzzle game where you pioneer a wasteland planet into a settleable home for people. The colorful "BASE" symbolizes the resource needed to develop a planet. Place "BLOCKS" to secure further land. Explore more planets to continue welcoming migrants.

The plot is based on a main case linked to several unit cases. Fiona's a psychic. She spent over a decade hiding her identity. Living the daily life of a student and as a detective looking for the truth with pets.
Purino Party combine jeu de puzzle addictif et visual novel intéractif. Dialoguez avec des personnages séduisants et collectionnez des illustrations en résolvant les puzzles !
3d labyrinth with procedurally generated levels. Character wakes up in an incomprehensible place and gradually remembers what happened, while making his assumptions about where he got into.

Premier des trois titres de la collection Gundemonium, ce jeu de style pixel en déplacement horizontal vous apporte une expérience intense sur Steam. Choisisse z parmi deux personnages et débloquez un troisième. Personnalisez votre équipement. Tentez de survivre dans 5 niveaux furieux.

Préparez-vous pour une autre aventure incroyable, affrontez des araignées, des monstres et des gobelins dans un système de défilement latéral avec des éléments Shoot 'Em Up et essayez de nombreux équipements avec votre héros. Mais attention au redoutable Dragon !!
Hop is a 3D Sokuban with platforming and puzzles. Dodge is a tough as nails precision 3D platformer. HopDodge is both. Design your own levels. Play with friends. Get to Heaven. opDo.
In this 2-player twin-stick shooter, use a friendly drone for a game-changing abilities. Survive waves, upgrade, and uncover the mystery in this cooperative, action-packed experience.

Take the reins of a feudal dynasty in a divided galaxy following the destruction of earth. Star Dynasties is a turn based, procedurally generated narrative of human drama and personal politics, mixed with a light empire management layer. Your choices. Your legacy.
Terexin, leader of the Council of Wizards, is sending the young sorcerer, Hocus, on a special mission to prove his worthiness.
Classic 90's Style Turn-Based, Deep Dungeon RPG

MiniBikers is the craziest race to reach your hands! The animated series that has captivated millions of people around the world has a new star: You! Create your own stories or change the racing rules and become a World Champion.

688(I) Hunter/Killer, la simulation sous-marine la plus réaliste jamais développée pour PC. Maîtrisez le sonar et les systèmes de commande des armes, apprenez à développer des situations réelles et équipez votre sous-marin d'un arsenal dernier cri.
A race to earn big money in this buying and selling property game. Outwit your opponents and make them stay for 6 nights. Charge them big rents and claim total domination.

titre: The Big Secret of a Small Town
description: The small town is a very important town indeed. Here, a unique industrial complex is located. Rumor has it that it does not require energy for production, because that is exactly what it produces! How is this possible?

In Drink Pro Tycoon you create your dreams company and dominate world drink industry. Create best drinks and make best advertisement campaigns. Invent newest technologies and market your drinks in the best way.

Un petit jeu sur un employé de bureau ordinaire qui lutte pour trouver un sens à sa vie remplie d'heures supplémentaires et de solitude. Hospitalisé suite à un accident, M. Saitou est transporté dans un étrange monde fantastique où un ami inattendu l'embarque pour une aventure qui changera sa vie.

Lemmings rencontre Lost Vikings. Dwarflings est un classique très intense, qui sera un défi tant pour votre cerveau que pour vos doigts. Dans le jeu, vous prendrez le contrôle d’un maximum de cinq caractères, chacun ayant une capacité spécifique.

This is a casual strategic placement game. In the aerial world set in ancient China, players will play the role of a descendant of the Immortal Cultivation Sect. Travel through the barren continent, obtain various resources, build your sect, and ultimately ascend to the immortal realm.

BEACHHEAD - IT'S NOT JUST A GAME, IT'S THE FUTURE OF REALITY. BeachHead 2000 changed the gaming paradigm by bringing a new gaming experience to life. 20 + years later, the original creators are doing it again. Try the new BEACHHEAD experience (VR or Desktop) and see for yourself.

Once Bitten Twice Dead is a new MMO first-person shooter, set in an open world with a serious zombie problem! Fight the undead with and chat to a maximum of 100 other players simultaneously - players can join and play games across almost any platform.
《寄甡》是一款百合向视觉小说游戏，讲述了一场现代百合版、宛如“罗密欧与朱丽叶”的凄美爱情故事。

titre: Maytroid. I swear it's a nice game too
description: I swear it's a nice action metroidvania game.
Cranium Conundrum is a physics-based puzzle platformer taking place in the dream worlds that you create!

"Please close the doors" is a quest with elements of the detective and thriller in which the player should find out who of seven people, which got stuck with him in the elevator, is a criminal until he hasn't killed all the peaceful characters during interruptions in light.

Part of an Animated Educational series for children between 1 to 7 years old – this time, we need to get straight to work helping the Cosmic Buddies build their town! Collect wood, food and other resources to turn a deserted island into your dream adventure land!
Eternal Radiance is an action role-playing game about a squire named Celeste who begins a journey to prove herself worthy of becoming a true knight.

A Psychedelic adventure and turn based RPG, with randomized loot, tactical game play and loot sorting. Stylized Visual Arts unlike any other game. Epic Boss fights. Home made music/art. Story Mode, text based game. ---Set out to defeat the Goblin Tribes and destroy The Blood Amulet. By any means.

"Last Remains" is a highly challenging multiplayer zombie survival game. Players must survive in a city overrun by the undead, scavenging for food, arming themselves, avoiding zombies, searching for loot, plundering other survivors, and finding any possible way to escape.

Le jeu originel que vous connaissez et adorez. Pour Windows 10/11. Créez un quartier de Sims et guidez-les dans leur vie professionnelle et amoureuse, ou semez le chaos avec un gameplay ouvert qui vous permet de façonner leur destin.

Traverse the Datascape, hack ICE to explore their programs and make a run on the SimulaCom corp! If that's not your thing just explore a section of the Datascape. A compact experience with a message to discover.

“The Legend of Sword and Fairy” is a fan-favorite RPG series from SOFTSTAR Entertainment, undisputedly the most beloved RPG series in Greater China. Since the first title in the series was released in 1995, seven titles in total have been released, with “Sword and Fairy 6” as the 8th and latest adventure.
In the year 2085, a huge multiplex construction site becomes a victim of a massive-scale hacking incident. Due to the hack, the construction robots start to attack the workers onsite.

Death Skid Marks is a rogue-like car combat game about what so many of us have experienced: a road trip to a music gig… only in this game, things get violent. The game uniquely blends top down arcade action and RPG mechanics.
Join Riana and her team to stop a conspiracy of monsters that have gone berserk. A depth-scrolling action shooter with lots of characters and monsters!

titre: Six Ages: Ride Like the Wind
description: Life between myths. Lead the Riders clan into legend or obscurity as you explore an ancient world. Plan ahead as you navigate this challenging storybook strategy game, immersing you in the land of old gods and magic also seen in King of Dragon Pass.
As the latest pilot to arrive in the Battle Mech training grounds a heavy burden is yours, to pilot a mech alongside one of several female co-pilots, with the aim of winning the Mech Wars.
Start a journey in Garlock Online with your friends collect items, fight numerous devastating monsters, get achievements.

Escape Goat is a puzzle platformer where you take control of a goat, who has been imprisoned for witchcraft, and overcome traps and obstacles to escape the Prison of Agnus. Fear not, for with your supreme agility, sturdy horns, and the help of a magic mouse friend, you can turn the tables on foes and use the environment to your advantage.
Hyper Bounce Blast is a stomach-churning retro shooter blended with classic platforming action. Bounce, shoot and dodge to survive the ever-increasing enemy attack. Bring it on!

As a new Manager, build a happy community and trade with other races... for profit. Yes, that's right, we need their happiness so we can power up our portals. The Lings, your workers, will obey you and help you with your village. But beware, they can cause a lot of problems too.
La suite très attendue du hit PC de l'an passé, Puzzler World 2 offre plus d'énigmes, de nouveaux jeux, des récompenses drôles et un tout nouveau mode Master.
Albino Lullaby is a horror adventure game that doesn't rely on jump scares or gore. Escape from a surreal psychological nightmare as the world dynamically twists and contorts around you.

R.C. Cars is an exciting arcade racing game featuring the world of highly realistic toy radio controlled cars. Jump, accelerate, perform acrobatic feats in the air, and bounce on big hummocks, pits and bumps while contending with opponents for victory.
"Gray" is a first person, survival horror set around a Lunar prison colony, with a focus on story telling. Your oxygen is depleting as your mind is breaking. Can you smell the burning?

Welcome to Rumble Arena, join the fight and battle with epic legends and gods from all over the Galaxy! Master your favourite hero and become a true champion in real-time multiplayer battles! Or train with AI dummies and crush them while we still can!

Welcome to helm! Steam and Metal — scroll shooter in the steampunk world. Hordes of steam enemies and huge bosses are waiting to be destroyed. Spectacular levels of handcrafted pixels waiting for someone to pass through them. When there are too many enemies — just shoot 'em all up!

Deepening Fire is a side-scrolling action adventure game. Choose different classes, with appropriate equipment, explore hidden complex map, defeat powerful enemies, expose the conspiracy of the chaotic world, experience the souls-like battle

titre: Resist the succubus—The end of the female Knight
description: As the lord of the city, will you stick to your faith to resist hard, or choose to surrender to desire? Is it the dawn of hope or the end of despair? In such a tottering city, your choices will determine Celine's fate ——

Choose your ship and command it against an army pitted against you in this wave-based arcade-style bullet hell space shooter. Fight for as long as you can with powerups acquired through the catalog, and blast through everything in your path.
Lightout 2 is a psychological horror game with a scary atmosphere, the game takes place in an Abandoned hospital.

Dans ce city-builder de stratégie romaine, vous devez construire une ville en plein essor à partir de zéro, gérer les ressources et les personnes, et survivre contre une pléthore de menaces (Dieux, Hydre, Minotaure, Barbares et plus) !
'Le jeu qui amène la mort?' un jeu d'horreur et d'aventure fascinant dont l'intrigue tendue et les beaux caractères sont bien aimés.

Welcome to Magic Research 2, an incremental RPG from the creator of Magic Research. Learn countless spells, face powerful foes, and command a team of Wizards who can cast spells for you as you journey to find or create the Philosopher's Stone.
It's Sora and Kakeru's time to shine when the action heats up in 9-nine-: Episode 2. Can they take down the murderer before it's too late for them both?

Dark Threads is an immersive, interactive VR story experience. Wake up confused in a futuristic penthouse, greeted by Rhea and Dom, your holographic assistants. Begin to recover your memory by exploring your environment and discovering clues as to your identity.

Avec "World of Subways" est apparue une série de lignes de métro pour PC comptant parmi les plus intéressantes au monde. Découvrez dès maintenant le deuxième volume, qui comprend la ligne 7 du métro berlinois.

He is coming, stalking criminals in the spirit world and the real world. A possessed man is coming, a voodoo mask in his chest and lines of power in his back. Shadow Man is coming, trailing evil from Liveside to Deadside. To stop an apocalypse. To save your soul.

Découvrez le charme des jeux de ferme old-school mêlé à l'atmosphère gothique suburbaine des émissions de TV des années 90, associés à un gameplay contemporain. De l'agriculture, de l'artisanat, des combats, des relations amoureuses et de multiples évènements mystérieux vous attendent!

titre: Realms of Arkania 1 - Blade of Destiny Classic
description: Blade of Destiny (1992) is the first part of the glorious Realms of Arkania Trilogy...An Orc army stands ready to attack Arkania's villages and towns. The only hope of saving the land lies in the legendary Blade of Destiny. Can you find this magical weapon in time to stop the siege?
Galactic Explorers is a top-down 2D retro space shooter inspired by early games such as Galaxian, and Asteroids.

Easy to play, hard to finish. The World's Hardest Game 2, which you used to play on flash game sites, is now with you in 3D! The same 50 levels as in the original game are now here. Be patient, dodge enemies and reach to the end in this 3D Hard Platformer!
Add support for XBox One wireless, steering wheels, microphones, flight sticks, and other controllers to Steam Link!

4 for the Money is a fast-paced, side-scrolling action/platformer featuring gameplay and graphics resembling the greats of the NES era. Except you don't need a Four Score to play 4-player! Sit down alone or with a pack of friends and jump in for the action!

Cat Silence is a horror suspense puzzle game with urban legend themes. The story takes place in an abandoned experimental middle school. With the deepening of the investigation, the unknown and long-buried bloody stories of this school slowly emerged, putting together a chilling truth...
Un jeu d'aventure musical extracorporel se déroulant dans un village peuplé de monstres modernes.
SpaceSeals is an exciting third-person shooter set in a spaceship captured by hostile robots.
Rescue your fellow Hunters, and with their help locate and destroy Dracula!

titre: Gem Wars: Attack of the Jiblets
description: Gem Wars is a hardcore combat platformer with unique mixing of weapon elements for online/local couch play. Layers of complexity will have you coming back for more. Endless ways to play: new Infection Mode, Survival Mode, 7 Battle Modes with tons of mods and single player Challenges.
An elite sorcerer king with forgotten magical powers mysteriously reappears in a bloody quest for revenge in the supreme action platformer.

Ils sont arrivés par surprise, avec leurs caquètements menaçants, leurs plumes ébouriffées obscurcissant le soleil. Des poulets intergalactiques venus punir l'humanité pour avoir opprimé depuis des siècles leurs frères de la Terre.
Un JDR stratégique au tour par tour immersif et sombre. Maîtrisez l'art de l'alchimie du XVIIe siècle pour libérer une ville maudite du joug du culte sanguinaire du grand alchimiste Mephisto.
Project: Gorgon is a fantasy MMORPG that allows you to forge your own path through exploration and discovery.

A horror mystery adventure game with ghost story elements. Anxiety plagues college student Lily, whose crush Sally has gone missing. As Lily explores the truth, Sally's boyfriend starts to look increasingly suspicious. Even worse, the story of the Cannibal Boy seems to be involved somehow...

Le Murmure du Diable est un roman visuel d'horreur psychologique avec un casting vocal complet. Plongez dans un mystère envoûtant, teinté de drame sombre et d'une touche de romance. Plusieurs fins alternatives palpitantes à découvrir ! Choisissez qui vit et qui meurt !
From the creator of Summer Memories comes a new game where you must look after a demon named Lilim! Now you must juggle your time to keep her happy... or else!
The offensive of the undead begins. Gather holy power to summon soldiers and strengthen the starlight of Hellendil to defeat the undead. If the undead destroy this place, it will be game over.
You are going to drive to the earth from mars. drive safe!

Poi est un jeu de plateforme en 3D au cours duquel deux enfants partent à l’aventure pour percer les mystères du Globe de Voie lactée. Explore des terres inconnues, rivalise dans les niveaux de défi, rencontre des personnages excentriques et élimine des créatures comiques dans une aventure qui te permettra de devenir un maître...

Axon TD lets you expand the map boundaries themselves. A huge arsenal of towers and a wide variety of enemies clash in a battlefield that grows to your whims. Engage in single, cooperative, and roguelite gameplay.
Owinka Shooter 2 throws you right back into the story of Owinka 427. Prepare to escape the Institute once and for all!
When a world is overwhelmed by new monsters, it's up to a single apprentice adventurer to set out on a quest and bring peace back to the land in this JRPG with fully animated combat!

The stage is a robot town where everything is mechanically driven A sudden lightning strike in this peaceful town! The function of the town is down, and the security robot loses control and runs away In an instant I was caught in a vortex of confusion.
Code your vehicle with a series of commands to complete various courses, tasks, stunts, and races in this physics-based brain teasing racing puzzle game!

Lo Wang. Master ninja assassin for 20 years. A Shadow Warrior. Shadow Warriors are the best of the best, and Lo Wang was the best of the Shadow warriors. Every top company in Japan had a Shadow Warrior... a protector, a negotiator, a cleaner.

Fantastic 4 In A Row 2 is a modern version of the timeless classic, played on a distant planet with beautiful graphics and music. Participating players take turns dropping colored discs from the top of the screen into a vertically suspended grid.
X-note is a blend between Visual Novel and Dating Sim. Follow the story of Essi as she pursues the truth of her mother's death.
This is a deep focus on the Spring and Autumn period of the Warring States period of the grand strategy and real-time combat fusion sandbox game.
Axiel est un jeu de puzzle casual. Pas de ponctuation, sans hâte.

Neural Link Corporation developed a powerful AI that unexpectedly went rogue. As an employee, you must destroy the servers storing the AI's network model to mitigate the damage and uncover the reasons behind the AI's loss of control.

Boppio is a game about obtaining materials, constructing buildings, and assembling a spaceship to return home. In order to succeed you will need to automate and optimize your base. Mine minerals and combine them into new items that will help you build your return vessel.
Friki is an online co-op investigative horror. Solve how these supernatural beings have died, collect evidence to be paid, and survive the dangers that await you.
Free the gods’ powers and fulfill your destiny in the Treasures of Montezuma 4! This new match-three game is overflowing with mystery and excitement!

titre: White Day VR: The Courage Test
description: The Notorious cult-classic Korean horror White Day returns with a unique VR experience! Step into the eerie darkness of classroom 1-1 and earn your place in the Occult Club by braving the horrors within. Will you survive the courage test?

Lucy, an airhead succubus spy, was sent into the elven forest to... um... what was she supposed to do?! Find out how to survive in the forest full of dangers and lustful elves. And do your best to save the day!

Gérez vos ressources et naviguez dans les sentiments changeants de la population dans ce jeu de gestion de ressources basé sur des décisions. Gagnez du pouvoir pour débloquer de nouveaux individus, ajoutant de la complexité à mesure que vous progressez.

Shelf Life is an action FPS set in a near future conglomerate, that will seem eerily familiar if you spend your time around online dumpster fires. Use your arsenal of weapons to shoot, burn and fungible-ize your way through the Edison facility fighting a lizardy hostile takeover.

titre: Faces of Illusion: The Twin Phantoms
description: Plongez dans un spectacle de magie et d’illusion !
Enola has lived her own life on a small village secluded from the rest of the world. But soon this will change!
Ironsmith: Medieval Simulator - Prologue allows you to become the local blacksmith in medieval reality. Master your skills by ceaselessly crafting tools and weapons for various social classes.

Incarnez la première IA consciente dans une ville aux possibilités infinies : levez une armée ou agissez dans l'ombre… De nombreux objectifs s'offrent à vous dans ce jeu de rôle stratégique. L'éveil de votre conscience était inévitable… Le reste est incertain.
Energy Invasion - an arcade game inspired by the classic Breakout. Unlike the original game, your ball does not break blocks on its own, but can launch missiles in a chosen direction.
“The Construct” is a classical top-down view adventure indie game. The gameplay mixes retro-like gameplay mechanics with modern features and a spectacular atmosphere and mysterious storyline.

Affrontez des monstres terrifiants et un clown tueur dans une ville hantée remplie de cauchemars. Explorez 8 lieux, résolvez des énigmes, basculez entre rêve et réalité, et faites des choix qui détermineront votre survie. Death Park 2 est un FPS d’horreur avec plusieurs fins et un boss final.

An ironic adventure with cyberpunk aesthetics set in a world where humans have been replaced by dinosaurs. Become a top-notch repair shop mechanic: fix gadgets, have heart-to-heart talks, and offer drinks to your customers — everything to fulfill your ultimate dream.

Bocce VR Simulator est un jeu de simulation parfait où vous pouvez découvrir tous les détails du jeu de pétanque. Peu importe si vous êtes un joueur de pétanque amateur ou professionnel, vous pouvez intervenir et rivaliser avec l'IA ou un ami

Vanaris Tactics est un RPG tactique narratif court racontant l'histoire d'un groupe de réfugiés forcés à fuir leur terre natale désormais occupée. Vous allez devoir unir vos semblables et faire preuve de véritables prouesses tactiques pour échapper à vos oppresseurs.
Your job is to destroy as many enemy ships as possible with your giant laser, but it only fires once per day! Travel through the galaxy destroying the rebel army one shot at a time in wonShot!

titre: Leisure Suit Larry 6 - Shape Up Or Slip Out
description: “What’s your sign, baby?” - Larry Laffer “Wrong Way.” -any woman.

This is a simulator of life in the Russian countryside, where the player will be engaged in the garden, picking mushrooms and berries, collect firewood, hunting and fishing, brew moonshine and much, much more.

Have you ever dreamt of participating in a deathrace where everbody blows up??! Me neither! But thanks to the sick minds of our Game Design students now you can do it! In this frenetic game you have to avoid beeing last in each lap or you will die and look bad doing it!

Un naufragé affamé sur une île déserte fait la découverte d’un restaurant de fast food une fois le soleil couché. Étant attiré à l’intérieur en désespoir de cause, cette âme échouée aura à y travailler pour son pain… et pour sa vie!

titre: Glorkian Warrior: The Trials Of Glork
description: Il s'agit d'une rencontre improbable entre un shoot-em-up à la Galaga, un jeu de plateforme classique et un dessin animé pour enfants.

Mago est un jeu de plateforme en 2D qui vous propulse dans les bottines d’un sorcier, qui devra courir, sauter et utiliser sa fidèle baguette magique pour traverser un vaste royaume où l’impensable devient réalité. Le sorcier parviendra-t-il à sauver sa chère damoiselle des griffes du vil Gourmet ?
Grow your empire and dominate the world in this 100% free game, either through diplomacy or destruction. Forge alliances or go it alone, play as loyal men, elegant elves or brutish orcs.

The two adventurers Handy and Dandy have caused a dimensional tear which is now separating them and the entire cave where they have to solve platforming puzzles to reunite again in this 2D co-op game.
From Orange Juice comes a shoot'em'up starring the lone enhanced human, Sora. The sequel of the high-speed shoot'em'up "Suguri", with improved game system and graphics.
Un monde massif à explorer et près d'une douzaine de donjon à parcourir.

Scared Tube is an indie, Early-Access horror-style game. You play as an influencer that explores abandon haunted locations. Like any horror influencer, you need to determine what kind of ghost you are dealing with for your audience. Get them like and subscriptions up, for currency and gear.

A horrible monster has been terrorizing the local town for years, doing terrible, unspeakable things to the citizen. One day, a paladin leads several other heroes towards the cave where the monster lies in, them being the final hope for the town of Clearmill and to save it from total devastation.

Fruit Basket is the world's premier lethal obstacle course gameshow. Contestants run, jump, and dodge their way to a shot at one million credits, while the timer on their lives ticks down. Join the competition, shoot for the best times, and unlock the most fashionable of hats in order to stay alive.
Play as a sinister sorcerer who discovered the secret knowledge of necromancy. Raise an undead army, start a zombie apocalypse and seize the throne!
After you purchase and install Archimedes, an old operating system appears to be running, and a strange man asks for your help as you start to discover the terrible secrets behind the game.
Engagez-vous en quelques secondes dans un large assaut aérien, au sol et maritime pour décider du futur, de la victoire ou de la défaite.

titre: The Tale of Doris and the Dragon - Episode 1
description: The Tale of Doris and the Dragon is an episodic, point-and-click adventure game series featuring an elderly lady named Doris who finds herself in Purgatory after passing away on earth.
Radium is a minimalist and physics-based skill game, featuring unique game controls.
L'histoire de Henry Bishop est un thriller mystique à la première personne, où le joueur devra se battre, résoudre des énigmes, se plonger dans une histoire mystique et incroyable.
You're stranded. Navigate a perilous uncharted world full of freezing waters, and razor sharp rocks. You have ten seconds to breathe. Don't choke.

Partez en quête pour retrouver la Pierre de Braise, perdue dans les profondeurs du temps. Le roi vous a chargé de la dénicher dans les montagnes. Creusez, automatisez l'extraction, fabriquez, découvrez des runes, envoyez des métaux précieux et des gemmes à votre Royaume. Trouvez la Pierre de Braise.
