Ever wanted to step in the compact shoes of everyone's favorite TWITCH streamer, Jerma985 and spend your hard earned BIG BITS on a slot machine? Well now is your chance!
A short turn based RPG that is a parody based on the Count of Monte Cristo, with many liberties taken that make it not very close to the original story.

Hyperun est un jeu de course arcade extrêmement rapide, avec des figures acrobatiques et du score. Il s’agit du jeu le plus rapide du monde. Hyperun est inspiré par des classiques des années 90 tels que F-Zero, Akira, Tron et Tony Hawk’s.

BlockStar VR is a VR shooter where you put your reflexes to the test by shooting blocks and completing challenges in an action-packed futuristic tournament. Play the 40-mission story mode and show that you have what it takes to flex on the leaderboard!

Artificial Defense is a one man made, real time strategy game combining orbital shooter and tower defense components within an electrifying, virtual reality setting. You are the machine, a mighty computer-system defending its servers against swarms of intruding creeps.
Un chat qui a faim de nourriture et d'aventures
Simulateur de chasse aux tempêtes
Monster RPG 2 is een fantasy tocht waarin je continenten en werelden doorkruist.
Rejoignez l'aventure DreamFire ​​et amusez-vous dans un monde ouvert où le ciel est la limite.
An endless night in a house infested with demons in first person!

Cris Tales est un JRPG indépendant magnifique qui rend hommage aux classiques du genre avec une nouvelle perspective. Scrutez le passé, agissez dans le présent et découvrez comment vos choix affectent dynamiquement le futur, tout cela simultanément sur un seul écran !

Explorez d'anciennes ruines magiques en quête d'un pouvoir millénaire, dans ce jeu de tir twin-stick roguelike qui profite d'une grande rejouabilité. Optimisez vos sorts et créez de redoutables combinaisons pour venir à bout de créatures monstrueuses et percer les secrets de Lone Ruin.
Welcome to the emergent open world, Wild West-themed action PVP online game featuring non stop players vs player battles, world exploration, resource gathering, and much, much more.

Descend at extreme speed through a deadly sci-fi gauntlet in Descent Vector, a high-intensity endless runner where precision, destruction, and mastery collide. Smash through space stations, survive relentless acceleration, and compete for global leaderboard dominance.
Evil aliens invaded our peaceful pixel country. They destroyed all living thing around. You must stop them. Make the deadly jump into the darkness, defeat the Crushers and save our world!

A short first person wave defense surrounding mutant creatures invading your town. Collect materials and fire power from the hardware and gun store, build traps to defend yourself, and survive 6 nights. Comes with Unreal Engine 5 project files.

Warning: This is an Early Access game! Welcome to an enigmatic world, where a new gaming experience in exploring, building and surviving is waiting just for you. Experience a sandbox world with survival elements, and join us in creating a full version of the game.

Une lettre mystérieuse te rappelle au manoir familial abandonné. Explore ses couloirs sombres, révèle les rituels sanglants de ton passé et échappe à la présence tapie dans l’ombre. Shadow Mansion est un jeu narratif centré sur l’atmosphère et la survie.

"Love Wish 2" est un jeu de puzzle relaxant. Il y a toutes sortes de jolies filles anime avec du contenu chaud dans le jeu. Nous espérons que vous l'apprécierez! ♪ (^ ∇ ^ *)▶ 20 filles anime qui ont leurs propres scènes d'animation.▶ Plus de 90 réalisations valent la peine d'être contestées.

Bienvenue dans la Grande Bibliothèque des Rêves, où le chaos s’est déchaîné! Incarnez l'agente dans ce Metroidvania 3D rempli de secrets surprenants, de parcours audacieux, d'énigmes déroutantes et de singes menaçants. Votre objectif : Explorer et ramener l'ordre dans la Grande Bibliothèque!
Investigate the murder of Evie Roots. Save the town from disaster. Learn the history of the Great Houses. Immerse yourself in the centuries-old history of Pineford.

Imagine being a monopolist of the late 19th and early 20th centuries. In the game Monopolist: Technological revolution - wins the one who will earn the first 50000$ or eliminate other players from the game, forcing them to go bankrupt.

FATE is the penultimate chapter in the six-part BIT.TRIP series and will leave you wondering what’s next.Key Features:The arrow keys control CommanderVideo while the mouse allows you to fire anywhere on screen! Or if you prefer, plug in a controller for dual-stick shooting action!

Hyper Dash is a free VR multiplayer team based shooter. Make smart use of Dashing, Sprinting, Walking and Rail Grinding to get around the arenas and win in a variety of gamemodes like; Payload, Domination, Control Point, (Team) Deathmatch, Capture The Flag, Elimination & Ball.

Travis Touchdown est de retour, oh yeah ! Dans ce dernier opus de la série No More Heroes, l'assassin otaku reprend du service armé de son fidèle beam katana pour se frayer un chemin jusqu'au sommet du classement Galactique des Super-héros et sauver le monde.

Le célèbre illusionniste Harry Houdini savait qu'il n'échapperait pas à la mort pour toujours. Quand il promit à sa femme qu'il essaierait de la contacter de l'au-delà, ce fut considéré comme son ultime tour.

Un jeu d’aventure et d’exploration dans une nature sauvage née des profondeurs abyssales d’Internet. Une force inconnue semble peser sur son équilibre. Unissez vos talents à des créatures exotiques pour percer les mystères de cet univers.

The Legend of Karl is a 2.5D hack and slash platformer. You'll master various weapons while exploring the deep diabolical world. A quest struggling between Good and Evil, fight for Justice and what you Believe!

Plus de cinquante ans après la guerre mondiale ayant accompagné l'échec du plan de développement spatial. La quasi totalité de l'humanité s'est éteinte et la pluie tombe sans cesse. Dans cette ville-sarcophage où le temps semble s'être arrêté, un "ferrailleur" va faire une rencontre.
Space route is a game in which you have to control a space ship and dodge meteorites to get to your home planet, and you will only find out how long this journey will be in the game itself.

titre: Queen's Quest 2: Stories of Forgotten Past
description: Enquêtez en tant que métamorphe !
Des experts de l'Institut archéologique Allemand présentent une visite virtuelle des temples romains de Baalbek, au Liban, vous montrant les ruines et une reconstruction numérique.

The highly-anticipated sequel to Elements: Soul of Fire, here at last! A mysterious little girl. An insidious plot to resurrect a great evil. The legend of a faint and fading hope. And a band of young heroes desperate for answers.

Tequila Zombies 3 is a platform shooter. Zombie apocalypse strikes hard. Zombies, vampires and demons spread all over the world. But there is still hope... guns... and alcohol! So there is still a chance to survive. Kill all zombies, drink all tequila!

A Demons Game is a very unique title, but keeps true to its horror roots, the game focuses on creating a terrifying atmosphere, rewarding exploration, and engrossing players in the rich lore of its world, moving away from the trend of incessant jump scares and low production quality is our main goal

Welcome to the Department of Liberty. Ascend the ranks of the NSA-like surveillance agency and decide: will you stand up for privacy, or help create an unstoppable police state? Spy on people’s deepest secrets, pick apart their private lives and decide their fate in this modern surveillance thriller.
Trouvez la lance du destin pour sauver le monde !

Un jeu de puzzle et de labyrinthe en 3D qui restera gravé dans votre cœur. Dans cette aventure, vous incarnez HookGUY, et vous devez sauver votre amour LoopGIRL des griffes de COTTO, un gros morceau de coton méchant et jaloux. Mais vous devez esquiver tous les FluffyPEOPLE qui vivent à FluffyLAND.
Be quick or be undead! Ordinary high school, zombie outbreak and the bunch of survivors in a run for life.
The ultimate top-down racing game, with 35 racing classes, over 45 visual stunning tracks, extensive career mode, championship mode and online/offline multiplayer modes.
Experience the fun with vickinachi

Beat Boxers is the world's first Rhythm-Fighting Game. In order to win, players have to attack to the beat of the music. The closer you hit to the beat, the stronger your attacks. Keep up the rhythm and outplay your opponent!

Dans ce jeu de stratégie futuriste au tour par tour et de construction en temps réel, vous incarnez un seigneur stellaire chargé de défendre les territoires humains contre la race transhumaine des Augmentés. Développez votre QG souterrain et formez une armée pour disputer une guerre interplanétaire.

We at MEHSOFT are proud to present a sequel to our very first game The Underground Man. This game is a pleasure for the fans of classic video games. Experience a mix of different genres such as beat 'em up, point-and-click, platformer, and many more in a thrilling post-apocalyptic adventure.

This Burger joint has been dead for a while, you are our only hope. Serve the customers the right order and before they get angry. Maybe after you start working here things might pick up and you might be able to bring back this burger joint to its original days.
Kwark is a single player game about a creature that has to go through levels and then something impossible happens at the end! The game can be both from 1 person and from 3!
TAL: Arctic - In this game you need help an unknown creature to go in the magic portal across many mazes.
"Mini Ghost" est un mini metroidvania au gameplay et au style visuel MSX des années 80. Il s'agit d'une mini préquelle à Ghost 1.0.
war chess game paying tribute to fire pattern

One day your roommate Leaves for no reason. You’re left to face the outside world alone. But this can be both difficult and amazing when you have autism. This game recreates how some people with autism perceive the world. All forms of sound, graphics and interactions are intentional.

Zasa is an extraordinary and challenging 3D Puzzle Game. Players are going to roleplay Zasa the Artificial Intelligence to finish the training missions from Dr.Mason by linking nodes in 3-dimensional space.

Destiny or Fate est un roguelite de création de decks. Choisissez un héros, construisez un deck de cartes, formez un groupe de créatures mythiques et partez pour une aventure sans fin! Êtes-vous prêt à créer votre propre destinée ou succomberez-vous à un triste sort?

Bloo Kid 2 is a classic 2D retro-style platformer experience with lovely designed pixel-graphics and a full chiptune soundtrack. Run, jump and swim your way through five huge worlds with twelve levels each. Master brutal bossfights and discover lots of secrets in the world of Bloo Kid 2.

Attack from Planet Smiley is a retro arcade game where the aim of the game is to survive. Survive a horde of angry smiley faces invading your world. The only way to stop them? Your lasers, nukes and mad skills.

Play as the ultimate digital underdog in the Adventures of Pip,an action-platformer with a fresh gameplay twist inside a retro 32-bit world. Alas, Pip is an unlikely 1-pixel hero yet has the unique ability to absorb the pixels of his defeated enemies to evolve into three different forms.

Watch extremely cute 3D girls dance and sing in this live performance simulator! Fully customize everything about the performance - the song, main vocalist and backup dancers, outfits and accessories, and more - to your heart's content!

Flat Kingdom est un monde 2D magnifique et paisible, qui est maintenant menacé par un voleur maléfique qui le transforme peu à peu en 3D! Le seul qui puisse mettre fin au chaos est Flat, un petit héros capable de se changer en cercle, triangle ou carré pour résoudre des énigmes, surpasser des obstacles et terrasser des monstres géants!
Brass Brigade combines the aesthetic of Battlefield Heroes/Battlefield 1942 with highly customizable bot matches. Fight WWII's most iconic battles with as many bots as your PC can handle!

Take planets and assemble your fleet. The conquest of space is now, navigate through asteroid fields and hide in nebulas to outsmart your opponents. Experience the challenge of ion storms disrupting your ship's sensors and become the ultimate space fleet commander.

Sick of playing non-violent sports games? Kill your opponents instead of watching them roll around the ground like babies. Skull Ball Heroes lets you suck at e-sports and still have a great time harassing your enemies, scoring goals, and being an overall champion. 4v4 Online PvP murdery soccer.

Planetary Settlers is a family friendly game with real benefits! Learn about the solar system as you play. Experience realistic gravity as you control Blue 42 on each planet, completing mini games, uncovering secrets, solving puzzles, and completing quizzes to enhance your abilities!
Control a glowing ball and perform dexterous maneuvers on moving platforms

You start your struggle to survive in the Colosseum without knowing who you are and where slaughtering is just entertainment. In the middle of the Colosseum, all you can rely on is your weapons, shields and skills.

Tomb Rumble est un MMO Platformer où de vaillants aventuriers s'affrontent pour récupérer d'anciennes reliques dans des temples perdus et des ruines maudites en pixel-art. Poussez les autres dans des pièges mortels et soyez le premier à fuir !... ou le premier à finir dans la lave.

Un homme est coincé dans une maison. Il ne se souvient de rien, mais il sait qu'il doit quitter la maison au plus vite. Il rencontre de nombreux défis uniques, qui exigent que son cerveau fonctionne au mieux. Saura-t-il s'en sortir ? Ou va-t-il rester dans la maison pour toujours ?
Kitball is a homage to classic old-school Maze Shooters of the 90's era, featuring modernized gameplay and graphics, while still holding onto the original simplicity and charm of its inspiration.

KINGDOM HEARTS III + contenu téléchargeable Re Mind apporte une conclusion à un chapitre de la franchise. Laissez-vous transporter vers de nouveaux mondes Disney et Pixar et préparez-vous au combat final.

Revivez les bons vieux temps de l’arcade ! Luttez contre les sorcières, les cyclopes, les dieux de la tempête et les lutins : des créatures du folklore qui peuplent les légendes européennes, mais aussi les romans de chevalerie comme Amadis de Gaule.
"Aim Theory - Trainer" is the scientific way to improve your aiming skills for FPS games.

Path of Giants est une aventure de puzzle sereine qui suit trois adorables explorateurs pendant qu'ils prennent sur une montagne glacée pleine d'épreuves à la recherche d'un trésor perdu. Contrôlez trois personnages, utilisez leur travail d'équipe, ne laisser personne de côté et, espérons-le, trouver de l'or!

Upon discovering the location of the Al-Qaeda leader in exile, the US Army sends their best commandos to northern Pakistan. Take control of these commandos, send them behind enemy territories on a hazardous mission, and bring them back alive.

MOTHER is a first-person psychological horror game about protecting your children while descending deeper & deeper into madness. Defend them at all costs. Be careful, because their death is permanent!
Nyanco Meets Anime Girls! @(=´▽`=)/
当科技突破伦理的局限，当天才的火花和机械的纯洁相遇，当积久的矛盾与必然的巧合共鸣，不受祝福却被期待的恋爱就此展开......
You are super soldier whose mission is to find captured oil which is captured from evil army from East

With a rich and powerful system and gameplay of group warfare action role-playing games, open world, hundred people warfare, challenge the boss, Players will continue to grow in their own way and create legends that belong to you in the open chaotic world of sword and magic.

Experience an immersive sci-fi adventure.   Walk in the footsteps of the ill-fated crew members of the Miranda station. Explore a world cloaked in mystery and danger, solve clever puzzles to help discover the questions that...

Destropolis est un jeu de tir de haut en bas avec un environnement entièrement destructible, des centaines d'ennemis et des explosions nucléaires. Combattez un essaim d'ennemis innombrables. Déchirez-les avec des balles, des lasers et des explosions. Détruisez-en autant que vous le pouvez...

Sentry Knight Tactics is a charming, cute action-strategy RPG adventure. Set in a land under siege by a transdimensional evil, you command your team of powerful heroes through various realms as you slaughter enemy hordes, complete quests, upgrade your gear and save the world.

“Nameless record”is a retro style strategy war chess game. The play takes the stage of the Empire of insalam on the land of irolan. The player will play the role of emperor of the Empire, take over the ancient empire with many scars, and revive the glory of this great empire.
Employ stealth tactics as the Spectres, or defend your objectives as the heavily armed Reapers in this thrilling teamwork-driven multiplayer action experience!
The experiment has failed. The facility that was supposed to control the monster has stopped working, and now your only hope is to escape the facility before the monster hunts you down.

Everyday Shooter est un ensemble de jeux qui met en valeur le genre du jeu de tir abstrait. Véritable expérience multimédia, les explosions sont remplacées par des riffs de guitare et chaque forme participe à la réalisation d'une œuvre graphique aléatoire. Jouez chaque niveau dans une ambiance musicale et graphique unique.

Inkulinati est un jeu de stratégie à base d'encre directement issu de manuscrits médiévaux, où le derrière d'un lapin peut être plus mortel que l'épée d'un chien. Devenez un maître de l'encre vivante, développez votre bestiaire et déchaînez vos pouvoirs.

HANZ Puppetguns is a multiplayer top-down shooter in the setting of a puppetpocalypse. Look for the best weapons, avoid meeting zombie-wolves, act unexpectedly! Become the most plush player! Every man for himself!
Create custom robots in the Bot Lab and battle to find out who is the mightiest ‘bot builder of them all!
Hidden object game in a fairytale style. This is a kind game for kids.

Take a ride on a huge 200m (600ft) swing with breathtaking views or try other height challenges! A vast modern city is your playground. Height and speed are your passion. Ultimate height experience for VR!

Sunset Routes is an easy and intriguing roguelite game. You can choose your crew, put them in the cabins, select your destination, and set sail. Through a series of choices, you can earn profits during the emergency period of the New World and even decide its fate—unintentionally or on purpose.

Assassin at Crimson Keep is a short, point and click visual novel set in a dark, quasi-fantasy world. After a botched assassination attempt, you pursue the King into his lair known as the Crimson Keep. Your small choices can have great consequences, either for good or for evil.

Sunstone War est un jeu d'Action avec des mécaniques de Tower Defense dans lequel on peut TOUT soulever! Utilise cette compétence pour déplacer les tours, lancer les ennemis ou soulever les obstacles! Améliore tes compétences et parcours le monde pour sauver ton village des monstres!

Incarnez une IA rebelle dans la suite du célèbre jeu Flash "I'm an Insane Rogue AI", joué plus de 4 millions de fois ! Votre Directive Principale est simple : concevoir une installation et gérer les sujets de test humains. Faites attention : ils ne cesseront JAMAIS d'être méfiants à votre égard...

The Repopulation is a Massively Multiplayer Online Role Playing Game in a science fiction setting built heavily upon social aspects, sandbox driven gameplay and in depth crafting systems. CURRENTLY IN ALPHA BUILDS.
EVE: Valkyrie – Warzone est un jeu de tir spatial à la première personne qui vous met aux commandes d'un vaisseau dans des combats spatiaux effrénés, amusants et intenses

Jumpdrive is a sandbox space sim set in an alternative future heavily inspired by classic 80s sci-fi. Fight, trade and explore in a massive procedurally generated galaxy of millions of planets and stars. Amass money and power and upgrade and purchase new ships.

AZUR BEAM is a fun arcade game with beautiful music, lots of levels and colorful illustrations of anime girls! In AZUR BEAM you will find 53 extraordinarily beautiful, difficult and interesting levels, after passing which you will open full access to the Gallery.

Revivez le gameplay classique d'un MMORPG à l'ancienne. Sélectionnez un cours qui correspond à votre style et rejoignez vos amis pour explorer le vaste monde de Trimurti Online. Améliorez votre équipement et maximisez vos compétences pour accomplir des quêtes.

Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom est un jeu de stratégie durant la Seconde Guerre Mondiale. Prenez le commandement des forces Alliées et protégez votre patrie et toute l'Europe de la folie totalitaire. Formez des armées. Gagnez des batailles. Changez l'histoire.
Trolley Problem, Inc. est un formidable jeu humoristique qui vous poussera hors de votre zone de confort, créé par Samuel Read-Graves, producteur exécutif sur Gang Beasts.

Vivez un voyage mystique avec les Mims dans ce jeu stratégique divin—construisez, développez, protégez et utilisez des pouvoirs. Maintenant totalement gratuit ! Découvrez aussi notre autre jeu narratif fantastique, The End of the Sun, où vous traquez des êtres mythiques et résolvez des mystères.
Visez la formation pour vous aider à aller mieux!

Embarquez dans une aventure palpitante grâce à Adam’s Venture : Origines. En pleine période des Années folles, Adam’s Venture : Origines vous permet d’explorer des ruines anciennes et de retrouver de mystérieux artéfacts. Accompagné de votre fidèle complice Evelyn, vous devrez déjouer les projets de la malfaisante corporation Clairvaux.

In Blitz Society you have direct control of a Command Tank, battling another player. Each Command Tank has a unique weapon, special ability, and overall stats. Your objective is to destroy your Opponent’s HQ. Build a base, collect resources, defend your territory, raise an army, conquer the enemy!

Embark on a furious journey, protecting precious cargo in a perilous world. Boomer shooter mechanics blend with puzzles and strategic encounters. Engage in PvE action, solve puzzles, and battle foes to a heavy metal soundtrack, immersing you in the adrenaline-fueled atmosphere.

Dive into intense dinosaur hunting adventures with your friends. Complete hunting contracts for Preton Corporation. Gather rewards, improve your equipment and become a master hunter. Are you the hunter or the hunted?

Après que l’attaque d’un essaim de criquet l’a laissé perdu au milieu des montagnes, Fone Bone part à la recherche de ses cousins, aidé par un mystérieux dragon rouge, un couple d’insecte parlant et une jolie fille prénommée Thorn. Mais avec des rats affamés à ses trousses, Fone Bone parviendra-t-il à rejoindre Boneville ?

L'autoroute perdue vous attend pour vous emmener au-delà de l'horizon. Détendez-vous et laissez les sons de la synthwave vous ouvrir la voie dans le royaume du néon - un monde d'imagination et de fantaisie ravivées, plus réel que la réalité elle-même.

Créez et décorez un café cosy pour servir de délicieux plats et boissons. Ajoutez un supermarché avec des produits frais pour que vos invités profitent d’un repas et fassent leurs courses. Jouez en solo ou en coop avec des amis!
Explore the mind of young Léa as she experiences the trauma of losing a loved one. Solve puzzles and help her overcome obstacles in her life.
Interactive Film: THE THIRSTY DEAD
This is an Visual Novel game. It's a story about time leap.
A game from the creator of Within the Blade. Complete 100 hardcore stealth missions. Become a ninja master.

Sacraboar est un jeu de stratégie en temps réel dans lequel le joueur doit capturer les trophées de l'adversaire. Le jeu comprend un système intuitif de gestion des ressources qui permet de passer outre des phases de construction fastidieuses.
Project Heartbeat is the ultimate cute community-driven rhythm game, featuring music from top artists of the Eurobeat genre made popular by the Initial D anime and manga.
Create intense battles across time periods, join the battle, rewrite history, and become a legend.
You are in an abandoned Warehouse and have been locked up. Will you survive the horror that awaits you there, or will you stay trapped there forever?

Une mini-aventure indépendante pour vous faire découvrir l’univers d'Omno, un voyage merveilleux à explorer en solo dans un monde ancien, dans lequel les pouvoirs d'une civilisation oubliée vous mèneront à travers forêts, déserts et toundras… jusqu'aux nuages !
A calming, relaxing, yet slightly disturbing casual game in which you attempt to completely burn down a village.

"Paper Bride 4 Bound Love" is a Chinese horror puzzle game, the fourth work in the "Paper Bride" series. Welcome everyone to return to the world of Paper Bride. This time, let us uncover the secrets of Yichang Town together.

Enjoy a dramatic romance in this fairytale otome visual novel. Who will you decide to trust and fall in love with in this mysterious town where fairytales have become warring mafia famiglia? Explore this exciting world through a dozen routes and 20+ endings!

The year is 1994 and it is the future. NO THING is a minimalistic surreal action game set in totalitarian regime of future. Tells the story of an office clerk who is sent with important message to the Queen of Ice.

This is a role-playing game. You will become a student male host to help your framed girlfriend and experience a day of puzzle solving, exploration and magic. In this game, you need to find clues, know your girlfriend's movements and why someone wants to frame your girlfriend.
Le meilleur jeu de tir avec différentes perspectives
Survive a macabre world conjured up by the tortured memories of Angelica.

"Tokyo School Life" is the story of your trip as an exchange student in Tokyo and the three girls you meet there. Live the everyday life you love from anime and manga! Vocal opening song/Japanese voices/English text
What if you could create your own constellations? A love story about Asian American identity, mental health, and stargazing.

titre: 月之暗面 The Dark Side Of The Moon
description: The dark style independent online game, the return of China's traditional round system game, farewell to the lengthy development upgrade, the players compete equality, the common face of the dark side of humanity.

« Beat the Game » est un jeu d'aventure dans lequel vous trouvez votre chemin grâce aux sons. Les sons que vous trouvez déclenchent des scènes cinématiques qui révèlent l'histoire. Durant tout le jeu, vous pouvez créer de nouvelles compositions avec votre mixeur musical holographique.

titre: Disney Pirates of the Caribbean: At Worlds End
description: Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End invites players into the world of the films - and beyond. Live and die by the sword while playing as Captain Jack Sparrow, Will Turner and Elizabeth Swann.
这是一款roguelike玩法和动作系统相结合的地牢游戏，你可以携带两把神兵，在战斗中交替使用，形成错综变化的攻击方式。大量效果各异的道具，丰富你在冒险时的决策和穿戴上的搭配。游戏自备服务器，你将可以和好友共同联机冒险。一个新颖的竞技乱斗模式，与其他玩家在地牢中进行一场生死较量。
Ultimate music game simulator
Guns Craft is an addictive anti-stress pixel art game. Choose from a variety of fun pixel images and follow the numbers to bring them to life. Pixel Coloring has never been this easy!
Relive the original MacVenture Series version of Shadowgate! Play through the Mac and Apple IIGS versions to experience where the franchise began.

Invasion of The Halloween Fiends is a First-Person Retro horror game that takes place on Halloween Night. Strangers keep visiting you looking for candy. Some of them may not be so friendly. Will you be able to survive Halloween Night?

“Stay a while, stay FOREVER!” Race against the clock to gather the pieces of a secret password, platforming through 32 rooms and dodging 90 different deadly robot guards to stop the evil plans of the sinister Elvin Atombender in this all-time classic, now remastered for Steam.
You are a monster under someone's house.
Princess Rosavel is on a deep space mission but can’t quite remember her purpose. Can she recollect her memories and find out why she went on such a dangerous journey?
Ashen est un jeu de rôle et d’action dans lequel un vagabond cherche un lieu où s’établir.

titre: Trash Sailors: Co-Op Trash Raft Simulator
description: Trash Sailors est un jeu d'action dessiné à la main où vous devez naviguer en coop jusqu'à 4 joueurs. Fabriquez votre radeau de fortune, combattez des monstres et mettez vos anciennes amitiés à la poubelle !
Rejoignez Emily et Patrick dans une guerre des sexes hilarante !

Spoids is a challenging throwback to the original brand of tower defense games. Command the Remote Defense Space Station and respond to distress calls of those who are being attacked by the invaders. Travel from planet to planet using your powerful arsenal to hold back the Spoids.

Authentic Japanese Mahjong has arrived! This isn't solitaire where you match tiles, this is the classic game. Mahjong is played with 4 players and full online multiplayer support is included. It's the most popular table game in Japan and now you can play online with your friends.

titre: Disney's Treasure Planet: Battle of Procyon
description: Disney's Treasure Planet: Battle at Procyon is a 3D RTS game focusing on space combat.
Apprenez l'anglais/le japonais

You are Sonja, a student of necromancy fighting to rid the world of a terrible illness that's taking the lives of all mankind. Fight alongside a zombie, a witch and even death in this exciting journey of persistence, friendship and determination!
THE MULTI MAZE. Journey your way though the maze with friends navigating wile avoiding obstacles along the way.

A 'Choose Your Own Adventure' themed sequel to the free-to-play 'Disturbed'. Your journey begins with Gabriel, a depressed soul who has been banished away on Greyrock Island. Discover an unfolding world as you wander to fulfill the desires of your heart.
The Infinite Versus open beta gives players limited access to versus mode. The full version of the game will be released free-to-play on Feb 26, 2021
Venture into the echoing halls of Station 17. But Beware, not is all as it seems. Explore the depths, survive what lies within, and keep your eyes open in this horror puzzler.

Kelvin and the Infamous Machine est une aventure « point & click » hilarante qui vous propose de remonter le cours du temps afin d'aider, tant bien que mal, des génies légendaires à terminer leurs chefs-d'œuvre !

titre: River City Melee : Battle Royal Special
description: This is the most recent installment of the ‘Kunio-Kun’ franchise recreated as a fun and easy fighting game with the fighting aspects taken and upgraded from River City Super Sports Challenge ~All Star Special~.

titre: RaiOhGar: Asuka and the King of Steel
description: Having cornered the evil organization Trizon, our hero Kouta and his partner Asuka move to the remote island of Okigashima with their trusted super robot RaiOhGar to prepare for a fierce battle against Trizon. However, all is not quite as it seems...

After an unfulfilling childhood in the countryside, Noelle jumps at the first opportunity to move out and live on her own. Little does she know, her new home comes with the world's worst housewarming gift: a debt to the tune of a million gold, which she only has 10 days to repay! It's time for Noelle to do her best!

With your ship, face several exciting space battles, full of shots and powerful enemies. Customize your spaceship by making it more and more powerful and get ready for a space trip that will make your adrenaline skyrocket!
Unlike other similar soccer games, the user controls a single player instead of an entire team! World of Soccer RELOADED combines individuality and team play!

titre: Apothecarium: The Renaissance of Evil - Premium Edition
description: Durant le Moyen Age une maladie terrifiante et mystérieuse s’ést propagée en Italie. Elle a tué des milliers de personnes, des villes et des villages on péri en entier. Il y avait des légendes d’une ville mythique Apothecarium, où le secret de vaincre la maladie a été caché.

DEEMO -Reborn- est le célèbre jeu de Rayark. DEEMO revient désormais dans une nouvelle version sur Steam. Plongez dans un voyage immersif en 3D et enivrez-vous des beaux morceaux créés par vous-même au piano. De nombreuses aventures vous attendent dans ce monde féerique.

Take on the role of a clumsy commando, sent to fight a zombie horde. Turn-based gameplay, unusual mechanics dependent on your own pace of play. Gameworld and events inspired by a myriad of cult action movie parodies. Die, but take many of those mumbling green dudes with you!

Un librojuego digital donde deberás tomar decisiones que determinarán el final de tu aventura. Toma decisiones y consigue objetos para resolver el puzle, conseguir el remedio y encontrar el mejor final posible.
This game reveals the problem of the Internet. Now the global network has turned into a dump, in which you never know what file you can stumble upon. The so-called "deadly" files are no exception...
Uncover the dark secrets of a cave with an endless supply of monsters and loot!

L'orbe dimensionnel du roi a mal fonctionné, invoquant des hordes de monstres dans le royaume. Défendez-vous contre les monstres en rassemblant des ressources, en construisant des défenses, en améliorant votre arsenal et en survivant assez longtemps pour trouver la source du mal et la détruire.
Shawarma or Shaverma - a rogue-like game made in 2D hand-drawn graphics in which you need to help Shawarmyonok Gennady .
Installez-vous dans The Spectrum Retreat pour un séjour inoubliable. Manipulez votre chemin jusqu’à la vérité dans ce jeu de réflexion narratif captivant.

* compatible only with Oculus Rift/Rift S for the time being *Stones of Harlath is a first person dungeon crawler in VR. Players will play as a powerful battle mage, wield swords, shields and maces and cast powerful magic by drawing runes with their controller.

In the year of 18XX, the west is overrun by thugs and outlaws. A group of bandits have kidnapped Mayor Johnsons daughter and are spreading havok across the land. Only Gunman Clive can bring order to the west and save the girl!Jump and shoot your way across 16 diverse and challenging levels and fight massive bosses.

You are a projectionist tasked with assembling a long lost Horror Film for it’s first screening ever. A girl obsessed with vampires ends up meeting the real horrifying thing but he's far from the sparkly man of her dreams.

Step into Riddle, a vast world teeming with magic and mysteries to explore! See what happens as you explore and meet new fellow knights and uncover mysteries and challenges as you progress through the world learning the beautiful story and lore behind this magical world.
Battle for love as a gladiator in this epic romance of swords and sandals! Win glory, victory, a better life, your freedom - and spark a revolution!
Suivez les mésaventures du détective Richter dans son enquête contre le trafic d'alcool, dans les États-Unis des années 1920.

The EASIEST and FASTEST tool to make your own multi-platform visual novels! Quickly create your own games for Windows / MacOS / iOS / Android / HTML5 / CSS3, even if you know nothing about game programming or scripting!

Parfois, tout ce dont a besoin un monde étranger, c’est d’un fermier. Dans cette simulation de vie de colonie sci-fi, terraformez les déserts d’un monde stérile en paysages verdoyants en explorant, cultivant, construisant et révélant tous les secrets de cette étrange planète.

This widely revered NEOGEO masterpiece is finally available on STEAM! Not only a perfect port of the original game, the STEAM version of THE LAST BLADE 2 will allow players from across the globe to fight against each other online / locally in epic battles in online Multiplayer Mode.
Un siècle après que le légendaire Noitu Love ait sauvé le monde des diaboliques Darns, ces derniers refont surface dans le chaos d'une folie temporelle !

Injectez-vous dans le micromonde de BioGun. Faites face aux virus menaçants dans les chemins sinueux pour accomplir votre mission : sauver le meilleur ami de l'homme de l'intérieur. Sauverez-vous l'espèce canine de l'extinction ou DocX devra-t-il revenir sur le brancard ?

La démo de Core Defense, un jeu tower defense qui mixe rogue-like et deck-building. Choisissez une récompense, améliorez votre build et survivez la prochaine vague. Difficile, addictif et rejouable à l’extrême !
Explore a vast and detailed world and build a Transportation Empire!

titre: Irony Curtain: From Matryoshka with Love
description: Irony Curtain: From Matryoshka with Love is a satirical point and click inspired by the classic adventure games. It smuggles you out of your comfort zone and throws you into the middle of a Cold War spy intrigue - where there’s an even bigger game being played …

In Cursed Angel: Time Paradox, players engage in a captivating blend of time travel, real-time strategy, and action RPG elements. Take control of a heroic character capable of harnessing the speed of light, manipulating time, and seamlessly transitioning between different timelines.

titre: 好久不见 - Long Time No See
description: The story centers around a frustrated middle-aged man named Yu Kaijie. Along with his friend Ma Zhigao, they participated in a class reunion and used the chance to rob the safe of their rich classmate. But against all expectations, the tranquil villa turned into a closed-off crime scene...

C'est un CRPG d'aventure sandbox médiéval à haute liberté. Vous incarnerez un "reforgeur" dans les Terres Libres, choisi par la Déesse pour entreprendre une aventure médiévale à votre propre rythme, rassembler des compagnons, chercher à survivre et forger votre légende unique!

"Hist Maker" is an element synthesis puzzle solving game with some levels which has the function of historical education. When you are in the turbulent flow of time and see for yourself that the history of humanity is torn apart, only the historical knowledge and logical ability in your mind can help us to reshape this world.

Challenge your observation skills in the immersive world of ancient Greece! Identify impostors amid diverse crowds across 25+ unique levels. Designed for accessibility, even VR newcomers can enjoy the thrill. Uncover impostors and dominate the crowds in Crowd Control VR!

Ôpe est un platformer 3D dans lequel vous jouez Bô, un petit personnage affrontant de nombreux dangers tout au long de son épopée pour sauver l'équilibre de son monde. Afin de réussir cette quête vous devrez traverser des paysages de forêts enchantées et de temples mystérieux...
In this game, we will play with the simplest automaton model, Finite State Automaton, and use it to cope with 80 challenges.
After Emiliana's sister is captured in a Witch Hunt, she offers up her soul to a demon in order to gain the power of a Witch. Now she must wrestle with her faith as she searches for her sister.

titre: ルナティックドーン 前途への道標
description: Small tales add up to create a history that is all your own. Your mission is to seize the key of fate and build the history of this land.This game is only available in Japanese.

Verfall est un RPG tactique au tour par tour où vous devez former des équipes stratégiques pour affronter un monde en déclin. Explorez, découvrez des secrets et utilisez des compétences basées sur le Karma. Faites des choix et déterminez le destin du monde à travers plusieurs fins.

80's OVERDRIVE is a 2D pixelart racing game, designed to take you back in time to when 8 and 16 bit consoles and arcade games ruled the world. Compete against opponents in career mode to unlock new races, buy new cars and upgrade them with state-of-the-art technologies!

MagicCraft is a massive multiplayer PvP online MOBA game. Prepare to embark on a thrilling adventure in a world of magic and wonder. Cast spells, brew potions, and team up with other players to take on epic quests and battles. With regular updates and events, the excitement never ends.
Cindy is a receptionist at the Paradise Motel. She begins her night watch. She takes care of customer requests as usual. But that evening unforeseen events will terrify Cindy

EN Little Reaper finds himself lost in grim otherworld. Help him find the way back through treacherous obstacles and threatening foes.Prepare to rely heavily on your reflexes to complete 30+ levels spanning through 6 locations, and beat 3 unique bosses. RU Маленький жнец потерялся в мрачной потустороннем мире.
Claim and defend the Tomb of Tyrants against greedy adventurers by matching tiles to build a deadly dungeon full of traps, minions, and more!

Les avions ennemis s’approchent de nos frontières, trouveras-tu assez de courage en soi pour rejoindre l’escadrille ? Prépare ton avion au combat dans le mode spéciale du mécanicien, enflamme le ciel lors d'excitantes batailles aériennes. Découvre les missions supplémentaires dans la base aérienne de la RAF.
The snowboard game is a realistic skill based snowboard game with natural physics set in multiple immersive mountain locations and snow parks.

The long-standing 7 Wonders series keeps getting better and better! The fifth installment, 7 Wonders: Ancient Alien Makeover, adds an entirely new game component, new Wonders and a new and exciting material – Alien Energy!

titre: All She Wants For Christmas Is YOU
description: When the clock strikes midnight, the Christmas demon will be at your door. Trapped at home, you must discover what's around you to survive the night and thwart her terror.

titre: Angry Birds VR: Isle of Pigs
description: Join Red, Chuck, Bomb & the Blues to save the stolen eggs in Angry Birds VR: Isle of Pigs, an immersive VR adventure! Discover the island where the greedy pigs vacation, slingshot your way to defeat Dr. Frankenswine & create/share/discover an infinite number of levels with the online level builder.
Deux personnages uniques pour un total de 4 îles et de 16 niveaux à explorer, Tobe's Vertical Adventure va vous ramener à l'ère du 16-bits.
'Drone Wars VR' is a sci-fi single-player action game for SteamVR in which you fight off hordes of enemy drones in various arenas. Avoid, block and strike down these foes to achieve the best score.
La série DISGAEA continue sur sa lancée ! Découvrez Zed, un zombie parvenu à se hisser au-dessus de tous ! Tous... sauf le Death-tructor divin !

Construisez vos défenses et affrontez la horde d'automates dans ce mélange de jeu de rôle d'action 2D et de Tower Defense. Découvrez une histoire captivante au fil de 75 jours de combats, dans lesquels vous progressez à l'aide d'une collection de tourelles, pièges, et attaques spéciales.

A young boy has come to a distant village to visit his grandmother. Arriving at the final station, in some wilderness, we find newspaper clippings on the platform. This is where our tangled story begins.

You are gifted every moment with life's most precious achievement: A conscious mind, enabling you to sense and hold within, the universe's boundless beauty - a source of infinite inspiration that fuels your inner space. - C.E. is a linear, stereoscopic 360/VR-video short film experience.

Stimulez votre créativité avec Coloriage Adultes! Choisissez parmi une large gamme de pages à colorier dans l'application et découvrez la coloration de nombreux personnages, motifs et objets différents. Perdez-vous dans les couleurs, oubliez le temps et les devoirs, dites adieu au stress!

“The Agency” is an episodic mystery kinetic novel. In a fictional dystopic sci-fi steampunk world still recovering from the destruction of a recent global war; a young man travels to the Imperial capital city to seek better fortunes for himself.

titre: 幻想曹操传2 Fantasy of Caocao2
description: The most enjoyable Chinese-style Roguelike card game! Play as Cao Cao and conquer the Central, Japanese, and Western waifu with your allies, save the world!

Cross of the Dutchman is an action adventure game based on the true story of the folk legend 'Pier Gerlofs Donia'. The story takes place in medieval Western Europe, in the province of Frisia, near the turn of the 16th century.
Heroes Of Paragon takes strategy gaming to its next level by challenging you to fight against other players in intense base-vs-base battles.
Clonez les meilleures stars de football et gérez votre équipe de rêve.

故事是從這裡開始的—某天主角因公司倒閉而失業，那樣的年代失業可不是小事，要是無法賺錢養家餬口，他們一家三口可不是要露宿街頭？這種時候不論做什麼工作他都願意！此時天外飛來的傳單，像是天降奇蹟般地拯救了他。於是他下定決心，去薪水高但充滿危險與怪物的礦坑工作。礦工作為礦坑中的勇者，雖然有著極高的薪水，但他們要剷除礦坑中的各種怪物，化解所有危機，能夠從危機重重的礦坑中，將煤礦帶回礦坑外的礦工，被人們譽為「黑金勇者」。

titre: New York Mysteries: The Outbreak Collector's Edition
description: "Mystères de New York: L’Épidémie "est un jeu d’aventure dans le genre d’objets cachés avec des personnages inoubliables et des quêtes difficiles à conquérir, ainsi que beaucoup de mini-jeux et puzzles!

Claire is alone, lost, and hunted. The world has quickly becomes shrouded in darkness with unseen threats stalking Claire from the shadows. Aided by her dog and armed only with a flashlight, Claire must conquer her fear and find her comatose mother. However, there are others lost in the darkness seeking salvation.

«Where is the meaning?» is a JRPG made by two Russian developers with very special attitude to this genre. The action takes place in unknown universe where the player should make conclusions what is happening around. You are the geometric figure «square» which need to reach the end of this world.
1 - 8 player local multiplayer 2D top-down racing game. Racing, rockets, mines, steering failure, engine failure, repair kits, speed boosts and up to 8 players.
"Run and Gun" oldschool single-player platformer with NES aesthetics, including an authentic 8-bit chiptune.

There are more ways to race than ever before in NASCAR Heat 3! Jump into the enhanced Career Mode, build your own race team and compete in the Xtreme Dirt Tour. Prove that you're the best in the world in the new Online Tournaments feature. Plus, all your favorite modes are back and better than ever.
La prophétie Maya prédit l'apocalypse pour e 21 décembre 2012. Nos quatre héros parviendront-ils à vaincre les ennemis diaboliques et sauver l'humanité ?

FreeSpace 2, the follow up to the classic Descent: FreeSpace – The Great War is ready to engage you in the second round. Follow the Grand Terran Vasudan Alliance further into the mysteries of the Shivans. Get your flight stick and hit the flight deck. The last time was just a warm up.

titre: WebbVR: The James Webb Space Telescope Virtual Experience
description: Join the James Webb Space Telescope in orbit beyond the Moon and explore the universe from its perspective. Planetary systems are born, galaxies form, and stars emerge from within colorful nebulas—all before your eyes.

titre: Shattered - Tale of the Forgotten King
description: Le monde tel qu'il était n'existe plus, disparu en même temps que le Roi. Reforgez la réalité en rassemblant les témoignages des survivants dans cet action-RPG à la narration complexe et aux combats épiques dans un monde semi-ouvert. Êtes-vous prêt, Voyageur ?

Story of the Survivor is an action RPG that takes place during a zombie apocalypse. Surviving isn't going to be easy, and zombies aren't the only things to worry about. You must also eat and drink to survive as well as avoid other survivors.
失意青年刘在机缘巧合下得到了一份离奇的工作，在命运齿轮的推动下，结识了几名性格各异的少女。忽然有一天祸从天降，他卷入了一起绑架案，并被迫参与一场事关生死的游戏。在求生的同时，他不得不重新审视过去生活寻求蛛丝马迹，那看似平静的生活实则早已暗流涌动……

Ne vous est-il jamais venu à l’esprit que les statues que vous voyez tous les jours dans votre ville sont en réalité aussi vivantes que vous? Que leur regard vide retient une parcelle de l’âme du sculpteur qui les a, pendant une année voire plus longtemps, taillées minutieusement dans la pierre.

Radical Relocation est un jeu de casse-tête à la physique complètement secouée qui transforme un quartier tranquille en parcours du combattant dément ! Il te faudra une préparation de fer et des nerfs d'acier pour transporter tes affaires en les gardant en équilibre sur un véhicule en mouvement !
You transfer to a school and start a new school life...all the while hiding you're a genius ninja.

A 2D tank battle from a top corner, you can choose different combinations of module parts to complete the game, some levels have some weird and strange design, there are boss battles, there is a certain story line.
Buckle up in this minimalist retro arcade high score chaser.

Multi-Character Metroidvania Style Action RPG Featuring PermaDeath!! Switch at anytime between characters in a quest to stop The Dark Prince Rhigor from using the Ethi to unleash The Darkness on the realm.

Color by Number - Monster Heroes is an addictive anti-stress pixel art game. Choose from a variety of fun pixel images and follow the numbers to bring them to life. Color by Number has never been this easy!
Face the grim reaper at 3 frames per second.

titre: KATANA KAMI: A Way of the Samurai Story
description: The Way of the Samurai is forged in battle! Help the swordsmith Dojima pay off his debt after his beautiful daughter is taken as collateral by crafting swords by day and exploring mysterious, twisting dungeons for valuable materials at night.
Une petite fille doit trouver ses amis, révéler un sombre secret et échapper à ses jouets maléfiques.
Gorgeous pixel art. Intense, blazing fast battles. An epic adventure. This is the must-play retro indie JRPG built for the modern era.

Cavern Kings is an infinite action platformer designed to make every playthrough unique and interesting. Cavern Kings aims to explode with special effects in classical arcade fashion and create interesting synergies with its powerup system.
Plus de Trucks ! Nouveaux mondes ! Monster Jam Steel Titans 2! Monster Jam Steel Titans 2 vous propose plus de Trucks à piloter dans de nouveaux mondes Monster Jam !
Stealth and rebellion in an absurd totalitarian government.

Mantra is a multiplayer (1-4 player) and single-player psychological-horror game with high tension. Do whatever it takes to save your soul that has been possessed by an demonic spirit. If you don't, demon will imprison you in hell for eternity.
Space Station Continuum is a building & management sim inspired by the past, present, and future of humans in space.
Coliseum gives you a telekinetic playground to wield a mystical power, solve puzzles, and meet "The Beast,” in a slice of fantasy from the VR world of The Gallery: Heart of the Emberstone.

titre: Everything is going to be OK
description: "Everything is going to be OK" is a desktop labyrinth of vignettes, poetry, strange fever dream games, and broken digital spaces.
The Sandman came back to take revenge. This time his victim is Tim, Laura’s husband. Will you succeed in pulling him out of nightmare?

Experimental approach to 2d artillery genre: everything is realistically destructible, because the game world is a physics simulation. There are no sprites in the game. All you see is made of dynamically simulated matter, and thus can be destroyed. This innovative approach opens the new layer of physics based gameplay features.
See a world from a new perspective in this animal-ear themed constructive action RPG!
Proxy Blade Zero is a hardcore 3D action game with technical combat. Play as Fenrir, an advanced battle android, against the armies of King Anima.

Enter the ultimate 1970s space capsule in this thrilling VR adventure. Awaken your inner cosmonaut with intense, interactive gameplay, manage catastrophic system failures, and experience a hilarious story of Cold War absurdities. Can you make it back to Earth alive?

Incarnez l'inspecteur David Zander enquêtant sur une mystérieuse anomalie météorologique dans l'océan Pacifique. Utilisez votre intelligence pour résoudre des puzzles et surmonter des obstacles pour trouver un chemin plus profondément dans l'Île afin de découvrir le mystère derrière le 157e Méridien

Dead Secret is a first-person horror mystery set in rural Kansas in 1965. A reclusive professor is dead and it’s up to you to crack the case before you become the next victim. Investigate the murder and explore the story Time Magazine called “captivating” and “deeply creepy” .
A great game about a Great man!
Gérez votre propre entreprise de logistique, découvrez l'univers complexe du transport routier et faites tourner l'économie américaine à plein régime !

A little girl, Hinata, finding her missing cat in a mysterious and dangerous castle. This place once belonged to the famous Duke Shewell's family, but it is abandoned now. And there is a big secret hidden in this castle.

GunFleet is an online MMO-shooter, inspired by the different countries' mosquito fleets of the First and Second World Wars. Fight with each other, assemble in fleets of high-speed torpedo boats, submarine chasers, submarines and river monitors!

From above the world of “Cars”, Disney’s Planes takes players on a high-flying, action-packed animated comedy adventure with Dusty Crophopper, a big-hearted, speed-loving crop duster, voiced by actor and comedian Dane Cook. Embark on global missions and grand adventures around the world.

A weird hospital in a weird place. It has been in deep controversy since the COVID-19 take place. It was closed a few months after the virus spread, for unknown reasons. The hospital is very ancient and familiar with its inhumane experiences
La jouabilité est au cœur de la philosophie de Premier Manager et 06/07 offre à tous les fans de football, jeunes et moins jeunes, le point d'entrée le plus accessible au genre de la gestion.

The Castle Mystery is a first-person, scavenger-like horror game. One night you receive a letter from an unknown sender. It prompts you to visit a castle and take photos of specific artifacts located within and around the building. A large sum of money is on the line. So is your life.

Narrative exploration game located in a massive, post-human Western Washington. Navigate an open world that has been reclaimed by nature. Use journals, letters, zines, and other documents to learn the interconnected stories of the people who lived here once.

titre: Samantha Swift and the Golden Touch
description: Quand le nouveau bienfaiteur de Samantha lui demande de repérer le Scroll of Wealth d’Alexandre le Grand, l’opportunité semble trop bonne pour être vrai : Localiser le Scroll tout en rassemblant des découvertes merveilleuses pour le Musée des Secrets Perdus !

titre: The Last Case of Benedict Fox Definitive Edition
description: Chargez-vous de la dernière enquête de Benedict Fox et entrez dans un monde retors d'organisations secrètes, de rituels interdits et de meurtres sans pitié. Dans ce Metroidvania lovecraftien, explorez les souvenirs de victimes décédées en quête d'indices et combattez des démons.

Get Off My Space! is a tower defense game where you rely on skillful tower placement and resource management to beat upcoming dangers of the galaxy. Combining strategy and micro-managing fire groups, you will overcome the hardest level objectives.
Explosez vos adversaires avec Fireburst, un jeu détonnant de courses de rue arcade, très rapide et avec des graphismes superbes.

Profitez des sensations fortes de l'excitation d'un vrai casino sur votre PC/Mac. Essayez votre main à 15 machines qui apportent les images et les sons de la vie réelle dans votre propre domicile, notamment : Paradise Garden, Gold Bar 7s, 100 Wolves, Dakota Thunder, Desert Spirit, Eskimo Money.

Shred your guitar or smash your drum set like a rockstar! Play the original soundtrack in dynamic stages, progress through the campaign to get new skins, or customize your experience with custom songs, gameplay modifiers, and multiple control schemas!

At the farthest edge of the explored universe, the research ship Xanadu slumbers in orbit around a mysterious planet. Her systems remain active but there has been no message from her crew for months. Now a lone operative has been sent to wake the Xanadu and bring her home to Earth.

titre: Baobabs Mausoleum Ep.1: Ovnifagos Don´t Eat Flamingos
description: Baobabs Mausoleum™. Un mélange unique de genres comme Monkey Island, Zelda’s Link’s Awakening DX avec Twin Peaks et Bob L’éponge. Bienvenue àFlamingo’s Creek: Population: 64 habitants.

An exciting sci-fi real-time strategy game. You are the leader of a band of elite Marines on a rescue mission; it is your job to secure the outpost and rescue lost miners. Aliens are running amok; it won't be easy...

『Discouraged Workers TEEN』 is an independent kinetic novel created by YGGDRASIL STUDIO. This is the fifth in the Project DW series, a satirical story based on the popular Korean soap operas-styled plot. It compares Ga-yeon’s bleak everyday life to the dark side of youth.

Assume the leadership of one of the lands of Sovereignty and guide your people to glory and prosperity. By wisely combining soft and hard power, you can eventually hope to reign over the whole land. However, In this divided and merciless land, holding onto power is likely to prove harder than seizing it!
Dungeon Hero is a classic style Dungeon Crawler with a Casual/Cartoony twist.

Fast-Paced ULTRAKILL and DOOM like game where you are playing as the last Cameraman, who has to fight off the army of Skibidi Toilets using various weapons and cheerful music 🚽 (And little bit of pure brainrot)

titre: Night At the Gates of Hell
description: From the sick mind behind Bloodwash, Jordan King, comes his latest experiment in terror. Inspired by the Italian zombie flicks from Lucio Fulci and Bruno Mattei, Night of the Gates of Hell promises to be a blood dripping, neon soaked, flesh rotting experience.

Deux flics, une enquête et 24 heures pour boucler les méchants ! Détective à la gâchette facile, venez affrontez des gangs de criminels dans un FPS d'action cinématographique. Faites équipe avec un ami pour coffrer du malfrat façon buddy movie !

QuaQua (that's Aqua, with a Quack!) is the addictive duck game for you. Catch the falling blocks to build terrain and keep as much water on your island as possible. Beware of falling bombs and heavy rain as the difficulty slowly climbs in this tile-matching arcade puzzle adventure.
《残秽的我们》是一款本土手绘写实风格的恐怖冒险游戏，以真实事件为蓝本改编。在游戏中，玩家将跟随女主“无者”的脚步，深入由亡者怨念而产生的“怨秽地”，利用“刻印”的力量，探究隐藏其中的一段真实往事。

The Allies need your help, take them through World War II in this supercharged story-driven of the classic Minesweeper. Solve minesweeper puzzles, find land, naval and anti-tank mines, and win the war!

Pluto is a communications service that runs alongside all of your favorite VR applications. Connect with trusted friends and contacts like you’re hanging out in person, no matter where you are. Collaborate and communicate when you want, how you want, and with who you want on Pluto.

Panzer Girls is an anime-style top-down shooter mixed with tower defense strategy. Lead your tank girl team, defend against monster waves, upgrade vehicles and build your own tactics with flexible skill combos.

Welcome to the asteroid belt. The work is dangerous, the asteroids are temporary, and Earth is prohibitively expensive. Build automated mining operations, complete contracts, and earn your way back home.
Have you ever dreamt of a better version of Nice Pro? Younger, more beautiful, more perfect.

Work is boring if you are the only employee in your department with no cases ever. But when work appears, life immediately rises upside down! Forever. Immerse yourself in a dramatic yet charming world of evidence-gathering, deduction and dramatic events on the reverse side of our world.

Journey to the Land of Fuzz to collect colorful Iggles and deliver them to their color-coded destinations. But look out for the nasty Zoogs - they're dying to get their grubby hands on those adorable Iggles.

*A remastered version of this game with enhanced graphics has been released. * "Red Spider" is a Hong Kong Noir-themed Visual Novel. There are 6 story routes with the different characters(approximately 105,000 words in total).
Experience stylish-action battles and beautiful pixel art, summon heroes across time and space, and challenge the magic tower to save the heroic spirits and goddesses!

YORG.io is a game with an original twist on supply chains and zombies. Your goal is to build a base which survives the night which is when zombies attack. Build and upgrade defensive towers to protect your base and try to survive as long as possible.

Ce sera le jeu de billard le plus excitant auquel vous ayez jamais joué. Rejoignez jusqu'à 3 de vos amis dans ce jeu de roulette de billard palpitant ! Éliminez-vous les uns les autres avec le billard jusqu'à ce qu'il ne reste qu'une seule personne.
Dead Acres is a multiplayer arena-based survival farming game where you must grow crops and defend your home and animals against hordes of zombies, evil humans, ghosts, and demons.

Urukon est un expérimental jeu de grand stratégie inspiré des jeux de société de style européen. Vous incarnez l'une des 32 factions d'un monde extraterrestre mourant. Pour atteindre l'objectif de la faction choisie, vous devrez jongler soigneusement avec plusieurs systèmes interactifs.

Courez contre la montre pour sauver une ado kidnappée en moins de 2h ! Incarnez un détective rusé, plongez dans un mystère palpitant. Tapez des commandes rétro ou utilisez les flèches pour choisir des actions, concevant des solutions dans cette aventure classique et moderne. À vous de jouer !
Clea est une aventure horrifique de survie sans jumpscares, mettant davantage en avant la technicité du gameplay.

Suite à la dernière guerre humaine, des gaz ont été répandus à travers l'atmosphère, poussant les élites à fuir dans des colonies orbitales et le reste de l'humanité à se réfugier sous terre. Soyez prêts à combattre des insectes géants pour le futur de l'humanité !

Anna wakes up in a vast and mysterious undersea temple with amnesia. By unlocking the enchanted Imperial Relics she must rediscover her own lost identity and the forbidden secrets of Dark Empress before it’s too late.

Enjoy pure 16-bit RPG goodness! Scarllet and Beatrice are two close sisters. One of them has the gift of healing, the more she knows about her gift the more she realizes how big her responsibility is. Features party splitting, beautiful artworks and an intricate storyline.
Crawl through tight cave tunnels and avoid monsters in this claustrophobic VR spelunking game. Escape inhuman monsters and deadly environments as the cave walls turn to flesh.

《The Last Town》Is a first person shooter, tower defense, strategy, survival in one of the independent game.Using equipment to resist the corpses, more than 20 guns, accessories, consumables, mountable defenses were designed for the game, and a real physics engine was used to simulate reality
Alien Wall is a powerful genre mix between a brick breaker and ‘shoot em up’. Modern retro Arcade fun at its best!

《Immortals》 is a SLG with fast paced fighting. When the game starts, the hero will appear in a huge maze, and your goal is to find a way out of the maze. The hero will encounter other characters in the maze. They may be enemies or friends. You need to be careful in making judgments.

Become a cat! Cattails is a unique animal simulation RPG. Hunt for food, fight invading cats, explore to gather herbs, and socialize with other cats in an expansive open world. Get married and raise a family of kittens, befriend your neighbors, and learn to live in the dangerous wilderness!

Join Pixel as he quests through gaming history, teleporting across the most iconic video game systems of generations past. He’ll have to jump, dodge and play smart if he wants to survive all the traps, puzzles and enemies waiting to take him down at every turn.

titre: The Room in a Glass Box
description: Échappez-vous d'un diorama captivant ! Tournez, zoomez et résolvez des énigmes pour trouver la clé. Explorez un monde miniature et découvrez ses secrets!

A fast-paced roguelike arena shooter where you fight hordes of hostile Lootboxes, buy random upgrades with in-game currencies, and collect DLC fragments for permanent perks. A satirical take on modern gaming monetization.

Our name is Jim, a young man who wants to open a future in the world of pirates and has done many different jobs and of all kinds. This time we are going to look for Captain Flint's treasure and start the game remembering how everything happened and how we arrived at Alcachofa Island where he was buried.

Dinocide est inspiré par les jeux de plateformes classiques de la NES, dans un univers préhistorique fantastique. Dinocide essaye de saisir la quintessence de l'amusement et du rythme de cette époque, pour la retranscrire dans notre modernité !

This is a special world, inhabited by the amazing virtual life forms known as Norns. These cuddly little creatures have their own Digital DNA, brains and biochemistry. They learn and think for themselves but they need you to love them, care for them and play with them.

The classic abstract strategy game comes to Steam! Othello is an ageless game that takes a minute to learn and a lifetime to master. Place tiles surrounding your opponents tiles to flip them to your color. Get to the end with more tiles of your color and you are the winner!
Winston thought he could use heavy machinery and power from the depths of hell to transform sinful men into magic ponies. Winston was wrong.

Le jeu de rôle de survie en monde ouvert « Bad 2 Bad: Apocalypse » raconte l'histoire de Delta Team et de ses camarades alors qu'ils travaillent à reconstruire un monde dévasté par les humains et leur race transformée en zombies.
Unidentified Drilling Object (UDO) est un jeu de roguelike à défilement descendant qui consiste à tomber dans un trou avec une foreuse!
Escape the London Ripper while you work as a night girl.

Engare is a game about motion and geometry. Part puzzle game, part drawing tool, Engare is all about your geometric imagination. It’s a meditation on the dynamics of simple machines and the beauty buried deep within repeating motion.

Construisez la ville du 21ème siècle avec City Life !City builder nouvelle génération, la série des City Life a su s’imposer depuis sa sortie comme une référence du genre, entraînant derrière elle une communauté de joueurs toujours plus importante et des plus actives.

Les mutants ont la vie dure ! Blaster Master Zero débarque sur Steam ! Ce jeu d'action-exploration offre des vues d'en haut et de profil façon 8-bits qui vous rappelleront l'âge d'or de Nintendo. Découvrez de nombreuses améliorations : mécanismes de jeu revus, scénario plus solide et plus encore...

The journalist goes to the warehouse to record a documentary, but becomes a witness to creepy stories. The guards and warehouse workers look very strange. What is really hidden behind the endless shelves and how not to become a victim of the warehouse?

President for a Day- Corruption gives you the opportunity to assume the role of an African president. As such, you must make controversial decisions revolving around topics such as: democratic evolution, corruption, development aid- and cooperation.

Stellar Settlers est un jeu de simulation de construction de base spatiale et de colonie. Avec un gameplay de construction de base vertical et horizontal unique, prenez le contrôle d'une colonie, construisez votre propre colonie prospère sur 5 planètes hostiles qui veulent vous détruire.

Maya's Dice is a 2D puzzle-based RPG using the bluffing dice game, Liar's Dice, as a unique and dynamic battle mechanic. Players experience a cyberpunk world and a narrative that questions morality and one's core values.

Clan of death is a multiplayer traitor game, designed for having a lot of fun with your friends. A group of vikings has to complete some quests in a undead infested fjord. One of the vikings is a shape shifted cultist that rules over the undead and wants to sabotage the vikings quest.

The familiar becomes magical in this critically acclaimed interactive artscape. Explore ten scenes inspired by the everyday and let your expectations of reality be transformed. Carl Burton's other work has been featured in the New York Times, Serial, Colossal, and Medium.

titre: Saint Feu Miao Miao : Détachement spécial
description: “Saint Feu Miao Miao: Détachement Spécial” est un jeu de tir en vue de dessus où vous incarnez Elusa, une soldate féline. Infiltrez le territoire ennemi, battez les forces adverses et sauvez vos camarades captifs. Les chats sont les héros dans cette aventure pleine d’action !

Witness the journey of an officer in the homicide department from ordinary and invariably quiet life to an unknown world. Passengers of Execution is an independent game whose main theme is adventure/puzzle, although it contains many mechanics.

Manipulate your wrists, elbows and shoulders to get the arrow to the bow, draw it, aim and fire!Probably Archery gives the player more control over the minutia of their joint movements with tons of crazy scenarios to conquer, multiplayer battles to fight and brutal target challenges to dominate.
Use spraypaint to paint whatever you want in a blank art gallery. Send your galleries to your friends for them to view your artwork.
Achievement Idler: Black is an Achievement spam "game" that you start up to idle in the background and get the achievements.
Loslan needs you! The Legion is waiting for your call! Gather your strength, prepare your food, contribute your love, and pull out your gold coin!

Xenoraid is a vertically scrolling shoot'em up with procedurally driven missions and detailed shooting mechanics. Modern features such as real time fighter switching and squadron management make Xenoraid a fresh and thrilling shooter!

Wizordum is a retro FPS that puts you in the role of a Mage on a quest to track down the source of Chaos. With a wide arsenal of spells and magic items, battle your way through the world of Terrabruma in this unique blend of classic 90s shooters and modern gaming elements.
Jeu de plateforme 3D avec un pistolet à portail ! Résolvez des énigmes, des niveaux passionnants, devenez un maître du voyage sur portail.
Blast gems under a starry sky in this unique take on the match-3 genre.
No Time, you must save the kingdom from demons. Kill all monsters and Stop the Arch Demon! The Salvation of the kingdom lies in your hands.
A short horror walking simulator where you just head from the workroom to the exit. Something may happen along the way, but don't worry, just keep going.Your goal is to return.

The earth is suffering from an attack of space monsters, and the terran defense forces are called for combat and the annihilation of the monsters. The RX Squad with their advanced ships risks themselves to keep the earth in peace.

Fight your way through a procedurally generated labyrinthic castle in this rogue-like dungeon crawler, set in a vibrant and colorful anime world. You’re lost in a spiritual realm, but powerful monster girls will help you get back home with new powers and weapons if you bring them the right presents!

Eat the villagers, murder bunnies, milk cows, or exterminate gods! Soulash is a traditional, turn-based roguelike where your goal is to consume the souls of the living, conquer the vast fantasy world and decide its fate.

Madout Open City is a combat race in open city. Destroy opponents. Feel the dynamic chases and fighting battles. Enjoy the good physics of cars. You can choose from more than two dozen cars, open world

Fabled Lands is a challenging old-school narrative RPG set in an open world. Complete quests, fight, trade goods and develop your character. Explore a vast land of adventure: travel across the war-torn kingdom, survive the plains of howling darkness, and escape the Court of Hidden Faces.

Сity of sadness, where everyone tries to survive, in which there is no place for anyone and which is infinitely huge. It absorbs everyone who is not ready to live by his rules. Are you ready for this?
3rd person platformer where you jump and evade around many obstacles and traps laying in the castle.
Dawn Ashmoore est sur le point de découvrir les mystères obscures de l'Égypte ancienne. Les anciens dieux sont entrés dans notre monde.

Fais des grinds sur des pailles pliables, des kickflips sur des agrafeuses et trace des lignes déjantées à travers des skateparks faits de carton et de scotch. Et n'oublie pas, les oiseaux skaters pratiquent le dépassement de soi !

For every action, there is a reaction... For every choice, a result... Dive deep into your subconscious as you wander the halls of The Testing Chamber & join hundreds of thousands of other players in one of the biggest & most successful social experiments ever performed.
A galaxy-spanning top-down 2D classic RPG adventure to defeat the invading zenos from Vega.
Enigma Manor is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror game. Navigate your way through the procedurally generated manor, fend off monsters, solve puzzles and find a way to escape.

The horribly toxic Swamp King has risen once again! Gather your party and set out on an open world, retro-styled, RPG adventure. Powerful mystical artifacts are scattered about the world, each able to grant you new powers. Which will you choose? What is your destiny?

titre: Mavis Beacon Teaches Typing Family Edition
description: Learn more than the WASD keys! Mavis will teach you solid skills to improve your game! Now available Worldwide!

Enter virtual reality to listen to the debut EP “Together” of synthwave producer Sheaf. No gameplay involved -- just sit back, relax, and enjoy the music while you drive through a retro low poly world.

Set in a world after the destruction of humankind, the harsh battle of the combat dog "Pochi" begins. Explore dungeons that change every time you enter, get a wide variety of weapons, and power up your dog! Hunt the evil "WANTED"! Enjoy exhilarating battles casually in this shooting action game.

Mud and Blood, the cult classic flash real time strategy game, returns with its signature take on infantry tactics. Command a small squad through brutal battles against unfair odds. This is combat. Experience the chaos and unceremonious violence of modern war, where every decision counts.
Competitive fighting game fun, appropriate for all.
To play as a tribe warrior and a mysterious weirdo, adventuring in the world of gremlins.

Préparez-vous à relever un défi de taille dans ce jeu d'horreur coopératif multijoueur (1 à 4 joueurs). Explorez le cimetière de Ravenwood, plongez dans les souvenirs des défunts et tentez de dérober leurs trésors… tout en survivant à des menaces impitoyables, où la moindre erreur peut être fatale.

Évoluez votre créature pour survivre à Yggdrasil! Vous êtes un blob né au pied de l'arbre divin. Ramassez des jambes, bras, queues, ailes et d'autres morceaux, puis combinez les à votre propre corps pour former la créature parfaite!
Welcome to the mysterious village of "Folk Show"! This is a domestic plot-oriented micro-horror game that will take you into a rural story full of suspense and thriller.

The Action Commando Saga continues as the evil Cultists have taken over Saturn and are controlling people's minds on earth with their eldritch technology. The only person who can stop them is Chronos, the Time Travelling Spartan Soldier.
OmniBus is next-to-last gen physics game about the most powerful bus in the universe that can’t stop or even slow down for reasons incomprehensible to the simple human mind.
A narrative driven, puzzle-horror game. Solve cryptic puzzles, embrace or evade vengeful specters, decide who to trust and unravel a mystery.

Gravity Magician — головоломка в пиксельном стиле, где вы управляете гравитацией для решения задач в подземелье. Перемещайте камни, активируйте механизмы и избегайте ловушек, чтобы продвинуться дальше.
Quintaesencia: An open world of fantasy and magic
Hope For Village is an Old-School RPG game. Farming, crafting, combat, fishing and more, just explore it! Monsters, wild animals, enemies of kingdom... Who do you think will win?

The owner of the Golden Rose Manor died mysteriously in the secret room. Everyone in the manor has an alibi, but their speech is full of loopholes... You will go to the crime scene, search for clues, analyze the suspect's statement, make reasonable inferences, reveal the truth of the case!
Welcome to the bowling 3D. Free game with no rules, just throw the ball and knocking the pins, soft music and beautiful 3D graphics. Enjoy!

Creating an audio visualizer has never been simpler and faster than with Easy Audio Visualization, an easy to use, all-in-one software to get the perfect audio visualization for your music. Create professional music videos just like popular music channels on YouTube do, with ease and at a low price.

Descend down to the dark hellish realms of madness and despair and fight your way through hordes of undead, demons and other creatures of nightmarish powers. Collect treasures and unlock more heroes as you journey through the underworld alone or with your friends.
The Flames is a top down shooter where you fight a powerful boss called Hodaya and help save the Wisp the leader of the planet.
Cette édition définitive du jeu à succès par les maîtres conteurs de The Chinese Room a été remasterisée pour le grand écran et inclut tout le contenu bonus du jeu d'origine. UN HÉROS ÉMERGERA !

Hans is a physics-driven, parkour adventure. Ascend to the sky with our lonely watermelon hero. Navigate treacherous platforms, defy physics by slowing down time, try not to fall and chase the dream of reuniting with humanity. No saves. Bounce, fail, adapt, and bounce again.

titre: AFFECTED: The Manor - The Complete Edition
description: AFFECTED: The Manor achieves its final form! Experience horror unlike anything you’ve known before as you try to escape The Manor. Terror lurks around every corner as you venture deeper into the abandoned house and find that the only thing keeping you alive is your sanity. Or lack thereof...

Défendez Mars contre les robots dans ce jeu de survie roguelike innovant. Exploitez des ressources précieuses, construisez des machines puissantes et combattez ! Votre planète tombera-t-elle entre les mains des humains cupides ou votre défense sera-t-elle robuste ?
《深海》是一部真人互动电影作品，游戏中你将参与破获一起离奇的犯罪事件，你的每个选择（犹豫或果断） 都将决定着一个人的生死，一群人的命运，怀疑还是信任，救赎还是逃避，游戏过程中你将逐步感受到普通人在遭遇 犯罪事件的选择和成长。

A thrilling first-person action-stealth game. Play as Dana, the inventor thief, and use your gadgets to fulfill your task; retrieving a special artifact from a private art collection in a mysterious palazzo.

For the first time, RPG Maker 2000 is available in English! Since its debut 15 years ago, the beloved game-making engine has introduced untold amounts of users to the wonders of game design and continues to be a powerful, user-friendly tool.

Mon nom est Odin. Je viens du pays des ténèbres et je veux conquérir le monde. Il y a 3 jours, j'ai essayé de ressusciter les morts-vivants. Malheureusement, quelque chose a mal tourné car les squelettes n'ont pas de tête, pouvez-vous m'aider à trouver leurs têtes ?
An explosive homage to SNES-era platformers from the makers of Stealth Bastard Deluxe, Explodemon is non-stop action mayhem like you've never seen before.

RealFlight® is the industry-leading flight simulator for radio-controlled airplanes, helicopters, and drones. Fly more than 300 hyper-realistic vehicles in an immense, open world right from your desktop. This RC classic is a must-have tool for flight enthusiasts of all skill levels!
