After a firefighter lost his partner, fighting a fire at a chemical factory, the city was overwhelmed by a wave of ignitions. Control the fireman to extinguish fires and eliminate the cause.

Hair metal's not dead, it just smells funny! Get your denim vest, bandana and makeup, and dive into a point-and-click adventure as a middle-aged teddy bear planning a comeback with his old glam metal band – in a world where glam metal has been dead and buried for decades.

titre: CONVERGENCE: A League of Legends Story™
description: Dans ce jeu de plateforme narratif, au cœur de la tentaculaire Zaun, incarnez Ekko, inventeur d'une machine à remonter le temps. Récupérez des pièces détachées, créez des gadgets, débloquez de nouvelles compétences, puis remontez le temps pour vous adapter et être à la hauteur de tous les défis.
After Sasha was deemed unworthy of redemption, she passed through the Nexus of Souls. Lilly, who had promised Sasha that she would never give up, followed her through the portal.

Les Tiny Troopers sont de retour et plus forts que jamais ! Fringants dans leurs nouveaux uniformes et dotés d'un armement dernier cri, vos soldats favoris ont la gâchette qui les démange ! Guidez-les vers la victoire dans 4 opérations haletantes !

Find out the long story, about how the famous "generals" met and appeared in the new third-person shooter from Victor "LVL90DRU1D" Gazmanoff and his Kalifas! Take control of four survivors, Jeff, Kayla, Helga and Emina! Rush through 15 breathtaking levels and find out how the fate of heroes formed!
Experience a shattered and surreal dream filled with fascinating riddles, where your only guide is an elusive butterfly. Can you make the journey and wake up?

Scientist Strohmann loves to play around with all kinds of crazy stuff. This time he thought of a cruel and inhumane experiment in which his test subject, Dummy 44, will experience a horrible and terrifying pain. Your role is to help Dummy 44 to escape the laboratory forever.

Help Splatians blend the stolen colors back with the world and get rid of the evil Lord Ashen in this 2.5D puzzle-platformer metroidvania. Splat'n'stomp juicy enemies, swim in paint pools, solve physics and color puzzles and of course survive the death while figuring out the evil plans of the Lord.

This is a horror decryption game It depicts a girl searching the house for information to decrypt Scenes are small for a house and may be updated with multiple scenes for a clue to a scene The game is not saved and must be completed once

Préparez-vous pour une bataille épique ! Deformers est un jeu de combat en arène tout aussi azimuté que débridé. Pulvérisez vos amis en coop local ou formez une équipe et affrontez des adversaires en ligne !

titre: The Game of Annie 安妮的游戏
description: Hi,This is a third person action shooter game. Support for custom character size, support for costume change, use guns and bows for long-distance combat, can also use cold weapons for melee combat, with some training elements. Enemies include monsters and humans.

Can you handle 1600HP of pure monster truck chaos? Crush cars, soar through massive jumps, and build your own tracks in Monster Truck Destruction—now bigger than ever with new trucks, modes, and multiplayer mayhem!
My Soul Forever is a 2D puzzle game about a knight who could control his ghost spirit.

Immerse yourself in the obscure and mysterious autumnal forest, where every wrong step could be your last. As you travel uncover the dark story behind this place, where beauty and danger have become as one.
BROKEN MIND est un Survival Horror d'action. Battez-vous, enquêtez, résolvez des énigmes et découvrez ce qui est arrivé à Laura Campbell. Si elle est encore en vie, vous devez agir rapidement !

titre: The Adventures of Fei Duanmu 端木斐异闻录
description: Play as college student who majors in criminal investigation and solve the weird cases happened right beside him! A visual novel involves puzzle solving, reasoning, humor and of course adventures! English version is available now.

Animal Super Squad is a physics-based adventure game that lets you play as your favorite animal. Speed through a world full of dangers and bananas. Create your own levels, share them with the community, or forget all that nonsense and just play other people’s stuff.

6 different types of towers! 4 planets with different characteristics! 25 different enemies. Drones, Tanks, Biorobotic enemies and many different ground and air vehicles! Snowy and Glacial maps, Desert and Arid lands! Prepare to defend the solar system against invaders!

Four humans have been put to test by the Gods of the Ancient Greece, they shall face the minotaurs in the labyrinth. To survive, the must show their wisdom and solve the traps inside the labyrinth, all while avoiding the minotaurs. Their goal is to reach the last room, where the exit will be shown and they can finally be free.

Super Forklift 3000 is an arcade space shooter with a twist: you drive a forklift that carries and shoots up to three boxes. Defeat enemies and bosses while managing your different box types. Be careful not to run out of ammo!

titre: 吞食孔明传 Tunshi Kongming Legends
description: 吞食孔明传是一款传统的回合制角色扮演独立游戏，讲述了东汉末年的战乱之中，诸葛孔明与刘关张三人从桃园结义开始至一统天下的传奇故事。八个章节的正统剧本，两百位武将登场，可加入玩家阵营突破五十名，二周目开启，百种天赋技能及成就待解锁。

Dr. Yaga Lost House is a first-person horror game where you play as a Video Content Creator exploring a haunted, abandoned house. Uncover dark secrets, solve puzzles, and survive the paranormal horrors left behind by Dr. Yaga. Can you escape the nightmare?

Defend humanity's last surviving metropolis from mysterious alien machinations in this challenging base-defense arcade shooter. Featuring rapid upgrade progression, procedurally generated attack waves, dark humor and laser-sharp aesthetics.

Embark on a journey through the Old Kingdom in Realms of Magic - a sandbox RPG where you customize your character, choose your path, and immerse yourself in the fantasy world as a knight, wizard, miner, lumberjack, farmer, and more. After all, this is YOUR adventure.
Pinga Ponga is a improved Pong game with many extras and different game modes.
Crystal Eyes is an Indie pixelart action adventure game with RPG touches.
Computer indie-game in the genre of third-person shooter and survival horror.

DRAG, BOOP, AND PRAY. Play your way through a psychedelic, retro mini golf labyrinth built by an intrusive AI named Susan. Master glitchy physics, dodge bizarre ball-killers, and tackle over 140 mind-bending levels in this ultra-minimalist, surrealist arcade sports puzzler.
Embark on the journey of Robbery Cold, a former soldier of the Kingdom of Thaltas, now living as a mercenary since a terrible tragedy struck his life, with his wife dying due to an incurable disease.
Get ready relive the DOS classic and to experience the Horror and Glory that was the battle of Austerlitz!
This sequel is in the MV version. Totally revamped and faithful to the previous game made on VX Ace. Everything you experienced in the 1st and 2nd game is redone with MV graphics.

HELLO i made weird game visual novel thingy Your character develops different personality types depending on your choices, so they respond uniquely to different situations. With around three different choices to make and three unique lines of dialogue for each of them there's around nine different texts you can see and six endings.

Emmenez Jethro le Lion dans un voyage magique à travers l’espace et le temps pour empêcher l’effondrement imminent de l’univers. Ah, et votre ami Ronald l’Ours a disparu… peut-être pourrez-vous le retrouver pendant que vous explorez ?
La nouvelle adaptation du jeu de plateau Talisman se concentre sur le jeu en solo, lors d'une aventure où vous entreprendrez une quête épique en suivant l'ensemble de règles de la 4e Édition révisée.
Alex, Bailey, and Joey all have one thing in common: they all live in the most depressed place in the Arctic. A penguin dating sim/visual novel loosely based on Club Penguin.

This 3 hour long 2D indie narrative uses a variety of game styles, from 2.5D perspective sword fighting to Platformer chases. However, succeeding at challenges and puzzles do not guarantee “'winning”' the game. Make the right choices to get out of hell — or don't. It's really your personal problem.
Experience a colorful puzzle-platformer experience in Color Phase! Find and use different colors to interact with the world around you in a variety of different ways to reach your goal!
Be prepared to survive in a custom-generated, low poly environment, fighting against other players from all over the world.
Save the world one wire at a time with Bomb Squad Academy, a puzzle game where you have to defuse bombs under a time constraint.

titre: OPUS: The Day We Found Earth
description: OPUS: OPUS: The Day We Found Earth (OPUS: Le Jour où Nous Avons Trouvé la Terre) vous emmène dans un voyage dans les étoiles. Aidez le robot Emeth à suivre la volonté de son créateur et retrouver notre maison perdue, comme il réalise un objectif plus grand dans son cœur mécanique.

Spirits Abyss is a roguelite platformer with destructible terrain. Cast into the Abysm you must explore its diverse depths battling phantasmic meanies and plundering its useful treasures to find a way home... but does something nestle beyond the realmic veil of death?

The most wicked men that ever lived on earth. Authoritarians, dictators, and tyrants, from Hitler to Stalin, they are all back. Historical Invaders it's a fixed shooter game where you are the chosen one to annihilate the demons of our past and save mankind.

titre: Buddi Bot:  Your Machine Learning AI Helper With Advanced Neural Networking!
description: Buddi Bot is an isometric puzzle game where you must (re)train Buddi Bot, an advanced AI with neural network technology. With just a click, Buddi will complete tasks like washing dishes or cooking a steak, by learning COLORS and SHAPES. Are you prepared for the future? Play and find out.
studio: University of Texas at Austin SAGA Lab

description: Covert Syndrome is a free to play Coop corridor shooter with a focus on unscripted AI and fast tough combat. Created as a prototyping project we wanted to release it to the community so people can experience Co-op VR for free.
Fly your plane with arcade flight simulator controls through narrow levels shooting enemy robots and dodging amongst obstacles such as trees and ancient ruins.

In GamersGoMakers, you found a little company creating the first video games in history. Create your first game with only basic sound and simple graphics available in the year 1980. You´re one of the pioneers entering the rising global market for computer games.

titre: 完蛋！我被美女包围了！前传
description: 在本作中，“你”化身为即将迎来毕业季的男主顾易，在对未来的迷茫与憧憬中，你将与六位性格迥异、各具魅力的女生发生一连串的故事，她们或是鬼马少女、或是温柔甜心、猫系娇女、豆腐西施，千娇百媚、亦幻亦真，敬过往。

First Strike est un jeu de stratégie en temps réel, dans lequel vous prenez les commandes de l'un des 12 principaux acteurs nucléaires du monde – des superpuissances telles que les États-Unis ou la Corée du Nord – en tentant d'être le seul rescapé lorsque le monde sera réduit en cendres.
Play as Adolf on his last day in the bunker, the Nazies have lost the war and you get to play out the events that follow with a humorous and dark twist.

Inspired by the classic arcade Lunar Lander game, in Galactic Lander you control a delicate scientific spaceship which you must deliver from point A to point B, either alone, or with a friend in a co-op level, potentially made by the game's own Steam Workshop community!
The next step in the evolution of chess tuned for more viable options, strategic interest, and years and years of expert play.
You play as chickens who have to survive on unstable platforms in various universes of the chicken coop, will you be able to keep the balance and hold on, compete with friends and beat the record!

Wrench is a mechanic simulator where players prepare and maintain race cars. The parts in Wrench are the most detailed of any game in the genre. Extreme attention has been paid to even the smallest components, including fasteners which are accurate to the thread pitch and install torque.

In Super Panda Adventures, you play as the brave panda-knight Fu, who is about to finish his training to become the new guardian of the Princess. At the same day of the big celebration party, some uninvited Robots show up to conquer the planet and take the Princess away in their Space Ships!

Un jeu narratif du type « road trip » qui se déroule en Italie, en plein dans les explosives années 70. Le jeu raconte l'histoire de Lella, une jeune fille tourmentée au volant de son coupé sur la Voie Aurelia, la route qui longe la côte Tyrrhénienne.
OSK is a stylishly brutal platformer in which you climb an enormous tree, up towards the sky as a squirrel escaping the chaotic apocalypse down below.

In Land of Puzzles: Battles the king and queen need your help. To avoid war the king has accepted a challenge of puzzles to solve. He needs you to solve 15 sets of challenging puzzles and help him secure the kingdom.
Raiden III Digital Edition is a revival of the classic Raiden series of scrolling shooter games.

Le jeu de rôle d'action classique de l'ancien jeu Web en 2010, la lutte contre les zombies dans les derniers jours, les jeux 2D horizontaux, les armes à feu, les armes blanches, les mercenaires, les gangs... Maintenant, une version autonome sans Internet est lancée.
Nightwalker 2 is a horror adventure game that focuses on story and exploration. While trying to uncover the mysteries of the lost village, Nightwalker needs to do more than before to survive.

You have crash-landed on Notrium. Your food supplies are running low, and a pack of predatory aliens have your scent. You're out of bullets for your pistol, your only weapon a handful of rocks. A freezing night is setting in, and you are desperately looking for firewood. Can you survive?

A surreal satire RPG set in a post-apocalyptic American dystopia starring a trio of young witches. Outlandish & colorful art design, wild characters, bizarrely surreal enemies, 20+ recruitable heroes, and an out-of-this-world story bound to keep you coming back for more!
Explore the world, learn new spells, bend spells around corners and get spell upgrades in the adventure of a young wizard roaming the world. Become a wizard for hire and begin your journey.
A game where your only goal is to die - Just like in real life!

Desert Bus is back and better than ever! The 1998 Penn and Teller cult hit mini-game is coming to virtual reality, so you can fully immerse yourself in the thrilling eight-hour trip from Arizona to Nevada. It’s almost like you’re driving the “wheel” thing!
High Speed Cataclysm est le plus frénétique et avancé des jeux de tir en 2D où vous devrez détruire des milliers d'ennemis afin de sauver la galaxie.

After the rise of a new Demon Lord, it falls on the chosen hero from an ancient bloodline to stop them. However, due to a curse cast upon him, he must pass the task to his sister, Shera. Now she must gather the Three Treasures, and defeat the Demon Lord.

Alice Andersson, a world-renowned scholar, faces a dilemma of grand proportions when her mother falls gravely ill. No traditional cures have been able to save her; not even the most unconventional methods have worked! Join her as she discovers the legend about the Elohim Cube, a mystical artifact that might be their only hope.
Panzermadels! The first dating simulator to deliver a thoughtful look at tanks, and the men who date them!

Notre si belle ville est en ce moment même victime de multiples attaques. Pantalons taille basse, costumes douteux, port de chaussettes avec sandales... Il convient d'envoyer un message fort, et de l'envoyer avec style... L'heure est venue de rendre justice envers la mode !

Planet Station est un jeu de tir d'action 3D tendu dans le genre Science-fiction. Les joueurs doivent aider l'ancien shérif Margaret à survivre sur une planète dangereuse après le crash de son vaisseau spatial. Combattez des monstres, rassemblez des ressources et trouvez un moyen d'échapper à ce piège mortel.
Blessé et en fuite, piégé dans un bâtiment abandonné avec pour seule arme une lampe mourante. Avance dans l’obscurité, échappe aux horreurs tapies et survis dans une expérience tendue et paranoïaque.

Explore the inner workings of deserted factories in search of data cassettes that contain boundless virtual worlds. Collect more tapes and explore more worlds and you'll soon discover new methods of traversal and control that will take you farther than you'd ever expect.

Hack greedy megacorps to help as many people as you can in a high-agility cyberpunk looter/shooter RPG. Explore neon cyberspace vistas and outmaneuver AIs to customize your hacker OS and weapon combos. Play solo or online co-op with up to 10 people!

You take the part of the military and political leadership, trying to lead your nation to victory, in the midst of some of the toughest operations of the Civil War. You will build, organize and command your armies over one of the largest maps of the USA ever made for a Civil War game.

Construisez et défendez une base impénétrable. Assemblez et programmez une armée de robots pour affronter une invasion de robots pirates. Construisez, programmez et combattez dans cinq environnements différents.

Rising Spire is a turn based RPG inspired by the classics. Play as Atlas, a young Nephilim whose world is on the brink of destruction at the hand of Divinity itself. Explore, forge deep relationships and hone your powers in this immersive coming-of-age story.

Quinn is a citizen of the social media obsessed society of Outpost 72. As Quinn, send messages and emojis to others in the city to affect their behavior. Use these methods to solve puzzles, distract guards, and explore the world through the short narrative stealth action adventure game of LOGOUT.
A physics based puzzle game. Bounce the ball of angled surfaces to get it to the finish.
Casual puzzle on the theme of a romantic evening in a cafe.

Mind Shadows is the first standalone game that my friend and I have made since graduating. It is a short psychological horror experience set in the 1980s. You will see multiple cinematic locations in First Person as you slowly gather hints to what is going on.

Death Crown est un jeu minimaliste de stratégie en temps réel dans un style 1bit où vous jouez la Mort elle-même, commandant ses légions de la mort et punissant le Royaume de l'Humanité pour son orgueil.

Matthew Taurus, après avoir tout perdu lors d'un événement horrifiant, est devenu un hors-la-loi vengeur. Préparez-vous à déchaîner votre colère à travers des vaisseaux spatiaux dangereux dans ce jeu de tir frénétique à deux sticks, où vous devez trouver vos ennemis et les détruire.
SokoMage is a new Top-Down puzzle that will push your brain to the limit. Slap rocks, avoid bushes, and hit the crystal to reach the end! Can you smash your way to the final level?
Protect the candy from insects and earn money. Hordes of insects will try to break through the defense. Give them a hard fight
K-9 Dog Job - simple runner game. Now you play as a dog and your goal collect bones.

Construisez une usine et partez explorer les donjons seul ou avec des amis. Automatisez la collecte et la fabrication de ressources ou bien aventurez-vous dans des donjons remplis de dangers et de récompenses. Trouvez votre équilibre de jeu idéal car peu importe le chemin l'histoire vous suivra !
Bac à sable simulation multi-joueurs agriculture sans règles. Jeu en ligne et hors ligne.

Sweet Volley High - A Yuri / Otome Visual Novel from NewWestGames Sweet Volley High is the story of Aya Mizuki in her senior year at high school, and beyond, as she pursues a dream of becoming a professional volleyball player. Will she find romance and success, or rejection and heartbreak?
Découvrez de magnifiques mondes extraterrestres, parsemés de techniques anciennes et de ruines mystérieuses qui font écho à un passé lointain.

Moonpod's Starscape mélange le jeu d'arcade avec une touche de personnalisation. Avec un équipage réduit et un système d'armement en ruine la station de recherche spatiale Aegis est à la dérive. En tant que pilote survivant vous devez aider à la réparation des défenses et, avec l'aide de la technologie extraterrestre, concevoir de...

« The Legacy: Prisonnière » est un jeu d’aventure d'objets cachés, avec un grand nombre de mini-jeux et puzzles passionnants, qui vous emmènera directement dans un tourbillon d’événements fantastiques dans un monde lointain !
Koi Unleashed is a party-based RPG, with real-time combat and inspired by Japanese folklore. Join a guild that has just set foot on an unknown world, filled with mysterious creatures.

Le monde est en danger ! Des créatures mutantes géantes attaquent la planète ! Un groupe appelé « Les Agents » s'est uni face à cette crise biologique. Votre mission : « Combattre, chasser, conquérir ». Le monde a besoin d'un héros. Remplissez les objectifs des parties et déjouez l'équipe ennemie !

Votre histoire à Super Woden GP partira du plus bas en termes de ressources et de budget. Avec cela, vous devez obtenir un véhicule bon marché et vous inscrire à certaines courses pour commencer à être quelqu'un et acquérir de meilleurs véhicules et atteindre le sommet du monde automobile.

Structura is a rather unique sci-fi real-time strategy set in space. Its a hybrid of rts and fps, with emphasis on combat and survival. Build your economy for war, modify the unit by adding components, explore, expand, and survive the savage waves of enemy attacks.

Experience the adrenaline of performing insane stunts, getting big airs, grinding and bombing hills with the only inline skating game available: On a Roll. It has everything sport sim fans love and includes a replay editor, skatepark builder, open world and lots more.
Toree's Panic Pack is a collection of three tiny 3D Platformer games in a classic low poly aesthetic.
Going Deep is a game played with a third-person view. Going Deep contains action and horror genres. using different materials you can craft/upgrade weapons, armors, knives, pouches, ammos and more
Each person’s family name in the Continuum is given a debt which they must pay back, or they risk being wiped by the Grid.

Project Wunderwaffe vous emmènera dans les réalités de la Seconde Guerre mondiale, dont la fin semble proche. Votre tâche est de construire une base militaire secrète et de construire des armes d'une puissance sans précédent ! Êtes-vous capable d'avoir une influence sur le sort de la guerre ?

Imagine being stranded on an island in the early 1900's, being a only survivor in a experimental plane crash. However, the island you crashed on is not a normal island, its Boom Island! Engage yourself in this arcade style first person shooter, where the main objective is to shoot explosive balls while surviving.

Découvrez un vaste jeu TD de survie en monde ouvert de science-fiction se déroulant sur une planète lointaine au plus profond de l'univers. Fabriquez, construisez, exploitez, échangez, explorez et survivez dans ce monde extraterrestre. Collectez des données et défendez-vous contre des vagues d'ennemis cherchant à vous bannir.
A game about parrying, attacking, and overcoming difficult foes

An historically accurate multiplayer strategy game that combines RPG elements with turn-based combat. You play as a leader of one of the many tribes surrounding the Roman borders in mid-5th century AD. Your objective is to lead your warriors into raids, skirmishes and battles to survive.
Explore your surrounds in this short narrative using a novel mechanic to find objects in a mirror's reflection

Iris and The Giant est un mélange de jeu de cartes, de RPG et de roguelike. Vous incarnez Iris et affrontez ses peurs dans son monde imaginaire. Plongez dans cette aventure mélancolique et trépidante remplie de monstres mignons. Prêts à combattre vos démons intérieurs ?

Slay is a turn based strategy game where your goal is to conquer the island by buying men and using them to capture your enemies' hexagons. By combining two men you can create a single more powerful man who is able to kill weaker men.

Run, Rush, Haste, Burst Speed has never been pushed this far. Jump, Charge, Dodge, Slide You just slipped and got crushed! You can’t handle T.E.C 3001 yet… Try again until speed holds no secrets for you.

titre: Tanks With Hands: Armed and Treaded
description: Rev up your engine and challenge your friends to an all-out melee! Whack your opponents with a vast array of weapons and survive deadly stage hazards. Perfect for parties and get-togethers! May the best tank-man win!
StarDrone: Sling Star, c'est la course hyper-cinétique à travers la galaxie, mélange de flipper, d'action arcade et de casse-briques, désormais sur écran plat et en réalité virtuelle.

titre: 死亡旅店Ⅱ亡者归来-Death Inn Ⅱ The Immortal Is Coming
description: Death Inn Ⅱ- The Immortal Is Coming is a horror puzzle. The film crew is in a castle to finish, What is the mystery behind the mysterious death of a leading actress in a castle? Was it a homicide or was there more to it? It's a foggy castle, but none of the truth is buried forever.

"let's make a promise... When I grow up, I'll find you." By complete chance, these two childhood friends meet again after 10 years apart, but this time, will he be able to hold on to her? Or, will he lose here again forever? A love story about a summer trip in the countryside.
After mind transfer into a body of a young wolf-human hybrid, you set out to stop a person on the verge of destroying our planet. A person addressed as Butcher.
《九霄缳神记》是一款东方幻想题材的动作冒险游戏，以爽快的即时战斗为主体，融合了众多冒险元素及解谜设计。在这世界中，意外卷入上古阴谋的“你”，踏上了与命运抗争的历程。

Combattez les esclavagistes de l’île de Kovit dans ce RPG au tour par tour inspiré des grands classiques. Gérez votre armée avec ses dizaines de classes et sortez victorieux des champs de bataille destructibles. Ils ont beau avoir le nombre, ils n’ont pas votre esprit tactique !

Aftercharge est un jeu compétitif en 3 contre 3 qui oppose une équipe de robots invisibles à une équipe de gardes de sécurité invincibles dans des batailles survoltées et tactiques. Les robots doivent se faufiler inaperçus et détruire tous les extracteurs d'énergie sur la carte alors que les gardes ont le devoir de les trouver, de les...
Rescue all animals from their enclosures without being caught by adults! But, you can’t do it alone. You and your friend will have to dress up as adults to get by in this zoo!
Wintermoor Tactics Club is a story about surviving high school, with gameplay inspired by tactics RPGs and visual novels.

titre: Epics Of Distant Realm: Director's Cut Edition
description: Ready for some nostalgia? Epics of Distant Realm is an adventure game from 2006, combined with role-playing elements.

titre: 下一层的封魔塔 Forever War
description: The world's greatest warriors set out for the tower! Start your expedition! Defeat those cute enemies who suddenly appear in front of you! Or be frightened by treasures and your amazing luck!

Flint's Hints is an escape-room-like puzzle game where you investigate your surroundings to appease your fussy pet cat, Flint. Search for hints to figure out what he wants and how to give it to him, but be careful with what you investigate. Some things are meant to be left alone and forgotten...

In this colorful arcade classic, play as one or two mercenaries hired by the American government to stop the terrorist organization known as "Big Valley''. Your mission: fight these terrorists for control of post-apocalyptic New York City.
Shoot zombies from terrace like a boss! Zombo Buster Rising Remastered brings you a nostalgic experience of classic 2D side shooting-defense in enhanced build right from your Steam library!

titre: ギャルモンフォークロア～女の子モンスターがいっぱい！～
description: A super kawaii and lengthy fantasy RPG with over 200 girl monsters!
studio: ミラージュブリンガー

description: She wakes up alone, missing, and trapped in the frozen tundra of Hyperborea, Hypatia must use her wits and wileys if she is to escape this accursed corner of the world. the choices she makes will determine not only her future, but that of the imperial exploratory legion.
Pourchassés par les mercenaires d’une ennemie aux pouvoirs immenses, le combattant Pseudo et la créature sous sa protection entament une quête périlleuse aux confins de terres étranges.

Jump into the vibrant VR world of Lollihop - a tasty third-person platformer! Guide a playful platypus with a large lollipop through colorful realms, mastering precise jumps and collecting juicy fruits in immersive stereoscopic vision.

Vous-vous êtes déjà demandé à quoi ressemblerait un mélange entre Tetris et Lemmings ? Bien, ne cherchez plus car... MouseCraft est arrivé ! MouseCraft est un puzzle-game de A à Z dans lequel les joueurs aident Schrödinger, le chavant fou, à compléter sa mystérieuse invention.

This is a horror and decryption game. The style is 2D pixel cartoon. There are five chapters to explore. Each chapter has new maps and music. There are three enemies. They all have two stages and six chasing music. They need to constantly avoid the pursuit of the enemy until the end

Insanely addictive, easy to learn, impossible to master! Airport Madness is an airport strategy game. Designed by real air traffic controllers, Airport Madness captures the fun aspects of air traffic control. The decisions and actions you make in this game are identical to real-world airport ops.

Snail Bob 2 est une garantie de divertissement pour les joueurs de tous les âges. C'est également le jeu parfait pour que les parents jouent avec leurs enfants, en trouvant des solutions ensemble et en s'amusant comme des petits fous.
A first-of-its-kind SUDOKU adventure game featuring the gang from EverythingHerbs, two separate story lines, and at least one super villain.

Le jeu inspiré par la dérive rue vieille école au début du Japon avec customisation profonde et la capacité de construire une voiture à partir de zéro! Châssis et suspension Démontable! Dommages à la voiture réalistes! Il a très cool dérive idéal physique pour touge drift rue!
Belle simulation interactive de liquide sur votre écran comme fond d'écran en direct. De nombreuses options vous permettront de l'adapter à vos besoins.

For the first time ever, Soul Nomad & the World Eaters is coming to Steam! With unique gameplay mechanics, memorable characters, and up-scaled artwork, this is a must-have for Strategy RPG fans and NIS fans alike!
Idle Trading Simulator - is a simulator of buying / selling currency in the stock market. The game will help you get a first idea of the financial market, without losing your real money.

Dark Traveller est un jeu d’énigme plein d'action avec plusieurs scénarios ouverts et plusieurs fins. Le jeu raconte l'histoire d'un futur lointain où le monde se meurt et où le protagoniste voyage à travers l'espace-temps quantique pour sauver sa maison mourante !
Smithy is an underground rodent that happens to be an excellent weapons smith. Purchase and upgrade weapons while destroying everything standing in your way to collect more gold!

In this interactive sci-fi adventure novel, you are the AI pilot of Earth's last interstellar ship, tasked with finding a home for your crew—the last remnants of humanity. Your choices will determine their fate, and your own.

A role-playing game with multiple endings. Throughout the ten years of life from childhood to adolescence, the protagonist will experience encounters, sacrifices, choices and separation. Also: This game does not support English, please understand.

titre: 青鳥樂園 Blue Bird Land EP.2 下篇
description: Blue Bird Land is an AVG with horror and puzzle elements. There are 2 episodes, including 6 endings and four chapters. In each chapter, the form of the game is unique and different from others. Let’s follow the alluring characters, addicted to the dangerous amusement park!
Maitrisez le combat tactique à l'épée, ou découvrez comment éviter le bain de sang. Un voyage qui vous fait confiance du début à la fin.
Wall jump and slash your way through the remains of Facility 32 as legendary Scrap Hunter Iggy Ikeda in this super-tight action platformer with collectibles.

An Interactive Visual Novel with 35 story branches, 150 unique lines of dialogue, unlockable skins and many wholesome vibes! Dere-chan is always kind, happy, and energetic so whatever happens she'll always be there with kindness and support!

Make your way through the abandoned establishment of Paribneur Co. As you discover the morbid secrets and chilling creatures of the building. Being forced to find a new way out of the building, you will be faced with hard choices, choose carefully, your choices will affect the rest of the game.

titre: Choices That Matter: And The Sun Went Out
description: Take part in one of the most complex interactive adventure stories ever written! What if the sun inexplicably vanished only to return hours later? Investigate with your AI companion, Moti. Uncover conspiracies. Discover ancient religions. Travel the globe.
LOEK is a FPS where the goal is to shoot farm animals with a rocket launcher.

Go back in time and experience, “The Fabulous Fifties”, in a game that recalls scenarios, vehicles andstreet races of the legendary 50´s films. Customize your car and compete in 8 different race modes, through five completely different 50´s themed areas and become the King of the Road.

Bunker Punks is a fast paced rogue-light FPS set in a dystopian future. Run a group of revolutionaries and raid corporate strongholds for supplies, weapons and armor. Customize your bunker, train your gang and tear down the corporate government.

Navigate the eerie world of Dreams in the Witch House, a unique blend of point-and-click and RPG-adventure. Unravel occult mysteries in Arkham, maintain your sanity, and survive the May-Eve in this Lovecraftian horror game.
Modify geometry and experience a gaming genre that is truly unique, different, beautiful and serene all in one.

Dark Train est une aventure de véhicules steampunk primée en papier. Assumez le rôle de calmar mécanique Ann 2.35f attaché à la machine ferroviaire et livrez la mystérieuse commande au défunt D. W. Tagrezbung, le célèbre inventeur de la ville frontalière.

Explorez la grotte Chauvet il y 36 000 ans, avec la voix de Cécile de France pour guide. C'est dans les gorges de l'Ardèche que nos ancêtres ont donné vie à leurs croyances en dessinant sur les parois les premiers chefs-d'oeuvre de l’humanité. Et vous y croiserez peut-être l'ours des cavernes…

In Fatal Falls you explore the dark secrets of "The Grand Elysium", a posh luxury hotel in the middle of nowhere. Interact with its guests, drink a cocktail at the bar, peruse the noble premises – the choice is yours! Just make sure you don't get entangled in the hotel's dark deeds...

In this game, you must regain your Rock Paper Scissors Crown by defeating the three members of the Triple R Gang: Rocky, Randy and Ripley. They all have their own unique play styles. When you throw three identical moves in a row you unleash a combo!

With Railroad X you can build complex railway worlds on your PC or notebook and it is possible to control trains as a train driver. You can control the entire rail traffic with a sophisticated signal system. Build train consists from steam, diesel and electric locomotives, passenger and freight cars.

Did you ever wonder what sports would be like on the moon? This dynamic multiplayer game will have you on the edge of your seat for hours to come! Mixing elements of Rugby with the low gravity of the moon, you can work as a team to score goals against your opponents.
Gravity Waves is a twin stick shoot 'em up in space with waves of enemies and realistic gravity to provide constantly changing gameplay.
Lightout is a first-person psychological horror game with puzzles, Which takes place in an abandoned apartment.
What's better than climbing mountain in a cardboard box? Getting deep frustration every time you fall from it.

While you are at the blind date table, you unexpectedly return to ancient times and incarnate as a lowly servant. Thanks to the help of several beauties, you are able to turn the corner. In the shocking He Mansion, it will be up to you to decide whether to live quietly or use your ingenuity!

Construisez des plates-formes pour miner du bitcoin, de l'ethereum et d'autres crypto-monnaies. Effectuez des transactions sur le marché pour accroître votre richesse. Développez votre entreprise dans de nouveaux bureaux. Embauchez des employés qualifiés et assignez-leur des tâches.

Lofi Ball Is A 3D Platforming Game, Inspired By Super Monkey Ball And Ball Race, Dodge Obstacles And Smash Through Walls To Get To The End Of Each Level And Find Multiple Ways To Complete Levels, Has Endless Mode And Infinite Levels

Demon's Revenge is a turn-based Gothic fantasy RPG about Sen, a lone water demon who serves a penance in an eerie forest for a terrible crime she once committed. Joined by other outcasts and monsters, she battles hunters, ghouls, ghosts, and dragons for the right to live in a world that hates them.

A science fiction-themed vertically scrolling shoot 'em up game known for its stunning detailed pixel art, gigantic bosses, and a menacing difficulty. From the legendary studio Toaplan, this is quite possibly the most rock and roll shooting game of all time.

Roll and be trolled on your journey to the legendary place called Ballhalla. Follow the beat to overcome deadly hazards in sync with the music. Style your balls and marble at awful puns in the roll playing game of the year!
In ROMBY you will earn points by placing 4 and even more figures of one color in a straight line. Earn more points and open all hidden girls. Trust me it won't be easy.

titre: Nancy Drew®: The Creature of Kapu Cave
description: Team up with the Hardy Boys® and Track an Ancient Legend Through Hawaii!
Drinks with Abbey is a short, slice-of-life visual novel about a first date.
Connect non-matching pieces to reach level 99.

Your friend got lost in a complex maze and really wants to get out of there as soon as possible. You don't know where exactly he is, but you can communicate with him by sending simple text messages. Can you save him?

"This application is no longer supported. Please switch to Fitforce2" No matter what happens outside, keep exercising at home using only a computer and a smartphone. Entertain your workout with interactive gameplay. Have fun and get fit with Fitforce.
Jeu d'horreur où vous devez effectuer différentes tâches à partir d'une créature d'horreur reçue par votre téléphone. Et souvenez-vous: ne discutez pas avec MOMO!

Sarah’s an aspiring actress and finally got her big break! Productions come with their challenges and romances, but Sarah never thought her big break would bring a ghost! Will this supernatural hiccup ruin everything Sarah's worked for? Help her solve the mysteries, and she may also find love!

Drive, Explore, Operate and Create the railroad of your dreams - and now you can collaborate in real time with Multiplayer Surveyor! TRS22 showcases a range of high quality routes, sessions and trains to drive, plus all the scenery you need to make your own masterpiece.
Shiness est un jeu de rôle/action développé par le studio indépendant Enigami, qui vous fera voyager dans un univers envoûtant, mais voué à sa perte suite à la fragmentation de la planète Mahera...

With a style inspired by Earthbound and Final Fantasy 3, The Princess' Heart features up to 15 hours of epic fantasy gameplay. Follow Princess Aerin on a quest to defeat her demons, both literal and metaphorical, in this light-hearted tale of hope and love.

I Am Jesus Christ: PROLOGUE is a stand-alone game and the introduction to the full version of I Am Jesus Christ. Walk in the footsteps of Jesus in this incredible first-person retelling of the story of Christ from birth to resurrection. Become the Messiah in ‘I Am Jesus Christ.

Boyle Wolfbane wanted to rule the world. He failed. Miserably. Forced into retirement early, Boyle now spends his days arguing with haunted trees and scaring off the occasional knight. At least he still has Fang, his loyal storm wolf. Things could be worse. He could have been born a hero.

After a botched face lift, a movie star confines herself to her penthouse apartment where she learns that her fans’ obsession may have turned fatal. Is her apartment really the safest place to be? Follow the clues and try to stay sane when it seems like the entire world has turned against you.
这是一款模拟了真实办公室白领的日常工作环境，又逐渐从现实环境慢慢走向奇幻的一个有趣故事。

Crush body parts together in this gory soft physics puzzle game. Create disgusting combos as your smash together like body parts keeping your bloody abattoir from overflowing as you chase ever higher scores.

This is a horror game adapted from the Chinese folklore. Players need to decrypt and collect key items in different stages. Ultimately find a way to escape the foggy forest. While searching for an exit, players will be disturbed by ghosts, players need to avoid the ghosts and evade their attacks.

Welcome to Gocco Studio Japan, a futuristic playground where kids come together to play make-believe war — a tradition started almost a hundred years ago. Up to 32 people can join a lobby, and up to 8 players can join up to take on quests.

The legendary iBomber series returns but this time it’s time to ATTACK! Jump into your tank and get ready to blast your way around Europe and defeat the enemy in this visceral tour of destruction! With 24 missions full of explosive action to go at, iBomber Attack is a dose of high-octane entertainment that you won’t be able to put down.

Bloomtown: A Different Story est un JRPG narratif mêlant combat au tour par tour, dressage de monstre et RPG social, sur fond d'ambiance des États-Unis des années 60. Suivez Emily et ses amis, et aidez-les à sauver leur ville des créatures démoniaques qui se cachent dans le cœur des habitants.

titre: Voice of Cards: The Forsaken Maiden
description: Deuxième volet de l'exceptionnelle série Voice of Cards, où chaque élément est représenté sous forme de cartes, à la manière des jeux de rôle papier et des livres de jeu.

titre: Victoria Clair and the Mystery Express
description: A girl and her cat solve a Jazz-Age murder mystery by doing everyone's math homework for them.
An anime-inspired supernatural detective game. Uncover the identities and powers of your adversaries using a conspiracy board full of evidence.

titre: Movavi Video Editor Plus 2020 - Video Editing Software
description: Laissez parler votre créativité avec Movavi Video Editor Plus 2020 ! Ses commandes intuitives vous permettent de manipuler des clips, d'ajouter effets spéciaux et titres, puis de mettre les résultats sur YouTube depuis le programme. Le montage vidéo avec Movavi est rapide, simple et amusant.

The much anticipated sequel to the #1 casual game of 2005, LUXOR 2 HD has been re-imagined and sets the new standard for action-puzzlers with dazzling new HD graphics & effects.Luxor 2 HD still offers the addictive and easy-to-learn, yet difficult to master game play which made the award-winning Luxor franchise such a smash hit,...

Sail above the clouds and explore a shattered world in the search for a special key. Navigate your ship through the sky and discover unexpected creatures and locations in this relaxing VR adventure game.
Take on the job of a line worker removing troublesome trees! Get out your chainsaw and use your control levers to maneuver the utility bucket in all directions, but watch your head!
Upon finding a mysterious social media account, Alex sets out to find the origins of the photos and meets three urban explorers, each of them unearthing something new and unfamiliar in her heart.

An extremely quick to use dungeon tile-based mapping tool to build battle maps for “Screen In Table” and "Print" (or Online) based play! Fully orthographic so you can play as if your Miniatures are in the map.

Guilty est un jeu d'horreur psychologique à la première personne. Incarnez Peter et accédez à votre inconscient pour vous rappeler des souvenirs plus terrifiants qui sont cachés. Un passé traumatisant qui vous donne un sentiment de culpabilité....

titre: Umineko When They Cry - Question Arcs
description: Umineko When They Cry is the 2nd series of Sound Novel released by 07th Expansion. The steam version features renewed character sprites which is swappable from the classic art.
Choose your barbarian character to hack and slash many beasts. Swords and magic will fight alongside you against the beasts to free the kingdom.

Entretenez la flamme de l'espoir au cours de votre aventure vers la mythique Étoile éternelle ! Rassemblez les survivants de votre planète, réparez et améliorez votre vaisseau, affrontez les trous noirs, repoussez des attaques, et gérez au quotidien un équipage haut en couleur !
An asteroid is hurtling toward the planet! Sneak, scavenge and blast your way through an immersive prehistoric world filled with Humans, Dinosaurs, Droids and Mother Nature’s fury!

titre: Detective March Forward - The Missing Will
description: Milly’s deceased grandfather, Mr. Peter, has left behind a will that has gone missing. It’s up to aspiring detective March Forward to solve the puzzles and unravel the truth in this handcrafted point-and-click adventure game. Are you ready to solve this case?

“Noosphere” est un jeu d’horreur psychologique en première personne avec des énigmes, ayant pour thème les personnalités multiples. Vincent a survécu à un accident de voiture, mais s’aperçoit qu’une autre entité vit en lui.

titre: Dr. Professor Scientist's Weapons Testing Facility
description: DPSWTF is a base defense game with roguelike elements, where instead of placing towers, you build the best tower of them all. Combine the best projectiles with effective modifiers and push back the incoming hordes. Research them all to conquer the secrets of the Great North!

titre: Hidden Object Secrets: Le Meurtre à Whitefield Édition Collector
description: Mets-toi dans la peau d'un détective chargé de résoudre le meurtre énigmatique d'un homme dont le passé est enveloppé de mystère ! Peux-tu résoudre un autre cas compliqué ?
A horror survival-based shooter game. Protect your self from the demons coming at you from all directions. Use the sound to your advantage and guns to take them down.
Neocube is the puzzle game in which you try to find a way to pass a number of test chambers by using the unique features of a cube.
Uncover the lies. Free your mind. Veritas is a compact narrative puzzle game that asks: what is truth, and does it even matter?

Beyond Galaxyland est un RPG passionnant combinant exploration cosmique, combats stratégiques au tour par tour et combats de boss épiques dans un vaste système solaire. Rejoignez Doug et son cochon d'Inde armé dans une quête exaltante pour sauver la Terre.
“城堡传说：魔王觉醒”是一款好玩的复古单机RPG，拥有丰富完整的原创剧情。采用双主线的特殊叙述手法，讲述了千年宿命轮回之下，起源魔王灵魂转世体梵侬，在于天才魔法少女梅玖利.萝莉的意外相遇之后，一起唤醒了沉睡千年的魔王守护者.雪风；从而开启了一段传奇而又感人的故事。

20 years after the birth of the legendary horror game "AOONI"... A completely new first-person, 3D horror stealth action "Absolute Fear -AOONI-" is now available! Players take on the role of a younger sister searching for her older sister in a mysterious mansion where AOONI roam.

titre: 弹幕音乐绘 ～风雷幻奏曲～ / Barrage Musical  ~A Fantasy of Tempest~
description: This is a music rhythm STG where stages with highly BGM synchronization will show you a barrage musical; 　　A shop system with dozens of items available offers you infinite possibility; 　　An AI based auto dodging system benefits beginners.
Help Robinson Crusoe survive!
Now Free To Play. Pick a car, invite your friends and enter the fray. Remember the classic car combat game style like Twisted Metal, Vigilante 8 and Pickup Express playing Deliverace.

Anyone can be President, so why not you? Become President of the United States in this text-based political satire strategy game, then push your morals and values upon hundreds of millions of people. Will you be a benevolent leader or a ruthless dictator?

L'affaire de "l'éléphant volé". L'éléphant... rare, à rayures. ... longtemps détenu par le négociant étranger Carbophos. Ne supportant plus coups et vexations, il s'est enfui. Un an plus tard, il a trouvé refuge au zoo de notre ville. C'est la marque de Carbophos. Vite ! Allons au zoo !
The DOS classic now available on Steam. Fight the most famous battle in history from a whole new perspective!

Yore VR is an open world sandbox game built from the ground up in VR for the HTC Vive. Venture out with nothing but the clothes on your back and empty hands to live Yore medieval life the way you want.

ShapeHero Factory est un jeu mêlant la simulation d’usine, le rogue-lite et la défense de tour. Utilisez différentes combinaisons de forme pour produire en masse divers héros, qui pourront ensuite combattre seuls. Vous n’avez qu’à vous soucier de construire l’usine parfaite pour les fabriquer.

The Dweller is a puzzle game where you play as the MONSTER! It's time to get rid of all those pesky archaeologists snooping around in your lair. SCARE them, CRUSH them, DEVOUR them! ELIMINATE THE INTRUDERS!

Eschaton est un court jeu d'exploration à la première personne, expérimental et surréaliste. Explorez les « conséquences » d'un rituel sectaire sur le domaine d'un manoir dans les Highlands écossais, reculés et pittoresques.

titre: Detective Boiled-Hard / Case File - Death of the Space Dino Hunter
description: A dialogue focused comedy point and click adventure game
Defeat the mage Kalinur and bring peace back to the kingdom in this mini metroidvania with a lot of action.

Prenez le contrôle de cinq tonnes de métal et de puissance, et foncez jusqu’à la ligne d’arrivée !Conduisez des camions entièrement destructibles en Championnat, Contre-la-montre; Elimination et Course simple. Débarrassez-vous des concurrents qui se mettent en travers de votre route et imposez-vous sur l'asphalte !
Ironbound is a turn-based multiplayer strategy game with fast-paced duels and deep meta-game. Upgrade your character and equipment and climb to the top of the multiplayer ladder!
Save the world as a Balloon(!?) in this story driven horror/stealth puzzle game!
Préparez-vous pour un voyage déroutant dans la mémoire Forgotten Hill. Arriverez-vous à survivre?

Street Karate 3 est un jeu passionnant du genre "combat contre des adversaires", où vous affrontez de nombreux ennemis lors de combats inégaux. Maîtrisez des armes improvisées, utilisez judicieusement des coups puissants et effectuez des projections et des sauts pour relever les défis.
9-nine-: Episode 3 is the latest chapter in this series of supernatural mystery visual novels with the focus now shifted towards a new heroine, Haruka Kosaka.
Battle creatures, collect loot, master magic, and build your very own Wizard Tower sanctuary in this rogue-like, dungeon-crawling RPG.
A hand drawn style obstacle avoidance game. How to deal with rainy days if don't like it?

titre: Sacra Terra: Kiss of Death Collector’s Edition
description: Plongez dans une histoire d'amour intense que le Mal ne peut ébranler.

Mimik is a local multiplayer game in which players hide, seek and tag each other. One player is "it", the rest attempt to hide hide in a crowd of NPCs. During matches every puck is visible, the only way to hide is to mimic NPC behavior. There is nowhere to hide except in plain sight.

“Just who are you…?” Uncover the truth behind K-pop idol Sena as you search through her social media accounts in Pricolage -IDOLIZED-. In order to locate K-pop idol Sena, pronounced missing, you must search for clues in the ocean of darkness and greed that is the internet.

Funanigans has 8 different party games for 2+ players! Create a room, and everyone can join and play from a web browser - on a phone, tablet, computer, etc. Features 4 drawing games, drawing on a shared canvas, 3 team-based games, word games, no max player limits, and hours of fun!
Life is short. Time is precious. Can you discover and solve the mysterious sequence of puzzles that will save the world before you are... eighty-sixed?

In 1939 Grand Emperor Hil’Tar a high elf who has set his sights for Poland which would spark the start of the Second World war. Hundreds of miles away across the ocean, you a young American working out of his parent's farm, learns of the fatal news that war in the Kingdom of Europe has broken out.
Use your Lite tool to build and explore a Sonic Light landscape.
Dirigez un camp de survivants dans un monde apocalyptique de zombis où le but ultime est de trouver un traitement curatif et évacuez les survivants!
Born into a punishing environment with no bearings, there is nowhere to go but up.

Lord Pain has risen once more to threaten the land of the living. As the last of an elite race known only as the Bowmen, you must gather your courage and slay his armies once again. Fight off hordes of enemies, equip unique items, and see how long you can survive in our debut title: Bowmen!

Omegalodon is a third-person multiplayer action game where players compete by attacking/defending the city. The Red Team is comprised of police and soldiers armed with an array of military vehicles and explosive weaponry. The Green Team is comprised of Omegalodon, a 100-foot shark monster, and the Enviros, equipped with a healing beam.

RoboBlitz™ est un jeu empreint d'humour et de modèles physiques où trucs, armes, personnages et décors innovants sont légion. Les joueurs incarnent Blitz, un robot aux multiples talents qui doit réactiver un vieux canon spatial pour sauver son monde d'une bande de pirates de l'espace mal intentionnés.

Fraie-toi un chemin à travers les pages d'une bande dessinée qui change constamment dans ce roguelike effréné. Joue en solo, en coop en local ou en ligne, agrandis ton arsenal et améliore ton personnage à chaque tentative. Et ce pour découvrir pourquoi ton créateur a perdu foi en toi.

The Moment of Silence est un jeu d'aventure classique en pointer-et-cliquer à la 3e personne se déroulant à New York en 2044. Les joueurs incarnent Peter Wright, un cadre publicitaire qui dirige actuellement la campagne gouvernementale sur la "Liberté d'expression".

Mater is holding a national race festival allowing racers from all around the world to challenge Lightning McQueen. Along with racing against the new characters, players can explore the world of Radiator Springs and Lightning McQueen's racing headquarters.

Dirigez un escadron de méchas d'élite dans une version alternative de la Seconde Guerre mondiale pour affronter l'Axe et libérer l'Europe. Améliorez vos méchas et pilotes, développez des stratégies et neutralisez le QG ennemi dans ce roguelite tactique en temps réel!
Chaque course est différente dans Ignite. Chaque course apporte quelque chose de nouveau que les joueurs essayent de remporter en utilisant leurs propres tactiques.
一款有人味的情感养成类游戏，教会你如何带给父母健康、快乐的晚年，也希望你的孩子学会如何关爱慢慢老去的你~ 毕竟，我们终将老去，我们终将成为步履蹒跚的他们，她们…很多事情就像时间~去了，就不再回来~
"GOODBYE WORLD" is a narrative adventure game. Play through 12 stages of a puzzle platformer while following the two protagonists through 13 chapters of their story.

A first-person horror game Incoming Evil, you will explore an unsolved event about 3 missing people. Nobody knows what happened to them, the police could not solve the case. You are an experienced detective; the case handed over to you.
Si vous voulez rendre à votre race la gloire qui lui revient, vous devez résoudre le mystère de sa destruction.
UnderParty is an Action Platformer game. This game is made up of a very high level of difficulty. It's very violent, so be careful.

S2 ENGINE HD is a complete general-purpose software kit for developing and running videogames, specifically dedicated to PC game hobbyists and enthusiasts. Its simplicity lets them turn on their computers and create amazing visuals in minutes just as if they were professionals.

Utilize just a grappling hook and wall jumping to adventure through a near-to-impossible parkour maze. With no checkpoints and lava floor, your every move counts because once you touch the lava, you restart at the beginning. Challenge yourself by making the game even worse with hardcore controls.
这是一款让你尽享「齐(七)人之福」的男性向恋爱互动影游。在这里你将与七位美女同住、同乐、同风雨，在这里爱与梦想绕梁不绝。

Bunhouse is a cute, simple, bunny-filled game focused on growing plants and managing a greenhouse with fellow buns. Take care of your leafy plant buddies by balancing the amount of water and light they get. Play with friends and upgrade your greenhouse for wholesome, relaxing fun.

Eternal Edge + is a casual Action-Adventure role-playing game following Cross, an Age-old warrior who is trying to wake his lost Wife from an Eternal slumber. Only together can they defeat the Skeleton King.
Pepe Porcupine works the nightshift in a warehouse and needs your help! Each night his job is to move crates into position in a confined area with the least amount of work.

A simple game of touch, pleasure and joy.Luxuria Superbia is a colorful, musical journey made to fill you with joy. Exciting designs explode from your touch as you glide through playful stylized flowers. It’s all about the experience and the interaction.There’s twelve flower-like tunnels and a garden with a temple.

Poöf has been tricked by accepting a golden laying kitten. But the precious kitty makes all the greedy monsters envious. Survive waves of monsters trying to steal your revenue!Poöf vs the cursed kitty is a mix between tower defense, and platforming action, a game focused on hardcore gameplay, tight controls and choices, inspired by games...

circloO is a colorful physics platformer in a round level. The level grows, so you'll have to avoid and use obstacles in everchanging ways. Enjoy a huge variety of physics challenges, from a sea of tiny blocks to planets with a gravity field! Make your own levels or play thousands of fanmade levels!
World of Valentardia will not let you get bored for a second! Adventures will require the hero to be not only determined but also to be faithfully accepted.
Survive, explore and discover the secrets of the woods. But be careful, there's something else in these woods...

Detective Reiji Tokisaka is back to face down a mystery that spans decades, if not centuries. With the aftermath of his last case weighing on his soul and a long-silent cult resurgent, can he solve the crime—or will it become his curse?
Hurricane is a 3rd person multiplayer survival game in open fantasy world.
A strong Chinese characteristics of the poker game
studio: Shanghai YiJun Network Info Technologies Inc.

titre: Princess Maker 3: Fairy Tales Come True
description: Princess Maker 3: Fairy Tales Come True to Steam on end of June 2017. This new release contains the original concept and feel to its series, but also had been upgraded to be compatible on Window 7 and above OS, and optimized to fit 16:9 aspect ratio. In addition to system upgrade, the game utilizes the Steam achievement system.

Escape the confinement of the space station and restart the systems to gain freedom. Cooperative Escape Room style game to challenge yourself and your friends. Seven rooms to solve the amazing and challenging mysteries before the timer runs out!

There are 9 chapters in this game Players will play the most capable agent "Eva" to face a huge number of undead and powerful cyborg warriors. The operation of this game is very simple, with gorgeous movie-like visual effects, allowing players to experience shocking sensory stimulation.
Chronon is a puzzle game in the first person.
Plongez dans le jeu de tir arcade en VR (shmup, shoot'em up, bullet hell). Beaucoup d'action vous attend. "Insert Coin" et sautez dans le shmup !

titre: 12 Labours of Hercules IV: Mother Nature (Platinum Edition)
description: Le légendaire héros Hercule et sa femme Mégare sont de retour, prêts à se lancer dans leur prochaine aventure ! Les dieux sont furieux de leur défaite et ont invoqué une redoutable créature capable d’égaler la force divine d’Hercule.

titre: iO Inner Self - The Lava Planet VR
description: Help iO defend the dangerous Lava Planet in this first-person VR shooter as hordes of enemies are unleashed in increasingly difficult waves! Use your gun and shield to get to the end and then beat your high score!

Bâtiment de ville casual. Devenez architecte. Managez le petit polis. Batissez de belles zones de la ville avec beaucoup de blocs modernes. Faites votre chemin vers le haut à travers le mode campagne detaillé, ou créez vos propres scénarios.

Aim Expert is a skill based aiming simulator providing arcade style levels and standard aim training modes. Challenge yourself in all aspects of aiming and climb the leaderboards to showcase your skills.
It's a game where you play as a bear and explore stuff.
Choose your giant monster! Destroy cities around the world! Rule the Earth in this light action-strategy game that harkens back to the classic PC monster city-stomping games of yesteryear!

Follow Luna's adventure through different worlds when she accidentally ends up chasing the mysterious pink-haired wizard named Aslan through a magical portal! Love Spell: Aslan's Route is the first content expansion game for our studio's debut title, Love Spell: Written In The Stars.
Do you know de way - the goal of the game is to carefully bring the Queen to the door through the thorny maze
A wave based FPS where you defend a barricaded house against increasing hordes of the dead.
Crafting Block World is an adventure with sandbox elements that will help you build your ideal world!

Command you and your army to change the course of the world. Fight massive armies while keeping your army thriving, raiding massive strongholds to further your goals. Choose who you ally and what your choices are carefully in this Mecha SRPG.

Plongez dans un monde d'élites débauchées et de policiers corrompus, un monde où le pouvoir peut tout acheter. Ce jeu est une passionnante introduction à notre nouvelle série HOPA, dans la tradition des meilleurs drames policiers.

BlastZone 2 est un jeu de tir rapide à défilement latéral très captivant ! Jouez en solo ou rejoignez un ami en local ou en ligne pour affronter vos ennemis ! De nombreux modes de jeu, types de vaisseaux et niveaux de difficulté sont disponibles : trouvez votre combinaison idéale !
YAR - Offre un jeu de rôle avec une histoire captivante dans un cadre slave.

An RTS classic updated in 2026 for modern systems. Welcome to Hell, soldier, and mind the radioactive dust. Join one of two groups battling tooth, claw, tentacle, and any other appendage for survival in this post-nuclear real-time strategy game.
FALL OF PORCUPINE est une aventure narrative unique : un choc entre la vie professionnelle et la vie quotidienne, et une réflexion sur notre système de santé déséquilibré.

Raise and train a troupe of cuddly virtual life creatures that live on a Space Station. Because they have neural network brains, Norns can be taught right from wrong, but because they also have their own, individual personalities, they may not always do what you want.
Spiral Splatter est un mélange de jeu d'arcade et de puzzle qui va vous permettre de tester vos réflexes, votre réactivité et votre précision grâce des niveaux de plus en plus diffciles!
A cozy mining platformer game. Dig deep into the earth in search of riches. Create your mine, improve your equipment, but don't get too greedy.
어느 날 한 연구실에서 눈을 뜬 주인공 "하연". 하연은 아무도 없는 낯선 곳에서 눈을 뜬다. 계속 사람을 찾아보지만 아무도 없었고 그러다 로봇을 만나게 된다. 로봇이 말하길 세상이 멸망하여 내가 마지막 생존자라 말한다. 또한 하연이 세상을 되돌릴 열쇠라는 사실을 전하는데...
Venture into the unforgiving caverns under the mountain on an impossible quest in this high-fantasy split screen roleplaying game.

Shot in the Dark is a multiplayer arena FPS that takes place in a dystopian future where multiple factions have sent their agents to kill for sensitive government information. You take control of one of these agents in an attempt to survive this low-light arena skirmish... in the dark.
"A shotgun wedding?! Will the brides make it down the aisle?!"
A slider puzzle is the one where the aim is to sort the given pieces
A fun minimalist RTS - build and defend your Viking Village from enemies like Knights, Pirates and Barbarians. Attack enemy villages on randomly generated islands. Play 1v1 multiplayer!
Tank Warz! is an arcade shooter that will keep you entertained with fast paced tank destruction, power-ups, traps, secrets, and an energetic rock soundtrack. You'll enjoy hours of arcade fun!

Armored Angels est un jeu de stratégie au tour par tour dans lequel les joueurs luttent contre des machines intelligentes, des entreprises compétitives et le temps. Faites face à l'invention de technologies et à la construction d'immenses unités qui vous permettent de contrer l'ampleur de la menace.

The second chapter in The Test trilogy. Answer a series of in-depth questions to reveal hidden truths about yourself and unlock secrets to discover how your life can change drastically with just a few, slight modifications. ...But are you sure you want the answers you seek?
Traum is a short, story-driven adventure about a man with a dream. Can even the best of plans be shattered by unexpected news?

Le crime paie ! Joue et regarde la ville du crime prendre vie sous tes yeux ! Doodle Mafia est le plus gros jeu "Doodle" qui soit ! Dans la peau d'un parrain du crime ou d'un flic, tu auras plus de 500 casse-tête à résoudre et d'objets à créer.

Retrouvez le plaisir intense des jeux de stratégie en temps réel. Crush Your Enemies renoue avec tout ce qui a pu vous vous donner autant de plaisir : planification, choix d’unités, gestion des ressources, occupation de territoires ennemis, manœuvres tactiques sur le champ de bataille.
Les plus belles peintures des grands musées du monde en réalité virtuelle. 1000 peintures à admirer.
You control a ball that attracts all kinds of cubes but try only to collect the white cubes to finish the levels.

Why do conventions need to be conventional (pun intended) when you can jump on an island and feel the rays of the digital sun? IWOCon 2021 is a convention app from Indie World Order showcasing upcoming & current indie games. Sail away with us into the heart of indies.

English A-game is a comprehensive English course in the form of a video game. It is a fun English language game to teach you basic English up to upper intermediate level. Included are an in-game user guide and English grammar tutorial for self-study. Designed for Polish learners of English.

You play Skeet, master defragmenter, in this sit-and-chill isometric puzzler. Spin, move, and swap pieces as you restore sectors, each of increasing complexity and variation. Collect cores along the way to improve your functionality, and meet the AIs, who may or may not be benevolent.

titre: El Hijo - A Wild West Tale
description: "El Hijo - A Wild West Tale" est un passionnant jeu de western-spaghetti, dans lequel vous guidez un garçon de 6 ans dans sa quête pour retrouver sa mère.

FLASHOUT 2, la suite tant attendue du jeu de course anti-gravité FLASHOUT 3D est enfin disponible ! Montez à bord d'un de nos bolides ultra-rapides, utilisez tout l'arsenal de missiles, mitraillettes, bonus et améliorations pour décrocher la victoire !

titre: Hello Emoji: Drawing to Solve Puzzles
description: “Hello Emoji: Drawing to Solve Puzzles” is an exciting mini game which will give you a smooth drawing experience.Draw a simple line to make the different balls scroll towards their own destinations. Levels with different difficulty challenge your logically and imagination.
A narrative adventure game about being trapped at home during the COVID-19 pandemic. For fans of To the Moon, Gone Home, and Night in the Woods.
In a region on the brink of endless war, tradition chose the weapon you wield. Your sworn allegiance compels you to fight. Honor your father’s legacy. Become a true Champion of Canaan.

The new generation of table pets in the AI era provides users with a comprehensive AI customized platform for creating table pets, including image, voice, character design, and even interactive methods, through AI technologies such as deep learning and language processing.

Heltons Haunted Hotel is a 2D Top Down Survival Horror game based on the story of a Haunted hotel, located in the Helton City, which has witnessed the various tragic incidents occurred during the early 2000s.
The Last Islands of Man is a retro rpg that forces you to manage your time. The sea waters are rising. Can you save yourself? Can you save your family?

titre: Command: Modern Air / Naval Operations WOTY
description: Command: Modern Air/Naval Operations is the ultimate military simulator for modern military conflicts. Designed with a huge emphasis on detail, realism, accuracy and flexibility, Command allows you to simulate and direct any historical or hypothetical air or naval engagement from 1945, at any scale, including strategic nuclear war.

Teuta assiste à la mort d’un avocat véreux nommé Limbo et décide de remonter dans le temps pour tenter de le sauver... Mêlant dangereuse romance et meurtres, BUSTAFELLOWS vous embarque dans une aventure torride qui vous fera frissonner de plaisir!
In this old-school RPG, you play as Callum and Lucia, the Trial Ones, as they find their way to be together in an epic battle that will change their and everyone else's lives.

Plunge into VR on a capsizing research ship, the Triton, where survival means outmaneuvering the water's lethal surge. Freedive through a sinking ship, overcome underwater chaos, and unlock your path to the surface, all while protecting your most precious resource: the breath in your lungs.
Immerse yourself in the Psychological horror adventure of James Charouz on his way to find his missing wife and uncover the dark secret of his hometown.
Pipe connect is a game based on an old puzzle where the player must arrange small blocks with numbers on a small board.
My Light In The Dark is a short story about a girl who lives with her abusive mother. The girl finds out some dark secrets about her mother, and she has to find a way to escape the house.

Galidon is a vampire kingdom. You’re a lawful heir. The power struggle and an intriguing plot are in place. 21 levels contain quests and crafting. The gameplay is rapid, bloodthirsty and intransigent and doesn't forgive a single mistake. Devoid of Shadows is a heat in the chill dungeons of the Labyrinth!

A tiny, naked cosmonaut with a jetpack & laser blaster must revive a dying galaxy by planting one seed at a time. An innovative and addictive arcade adventure experience with mystery and intrigue in all the right places.

titre: Realms of Arkania 3 - Shadows over Riva Classic
description: Shadows over Riva (1997) is the third part of the glorious Realms of Arkania Trilogy...Something sinister lurks in the seaside town of Riva. An evil force has subverted the city's leaders, and evil things lurk in the town's sewers. Explore the huge city, dungeons and even underwater regions in stunningly detailed 3D.

Out of the Park Baseball 25 marks a milestone - 25 years of sports gaming excellence! Officially licensed by MLB, the MLB Players Inc. and KBO, this year's Anniversary Edition puts you in charge of your favorite baseball franchise. Your team, your legacy, your dynasty. Play what the pros play!

IRON CRYPTICLE is an arcade twin-stick dungeon shooter with RPG elements for 1 to 4 players LOCAL CO-OP! A mysterious, malevolent force has abducted Cryptonia’s princess – along with the king’s royal golden treasures (shaped curiously like large foodstuffs...). Kingsguard to the rescue!

titre: Darkness and Flame: Missing Memories Collector's Edition
description: "Darkness and Flame: Souvenirs Perdus" - Un jeu d'aventure passionnant rempli de quêtes, d'objets cachés, de mini-jeux et de puzzles !

Découvrez un jeu de casse-briques 100 % action mélangeant arcade et heroic fantasy ! Avec des personnages adorables, des attaques magiques puissantes, des boss redoutables et un mode coop local pour 2 joueurs !

Horror game series about the investigation of missing hikers in the U.S. National Parks. Follow the story of a wannabe reporter who got a job as a ranger to investigate the disappearances - several episodes that tell one story! Based on true events.

Zueirama is a fun action adventure game packed with references to memes. Inspired by the games of the 90s, with cartoon characters that reflect the essence and Brazilian swinging like you have never seen.
A wave-based zombie survival game

Jet Set Knights is an old-school arcade action platformer inspired by classics from the golden age such as Mario Bros, Snow Bros or newest Super Crate Box. If You love retro 2D platformers mixed with tower defense and RPG elements, Jet Set Knight is for You!
Cowboy's Adventure - is a Western Deathrun, with three levels of difficulty for your choice!

Untangle the story of the family that has occupied Cliffhouse for so many years. Search for clues, solve puzzles, talk to guests, get summoned to a chapel, discover a luscious Japanese garden and find your way through the rainforest. There is so much to discover about the family, the land and the lore.

DEAD IN BERMUDA est un jeu de gestion de survie avec des éléments d'aventure et de RPG. Gérez une équipe de 8 survivants d'un accident d'avion. Assignez-les à des tâches, gagnez de l'expérience, développez vos compétences de survie et explorez l'île mystérieuse.
Discover the Dark Secrets of Regotown

VRC Pro takes you deep into the world of cutting edge, modern RC cars. You can race up to 15 different RC cars on real existing mini race tracks all around the world; all fully customizable & tunable.

Slay the hordes and survive the night! Journey through a wild and untamed world filled with dangerously relentless foes. In this bullet heaven inspired by Vampire Survivors, you'll use a wide range of melee and ranged weapons to stay safe while you duck and dodge through massive waves of enemies.
Bastard Bonds is a mature, fast-paced tactical RPG with high-end pixel art and in-depth character customization.

Haku has sacrificed a lot to inherit a mask. With his natural wiles and the reputation of his departed friend, he strikes out on the path to a new future. The curtains rise on an era of strife that will shake Yamato to its very foundations.

Divine Miracle Defense is an tower defense game with an magic theme and few roguelike which make it very unique. You have to build an defense line with mages and upgrade them to stay alive as long as possible. when you die, you get a few special points depending on how long you survived.

titre: Adventure of Rikka - The Cursed Kingdom
description: Adventure of Rikka est un RPG d'action en 2D basé sur les énigmes, l'exploration et les mystères cachés. Vous devez vaincre les forces obscures qui ont maudit les terres, combattre les ennemis avec votre épée et un arsenal d'objets tels que l'arc ou la baguette de feu pour sauver le royaume!
You've drunk too much... Let's go home while being aware of the dangerous around you! Drunken movements are fully simulated with physical calculation. Enjoy your drunkenness :)

La Quimera is a story-driven FPS set in dystopian future Latin America. In a fractured world where microstates rely on mercenary forces, you are an operative caught in a web of lies and deception. Play alone or with up to two friends geared with futuristic weapons, exoskeletons and combat abilities.

This is a horror plot puzzle game with Chinese folk themes. There is an unwritten rule in Tianhe Town: on the day of the Winter Clothing Festival, no villager is allowed to approach the back mountain. Is there really a ghost on the mountain? Perhaps there is something more terrifying than ghosts.

You should consume a good balance of protein, carbohydrates, and fats to survive. The nutritional balance changes depending on the ingredients you put in your takoyaki. If you are overloaded with calories, you will be too full to eat, so please consume calories by squatting.
SANTICIDE is the sixth volume of the arcade series UBERMOSH. A must buy for arcade and top-down enthusiasts.
Someone is killing half-bloods (half-elves, half-humans) in a small city. The protagonist, a young half-blood girl called Mia Silverlight, falls into a whirlpool of events.

Lawgivers est un jeu de simulation politique au tour par tour. Présentez-vous aux élections avec votre parti et entrez au Parlement pour approuver ou abolir les lois. Nommez le président et décidez si vous voulez voir une démocratie vraie ou apparente.

Yon Paradox ​is a survival puzzle game where the hardest puzzle is yourself. Set in a cyber dimension, an antimatter-powered time machine broke, causing periodical time rewinds. You will have to solve riddles to repair the time machine, while avoiding your past alter-egos to not create paradoxes.

SuperSecret is a Tiny Adventure made just for You. A very special Secret is hidden on the strange islands of Prisoner’s Keys. It is yours to find, but first you must find it. Run, ride, and puzzle your way to discovery.

Bienvenue à la journée de formation sur Mars! En tant qu'ingénieur - vous êtes responsable de la réparation et de l'entretien des Mars Rovers. Dans ce simulateur avancé, vous apprendrez les détails internes de divers Mars Rovers et de leurs composants.

Guarding the graveyard shift is often considered one of the most terrifying jobs globally, but night guarding at Whispering Winds Cemetery surpasses any other cemetery in horror! Being Night Security in this place will turn into a nightmare for you that you may never forget.

Touge Shakai (Mountain Pass Society) is an online Touge Racing Game based on Japanese car culture in the 90s. With an emphasis on balance between realism and fun gameplay, the physics are tailored for competitive drift racing, while giving a challenge to all players.

Pixel Dungeon is an exciting and extremely popular roguelike (more than 2 million mobile installs!). Explore the depths of Pixel Dungeon, collect useful items and fight fierce monsters to find the Amulet of Yendor - the ultimate artefact of this game world!

Keep your stores afloat against unique threats like royal laws, wars and crazy fantasy events. Discover new items, craft, sell them, and create your Merchant Empire in the kingdom! - All in a hybrid 2D-3D style.
The player controls a platform that can be moved from one wall to another by placing it under the ball, preventing it from falling.

Si vous avez toujours rêvé d'être un roi du tennis de table, que chaque renvoi de balles soit une réussite, alors bienvenue dans King Pong ! Tant que vous ne ratez pas la balle, le point est en jeu. Mais attention aux frappes spéciales qui pourront vous déstabiliser !

Beasts of Maravilla Island est un jeu d’aventure en 3D où vous incarnez une jeune photographe animalière qui parcoure les écosystèmes magiques de l’île de Maravilla pour découvrir des créatures extraordinaires, apprendre leurs comportements et, avant tout, les immortaliser en photo.
TimeShifters is an old school first person shooter inspired by games like TimeSplitters and GoldenEye.
Raatihuone is a virtual reality experience where you travel through the history of Kajaani city hall and solve interesting puzzles.

Every day is a wonderful day for invertebrates! Come join the Squidlits of Blipston for a squishy adventure of spoopy castles, muffins, and wiggles! Made with classic handheld technology in mind, Squidlit strives to be the closest modern recreation of GameBoy game-design methods on the market.
