Jumping Master is a innovative casual competitive game fully merged with classic gameplay of mushroom game. It aims to help us revisit the classic mushroom game in our chlidhood.

titre: The Tale of Doris and the Dragon - Episode 2
description: Sequel to the breakout Newgrounds title and Winner of the Pocket Gamer Bronze award, the adventure continues in The Tale of Doris and the Dragon - Episode 2. In this episode, Doris continues on her quest to find her missing husband Albert.

titre: Adventure Time: Magic Man's Head Games
description: Découvre Adventure Time comme tu ne l'as jamais vu dans ce nouveau jeu de réalité virtuelle incroyable, Les intrigues du Magicien.

Broventure = Vampire Survivors + Construction de Base + Coop. Rassemblez-vous avec des amis et anéantissez des hordes d'ennemis redoutables, collectez des ressources essentielles et transformez votre camp en un sanctuaire de libération.

My Lovely Daughter is an alchemist simulator that explores the depth of a father’s grief and how far he will go to resurrect his daughter. Contains dark and disturbing subject matters, might not be suitable for children or those who are easily disturbed.

As a rookie musher, foster a dogsledding team whose skills will grow if they're treated right. Week by week, get to know your dogs' unique traits, and carve your story into the trails of the Mount St. Something region.
A first-person action game featuring an epic battle between survivors and hordes of mutants.

La nouvelle référence développée par des vétérans de la simulation de tennis : incarnez 30 joueurs pros, maîtrisez tous les coups, dominez chaque surface et vivez un mode carrière réaliste. Définissez votre style de jeu et perfectionnez vos tactiques pour devenir le n°1 du classement mondial !

Get ready to venture out as Warren, the ominous-looking warlock. Hurl your magic orb, invert gravity for yourself, and phase shift through walls. Fight your way to the leader of the invading horde in hopes of liberating your realm.

Circus Electrique est un JDR où l’histoire, la stratégie et la gestion d’un cirque fusionnent pour former un jeu poignant– le tout dans un univers steampunk. Quand les Londoniens se transforment mystérieusement en tueurs sanguinaires, seuls les artistes habiles du cirque peuvent sauver la ville.

SIK - Space Invader Kreature is a multiplayer shooter, a frantic experience of eliminating the hordes of invaders. Rush through the Wayans, unlock paths, create a strategy with your online friends and defeat all the invader kreatures.

DoDodge is a game about dodging the music notes playing with Youtube video. Also, there is basic NCS songs for who that wants to try this game simple. Control is very simple, press left arrow or right arrow to dodge the notes. You can play all kinds of music with youtube play!
Spy Chameleon RGB Agent is a challenging arcade-puzzle game where the player needs to avoid being spotted thanks to the color-changing mechanisms of the main character.
You are Kin, a slumbering imp awakened by a less-than-stellar Arcanist who wants to fix the damaged world. Use new powers granted to you by new allies to recruit monsters and travel through time.

Conçu tout spécialement pour la RV, Cosmic Trip est un jeu de stratégie en temps réel pour HTC Vive et Oculus Rift. Il a été vainqueur des Proto Awards 2016 ! Commandez une armée de robots qui envoie du steak et combattez des ennemis extraterrestres sur de magnifiques planètes lointaines.

Join a roguelike battle immediately, where you need to recruit human warriors, activate bonds, purchase divine equipment, and form a powerful combat team. Facing waves of growing undead, elf, and orc teams, lead your warriors to charge happily and enjoy the fun of electronic cricket fighting!
Live Danmaku interactive game.

titre: 致命游戏-Lethal Gamble 1 Werewolf Puzzle
description: “Lethal Gamble 1 Werewolf Puzzle”is a suspense reasoning emotional work based on werewolf killing rules.A group of college students accidentally came to a mysterious villa. They wanted to play a game of werewolf killing.You have only five days left to refute the truth.

Psycho Reign is a Single or 2 player co-operative online horror puzzle and stealth game where in each level you will be chased by blood thirsty psychos. Look for and solve mini puzzles in order to progress further on the map. Ultimately, find something to fight back...or get chopped up.

We are trying to complete the tasks given to us with our robot. While completing our missions, we need to destroy many enemies and bosses. 3 different weapons we have and using different strategies, we can destroy the enemies.

Joue en tant que Jettomero, un robot géant, indéstructible et incroyablement maladroit qui est determinéà sauver la race humaine. Explorez un univers procedural en volant à travers l'espace en atterissant sur differentes planetes et en essayant de ne pas detruire tout ce qui se trouve sur votre chemin.
The love at first sight, came like a sunny summer day. Meet YUA and make your own sparkling moments.

titre: Space Captain McCallery - Episode 1: Crash Landing
description: Space Pirate Captain McCallery has Crash Landed on an alien planet! Explore a strange and hostile alien world in this Low-Poly 3D Action-Adventure game.

‘Tomorrow’ is a VR experience about how humans have evolved through language over time. It takes us on a mesmerizing journey from prehistoric caves and the Amazonian jungle to the top of the Himalayas. We finally approach ‘Tomorrow’, our next phase of evolution where VR is the new language.

The Broken Ceiling is a hand-drawn, 2D, top-down eldritch horror adventure where the player must use a fragile light, which constantly needs to be recharged, to hold back the darkness, explore alien caverns, and uncover why fate has summoned a little rabbit into a pit of incomprehensible beings.

Action-platformer with puzzles for the most hardcore gamers! Help the young wizard to save her loved one. Use your reaction, intelligence, and some gravity-changing magic to complete ten dungeons and fight the evil technomage.
The Madness of Little Emma is a difficult action platformer with roguelike elements. Featuring over 250 items with insane synergies, varied enemies, and numerous secrets and mysteries to discover.

Si vous criez, vous mourrez avec toute l'équipe. Vous devez quitter la zone de la forêt dangereuse avant la fin du temps imparti, en construisant un véhicule ou en appelant la police. Si le temps imparti s'écoule, toute l'équipe meurt. Le temps passe lorsque vous bougez.

Joins le tournoi galactique dans ce shooter frénétique et comique. Augmente le niveau de ton héros et débloque un arsenal d’armes. Détruis tes amis et ennemis dans parties multijoueur locales, en ligne et sur réseau LAN ou perfectionne tes habiletés dans des parties personnalisées et pour joueur unique.
C’est la saison Footy et il s’agit du Rugby League Live 3 !!!

Vivez le quotidien trépidant d'un agriculteur des temps modernes ! Contrôlez de nombreux véhicules, cultivez vos champs, prenez soin de vos animaux, et vendez votre production ! Grâce à des conditions météorologiques réalistes, ce jeu vous tiendra en haleine des heures durant !

Monster Showdown is an action packed VR shooter. Increase your chances of survival against an ever growing horde of monster by exploring your environment and strengthening yourself by picking up Perks, Ranged Weapons and Melee Weapons.
Splash is a third-person splash damage based action RPG where you play as an alchemist traveling the land, creating more potions.

Objective H.A.S.T.E. - is a first-person 3D survival game in the horror genre. Have you ever imagined that your school could be under attack by terrorists, so the only good thing would be that the lessons would be canceled? I bet you did. This game can allow you to visit such a situation.

Lead your LLC to its inevitable destruction in this day by day management sim. Harvest resources, make a profit, expand your Corp. But be careful; from the local fauna to the Syndicate, no one wants you to succeed.

Amatsuki Mahjong is a ACG style mahjong game that offers real-time multiplayer online matches. It features four styles of mahjong: Japanese, Sichuan, Taiwanese, and Hong Kong Mahjong. Enjoy a variety of play styles tailored to your preferences.

Hands of Necromancy is a Dark Fantasy FPS metroidvania, inspired by classics such as Heretic and made with the GZDoom engine. Wield weapons, magic or transform into a fearsome monster to slay your foes, then raise them as undead servants and unleash even more carnage to become a master Necromancer!

Nightmare Horror Story an adventure game from the first face in a horror genre provides you to take a trip in a huge and dark city full of dummies. You would have a possibility to figure out in a weird atmosphere when alive people are missed and everything that had remained is the dummies.
Grab a friend and try to escape from the dungeons of TRISTOY in this story-driven coop-platformer.

“The Forgotten Concluder” is a third person perspective 3D Role-playing game base on the ancient Chinese fantasy wu-xia world. Being a young teenager Shen Zi-Jun that grew in a isolated valley, taking on a adventure to discover a great secret and his true dentity.
A beat ‘em up adventure with paperboard style characters in which you can punch a lot and feel your adrenaline soar with so much action and rock and roll!
Meet a new minimalistic puzzle in which you have to hit the balls in the basket and complete the level.

Dans ce jeu de puzzle en 2D, vous avez la responsabilité de réarranger des chiens adorables de sorte à ce qu'ils tiennent dans une grille. Dogs Organized Neatly apporte 80 niveaux différents, faits main, contenant tout un tas de chiens sous toutes les formes et tailles.
The crash ... Not the best start of the day. In any case, for those who live on this planet... The time has come to destroy the monsters and fly home.
Intruders : Hide and Seek est un jeu d’action à la première personne, un thriller intense qui associe la plus grande terreur psychologique et le point de vue d'un enfant sans défense.

The Last Pawn is a shooter platformer where you play as the last hope of your kingdom. In your journey across the land, you will find yourself dealing with multiple enemy types, boss battles and 21 different levels.
A tongue-in-cheek space shooter where your only weapon is a ping pong cannon. Survive 15 levels and you might just earn your pilot's license.
Dino Cub is a fun and relaxing puzzle game, you have to build the correct path to prevent the dinosaur egg from breaking as the level progresses.

Retrouvez le cultissime Assault Suit Leynos en haute définition ! Plongez au cœur d'une guerre robotique totale dans ce célèbre jeu sorti initialement sur Mega Drive, sublimé à l'aide de nouveaux graphismes HD pour une expérience plus captivante que jamais !

Immerse yourself in the captivating world of the Cthulhu Mythos with this 2D visual novel game featuring a thrilling TRPG-based experience! Roll the dice and use your skills and luck to escape the abandoned hospital, while experiencing the cosmic terror.

Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, also known as CBT, is the use of evidence based strategies to help manage symptoms of poor mental health problems such as stress, anxiety and depression. Yuuka Kazami from the Touhou Project invites you to some mostly peaceful lessons where you grasp the basics of CBT!

titre: ESCAPE FROM VOYNA:  Tactical FPS survival
description: Escape from Voyna is an action packed realistic single player shooter set in the era of the Cold War on russian soil. After many nuclear tests the land is devastated and apocalypse spreading. You, a secret agent stranded on an island try to escape without getting caught by enemy soldiers.

titre: Witch's Pranks: Frog's Fortune Collector's Edition
description: Evil witch decided to marry a prince. And everyone, who rejected her, she turned to frogs. Help bewitched princes to reach their brides to cure the spell with a kiss of love.
Is a hidden object game in which you need to find all the ancient runes on a large location. Ancient runes will be located in a variety of places, from the most prominent to barely noticeable places.

Wordlase is a word-puzzle game. You need to compile words from the letters of offered one. For example, you can make words "ant" and "potion" from the letters of "interpolation". But you can't assemble "mol" since there is no "m" letter.

Are you ready for your new challenge? Get ready to take over the control of your original "Jungheinrich" Forklift! Just the best drivers will level up in the Highscore list. The fastest drivers will receive a special bonus. Enjoy the game in full 3D and feel the realistic driving experience.
You play for Putin, who at the time of the taxation bargained with Trump, so you have to run away from Trump and his clones, and also collect taxes (bitcoins)
A piece of Steam history - THE FIRST EVER NON VALVE GAME TO APPEAR ON THE STEAM PLATFORM!
Monsters' Domain: Incarnez un nécromancien, bâtissez un domaine de monstres, commandez des armées de morts-vivants. Explorez des donjons, utilisez des compétences pour vaincre les ennemis.
Project Aura is a micro management game where you lead a Colony of Climate Disaster Survivors. You have been assigned the mission to build an habitat capable of survival in this new unknown world.

In Dark Ages, you’re the Prince of the Great Kingdom, who as a child watched the King – your father – die at the hands of Garth, a power mad warlord with uncanny magical abilities. Garth sent you away from the Great Kingdom to be raised as a peasant, and to never fulfill your destiny as the future King. But Garth made a terrible mistake.

Choisissez votre héros, construisez votre équipe et affrontez les autres joueurs de l'univers Arena Stars dans ce nouveau jeu de stratégie multijoueur épique bourré d'action des Tiny Titan Studios! Arena Stars est un MOBA d'action 1v1 gratuit pour tous.

Un simulateur de construction de base dans 1500 ans. Partez pour l’île d’Enen. Récoltez, fabriquez, construisez, chassez, méditez et explorez de vastes biomes. Découvrez des secrets et créez votre propre repaire. Avec 160+ objets, chaque construction est unique.

"Unlight:SchizoChronicle" is a real time deck building game. Every turn each player purchases cards and fights against monsters. If you purchase a card, if that card gets added to your deck and you win the battle with the monster you get a "sherd point".

Land on unique planets to survive the horrors that await in this adventure survival RPG. Use the spoils to upgrade defensive buildings and explore the galaxy further. Can you survive the hunt all alone?
Build your cities, manage resources, train soldiers and fight for supremacy in a vast world with other player controlled empires

Make bots, customize their behaviors, then send them into battle against other players! Create scripts for your bots either visually or via code to master your automated bot army, and put your strategic fortitude to the test!

One of the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful arcade games of the 1980s is back in its Classic pixel perfect 2D form, and a re-imagined Reboot version with state of the art 3D game-play and graphics that remain faithful to the original concept.

titre: 白猫冒险团 White Cat Adventure Team
description: You will play as the White Cat Adventure Team and experience a simple story, exploring and collecting in different themed areas, using the resources and skills you have found, and facing various battles with the different mechanisms of the four characters.
A short story-driven game about two inquisitors, Arun and Quila, investigating a murder. During the game you'll control both, each having their own set of skills you'll need to solve the mystery.
在90年代的东欧国家，由于艾斯佩罗族和伊多诺族之间的矛盾，进而引发了双方的战争。玩家将扮演故事的主人公艾斯佩罗族的少女——弗洛拉，穿越战火过后的断壁残垣，结识抱持着不同想法理念的人们，在残酷的战争中竭尽全力生存下去，并揭开隐藏在战争背后的真相。
Juicy army is the sweetest action roguelike set in a dream universe where you'll have to fight an army of juicy creatures!
Is a game in which the player needs to take all the cargo (boxes, barrels) through obstacles to the finish line

Enjoy Disney Infinity with a Full Toy Box! Disney Infinity 1.0: Gold Edition gives you the freedom to create stories and play experiences with all Disney Infinity 1.0 Characters and Playsets Unlocked and ready for you to mix, match and mash up to invent just about any adventure you can imagine.
Restoring the power of a kingdom to its former glory using innate cunning, military might and a fearsome will to win.

The Majority of People navigate progress, politics and preposterous propulsive plans in this satirical point-and-click adventure. Featuring highly debatable democracy, problematic project managers and the belief that Anthony's underdeveloped prefrontal cortex will lead to your salvation!
Star Sky is a game about a man taking a midnight stroll. You take the same road as many times as you want, each time hopefully unlocking new encounters. Can you unlock the mysteries of the night?

Super Asqr is a collection of different game types and modes, both single and multiplayer, offered under one package with simple but elegant visual/audio feature set. Being a live game and guided by community, all these game modes are shaped by player feedback!

Backroom Beyond est un jeu à la première personne qui mélange des énigmes avec des plates-formes dans un environnement sombre et pénible qui amène le joueur à remettre en question la santé mentale du protagoniste. Basé sur le mythe d'internet, Backroom Beyond.

Love Colors is the relaxing paint by numbers pixel art game. Choose from over 150 stylish paintings from lovable themes and become the Picasso of the pixel. Playable solo and up to 4-player couch co-op.

This is a game with the background of new coronavirus, the story happened in w City, you and your family will face the epidemic together. All your choices will lead to different endings. Revisit the story of the epidemic and survive it。 It's a total of 30 days of epidemic life.
Le joueur n'incarne pas un simple homme, mais un puissant, riche et célèbre noble qui semble capable d'obtenir tout ce qu'il désire. Mais est-ce que ce sera assez cette fois ?
The virus has devastated cities and lands. Most of the population died, the rest turned into the walking dead. You're one of the last survivors. Do whatever it takes to last another day.

Road to Eden is a third-person multiplayer survival coop game, set within the post-apocalyptic ruins of a world destroyed by an alien invasion. You wake up at the side of the road with no memory and must team up with other survivors to make the long and dangerous journey to Eden.
Get your dose of '80s nostalgia! Blaze through neon streets, master turbo boosts, and chase victory. With a synthwave soundtrack and addictive gameplay, unleash your inner '80s racer!
Sniper Game is an arcade first person shooter.
"Deep Space Solitude" is a first-person horror game. As a journalist, you investigate the disappearance of a scientist in a remote cabin, tackling puzzles, challenges, and fear to survive.
Évadez-vous dans un monde de casse-tête mystérieux qui éveillera votre esprit, et calmera votre âme.

Pure Rock Crawling is a physics based off-road simulator. Featuring soft body tires, suspension customization that affects your handling, true to life drivetrain simulation and visual addons. Explore a variety of trails in free roam with multiple challenges.

titre: Princess Maker ~Faery Tales Come True~ (HD Remake)
description: Un jeu de simulation adorable et intéressant permettant d'élever une fille qui vous a rendu visite pour réaliser ses rêves.

Polda Pankrác v podání Luďka Soboty se vrací již posedmé. A je to návrat jaksepatří. Záhadná zpráva Temného lorda Vedra a havárie kosmické lodi odstartují kolotoč událostí, které může vyřešit jen náš elitní detektiv Pankrác.
Vous venez d'être embauché par l'EIRI ; rechercher et combattre les Visiteurs, un RPG de science-fiction sombre avec des thèmes d'exploration et de survie.
A quick 2-4 hour turn based fantasy RPG where the fate of the world is in your hands!

Bienvenue dans le monde dur et impitoyable d’un western spatial ! Explorez une planète sauvage et dangereuse, devenez un mercenaire d’une société indifférente ou ralliez-vous à des colons libres opprimés. Joignez-vous à la nouvelle ruée vers l'or et combattez pour survivre.
Red + Green = Yellow, Red + Blue = Violet, Green + Blue = Cyan. Try to find out all cells' color
Explore a ruined city and shoot your way to the truth of the past in the first ever 3D game from the creator of the Lloyd the Monkey series.
Prenez la tête de puissants Vikings, de Perses rusés ou de démons féroces ! Détruisez la base de votre adversaire tout en défendant la vôtre dans ce STR à défilement horizontal bourré d'adrénaline !
Search for the legendary lost artifact Nienix through galaxies in conflict! An open world space action RPG adventure that can be played both alone and together!
Dodge bullets to the rhythm and take down everything that moves! A rhythmical danmaku action game.

Descendez en tant qu’esprit IA d’un sous-marin de pointe, chargé de protéger des eaux mystérieuses. Un récit narratif mêlant science-fiction, mythologie sous-marine et exploration glaçante de l’évolution morale de l’intelligence artificielle.

Apprentice Lumina, who had never obtained her magic wand, was trapped in a forest. The main road was blocked, and there might be other ways to reach the destination. To solve puzzles in the dark world, explore the underground world, resist ghosts and demons, and finally defeat the enemy on your own

The Executioner puts you in the shoes of a man who tortures people for a living while trying to retain his own sanity. In this game the monster isn’t lurking behind you. You are the monster, if you choose to become one.

Inland est un jeu de coureurs au rythme rapide. Vous courez en avant et vous devez éviter les obstacles sombres, pour chaque obstacle que vous surmontez, vous obtenez un point. Mais si vous en rencontrez au moins un, vous perdrez immédiatement. Combien de points pouvez-vous obtenir?

Mesozoica - A full featured dinosaur theme park tycoon simulator in which you focus on the construction and management of your dinosaur wonderland. From choosing your starting company to your prime attraction, everything lies in your hands.
The final chapter of The Journey Down, a classic point-and-click saga with an Afro-Caribbean vibe. Get ready to embark on an epic journey of brain-teasing adventure!

Incarnez Charlie, un riche héritier, partageant son temps entre obligations mondaines et son hobby de détective privé. Dans Dream Chamber, démasquez le coupable de cette quête à la fois haletante et onirique.
Drive down a mountain with your friends in this chaotic cult classic kart racer!

Par l'équipe de création de System Shock, Thief et la série Underworld®. Pénétrez l'Abysse stygien, un monde dangereux et hautement interactif. Associez des dizaines d'aptitudes de combat, de discrétion et de magie pour développer votre style de jeu. Devenez l'Ascendant.

A hardcore arcade in retro soviet style. Red Falcon based on a cross between two classic retro games: Invaders and Tetris. Feel the power of soviet technology and destroy non-soviet sectarians heresy, that comes from another universe.

Space Survival is the next great SIMPLE 2D casual space action shooter where you have to defend against wave of enemies, have fast reflexes and strong will to win. It is great way to relax, but also a great challenge. How long can you stay focused?
Experience Winter Sale without losing money.

Dungeon crawler solo en tour par tour sur cases hexagonales, avec dés multifaces, PNJ malicieux, donjons aléatoires, chasse en plein air et tournois hebdomadaires. Vous tomberez peut-être sur une ou deux nuées de spores ou des monstres tout gluants, mais jamais sur une microtransaction.
Six stories about the most important things. And elves, gnomes, robots, aliens, adventure, and love.

Classical Minesweeper gameplay in all new 3D way!The best game mechanics features from Minesweeper combined with a hero in 3D and new goal. A lot of obstacles in the level and bonuses to avoid it, Sapper need to go through mine field and reach Finish line, its not gonna be easy though.
Hunt monsters and level up your character in a retro fantasy setting. Further make your character stronger with rare loot from monsters and by increasing character skills.
Zero G Arena is an arena shooter with zero gravity, ragdoll physics, grappling beams and magnet boots

KEO is a team-based online multiplayer vehicle combat game set in a sci-fi post-apocalyptic world. Build your loadout to suit your playstyle and balance your team to dominate the battlefield using futuristic remote controlled vehicles!
DAVIGO is a VR vs. PC physics-based battle game. Become the GIANT in VR or a small KNIGHT on PC and fight your friends in local or online matches. KNIGHTS play for free with DAVIGO KNIGHT'S PASS.

A dark jrpg with tough choices that change the story. You play as the last of the antadins, the protector of the queen of your colony. You have to traverse bleak, corrupted caverns, inhabitated by a myriad of different insects. Trying to protect your ward.

"3D Survivors" is a flashy and vibrant casual game. Take down the approaching monsters from all directions with high firepower. Obtain various power-up items to prepare for the final boss. Use the acquired score to upgrade the characters.
HUMBLE ZOMBIE is a game in which you control an unstable Zombie, trying to get to the top to taste the freshest brain.

titre: Unsolved Case: La Jacinthe écarlate Édition Collector
description: Il est temps de faire ton choix ! Une série de crimes se déroulent sous ton yeux : un meurtre dans une ruelle, l'assassinat de ton patron, un enlèvement en plein jour, et ainsi de suite... Sauras-tu faire face à tout cela ?

Atulos Online is a free to play 2D medieval MMORPG. You can choose from many different characters including Mage, Knight, Dwarf and Guardian. The story unfolds as a confrontation with the sorcerer Atulos draws ever closer.
Casually nuke targets on the surface of a planet with a long-range cannon, by adjusting the cannon's loaded ammo, heading, azimuth, and power.

Plongez dans l'univers époustouflant de "Reach The Beat", où vos talents de tireur sont mis à l'épreuve sur les rythmes électrisants de la musique électronique. Dans ce jeu, chacun de vos mouvements et de vos tirs crée une harmonie musicale, illuminée par les néons d'une ville abstraite.
De véritables camions. Une action plus vraie que nature. Monster Jam ! Découvrez le monde du Monster Jam avec Monster Jam Steel Titans !
Find the Vanishing Hitchhiker!

Ask anyone who considered themselves a true gamer in 1987 and the chances are they will fondly remember California Games. Now on Steam for the very first time, you too can enjoy six radical and awesome events: the half-pipe, roller skating, surfing, BMX, footbag and the flying disc.
Sauvez l'humanité des forces démoniaques !

Il est maintenant temps de construire 9 des structures les plus invraisemblables de l'histoire. Faites correspondre les runes pour détruire les blocs et trouver les serrures et les clefs de pierre. Faites pivoter les cubes pour découvrir les clefs !
Whiplash - Crash Valley. Super-premium-deluxe interactive Ragdoll simulation system.

BoxesWithGuns is a 2D neon vertex endless shooter game. Try to survive as long as possible by avoiding collisions with the enemies that spawn. One game equals the length of the background music track playing. Collect dollars and customize your spaceship by adding new boxes and weapons.

titre: Groundhog Day: Like Father Like Son
description: Bienvenue à Punxsutawney pour le jour de la marmotte dans la séquelle en réalité virtuelle du film. Tu es Phil Connors Jr, prisonnier dans une faille spatio-temporelle qui te fait revenir le même jour encore et encore.
Explore the mysterious room by traversing time, while you watch a man succumb to the room syndrome.
Son héritage perdure ! Jouez aux prochaines aventures Tomb Raider dans cette collection remastérisée de Darkness Trilogy.

Take on the ultimate driving challenge in Mountain Taxi Challenge! Navigate treacherous mountain roads, pick up diverse passengers, and complete 30 unique missions—from emergency rescues to time-sensitive drop-offs. Can you master the winding paths and become the best taxi driver in the mountains?

Gladiator School is a Tycoon-style simulation game. You play as the master of a newly formed school for gladiators. Your job is to prepare and train recruits before you send them away to fight for their survival and entertain the crowd in the arena.

An experimental mind-reading helmet, a time machine, and a doomsday device that can annihilate the human race. Which one would you like to test out first? The classic choose-your-path comic book by Jason Shiga.

titre: War of the Human Tanks - ALTeR
description: Human Tanks - ALTeR is the much-awaited second installment of the War of the Human Tanks series, and sequel to War of the Human Tanks. This time you assume command of the enemy of the first game, the Royal Army, and fight back for all you hold dear!
Grab your equipment, there are monsters to kill in the deep and narrow dungeons.
An arcade game about a rocket flying in endless space.
After a freak accident, a seemingly ordinary chicken becomes a bomb laying free range hero. Explore the versatile mechanic of laying bombs in this explosive exploration platformer.
SaGa Frontier, le RPG classique adulé de 1998, revient avec des graphismes améliorés, des fonctionnalités supplémentaires et un nouveau personnage principal !
Save the scientists! Prevent biological catastrophe! Eat all the burgers on the way!

This is a realistic Bookstore where you can read real books of several different topics. Interested in learning about business communication? Find and read any book in this realistic virtual bookstore. our Other Games Movie Theater Simulator Restaurant Simulator
Political Puzzle - slide puzzle game. You need solve the puzzle as fast as you can.

This is the final installment of TAISHO x ALICE, a fairytale visual novel in which YOU must save your Prince Charming! Take on the role of the heroine in order to rehabilitate your chosen love interest and guide him to his "happily ever after" once and for all!

Enter The Lethe, a forsaken asylum where reality and nightmare blur. In RealEscape, solve puzzles, uncover dark secrets, and face terrifying challenges alone or with friends in multiplayer and find your escape room player type. Can you escape the twisted maze, or will you become another lost soul?

titre: Train Simulator: NEC: New York-New Haven Route Add-On
description: L’impressionnante Big Apple et l’incroyable ville New Haven se rejoignent sur ce nouvel itinéraire NEC: New York-New Haven pour Train Simulator, en vous offrant nombreux des intournables endroits à découvrir à New York et un nouveau mode de signalement en cabine.

Hellfire 1988: An Oregon Story is a story-rich visual novel with point-and-click adventure game elements. Featuring a 30,000 word interactive script, hundreds of story choices, challenging puzzles, and a thrilling hard rock soundtrack, Hellfire 1988 is a compelling dramatic adventure.

Experience the horrors of a haunting that's never the same twice. Paranormal is a 3D fully dynamic haunting experience. The player takes the role of Mattel Clarke, an artist who has a haunted house. Mattel decides to film the hauntings with his camera, which is the viewpoint of the game.

Jeu de cartes avec un scénario non linéaire et des batailles passionnantes ! Vous allez plonger dans le monde fantastique des créatures magiques et des dragons, descendre dans les profondeurs des souterrains pour trouver des ressources précieuses et construire un Royaume indestructible !
Play as Persephone finding her way through a dangerous Underworld as she sneaks past Lost Souls and the prying eyes of her mother.
A corporate artificial intelligence simulator.
Combots is a multiplayer robot war shooter set in fully procedurally generated maps with the physical environment.

Un jeu de tir roguelite en vue du dessus fait part les créateurs de Crimsonland? N'attendez plus pour tracer votre propre chemin à l'aide de flingues ou d'améliorations cybernétiques tout en améliorant les caractéristiques de votre personnage à travers les niveaux. Saurez-vous stopper l'Overseer?

Den is a one-eyed alien who is grounded after the terrible crash of a spaceship. On this planet, one can control the gravity around him to walk in space. Lucky Dan is also able to change the gravity on the ground. Help him to reach the lost ship.

You confront the ghosts in order to break the spell of school resentment. The disappearance of the missing girls... Will he be able to contain all the Ghost in the school and restore peace to the school?
Invisibox is a tough puzzle game where you have to solve sliding puzzles by controlling invisible boxes while avoiding various obstacles.

titre: Teleportals. I swear it's a nice game
description: I swear it's a nice puzzle game.

All Juliette ever wanted was to go back home. With the help of her ghost recording equipment she makes her way through flooded landscapes, buried houses and abandoned apartments. This is calm psychological horror with emphasis on atmosphere.

While constantly working on a video game without any rest, a college student who's about to graduate quietly slipped into slumber several times. In those lucid dreams, he found himself in the game he was working on, the fantasy world of Dragon Spirits.
Firewood is a 2D adventure game with psychological horror elements. The game tells the story of an old man who has lost his wife years ago and is still having troubles with his past.
中国玄幻沙盒世界，具有丰富的剧情，多种分支，超过五百多位世界NPC，自由培养角色，自动回合加即时心法插入的战斗方式，带给您别致的扮演体验。 欢迎大家入官方交流QQ群：519866786。

In the American Southwest, a lone witch hunter travels across the desert, seeking to wipe out cultists of all sorts. Fight a variety of goons and ghouls, through small towns to dimension-spanning motels. Blast your way through a neon-dripped, pixelated nightmare in this high-speed, high-thrills FPS.
Harness the phenomenal abilities of an unliving wraith to preserve liberty—or to subvert it. Will you use your powers over quintessence to save your nation, or will you profit from its broken shell?
Make tasty food items to serve hungry customers in this fast-paced food making game!

Crumbling school buildings in Japan. A string of bizarre incidents. The eerie legend of Mandemon. Lies and truth intertwine. Love and hatred blur in the mist. What will you do? Who can you trust? Welcome to a cruel world of deceit and suffering—

Recruit a company of heroes to save a world in ruins after a devastating cataclysm. Valley Knights is a turn-based, tactical, roguelike, RPG set in a dark-horror fantasy world out of the 1980s, where every decision matters, and no one lives forever...

Do you have what it takes to become a legendary Powered hero? "Heroes Rise" is an epic interactive novel where your choices control the story. The game is entirely text-based--without graphics or sound effects--and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination. How high will you rise?

After hearing about a number of student couples forming at her school, Himeka Uchida decides to look for a girlfriend of her own. As she gets wrapped up in the daily lives of her friends and classmates at Solana Academy, will she find the romance she seeks?

Passez trois nuits dans une galerie maudite pour résoudre l'affaire du meurtre de Mordechai Grey, un artiste torturé tué par l'une des six muses mortelles. Accrochez des portraits pour voir dans le passé, tout en résolvant des énigmes et en explorant des pièces en perpétuelle transformation.

<p>BC Kings comprend de nouveaux éléments qu'on ne rencontre pas forcément dans les jeux de stratégie. En plus de récolter des ressources, d'entraîner une armée et de défaire l'ennemi il va falloir résoudre des énigmes comme dans un jeu de rôle.
A futuristic action RPG hack-and-slash where two warriors with unique powers battle abominations and uncover the dark secrets of a world ravaged by hate.

An AVG with novel endings influenced by different choices. The Silver cat wanted to recover the stolen gem only ended up in a trap set by the notoriously perverted dominatrix in the 【Kurobara’s Mansion】. Whipping, bondage, shocking and wax-dripping, she threw everything at Ginka. What will Ginka’s fate be?

Triangulate, a game that is easy to learn but hard to master. Stack the falling triangles to create bigger triangles of the same color making them disappear along with the black background. A very simple concept, but doing it for an entire level requires quick memory, clever strategy, and great dexterity.
Make burgers, shakes and more in this exciting food-making game that has been enjoyed by millions of fans everywhere.

Nous sommes en 1942. Le gouvernement britannique décide de lancer l‘une des opérations les plus audacieuses de la Seconde Guerre mondiale, qui consiste a tuer les dirigeants les plus importants du IIIe Reich.

Comme ses prédécesseurs, Crash Time 3, le nouvel épisode de la série de jeux de courses bien connue, offre un jeu varié en haute qualité. Le créateur de jeux allemand Synetic a une fois de plus poussé le moteur graphique encore plus loin.
The complete Moto Racer series together in a single package featuring the original Moto Racer, Moto Racer 2 , Moto Racer 3 Gold Edition and Moto Racer15th Anniversary titles."

titre: [Chilla's Art] Aka Manto | 赤マント
description: Aka Manto (赤マント Red Cloak), aka Red Cape or Red Mantle, is a Japanese urban legend about a masked spirit who wears a red cloak, and who appears to people using public or school restrooms.
Fast paced 3D action platformer.

"🎃 Plongez dans 'Scary Humans' ce Halloween! Un jeu de survie survitaminé avec des vibes rétro des années 80. Affrontez des niveaux implacables, déjouez les humains sinistres et échappez d'un complexe militaire tordu. Avez-vous le courage de survivre au cauchemar? 🎮👻"

Multi-Medium est une aventure plate-forme en 2D unique en son genre,dans laquelle vous incarnez un explorateur interdimensionnel perdu dans le multivers. Traversez différents mondes, chacun dessinés ou peints à la main avec un support et un style différent, et trouvez votre place dans le cosmos.
Organize railroad networks in this exciting time management game! Direct trains and monorails to clear areas and venture into new park sections.

Arcade cover shooter inspired by Time Crisis, Metal Slug and 80's action heros! He's got an itchy trigger finger, some scratchy stubble, and a fondness for shooting dudes in the face. Run and gun your way through gorgeous 3D environments as you embark on a mission to rescue your kidnapped girlfriend from the Forces of Evil.

As Sam McRae, last surviving member of the “Titan Hauler” crew, you must hack and blast your way through an onslaught of truly bad 'bots to find a way to prevent a potential planet-destroying catastrophe.

titre: Captain Lycop : Invasion of the Heters
description: Un shooter spatial mêlant aventure, action et tactique. Affrontez des insectes bureaucrates, des ennemis sans pitié et des boss épiques. Votre seul espoir est de bannir la lâcheté et d'emprunter un chemin de vertu.

Collectez des objets en synergie pour créer un personnage surpuissant et combattre des hordes de monstres cyclopes. Cyclo Chambers est un jeu de tir en arène au rythme rapide, en vue de dessus, avec des éléments rogue-like. 150 objets au choix pour créer des combinaisons effrénées.
Use the power of music to reawaken long forgotten memories in Distortions, a story-driven journey through a world of unparalleled beauty.

Un jeu de stratégie au tour par tour dans un univers de fantasy sombre où la synergie des unités, le positionnement et le contrôle de la carte font la différence. Combinez vos troupes stratégiquement pour débloquer des capacités spéciales et des combos dévastateurs. Trois factions. Trois commandants. Des possibilités tactiques infinies.

This is a historical action game from 3rd person based on Yakut mythology. Alaa-Mogus the devil has come to seize our land! Uraankhai Sakha, let's take up our weapons and drive him back to the dungeon! Uruy-Aikhal!

Fight the battle you already won, but never remember. It is you up against 1000 other sperm fighters. Can you beat off your competition and come first? Finally, collect your very own baby gnomes as trophies for your minivan!
Pirates Outlaws is an easy-to-play roguelike card game. Build your deck and combos to become a reputed pirate.
The Odd Neon Void is an experimental Adventure/RPG game where you become Jack, a man stuck in a strange and unfamiliar place called the neon void. Don't be too sad.
Savourez l'action du Jeu de Tir sur Bille classique dans une toute nouvelle aventure Luxor !
Take Boston or die for freedom!
A one-of-a-kind horror shocker – a game aware of your fear!Check out the improvements introduced with Update 2.0!

Les personnages TRANSFORMERS sont de retour, et cette fois, ils sont dans les mains du fameux studio PlatinumGames, qui a combiné sa maîtrise de l'action pure et dure à une bonne dose de nostalgie pour créer un jeu TRANSFORMERS sans équivalent.

Infernium, un jeu de survie et d'horreur non linéaire. Plongez dans un beau portrait interconnecté de l'enfer, mourez dans une prison sans barreaux et surmontez une pénitence brutale. Une expérience agonique et angoissante qui va vous ébranler.

It is an application made for the person who aims for virtual youtube from now on easily for easy handling. If there is a web camera, it blinks with face recognition, the direction of the face. You can project from microphone to lip sync (interlocking of lip movement) avatar.
Enfilez les bottes robustes de McJagger et affrontez une armée de mort-vivants !
This is a completely free, volunteer made, multiplayer, satirical parody of common thematic elements found in American broadcast television serieses (yes that's actually a word)

Aidez Flynn et son mythique compagnon Dex à sauver Rosantica avant que la maléfique Infection ne l'envahisse. Flynn: Son of Crimson, vous entraîne dans un voyage de découverte et de conflits à mesure que vous apprenez à maîtriser l'art de l'énergie de Pourpre.

A classic addictive/fun indie mini game for windows that you will play every time!. Do you ever wonder what is like to be in a realistic combat arena and how it feel? Play as Octavius , the greek warrior who is forced to fight in the gladiatorial arenas with many of the best soldiers in the empire..
어떻게든 돌아갈 거야. 가족이 기다리고 있는 집으로.
Un jeu de permutation en coopération dont le but est d'essayer de ne PAS tuer vos amis !

Tower Factory est un jeu de défense de tours et d'automatisation avec des éléments roguelite. Optimisez la production de ressources avec des systèmes de convoyeurs tout en vous défendant contre des vagues de monstres. Pouvez-vous trouver et détruire la tour ennemie avant qu'il ne soit trop tard?
Tough as nails arcade driving game where you try to survive as long as possible without crashing your car in a police chase situation.

The core gameplay of HideSeekBattle is to organically combine the classic hide-and-seek mode with the FPS/TPS shooting mechanism. In each round of the game, players will be assigned different roles and play as different character identities to engage in intense battles in complex scenarios.
KNIGHT CLUB + Is a casual 2-4 player action platform-fighting game that brings traditional fighting game elements into an unlocked, free form movement playstyle.

If you enjoyed NES games like Castlevania, Ninja Gaiden, Shatterhand, Jorney to Silius you have to try this game! Play as Vlad Tepes Dracula and fight your way to the Wallachian border to take your rightful throne in a new medieval Classicvania game with gorgeous art, and 10 playable characters!

Forge Quest is a dungeon crawling rpg set in a voxel world. Explore the land full of chickens on a light hearted quest to become a hero. Delve deep into the randomly generated dungeons to battle monsters, find treasure and craft your equipment. Invite your friends to join your world and help you in your adventure.

Plongez-vous dans la plus belle et frissonnante expérience de VR réalisée à ce jour. Vivez une suite d'événements catastrophiques dans le froid du vide spatial, alors que vous foncez à grande vitesse vers la Terre. Quand le désastre s'abat sur vous, votre unique mission est de vous en sortir aussi vite que possible.

Show your strategic talents in Taste of Power! It's a RTS set in an alternate medieval world, where Europe, Middle East, and China confront each other. Develop unique technologies and lead warriors into an epic battlefield – the victory is yours!

The hit series returns! Roll and bounce in this jumpless precision platformer for all skill levels. Play through an eerie campaign, best the wicked difficulty, or create your own levels to share with the world!

titre: 巴伦西亚传说：索菲亚的重生 Valencia Saga:Sophia's rebirth
description: The story starts when two countries on one continent collide. Two charactors are on their journey to save all beings, and the adventure unfolds.

Hardcore sci-fi first person shooter. You are a liaison on Vega 237 spacecraft. All crew members died and you are all by yourself in the midst of an unknown planet. Your goal is to find out what happened to the crew and establish the signal's nature.
Don your cape and mask and join the Supreme League of Patriots in this hilarious and irreverent superhero comedy adventure!

Enfilez les chaussures d'un hackeur anonyme compétent et lancez-vous dans une mission pour révéler la vérité cachée derrière les sinistres plans d'une organisation visant à surveiller les données des citoyens et à imposer une surveillance de masse.

Dans ce secouriste 2D platformer intergalactique devrait aussi vite que possible de passer à travers vaisseau spatial de scientifiques interplanétaires et collectez des batteries quantiques d'ions. Utilisez une variété de mécanismes de jeu pour terminer plus rapidement les niveaux. Ce sera difficile

La démo de Cherry Jump est un jeu de plateforme 2D rapide où les joueurs traversent des niveaux en pixel art, collectant des cerises et visant les meilleurs temps. Testez votre vitesse et votre habileté en naviguant à travers de multiples chemins.
A fast paced precision platform game where you play as Lupu, a monster looking to make their way out of the abandoned lab and onto the surface!

Vous n'êtes pas dans une chaîne de montage normale. Dans cette escape room, vous devrez découvrir ce que fabrique réellement l'usine secrète, explorer des endroits mystérieux et résoudre des énigmes. Trouverez-vous la vérité ?

Gatewalkers est un jeu d'action de survie collectif avec des éléments d'action-RPG, dans lequel vous parcourez différents mondes pour sauver le vôtre. Explorez les paysages, faites face à leurs habitants et à d'autres défis tels que les conditions climatiques extrêmes, l'atmosphère toxique et le manque d'eau.

Reign: Conflict of Nations allows players to have a well thought-out and historically accurate system of building and assigning labor forces in cities, a large selection of scenario-based and random missions, an expansive and realistic technology tree, more than 150 types of military units and elaborated graphics and animations which brin

Orbital Bullet is a fast paced 360° action-platformer with rogue-lite elements, where all actions take place in a circular pattern. Fight your way through a variety of procedural planets and use body modifications, crafting and heavy weaponry. Kill. Die. Modify.

De tout NOUVEAUX graphismes pixélisés et une bande-son 8 bits totalement INÉDITE! Tous les Éléments et toutes les réactions ont été magnifiquement redessinés. Si vous aimez les jeux rétro des années 80, vous allez être fan de Doodle God: 8-bit Mania!
Abduction Bit is a NES-like arcade based on elements of some timeless classics from 80's (Bubble Bobble, Ice Climber, Mario Bros).

Supplice is a stylish throwback shooter inspired by the mid-90s FPS glory days and the legendary Doom modding community. Mixing the retro stylings of 90s era shooters with colorful graphics and frantic gameplay, it creates an experience that's ever so familiar but also exciting and fresh.

Trois activistes volent des chefs-d’œuvre dans les plus grands musées pour les vendre à des collectionneurs et financer des œuvres caritatives. Changez le monde, un vol à la fois, tout en échappant à la police dans ce jeu d'aventure et de conspiration.

Une voie difficile..., pire que ♂deep dark fantasies♂. Aidez votre personnage à traverser tous les endroits les plus difficiles de Russie pour enfin arriver au palais de Poutine. Ce ne sera pas facile, mais si vous n'êtes pas un ♂Slave♂ vous pouvez y arriver. Bonne chance !

From the creator of Coffee Talk and What Comes After, comes a slice-of-life adventure set in modern Jakarta about love, loss and finding your own way forward. Step into the shoes of Rama, a young musician struggling to move on with life after the death of his girlfriend, Cinta.

Un jeu palpitant mêlant horreur et ambiance dans un manoir plongé dans le noir. Avec une lampe torche, un pistolet et une discussion vocale de proximité, rassemblez jusqu'à cinq amis. Furetez et criez lors d'accrochages tendus au pistolet, ponctués de pièges, le tout dans le noir complet.
Voyons qui est le plus grand trou noir de la ville !

Just King is an action auto-battler with roguelike elements. Assemble your party to venture into different lands fighting fearsome kings and their deadly armies. Use your loot to hire and upgrade mighty heroes... or the bard.

The Slaverian Trucker is a Survival/Truck/Life simulator game. Make enough money to survive and expand your wealth in the harsh semi-post apocalyptic lands of Slaveria, doing legal and illegal work, while maintaining, fixing, building, repairing, tuning your trucks, cars and other vehicles.

titre: 孟德大小姐与自爆少年THREE KINGDOM FANTASY
description: 《孟德大小姐与自爆少年》是一款文字冒险（AVG）游戏，完全原创剧情，将带给大家一段穿插了过去与未来的棋局与因缘。游戏中，玩家将扮演普通大学生郭风笑，开启一场独特的奇妙旅程。

Creatures from all over the Galaxy make their way to play on the annual idle chess tournament. In Idle Chess Story You take control of a team of chess units with special abilities to win over your opponents and increase your rank.

titre: Sonucido: The Mage - A Dungeon Crawler by Daniel da Silva
description: Sonucido: The Mage is a grid-based, turn-based Dungeon Crawler RPG. Find the mage in the depths of Sonucido!

Deflector est un roguelike en vue du dessus situé dans un microcosme mortel. Visitez des mondes hostiles envahis par les virus. Terrassez des ennemis de plus en plus forts en utilisant vos armes et en déviant leurs balles. Vivez, mourez et gagnez en puissance pour tenter d'atteindre la Source !

The UnderGarden est un jeu Zen occasionnel qui permet au joueur d'explorer des caves qui contiennent des formes de vie étranges, des sons, de la musique et des secrets. Les joueurs occasionnels qui apprécient les jeux d'énigmes apprécieront la jouabilité de The UnderGarden, un jeu d'énigme qui va mettre votre réflexion à l'épreuve en...

Un archipel paisible sombre dans la corruption, dominé par des pirates contrôlant l’alcool. Explorez les îles, récoltez des ingrédients et créez des boissons uniques pour renverser l’organisation criminelle et rétablir la paix.
Combats d'avion en ligne contre de vrais pilotes, chars et fantassins.
Rogue Survivor is a casual top-down shooter game where you try to survive as long as enemy waves finishes. Choose different heroes and different skills to make better builds.
Yono and the Celestial Elephant est une grande aventure avec des puzzles minutieusement conçus, des chasses au trésor, un combat fantastique et un monde rempli de gens.

Carve a path through an unforgiving wilderness to rescue a hero trapped by a villain! Developed to provide gamers with a thrilling and accessible t adventure, Pathfinders will provide hours of unforgettable fun!
An action platformer with size-changing mechanics. Be quick and nimble or large and in-charge!

Explorez la beauté infinie, forgez la force puissante. Moon VR Player, un lecteur vidéo compact en VR,réécrit les règles de la visualisation de la réalité virtuelle et restructure la lumière et les ombres. Une ère d'expérience de visionnage de vidéo totalement nouvelle commence à partir d'ici.
Explore a robot populated world while jumping across sea platforms, solving puzzles, operating drones and more. Tons of levels, tons of fun!

Dawnfolk est un jeu de puzzle et de construction simple au charme ténébreux. Collecte des ressources, reconstruis ton royaume et protège ton peuple des ténèbres. Parviendras-tu à percer les secrets des monolithes pour ramener la lumière dans le monde ?
Le simulateur de billard le moins réaliste du monde !

titre: Gears of Phantasm: Destiny Tailored(Act I)
description: A classic story with fun exploration, an RPG like nothing you remembered. Familiar gameplay with new twists, building your Warriors into Legends.
Card Shark est un jeu d'aventure où se mêlent intrigues, ruses et autres délicieuses tricheries. Découvrez un monde dans lequel vous devrez manipuler vos adversaires aussi bien que vos cartes.

Devenez un écureuil. Explorez, rassemblez, créez, et construisez d’incroyables cabanes sur des aires boisées. Cavalez à travers les espaces verts, faufilez-vous entre les arbres et balancez-vous de branche à branche en solo, ou jusqu’à quatre en coop. D’infinies journées estivales vous attendent !

Bioweaver est un jeu RPG avec un contenu de chasse au trésor et de création de personnages. Vous pouvez non seulement utiliser la logique de programmation de base pour personnaliser en profondeur leurs compétences, mais aussi créer des organes uniques grâce au système d'artisanat.

Pandora est un jeu de tir en arène au style rétro. Affrontez des hordes de démons, utilisez vos pouvoirs magiques, collectez des cristaux pour devenir plus puissant, et déchaînez des attaques dévastatrices.
The legendary game. One of the best action-puzzle games in the world!
The blood-curdling sequel to Dracula: Resurrection brings an even scarier adventure to life. After saving Mina, Jonathan Harker and his beloved return to London carrying a mysterious Dragon Ring.

titre: Captain Morgane and the Golden Turtle
description: Morgane Castillo est belle, séduisante, pleine d’esprit et possède un caractère bien trempé. Depuis son enfance, elle est un vrai garçon manqué. Les efforts de sa mère pour l’éduquer comme une vraie jeune fille n’y ont rien changé.

A stealth-based adventure set in the 1960s where you play as Doctor Clint, navigating the dangerous corridors of a secret underground facility. Outsmart guards, avoid detection, and team up with rebels to bring down a brutal regime.

In this thrilling point-and-click adventure based on the works of H.P Lovecraft, you’ll traverse the haunting world of Gothic New England, solving puzzles and acquiring information to help Stanton solve the mystery of the Necronomicon.

ShadowSide is a First Person Exploration game. A policeman Alex Carter has been watching over the tranquility in the town for many years. He protects the people from robbery and crime. Nothing but a routine.
Fish Feast is an underwater side-scrolling eat 'em up game. You start playing as a tiny fish in the ocean with an insatiable appetite. The more you eat, the bigger you get!
Il existe un endroit appelé Wind Peaks, où le mystère est au rendez-vous. Aidez des scouts à trouver tous les objets manquants dans cette aventure amusante et relaxante de chasse au trésor.

FOR LIVE STREAMS ONLY! Coin Pusher Live lets streamers host an interactive arcade coin pusher where viewers drop coins, trigger events, win rewards, and climb the boards using commands like !drop. Customize the machine, fire up Twitch, Kick or YouTube, and let the coin chaos begin.
A good game without limits with simple control and syllogistic passage of levels.
In this game, you control Paul, a man that faces many obstacles in both life and death.

Galagan's Island is an Arcade style Space Shooter paying loving homage to classic arcade style & difficulty. This Bullet Hell is sure to satisfy your Shmup Shortage! Featuring 25 LEVELS of handcrafted whimsical charm. Formations so pretty you almost don't want to destroy them.

After a sexual mishap, our hero 77p egg finds itself on a quest to find a new wife while the world is overrun by sentient sewage and a milk-obsessed cult. A dumb and crass FPS inspired by the likes of Postal 2, Duke 3D, and Goat Simulator.
Welcome to My Dad Left Me, a sequel to Scuffy Game that no one on Earth asked for.
《伏雨录》是一款2D横版角色扮演类的剧情游戏。在一个宁静的村庄，有两位热血少年，不顾众人反对，毅然踏上了由朝廷举办的“种青”考试之路。然而路途看似平坦，未料上一辈的“前仇旧账”却向他们抛下一张束缚之网。
Explore the multiverse with different versions of NUSNURs where every universe has its own mechanics, style, story, and lore. Observe how their lives connect and how everything ends.

Viens passer l'été à Kabuto Park ! Capture les plus mignons des insectes, entraîne-les et gagne le tournoi de scarabagarre dans ce petit jeu de collection. Améliore ton matériel pour attraper des bébêtes toujours plus rares, plus fortes et plus belles.

titre: Gabriel Knight® 3: Blood of the Sacred, Blood of the Damned
description: Play as both Gabriel Knight and Grace Nakimura as you learn more about what is hidden in the hills of France.

Superstar Racing is a popular arcade-style MMO racing game. Superstar Racing Features – Invite other players and create your own Racing Team! – Create your own personal driver and take it to the track. – Race with players around the world and become your own racing superstar!

titre: Last Days of Spring Visual Novel
description: Last Days of Spring is a YA (Young Adult) Otome Visual Novel following a group of high school seniors in their last week of school as they come to terms with questions about love, life and destiny. Follow the steps of Yuka Kishimoto as she navigates across her final week as a high school student and sees her life come to a complete...

Ne lâchez pas la gâchette ! Dans le jeu de tir rythmé ROBOBEAT, vous jouez Ace, un chasseur de prime aux trousses du robot fou Frazzer dans son manoir évolutif. Courez sur les murs, glissez et tirez au rythme qui vous plaît grâce à l'éditeur de musiques personnalisées !
7 is a puzzle platformer, literally, by the numbers.

LUXOR, le numéro 1 des jeux d'action et de puzzle franchit les frontières de l'Égypte pour se lancer sur les routes de la soie. Les joyaux de la couronne de Nefertiti ont été dérobés et son esprit fait appel à vous pour résoudre le mystère. Horus vous aidera dans cette quête.Explorez la Perse, la Syrie et l'Inde.
Monsters come from missed shots! Learn the monster's behaviours, shoot wisely and balance the difficulty to maximize scoring!

Battlerace est un jeu de tir à la première personne avec des champs de bataille dynamiques. Appliquez votre propre stratégie en utilisant l'arsenal disponible et menez votre équipe à la victoire sur une carte avec jusqu'à 16 joueurs.

Steam Hammer est le premier hardcore RPG en bac à sable établi dans un univers steampunk et incluant des éléments de survie. Tu y trouveras tous les avantages d’un jeu en bac à sable dans l’univers mystérieux des machines à vapeur.

Ever wanted to create your own world? Keep track of your P&P campaigns? Are you working as a worldbuilder and find it troublesome to keep track of lots of relevant data or simply want to share that data in an accessible way? Well look no further than Ikarus!
Would you like to escape the crisis with your furry partner and escape from this "mysterious dungeon", or explore and understand the secret behind this mysterious underground facility?

Plongez dans une histoire de gangsters et de malfrats avec Out of the Box, un thriller passionnant dans lequel vous déciderez du sort des clients d'un night-club très sélect dans une perpétuelle course contre la montre.
Type, Type and just Type.

One Night On the Road is a quest in which You have to play as a character who has run out of fuel in the car. And now you have to find fuel in a small town. During the search, you can learn about the mysterious history of a resident of the city.

Desert Thunder is an arcade-style action tank game for the PC. Ripped from today’s headlines, the storyline immerses players into the heat of a desert-based military conflict. Players will tear through desert, urban and industrial settings in their experimental battle engine, the Abrams M1A6 Advanced tank that’s loaded with awe-inspiring...

titre: Nancy Drew®: Danger on Deception Island
description: Plunge into Danger to Bring a Mysterious Island’s Secrets to the Surface!

Explorez les niveaux occupés par les monstres de Banban's Kindergarten. Survivez aux monstres qui résident dans les étages inférieurs, car vous êtes désormais complètement seul. Découvrez la vérité sur cet endroit et retrouvez votre enfant disparu...
It's a zoo out there, and you're in charge! Go wild with your imagination running the most exotic, fun and exciting zoo ever.

Vous allez voler une machine à remonter le temps. Dans cette escape room, vous devez voyager dans le temps, explorer des lieux mystérieux et résoudre des énigmes pour obtenir des trésors inestimables. Pourrez-vous revenir en vie ?

Embark on an epic adventure to save the lands. Form a party by selecting 4 different adventurers from a pool of over 12 unique classes. Battle your way through the cursed lands scaling the highest mountains and exploring the darkest dungeons. Face more than 30 unique challenging bosses in order to reach the capital of the kingdom.
Tactical Combat Department is a tactical turn-based strategy game inspired by Swat games. You command a special intervention squad that intervenes in various situations and environments.

Votre heure a sonné dans la grosse pomme... New York, la ville qui ne dort jamais ! Partez du ruisseau jusqu'à construire votre empire à Manhattan. Une centaine de types d'entreprises sont à portée de main : nightclub, médias, théâtre... les choix sont infinis. Avec le succès vient la renommée : bientôt la ville sera à vos pieds.
Short kinetic visual novell about three girls get caught in quite misterious situation.

The biggest installment of the award winning Sentinel sci-fi tower defense series now on PC!Take the fight to the alien homeworld and unleash a massive arsenal of weaponry. Get up close and personal on the battlefield in your power armor to execute devastating attacks and support your defenses! * An epic campaign across 20 levels.
Partez à l'aventure dans cet immense point-and-click de science-fiction post-apocalyptique, peuplé de personnages originaux et d'énigmes captivantes.
Tous les éléments classiques des jeux d'action sont au rendez-vous, doublés de graphismes haute définition et de fonctionnalités multijoueurs en temps réel.

The Frenzy Virus has mutated. Now, you and your team must defeat hordes of "The Ridden" in Frenzy Extinction! Survive waves of mutated monsters as your team upgrades their gear, powers up with custom abilities, and races to extract after defeating the boss.
Help Keeper to seal restless trolls in the totems. Simple and addictive mechanics in the style of Tetris!

Utilise les pouvoirs de Zeus et des dieux d’Olympe pour aider Nyx à réussir son épique aventure. Envoie des rayons, contrôle les vents, envoie du feu, combats Hydra, surfe sur le sable et modifie ton environnement comme tu n’as jamais pu le faire auparavant.Principales caractéristiquesGameplay unique et innovant.
La rencontre entre la survie et l'automatisation. Capturez des créatures pour les ajouter à votre chaîne de montage. Survivrez-vous assez longtemps pour rallumer les lumières ?

titre: Tales of Monkey Island Complete Pack: Chapter 4 - The Trial and Execution of Guybrush Threepwood
description: Alors que vous étiez en train de faire passer un sale quart d'heure au pirate LeChuck, GuyBrush Threepwood rependait le mal vaudou dans l'ensemble des caraïbes sans le savoir. Ce mal menace à présent de transformer les pirates en monstres.

Rebound is a physics based reflex arcade game where the player must keep a ball within bounds of the screen, while aiming for the most points and longest time survived possible in a single round. Sounds simple, right?
Follow the story of a brave, courageous and handsome pirate as he continues his journey to find THE treasure after his death!
A narrative driven tower defense / arena shooter. Equal parts comedy and adrenaline pumping horror.
Chef can't work without his hand. So, please cut food carefully.

In Frontline: The Longest Day, players command the Allied forces through some of the most famous battles of the war, freeing Europe from the hands of the German Army. The game takes place over five massive, engaging and challenging missions, all inspired by historical missions which took place during operation Overlord: Utah, Omaha,...

Flat Eye est un jeu de management mettant l'accent sur la narration. Gérez une des stations services les plus avancées au monde, développez ses produits et interagissez avec ses clients les plus fidèles. Flat Eye - Toujours un oeil sur vous!

In this 16-bit style RPG, Gallow and Liza are two teenagers gifted with great powers, and that destiny seems to persist in keeping away from each other, however their feelings drive them close. Can the two of them have what it takes to preserve the world from the rise of the Blight?

Dans CRIMESIGHT, affrontez d'autres joueurs dans une simulation de prédiction des crimes ultrasophistiquée ! Aiderez-vous le machiavélique Moriarty, une IA criminelle, à commettre des crimes odieux ? Ou aiderez-vous l'IA Sherlock à déjouer les meurtres d'une main de maître ? À vous de choisir !
The original 3D wrestling sim takes you either side of the curtain in one epic shared universe - where you can either take shots in the ring as a wrestler or call the shots backstage as a booker!

Super Club Soccer is a tactical turn based football game. FIFA Pro Clubs meets turn based RPG. Create your player and begin competing in tactical online battles against users from around the globe, or hone your skills against our AI in single player action. Start your soccer story today!
A colorful dark retro-styled RPG adventure about Soul, Love and Emotion. Never lose faith in yourself!
SHAPIK: The Moon Quest — est une quête émouvante, dont l’histoire se déroule dans un univers mystérieux d’après guerre nucléaire.

Entre rêves et cauchemars, "Koloro" raconte l'histoire d'une jeune fille aux cheveux roses nommée Kora qui se lance dans une quête pour retrouver sa soeur disparue à travers un jeu de Puzzles et de Plateformes surprenant conçu par Sköll Studio.
你知道候鸟吗？候鸟有夏候鸟和冬候鸟之分。夏候鸟就是「春天来北方，秋天去南方」的鸟，他们一年四季都生活在很温暖的环境里，而冬候鸟……则是春天就飞向北方，飞到又远又冷的地方生活，冬季才返回的鸟。尽管它们可能会在同一个地方各自度过一生中一半的时光——却从来没有机会在一起。
Player is Ivanka Horny. Women fighter who needs to fight against hungry mens in this meme fighter

Even if you bear no Grudge, your Grudge was surely born. Explore the abandoned house at 77 Oleander, search for your wallet, keys, and phone, and above all else... try not to forget again the next time she tells you to leave.

titre: 最后的47小时 - The Last 47 Hours
description: "Let's break up in 47 hours!" The girl who has been in love with me for six years and  will become my sweet bride next month, now declares. Are we really going to say goodbye after forty-seven hours?
Minijeu où vous devez détruire des robots pour sauver le monde
CounterBlocks is an arcade-like rebellious block-breaking game that combines simple block-breaking and non-simple counter bullets.

Unique mix of Action, RTS and RPG gameplay elements that forms an innovative game genre. You can build base, manage troops, and then come down to keep your enemy at gunpoint in the dynamic battle and customize your main characters.

After Dreams is a story-rich exploration game based on real life experiences and events. The main focus of the story is to answer the basic human question that has pervaded our collective consciousness since sentience: What happens when we die?
An honest comedy about anxiety and feeling awkward, played through painfully relatable mini games.

La nature n'est pas pour les timorés, mais si vous travaillez dur et que vous apprenez à chasser, fabriquer ce dont vous avez besoin, exploiter votre environnement et vivre en communion avec elle, alors la vie au grand air et le statut de maître baroudeur vous tendront les bras.

You are no hero in this game.  You are just an average Joe.  Looking for teamwork? Heroic feat? Not here!  Be mean. Be dirty. Do what you got to do to survive.  Struggle to live.  Get the key. Get the gun.  Stay alive and escape.
An episodic Visual Novel about a Gamer and his life with cute girls.
The Cryptologist Room is a puzzle driven game that will test your cryptology skills to the limit! With the most difficult puzzles you can imagine! Are you able to escape the building in time?
A video game that plays like your favorite tabletop RPG game. With every roll, fate is placed in your hands.

I got a job as a night guard. They promise to pay a lot, but for my own safety I have to follow strange rules. As you progress, you'll have to find keys and open locked rooms. A first-person game with elements of horror. Explore the hospital and its rooms, collect batteries for your flashlight.

titre: Stranded Sails - Explorers of the Cursed Islands
description: Cultivez, cuisinez, fabriquez et décorez dans ce jeu relaxant en monde ouvert. Établissez votre campement après vous être échoués sur un mystérieux archipel. Vous devez survivre, explorer et découvrir les secrets des Îles Maudites. Gérez le moral de votre équipage et obtenez des récompenses.

The player will play the role of nine JiuTianXuannu, who will fight with many demons, meet and help the innocent in six different and interconnected worlds, and finally go deep into the hinterland of magic city to uncover the truth of the ancient mystery between magic seal city and Xuannu family.

Put yourself in the Front Office with Front Office Football, the professional football simulation from Solecismic Software. Manage your roster through trading, free agency and the amateur draft. Create game plans, organize depth charts and watch your franchise thrive for decades.

Sci-fi Visual Novel (Linear Story). A group of astronauts, scientists and robots is sent to space on a mission to investigate the disturbing disappearance of the first manned spaceship in its journey to Mars.

"Boiling Steel" - is a sci-fi story-based FPS VR shooter. You are one of many who set off in search of a better life in the distant bastion of scientific progress. Immerse yourself in the thick of events and witness the inexplicable global cataclysm.
Depuis l'humble village de campagne jusqu'à la métropole médiévale, construisez la cité de VOS rêves !

Pick 2 animals from a giant list, and the game will use an algorithm to morph them together! Each hybrid has its own unique stats and perks, and you test them against your friends in a natural-selection kind of way. There are millions of possibilities.
CatDog Puzzle - slide puzzle game. You need solve the puzzle as fast as you can.
In this old-school RPG, you are the Child of Hope.
VOUS êtes le Héros de la Forêt de la Malédiction ! Explorez la forêt maléfique du livre-jeu de Ian Livingstone !
Liberation Day will come... but you will be betrayed. Experience the stunning continuation of Sunrider Mask of Arcadius in this hardcore turn based tactics game with heavy story elements.
Maze Blaze is filled with endless possibilities. Lock and load, then enter at your own peril.

"Drive me crazy" is a game inspired by the urban legend "Yua Mikami's wedding and retirement event." You play as her fiancé, qiangzi, in this interactive adventure. During the game, you will be asked one question: "With Yua Mikami by your side, would you still have a change of heart?"
Puzzle through different difficulty levels and hazards. Collect fruit to increase your tail segments. Avoid the pokey bits and explosions. Also, don't run into yourself.

Δ Time (Delta Time) is a third person game which takes place in space in a lit artsy pixelated style. Time moves only when you move, so prepare yourself for a thrilling slow motion experience. Take your time and fight in style! :)
Popap - is a simple puzzle game. Your task is to get the green cube, avoiding the traps, to the finish line.

Achetez, vendez et échangez des organes dans un univers étrange et en constante évolution. Plongez dans les entrailles frémissantes du capitalisme extraterrestre avec ce jeu de science-fiction qui simule un marché d'horreurs corporelles étrangement fascinant.

An immersive, animated VR film. Crafted by the artists, animators and storytellers of Penrose Studios, “The Rose And I” is about loneliness, friendship, love, and loss. Come meet a lonely Rose living in the unlikeliest of places, and join her as she transports you to a brand new universe.

Dans Copoka, vous êtes un oiseau qui vole en toute liberté au-dessus de la cité-état totalitaire de Copoka. Votre but est de trouver et de ramasser des petites branches pour fabriquer votre nid. À mesure que le nid croît, une histoire d'intrigues politiques se déploie.

Envoyez vos chevaliers en quête de fraternité et de rédemption dans The Valiant, un jeu de stratégie en temps réel (RTS) dans l’Europe et le Moyen-Orient du XIIIe siècle. Découvrez une campagne solo épique et profitez du multijoueur en ligne, en coop et en compétitif.
Au début de la guerre civile, Iron Man est à la tête du mouvement Pro-recensement tandis que Captain America est le fer de lance du mouvement anti-recensement.
A thrilling parkour game where you play as a lost soul. your mission is keep climbing up, and run up the stairway to heaven before you disperse and disappear. Single player or two local players.

Sois prêt pour des courses à grande vitesse contre des pilotes AI expérimentés, sur des circuits grandioses et futuristes! Combats tes ennemis avec des canons intégrés et des armes pick-up spéciales! Développe et pilote différents racers sur la Terre et dans l'espace!

One night The Grandfather went to give his wife a good night kiss, she ignored him as usual, this broke his heart every night. He went to sleep in his own bed, full of misery as usual, but this night would turn out to be different than the others.
Redie is a challenging singleplayer 3D top-down shooter. Fight an army of well-trained terrorists and soldiers in action-packed close quarters combat. Prepare to (re)die.

titre: Midnight Mysteries 3: Devil on the Mississippi
description: Près du profond et boueux Mississippi, il y a quelque chose qui ne tourne pas rond. Une nouvelle conspiration nous est dévoilée dans ce nouvel épisode de Midnight Mystery se déroulant dans un bateau à vapeur fantomatique.
Help Short Legs Bill find his rum!
Frayez-vous un chemin dans ce jeu comico-enigmo-aventuresque

Ce jeu combine des éléments de roguelike et de construction de son paquet de cartes. Au cours de la partie, vous devez vous efforcer de récupérer des cartes pour construire un jeu unique et l'utiliser pour vaincre les ennemis qui se trouvent sur votre chemin.

Lorsque votre vaisseau spatial s'écrase sur une planète inconnue, vous vous frayez un chemin à travers ses couloirs sombres et déroutants. En utilisant seulement vos mains et votre esprit, serez-vous capable de résoudre ses chambres et explorer ce qui est au-delà?

The Walking Evil takes you to the great classic of the survival horror of the 90s, where you guide the main character with a fixed system of cameras, which enhances the feeling of being in a real horror movie.

Dans ce jeu de puzzle 2D, vous avez la responsabilité de ranger vos amis félins d'une manière qui corresponde à la grille. Cat Organized Neatly contient 80 niveaux faits à la main avec tout un paquet de chats de toutes formes et de toutes tailles.
Ceci est un jeu de stratégie très conscience

"Tempter" is a suspenseful first-person horror game that shows how humans can be even more dangerous than demons when they gain power. It centers on the struggle to save one's soul against a demon after breaking a pact.

Demons Never Lie is a creepy graphic adventure made with voxel and low-poly where even your soul is at stake! An incredible and dark story with elements of the classic point&click and visual novels. An exciting interactive experience with a unique atmosphere.
What happens when warriors, worlds and different times decide to face each other to know who is the best? The "ARENA 8", a place where these warriors can solve their differences.
Come! Indulge yourselves in your own private den and create sweet and loving memories with her!

16-bit RPG magic is back! Can you stop the Wastelands from spreading and overtaking the world? Play as Marcus, Bastien and Fela, 3 army conscripts with little liking for their new life, yet who find themselves engulfed in a mystery that could very well cause the demise of their nation.

Action RPG Shooter with Base Management elements, featuring AI NPCs. Take charge of an abandoned outpost, explore a lush alien planet, battle fierce creatures, gather resources, and upgrade your base as you develop your character and bring dozens of distinct weapons to bear.

Strategic Mind: Blitzkrieg est un jeu de stratégie durant la Seconde Guerre Mondiale. Il apporte un regard morderne au genre wargame. Vous devez diriger les forces Allemandes, surmonter des obstacles impensables et remporter la victoire ultime contre l'Europe. Le Blitzkrieg est le meilleur moyen !

titre: Pixel Boy and the Ever Expanding Dungeon
description: Pixel Boy and the ever expanding dungeon is an Action-RPG Shoot-em-up with dynamically generated stages across twenty levels and four acts each with an epic boss. Players can stack and combine power ups into over 6000 different powerful weapons as well as craft custom armours to overcome the dangers of the dungeon.

NOUS AVONS DES EXTRATERRESTRES, PAS VOUS — Affrontez envahisseurs martiens et soucoupes volantes sur 30 niveaux, avec des voix robotiques. Utilisez votre bouclier destructible, sauvez des soldats pour des points bonus et visez le meilleur score.

Clandestine is a 2-player or singleplayer stealth/hacking game set in 1996. Asymmetrical co-op allows one player to take the role of the spy while a friend provides overwatch and assistance as the hacker, and unravel a post-Cold War espionage conspiracy.
Dérive dans la ville avec le jeu multijoueur tofas sahin.
You are a slime trying to traverse the labs with your ability to jump, shoot, control projectile speed, and equip fancy hats and weapons what could possibly go wrong.

<p>Vivez l'intensité de la course moto avec Ducati World Championship. Choisissez votre machine parmi 70 modèles originaux : ils sont tous à votre disposition !</p> <p>4 catégories différentes : Classique, Sport, Route et Grand Prix. 34 circuits vous attendent avec de nombreux prix à gagner et des extras à déverrouiller.
你有没有一段时间，无论如何都提不起精神来，总以为离开这里会变好，换了个环境却没有任何改变。 觉得自己做的事情毫无意义，只想做“自己想做的事情”，却连什么是“自己想做的事情”都不知道。 害怕自己的人生就这么平淡的结束，但却一直没有找到改变的契机……

This is a third person shooter game The main plot is a secret experiment being conducted somewhere in the future During this process, a strange mineral was discovered and caused a large-scale infection The protagonist's task is to retrieve important "files" and escape from this place!
