Race over completely randomised tracks through space! With two different Game Modes to choose from, countless ways to customise your Golem and even a Path Creator, you'll never - Rumble Run - out of ways to play! Host a party and invite your friends! Are you the Superior Rumble Runner?

titre: Bunny Must Die! Chelsea and the 7 Devils
description: Le créateur de la Collection Gundemonium a créé un nouveau plateau d'action 2D palpitant ! Aidez Bunny à s'échapper du labyrinthe des démons et à vaincre les 7 démons dans ce jeu de plates-formes d'action hilarant. Combattez sur une grande carte connectée remplie d'ennemis uniques, de pièges et de puzzles.

Reptiles: In Hunt vous offre l'opportunité d'affronter de dangereux dinosaures dans un monde en ruines. Chassez, explorez, obtenez des ressources, construisez de nouvelles armes et combattez les énormes reptiles et les dangereux reptiliens qui ont détruit la civilisation humaine.

titre: Eye of the Temple: First Steps
description: This introduction to Eye of the Temple lets you step into a vast and treacherous temple in VR using your own feet. Keep your balance as you step from one moving block to another, dodging traps and solving puzzles with your torch and whip in hand.
Recrutez une équipe de free lancers féroces et découvrez un gameplay rogue-lite comme jamais avant ! La toute nouvelle constellation d'ennemis, d'attributs et de butin rend chaque course unique.

Courez au rythme de votre propre musique ! Melody est de retour, avec des algorithmes d'analyse audio largement améliorés. Chaque MP3 génére un parcours d'obstacles unique, synchronisé sur le tempo et l'intensité de votre musique.

Dirigez une équipe de chasseurs de fantômes et délivrez Londres de la terreur provoquée par différents phénomènes paranormaux dans des combats intenses ! Suivez une stratégie efficace et développez votre entreprise !

Husk est un jeu de survie-horreur inspiré des grands classiques du genre. Découvrez Shivercliff, une bourgade lugubre où vous dévoilerez une intrigue sinistre et captivante. Affrontez les pires cauchemars, chassez-les, résolvez des mystères et survivez aux ténèbres dévorantes pour retrouver votre famille.
You take on the role of a house sitter tasked with completing chores while surviving 5 nightmarish nights until 6 AM. The catch? You're not alone.

In Where is my Heart? you play the story of a family of forest spirits. The family lives comfortably in a tree in the woods until one day they lose their home and thus embark on a great adventure. Their journey will take them through the mushroom caves and even deeper down to the lifeless crystal pools and back up into the mountains.

Reverie Knights Tactics is a turn-based tactical RPG with strategic battles in isometric grids where every decision can alter the story. Travel through a hand-drawn fantasy world and lead your heroes in a story-rich adventure, visual novel style!

titre: The Reject Demon: Toko Chapter 0 — Prelude
description: When a human is destined to die, the demons ferry their souls to the afterlife. ‘The Reject Demon: Toko’ is the story of Toko herself, a demon who has been kicked out of hell. Toko cannot ferry human souls to the underworld, and every day she stays on earth has her becoming increasingly human.
Capsule is a challenging VR escape game developed for the HTC Vive and Valve Index.

Ravenmark: Scourge of Estellion is a turn-based wargame, where strategic troop placement is essential to succeed, but this is just one of the many choices you will face while fighting your way through your many battles!
Use virtual reality to enter a fictional open comic world, freely experience a horrible time with black and white comics, explore the story of each character and their respective destiny and ending

You will play a telepath named James. He has the ability to connect with the soul thus he can understand their past. He was hired to explore what happened in the previous 20 years in a haunted house This is the puzzle game!

"Half Billion" is a surreal simulation business interactive game, where you will complete the entrepreneurial journey with a start-up capital of half billion. Six beauty enter your life. How will you balance the relationship? Note that "wealth" and "likability" will jointly determine the your story.
studio: 东阳开局互动影视有限公司

description: Control two independent pixels as you avoid any and all obstacles in the crazily hard and addictive game that is Twixel!

Gérez une des 80 équipes à travers plus de 260 courses et 700 étapes. De la stratégie au recrutement, vous êtes seul pour prendre les bonnes décisions. Profitez d’encore plus de réalisme et d’authenticité grâce aux nouveautés 2021.

Have you ever faced your worst nightmare? What if you have no choice but to move on and see what’s behind it? Then you’d better arm yourself with a couple of big guns, stock up on ammo and show them all what a real nightmare is!
When you discover that the Serpent of Chaos is trying to destroy Egypt, will you stand against him, or will you help spread his eternal darkness?

Quelque chose a disparu. Entrez dans une nouvelle Grille, forgez des alliances en faisant des choix judicieux et découvrez la vérité en résolvant les casse-têtes des Disques d'identité. Prenez des décisions cruciales et tracez votre propre route dans un monde sans créateur.

Welcome to the wonderful *New* world of Nuumonsters! A short, retro-style Creature Collector RPG — play as Yana or Yasaka and battle your way through the Hana region, with 70+ creatures to catch and train!

Tout comme dans la série, la coopération est au cœur de Stranger Things 3 : Le Jeu. Les fans pourront faire équipe en mode coopération à deux joueurs pour explorer l'univers d'Hawkins, résoudre des énigmes et affronter les forces maléfiques du Monde à l'Envers en incarnant un des douze personnages bien-aimés de la série.
You are apt - this is a fascinating shooter in which you need to destroy objects and prevent them from falling down. Test your reaction, prudence and try not to drop objects. How accurate are you?
Phat Phrog is an all new one of a kind free to play, physics based addictive arcade game that puts your reflexes and skills to the test (and also your patience).

The title says it all. Take one part falling block puzzle game, combine one part old-school platformer, add a couple thousand pixels, blend and serve. Why match colored blocks when you can just shoot the hell out of them? Your goal is to survive as long as you can. From celebrated indie developer Andrew Morrish and Adult Swim Games.

"We are food, but not for long." The Zombie apocalypse has come, and your squad is the last line of defense. Command a Special Forces unit with high-tech weaponry in this mission-based FPS with sprawling indoor and outdoor environments.
Join Margo on her quest to discover the joy that food brings to others, and the memories gathered around sharing a treat with loved ones!

Explore an intriguing world in The Book of Desires, a thrilling Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game! Ashley had a horrible dream where she traveled to a strange world. When she awoke she realized it was just a nightmare, but her reality turns out to be just as scary...

Perception est un jeu d’horreur à la première personne qui raconte les aventures de Cassie, une jeune femme aveugle qui doit utiliser son extraordinaire audition et son esprit vif pour résoudre les mystères qui entourent le manoir abandonné qui hante ses rêves.

titre: SAD RPG: A Social Anxiety Role Playing Game
description: SAD RPG : A Social Anxiety Role Playing Game is an experimental indie computer RPG game about social anxiety. It's an unexpectedly colourful, weird and full of surprises journey with our own story about dealing with Social Anxiety Disorder.

You died. Welcome to XING: The Land Beyond, an atmospheric first-person puzzle adventure for desktops and virtual reality. Enjoy your peaceful escape from the chaotic world of the living, and travel the lands of the dead.

Black River is a Survival-Horror RPG worth 3-5 hours of intense gameplay where you ultimately have to turn the table on those who want to harm you. It is not about escaping the village of Black River, it's about putting an end to its misery!

Chased by Darkness est une horreur de survie en coopération pour 1 à 4 joueurs. Votre mission est d'affronter des entités surnaturelles et de les bannir sur le plan spirituel. Explorez, combattez les ennemis et ne laissez pas les ténèbres vous atteindre.

Star Merc is an open world rpg where player choices heavily affect outcomes and drastically change the storyline. The game is about exploring different planets, learning about the inhabitants and dealing with the different factions that like to think they control the universe.

Rebots est un jeu de gestion de ressources à la première personne dans lequel vous devrez terraformer des astéroïdes pour des aliens exigeants. Partez à la découverte de nombreux biomes, récoltez des ressources grâce à l'automatisation de bots, et répondez aux besoins de vos clients !
2DGameManias Taken is a 2.5D retro platform game in which you have been Taken by the unknown and you need to fight your way to freedom.

Un jeu de stratégie se déroulant dans un univers sombre d'Orques, d'Elfes et Dragons. Kingdom Wars 2 combine le meilleur de la survie et l'artisanat avec la construction de villes. Participez à des batailles de siège qui transforment de magnifiques paysages en champs de bataille.

At last, the Queen has given you power and freedom! The cost? You must rebuild her Empire. Will you? In this epic, indie fantasy adventure, you are free to explore, fight for fame and power, and shape the world as you choose. Escape into an unpredictable open-ended story and cunning tactical combat.

The best software to update, backup, clean, and monitor the drivers and devices of your PC. Update drivers, delete unused drivers, back up drivers, and uninstall disconnected devices to keep your computer reliable and up to date.

Ultimate Ragdoll Game est un jeu Sandbox sans limites. Amusez-vous avec plusieurs ragdolls disponibles sur la Workshop Steam et construisez vos propres constructions en utilisant une large variété de blocs.
70s giant robot anime-inspired side-scrolling shooting from the creators of SATAZIUS and GIGANTIC ARMY!

In ancient Japan, a young samurai watches as his people and his Master are massacred by the hands of the Demon King. He swears vengeance and invokes the power of the Witch... Thus begins the pursuit of the Demon King through space and time - a bloody crusade where there is no turning back...
Four nerds walk into a dungeon. It’s not a joke, it’s Doom & Destiny Advanced.

Fight off the Ember invasion as they arrive in action packed waves while you try to defend your world from impending doom. Battle the Ember as an astute Mage, stalwart Paladin, devout Priest, or crafty Rogue and defend your world from the Ember.
Janus VR - Virtual Reality Internet Browser Build, browse and socialize in the Immersive Internet - Janus VR is the internet like you've never seen it before.
Yoel, a novice soldiers finds himself entangled with the war and the prophecy, freshly out of the academy he jumps not only right into war but also into the Prophecy itself.

Did you ever wake up in the middle of the night because you heard the cat meowing? This game is just about that! Meet a family with five naughty cats and solve puzzles while trying to convince them to sleep.
Last Laugh is a horror game that tells the story of the fate of 3 teenagers who often bully their classmates.

ERSATZ is a speed focused Hardcore Action Platformer with a musical twist! Featuring an Original Electronic Soundtrack also by Paris Stalker, the game's creator, hear and feel the music build as you progress and hazards, obstacles, boss attacks & controller vibrations move to the ever present beat!
Cryohazard is a spooky turn-based strategy rogue-lite. Pilot an upgradeable train caravan into the depths of the hazardous Soul Storm. Fight off the angels that give chase.
Collect food, weapons and materials, face enemies and make difficult moral choices that will affect the gameplay.
Bouncing Ball has come 3D!

The Broken Moon Execution is a text-based fast-passing supernatural puzzle game. Game play is diverse, players need to explore through the map, collect various clues to solve the mystery, and gradually understand the truth of the collapse of "Samle" ......

It is a Japanese visual novel game. It is a game to read texts. Enjoy the story of anguish, conflict, dreams and hope. There is no branching depending on the choices, but you can have a rich story experience like a movie.

titre: Odd Adventure of Chub, Color, 23 and You
description: Very funny, very short and very sweet text adventure game about Chub, Color, 23 and You.
Drive a tank, destroy enemy, defend your homeland. Act alone or co-op with a friend and have fun!
Challenge the Dragon and free the Kingdom!

Backrooms: The Deep Dark is a 4-player cooperative horror game where you will survive in a mysterious scary atmospheric world, wander through unknown dark corners and get scared of every nook and cranny!

Fight and make your way through the world of Akinori in this strategic turn-based RPG! Defeat powerful enemies, complete the intriguing story mode, upgrade your character, unlock new skills and join the fray!

titre: Secret Agent Wizard Boy and the International Crime Syndicate
description: Vous êtes un sorcier ! Mais aussi un agent secret. Le vilain syndicat du crime S.P.I.D.E.R a mis la main sur votre école, semant le chaos. Jouez en solo ou en coop jusqu'à 4 joueurs et affrontez des étudiants en duel, dévoilez d'anciens secrets et lancez des sorts scandaleux.

Robots have torn open a portal to invade earth, everyone has mysteriously disappeared, the world has begun to tear apart. Sprint across the skies of robot-invaded Earth as you try to end the invasion.

titre: Unsolved Case: Scénario meurtrière Édition Collector
description: La vie d'un détective est imprévisible et très dangereuse. Vous ne savez jamais ce qui vous attend au prochain coin de rue et quels secrets vous devez élucider. Mais si vous saviez dans quoi vous vous embarquez, vous ne pourriez plus revenir en arrière !
Enter the battle between four factions fighting to control the future of humanity.

IfSunSets est un jeu RPG de survie sur une île mystérieuse. Le jour, explorez l'île pour trouver des ressources. La nuit, affrontez des monstres terrifiants qui vous traquent. Utilisez les ressources pour construire une base et renforcer votre refuge.

Based off the hit game Bomberman initially developed in 1983, Multibombers takes the concept to an all-new perspective featuring a unique first-person mode with the inclusion of multiplayer for you and three other buddies to have a night of fun.
Malus is an Isometric Action RPG game aiming to bring back the nostalgic feeling of Diablo 1 but with a unique combat system.

The space war started here and now! The victory depends only on you and all your years as a gamer. Show what you are capable of and destroy everything by writing quickly and correctly! "The keyboard is your weapon!"

titre: 位面穿越者-三国传(A Bit Crosser-Three Kingdoms)
description: This is a RPG game of training multi heros , you could collect as many as forty generals to fight together , you would unlock more generals under attacking city and develop it ,Collect special weapons from special events。co-ordinate the different generals to beat the boss .

Chaos Starter is a fight simulator with realistic physics. You are going to find yourself in different life situations, and every time you will have to start a chaos. No matter where are you and what you are doing, your only task is to spoil the event and initiate a brawl.

Pars ŕ l'aventure dans la peau d'un petit carré n'ayant qu'un seul oeil et traverse des grottes remplies de puzzles, d'énigmes et de casse-tętes ! Découvre 63 niveaux et l'éditeur de niveau dans le Workshop de Steam !

The government has been attacked by unidentified creatures, and you, as a mercenary, was hired by the government to clear all the threat. An FPS game which you can fight with those cunning creatures regardless of the weather, day and night change. Earn more and more reward to buy better weapons!

The Dark Stares Back pins you against multiple invaders with no purpose but to hunt you. Each of them behaves in their own unique way and you must learn from your experience to evade them long enough to win. You can run into the vents, hide in cabinets, duck behind furniture and more to survive.
This game centers on monster hunting, equipment collection, random talents, gear enhancement, and top-tier loot drops.

Simply Parkour is built of upon a Beautiful Simplistic World of Platforming Areas for Endless Running & Unique Movement for First Person Parkour. Titled Simply Parkour. Don't fall off or you will have to start over again, stay on rooftops and traverse through puzzles to beat the game.

The Kokurase gang, also known as Cupid’s Helpers, is out to help freshman Sakura woo Yoshimitsu, a popular senior with every other girl in school vying for his heart. Switch between members to bring these two lovebirds together in an intertwining tale.

titre: Horde de morts-vivants : Conquérant des ténèbres
description: Morts-vivants contre Alliance en JcE de contrôle de zone

BASIC ROGUE is a turn-based dungeon crawler. You have very limited inventory space, skills, weapons, armor, and stats which all need to be managed while fighting enemies, gathering treasure, and figuring out what your primary objective is. This game will appeal to players looking for a challenge.
洪荒是一款非常非常非常肝的文字素材类游戏，游戏中没有华丽的美术，闪亮亮的特效，完全以放置挂机的数值玩法为驱动，养成依靠打书、炼妖、修炼、构筑装备品质词条等搭配数百名不同的角色，在其中玩家更能够通过放置挂机获得宝物与资源，拥有各种神话传说中的角色，然后将获得的物品角色与其他玩家进行交易来养成自己最强的阵容。

Experience the UFO abduction in first person and take a trip to meet the keeper. Explore layers of reality and learn what is concealed behind the modern Unidentified Anomalous Phenomenon (UAP) in this esthetic and eerie interactive experience.
Battle orc clans and survive deadly dungeons while leveling up as an adventurer. Will you become a fighter, wizard, cleric or rogue?
Le démon Rocketman et son armée ont kidnappé la femme de Terzonator. Vous devez donc collecter des armes, détruire l'armée et le chef démon pour resque votre femme
Play an exciting 2D old-school RPG in the classic style of Valiant - Resurrection by the same developers.
Pinball Simulator vous replonge dans les années 80-90: néons, bruit de verres, ambiance arcade. Maîtrisez les flippers, battez les scores et revivez la magie des salles de jeux d’antan.
It's a dark night in the forest, and something is lurking just beyond the trees. Can you find Bigfoot before he finds you?

Brother Wings is a shoot up jet fighter game with vertical scrolling. In this game the player can choose between controlling Marko or Guida, brothers and pilots. The game has two forms, infinity and time attack, both with several ships and types of villains to face.

titre: 420BLAZEIT 2: GAME OF THE YEAR -=Dank Dreams and Goated Memes=- [#wow/11 Like and Subscribe] Poggerz Edition
description: Prepare yourself for the long awaited sequel. You will 360. You will noscope. You will see some weird af s*** on your quest to destroy the Illuminati and rescue the memes. Are you ready for 420BLAZEIT 2????!!1

Enjoy uncapped health and deploy-able shields for intense action. "Perfect Plan" is a first-person shooter combining shoot 'em up and platforming. Take on a solo robot's mission to rob a bank and defeat Multiple crazy hard bosses while unlocking a variety of guns, special items and shield upgrades.

A classic RPG experience with modern strategic battle mechanics. There are over 20 classes to unlock, with the ability to assign sub-classes. Explore the world of Alterra with an array of dynamic characters, and gain allies to help turn the tides of the ongoing fight between humans and elves.
"Première jeu de plateforme à son meilleur !" Construct: Escape the System est une plate-forme de jeu de science-fiction qui vous voit piégé dans un système informatique, essayant de vous échapper.
You find yourself stuck in a cave with nothing but your wit... and a pickaxe! As you climb your way out you'll find this is no ordinary cave.
Super Switch is a difficult platformer in which you have to actively switch between 2 dimensions. It's tougher than iron and extremely rewarding.
S'échapper ou mourir et découvrir ce qui se passe.

New Home : Medieval Village est un jeu de construction et de gestion de ville médiévale. Construisez des routes, zonez vos maisons, entreprises et terres agricoles pour attirer des villageois. Accédez à leurs besoins, éduquez-les et gardez les en sécurité afin de bâtir une colonie tentaculaire!

ETERNAL MAZEFind the map, find the monoliths, avoid the dogs and survive to escape from the mazes! Inspired by crop circles, Eternal Maze is a puzzle adventure game about a farmer who is trapped in corn mazes.

Aidez Dr. Fetus à créer un clone de Meat Boy parfait dans ce jeu d’association de tuiles unique en son genre. Comme dans Meat Boy, vous devrez traverser une myriade de pièges vicieux et mortels pour remporter la victoire. Ce jeu mettra vos capacités et vos nerfs à rude épreuve.

Masks of Deception is a 6 player horror game where you must use teamwork, equipment, and sensing abilities to identify then exorcize the demon in your group... otherwise the demon will slay you first.
Stratégie de chars pas à pas avec combats 5 contre 5. PVP pour intelligents!
Speechless is a first-person psychological horror experience focused on atmosphere, emotional storytelling, repetition, and environmental transformation

Jump, skip, hop and leap! Go as far as your little wheel can take you! Play as a little delivery bot from a far-flung future controlled by the monolithic "MARE" corporation, and find your way back home through the perilous deserts, dead forests, and untold wild lands that lie ahead.

Enfilez les chaussures d’un policier dans "Amber Alert TOTAL VR", un jeu d’horreur VR difficile. Répondant à un appel nocturne, vous découvrez une secte sinistre de femmes ravisseuses. Sauver une fille captive. Naviguez dans des rues périlleuses, évitez les membres de la secte et survivez.
Use custom crosshairs for all your games, enjoy both fullscreen and desktop crosshairs for other window modes.
The forest holds many secrets...
the classic minesweep gameplay with quality backgrounds and nice look

Welcome to Dreadlands! A perilous landscape brimming with potential in the form of Glow. Command one of 3 unique factions in this turn-based tactical RPG and play through their campaigns, be it solo or Co-Op, or battle it out in PvP. So far no one has tamed the Dreadlands. Will you be the first?

Combattez des extraterrestres géants, façon La Guerre des mondes, qui envahissent la Finlande au cours d'un hiver des années 90. Formez une armée de villageois dans un jeu chaotique semi-autobattler de type roguelike. Parcourez les biomes pour anéantir ces ennemis d'autres dimensions cosmiques.
The most boring game ever made.

100ft Robot Golf is a fast-paced arcade golf game where you get to control impossibly large robots on their quest for par. Just swing your golf club to smash even the tallest buildings out of the way - or into the way of your robot golfing buddies.
Linelight is an elegant puzzle game set in a world of lines.
Bienvenue dans un univers sombre mais chaleureux ! Obscurity est un petit jeu 2D où l'objectif est de délivrer votre petite créature !
Boy meets girl against a backdrop of magical battles in a dramatic visual novel!

titre: Queen's Quest 3: The End of Dawn
description: Devenez un vrai alchimiste !

A loving echo of games from the 80's and familiar to those who loved classics such as Lunar Rescue and Lunar Lander. Swing on a thread from your mothership and thrust safely down to rescue some of those poor guys on the planet, then try to escape safely.

“The Hurt in Secret” is a visual novel game adapted from true events. Players play a role as practice teacher to experience teachers’ life. They will involve in a troublesome case. In the story, the chosen dialogue will affect directly to the ending.
Battle against your friends and loved ones in Kill Ball! Score a goal and get an explosive bullet to kill your opponent. The first player to reach three kills wins the game and all the glory.
Play hide-and-seek with friends online, hide from the monster, or play as a monster and catch other players. Get scared, have fun, collect points, buy upgrades, and most importantly, have fun.
I Am Overburdened est un roguelike au tour par tour déjanté plein d'artefacts totalement fous et un "héros" qui a 20 emplacements d'inventaire.

Marchez dans les traces d'Alfred Fox, un détective privé qui a l'art de s'attirer des ennuis et affrontez le danger qui menace votre ex : Barbara LePurr. En utilisant votre intuition et des techniques d'investigation, vous suivrez l'intrigue et ferez face à plusieurs conséquences parfois mortelles.
Pingers is an addictive 'one-more-round' score chaser which is perfect to play solo or with friends. Ping your way to victory and see just how far you can get!
DarkFairyTales SleepingBeauty is a jigsaw puzzle game.

Are strategy games with strong RPG elements your cup of tea? Did you enjoy games like Xcom: UFO Defence, the Fallout series, the Civilization series, the Heroes of Might and magic? And now you are looking for something new to satisfy your craving for turn-based fun?
HexLab is a logical game with a relaxing atmosphere and original gameplay.

Sacred Earth - Promise is a four- to six-hour visual novel/RPG experience set within a fantasy world of floating continents and ancient ruins, with a dynamic custom battle system and a compelling cast of characters.

Mofina Island is a slow paced survival/ adventure game, where you will need to try and solve the mysteries of the island as well as survive on your own. Gather food and other resources, build tools and other items and use your GAME BUD System to defend yourself of the scary ghost attacks!

Blackout Rugby est un jeu de management de rugby moderne, multijoueur, social et de classe mondiale. Prenez le contrôle d'un club de rugby novice, plaquez, esquivez et frayez-vous un chemin vers la gloire.
The phone rings. Ninja’s ‘R’ Us answer the call off of a multi-millionaire whose daughter has been kidnapped. Scanning the books, the ninja for hire company realise there is only one unit available.
1000 adorable sheep!The popular single-player card game Shephy, is now available on Steam.

Vous vous retrouvez derrière l'impressionnante puissance de feu d'un canon de pont anti-aérien de 40 mm à l'avant d'un navire de guerre. Votre mission est de repousser l'assaut sans fin des attaquants ennemis déterminés à couler votre navire de guerre.

Lock and Load! It's time to Kick-Ass. Grab your machine gun, flamethrower, rocket launcher, and grenades. Assault the enemy base and free commandos to join your team while you destroy everything in sight. Make your way through enemy bunkers to rescue your comrades, and kill everyone you encounter!

Prove yourself and earn your wings in the Exphelius Championships - a reckless bloodsport of vehicular mayhem across the galaxy Exphelius. Win matches across multiple game modes to earn cash and new parts, upgrade your ships or buy new ones, and claim your way to the top.
Climb, fall, be verbally abused, repeat.
Sci-fi 2D-adventure game. Help the genius scientist go back in time and make his main dream come true. On the way monsters, riddles and unexpected allies will be waiting for you.
Physics-based aerial batball game. Online multiplayer. 1v1 to 3v3. A mix of many sports. Baseball, tennis, hockey, golf and nfl. Maybe even more. Added melee and tackles.
THE WORLD IS ENDING AND THE GODS ARE SQUABBLING! Suck up and launch dialogue in a world of puzzles, puppets, and weird gods… or THE RIFT WILL CONSUME US ALL!
The Initiate is a mystery puzzle game. You awake in a house full of traps and puzzles - This is your trial; complete it, or die!

titre: Samsa and the Knights of Light
description: BE THE HERO; OR NOT....IT'S UP TO YOU!Samsa and the Knights of Light is a RPG game, with 2D retro-style.
Pick up your pickaxe!!!Make your inference, use the best strategy and highest speed, DIG THEM ALL!!!
The World’s First ‘Arcadified Trading' game! Learn or level up stock trading and technical analysis skills while playing a video game!
Frenetic arcade style twin-stick shooter. Fight your way through hordes of enemies alone or with a friend!

This action platformer takes place on the asteroids of far away worlds. You have to jump from asteroid to asteroid in 30+ mind bending levels in order to get through the level as fast as possible. Normal Game Mode - More that 30 handcrafted levels.

titre: Barrow Hill: Curse of the Ancient Circle
description: Somewhere deep within the woods of Cornwall, a timeless force is stirring. Unseen beneath the ancient burial mound, known locally as Barrow Hill, a forgotten myth awakens. Use archaeology to discover that the barrow is more than just a collection of forgotten standing stones.

Shu est un magnifique jeu de plates-formes en 2,5D se déroulant dans un superbe monde captivant. Guidez Shu et toute une troupe de personnages dessinés à la main pendant qu’ils courent, sautent et planent au travers de terres exotiques, tout en étant constamment poursuivis par l’Orage monstrueux interminable.

A 2D narrative-focused strategic RPG with visual novel elements. You play as Willow Wisp, a campfire spirit who guides a group of amateur adventurers in harnessing the warm magic of self love to fend off the Frost that surrounds them.
Play snowballs? In May? Why not!

Svoboda 1945: Liberation is a unique adventure game featuring dialogues with real actors. Talk to witnesses of the chaotic aftermath of World War 2 and discover the secret history of your own family in a captivating story about reconciliation with the dark past.

Mini Tone est un jeu de puzzle minimaliste qui combine notes musicales et intuition physique. Trouvez l’angle et le point de lancement parfaits pour supprimer tous les blocs musicaux de chaque niveau. Serez-vous capable d’exécuter la trajectoire parfaite?

In the doomsday Hotel, you can experience the hard life in the waste Land World. Stick to hope in motel-based doomsday shelters and fight survival challenges such as hunger, thirst and lack of energy. Risking their lives to collect supplies, develop and build hotel shelters. Do everything possible to survive the cataclysmic world.
When the storms of nature threaten her very existence, the viewer must help a young shepherd girl take on the responsibilities of her deceased papá.
This is the Story of the once glorious Kingdom of Bellion. Ann, a time traveler from the future, fights to save the King from his fate to die.

Forsake est un jeu de survie d'horreur de 1 à 4 joueurs où vous incarnez un groupe d'explorateurs urbains. Choisissez votre équipement pour explorer des lieux protégés par des entités et exorcisez-les, si vous en êtes capables !
Dodge your way through the crucible of fire! Crucible is a 2D, high-action, top-down shooter game.

Deviens un pionnier de l'espace en construisant et gérant ta propre station dans l'orbite d'une planète reculée ! Concentre-toi sur la conception et la gestion ou atteins des objectifs pour progresser. Explore, construis et prospère !
Rule the Waves III is a simulation of naval ship design and construction, fleet management and naval warfare from 1890 to 1970.

Explorez un monde lovecraftien dévasté en solo ou jusqu'à 5 joueurs. Dirigez et faites évoluer votre train sentient effroyable, forgez des armes, obtenez des pouvoirs et affrontez les Grands Anciens. Découvrez un monde en constante évolution, gardez la raison et atteignez le statut de divinité !
Mutants and monsters unleash maniacal carnage on the gridiron in this crazy gore fest of arcade-style football. Packed full of humor, intense online multiplayer action, and strategy.

Stones Keeper: Director's Cut est un RPG tactique au tour par tour se déroulant dans un univers unique dessiné à la main. Constituez une escouade de combattants hors du commun, élevez votre propre forteresse dans les cieux et menez l’Ordre du Griffon dans une guerre pour l’avenir du royaume.

Onechanbara Z2: Chaos is the latest entry in the Onechanbara series. Two sets of buxom vampire sisters battle through over a dozen stages of high-octane real-time swordplay. Fight off the invasion in gruesome detail, occasionally transforming into a demon for short bursts of added power and speed.
A combination of action and rhythm games, players need to move characters while entering corresponding keys.
Become the master of puzzles by mastering three types of puzzle Falling shapes, Swap Attack, slide portraits and facing challenges to become the best.

An indie tower defense that combines elements of CCG and RPG. Use your deck to defend reality from hordes of invaders. During five acts, you will encounter a variety of enemies, well-designed levels, hundreds of different items, five difficulty levels, a crafting system, challenges and much more!
Agni Fighter is a vertical scroll flight shooting game with future technology pictures. In the game, the player will control a fighter to fight over the city.

Les plateformes 2D et les puzzles ont fusionné en un seul jeu à cause d'une turbulence cosmique ! Bascule entre Toodi et Topdi pour voir le monde de leurs points de vue, relève des défis, creuse-toi la tête pour résoudre les casse-tête et anéantis de redoutables boss. Oh ! Et il y a un mode coop !
Defeat your enemies with the power of love, friendship, and violent military aggression in Magellania, a hardcore tactics-RPG set in outer space.

Investiguez un poste de traite abandonné, explorez ses alentours et décelez le terrible mystère qui s'y cache. Le Murmureur est un court jeu narratif en pointer-cliquer qui se déroule au Bas-Canada au début du 19e siècle.

Dans un monde envahi par les morts- vivants, construisez un laboratoire pour riposter avec à la science ! Gérez les survivants, rassemblez des ressources vitales et transformez les zombies en alliés. Défendez votre base et recherchez le remède pour reconquérir l'humanité.
Just remember, if you mess up big time, you could lose everything, even your life. So, for safety's sake, always make sure to keep your valuables in the safe zone.

Créez créatures pour explorer des mondes en ligne avec vos amis et collectez de nouvelles parties de corps pour améliorer vos statistiques et vos capacités ! Complétez des quêtes, combattez des ennemis ou RP - les possibilités sont infinies lorsque votre imagination est la limite !
Dark Podval - platformer where you have to go through the basement mazes, solve puzzlesand avoid deadly traps. Can you get out of there alive and take all the coins?

Plonge dans un vaste monde ouvert de création et de survie avec ton compagnon Grammi, en mode solo ou avec des amis en multijoueur ! Programme ton Grammi pour automatiser diverses tâches et construire ta propre ville, et affronte de redoutables monstres.

Enishia is a simple nun and the sole manager of the last church in Megista. However, she must pay off a mountain of debt to prevent the demolition of the church and its attached orphanage. How can she make the money she needs?

Blast rocks, drill tunnels and force your way through every mountain. At the beginning you have enough time and no major problems. Once the TNT charges are placed you can start the blasting to create the tunnel entrance. The excavated material will be loaded by a shovel dozer on a dump truck and transported to the storage site.

titre: QUAKE Mission Pack 1: Scourge of Armagon
description: Après avoir vaincu Shub-Niggurath, vous êtes de retour sur Terre. Pour vous apercevoir que ce n'est pas précisément pour profiter du ciel bleu et des petits oiseaux. Apparemment les forces de l'Enfer n'ont pas toutes été supprimées. Place au chaos et à la destruction alors que vous tentez de sceller le portail.

Experience a true classic! This Gold edition includes the original Jagged Alliance plus the add-on Jagged Alliance: Deadly Games. Take a trip into retro land and learn why this is considered to be one the best turn-based games of all times.
Intensive Exposure is a fast paced game in which you have to expose yourself as many times as possible without getting caught by security.
RC Quadcopter Racing Simulator - Fly (and crash!) all you want regardless of the weather, all for the price of a few replacement props.

Stars in Shadow est un jeu 4X rendant un vibrant hommage aux plus grands classiques du genre ! Colonisez des systèmes stellaires, formez une invincible armada spatiale, défiez les factions extraterrestres et forgez des alliances. Votre objectif ? Unifier la galaxie par la diplomatie... ou par les armes !
Solve hidden items and puzzles while avoiding abyssal zombies and traps at school.

Beyond Polaris Guardian est un jeu d'action RPG et TPS sur un système de campagne flexible avec différentes histoires. Incarne 3 personnages uniques et développe ta propre histoire personnelle grâce au système innovant du réseau galactique.
Protégez votre champ de maïs et rassemblez le troupeau car FLOCK est dans les parages.

Sous les traits de Mean Mcallister, le poulet le plus méchant en ville, frayez-vous un chemin en affrontant des hordes d'ennemis pour sauver votre poulette bien-aimée dans un jeu désopilant orienté action-JDR avec martelage stratégique de boutons.

titre: Nancy Drew®: Secret of the Scarlet Hand
description: Expose Buried Secrets and Catch a Thief Red-handed!

Classic 4X turn-based strategy game, where you manage a theocratic empire, conquer and convert pagans and enemies by divine power or brute force, cast mighty miracles and enact dogmas. Advance and expand your theocracy into dominant world empire. And if necessary... release the Kraken!

Herta's simulated universe network is interconnected throughout the universe. Pack your luggage and enter Herta's world with your friends. In this fan game, you will use the simulation data of each original character to have a strategic showdown with Herta.
Un mélange brutal entre dungeon-crawler et shoot-em up. Le donjon apprendra de vous et deviendra plus dangereux à chaque partie !
Full of hilarious dialogue and comical encounters! A super exhilarating Metroidvania action game!!

Bâtiment de ville casual. Devenez architecte. Managez le petit polis. Batissez une ancienne ville romaine idyllique avec beaucoup de maisons. Faites votre chemin vers le haut à travers le mode campagne detaillé, ou créez vos propres scénarios.

titre: Nancy Drew®: Trail of the Twister
description: Apprehend a Saboteur Stirring up Turbulent Trouble!
'The Tide Intro' is only the beginning. Stay alert for 'The Tide' coming up soon this year!
TROUVEZ LA PANACÉE ET SAUVEZ L’HUMANITÉ !

Ramenez la fête des saisons au royaume des contes de fées ! Joignez-vous à la reine des neiges et la princesse des saisons pour affronter le méchant prince Janvier et sauver le royaume du conte de fées d'un hiver éternel ! Résolvez des casse-tête intelligents pour vaincre les forces du mal !
Realistic air combat is waiting for you, in some of the most intense dogfights of the Cold War era!

A planetary physics game that challenges you to master the powers of the universe. Use orbital mechanics to maneuver the trajectories of moons, with the powers of changing gravity, creating black holes, forming wormholes, and even shooting lasers!

Armies of zombies are coming! The Edgar Kingdom is teetering on the brink of collapse! Young Edgar Princess stands out and leads her subjects to defeat enemies. Follow the story of the princess to explore uncharted land, and might unravel the mysteries behind such disaster?

Il y a fort longtemps, le Ragnarök, l’apocalypse, mena le monde au bord de la destruction. Odin, dieu suprême contrôlant toute chose, puisa dans ses dernières forces afin de créer un apôtre du salut à qui il confia le sort du monde.
In this game you have to collect as many keys as you can. They will fly around in a location with ever increasing complexity. Beat the records! Be the best!

The Zoo is expanding! More than 30 new types of animals and plants have moved in at the zoo. Favorite species such as the Wolf, the Arctic Fox, the Giant Kangaroo and the Meerkat are the new Stars in your zoo! Improve the park with the blossoms of sunflowers and rare orchids and plant exotic trees such as bamboo and eucalyptus.

Blank Frame is a first person surreal horror game with a look akin to early 2000's pc/ps2 games.. In the small town of Dim River, one resident, Henri, has found himself trapped inside of his own apartment, perhaps not completely by himself. The night is going to be long and peculiar.
Play as Erica, princess of the Tolinia Kingdom, as she fights to unify the Stivale Peninsula against a powerful, modernized country, that threatens to undermine the peninsula's sovereignty.

titre: ケチャップandマヨネーズ
description: Frenetic, chaotic battles! A dynamic duo, who are the best of friends, come out swinging in this pretty absurd RPG!

Sur la planète Aethereus existe un monde ancien et mystérieux, empli de forêts majestueuses, de marécages brumeux, de souterrains profonds et de ruines anciennes. Ravagé par trois catastrophes astronomiques majeures: les Trois Grand Déluges, c’est un monde qui renait tout juste des ruines et du chaos.
Nuclear Reactor Simulator: Prenez le contrôle. Évitez la catastrophe. Alimentez le monde.
Destroy the Demon and locate the lost Crown of Peace!

DeHumanized is a Roguelite sidescroller action shooter inspired by Metroid and Binding of Isaac.The world runs on physical rules with elements interacted subtly with each other. To survive you have to take strength from beasts, and learn rules how the world works.
A unique combination of run n' jump and humor. Even death is fun in Pyramid Raid!
Join Dangeresque, (Strong Bad from Homestar Runner) the world's greatest private eye/crooked cop, as he puzzles his way through 3 bite-sized roomisodes in this classic-style point n' click adventure.
Tactical turn-based space battles. Elaborate war strategies to prepare against the inevitable alien invasion.

titre: Root Double -Before Crime * After Days- Xtend Edition
description: Rescue squad captain Watase Kasasagi wakes up without his memories in the middle of his most critical mission yet-- a nuclear meltdown at a research facility. In an unfamiliar place and without his years of training, he must rescue the survivors and escape...

Primordials: Battle of Gods est un jeu de stratégie en 1 contre 1 de lutte acharnée où les joueurs dirigent des royaumes et construisent des armées pour se battre pour obtenir encore plus de puissance. Un seul s'élèvera, beaucoup tomberont.
Gimbal is the multiplayer shooter with buildable vehicles. Customize your weaponry, engines, and accessories, and then take to the skies against other pilots in real time.
For the first time ever, step inside Nefertari's tomb and immerse yourself in the story of its art, history, construction, and mythology through interactive elements.
Gorge is a first-person puzzle-platformer, where you use telekinesis and wall-running to solve challenging interconnected obstacle courses.

Dans ce jeu d'aventure mêlant horreur et mystères, la salle d'arcade abandonnée où vous trouvez refuge suite à un accident de voiture essaie de vous dévorer tout cru. Résolvez des énigmes, contentez la borne JANITOR et jetez toujours un œil derrière vous. Frissons garantis !

Jeu de puzzle d'aventure en 3D de légendes mythiques et du monde moderne. Harmony's Odyssey propose des énigmes engageantes et réfléchies basées sur des carreaux basés sur une idée de puzzle classique, portées vers de nouveaux sommets, accompagnées de créatures puissantes.

"Don't go to GALXAGAR"; a phrase uttered by many who have traversed its rim. Untold treasures, and terrors, await within its blackened depths. Ready your craft, spacefarer, because you're about to enter the most dangerous sector in all the stars. Get ready.. for GALXAGAR!

When you awake, you find yourself in a mansion, where was the secret research center, is now a maze full of horrible zombies and deadly traps. You'll have to escape by overcoming your fears, collecting items, solving innovative puzzles and revealing the cruel truth.
Montez sur le trône de l’empire de Varennes et menez plusieurs générations de rois dans une lutte acharnée contre les sept Héros.
A bite-sized, 8-bit style run-and-gun inspired by Saturday morning cartoons of the 80s!

Hack&Slash – Battez-les tous ! Six héroïnes, cinq types d'armes et des niveaux qui vous donnent une montée d'adrénaline à laquelle vous ne pourrez pas résister. Facile à apprendre, difficile à maîtriser. Compatible 4K/120Hz et parfait sur SteamDeck. Tout le monde peut s'amuser !

No Water in Hell is a 2D roguelike dungeon crawler from CaffNight Software. Fight through the legions of Hell with a wide range of weapons and items as you explore and conquer the 9 circles of the Underworld with procedurally generated dungeons with your trusty fire hose.

Space of Darkness tells the story of a mechanic who works on a space station. The mechanic is alone on the ship for a few months. One day the power suddenly cuts off. He soon finds himself alone in the dark corridors of a space station. Can you unearth what truly happened on the space station?
The acclaimed gay dating sim. Have a sweet, sexy, or bizarrely comedic adventure with the man of your choice!

Bad Caterpillars and their swarms of insect hordes are invading. Get to your ship, man the lasers, and save the galaxy from caterpillars, scorpions, spiders, and a slew of other ill-tempered giant killer insects.

Experience LUXOR in stunning HD! Answer the call of the goddess, Isis, in this addictive marble-shooter game. Chains of colored spheres are working their way through ancient Egypt, and it’s up to you to stop them before they reach the pyramids.
Un après-midi apparemment normal se transforme en une journée apocalyptique lorsque qu’un minuscule crapaud gagne la capacité de grossir de plus en plus à chaque chose qu’il mange…
This is a desktop pet, Can be placed on the computer desktop, Character's chest has a physical softening effect, Can add a layer of sexy to the desktop !

titre: DROD: Gunthro and the Epic Blunder
description: DROD is a unique puzzle-logic game with clever mechanics and an engaging story. It is a turn-based top-down 2-D dungeon puzzler. The game play has amazing depth through emergent behaviors as puzzle elements are combined. There is a simple interface and only a handful of commands to master.

In this side-scrolling action-adventure game, you'll need to scour the inside of an abandoned hotel, looking for clues to solve the mystery of the hotel and ensure your escape from a mysterious, murderous mascot intent to kill.
indie adventure game topdown puzzle pixelart gameboy retrògame pixelart Make your way through the pitfalls to retrieve the navespace battery and return home.
Stack-Making Neighbors is a casual physics-based puzzle game. Remove blocks from a tower, and carefully stack them on top. Play alone, or with friends.
Juice cans hit each other! ?? A powerful and high-speed 3D action game that decides the best drink in the world!
Arena Wars 2 est la suite de la série récompensée Arena Wars et combine des combats en temps réel révolutionnaires avec des éléments issus des jeux de rôle.
Pythagoria is a brain-teasing number puzzle game.

Oh no! This cute little kitty cat is alone and lost in a haunted house! Only by collecting pennies and defeating monsters can she find the way out! Use your fast fingers to defeat this adorably dark and funny platform game.
"Lone Shadow" est un jeu de tir à la troisième personne.

Ascent is a PVE sandbox space MMO with 270 BILLION star systems and an emphasis on strong Sci Fi. It encourages Exploration, Colonization, Research, Asteroid mining, Farming, Trading, and Combat. Outside the tutorial sector, everything in-game has been built by players.
Enjoy the rhythmic music and beat the SCORE!!!

Dylan is the head of a small village and captain of The Eagle and he takes it upon himself to find The Grail and stop the Falls, saving those he cares for. The journey will be long and perilous, but the whole world above the skies depends on it.

World’s greatest competitive multiplayer stair climbing game. In local or online play, up to three people race to the finish while the fourth, armed to the teeth with an arsenal of unconventional ammo types, does everything to stop them.

Sweezy Gunner is an eye melting, brain bending, mouse squeezing 2D Shoot em up. destroy everything in your path, Upgrade the Sweezy Gunner ship. A Large open World! Travel through the lush green fields, frozen tundra and arid desert. Explore the depths of the many dungeons, caves and temples and collect that tasty loot!
Save Cow Bella from certain fate in this 3rd person car chasing, bull fighting adventure. Will you get there in time?

Start your life as a simple gamer in the year 2000. Find popular games to stream or compete in 8 different Esports. Who will you be? Play your career and story. Can you become the most famous broadcaster or the best progamer in the world?

Sur le continent d'Aurorium, envahi par le Roi Démon du Vide, les héros ont obtenu des artefacts de diverses manières, ont vaincu un grand nombre d'ennemis et ont continuellement amélioré leur puissance pour finalement vaincre le Roi Démon et sauver le monde.

Bound across the world spreading color, creating life, tearing brains asunder and meeting interesting geometry.Slowly begin to doubt that you are playing correctly. Slowly begin to doubt that life is even able to be lived correctly.And come to a terrifying conclusion.

titre: Crowns and Pawns: Kingdom of Deceit
description: Les légendes du passé refont surface dans cette charmante aventure pleine de mystères. Faites vos bagages et voyagez à travers l'Europe d'aujourd'hui dans Crowns and Pawns: Kingdom of Deceit pour révéler les secrets du roi qui ne fut jamais couronné.
Bienvenue dans une eau nucléaire polluée où la vie mutate. Commencez par un petit poisson et évoluez pour survivre dans cette mer toxique, devenant un monstre marin maître de l'océan.
Journey to Olympus and face challenges from Greek myths in this co-op survival RPG! Build, craft, explore, and discover your demi-god abilities solo or co-op up to 16 players.

Dead Hungry Diner is all about big combos, spells, monsters fighting monsters and finding your flow within the monstrous mayhem!Help Gabe and Gabby, patrons of “The Dead Hungry Diner”, as they feed the creatures of the night buckets and buckets of juicy Brain Berry goop!(Well... that’s the easy part!

[VR Only] Annie Amber is a VR Puzzle Game that leads you on an intense and dreamy journey through the life of a person condensed in a surreal and poetic experience. Annie Amber makes you explore this strange and beautiful scenery that is life itself through her memories.
Une aventure en 3D qui comporte son lot de périls variés et de sourires !
VoxelSuite is a free, open source, voxel editing application. Use VoxelSuite to create entire scenes, characters, or assets for your games.
Kirchhoff is annoyed because nobody appreciates his circuit laws! You get transported to his secret lair and won't be able to get out until you show mastery!

A crash landing on a world inhabited by bee-like lifeforms. Stranded, our hero must unravel the rules of this uncharted planet to find their way home. Navigate a world where left is right, up is down, and you don't know where the simulation ends and you begin.

titre: The Metronomicon: Slay The Dance Floor
description: RhythmRPG

Abalyte is a 2D-roguelike metroidvania that focuses on the player's skill and inventiveness. While other games have crutches or progression systems that help the player beat the game, Abalyte does the opposite and throws you in a spike-pit.

Join 2 cute but not-so-bright ducklings on their quest through over 100 fun and challenging puzzles! Conquer new modes, collect costumes, and explore different worlds on their journey to reunite with their Mother!

A JRPG with retro CRT pixel art graphics, a modern open world approach and a curated piano soundtrack composed by the developer himself. There will be drama and funny moments, Make friends along the way, and complete challenges and minigames to unlock secrets and piano songs.

titre: 孙美琪疑案 第五季
description: 《孙美琪疑案》系列第五季，共包含6个DLC，分别是：徽州古宅:蝶儿、鬼船:邓秋平、回廊:余仁仁、超杀:陈双十、金牙:宗大宝、南河:游乐园。

Un jeu d'exploration paisible en vue subjective qui se découvre au fur et à mesure que le monde croît autour de vous. Aventurez-vous dans un écosystème coloré et psychédélique possédant flore abondante, ruisseaux cascadants, montagnes luxuriantes, monolithes luisants et créatures gracieuses.

Interloper est un jeu multijoueur en ligne de stratégie en temps réel, avec des parties qui ne durent que 5 minutes. Plutôt que de détruire votre adversaire, vous devez occuper du territoire pour gagner. En prédisant les mouvements de votre adversaire, vous pourrez l'encercler et occuper le niveau au complet.

SCP-087 est un jeu d'horreur à la première personne axé sur des événements paranormaux. Les joueurs, dans un laboratoire tranquille, sont des chercheurs de vérité qui plongent toujours plus profondément dans le bâtiment. S'échapper n'est pas une option, les obligeant à endurer une descente en enfer.

What do you trust most — what you see, what you're told, or your instincts? On a year long solo mission aboard Verde Station, you will test your wits and question everything, but you may not find answers. Welcome to solitude.
You are the sheriff. Robbers roam the village and pillage. Your mission is to catch robbers and bounties. Fight them to protect your town.

Clementine Valley est habituellement l’endroit où être!utilisé pour être le lieu de l'être! Il était mondialement connu pour ses arbres fruitiers fantastique amoureusement entretenus par le vieux Jim. Malheureusement, Jim a perdu l'énergie nécessaire pour cultiver assez de fruits pour garder les habitants heureux, et encore moins pour...
Le Donjon malicieux est un titre médiéval de Plateforme d'action centré sur le Moyen Âge.
Zap Dem Rats is a third person adventure RPG of skill where the player helps Mr. Prez regain the Whitehouse. Along the way Mr. Prez transforms zombies into citizens and vanquishes his adversaries

State of Matter is a First-Person Puzzle Action Shooter utilizing a new element and its three states of matter to traverse through a derelict mining outpost in the Kuiper Belt. Armed with an experimental mining tool, you must solve puzzles and defeat enemies as you travel deeper into the facility.

titre: One More Gate : A Wakfu Legend
description: One More Gate est un roguelite-deckbuilder mêlant exploration et combats stratégiques au tour par tour. Partez à la découverte de lieux fantastiques, maitrisez la puissance du Wakfu pour créer des combos de cartes destructeurs et venez à bouts de tout ce qui se dressera sur votre route.

Explorez le monde de Never Mourn dans cette aventure d'action rogue-lite. La mort n'est jamais la fin, mais simplement le début de votre prochaine aventure. Utilisez d'anciennes magies nécromantiques pour lever une armée de démons morts-vivants et combattez pour combler les failles de Never Mourn.

Dungeons the Eye of Draconus is a early 90’s arcade style, one to three player, comedy, retro brawler, with both local and online multiplayer support, complete with mounts; multiple attacks, and varied gameplay, all reminiscent of Battle Toads, Golden Axe and TMNT Arcade.

titre: Alone in the Dark: The New Nightmare
description: From the moment Edward Carnby and Aline Cedrac set foot on Shadow Island, they are confronted by mysterious, evil creatures intent on thwarting their progress to recover 3 ancient tablets believed to hold the secret key to some incredible menacing phenomena. Danger threatens from every corner.

Le wargame ultime à l'époque des piquiers et tireurs est de retour. Vous avez maintenant le contrôle complet des armées de votre nation, au travers une longue campagne où vous luttez pour pour la suprématie.

The ultimate couch fragger gibfest! Armed with a powerful shotgun, bullet deflecting shield and power-up tarot cards, 2 to 4 local players will battle it out to collect each others souls in 9 different competitive game modes across 4 realms & 40 arenas. This is frantic local multiplayer action at its bloodiest!

Avez-vous l’œil pour les détails ? Saurez-vous retrouver suffisamment d'indices pour résoudre les crimes et devenir Maître Détective ? Mystery Case Files : Huntsville propose aux joueurs un ensemble d'intrigues et d'énigmes à résoudre : des photos à reconstituer, d'étranges scènes de crime à explorer et bien plus encore.

Undarkened is a wizarding survival-adventure game where you must unravel the mystery of what, or who, corrupted your homeland. Explore a devastated world alone or with your friends, find out what happened, and try everything you can to save your home.

Développé aux États-Unis et apparu pour la première fois en 1981, Ms. PAC-MAN arrive enfin sur Steam ! Déplacez Ms. PAC-MAN vers le haut, le bas, la gauche et la droite pour éviter les fantômes et engloutir toutes les Pac-Billes !
The Network has been infested. Face a giant creature ruled by music to cleanse it. Fight while switching between 2 complementary Game Modes!
The passage of time can't be stopped. The nature is constantly changing. The seasons are the continuing circle of our lives. And you can touch it with Forestation: Circle of Nature.

Play as Psych, while he escapes from a research facility run by evil slugs as they attempt to harvest him for his psychic powers. Face the evil slugs and survive the lab! Watch_out_for_Failed_Experiment

Jrago II Gardiens d'Eden est un jeu de rôle d'action-aventure de plateforme 2D indépendant de style METROIDVANIA. Les ténèbres sont de nouveau revenues, et cette fois Jrago fait équipe avec ses compagnons gardiens pour tuer les démons maléfiques et ramener la lumière !
Deathsmiles is CAVE's bullet-hell shoot-'em-up where you take the role of one of five Angels to defend the magical land of Gilverado from an invasion by Hell itself! Eradicate this devilish assault!

ASMR LIGHTness - Light painting est un casse-tête atmosphérique avec des lumières, une belle esthétique et une atmosphère extraordinaire d'un monde inconnu. Les lumières ne peuvent pas se chevaucher, car elles perdent toute leur puissance...

Duet est un jeu élégant et minimaliste dans lequel vous devez simplement manipuler deux sphères à travers un dédale d'obstacles en chute libre de plus en plus complexe. Découvrez une histoire à la narration singulière alors que la difficulté augmente et que la tension monte.

The Steam Revolution Is a first person design game. Players will be able to drive armed trains through enemy lines and will use various historic cannons, which will be used to repel enemy attacks and reclaim their country's territory

FINAL PROFIT is a story driven shop-sim RPG. Gather products and find customers. Spend your hard-earned profits on upgrades and investments. Make far-reaching choices as you expand your business. And explore a world full of secrets on your quest to defeat capitalism by becoming the best at it!
Discover a new world in this quirky RPG full of colorful characters - a story of love and madness filled with twists and surprises!

titre: 尘沙的选择 THE CHOICE OF SAND
description: 2D action shooting, plot rich game. Classic game system, simple weapon and menu operation mode, let you feel the spirit of classic action adventure game, gradually reveal plot development, more choice dialogue, non-compulsory task.
Who froze the city of NEW ICE YORK? Who did this? That's up to you to find out, Detective...
『海洋ホテル☆海猫亭』は五つ星ホテルを目指す経営シミュレーションゲームです。プレイヤーはホテル『海猫亭』の看板娘『イヴ』となり、お店を切り盛りすることになります。
RPG veteran Warfare Studios (Vagrant Hearts, Ashes of Immortality, Shining Plume) is back with a new tale in this exciting, story-driven RPG.

Assassin est un jeu d'action furtif dans lequel l'information est synonyme de pouvoir. Devenez le maître assassin, endossant le rôle d'un agent hautement qualifié qui a été envoyé pour éliminer un groupe de cibles du monde entier. Ils ne sauront jamais ce qui les a frappés.
Get ready to rethink all your defense strategies! Build barricades to stop monsters, or lure them into a maze and attack. A variety of stages that change each time depending on how you play them.

In this hyper-realistic multiplayer horror game, one player starts as The Hound, while up to 15 players are human survivors trying to hide. Navigate through hyper-realistic environments, and experience the ultimate survival horror experience in multiplayer.
Découvrez un monde pleins de puzzles, déjouez les mauvais "Meowbots", et emparez-vous du fromage!

"Moke Bottle and Monster Girl 2" is a shooting game that avoids monsters and breaks the target point. There will be 5 monsters in each level. Players can control the Moke bottle to avoid monsters and break the target point to clear the level.
Snowball Rush is a Runner-Timekiller game about a funny snowball and many obstacles on the way to the foot of the mountain.
Space zone defender is an oldschool arcade style space shooter. You can choose between different weapon sets and ship skins and try to survive as long as you can.

Which is my toilet is a satirical anomaly puzzle. You are the Reborn, assigned a random identity (97 genders + MEMES). Decipher absurd, ever-changing restroom signs in an infinite maze to find YOUR door. Choose wrong? Loop back! A unique blend of observation and dark humor.
Lazerbait is a free arcade strategy game set in virtual reality with one simple goal: capture all the planets to build more ships and destroy your enemies!
A relaxing hiatus from the hustle and bustle of everyday life. Sit in a remote corner of the world, drop a line, and see what bites.

titre: Learn Japanese To Survive! Katakana War
description: Learn the basics of Japanese in this interactive role-playing game! No experience needed – start reading and writing in Japanese!
Cross-platform todolist, mobile phone, bi-directional synchronization on PC.

Dynamite Alex is an action platform-shooter starring a 17-year old tomboy named Alexandra Tobynskii. After a cliched outbreak of robbers invading the city, it's up to her to investigate what's going on! Donning glorious retro flair, the game transports players back to when gameplay was king!
Driving School是一款致力于汽车安全驾驶培训的软件，主要包括汽车驾驶的教学、练习、模拟考试以及安全驾驶等几部分。该软件适用于准备学习或者正在学习汽车驾驶的人员，也可以作为新司机巩固驾驶技能、培养安全驾驶习惯的练习工具。
studio: Chengdu Hezonglianheng Digital Technology Co, Ltd.

description: Get ready for a gaming experience in Schrodinger's Cat Experiment that combines brain-teasing puzzles with enchanting aesthetics and feline charm. Dead or alive? The cat's fate is in your hands.

Un simulateur de vols pour avions, hélicoptères, drones et buggys. Incluant des courses en FPV (vue à la première personne) dans des décors 3D réalistes. Nous nous sommes concentré sur le rendu réel du dynamisme de vol, nos utilisateurs le disent, c'est le plus réaliste des simulateurs de vols qu'ils aient essayé.

"The Silent Huntress" is a visual novel in the genre of a dark fairy tale with choices and different endings. Not only the development of events will depend on your choices, but also the conclusions that the main character makes about her life and the world around her.

Find as many of your friends as possible before the monster gets you. Save all you can, as the amount of friends you have is endless! You can't save them all but find the best strategy and do your best sweetie! I hope everything's ok and hope you'll enjoy this mini game I finished for you.
Fantasynth One is an audio-reactive experience designed for Virtual Reality. Glide through a procedurally populated environment that comes alight with electronic music by French producer N'to.

Build your perfect defenses with hexagons! Use hex tiles to explore cyberspace, upgrade your defense towers, and complete quests in this unique turn-based strategy game. With a campaign, a procedurally generated endless mode, and a powerful editor, HexaScape offers endless challenges.

Driftez à pleine vitesse en esquivant pièges et obstacles dans un environnement animé par une bande-son captivante. Créez, jouez à des niveaux conçus par la communauté, ou lancez vous dans une campagne palpitante.
Bulldozer is an action game where the player controls a bulldozer and needs to push off all the barrels of the platform except the bulldozer to win the game.

Access Denied is a puzzle game in the world where for storage of personal data are used special device in the form of protected boxes. Imagine yourself in the role of the professional cracker of such devices and test your skills for 36 different levels.

titre: Al Andalus 711: Epic history battle game
description: In Al Andalus 711 you don't play as a warrior, but as a villager who tries to survive in a country that is being invaded and must face the risky roads, the lack of experience and the constant danger of enemy soldiers and hostile bandits.

titre: Romance of the Three Kingdoms IX with Power Up Kit
description: "Romance of the Three Kingdoms Ⅸ with Power Up Kit" is an expanded version of "Romance of the Three Kingdoms Ⅸ," which was released in 2003 as the 9th game in the series. RTK Ⅸ is a strategy based simulation game based in China's chaotic Three Kingdoms period.
Greetings Space Traveler, we need you to save the universe again! New virus variants threaten our galaxy. Level up with a new arsenal of weapons to combat them!

This is a simple old school dungeon crawler. It's made completely by one person - me, who is a fan of dark fantasy games, adventures, dungeons and dragons! Gold Edition means the game is complete with all additional features and items. It also offers new in-game economy based on the gold you collect

titre: MANOS: The Hands of Fate ~ Director's Cut
description: Retro platforming action in this adaptation of a terrible movie.

Journey on an epic quest with Lethal and his elite party of warriors through a huge fantasy land. Play as Lethal and his companions in exciting turn based battles against a variety of fantasy creatures.

Discover with TramSim Munich a new city with numerous landmarks as well as the low-floor tram model R2.2.b! Transport your passengers on three detailed tram lines in full length through the centre of the Bavarian capital.

In Hollow Space, you are transported to an abandoned space station drifting on the edge of the galaxy. A rescue crew responds to a mysterious SOS signal, only to find that something terrifying lurks in the shadows. Will you dare to face the danger, or will you become the monster yourself?

Ocean Planet reprend l'essence de Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy et la transforme en une œuvre d'art, avec des visuels et un audio atmosphériques et immersifs. Vous serez plongé dans un monde aquatique diversifié, et ce sera à vous de vous élever pour découvrir ce qui vous attend à la surface.

A collection of over one hundred completely free small games wrapped into one convenient launcher! Slash slimes, shoot lemons, blow kisses, take blood, and so much more in these wacky, weird, and wild games!

Zombie Rollerz est le mash-up ultime qui mêle flipper, zombie defense et éléments rogue-like. Tirez, écrasez et frappez des hordes de zombies et participez à des combats de boss épiques. Sélectionnez votre héros et devenez une légende du flipper !

Lycans est un jeu multijoueur. Il peut accueillir jusqu'à 10 joueurs. Enquêtez pour trouver les loups-garous se cachant parmi les villageois pendant la journée et cachez-vous la nuit pour survivre à leurs attaques !

Welcome to a world where the entire human population of earth is undergoing a massive de evolution process! The human race has de evolved back into monkeys and are causing an apocalyptic mayhem over the entire earth, and It's only up to you to end this terrorizing madness!
Gizmo is a Saturday-morning 3D platformer inspired by 90s classics of the genre.
Compete against the galaxy in this fast-paced speedrunning game. Create and share levels. Break records. Be the best.

The Watchmaker est un jeu d'action-aventure dans un étrange monde steampunk rempli de mécanismes d'horloge géants, dans lequel le temps s'est détraqué. Aidez Alexander, l'Horloger de la tour, à remettre le temps sur de bons rails !

Le spinoff d'Out of Reach est un jeu de style Battle Royale dans lequel des dizaines d'équipages de pirates se font face en pleine mer, dans la jungle des îles et dans des grottes sombres. Naviguez sur votre vaisseau, bombardez vos ennemis, trouvez des équipements mais surtout cherchez des trésors!

Explore a scary mansion in the first-person adventure horror game. Talk to kidnapped souls, collect grimoires, and discover the hidden secret inside the many doors. Your soul was stolen, and you found yourself in the underworld. Can you escape?
You hate green.

Protoball is a futuristic First Person Sports Shooter, a blend of basketball and soccer crossed with high tech futuristic style. Players athletically jump, slide, run, and dash around the arena trying to pass the Protoball through the opponents goal.

titre: 异世界的城主大人(国际服)
description: This game is a more casual strategy war game, it bid farewell to the endless confrontation between players in traditional strategy games! More emphasis on collaboration between players.

L’Edition Collector de Bear With Me comprend les trois épisodes racontant l’histoire complète d’Amber et Ted, ainsi que la bande-son originale, un art book numérique et des documents de conceptions complets sur les casse-têtes et le script.

titre: Tear and the Library of Labyrinths
description: The twin sisters Tear and Lumiere enjoy a happy life running their clinic. But when a demon abducts her sister, Tear must summon her courage to venture through worlds within magical tomes to bring her sister home safe.

Rym 9000 is a hyperkinetic shooter inspired by Akira, Neon Genesis Evangelion, and Guxt. A treasure-hunting journey to the Moon developed by Sonoshee and composed by Roex. A unique high-octane experience conceived to stimulate your senses and make your eyes and ears bleed!

Play as a wheat fairy, using the magical energy of the wheat field to dispel the threats of wheat! Combine different skills to make your own attack style! And let the wheat grow and harvest smoothly under the test of other nature fairies.
Un jeu de tir immersif mené par une ligne sénaristique incorporant un gameplay VR à la pointe, Vertigo Remastered est une complete révisoin et ré-imagination occasionnelle du jeu original de 2016 .

titre: Meet the Miner - WDR VR Bergwerk
description: Ever worked hundreds of meters beneath the earth, bent down in dark, narrow shafts, hitting coal out of the walls? Probably not. Now you can: The WDR, Germany’s largest public broadcaster, presents the interactive VR experience “Meet the Miner – WDR VR Bergwerk”.

titre: LR2 : Liars' Race in Lost Ruins
description: This is a FPS game in which players repeatedly play alliances and treacherous tactics to evade the traps of the huge labyrinth and reach the goal to get the treasure hidden in the depths of the labyrinth.
Play Online Poker without restriction or cost! Compete with community, your friends or family play this truly free Texas Hold'em Poker.

Une aventure de science-fiction. Le jeu suit les aventures de Shin-kai, une demi-divine ramenée à la vie par une ancienne magie dans un monde inconnu et mystérieux. L'histoire commence en 1959 en Union soviétique, dans un endroit appelé "la montagne des morts".

titre: The Ember Saga: A New Fire
description: A deep, story-driven experience where The Order, a powerful organization that has existed for over 3000 years, never interferes with the politics of the nations of Mörja. But everything is not as it seems, as The Order has a dark secret.
Sit behind the wheel of monsters with over 4000 hp engines in brand new arcade style racing game.

As daily life goes on unchanged, the girls - and Haruto - continue to sharpen their fangs. They are summoned for a mission of unprecedented scale, against the religious organization "TFA", where Enishi and Kuroe await. What kind of hellish scenes will Arisaka have to face on the battlefield?

titre: 法医探案团之碎嘴小诗
description: 在《法医探案团之碎嘴小诗》中，玩家将化身被害人小诗，用独特的“逝者视角”沉浸式与法医一同寻找自己死因真相！通过“拟真尸检”和“嫌疑人的调查”、“多样的剧情选择”和“技能释放”中冲出层层迷雾，而在扑朔迷离的案情不断袭来之时，一个「糖果岛」的神秘符号，竟引出无数少女的神秘失踪与被囚禁的线索，把案件再次推向新的高潮！

Our Love Will Grow is a farming game in the style of Harvest Moon with a different party to attend each week. Grow your farm, uncover secrets, and attract girls by presenting them with food and jewellery you make yourself.

Gods of the Fallen Land is an action-strategy game centered around base building and villager management. Take on the role of a leader trying to rebuild humanity in a broken and dangerous world. Lead your followers into battle and make strategic decisions on what to develop and build to survive.
A turn-based role-playing game

You have come to the right place pilgrim... Rumours from Elsewhere is a 2.5D action platformer with RPG and Roguelite elements. Battle alone or with a friend through an ancient fantasy world, filled with loot and danger... welcome to the gauntlet of greed.

Construisez votre cité-État dans Kaiserpunk, un city-builder qui entremêle des mécaniques de production fouillées et la conquête mondiale. Gérez votre ville et son industrie, levez une armée et affrontez vos rivaux pour devenir la figure de proue d'un 20e siècle uchronique.
Farming with guns, drones, artillery, and super fast-growing crops! Plant, harvest, and sell with the full United States Military Arsenal at your fingertips! Your country needs you, Farmer!
A detective noir, choose-your-own-adventure game with hand-drawn art, over 250k words, and an immersive soundtrack.
Pamir opened his eyes at an unknown sanctuary somewhere. He has no choice because he has lost even his memory. Will he be able to regain his memory and defeat four powerful enemies?

titre: 你与月光同罪-As Guilty As the Moon
description: This is a realistic + survival oriented work. The murder of a girl in a ride-hailing service two years ago, brought your 12 fates back together. You wake up in a strange room, and things are getting weird around you. In the fog, not everything you see is the truth. Is everything real or unreal?

Dans Mudborne, découvrez, élevez et gérez des populations de grenouilles ! Au sortir de votre hibernation, vous retrouvez votre étang abandonné. Utilisez les clés génétiques de nouvelles espèces pour rouvrir les passages entre les mondes de l'éveil et du rêve, et recréer les populations disparues.
Elementite is a third-person shooter RPG that fuses natural elements and futuristic firearms in a vast chaotic open world of challenges and secrets in a way never seen before.

CityBattle | Virtual Earth (EU) est un online shooter gratuit, en réalité alternée dans lequel des robots militaires complexes se battent pour dominer la Terre. Les robots ont plusieurs aptitudes, une grande variété de catégories, et de sous-catégories et former une équipe stratégiquement sera essentiel pour gagner des batailles.

Castle Xenon is a retro-themed, console-style RPG downloadable for Windows. A 30 hour adventure, take part in turn-based battles, solve puzzles, and explore detailed, handcrafted maps in your quest to save the world from destruction.

The Heartbeat is a lightweight political simulation game that incorporates rhythmic, text-oriented options. All the player has to do in the game is keep himself and the city alive as much as possible.

Spirit of the Island est une simulation en coopération située dans un archipel tropical. Construisez votre ferme, faites pousser vos récoltes et élevez vos animaux, fabriquez des objets, cuisinez, construisez boutiques et musées pour transformer votre île en une destination touristique prospère !
Incarne Hiro, Meilin ou Shin, trois maîtres des arts martiaux qui se retrouvent au cœur d'un conflit contre le clan de Black Mantis. Invite un ou une ami(e) pour combattre les ninjas à deux !

Breath of Ghosts est un jeu d'horreur à la première personne réalisé dans des graphismes 3D réalistes qui vous plonge dans une atmosphère d'horreur et vous effraie de toutes les manières. L'objectif principal est de survivre et d'être sauvé.

Heart of Y follows the protagonist's journey to find the "Heart of Y" in a shattered world. Players take on the role of an amnesiac traveler as they explore ancient ruins, solve hidden puzzles, and interact with a variety of characters to uncover the truth behind the world.
Created to enrage.

Once a great hero and a servant of the Emperor, Lan Mei now enjoys a quiet life running a dojo. However, when a new evil appears, she is called back into the world of martial arts to take part in a tournament that will determine the true Kung Fu Grand King!

titre: Tales of Tarium: Awakening from the Ashes
description: Explore this dark medieval world while fighting mythological creatures. Throughout betrayal, nervous battles and hidden truths decide whether to defend the honor of high members of the church, help a rebellious group of cultists or embrace on a quest to reveal the secrets of this land.
Découvrez les secrets d’un ancien château!
Défendez la terre des pharaons. Construisez des tours, libérez des pouvoirs et tenez la ligne dans l’Égypte antique.
Breathing Fear-horreur 2D non linéaire avec des éléments de survie. Résolvez tous les mystères de la maison mystérieuse et essayez de ne pas devenir fou d'horreur.
这是一款关于细胞生物学基础知识问答的冒险小游戏。

Mika and the Witch's Mountain est une aventure fantastique qui raconte l'histoire d'une aspirante sorcière qui livre des colis aux habitants d'une petite île. Explorez les moindres recoins et envolez-vous dans le ciel à l'aide de votre balai magique.

Arcade Racer basé sur la physique avec néons, synthwave et écran partagé. Devenez le héros le plus rapide de l'Union soviétique alternative aux néons dans le classement PVP. Collectionnez des voitures classiques uniques de l'East Bloc. Utilisez les bandes de boosts sensibles aux couleurs.

Forget pre-calculated animations for pure physics-based basketball chaos! Master wacky controls, trigger well-timed dashes (even mid-air!), and collect arcade-mode items. Basketing brings fast, unpredictable fun that is perfect for playing solo or in chaotic local and remote matchups with friends.

Duke Grabowski is a classic point-and-click adventure, created with love by an indie team that includes Bill Tiller (The Curse of Monkey Island, Steven Spielberg's The Dig, Indiana Jones and the Infernal Machine).

Bienvenue dans Epic Fantasy Battle Simulator, le simulateur de bataille médiévale le plus immersif à ce jour ! Lancez des dizaines de milliers de soldats dans la bataille, profitez du spectacle ou prenez le contrôle de l'un d'entre eux pour prouver votre bravoure !

Grand Strategy Game. How does reincarnation affect the evolution of a state ? Control the material well-being of your country with a backbone of spiritual growth. Religion. Economy. Diplomacy. War. Souls. Karma. Ideology. Tech. Stories. Single-Player. MMO.
Play an old-school 2D RPG in the vein of Skyfall, Last Heroes and Fantasy Heroes!
