DREAMIO est un jeu d'aventure "choisissez votre propre aventure" où les histoires et visuels sont créés dynamiquement par l'intelligence artificielle selon vos choix. Explorez des mondes infinis avec des possibilités illimitées; allez partout, faites tout.

'Project : Skyscape' is fighter jet experience, multiplayer across VR and non-VR platforms, with in-depth physicalized cockpit interactions. Skyscape hits the gap between simulator and game with a balance of realism and fun
CHESS CROWN- chess in a medieval fantasy theme and with the opportunity to compete with other players on the network.
Only the paranoid survive, build your defenses and prepare to take on hordes of infected while protecting the trader.
一个小女孩被卷入了一连串诡异的事件，信仰，争端，神秘空间----究竟她的命运会如何呢？ 本游戏为多结局模式，玩家需要收集信息和道具来触发不同的结局。 《梦缚》 是一款剧情向游戏，带有部分解谜和迷宫玩法，希望大家会喜欢！ 老梅如果有空会持续更新，如果大家发现一些问题请向梅老师提出，梅老师会尽量修复。 希望大家能不嫌弃我们刚刚起步的革诚星迹团队。
Join Captain Jake Hunter and his loyal sidekick FU-2 as they storm across the galaxy in search of adventure (and revenge) in a side-splitting classic comedy adventure!
《修炼成仙》是一款极简主义的文字挂机游戏。创建人物，踏上仙途，自动战斗，获取战利品，修炼功法，装备法宝，一步一步登上仙途，获得永生轮回。游戏永无止境，无需焦虑通关限制，即开即挂，随缘随心，修炼成仙。

Construisez des villes et des usines dans un monde infini d'hexagones. Explorez plus de tuiles. Équilibrez la production et la consommation de votre ville, attirez plus de citoyens de différentes classes, recherchez de nouvelles technologies et construisez plus d'usines et de villes.

Flightless is a tile-based puzzle adventure game. Navigate your way through a series of floating islands, each presenting a curious puzzle. A minimalist art style and calming piano soundtrack complement senses of wonder and discovery.
Fight and dodge through hundreds of space bugs in Bug Blast! Go through each space station to protect from the hoards of bugs that come their way.
Un jeu de rallye rétro... dans des parkings ?! Une conduite précise avec des commandes réactives et précises inspirées des bornes d'arcade, le tout sous la forme d'un jeu Sega Saturn.
Kill 'em all in 2D and 3D!

Comprend les 5 épisodes de la deuxième saison : Épisode 1: Ice Station Santa Épisode 2: Moai Better Blues Épisode 3: Night of the Raving Dead Épisode 4: Chariots of the Dogs Épisode 5: What's New Beelzebub ?

Slip is a fast paced side scrolling platformer featuring a two color, swap mechanic. Using your two colors flee from Steve and his wretched purple beam through a multitude of obstacles and enemies. Slip combines the elegant simplicity of platforming with a polarity mechanic to create an easy to learn, but extremely difficult to master...

The Panel Remake is a puzzle game where you will turn valves, pull levers and push buttons. Start interacting with the panel elements and found the combinations to make it work. Then you can make it out of the room you get locked in.
Our character has a tantrum after eating spicy Adana Kebab. Then he finds himself in hell for some unknown reason.
Tiny Tanks est un party game multijoueur amusant avec des chars colorés, une infinité de modes de jeu et de la destruction absolue. Pour couronner le tout, tout y est "physiquement réaliste"

titre: Hey ma i'm a Dragon Now
description: a Single Player 2D Side-Scrolling pixel art Skill-Based Bullet-Hell Game where you kill various enemies and bosses to get coins to upgrade your character so you can beat more enemies and progressed further in the

Repoussez vos limites et apprenez de nouvelles capacités pour survivre dans un impitoyable monde non-linéaire en 2D, où les forces des ténèbres sont prêtes à tout pour vous détruire. Dans Moonscars, chaque mort est une leçon, et chaque obstacle surmonté vous fera découvrir une nouvelle vérité.

Legends of Persia is a highly ambitious Action RPG Adventure which incorporating bloody battles, item usage, character building, and storyline incorporation. The storyline revolves around Keykhosro, the son of the Persian prince Siavosh, who in the name of his father’s blood seeks to take revenge upon Afrasiab, the king of Tooran.
After you grew the province, the Imperi wants you to step down. You refuse and are now at war with the Imperi. Will you become Emperor or will you be supplanted?

Banana-Shape est un jeu de clicker dans lequel vous cliquez sur une forme de banane !Gagnez des formes de banane aléatoires pour agrandir votre collection !Venez sortir avec nous et devenons les rois des formes de banane !

The Death Tree is an ambiental, first-person, horror hunting short game with 'Smooth Movement'. Set in a nightmarish dark forest that involves action and "jump scares" through a tension and intrigue atmosphere. Hunt creepy monsters,ruthlessly creatures and witches.
Prepare yourself for the hottest pool party of 2022! Slip into your best costume, grab your friends and fight for the trophy in many different chaotic levels!
Running Dead is a puzzle & shot game. Shot your zombies and get coin from human.
Blast your way through waves of space debris in order to reach what is waiting for you on the other side. Find your fighting style with multiple unlockable ships in this fast paced space adventure!

In the 1980s, a young man is driving home when trouble occurs. The young man, who is familiar with the area, goes to a nearby inn to ask for help, but a bizarre experience strikes him. Can the young man make it home safely?

Explore the dark underbelly of a massive wine cellar contested with cult bandits, traps, and paranormal bosses. Select from an array of different characters with unique abilities, and opportunities for customization.

Sandbox economic simulation game about class struggle. European country is in a deep crisis. You are the mayor of the capital. Social unrest is inevitable. What price will you pay to save your people from anarchy?

An unquenchable multiplayer strategy game where bugs clash over the sweet nectar of sugary beverages. From Beetle Brigade to Spidey Party, you will artfully master strengths and shortcomings to topple boba shops and coffee bars. The countertop mayhem has begun.

Nobunaga was captured by Ninja Castle and remodeled to overflow from his whole body with lubricant.! He cannot even walk due to the slimy texture, but is able to kick the wall and slip with taking advantage of the lubricant! Let's cut off Ninjas' heads one after another, and escape from the Castle!
Tu travailles dans une putain de laverie automatique. Vous faites votre travail normalement pendant la journée, mais des choses étranges vous arrivent la nuit.

It's hard to be a god! Worshipper is a fast-paced strategy combined with collectible card game. Explore and conquer the land, face dreadful creatures, lead your people to glory! With every victory you will unlock new units, spells and buildings, use them to develop your own unique strategies!
「Maybe one day, I won't have to fight when I fly.」

A new take on the Infinite Runner, now in VR. Dodge, Jump, and Vault with both hands as you make your way through infinite obstacles and Zombies. Unlock more weapons to help you progress further. How far will you go?
Be who you were meant to be. Be a Banana!
Use deduction, murder and trust your luck to eliminate the town council and rule over the helpless cartoon horses in a twisted strategy RPG.
Gear up and get ready for war! Take on hectic 2D action shooting stages with your deadly Gunhound mech.

Tactical turn based strategy game in an Alien invasion, inspired by classic boardgame rules. You will battle in a procedurally generated mission environments, upgrade your squad & equipment to battle against alien invaders and terrorists. No checkpoints, save only if you make it back to base alive..

It's after midnight on the Quartzway Express, and there's been a MAGICAL CRIME! Investigate the crime scene, question suspects, and defend the accused through unique cross-examination puzzles in this "Phoenix Wright" inspired mystery comedy.

titre: A Sky Full of Stars 仰望夜空的星辰
description: The starry sky spreads far and wide overhead... This story full of love, comedy, and excitement follows our protagonist and his stargazing friends as they grow together. "A Sky Full of Stars" is a coming-of-age astronomy tale by the same team who brought you "If My Heart Had Wings".

titre: The Legend of Heroes: Trails into Reverie
description: Three different legends are about to unfold! Determine the fates of Rean Schwarzer, Lloyd Bannings, and the mysterious “C” in this climactic chapter of The Legend of Heroes series.

Hybrid Wars : un jeu de tir futuriste en vue de dessus. Commandez et améliorez un arsenal d'engins futuristes pour abattre des hordes d'ennemis au travers de gigantesques niveaux dans ce jeu de tir pour les casse-cou.

Après vous être retrouvé piégé dans votre propre rêve, explorez un monde rempli de magie et riche en histoires. Exploitez la puissance des Pierres de Nuit pour transformer instantanément le jour en nuit, découvrir de nouveaux personnages, dénicher des trésors cachés et débloquer de nouvelles capacités dans ce jeu d'aventure en monde...
Anime Hack and Slash with an intense 3D combat. Neutralize the irregular robots and recover the control of the factory.

CLICK THE BUTTON. click the button. cLiCk ThE bUtToN. The unofficial sequel, of the unofficial sequel, of click to ten. Explore the intriguing story of how you go from 0 to 1. 1 to 2. 2 to 3. and you know the rest.

titre: Romance of the Three Kingdoms V with Power Up Kit
description: Released in 1995, "Romance of the Three Kingdoms Ⅴ with Power Up Kit" is the enhanced version of the 5th release in the Romance of the Three Kingdoms series. It places more focus on the common people with "Fame," which was an indicator of how well the Ruler grasped the hearts of the people.
Chase your friends in this heart-racing "Tag" based game. Use a grappling hook and bouncy physics to your advantage. Features proximity voice chat.
Deep Space Cache est un jeu court et simple de bullet heaven combiné à un incremental miner d'astéroïdes.
A game of immense adventure and fun excavation potential.
Row Divers is a short, experimental incremental game about diving into dungeons in the form of rows, shooting enemies, collecting resources, and upgrading your bow to conquer the depths!

"Old Coin Pusher Friends 2" is an online cooperative coin pusher game set in the Edo period. Players work together to defeat yokai, repel skulls, and aim for the jackpot. As the game progresses, players can upgrade their abilities and equipment to become stronger.

titre: The Legend of Heroes: Trails through Daybreak
description: The spriggan known as Van Arkride, an underground professional, accepts any job, acting as detective, negotiator, or bounty hunter. Dive into the Trails series' latest chapter with intense combat, beautiful visuals, and a new alignment system in Calvard!

Prenez un sac à dos, du ruban de boxe et concentrez-vous sur l’objectif réel du lycée : Se casser la tronche en combat ! Troublemaker rassemble les éléments d'action-aventure-beat'em-up préférés des plus grandes traditions du genre.

You are a Wizard, who to perfect himself in the art of magic, begins a challenging journey. Using the power of your staff and the ability to solve puzzles, you will acquire the energy of rare crystals and unlock powerful spells. Are you ready to this journey?
You play as a Saint fighting in a gun-filled pit, defeating as many opponents as you can in a 90 seconds match, the UBERMOSH, an enlightenment ritual of combat.

Viktor is an action-packed sidescrolling adventure with gameplay inspired by classics such as Castlevania and Megaman. As Viktor, you will fight your way through hordes of relentless enemies, lurking traps, and fearsome bosses who will try to keep you from your mission.

Sautez à travers la lave en fusion, fuillez un rémouleur, glissez et grimpez dans les catacombes, tombez dans les abysses et devenez maître de la gravité ! Surtout, n'oubliez pas de sauter vers une dimension temporelle parallèle parce que c'est ça Alteric.

Vous avez deux semaines pour sauver le festival des moissons ! Cultivez votre jardin et faites pousser des plantes pour élaborer sorts et rituels afin de venir en aide aux habitants du village de Flora (ou pas...). Une histoire toute mimi pleine de chaos, d'amitié et de romantisme !

Une NOUVELLE aventure interactive animée! Dans ce jeu d’action-aventure, Arzette doit explorer le royaume de Faramore, tuer des ennemis redoutables, acquérir des objets puissants, mettre à jour des secrets, aider des personnages hauts en couleurs, et vaincre le maléfique Daimur!

The Stranger is an intense VR combat game which sets in an incredibly detailed exotic world. Explore the rich sci fi universe and survive with your weapons and wrist blade. Welcome to the world of the Stranger!
Attaque de l'espace extra-atmosphérique. Jeu de tir classique à la première/troisième personne à l'ancienne. Combattez des zombies, des mutants, des monstres pour sauver la Terre !

Project Boost is a third person action shooter game. It is a single player experience, where you have to skillfully clear your way. You’ll be unlocking new abilities as you progress and use them to your advantage. Unravel the cause behind all this Mayhem.
a singleplayer sci-fi adventure game where you play as a a former child-soldier and his son uncovering the largest conspiracy in world history.
Satisfy your hacking and slashing needs in colorful and mushy candy world. Experience the most fun you can have with VR and HTC Vive controllers smashing stuff!

titre: Adventures in Morality: An Interactive Case Study
description: Take a 3D interactive test to calculate your sympathy-type. According to CYBIL, the A.I. who built Adventures in Morality, differences in sympathy-types is the cause and solution to all human conflict. Hear CYBIL's story and discover your sympathy-type in Adventures in Morality.
Utilisez votre voiture pour surmonter les obstacles, battre le temps et gagner
Ne vous arrêtez jamais dans cet intense et précis jeu de plate-forme afin de vous échapper de ce monde glitché ! Pourrez-vous être le plus rapide ?

Parcourez l’univers dans ce jeu de tir dans l’espace aux accents rogue-like. Découvrez de nombreux bonus, consommables et leurs combinaisons. Explorez une galaxie générée aléatoirement et débloquez vaisseaux, collectez des cartouches StellarnetES, éliminez les suzerains galactiques.
Plongez dans des dizaines d’univers poétiques et de paysages sonores méditatifs, ou résolvez des puzzles allant du mode facile au mode difficile.

KeyWe est un adorable puzzle-game postal en coop dans lequel deux oiseaux – des kiwis pour être plus précis – travaillent dans un bureau de poste extravagant. Ils doivent s'agiter tous azimuts pour se frayer un chemin à travers un paysage interactif de leviers, de clochettes et de boutons !

Avez-vous toujours rêvé de devenir PDG de la plus grande entreprise de fusées au monde? C'est devenu réalité. Commencez avec pratiquement rien et aboutissez à un empire de fusées. Dans EarthX, vous pouvez développer des technologies de fusée, mais également votre entreprise et la planète Terre!

Le son horrible résonne dans une ville isolée jusqu'à ce qu'il s'éloigne progressivement. Lorsque vous vous réveillez soudainement, vous êtes entouré de brouillard et vous jurez d'utiliser vos propres mains pour découvrir la brume enveloppée de doute et enfin trouver la vérité.

Content is a point-and-click horror adventure game. Become Anthony, an influencer looking for content that will make his videos viral. Investigate the cases, combine and use tools to overcome the given challenges. The fate of the protagonist, Anthony, is in your hands.
A cute turn-based tactics game about growing stronger, making friends and conquering foes! Become a cat, expand your territory and reign supreme over your enemies through dynamic tactical combat!

"Endless Monday: Dreams and Deadlines" - In this short story from the Endless Monday, Penny, a mild-mannered corporate grunt, spends a weekend at the office in an effort to finish her project on time while overcoming distractions from coworkers, space aliens, imaginary friends, and herself.

Chip is back and this time he's teamed up with Melinda to try and solve even more puzzles built from a combination of new and old monster, hazards and game elements created by Vladimir Gerajkee The Puzzle Master.
Skinwalker Hunt est un jeu de chasse sur fond d'horreur, créé par le créateur de Witch Hunt. Le jeu se concentre principalement sur de l'exploration, son gameplay non linéaire et son ambiance.
Octave is a point 'n click horror-adventure game with elements of action. Dark woods, monsters, paranormal activity, nice puzzles - all this is present in the game.
Découvrez les sombres secrets derrière les paillettes du monde de la mode !
Punch out Fascists and unravel conspiracies in this pulp adventure set in a retro-futuristic 1930s world of airships, fast cars, and two-fisted action!
Plongez-vous dans la peau de Dieu tout puissant et décidez du sort de l'humanité.

titre: Nameless ~The one thing you must recall~
description: Nameless ~The one thing you must recall~ is a visual novel game designed for female audiences. It was distributed by the publisher, Cheritz, in English, Korean, and Japanese on Nov. 11th, 2013 and now it is available on Steam.

Furgal's Jetpack is a 2D runner with a side view. You are unjustly imprisoned, and your goal is to escape! Fly over cars and Dodge flying clubs to get to the desired freedom, because the only way to it is through the thorns of the urban jungle.
Gold are again stolen so you super hero need destroy enemy army and find stolen gold at 10 different locations
This is a story about an office clerk who tries to leave monotonous routine of life and do a book. And if he could find the time for his dream it depends on you.
Be a Pirate - a game about a small but brave pirate, whose goal is to collect all the coins and escape faster, because time is limited.
Minimalist style game : plankton simulation, an electronic pet generated by math codes. Under your care it will slowly grow up and evolve.
《露露的装备店》是一款模拟经营向RPG游戏。在游戏中，你将扮演名叫露露的精灵少女，在一个偏远的小镇上，从零开始经营一家装备店。据说，这个小镇的上一家装备店才开几天就倒闭了，而这一次，能够将店成功运营起来吗？

DigDigDrill is an underground mining and resource collecting game. Dig freely for minerals and treasures. Use the items you collect to forge your original drills in a hack-and-slash style equipment system.
Time moves forward only when you do in the dungeons of WazHack. Think your way out of problems instead of just spamming 'attack' and 'drink healing potion'.

Synced Warriors is a puzzle game where each button press controls all of the characters on the screen at the same time. You must navigate them to different locations while killing off the extra warriors.

You've taken what seems like an easy task: find missing clues to unlock doors that will lead you to secrets of the abandoned house. What you don't know is the danger that lurks inside and outside the house!
Fourth in the legendary Monkey Island series of graphic adventures!

The Graveyard est un jeu vidéo très court. Vous incarnez une personne âgée qui visite un cimetière. Vous marchez, vous vous asseyez sur un banc et écoutez une chanson. Il s'agit plus d'un tableau que vous pouvez explorer qu'un véritable jeu. Une essai avec de la poésie et de la narration, mais sans qu'aucun mot ne soit prononcé.
Fight with grappling hooks in this party brawler for one to four players. Play as a treasure hunting cat or a land swimming shark as you swing around the stage taking out your opponents.
A cute sandbox game about restoring an estate. Work with your (real or AI) friend Bollie to cut trees, catch sheep, build a shed and more in this outdoor autumn sandbox game.

EDIT: Starting on February 10th 2025, OrbusVR: Reborn will no longer be available for purchase, including all in-game purchases. We will continue to maintain servers until they sunset on April 6th 2025.

Pascal's Wager: Definitive Edition est un jeu RPG d'action captivant qui se déroule dans un univers de fantasy sombre. Incarnez les Hérauts dans leur quête pour découvrir ce qui se cache derrière la mystérieuse Brume sombre.

Magic Research is a text-based incremental game about Magic. You are the headmaster of a newly-created institution of Magic. Will you be able to lead your school to win the prestigious Tournament of Magic?

titre: Nancy Drew®: The Phantom of Venice
description: Infiltrate a Carnevale of Criminals in Italy!

titre: Nancy Drew®: The Secret of Shadow Ranch
description: Take a Wild Ride into Terror and Trickery to Rein in a Ghostly Secret!
The best Logic Puzzle game on Steam.

Inspiré par le jeu d'échecs, mais avec des combats que VOUS contrôlez, Archon était le jeu d'échecs de combat originel. Vous devez tenter de vous montrer plus habile que votre adversaire en utilisant des équipes de créatures fantastiques et autres monstres dans cette lutte épique entre la Lumière et les Ténèbres.

Vous êtes Haroona, une Quaestor née avec la capacité de pénétrer dans une dimension mystérieuse, le Revers. Au cours de sa quête d'un savoir secret inestimable, elle va devoir apprendre à maîtriser les pouvoirs du Revers pour combattre une société secrète aux intentions malveillantes.

titre: Adventures of JQ Jones: "Isle of the Serpent Empress"
description: An action, adventure, stealth, VR maze crawler game. Explore and help JQ Jones collect gems, Serpent's eggs, hidden door knobs and keys to open gates. Battle against the enemies to pass through each levels by using your longbow, sword and Shuriken blade.
Hard to be a God is a Sci-Fi RPG with adventure and espionage elements.
This is an action-comedy game where you work part-time at a convenience store register while taking down troublesome "nuisance customers."

Destroyer: The U-Boat Hunter vous offre une expérience de simulation de destroyer authentique et fidèle à la réalité historique, ainsi que des combats navals anti-sous-marins en plein océan Atlantique durant la Seconde Guerre mondiale.

Crying Pony is a 2D side-scrolling horror game where the protagonist, Michael, is hunted by the lurking evil in his nightmares. As the nightmare's corruption seeps into reality and even pulls Michael's daughter into its grasp, will he be able to lead them both to escape from the nightmare?

Bâtiment de ville casual. Devenez architecte. Managez le petit polis. Batissez un quartier idyllique avec beaucoup de maisons. Faites votre chemin vers le haut à travers le mode campagne detaillé, ou créez vos propres scénarios.

Slow time to a crawl as you pilot your super charged space craft through randomly generated waves of enemies, defeat huge bosses, and explore a cyberpunk planet with a flunking college football captain and his team's feline mascot Nova!
An online or local multiplayer space monkey racing platformer. Fight your way to the top to grab the banana with tons of different ways to play.

"Heavy front" is a Japanese eschatological painting style, classic chess and card game with two core playing methods. Free skills, as well as arms restraint and matching, start your eschatological journey.
Les filles ont très faim, nourrissez-les, elles vous attendent.

titre: Forgotten Realms: The Archives - Collection Two
description: The Forgotten Realm Archives - Collection Two brings a healthy mix of “Gold Box” and nostalgia goodness to your PC, along with a combination of adventure builders, turn-based and real-time role-playing gameplay.

Devenez un coach de tennis et gérez jusqu'à 4 joueurs de tennis : gérez les sessions d'entraînements, le planning, les sponsors, les membres de l'équipe, les tactiques de match, et plus ! Serez-vous capable de mener vos joueurs au sommet de la hiérarchie mondiale ?
A lone man's journey through a strange world. Dimension switching mechanic - switch between the dimensions to traverse the world and solve puzzles.
Vivez aux premières loges la saison 2003 du FIA GT Championship tout en testant vos talents de pilote sur les tracés légendaires du FIA GT.

It's hard to be a kitten when you have such a clumsy owner! Yesterday she lost a lot of things in the park and now it's up to you to find them! Memories of that day can be helpful - you should remember where you've seen these things last and search there.

In a world where banks control countries, finances and armies, manage your bank and army to dominate the world. Based on actual banking principles, create relationships and strategies to manage finances and armies and lead your bank in turn-based grid game play

Bridge! lets you be a structural engineer and a construction manager in one. Master the mystery to bridge with a limited budget and limited numbers of parts to divide and to ensure a smooth operation.
This is a classic historical simulation + real-time strategy game, where you will go back to the era of the Three Kingdoms and play as various renowned sovereigns.

A turn based tactics style Roguelike mecha RPG set in a world recovering from the apocalypse. Take control of an 18m, 50 ton death machine and build a team of unique lancemates. Features include a detailed mecha design system, procedural narrative, and both mecha + personal scale combat.
Engage in multiplayer VR gunfights that capture real gun play like no FPS you've played before. Pilot and fortify Hover Junkers as you physically walk, duck, dodge and aim in cross ship combat.
Cinemaware's Anthology of classic games gives you a fascinating collection of some of the highest-regarded, most successful games from legendary game developer Cinemaware!

After finding a collapsed goddess on the street, Sho takes her home. Akane is an Aragami, a goddess that only thinks about herself and causes trouble to those around her. Can Sho, with the help of Inori and Maika, help Akane reform into a perfect goddess?
All Curtis wants is to live a normal, happy life, but something seems to have other plans...

Design your battleship and fight your way through unforgiving space. This is a tale of a lone spaceship on a centuries-long mission. As the captain, you´ll make strategic decisions, explore unknown sectors, meet allies and enemies, gather resources, technology and crew. To battle stations!

titre: Magic Seeker: a mimic's odyssey - chapter 1
description: Welcome to world of "MAGIKA". A turn-based game, with an intriguing story filled with mimics, creatures who can be anything that is around you, so always be prepared for a fight!
Click your way to a fortune in Treasure Chest Clicker! Discover gold, level up and find all the rare treasures hidden inside the chests!

titre: The Legacy: The Tree of Might Collector's Edition
description: Explorez les causes de la mystérieuse épidémie. Enquêter sur les causes de la mystérieuse épidémie aura des conséquences plutôt imprévisibles... “The Legacy: l'Arbre de la Puissance'' est un jeu d'aventure dans le genre Objet Caché, avec plusieurs mini-jeux et puzzles, des personnages inoubliables et des quêtes complexes.

Project Wunderwaffe: Prologue n’est qu'une partie du jeu qui vous attend dans la version complète du jeu. Vous serez plongé dans la réalité de la Seconde Guerre mondiale. Votre tâche consiste à éloigner les troupes ennemies le plus loin possible de votre base. Combattez et survivez !
Missing Persons est un jeu d'horreur et de survie dans lequel vous incarnez Calvin pour survivre contre le scientifique qui vous a kidnappé pour effectuer des tests sur vous.

Bing Bong XL est un jeu d’arcade minimaliste et rapide avec un gameplay addictif à un seul bouton. Esquivez les obstacles, collectez des points et survivez le plus longtemps possible. Idéal pour des parties rapides ou en attendant une autre partie !
Challlenge Speedball is a cooperative multiplayer game based on the competition paintball variation called Speedball.
Jane Sinclaire faces her greatest challenge in the mysterious city of Adera. Solve puzzles, collect artifacts, and unlock its secrets!
When fear is incarnated in our humanity, many things happen, good and bad, take control of this fear by mixing 2D and 3D dimensions and live a journey beyond Greece.

The story of a homeless person is a wonderful story about one cheerful homeless person. This game will be able to immerse you in the world of homelessness. In this excellent game, you will need to collect bottles and turn them in to buy some vodka.

Hearthlands is a medieval/fantasy city-building real time strategy game in which you take a role of a king in a procedurally generated world. You can not control your subjects directly; instead you focus on city-building, resource management, diplomacy, magic, etc.

Almost Alive is redefining the role playing tactical games with an awesome fast paced but complexe real time combat system in a mad hand drawn post apocalyptic world that features character mental sanity, destructible environment, a cover system, tons of loot, a none linear story, and a lot of humor.
Construa hotéis, acomode hóspedes e expanda seu negócio de hotéis através do mundo!
Fork Road est un jeu atmosphérique immersif à la première personne avec un nouveau gameplay. Préparez-vous à affronter des peurs que vous n'avez jamais affrontées auparavant.

Gunman Taco Truck is an action-packed drive across the post-apocalypse United States to reach the safe haven of Winnipeg, Canada, where there are no taco trucks and your family’s taco business can thrive. Getting to the safe towns is hectic but your truck is armed with weapons that blast mutants into taco fillings.
Train of Afterlife is a mystery, psychological, horror Visual Novel.

It's the future! And humanity is, predictably, under attack by extraterrestrial forces. Lucky for us we have an experimental ship that's never before been flown that will surely...uh, possibly...well, implausibly be able to win the war! All we need now is a pilot or two.
In this old-school RPG, join three seemingly unrelated characters as their decisions unknowingly intertwines their fate with the fate of the world and all life as they know it.

A tribute to those less then stellar computer shareware and multicart games of the past, 32 in 1 features many different game genres, some with a odd sense of humor. Games mainly lean on point scores ,speed runs and survival, all to give you the player a sense of pride and accomplishment!

Delve into the infinitely AI-generated, ghastly haunted mansion of TORUTARU. Use talismans, maps, your wits, and the friends you make along the way to fight off the angered spirits and survive. Every playthrough is a unique experience.
Build a space station. Command the tiny crew. Explore the galaxy. A meditative space strategy game.

Ignited Steel is a mech roguelike turn-based-tactics game. Manage a team of overheating old-tech mechs, more heat means more vulnerability and damage! Unravel the galaxy’s story as you travel from node to node, improving your mechs, acquiring new pilots, and defeat the sentient A.I. overlord!

Freud Gate is an interactive story game about the story of dream and redemption. Freud Gate, the "door of heart" in the game. Players will play as a spiritual mentor and help the depressed girl to find a breakthrough. The game is divided into two parts: the real world and the imaginary world.
Bullet in the sleeve. Shoot, dodge and reload.

Semblance est un jeu de plateforme dans un monde minimaliste et malléable. Un jeu qui évoque la possibilité de changer la forme du monde. Un jeu de plate-forme à l'envers. Et si les plateformes servaient à résoudre les énigmes?

titre: Romance of the Three Kingdoms X with Power Up Kit
description: "Romance of the Three Kingdoms Ⅹ with Power Up Kit" is an expanded version of "Romance of the Three Kingdoms Ⅹ," which was released in 2004 as the 10th game in the series. In this release, the all-officer playable advances.
Race your oppression away! Kill all men in the race of your life - the race for tolerance and equality.
Un jeu de défense/tourelles dans un monde fantastique, avec une surprise...
Watch videos together with your friends online!
Shoot, slash, dodge and survive to blade combats in multiple kind of challenges to test your skills and claim your place in the Omega Blade hall of fame.
Retro, classic, couch-buddy competition in space! Simple controls make it easy for friends and family to join in the fun!

Un shooter PvP déjanté pour 2–12 joueurs ! Pourchassez vos ennemis sur des torpilles rapides, dépassez-les avec des tactiques 360° et maîtrisez 4 modes à enjeux élevés dans d’immenses arènes sous-marines. Toujours gratuit, jamais pay-to-win !

Single Player: Horror is a unique POV interactive experience. You don’t just play the role of Sophie, you see through her eyes. You wake up to find a Psycho Axe Killer in your living room who is desperate to chop you into pieces. Will you survive the night?

Emprisonné dans l’obscurité, vous devez utiliser la visualisation du son pour vous guider à travers les environnements menaçants. Les sons que vous créez sont réfléchis par les obstacles et vous révèlent les formes du monde environnant.

"With your trusty shank and die hard will to survive, you've successfully broken out of your Prison Cell. How many other prisoners can you set free on your way to Freedom? Take down as many Guards as possible while avoiding traps and hazards along the way! From Knives, to Guns, and Mines to Bombs!"

Prenez le contrôle d'une équipe mondiale d'élite de pirates informatiques, interceptant les communications entre les entreprises, les gouvernements et les criminels du monde entier. Le choix t'appartient!

Un incroyable mélange de jeu de rôle, stratégie, gestion, bac à sable et survie. Aurora Dusk ressemble à beaucoup de jeux, mais au lieu d'être seul, vous vivez au milieu d'une communauté. Vous incarnez un ou plusieurs villageois et évoluez de l'Âge du bois jusqu'à l’Âge de la Vapeur.

A turn-based RPG where you play as Lelie, a woman who uses the power of Dowsing to help people find things they've lost. One day however, Lelie's power gets her and her friend into a dangerous situation that they must work together to overcome.

Scary World is a single player bullet heaven roguelike. It's like Vampire Survivors but with lots of physics. Also, matches are shorter, more like 10 minutes long. Give it a try, maybe you'll like it!

Faster than anyone. Stronger than anyone. And more stunning. Customize your robot for “cyber battle racing” in a game that offers all the thrills of racing, battle, and customization. Online, Offline, Time-Attack... which mode will you dominate?!
Playcraft est un bac à sable multijoueur de création de jeux accessible à tous!

Deranged is a single player puzzle and psychological horror video game. Find a way to escape the O'Connor mansion before things get tough. Remember that in order to escape you must complete challenging puzzles against the clock ... Will you be able?
Explore the picturesque U3 line of Hamburg's elevated railroad in the new SubwaySim Hamburg!

Welcome to the fantastical world of Alamyth where you can recruit all new legendary heroes and fight the terrifying forces of evil. Visit all new landscapes of Alamyth such as the Firelands and fight the likes of The Leprechaun Henchmen and the evil villain, Ernak The Lethal.

AO International Tennis est le jeu de tennis le plus authentique et le plus convivial de tous les temps. Grâce à son outil PlayFace™ complet, son éditeur de stades et d’autres options de personnalisation, vous pouvez introduire une version super réaliste de vous-même dans votre compétition de tennis locale, vous confronter aux plus...

Since the outbreak, New York has turned into an isolated quarantine zone. You and your squad are just on the way to the quarantine border to reinforce the guard when an unexpected emergency call forces you to enter. Those who enter the quarantine zone rarely return. Can you and your team survive?

Lucius game has been demade, and is now ready for mayhem. Enjoy all the gore now in fewer pixels and fewer colors. The original game has been fully demade to achieve the atmosphere of an 80's style gory adventure. Lucius is now killing all the pixels and there isn't a damn thing anyone can do about it.

In this voice-acted, hand-painted visual novel about women and witchcraft, a brush with the coronavirus sends Penny back in time to the New England witch hunts. As Penny meets strong female characters who challenge past and present stereotypes, she discovers her own special role in the changing seasons of time.

From the creators of the critically acclaimed STEINS;GATE comes a sensational new visual novel: CHAOS;CHILD. Set in Shibuya in 2015, a group of high school students who survived an earthquake six years ago find themselves at the center of a new series of bizarre murders in the city.
有一天，想成为制簪人的【光】无法忍耐每日修行的痛苦，逃出了家门。 路上，她遇到一位头上发簪十分合称的女性。 在女性的引导下，她来到一个稀奇古怪的城镇。

titre: The Girl of Glass: A Summer Bird's Tale - The Journey Begins
description: Experience the beginning of Kristal's journey and the world around her. Learn the basic mechanics of this point and click adventure game, featuring turn-based combat and visual novel elements.
Boss Monster is a dungeon-building game based on the boardgame of the same name.

Man of Honor is a mafia themed top down shooter / character study where you control Emilio Gallo, an ex-mafioso, as he fights to get revenge on his former friends in the waning rust belt city of Ferrousburgh.

In 2030, humans successfully create a VRMMO Simulation game that players will play in a virtual reality world via a special Headset. You as a player join this game, encounter many girls and seduce them.

Bush Rescue Returns! The hero loved by millions worldwide, TY the Tasmanian Tiger™, is back! Join TY on an exciting new adventure in the great Aussie Outback. Use your wits and boomerangs to find hidden treasures, help the colorful locals, and uncover the mysteries of the land Down Under.
This is a search for beautiful girls. Through the wiping of the gentlemen, the girls and girls interact to trigger the unlocking of all CG.

titre: Toy Odyssey: The Lost and Found
description: ​Toy Odyssey is fundamentally an action-adventure platformer. The player spends the night exploring a randomly-generated house, defeating bosses in each of the unique rooms, and then going up against the final boss.
Use your detective skills to solve the mystery of the missing film crew and finish the movie.

Be My Girlfriends est une combinaison d'une belle fille + un jeu magique d'esquive d'obstacles + un GALGAME. Vous devez contrôler les poulets, esquiver divers obstacles, éviter les ennemis et atteindre la porte de l'amour avec vos copines pour déclencher le niveau de l'intrigue...

Glyph is a free-to-play virtual reality game where you control a ball-shaped mechanical scarab from a third-person perspective. You are challenged to use precision and speed to collect relics and artifacts to complete levels.

You've been entrusted with the care of a crew of girls whose sins have damned their souls to Hell and an eternity of punishment... Their only hope of salvation is for you to recognize their unique histories, and to guide them along the path to redemption.
Help Find Dan the Dog!
War Cube is a strategy game, each team is on a face of the cube and the player must turn sideways to position your troops so that they stop in an attacking position, being behind or beside the enemy.

Wilmot's Warehouse est un jeu d’énigmes dans lequel il faut organiser au mieux un entrepôt. Mais n’oubliez pas où vous avez rangé les divers produits, parce que quand la trappe de service s’ouvre, vous devez trouver ce que veulent les clients rapidement, afin de gagner les étoiles de performance convoitées.
体验无需编程的全能游戏编辑器：唤境引擎！唤境引擎提供了多种游戏类型所需的常用逻辑，从物理碰撞到自动寻路均可一键配置，同时也提供自由编写游戏逻辑的能力；支持多种素材格式，从精灵到骨骼再到tilemap，也支持PC、安卓、H5等多个平台的打包发布；更有丰富的教程、示例、模板、手册来帮你快速上手。快来使用唤境，实现你的游戏梦想吧！

Au coeur d'une Odyssée futuriste, "The Next Penelope" mélange l'action, la stratégie et le danger sur fond de courses ultra nerveuses. Les armes spéciales peuvent être utilisées à tout moment, mais coûtent de l'énergie vitale au vaisseau, forçant le joueur à prendre des risques maximum!

Milford Heaven, a small medieval village, is under attack!! Won't you do nothing? Luken's castle is filled with treasures! Come, help the villagers, loot Luken's castle and became as rich as you have never dreamed before!
Mister Burnhouse is a real gangster quest with drawn graphics and colorful characters. Many interesting situations and puzzles with a slight flavor of madness!
A dating simulator where your end goal is to get your date to "Flix & Chill" with you. Do you have what it takes to do the bowchickawowow?
Dare you to explore and interact with an innocuous home environment in first person, solving intricate puzzles and a mystery whilst escaping the clutches of a sadistic hag and her morbid son.

Dans un monde d'hommes-singes, vous êtes un homme-banane luttant pour survivre dans une station spatiale. Craftez des plateformes, attrapez des bananes et restaurez la station pour devenir le commandant.

Réveillé la nuit par votre poupée. Parlant comme si elle possédait une âme. La poupée vous avertit qu’un monstre vient pour vous emporter. Prenez votre lampe de poche et trouvez le Boogeyman avant qu’il ne vous trouve !
Odd||Even is a math and logic based, integer placement puzzle game.

Apprenez et jouez au Go, le jeu de société classique pratiqué depuis des milliers d'années, et participez à la course pour conquérir le maximum de terrain dans le monde du jeu, ou affrontez des adversaires en ligne aux quatre coins du monde réel.

Purrfect Date est un mélange entre un roman visuel et un simulateur de rencontres, avec une bonne dose d'humour noir anglais. Vous incarnez un humain qui doit rencontrer des chats et découvrir les secrets inavouables de la mystérieuse Cat Island.

titre: Sacred Fire: A Role Playing Game
description: RPG textuel rempli de choix et d’action. Battez-vous pour votre survie en invasion romaine en Calédonie. Vos émotions affectent tous les jets de dés : utilisez votre volonté pour surpasser vos ennemis, gagner des alliés, faire la guerre ou chercher la paix. Comment se terminera votre histoire ?

Par les créateurs du carton indépendant Stick It to The Man ! Ce jeu de poignardage coopératif pour un à quatre joueurs est une aventure mortelle avec une bande de vikings zombies parcourant un monde épique en quête de l'œil perdu d'Odin.
Découvrez et détruisez des créatures toujours plus horribles dans un monde lo-fi oppressant, armé d'un puissant arsenal et de sorts dévastateurs dans ce jeu d'action-aventure au format poche.

titre: 湛藍牢籠 Rail of Möbius
description: "Rail of Möbius" est un jeu d'aventure textuel avec de multiples choix et plusieurs fins. Il fusionne les éléments de déduction, de suspense, de romance et de science-fiction, permettant aux joueurs de se lancer dans un voyage de sauvetage à bord d'un train sous-marin.
Everyone has nightmares every now and then... but what would you do if a demon trapped you in a nightmare and you couldn't wake up?
PixelJunk™ Monsters is back with the simple, yet highly strategic real-time tower defense gameplay gameplay of the original title, now with updated graphics and brand new multiplayer modes!

Faites les tâches données dans la forêt tropicale et obtenez tous les diamants magiques. Tuez les créatures résultantes et poursuivez votre mission. Protégez-vous dans le monde ouvert et rappelez-vous que vous êtes seul.

titre: Amulet of Time: Shadow of La Rochelle
description: When the ghost of the beautiful Diane de Poitiers appears in front of you, you are transported back in time in "Amulet of Time: Shadow of la Rochelle"! Explore France and an incredible love story in this amazing Hidden Object Adventure game.

Einherjar is a combination RTS and turn-based game, with roguelike elements. Defend against waves of enemies as your territory expands, and the opposition becomes tougher, while building up your base and defending and upgrading your resources.

In Enlightenment, you play in a roguelike action-shooter with a fast-paced challenging journey deep into a underground complex called "the Ark". Players will be tested by large varieties of enemies in a procedurally-generated dungeon, and become stronger by learning from the inevitable deaths.
這是一款日本遊戲公司La'cryma製作的以“淚水”為主題的校園戀愛Galgame，表面是融合了“萌”和“燃”要素的青春愛情+熱血戰鬥的美少女遊戲，實際是催淚催奶帶五險一金的里番，更令人震精的是你玩到最後會發現更大的黑幕：神OP+神主題曲+神級BGM讓你燃到爆，音樂才是本體！

La peste propage peur et souffrance dans la petite ville de Wippra. Médecin, vous soulagez ses habitants lorsque c'est possible… Mais l'ignorance, la superstition et le zèle religieux sont des menaces mortelles dans cette aventure rétro-médiévale !

The USSR era is coming to its end – it is 1988. The radio amateur catches a strange signal that emits incomprehensible noises. It is broadcast around the clock and only sometimes a human voice makes its way through the air. You will have to uncover terrifying secrets about this enigmatic signal.
In Luckslinger, luck is measurable, collectable and usable whenever you please. Contains: gunslingers, dark humor, spaghetti western, vinyl digging, graffiti spraying and jazzy hip hop beats.

Step into the extraordinary, dystopian world of Dark Future, filled with danger, chaos and adventure. A game of both action and strategy unlike any other, featuring a unique time dilating command mode to help you make tactical decisions on the dangerous highways of this world.

Winter Survival est un jeu de survie narratif où vos traumatismes transforment la réalité en un reflet de votre psyché fragile. Affrontez le froid, la faim et les hallucinations et tentez de survivre à cette nature hostile qui s'adapte à vous.
Be a Ninja character in this 3rd person platformer. Avoid traps, enemies, solve puzzles and finish maps

In another normal day of his job as a space engineer, Ryzer is going to fix a space prison ship and things don't go his way. In Ryzer: The Reflectors Path, help Ryzer find the best path through the reflectors in this futuristic puzzle and finally just complete his job.
Tank Operations: European Campaign est un wargame tactique en tour par tour, qui vous propose de revivre une douzaine de batailles historiques sur divers théâtres de la 2e Guerre Mondiale.
《锋芒录》是一款古风武侠题材的经营类独立游戏，讲述的是古时江南一名喜爱武学的公子，以寻找失踪家人为契机，经营起武馆的故事。

A real-time strategy game based on the history of the Northern Song Dynasty. The player can experience the fun of conquering cities, directing the country, and ultimately uniting the world through their own efforts in the simulated historical background of the game!
studio: 石家庄龙游科技有限公司

description: Moving Out est de retour, plus loufoque que jamais, avec un MODE EN LIGNE ! Faites vos valises pour Packmore et mettez vos talents de déménageur à l'épreuve.

À coups de poing et de fouet ou en tyrolienne, frayez-vous un chemin au travers les dangers d'une Amérique post-apocalyptique dans ce jeu d'action purement rétro! Incarnez Taro Takahashi, un soldat de la résistance en quête de vengeance contre le dictateur qui contrôle les ruines fumantes du pays.

Featuring up to 8 Players at once via local Co-op or Steam Remote Play, DOG GONE GOLFING is a fun pick up and play Arcade golf game where cute dogs slap hockey pucks around procedurallly generated worlds. Compete on the Leaderboards for top scores, or find some buddies for some multiplayer madness.

In the depths of a forest, an exiled princess whiles her time in solitude. One day, a mysterious, beautiful maiden appears, throwing her world out of its alignment. A dark fantasy visual novel following the intertwining paths of these two women. In seven days, the wheel of fate will splinter...
Water is flooding the world. Build your own way to climb higher and higher. Maybe there is a chance of survival after all. Give yourself a try! Help those boars reach the highest level.

titre: Mystery Case Files®: Escape from Ravenhearst™
description: Return once more to the haunted grounds of Ravenhearst Manor to uncover new details about this poignant saga. What you find could very well be the final chapter of this riveting story—if you escape.

titre: Twilight City: Love as a Cure
description: In Twilight City: Love as a Cure, vous incarnez un jeune vampire passionnément amoureux d’une humaine. Toutefois, le prix à payer pour la malédiction de l’immortalité est très élevé. Votre dévorante soif de sang peut anéantir votre amour.

You are the only survivor of a plane crash and you find yourself on mysterious phantom island. Can you solve the mystery of the island and get out of it relying only on yourself and your survival skills?
Equip your battleship's guns, install faster engines, and increase the power of your reactor. Throw a barrage of rockets on hordes of enemy ships, burning everything in your path!

Un escape game horrifique sur une femme victime d'un enlèvement. Levez le voile sur le passé de votre ravisseur pour trouver un chemin vers la liberté sans vous faire surprendre. Mais votre ravisseur est loin d'être votre seul problème. Plus vous avancez, plus les choses deviennent étranges.

HunterX : code name T est un jeu d'action-aventure qui propose des combats rapides et stylés. Perfectionnez votre propre style de combat en utilisant les nombreuses armes et en lançant des sorts, tout en explorant un monde incroyablement vaste.

Gaze into the stars as a curious astronomer in this VR adventure of magic & science. Manipulate a strangely powerful telescope and influence a galaxy of planets and their inhabitants for the better. Take photos and conduct intricate research to uncover the deepest cosmic secrets.
Explore the mysterious world of Erenblad to protect the land from demonic entities and perform your shanar to become the new master shaman of Aahkray in this tactical turn-based RPG.

Kingso est un jeu de stratégie 2D au tour par tour dans le genre fantasy médiévale, avec une variété de mécaniques. Chaque partie est unique, se déroulant sur le continent d'Avelir. Serez-vous capable de changer le destin du continent d'Avelir, ou permettrez-vous sa destruction?

Assume the role of a praying mantis in a relationship dilemma. Torn between their mutual love and the instinct to have sex – which could lead to the male mantis’s death – the couple is on the verge of making a decision. Type anything you want in response to your partner during this life-changing conversation.

Don't get fooled by the simple looks of this game! The way it is played is something unseen so far in the gaming world! Using a novel patented technology you and your friends will use your cellphones to aim at the screen and shoot! Show your friends who is a real gunslinger!
Vous commencez le jeu, vous vous réveillez et finalement vous fermez le jeu. Un jour, vous pouvez même recommencer le jeu. C'est le jeu.

Welcome to an adrenaline-pumping platform game where players embark on an exhilarating race against each other through a challenging parkour course! Prepare to test your agility, speed, and reflexes as you navigate through an immersive world filled with obstacles, traps, and exciting surprises.

Responsible for the deaths of his girlfriend and sister, George is an alcoholic with a stormy past. Raised by a serial killer, George's life ends in suicide. But his story starts right from the end...

Il s'agit d'un jeu de combat 3D en temps réel à la troisième personne. Les héros tuent des monstres, gagnent de l'expérience et des adeptes. Les suiveurs forment une formation pour combattre avec les héros.

"Blood Hospital" is a FPS Horror adventure game A young man with frequent headache woke up in an abandoned hospital.Here let him have a strange and familiar feeling, locked doors, drugs, dark corridors, the voice in the shadow... A Strange voices always appeared and guided him to do something..

Kiosk est un jeu de cuisine horrifique où vous préparez des commandes pour les clients nocturnes qui visitent votre kiosque chaleureux et baigné de pluie. Une atmosphère étrange se mêle à une tension croissante tandis que vous servez vos visiteurs mystérieux.

Build, upgrade, and research mechs, weapons, and components. Manage employees and expand your base. Explore and collect resources. Find wanted mechs, destroy them, and collect bounties. Explore the post-nuclear wasteland and make the choices you believe are right.

Foul Play tells the story of a young, bright-eyed detective who is determined to succeed. Her world quickly turns upside down after she is tasked with catching a sexy, mercurial assassin. In the end, she'll need to determine how pure her conscience really is. After all, justice is subjective.

HALP! is a single-player VR sandbox puzzle game where you help a stranded scavenger pirate captain fix his broken ship before spaceworms attack... or where you DON'T do that and just enjoy poking around and messing with the ship's various gizmos and contraptions.

Blood Bar Tycoon est un jeu de gestion de bar à vampires. Construisez des bars et des usines à sang, attirez des humains pour récolter leur sang, transformez le et servez d'autres vampires. Recherchez des machines loufoques et faites face aux chasseurs! Étendez vous à travers Crimson City!
Action explosive en solo RTS avec une campagne scénarisée. Tenez bon face aux hordes massives sur un champ de bataille entièrement simulé.

titre: 安堂的心理咨询室：杯中之心〈ANDOU：Pulse of cup〉
description: 森林深处有着一间咨询室，在那里有一个机器人，她的任务是透过语言为迷途之人指引前行的道路，单纯且复杂。
A light-hearted FPS. Jam-packed with 15 missions, each with a different theme. Take out various targets, everything from trains, cars, to bombs and helicopters. Everything EXCEPT people!
Immersive and associative first person experience
Metagroove lets you create visual music experiments, make memes or random visual nonsense!

A visually stunning RTS where players battle to build the ultimate automated floating Ultraweapon. Outsmart players or AIs by building a strategically superior Battlecruiser. Step aboard for unique, hand-drawn misadventure on Flooded Earth, explosive gameplay, and an addictive soundtrack. And nukes.

Roombo : First Blood est un jeu d'action furtif en vue du dessus bourré d'humour où vous incarnez un aspirateur robot qui doit éliminer les cambrioleurs qui tentent de s'introduire chez vous. Un jeu court et expérimental qui vous donnera le frisson !

Old-school Action-RPG. The Fall of Gods is an indie game humbly inspired by Action-RPG you used to play on 16-bit consoles (zelda, secret of mana, alundra...). It was played by more than 75’000 gamers on PC and Xbox so far.

titre: The Adventures of Spunk Dodgers and Splat
description: Spunk Dodgers and his sidekick Splat are ambushed by a group of space pirates and crash land on a mysterious asteroid! As Splat, dodge wacky space monsters through hazardous terrain on your adventure to help Spunk Dodgers fix your ship!

Kyvir: Rebirth is a single player card game that combines elements of RPG, deck building, and roguelike gameplay. This game features an original dual deck mechanism, hundreds of distinctive items, skills, and cards for you to experiment with.
Turn-based space battle tactical/strategic game

AirMech Command is the definitive Action/RTS experience in VR. With all new tactical room-space controls AND ground-level flight controls, you can command troops and units from orbit, or grab the stick and pilot your AirMech directly. Lots of mechs, units, and unlockable vanity items--no microtrans!

Mélange de casse-tête et d'action, HUMANITY met le destin de l'humanité entre vos pattes. Incarnez un Shiba Inu guidant d'immenses foules vers l'objectif en mode histoire, ou créez vos propres niveaux grâce au Créateur de niveau intégré !
Pratiquez une multitude de jeux de sports tel que l'athlétisme, l'équitation, le cyclisme ou encore la natation.
Mark Thompson accepte un service de nuit dans un bureau mystérieux, mais ce qui semblait être une nuit de routine se transforme rapidement en cauchemar.

Weird Hero is a humorous and challenging shoot'em up where the hero, SuperMegaDude, battles countless foes with his arsenal of weird weapons: the Flickinator, the Atomic Toaster, a magician's hat and other strange devices.

A Combat driven metroidvania experience. Discover a tale long lost in our past. Seven swords need to be found in this world where you will discover ancient secrets and fight with an intense combat system that rewards players for their skills and knowledge.

Forge your own story and explore the world of Athens in Athenian Rhapsody, a souls-like platonic dating simulator with cooking-mama and WarioWare style battle mechanics... and by that I mean it's a choose-your-own-adventure action RPG with the ability to trade ENTIRE PLAYTHROUGHS between friends!!

The Sink Gods is a modern adventure game. You play a poor villager who lives in the Sink Valley. When you are evicted from your home, you realise your only hope is the Sink Gods of the Great Basin. Journey to each of their temples, and pass their test to gain revenge for what you have lost.

Blast disgusting foes in this randomly generated lootfest roguelite dungeon crawling puzzle shooter extravaganza! No two games will ever be the same in this cave of insanity and ill-repute, and indeed, you will never be the same after experiencing this insidious piece of software.
Starsation is a space shooter game made in voxel graphics.

Avenger Bird is a platform side-scroller game with pixel-art graphics, but your hero isn't just a regular hero. You are playing a bird that can flap it's tiny wings to fly and glide for a limited distances. It's a retro inspired 16-bit era game with innovative and challenging fly/glide mechanic.
A fun objective based single player first person shooter game similar to classic shooter games. Unique levels, fun objectives, and rewarding gunplay.

Ragnarök n'était que le début… de la fin ! Odinfall est un jeu de tir à double joystick en rogue-lite viking. Dégommez tout ce qui passe dans des niveaux en génération procédurale, améliorez votre personnage, modifiez vos armes et abattez des dieux-robots nordiques pour reconquérir votre liberté !

titre: 난중설화: The Tales of Imjin War
description: Join the epic journey of the Yuldogook warriors to uncover the truth behind the Imjin War and end the war once and for all.
Broll est un jeu de plateformes en 3D basé sur des ragdolls. Explorez des niveaux ouverts, utilisez les ragdolls pour interagir avec le monde et relever des défis impressionnants !

Tank Squad est un jeu tactique de combat et d'action. Participez à de grandes batailles de chars de la seconde guerre mondiale. Jouez en mode solo ou coop (4 joueurs). Réparez vos chars, ravitaillez-vous, dirigez l'équipe et retournez au combat!
전역은 오는가(My Military Life)는 제작자의 군 생활을 바탕으로 만든 추리·군대 쯔꾸르입니다. 저와 함께 군 생활을 하면서 사라진 분대카드를 찾아 무사히 전역하도록 합시다.

Cat in the Box is a horror adventure game. Help the poor girl explore the mansion and escape from unknown entities that are pursuing her. Use a variety of tools and your wits to overcome any challenges you face. At times, you'll even have to wake yourself from nightmares to survive.

Blood Soaked Bastard! Is an RPG set in a dreary medieval fantasy setting. Become a much abhorred Blood Knight and kill monsters in turn based combat, alongside a cast of freakish companions. Draw the blood of wretched monsters, you Bastard!
Dans ce jeu de plate-forme 2D, prenez votre arme à feu et tirez tout monstre sur votre chemin ou évadez-vous jusqu'à la sortie.

"Quantum Derelict" is a rogue-lite survival horror game set in a chilling Lovecraftian inspired narrative. In the uncharted vastness of space, outwit the sinister cult of VUGSHERYOG and the lurking horrors as you strive to retain your sanity, find rescue, and survive against all odds.
DOLLMAKER is a first person shooter tower defense game where you, an anthropomorphic rat, traverse the town of Willoughby to harvest eggs for the purpose of creating the perfect doll
Flappy Dragon is an endless runner with realistic graphics. Avoid obstacles to gain points pick up lives, shields and coins.

In a world left at the brink of destruction after years of war, take the role of a newly appointed lord and help bring back peace and stability to the kingdom! Choose your own formations and strategies to win your battles in this real-time battle RPG!

titre: Scary pictures: Yavez - seven deadly sins
description: Scary pictures: Yavez - seven deadly sins in the novel-horror genre. The game will plunge you into the atmosphere of the classic and gloomy history of the Soviet times. You have to face many life choices that will have consequences and lead to one of eight endings.
Participez à la construction du monument qui a fait la célébrité de l'île d'Alcatraz !

Survival-adventure VR game with the history in the background. We have to run away from Siberia. During World War II, the Russians deported by trains several hundred thousand people from Eastern Europe, including Poland to Siberia for work camps. You play as one of the displaced people.
Remember what it means to be a human in this interactive biography of a dead astronaut found in deep space by future intelligences who have no concept of humankind.
Insulated at the bottom - An atmospheric third-person shooter, meet and destroy enemies on your way, cope with difficult platforming and plunge into the atmosphere of an abandoned military base.

An eerie horror game set in a weird hotel plagued with bizarre beings and interesting characters. The game utilizes a never-used before environment alongside brand new horror mechanics, one of a kind graphics/art style, and an unnerving story with rich lore to create a unique experience for players.

MATH ADVENTURES Innovative game showing that Math is not difficult or boring! Not at all! Game develops mathematic skills and abilities of player. Consists of series of tasks for children and teens. Each task includes four levels of difficulty.

Starwalker is a space-exploration survival rpg focused on surviving a massive alien invasion on planet Earth. You'll be able to explore the solar system and beyond. You are the last human standing - ready to start a new life.

Descend into Netherguild, a tactical grid-based roguelite. Lead expeditions deep into mysterious, strange depths. Explore, battle dangerous foes, and manage resources carefully. Push your limits before returning to resupply. What secrets await below?

"Extraordinary: Soul" is a hand-drawn wind suspense story puzzle game, the story takes place in a shamanic legend of the town of Mutuso, you will follow a naughty robot Moe to investigate an unusual disappearance case.

titre: Zen Blocks - Relaxing Puzzle Board Game
description: Zen Blocks is an addictive original block puzzle game using original game play mechanics. Mixing some elements of tetris style gameplay on a 2D board, in an oriental ZEN setting. Original game play with 3 game modes. Enjoy this relaxing turn-based puzzler for a meditative XP.
Donuts 'N' Justice is a fast-paced 2d horizontal shoot-'em-up wherein you take the role of one of two Super Cops in the 1980s to defend their city against gangs, violence and corruption.

Être un fixeur de haute volée, c'est une question de contacts : vos clients ont besoin de discrétion, vos équipes d'arriver à la retraite. Et puis il y a vous, coincé entre les deux avec votre réputation en jeu. Oui, vous allez raccrocher. Mais après un dernier boulot.
Classic ribbon-cut jigsaw puzzle game play with original nature photography and animated puzzles. User-extendable means you can create your own puzzles instead of buying more.
Broken In Time is an action/adventure Turn based RPG. You (Titus) will explore different dimensions, solve puzzles, fight demons and monsters and ally with the other hero's around the multiverse!

Sanzenkai Setsuna awakens on the shore of isolated island Urashima with no memories of his past. Befriending three local girls, Rinne, Karen, and Sara, Setsuna's quest to discover the secrets of Urashima and how they tie into his own past - and future - begins.
Squirrel-based 2D platformer

Go on an exciting journey in the 14th century of Florence, an amazing city struck by a mysterious disease. The story is brimming with fascinating characters, historical events and captivating locations. History is yours to explore.

titre: Million on Mars: Space to Venture
description: Million on Mars delivers the most realistic Mars city-building MMO experience. Granted 40 acres of real Martian terrain, shop for rovers, energy systems, & factories to begin production on Mars. Leverage your skills and rovers, prepare your settlement for the arrival of the initial 20 Martians.
Thermonuclear is a fast-paced arcade shooter inspired by classic Cold War–era action games, featuring nuclear-themed combat and score-driven gameplay.

Stream Smash is an experimental game where streamers play with their viewers in real-time in a twin stick shooter. Battle against an ever increasing number of enemies with your Twitch viewers dropping towers and power-ups to help you.

In The Path to Memento Mori, players navigate eerie mazes in a co-op multiplayer horror puzzle game, solving complex puzzles and evading relentless monsters. Work together to uncover buried family secrets and unravel the chilling mystery that lies at the heart of the estate.

Cartographer is a turn-based game, where you decide how the world map looks. Build the map to build the world! The combat system is very simple and each enemy has its own attack pattern, which you can learn and exploit to defeat them in glorious turn-based battle!

Ride on a cloud, fly freely in the sky. Just stand on the cloud and you can control it by changing your position. dodging various obstacles, reach the goal in limited time. Support up to 4 local players racing in splict screen mode.
Multiplayer / Singleplayer Action platformer with customization, progression and custom PvP / races maps
Dive into dynamic mazes, outsmart weird ghosts, and snatch coins in this thrilling arcade adventure. Are you maverick enough?
MIMIC is an atmospheric horror game where you face off against your own shadow, trapped in a deadly game of wits. How do you defeat something that mimics your every move?
Hexagonal Explods is a vertical shoot 'em up game where you need to defend the earth from aliens. Collect power ups, fight funny bosses and... well... SHOOT THEM UP!

Guide the shipwrecked hero through the mysterious land of dungeons & castles in this classic-style action RPG, combined with modern, streamlined features; random loot, skill tree paths, player development, character customization, real-time combat and handcrafted maps.

Partez pour une croisière de luxe avec Sea of Dreams. Mais attention, ce navire est rempli d'énigmes et d'horreurs qui vous tiendront en haleine ! Arriverez-vous à résoudre le mystère et à vous échapper ?

VR, Multiplayer focused, Fast paced FPS with an emphasis on quick and flowing movement. Featuring DM, TDM , CTF, Domination, Bots to practice against, and a Horde mode for single player or co-op. Room Scale VR with HTC Vive and Oculus Touch. Also included, Non-VR and Seated VR!

Drive//Shaft est un jeu de course automobile multi-joueurs à physique réaliste dans un monde ouvert. Votre mission consiste à atteindre en premier le mystérieux orbe lumineux. Le premier à gagner dix points remporte la partie. C'est un super jeu si vous avez du temps à perdre et souhaitez jouer à quelque chose d'amusant et décalé.
After a tragic accident, you find yourself trapped in a nightmare, and hunted by a monster. With your best friend Chester at your side, you'll have to stay alive, and find a way to wake up.
Osylla is a horror game based on real events. Try to escape from your own house and help your mother to get medical help. Are you able to help everyone in the household?

After the outbreak of the zombie virus, a group of survivors hit the zombie to survive! You can get a variety of special professional roles, weapons, supplies props, etc. - and perhaps a little white dog!

On 24 February, Russia invaded Ukraine in an escalation of the Russo-Ukrainian War. Your task is kill the invaders. Use any available weapons: knive and axe, machine gun and grenades. Be careful, enemies are crafty and merciless. The fate of Ukraine depends on you.

titre: The Last Stand at Camp Zombie
description: Affrontez des zombies affamés et explorez les secrets cachés du camping tout en travaillant en équipe avec un ami en multijoueur local. La tension est à son comble et chaque balle compte - serez-vous capable de survivre jusqu'à la fin ?

Le simulateur d'entreprise Plutocracy vous donne la chance de devenir riche et puissant pour prendre le contrôle du monde. Où la politique, les lois, les officiels et les gens ne sont que les pièces d’un échiquier, comment jouez-vous à votre jeu?
Choose your hero and get to the finish without losing your head :) Avoid obstacles and try to complete the levels with all your body parts.

The story of a failing business and its owner desperate to pull it out of the gutter. Even if that means turning to an unknown, sinister figure with an even more sinister book. Follow Daniel through shady adventures, battle monsters in turn based combat, and watch as his conscience ebbs away...

Take up the mantle of an Apprentice Knight Iona in this Action-RPG game on her quest to be part of the Brave Hero’s Party. Failing the knighthood examination, you must now train with your master to prove yourself worthy.

Wonderful Everyday is a visual novel with multiple routes which develops a story based on a few concepts: "the sky and the world", "the beginning and the end", "literature and science", "savior and hero", "brother and sister".
Votre santé diminue à chaque seconde et l'extermination des ennemis est le moyen le plus efficace de la restaurer. Ne restez pas immobile si vous voulez rester en vie.

titre: Justin Wack and the Big Time Hack
description: Une délicate aventure Point & Click en 2D comprenant plusieurs personnages contrôlables et beaucoup d'idioties. Oh, et il y a aussi des voyages dans le temps et tout le bazar qui va avec. Et des robots - beaucoup de robots...

Crouching Pony Hidden Dragon (CPHD) is a brand-new Action/RPG game developed for SNK’s Neo Geo console which came out in 1990. It might look like a straight-forward arcade game, but under the surface is a persistent world with a rich and varied set of rules.
Gobbo goes adventures is a isometric puzzle game with post industrial comic style.

In this horror-adventure game, you play as a child lost in a dystopian parallel dimension where human flesh is a commodity and outsiders are on the menu. You must flee from, hide from, and misdirect various threats as you search for a portal that will bring you back home.

titre: Voyage Senki VR 海洋传说 VR
description: Sailing in the blue ocean and exploring a new world is a dream in people's nature. Voyage Senki VR is a game of sailing, exploring and adventure. Start a great expedition and Create a new land with your genius and talent of construction, manufacture, and protection.

You play as a little, square guy trapped in a maze of cardboard boxes filled with a myriad of challenges. The rules are simple: move the diamonds to the appropriate pressure plates without letting different-colored diamonds touch—swap, push, and phase to complete levels as quickly as possible.
Jeu de type BATTLE ROYALE EN 2D offrant une expérience intense de 3 à 5 minutes. Pas de lobby, pas de longues séquences de drop. Dans Surviv.io, vous ne faites que combattre !

This toolkit accelerates the invention of unique structures for games using well-known purchasable assets or individual game specific DLC's and allows developers to give their audience a tool to actively participate in the development of the game world.

A stylish puzzle game where you play the role of something flying through the long corridors. The main task is to shoot down objects thereby collecting fuel, which very quickly ends. To avoid collisions with other figures and go to the coveted finish.

Explore a long-forgotten temple crawling with freakish monsters in the second episode of this action-horror RPG, uncovering an ancient history and meeting loveable characters through hand-drawn visuals inspired by 90s anime.

In a near future, the world has been devastated by a virus turning humanity into zombies. You are Iron Corps, the last defense of civilization traveling the world to find resources, help people and find answers. Will you survive long enough?

Cube Raiders est un jeu de puzzle amusant pour un ou deux joueurs où le but est de combiner un groupe de dés en utilisant l’énergie des gants. Grace à ce pouvoir, il est possible de pousser ou de faire pivoter le dé pour résoudre le niveau tout en évitant les pièges de chaque temple.
Battle Trucks it is a race on huge and furious trucks. Your aim is to destroy anyone who stands on your way to victory.
Play as Christopher, a kid left home alone with a terrifying STALKER on the loose! Try and survive in this 80's, PS1 inspired, Home Invasion Survival Horror game - OR DIE TRYING!

C'est un court jeu d'horreur indépendant dans lequel on incarne Alex, un étudiant qui, à la recherche de plus de confort, loue un appartement en ville qui, au premier abord, semble plutôt correct, mais en arrivant, il se rend compte que quelque chose ne va pas.

L'amour se transforme en rage et en tronçonneuses dans Cookie Cutter, un Metroidvania 2D totalement unique dessiné à la main. Incarnez Cherry, une androïde violente en quête remplie de rage pour sauver son créateur.
Beyond the Mind - is the short relaxing game, where you need to solve riddles, exploring depths of mind. Also you will get a personal Oracle to solve your questions.

The MAGICIAN'S RESEARCH is an RPG style IDLE - INCREMENTAL - MANAGEMENT Game! The Experiments of the Mage's Guild have broken out and you are tasked with tracking down, researching, and disposing of them before they can disturb the nearby towns or multiply!
Créez une spectaculaire station de train ! Tchou tchou !

Retaliation: Enemy Mine offers challenging reasoning in a fast, easy and greatly enjoyable format, with the mission of making the spirit of wargaming immediately available to everyone, casual gamers and seasoned strategists alike.
「Dorasyeoda」 is a 3D Mystery & Detective game set in a dystopian world, which is based on a virtual history of the Joseon Dynasty.
DMM Connect Chat is a social communication service that allows you to use your own avatar and interact with others in a virtual space. Anyone with a PC can play for free.

Evil's Den est un robot d'exploration de donjon rogue-lite avec des niveaux générés de manière procédurale où vous combattrez à travers des hordes de monstres pour fermer un portail vers l'enfer ouvert dans l'église du village.

Embark on a spectacular fantasy RPG adventure! Choose your class: Hero, Warrior, Mage, Priest. Level up, develop your equipment, uncover hidden secrets, hunt monsters, discover all elemental weapons, and defeat mighty gods! Help Sunny and Moony save the Kingdom from an unexpected threat!

Help three brave adventurers on their quest to stop the diabolical Baron Von Smog’s plot to conquer Steam Land. However, there is an army of evil minions that stand in your way. Challenge yourself in this new puzzle strategy game; includes 12 action-packed stages, a full soundtrack, competitive online play, all in stunning 720p HD...

It's 1999 and your friend sends you a floppy disk, titled "RemBo". It turns out to be the installer for an old BBS service, filled with both strangers and a familiar face. How are you going to use it?

Explore the eternal landscapes of 3D Idle clicker RPG Endless World! Enjoy an epic adventure with a cast of 40+ characters. Build your army, craft unique weapons, balance your teams and set forth on an heroic saga that spans endless levels of monsters and mayhem!

Travel and you can explore uncharted lands, collect resources and find some treasures in this relaxing game. And you may be able to find something interesting. Adventure and beautiful views of nature await you.
A stand-alone expansion pack to Legions of Iron, discover new innovations and even more stunning visuals that launch the Haegemonia experience into light speed.
Welcome to the Soccer World Cup on a Pinball!
Play as King Boo, who unfortunately has lost their royal adornments and must find them back before being allowed back in the castle! A simple, colorful adventure game for young players.
Welcome to Gravulse, an innovative space curvature laboratory that is trying to "flip" the laws of physics, literally. Here you have to go through many test levels using various new technologies!
Cut the trees, catch some fish, upgrade your castle and environment. Guard the treasure against waves of enemies and lead your dwarves on their way to victory!

"RPG Era" is a high degree of freedom of adventure, survival, leisure RPG games. At one end of the parallel universe is a place called the Epoch World. Although everything looks good, it is actually more dangerous than we thought. How can we survive and solve all the difficulties we encounter? It's up to you to decide.

titre: Tale of Ninja: Fall of the Miyoshi
description: Play as a ninja through the Sengoku period of Japan. There are many possible ways to assassinate the target and find your own nindou.

LifeZ - Survival is a third-person sandbox-survival game. Build your hideout, search for water and food, mine resources and fight against zombies and finally find ways to contact the outside world and leave Catastrophie Area.
Challenge yourself to learn new and interesting things every day with the new free-to-play trivia game!

Bienvenue dans la magie de l’univers de « Dragon Kingdom War: Puzzle RPG », une aventure dont le gameplay combine le meilleur de la stratégie au tour par tour, du jeu de rôle, de la bataille de cartes et du Match 3.

Experience the first “modern-era” Ys game, now off the small screen for its worldwide PC debut! Features a full party system, dozens of unique combat skills, and a massive overworld to explore. Uncover the secret of the Five Great Dragons, and help Adol Christin save the day once again!

《全战天下》是一款全新的SLG战争策略游戏，游戏背景上我们抛开了单一历史时空的限制，将东西方文明中那些伟大的名字写到了游戏中，如果您热爱华夏文明，辅佐玄德公匡扶汉室，与嬴政白起一统六国，加入刘邦项羽的楚汉之争，携手成吉思汗征服亚欧将是您完美的选择，如果您喜欢日本战国，那就与三刀一流的宫本武藏，天下布武的织田信长一道征战沙场，您要是喜好欧美文明，我们推荐您选择圣女贞德，美杜莎、阿克琉斯来助您成就大业，经典英灵不胜枚举，阵容豪华堪称策略游戏的复仇者联盟。

titre: 胸怀三国 OL / 삼국지를 품다 / Embrace the Three Kingdoms OL
description: 《胸怀三国》以三国故事来展开，作为一款纯正的MMORPG（多人在线角色扮演）游戏，本作所涵盖的元素相当丰富。除了角色扮演与战斗，游戏还融合了经营策略的设定，结合独特的剧情动画语音与超过1000篇的丰富剧情，让玩家体验不同玩法的乐趣。

Les morts ne racontent pas d'histoires ! Mason Owens en sait quelque chose. À force de raconter des histoires sur le Cursed Rose il a mal fini. Vous êtes sa fille, il ne vous reste donc plus qu’à trouver ce navire pour savoir ce qu’il s’est passé.
Captain a starship in a thrilling 2D shooter, dodging asteroids across galaxies. As you journey to Horizon Station, each galaxy's challenge intensifies. Can you navigate the cosmic gauntlet?
A virtual-reality open-source rhythm game, Envoy of Nezphere welcomes everyone to feel the flow of the music by chopping the boxes alone the right direction.
Truffle Saga, can you clear levels in one shot? Addictive physics puzzle game.
ASPEN: Uncanny Home puts the player in a state of psychological terror. Players will find themselves in puzzling situations and search to find the hidden story.

Échoué sur une île lointaine, les choses ne vont pas vraiment se passer comme vous l'imaginiez ! Construisez votre club de loisir paradisiaque en gardant l'œil sur ces étranges ex-amateurs de tofu à l'appétit dévorant... Une aventure intense et hilarante vous attend !
