Tomohiro Izumi, recognized by himself and those around him as an introvert, is spending another quiet day in his little corner of his classroom… or so he thought.

I'm sure you had played Tetris, but this game, will give you new experience. In this game, the movement of graphics is not limited by the unit lattice, as the game progresses, once you have an oblique graphic, there will be a lot of irregular objects in the game (whether this is a blessing or a curse ；）

Tyler is a high schooler on a mission. He's going to use every minute of summer vacation to go on as many GPS-assisted scavenger hunts as possible. After running into some old friends during one of these hunts, strange things start happening: The day resets and today plays out exactly like yesterday
A love letter to 8-bit era in a punishing, rewarding, tight retro top-down shooter.

Legend Bowl is a throwback to the classic 8-bit and 16-bit football games of the past. Take to the gridiron and fight your way to becoming a football legend! Enjoy sim-style gameplay, realistic weather, detailed stats, franchise mode, tournament mode, fully customizable rosters, and much much more!

Wreak your path of vengeance in a procedurally generated dark fantasy world, with a unique take on stamina-based combat. Battle in arenas with interactive environment, where every run will be one of a kind. Experience a variety of abilities and power-ups, along with permadeath. Slice, Die, Repeat.

Dans ce jeu de rôle au tour par tour de type Roguelite, créez une lignée de gladiateurs, combattez en ligne avec ou contre vos amis dans l’arène, décidez du sort de vos rivaux vaincus, et apportez à votre maison honneur, richesses et butins de guerre.

Grand-père reçoit un appel téléphonique d'une maîtresse qui demande de l'aide, grand-père n'a d'autre choix que de se lancer dans une aventure d'humour noir et rétro avec son petit-fils pour sauver la maîtresse du téléphone.

Dodge the music and dance through a mesmerizing ballet of choreographed bullets, each synced to music from over a dozen international artists. Push your creativity and skills with the fully-featured Level Editor and never run out of things to dodge.

"In my dreams, I can get out. In my dreams, I can fit in." 'ghostpia' mixes the adorable art style of an illustrated book with glitches-and-noise effects. There are no choices to be made. There's only a lonely girl in a ghost town and her story full of mystery, friendhood...and a bit of violence.

titre: Project ONe プロジェクト・ワン ～ハロルドはつらいよ～
description: Old School RPG. Sorry, Japanese Language Only. It is an old school RPG. In RPG, it enters the genre called puzzle RPG.

Searching for the demon beast that branded her, the huntress Azel reaches the front line of the battle between humans and monsters. She has arrived at the remote land which some call the Harbor of Disasters, Niplheim...

A Sci-fi FPS set on the mysterious planet ADACA. - Use your GRAVITY-MANIPULATING arm to HURL objects at your foes or even RIP weapons directly from their hands! - EXPLORE and manipulate the environment in this EERIE and HOSTILE world!

Ruvato est un jeu Hack 'n' Slash dont les combats sont courts et rapides. La puissance d’attaque de Ria, le personnage principal du jeu, augmente au fur et à mesure qu’elle élimine ses ennemis. En employant cette capacité, un joueur habile peut terrasser aisément de nombreux ennemis !
A platformer without a jump button. Use your chainsaw to navigate the world.
Experience Starman's amazing journey through our solar system in Virtual Reality. See a 'live' view from the cherry red sports car or move in time to see future events.
Une mélodie de vie et de mort entoure une jeune fille malade et ses amis.
CLOUD ESCAPE is a fast-paced 3D precision platformer with countless traps, obstacles and cool movement mechanics.

The Promised Land, a brave new world , the hole nation – all this lies in your hands! Become a true leader, a chosen one, a father of nation! Guide your colony to the victory of the modern superpower! We collected all the best that is in games of this genre, arched by exciting mini-games and carefully turned it into the deep and...
Pinkman is a fast-paced, action platformer about a lost man with pink skin and an incredible skill to fart.

Aerial Guardian is a large scale multiplayer battle first person shooter. Choose from several classes and play as a soldier to embroil yourself in a space fleet battle. Choose from a variety of over 20 weapons and several vehicles including mechs.

Ship Graveyard Simulator 2: Prologue n'est qu'une partie du gameplay qui vous attend dans la version complète du jeu. Visitez la nouvelle côte de la plage avec le plus grand cimetière de navires du monde, démontez d'énormes parties de navires et collectez des tonnes d'acier précieux.

Choose your spaceship and defeat the alien threat that comes from the Moon. Blast your way crushing, ripping apart and exploding hostile aliens that are taking control of powerful weapons and military technology from Earth. Find the entity that controls the threat and make it explode into blood.
Investigate the mysterious death of an unidentified young woman, in this shocking psychological thriller kinetic novel.

Vous êtes pris au piège dans une installation étrange avec un seul outil à votre disposition : un lance-roquettes. Vous devez utiliser ce lanceur pour frayer un chemin vers l'objectif dans beaucoup de nouveaux environnements uniques.

Mayhem Brawler est un beat'em up de fantasy urbaine qui vous plonge dans l'ambiance arcade des années 90. Avec un style BD et une bande-son incroyable, il offre une expérience unique à vivre en solo ou en coop avec des amis, au cours de laquelle vos choix influenceront l'histoire.

Tracez votre chemin à une vitesse fulgurante à travers 47 pistes en évitant les obstacles, détruissant les chasseurs ennemis sur votre passage et phasant à travers les pulsars pour un éclat de vitesse additionnel.

Furious Seas puts you in command as captain of a deadly pirate ship. Navigate through treacherous waters and blast apart fearsome enemy fleets in this thrilling VR adventure like no other. Carve out your legend today amidst the Furious Seas.

Rencontrez les Pixeliens et découvrez le simulateur de vie ultime dans To Pixelia. En gravissant les échelons de votre carrière, entrez dans le monde de la politique, de l'art, du sport, de la musique et même du crime. Vivez la vie de vos rêves en pixels!
Enter a surreal adventure where puzzles are built from dreams and memories. Solve the mystery behind an ancient artifact. Advance through a world that transforms around you. Transcend this existence.

Un monde rétro gore qui fait monter l'adrénaline avec des armes, de la magie, des démons, des arènes verticales, des visuels 3D, des sprites 2D et du heavy métal. Inspiré des classiques du jeu de tir, Project Warlock II est la suite explosive du boomer shooter que vous n'osiez pas demander.

You can’t run from your dreams in this unsettling classic point-and-click horror game from award-winning indie developer scriptwelder. To find a way out, you’ll have to go even deeper into your nightmares.
Réconciliez les royaumes jumeaux ! Comme Gillian, explorez deux mondes et utilisez les Parchemins magiques pour découvrir la vérité sur une lignée royale oubliée.

titre: Tales of Monkey Island Complete Pack: Chapter 3 - Lair of the Leviathan
description: Alors que vous étiez en train de faire passer un sale quart d'heure au pirate LeChuck, GuyBrush Threepwood rependait le mal vaudou dans l'ensemble des caraïbes sans le savoir. Ce mal menace à présent de transformer les pirates en monstres.
Go Undercover in Paris and Unravel a Case in Style!
Sneak into the pharaoh's pyramid and meet up with Assil and his crew of crazy friends. Just as the party starts to get hot, a silly accident turns life upside down! Help Assil reverse the curse!
Rise to the challenge of overthrowing a power mad tyrant in this innovative action dungeon crawler RPG.
Zombies is a progressivly hard mob survival game where you try to live as long as possible while upgrading, healing, and buying new items and passages along the way.

RENTREZ DANS L’HISTOIRESystèmes de jeu - Une variété de tactiques vous offre un choix d'options d'attaque dynamique pour anéantir la défense.Logiciel de création FanHub - Créez vos propres stades, logos, joueurs et équipes et partagez-les en ligne sur toutes les plateformes disponibles.
Build, terraform, quest, and explore your way across beautiful voxel-based worlds in MyDream!
Play through loads of hand-crafted fast-paced microgames based on horror tropes, explore the world of the afterlife and help the skelebros live their death to the fullest.

Behind every great fortune, lies a great crime! Sell drugs, attack with your gang, gamble your CrimeCoins away and hope, that you get that rare item, finally. Free-to-play. Offline Progression. No Microtransactions except 2 optional DLCs.

Colonial England. Under a certain amount of duress... Jack takes on a job, which will not only cause him a great deal of trouble, but also bring to light the answer to a mystery out of his distant past. A lack of money leads Jack to accept a charter to take a British secret agent to mysterious 'Tooth Island'.

An abandoned boat. A system of surveillance camera that works. A woman, Lea Nichols, only survivor of a team of researchers. Monitor, manage, search… Behind your camera, guide Lea Nichols to freedom but also to the truth. Be her eyes and ears to help fulfill her destiny! But be careful, remember that things are not always what they seem…

It's the year 2351, and you're a pilot trying to rise through the ranks all the way to glory. As a member of the Galactic Federation, you'll be granted more than 20 weapons to use in each pass-fail mission. Your goal is to defend the planet from attacking alien forces, and you'll put your skills into play across more than 30 campaigns.

Seed of Life est un jeu d'aventure épique sur la persistance de la vie. Vous êtes Cora, la dernière survivante connue de Lumia, une planète mourante. Votre seul espoir de sauver votre monde natal est d'activer la graine de vie et de parvenir à raviver le soleil.
Le mardi 6 novembre, les américains vont voter pour changer le futur de leur nation. Pourquoi attendre ? Commencez dès maintenant à changer le futur du pays grâce à Democracy 2.

titre: Samantha Swift and the Hidden Roses of Athena
description: Dans sa quête pour retrouver le sceptre de Zeus pour le musée des secrets perdus, l'archéologue Samantha Swift fait la plus importante découverte archéologique de tous les temps ! Malheureusement pour elle, la chasseuse de trésor Ravena Stryker est également sur le coup.
Pilot a mech through the barrens of Texas and fight off the threat of an insect horde. Tex-Mechs was made by students at SMU Guildhall.

titre: Megamagic: Wizards of the Neon Age
description: Préparez-vous à plonger dans un monde fascinant où les forces de la technologie et de la magie sont entraînées dans une lutte acharnée! Brouillant les frontières entre les genres RPG et stratégie, Megamagic se réapproprie la saveur unique des années 80 dans un jeu magnifié par la musique incroyable de Mitch Murder.
An adventure psychological horror game which explores the themes of life and death in a unique way. Help a girl in the capsule to find her memories and escape from a mysterious world.

Notre civilisation est déchue. Quatre nouvelles puissances émergent des cendres. Laissez-vous entraîner dans un jeu de stratégie 4X au tour par tour, où des corporations de vapeur, d'acier, d'atome et de diesel punk s'affrontent pour répandre leur technologie et leur mode de vie.

Follow along with Sally, an extraordinarily lucky girl for whom nothing can stand in her way, as she journeys home to see her critically-ill father in this indie award-winning puzzle-platformer! Could Sally's luck be a mere coincidence?
ZOMBIE CO-OP SHOOTER

The Haunted Hospice, You got yourself stuck in the hospital while you where searching for your friend. Are you capable and smart enough to escape from the hospital and save your friend? Remember that you are not alone in the hospital there is always danger lurking.

The Hotel est un thriller d'horreur psychologique dans lequel le joueur devra affronter le mal qui vit entre les murs d'un hôtel isolé. Mais plus important encore, le joueur devra décider ce que ce mal représente pour lui. Peut-être que la nature de ce mal est plus profonde.
Aidez le détective Alicia à résoudre le mystère qui se cache derrière un meurtre rituel
First addon for Elven Legacy wargame.

Livrez des colis aux joyeux habitants de Little Vale et découvrez les terrifiants secrets qu'ils cachent. Êtes-vous assez courageux pour affronter les nombreux monstres et lieux sinistres de ce jeu d'aventure horrifique à la première personne ? Il n'y a qu'une seule façon de le savoir...
Explore a surreal world inspired by Kowloon Walled city in this turn-based RPG inspired by Japanese dungeon crawlers from the late 1990s.

Help guide a young boy escape a terrible nightmare in a castle. Discover the long buried secrets within the dark.The Fortress of Varnolis is a mystery horror game where you explore the deepest reaches of the ancient Fortress that you have awoken within.

titre: The Song of Terminus  終焉的迴響:護界者之歌
description: A terrible war began from human's desires, causing extreme changes to the world, eventually causing the world tree's energy to become tainted. Two heroes embark on a journey to rejuvenate the world. The player can use different skills by switching between the two heroes facing different enemies.

Venture into dungeons with a huge party of your favorite Touhou characters! This is a dungeon-crawler RPG with an absurdly large party size! Lead tons of your favorite Touhou characters at once and conquer the impregnable Lotus Labyrinth dungeon!

An apocalyptic grand strategy game, in which you take the role of the forces of darkness, trying to bring an end to a fantasy world. Complete with complex internal politics by NPC factions and wide ranges of strategies and types of doom to choose between.

Check out this simple motorcycle racing minigame created with Pixel Game Maker MV! Tame your wild and jacked-up bike to fly through the various stages and rub your awesome clear times in your opponents’ faces!

Confronted with life's peak, diverse romance beckons. Do you choose the allure of a charming secretary or the wisdom of an independent yoga instructor? Will you pursue distant celebrities or seek the sincerity of a working girl's love? Each choice shapes your journey.

titre: Mystery Case Files: Black Crown Collector's Edition
description: A visit to Manchester Asylum takes a dangerous turn into madness!
Take control of giant snake monster consuming everything in its way! Nowhere is safe from you on this planet! Not even in space.
Hidden object game in the alien setting. Black and white hand-drawn graphics in a cartoon style. A large location and cute dogs.

REAVER is an ultra-fast-paced FPS that endows you with the mobility and weapon mechanics to reave through arenas of killer machines with grace and efficiency. Push the boundaries of speed and style in this next-gen movement-shooter.
Take action - defense game. Rush in and protect your own castle right now!
Avoiding all obstacles and collect points before they are destroyed. Watch out for projectiles and enemies stalking you! Will you the #1 highscore on leaderboard against your friends?

Afflicted by severe amnesia, you drift deep into the Common Dream. You scour for the lost pages of the Necronomicon, while clinging on to any little purpose you have left. Faced with mad dreamers, horrible abominations and eldritch deities, you feel drawn to the dark Abyss deep within.
Peux - tu devenir un petit ami parfait, laisser ta copine t 'ouvrir le cœur?

Set sail on the romantic adventure of the season! “True Lover’s Knot” follows the story of Emma, a London-based tech genius, as she and her best friend, Lucas, take to the high seas in a luxurious cruise that will change their lives forever!

Command a fleet of ships to hunt aliens, trade resources and loot treasure! Form corporations with your friends while fighting a never-ending intergalactic war in this open-world online space adventure!
Battle it out local and online in this neon-soaked arena brawler full of lethal weapons, stackable perks, furious combat and a killer synthwave soundtrack.
Welcome to the operating room, doctor. The patient needs an urgent respiration recovery!
A bullet hell fishing game, this / Bop fish with your hook, do not miss / With loot from the blue / a way is paved to / a fishing apotheosis.
Would you say that 2007 cannot be returned? After 11 long years, 2007 are coming back to us in 2018! AGAIN! Be ready for Cool Story! Old-school platformer game.

After falling in love at first sight with the shy Sachi Usui, an injury-ridden, single-eyed high school girl, the protagonist tries to win over her lonely and isolated heart. A pure, heart-warming romance game where the apple of your eye only has one eye!
The fate of the world in one package.
Better Off Tread is a nonstop arena combat game with up to twelve players squaring off against each other using a collection of unusual – and often comical – armored vehicles.

Help defend Earth's space base from invading enemy aliens in this incredible game to train reaction and aiming skills. Use your entire arsenal of weapons to destroy enemies of various types. Stand up to protect the planet. Best of luck!

Control a squad of fearless soldiers with unique abilities to stop a mad scientist who is ready to open a portal for creatures from hell. A classical turn-based system and procedural generation of levels which would require various tactical decisions to beat the game.

Stranded in an unknown galaxy full of escaped prisoners who grow stronger with every passing moment. Build a space station, upgrade your ship, and dogfight your way out of the galaxy. Take risks when necessary, but don't forget that you only have one chance.

titre: Hegemony Gold: Wars of Ancient Greece
description: Conquérez la Grèce antique dans Hegemony Gold : Guerre de la Grèce Antique, un jeu de stratégie de guerre épique qui développe et raffine le jeu prisé Hegemony: Philippe de Macédoine avec du tout nouveau contenu et de nouvelles fonctionnalités.
Obtenez le pouvoir d'un ancien complexe et affrontez une terrible créature omnisciente dans ce hack & slash aux airs de flipper.

"The last soldier" is a game where the player controls a soldier who is the sole survivor of his battalion. Into the game the player will find 6 game modes and 21 goals, where the player can shoot, paralyze enemies, steal war tanks, blow up enemy tanks, escape and more ...

Danger Room is a short and frenetic VR game. Players will have to master their reflexes and skills to reach the goal: try to collect as many knowledge balls as possible, while avoiding the multiple traps awaiting you.

Talk to surreal scribbles in surreal-er environments in MINI MECUM! A short adventure game about weird philosophy. Explore a stylized world as you try to understand what the heck I'm talking about. I'm not sure what I'm talking about either. Is surreal-er even a word? Oh god I thought I had more spa

In Roam Survival, Sam, an inexperienced mechanic, ventures into a vast open world in search of the last missing explorer. Hunt, build shelters, and explore uncharted lands while uncovering hidden mysteries. Every step could be your last. Will you survive?

Symploké: The Legend of Gustavo Bueno is a classic point and click adventure set in a Spanish university and inspired in one of the most influential contemporary philosophers in the world. Play Chapter 1 and take care in your first day of class!

Drox Operative is a starship action RPG with warring alien races, fierce space battles, a dynamic, evolving galaxy, and co-op multiplayer for Windows and Mac.Eons ago the Drox ruled the galaxy through their mighty Operatives. These elite starship captains were trained to accomplish the impossible at whatever cost necessary.
Un jeu éducatif interactif pour les enfants et leurs parents.
3D Run'n'Gun Arcade-Style Action! Fight the Mechanized Forces of the Argus Empire and Escape from Terror City!

Find the masked killer responsible for butchering innocent citizens of 1980s Los Angeles...before he finds you. Uncover clues about the killer's whereabouts to save the city and put the Limb Chopper away for good.
-A magical world beautifully depicted through in-game graphics. -Diverse levels that provide a fair challenge. -Additional bonuses that reward those who replay the game. -3 difficulty modes.

titre: Mortadelo y Filemón: Una aventura de cine - Edición especial
description: The return of the adventures "Two sloppy cowboys" and "Terror, horror and fear" in a special edition that is the best and most modern work of the Spanish studio Alcachofa Soft in the franchise.
In a world of no humans, a robot remains. Voiced by Kakos Xamos.
AchBall is a casual game in which you hit goals by launching a ball. You score extra points for each time the ball bounces.

This side story to "The Fruit of Grisaia" is a character-driven visual novel featuring some of the same characters. This time, it's Michiru who takes the lead role in this slapstick comedy. A laugh-out-loud side story detailing the Mihama girls' school hijinks.

You wake up in an unknown city. A city without people, a city completely deserted. But you’re not alone. There's something out there, something strange, something terrifying. Somehow, you know your only way out is to figure out why you're the only one left when everyone else is gone.

Un jeu d'aventures et de puzzles qui se déroule dans le monde magique de Panmorphia. Maniez l'amulette et transformez-vous en l'un des quatre animaux qui représentent les quatre éléments. Chaque changement apporte également une perspective unique du monde.

titre: Leisure Suit Larry 5 - Passionate Patti Does a Little Undercover Work
description: “What’s your sign, baby?” - Larry Laffer “Wrong Way.” -any woman.

Oknytt is an old school point-and-click adventure game where the player takes the role of a small, seemingly insignificant creature, leading it through a dark world filled with beings and areas inspired by Swedish folklore, in search of a place to belong.
'My own little planet' tells the story of a lost boy who is trapped on a dark and strange world. Fight your deepest fears and find an exit to this madness!

Time is relative. Sometimes 10 seconds can feel like an eternity... In TIMEframe you will discover a world in slow motion. Explore the remnants of a mysterious civilization on the brink of destruction.
Repetendium is a top-down roguelike-lite shooter. Select from a rowdy group of characters to play as and wield an ever expanding variety of gear and items to conquer the underworld. Death awaits...
AGEod goes back to the Napoleonic era and delivers the most detailed and comprehensive strategy game ever created about a time of struggle and conquest that forged modern Europe.
Control a tiny ball of grey goo with the ability to eat anything smaller than itself. The more it eats, the bigger it gets! Soon you'll be able to eat the entire planet!
Synthrome is a fast-paced, momentum-based platformer where players control the sentient SynthRide vehicle to battle against the corrupt forces of the SYNs, who have overtaken the world of SYNTHROME

Welcome to Candy gun!You have to shoot caramels, and chains of sweets of the same color (three or more pieces) disappear when they are hit by caramels of the same color. The colors of the thrown caramels can be changed for convenience.

Meet allies, foes and aliens on your trek across a solar system. Plan layouts, coordinate attacks, balance resources, manage fleet facilities and take on many different kinds of enemies in numerous encounters along your journey.
Cardbot is an action-platformer game about traveling through dimensions to restore the world!
Abandoned Souls is a horror game, shown through a GoPro lens. You play as a vlogger who specializes in urban exploration.
This is very interesting and very cool horror game Hungry Wolf. You need escape from house hungry wolf. You only need to hold out for 5 days for winning game. Good luck player and good game.

AVAILABLE TO PLAY IN NON-VR (KEYBOARD/MOUSE AND CONTROLLER) VR HEADSET NO LONGER REQUIRED.“PARANORMAL ACTIVITY: THE LOST SOUL” immerses you in a terrifying realistic environment with haunting atmosphere, and the need to survive.

Alek, le jeune homme qui changera le monde de Zarabon pour toujours. Dans cette aventure, vous devez reconstruire le monde de Zarabon à votre image. Construisez des villages et gérez vos lignes de production avec l'aide de vos villageois.

"Viktor, a Steampunk Adventure" is a comedy adventure game set in a cartoonish steampunk world. The story follows Viktor, a wild boar who tries to cope with the loss of his job by going on a quest to become a new Emperor of Austria-Hungary.

A silky smooth Arena First Person Shooter with a prime focus on game-feel. Massacre waves of sentient metallic geometry and their monster compatriots as you fight for your Hi-Score! Designed to be the ultimate 'warm-up' or 'waiting-for-download' game!

Nova-111 est un jeu d'aventure à thématique science fiction dotée d'un système de jeu unique: une combinaison d'action tour par tour et de temps réel! Combattre des extra-terrestres dans l'espace, pour la SCIENCE!
A first-person 3D platforming experience through a broken mind turned against you.

Make Your Kingdom — un simulateur de construction urbaine où vous devez survivre, réanimer et équiper votre colonie. Vous êtes le fondateur d'une nouvelle colonie! Choisissez la meilleure façon de développer et d'atteindre vos objectifs.
Avoid everything, touch nothing, and reach a screen edge!

Ever wanted to punch a bear IN THE MOUTH? FIST OF AWESOME asks the eternal question "what would happen if bears took over the world?" and answers it with the epic tale of a lumberjack travelling through time punching bears in the face to save humanity.

A first-person perspective mystery puzzle-solving game where players immerse themselves in the role of characters involved in each episode's abnormal event to uncover the truth. The plan is to release 1 episodes per month, totaling 6 episodes per season.

titre: Ritual on the Eve 前夜祭
description: 学园祭的前夜，据说时不时会出现名为【爱丽丝幻境】的怪异现象，过去的死者在虚假的幻境中， 向生者叙述怨念，企图寻求解脱，亦或者是报复。

Build beautifully precise or wildly creative furniture! Decorate an entire house with your creations. 4 players can play locally, or invite an online player to help you build! Full support for the HTC Vive, including local and online multiplayer

In Windscape you play as a young girl living on your parents’ farm, set in a lovely world made up of floating islands in the sky. As you discover the world you learn that something has gone terribly wrong - islands are breaking apart and falling from the sky!
Run and jump through the land of an ancient civilization in a challenging platformer in which your goal is to reach the end without any saves.

Montague's Mount est un thriller psychologique inquiétant, qui se déroule sur une île irlandaise abandonnée et désolée. Il propose d’explorer l’environnement et de résoudre des énigmes complexes. Ce jeu est la première partie d’une histoire en deux parties, où certaines questions ne trouvent pas de réponses et sont laissées à...

titre: The Interactive Adventures of Dog Mendonça & Pizzaboy®
description: Résolvez les mystères surnaturels des souterrains de Lisbonne dans « The Interactive Adventures of Dog Mendonça & Pizzaboy », le jeu basé sur la série de romans graphiques récompensée de Dark Horse ! Incarnez le livreur de pizzas et vivez une toute nouvelle histoire dans l'univers de Dog Mendonça !
Grab your safety goggles and set out on a chemical-burning, liquid-stirring, camera-whirring competition in HoloLAB Champions, a virtual reality chemistry game show.

Bezier is a dual stick blaster set inside a vast computer built deep underground. The story traces the principal's escape from this "Noah's Ark" gone wrong. A simple shooter on the surface, the deeper narrative pulls in his relationship between evolution and god, family and love.
Secret files est de retour ! Le couple de rêve Max et Nina annoncent leur marriage.

titre: Leisure Suit Larry - Magna Cum Laude Uncut and Uncensored
description: With gorgeous co-eds everywhere, college dweeb Larry Lovage is chasing around more than his diploma. He's trying to live up to the legend of his uncle, Larry Laffer, everyone's favourite polyester playboy.
Railway Islands is a puzzle game about designing a railway map for a large archipelago. Make a safe path between the stations and let your train deliver all the resources and go to the next island.
Build up a world piece-by-piece using the power of the god-like Fates, while keeping them happy enough to avoid world-shattering temper tantrums!

Create strange and charming pixel comics in this totally free free-for-all art game. Choose a theme, draw cards, and build your own story. Is Bitku a simple storyteller, a comic creator, an art toy, or a new way to express yourself in pixels? Find out for yourself.

titre: Retro Golden Age - Livingstone I Presume
description: In this platform and puzzle game, David Livingstone, famous English missionary and explorer, went to Africa on a sanitary and cartographic mission to establish the Zambeza and Nile river basins when he disappeared...

A light-hearted and enjoyable short romance VN! The protagonist, Fan Tong, struggles to lose weight in hopes of finding a job, but the journey is far from smooth. Until one day, a cute and sunny girl named Bagel comes into his life, kickstarting a story of weight loss, cross-dressing, and romance!

In a back-alley cafe, the dead are granted one last night to mingle with the living. Necrobarista follows a dynamic and diverse cast of characters as they navigate Melbourne's hipstery coffee culture, the questionable ethics of necromancy, and the process of letting go.
SAND LAND est un action RPG où vous incarnez Beelzebub, le prince de démons. Menez votre petite troupe de héros bigarrés et explorez le monde légendaire de SAND LAND, créé par Akira Toriyama.
Panty Party est un jeu de combat palpitant. Faites voler vos culottes dans les rues et entre les bâtiments. Cherchez les culottes ennemies et bottez-leur le ♥♥♥!

Continue Joey and Xefros’s adventure through the dark and dangerous planet Alternia. Meet dozens of unique and memorable characters, some more helpful than others, as you navigate this volatile alien culture. Hurry up! There’s a train to catch.
Spring Falls est un jeu de réflexion sur l'eau, l'érosion et où il faut observer les végétaux pousser. Manipulez le paysage et donnez vie à des fleurs sauvages sur un flanc de montagne paisible.
《青夏轨迹》是日本美少女游戏资深大厂GIGA/Entergram出品的一部青春题材的视觉小说。本作由知名插画家U35负责原画与角色设计，人气声优小鸟居夕花、夏和小、和实羽优希为本作女主角献声。本作发售后赢得市场普遍赞誉，并荣获萌系游戏大赏年度剧本金奖等诸多奖项。

WARSAW RISING: Cité des Héros est un RPG tactique au tour par tour stimulant dont les graphismes magnifiques ont été peints à la main. L'histoire se déroule pendant la Seconde Guerre mondiale, au sein d'une ville ravagée par la guerre.

Toute la puissance de la motocross entre vos mains : le nouveau MXGP 2021 est enfin arrivé ! Le jeu vidéo officiel MXGP va vous décoiffer : faites chauffer les moteurs et préparez-vous pour l'expérience la plus réaliste et la passionnante qui soit sur deux roues !

Un jeu d'arcade rapide et néon-fluorescent avec des commandes simples à un seul bouton ! Addictif, facile à apprendre et parfait pour des sessions rapides. Défiez-vous pour battre votre meilleur score en attendant une autre partie !

We promise you will feel like a pilot flying airliners, helicopters, fighters, gliders, historical and aerobatic aircraft in a photorealistic world! Over 10,000 real world flights, highly detailed cockpits and scenery are awaiting you.

Soundfall est un dungeon-crawler qui combine l'action explosive d'un looter-shooter avec un gameplay rythmique. Partez à l'aventure en solo ou en groupe de quatre joueurs en local ou en ligne. Plus vous synchronisez vos actions avec la rythmique de la bande-son, plus vous devenez puissant !

Driver4VR is a versatile virtual reality solution that provides many useful VR features. You can use it for body tracking, head & hand tracking, controller emulation, utilities, and alternative VR configurations.

Eight women simultaneously appear in your life, offering you unconditional love and support! Will you choose to uphold your beliefs and become a good man, or give in to human temptations and become a bad man?

Il est dangereux de s’aventurer seul ! Réunissez vos amis et montez un groupe, puis faites preuve de stratégie, d’astuce et collaborez pour explorer les profondeurs de «Demeo». Une aventure coopérative sur table primée pour 4 joueurs maximum.

titre: Boom 3D Windows: Experience 3D surround sound in games
description: Boom 3D est une application d'amélioration audio professionnelle qui a été conçue pour lire tout votre contenu multimédia avec des effets 3D incroyables sur N'IMPORTE QUEL casque / haut-parleurs, depuis n'importe quel lecteur, n'importe quel média, n'importe quel service de streaming.
Paranormal first-person horror, which takes place in an abandoned orphanage. Walk through the corridors of your childhood, but do remember that you're not only one here.

Une aventure agricole magique est là ! Transformez votre ferme en paradis estival en solo ou en coop jusqu'à 4. Explorez, cultivez, prenez soin des animaux et rénovez votre foyer, voilà vos missions du jour. La nuit, rejoignez les créatures dans le rêve et apportez une touche de magie à la vallée.

Journey to Incrementalia is an active incremental auto-battler about a necromancer on a short quest. Cast diabolical spells, summon an army and open the gates of hell on your quest to break down 99 walls and reach the lost city of Incrementalia.
LEGO® Harry Potter™ Collection rassemble « LEGO® Harry Potter™ : Années 1 à 4 » et « LEGO® Harry Potter™ : Années 5 à 7 » dans un seul jeu, remasterisés avec des graphismes améliorés.

Vivez une expérience émotionnelle forte portée par un scénario plein de mystères et suivez les aventures d’une petite fille perdue dans un monde d’adultes. Comment trouver un monstre que l’on ne peut voir ?
One day, Jimmy looked inside.

Dirigez une escouade de guerriers adorables mais féroces dans Anomaly Collapse, un jeu de stratégie Roguelite au tour par tour innovant. Affrontez des êtres venus d'ailleurs et découvrez les sombres secrets de calamités surnaturelles dans une histoire où chaque tour compte.
Pouvez-vous tracer une ligne?

Vous êtes une sorcière menant votre ordre dans de nouveaux territoires hostiles. Utilisez les cartes que vous trouvez pour construire et agrandir votre empire. Alliez-vous aux ordres locaux ou utilisez leurs os pour vos sorts. Rassemblez vos familiers, l'heure des sorcières approche.
Enfilez l’armure énergétique Paladin, emparez-vous des armes de mêlée des envahisseurs démoniaques et prenez votre terrible revanche!

MISE À JOUR MAJEURE 1.2 : ARBRES DE COMPÉTENCES ! Choisissez votre classe et adaptez votre arbre de compétences à votre style de jeu idéal. Vivez une expérience réinventée avec le système de rencontre et les combos élémentaires. MythForce est prêt à vous éblouir !

Just like the faeries in your garden, we love collecting berries for our prickleberry loaves and finding treasure with our special fribblesham fireworks. Come join us in our faerieland, full of strange adventure!

Cally's parents have been abducted, as her arch-enemy Herbert has taken control of the Caves to perform his evil experiments. Join Cally and her friends in this action-packed run and gun platformer, conquering insane bosses, exploring to find secrets, and levelling up EVERYTHING.

JUNKPUNK is a factory management, base building, exploration game where a New World Robotics ship has crash landed. You and any survivors must restore this ruined planet and prepare it for habitable life. Craft, build, explore, discover, and grow to terraform the planet.

Vous vous réveillez dans un vaisseau spatial sans mémoire. Dans cette salle d'évasion avec un décor de science-fiction, vous devrez enquêter sur votre passé en résolvant différentes énigmes. Serez-vous capable de découvrir ce qui vous est arrivé et comment y êtes-vous arrivé?

openCanvas is a painting software dedicated to Windows Operating System, that is suitable to beginners to advanced users. Equipped with analog-like brush strokes and functional yet user-friendly interface, openCanvas has the higher basic performance and the unique "Event" function that enables to record and replay the drawing...

Suite de la comédie romantique Five Dates, Ten Dates se déroule dans un monde post-pandémie. Misha, une millennial londonienne en mal de contact humain, piège Ryan, son meilleur ami, et l’embarque dans un programme de speed dating.

PERISH est un FPS stylé pour 1-4 joueurs qui porte une lourde croix. Massacrez des hordes au Purgatoire et vendez leurs corps souillés d'or à des prêtres lâches. Tuez des boss pour accéder à l'Élysée, lieu de révélations cosmiques.
Sky Break est un jeu en monde ouvert sur une planète abandonnée remplie de tempête et de mechas sauvages. Apprenez à maîtriser ce monde et à pirater les mechas pour avoir une chance de survivre.

Midnight Protocol is a tactical narrative-driven RPG with unique keyboard-only controls. Hack into servers, beat security systems and discover encrypted secrets while you try to find answers to why and how you got doxxed.

WarriOrb : Prologue est une démo gratuite de ce prochain jeu de plates-formes et d'action, WarriOrb ou vous jouez le rôle d'un puissant démon piégé dans un corps improbable. Le chemin à parcourir n'est pas simple... Êtes-vous prêt à faire le nécessaire pour retrouver votre liberté ?

titre: Cat Burglar: A Tail of Purrsuit
description: Cat Burglar is a short, light-hearted, stealth, puzzle platformer with a pet charity awareness campaign. Help Kat find her way into the Dogo Corps base to discover Major Bulls' master plan.

Lumina, une jeune teslamancienne, se retrouve coincée après l'atterrissage forcé de son dirigeable sur Wyrmheim, un territoire reculé au Nord. Embarquez dans une aventure périlleuse et explorez une grande tour abandonnée surplombant un fjord pour raccompagner Lumina chez elle.
[game type] AVG + simulated love cultivation[game rating] objects aged 18 and above[game theme] BL ancient Roman wind school daily + hot-blooded battle

Galaxy of Pen & Paper est un RPG au tour par tour dans lequel se retrouve un groupe de jeu de rôle de 1999 ! Créez votre maître de jeu et ses joueurs. Ils pourront lors de leur aventure explorer de lointaines planètes imaginaires, affronter d’étranges aliens et sauver la galaxie dans l’ère des disquettes et de l’internet bas-débit !

Jeu multijoueur en ligne ! Il te rappelle une star ? Oui ! Tu es piégé dans le rêve sans fin de Kunkun, peuplé de créatures de mèmes. Obsédés par le basket, ils chuchotent : « Viens ! Montre-toi ! » Forme une équipe, esquivez, unissez-vous pour briser le rêve et échappez à la boucle !

Invent a new computer! Logic World is a first-person sandbox simulation game that's all about digital logic. Play alone or with friends, design unique machines, build up layers of complexity, and experience the joy of circuits!

Hacktag est un jeu d'infiltration à 2 joueurs en coopération avec un gameplay asymétrique et nerveux. Incarnez l'Agent infiltré sur le terrain ou le Hacker infiltré virtuellement et coopérez pour accomplir des missions d'espionnage où rien ne se passe comme prévu !

Stellar Initiative est un jeu de tower defense et roguelike où vous atterrissez sur une planète et utilisez votre vaisseau pour déployer des bâtiments et soutenir vos tirs. Complétez des missions, améliorez vos installations, découvrez des artefacts puissants et trouvez la meilleure stratégie !

Organ Quarter est un jeu d'horreur et de survie en réalité virtuelle axé sur ce qui a fait la grandeur de l'horreur de survie : des environnements labyrinthiques, la gestion des ressources et des énigmes bien équilibrées.

NASCAR Heat 2 brings the most authentic and intense stock car and truck racing of all time. Test your driving skills across 3 NASCAR national series and 29 NASCAR sanctioned-tracks, and go head-to-head in local split-screen mode!

Skelly Selest is a score-attack hack slash dash run 'n' gun-athon. Venture into the procedurally generated perdition depths of Hell to purge the evil taint of the Deamonica Netherlords and their fiendly followers.

titre: Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition
description: Préparez bien votre action suivante, chaque combo en plus peut tout changer ! Que vous jouiez en solo ou en duo, en ligne ou hors ligne, mélangez vos unités pour vaincre vos ennemis dans cette version définitive de Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes !
Casual physics puzzle.

Robothorium est un tour par tour futuriste mêlant Rogue Like et RPG dans lequel vos choix auront un impact direct dans votre révolution contre le genre humain. Rassemblez votre équipe de robots, choisissez vos alliés et mener vos troupes à la prochaine ère robotique.

Latest Update: Animal Kingdom. Explore tropical beaches, underwater oceans and even take to the stars. Discover over 60 different animals. Command the weather, take control of the night or create and shape your own world. Relax and immerse yourself into the Nature Treks VR experience.

Élucidez le mystère entourant une mort inexpliquée en explorant les souvenirs objectifs et les expériences subjectives de la victime. Fouillez l'esprit humain, résolvez des énigmes et découvrez la terrible vérité dans ce grand thriller psychologique.

Letters est un jeu de puzzle amusant autour des mots, de l’amitié, de grandir et de trouver sa place dans la vie. Accompagnez Sarah, une fille timide originaire de Suisse, au fil de ses lettres et de ses messages.
Conformity is everything in this lightning-fast platformer - get ready to shift your friendships each and every second!

Le monde ne se crée pas tout seul – c’est toi qui le fais, forme-le comme tu le souhaites ! Commence à partir de rien et construis des maisons de rêve pour les gobelins et toi-même en explorant, collectant des ressources, fabriquant, construisant, luttant, cultivant… et bien plus !

Willy-Nilly Knight is the great story, based on the legend of King Arthur. Immerse yourself in a single-player, isometric, story-driven RPG with real-time gameplay and turn-based combat, set in the colorful fantasy universe. Will you find the power to save the world in the war of gods? Find your answer.
Enregistrez des extraits audio, envoyez-les sur les ondes et démêlez le mystère de la boucle temporelle dans cette enquête interactive radiophonique
Songbringer est un action RPG de science-fiction avec des épées, des secrets, des donjons, des boss et des tonnes d'autres choses.

Incarnez Jules Verne et affrontez les dangers dissimulés dans Hemera, un monde parallèle fantastique élaboré à partir de sa propre imagination. Explorez, résolvez des énigmes et percez le secret le plus convoité de la puissante Atlantide.

Deep civilization-building strategy in a fast-paced card game! There are many paths to victory in this competitive card drafting game featuring 12 unique characters and hundreds of cards ranging from great pyramids and war elephants to sneaky spies and crafty merchants.

Découvrez Swords of Gargantua, un jeu d'action d'épée en réalité virtuelle en mode solo ou en coopération en ligne avec jusqu'à trois autres joueurs ! Aventurez-vous à travers les paliers des abysses de Tesseract pour battre le géant, Gargantua, à l'affût au niveau le plus profond, le Palier 101.

Explorez, combattez et fabriquez des objets pour gagner en puissance tout en incarnant sept héros différents dans un monde de silence. Grâce à la Princesse, vous découvrirez les mystères du Roi et de son royaume déchu dans les Abysses. Sans paroles, quel espoir y a-t-il pour l'humanité ?

Immerse yourself in the world of Flåklypa in this game for the whole family. Play nine mini games, enjoy the classic story and take it to the tracks for high-octane racing, alone or with a friend in split-screen. But watch out, your competitors will use dirty tricks to win – and so can you!

Join exciting tank battles in an amazing place — labyrinth! During the battle, you'll find bonuses that can either help you or make things worse:) Don't forget to invite your friends — they'll make the game even more fun!

Leviathan is a Survival Adventure RPG that takes place on a nearly inescapable island that's guarded by a dragon called the Leviathan. It's up to the player to try to find a way to escape the island and defeat the dragon while using all the resources on the island at their disposal.

A gripping seaside adventure following the connection of two young souls, each unknowingly helping the other make sense of a world that seems senseless. Complemented by breathtaking artwork and an addictive soundtrack, this charming tale will definitely suck you in and leave a lasting impression!

Cobalt WASD is a multiplayer bomb-defusal action platformer with grenades that stop time. Blast your way to the bomb site or repel the assault! Use teleporter guns, grappling hooks, sticky sentry turrets and quick tactical thinking to lead your team to victory! Play online or against AI!
Hexagonal puzzle with the ability to edit levels

Les feux d'artifice fascinent. Tous les regards sont tournés vers le ciel, la musique démarre, les premiers effets spectaculaires explosent dans le ciel, tous les spectateurs sont émerveillés et on entend les « oh » et les « ah » de la foule.
Colonial Conquest est une simulation de conquêtes militaires et d’expansion à l’ère victorienne, le monde de la fin du XIXème siècle et tout début du XXème.

titre: 皇帝与社稷 The Emperor and State
description: The Emperor and State est un jeu de stratégie au tour par tour qui simule le règne d'un ancien monarque féodal. Il implique l'administration, l'ajustement des politiques, les vérifications et équilibres diplomatiques, les guerres nationales, et ainsi de suite.
Sound Shift is a VJ style music visualiser mixed with a simple arcade shooter.

Survivez à un clown meurtrier dans un parc d’attractions hanté. Résolvez des énigmes, trouvez des objets et prenez des décisions qui façonneront votre évasion. Death Park est un jeu d’horreur à la première personne avec plusieurs fins, de l’infiltration tendue et des moments terrifiants.
Fast paced breakfast themed arcade game with quirky puzzle elements

Use sword and spell combos to slash and blast through hordes of attacking enemies! Guard break a boss's defenses, find an opening, then obliterate them for good with a well-placed super deadly attack! Satisfying 3D side-scrolling action with game-play elements inspired by fighting games!

Collapsed est un jeu de plates-formes d'action rogue-like post-apocalyptique. Chassez votre proie à travers de vastes niveaux générés procéduralement, remplis d'ennemis coriaces, de butin de valeur et de points d'expérience. Combattez seul ou avec un ami – dans tous les cas, ce ne sera pas facile !
Give takeoff clearances, landing clearances and taxi clearances at six complex airports in a strategic effort to maintain efficiency, and avoid collisions.

The 1st chapter of mystic trans-media adventure with the atmosphere of Eastern Europe of the last century. After completing the 1st chapter, each player can influence the further plot of the game chapters/short films/visual novel.The plot in your hands...
Résoudre le mystère du disque de Phaistos ! Dans ce jeu d'objets cachés, vous ferez un voyage plein de surprises autour de la Crète pour éviter une catastrophe après une expérience échouée.

titre: The Secret Order 8: Return to the Buried Kingdom
description: Faites la lumière sur les étranges événements du Royaume enseveli dans cette palpitante aventure. Ce 8e épisode de l’Ordre secret vous propose de nouvelles aventures, de nouvelles énigmes et surtout de nombreuses heures de divertissement !

A horrible corruption has forced the children of the forest into hiding. They confide in the Treehouse Man, but their prayers remain unanswered. Baptized into the group, you must take the hallowed boat on an odyssey to save your brothers and sisters before the silence kills them.

Defense Clicker is an clicker game which will be soon F2P, with an tower defense theme and a few twists which make it very unique. You have to build an defense line with towers and upgrade them to stay alive as long as possible. when you die the map resets but you get a few special points depending on how long you survived.

Talon's Blade is a third person adventure RPG with an advanced direction based melee combat system. Experience the journey of Marcus Veridius as he is set on the path of vengeance. Explore a world plagued with war and corruption as the very foundations of an empire crumble around you.
Scion of Fate Online, one of the top MMORPG game in the history, now available on Steam.
"Murasaki" is a puzzle explosion game. Use explosions to clear the screen of pesky obstacles filling it up. The only controls you need are the directional buttons and two other buttons (Z and X)!

Epic Card Game is a fast-paced card game of fantasy combat designed by Hall of Fame Magic players Rob Dougherty and Darwin Kastle. It has all the amazing game play and beautiful art of a digital trading card game, without the costs: you get unlimited copies of every card!

titre: 風色幻想3:罪與罰的鎮魂歌
description: 风二发售之后的两年，于２００４年，搭配着全新３Ｄ引擎所推出的「风色幻想Ⅲ～罪与罚的镇魂歌～」。游戏本身在众多玩家的引颈期盼下，再次以战略角色扮演的方式呈现。由于本作品是风色全系列作里唯一以两个主角之观点来述说故事内容的革新之作。因此对该作品如此安排是否得当的赞否两论讨论也在当时讨论的十分火热．．。当然本作依然维持着风色系列优良剧本的传统，它交杂着私人友情与国家大义间挣扎的剧情，甚至还获得了当年「计算机玩家」所举办的『计算机玩家第八届游戏金像奖自制类最佳游戏剧本奖项』之肯定。
studio: 弘煜科技事業股份有限公司

description: A peaceful 3rd person adventure and town-building game. Gather, build, puzzle, explore, and quest in a beautifully handcrafted world.

A small American town is overrun by the living dead! You manage to enter the town just before the military locks it down and now you must slice and shoot your way through thousands of zombies in order complete your mission in this action-packed Hack & Slash RPG.
Super XYX is a new shmup from the creator of Fire Arrow X, Megatank, ZPF and a couple of others. Co-developed and published by Team Grybanser Fox.

Help Cummerbund Bandersnatch in this quintessentially British point & click comedy adventure as he explores the darker side of Victorian England, oblivious to its perils. Manipulate time, talk to a host of dubious characters and solve puzzles to get Bandersnatch out of a fix before it's too late.

A gruesome murder interrupts an evening party at a secluded mansion and you are the prime suspect! Explore the mansion, search for clues, and interrogate the other guests as you strive to unmask the killer in this open-ended mystery.

Gherman,a middle-aged man who has abandoned all to find what lies behind the "Philadelphia experiment".11 years after the experiment,Gherman found a document that marked the coordinates of the project's military establishment.Certainly he didn't expect to find so much...

It's the zombie apocalypse, but you can't miss a work day! Scavenge for weapons, survive... and don't forget to restock the toner cartridges over at accounting. This humorous top-down shooter has you working your way up the corporate ladder, all the way to the rescue helicopter on the rooftop.
Des combats intenses contre des boss déjantés dans ce jeu de plateforme en 2D

You arrive at Mars Site-113, a decaying monument to the SCP Foundation's ambition—and its failures. Once the most secure facility, now a cradle of horrors calling you to uncover its secrets. Face relentless anomalies, humanity's darkest truths, and a mission that demands survival above all else.
Kappa's Asylum is a survival horror game in which you control a YouTuber in an abandoned asylum to record a video.
A narrative puzzle game about two people trying to find their way back together in a city on fire.

SURVIVAL HORROR in first person. We incarnate an investigator of paranormal events that only with the help of a paranormal activity detector (EMF DETECTOR) and a small oil lamp, we will try to perform an EXORCISM.

This is a short story about humanity's last attempt to resist nature. Cities lie in ruins, there are traces of huge claws everywhere - once disturbed by people, giants began to wreak havoc around the world. But is there a solution?...

Incarnez Esteban, Zia et Tao à travers les multiples niveaux remplis de puzzles astucieux, de pièges et de phases d’infiltration, dans une grande variété de merveilleux décors. Explorez chaque recoin de la Chine, et échappez aux ennemis des enfants, à la recherche des Cités d’Or locales.
Une aventure unique, choisissez votre propre aventure avec des morts horribles et des choix merveilleux!

Have you ever had the opportunity to control your own amusement ride at the fair? Probably not ... Now you can experience this on your PC & Mac with the new Funfair Ride Simulator 3. With physics and detailed graphics, awesome fog, firework and light effects and a simulated fairground.

Experience authentic Martial Arts like never before in a game. Tactical action mixed with realism as you move like true professional fighters, thanks to motion-capture technology. Focus your mind, hone your skills and calibrate your reflexes. It’s time to fight.
《皓月空华》是一款传统RPG游戏，同时这也是一个少年的故事，一段足以改变其人生轨迹的经历...... 亲人们的别离，黑暗下的假面，尘封许久的过往，以及那被掩埋的真相...... 为了追寻父亲的踪迹，只身踏入无底的漩涡，最终得到的，又是否是TA所渴望的...... 真希望能在一轮皓月之下与其一起赏看那光华......

Un jeu d'horreur et de survie non linéaire à la troisième personne comprenant des énigmes et des ennemis venus des profondeurs de l'enfer. Lorsque la mère d'Anna décède des suites d'une maladie soudaine, elle reçoit une lettre inquiétante de sa sœur. Découvrira-t-elle la vérité ?

True Fear: Forsaken Souls Part 3 est le dernier chapitre de la trilogie de thriller psychologique. Avec des mécaniques point-and-click, des énigmes complexes et des scènes cinématiques, plongez dans une expérience d'horreur sombre qui redéfinit le genre.
Un tout nouveau RPG de SQUARE ENIX, développé par l'équipe d'OCTOPATH TRAVELER et de BRAVELY DEFAULT.

titre: Duck Detective: The Ghost of Glamping
description: You are the one and only Duck Detective, a depressed and recently divorced duck who must quack the case. Inspect evidence, make de-duck-tions, and solve this no-murder mystery!

Prends le contrôle de 3 navires de services spécialisés et remplis de fascinantes missions sur les eaux périeuses de la Baltique. Participe à l’extractions d’objets volumineux du fond de la mer, au tranport et aux gros travaux d’aménagement maritime et même aux missions de sauvetage et de transport.

The "trivia roguelike" where Wikipedia articles battle it out and you predict the winner! Guess the length and popularity of articles randomly pulled from Wikipedia's daily growing archive of 6.5+ million entries! Featuring arena, endless and a WikiBot duel mode, no two runs will ever be the same!

Dungeon crawling roguelike where rooms contain puzzles, not enemies. Discover alternative solutions which use up different tools. Manage you resources, spend rare tools, and discover secrets. Will your covert broadcasts be answered? 480+ Puzzles.

titre: Notre-Dame de Paris: Journey Back in Time
description: Ubisoft propose une visite en réalité virtuelle de Notre-Dame de Paris à partir de la reconstitution du XVIIIème siècle extraite du jeu Assassin’s Creed : Unity.
Panzer Warfare is an amazing multiplayer tank game with up to 24 players online.

My Incubi Harem is a visual novel about how you became an incubi king and ended up with beautiful men in love with you. Featuring a lewd mentor, a hot singer, a queer dom activist, a cold-hearted nobleman, and a sensible daddy. This is the first episode of a game series made by Male Doll.

titre: Realms of Arkania 2 - Star Trail Classic
description: Star Trail (1994) is the second part of the glorious Realms of Arkania Trilogy...Can you join together the elves and dwarves in common war against the orc invaders? Star Trail features over 70 spells, 50 skills, over 350 types of items and weapons.
Aidez Emily à traverser les hauts et les bas de sa grossesse ! 👶 🍼
Dragon Souls is a game allowing players to play as a dragon - terrorizing denizens and taking their gold.
A mining fleet gone rogue on the edge of space. Dangerous figures emerging from the past. This year could be a killer.

Scribble Ships is a 2D top-down arcade shooter that tosses the player into a world of color and chaos. With a range of ships to choose from, the player is tasked with coloring the monochromatic enemies that are trying to take your color away.

connect is your customizable, social, multifunctional virtual home. You can play games, chat, make video calls, listen to music, watch TV, read a newspaper, surf the net, or meet friends. connect is a free, data protected virtual world and a device-independent interface (2D/3D/VR/AR) for all digital content.
Live the Adventures that await this very friendly robot who is faced with a harsh reality that he will have to face. 3D platform game in the purest mythical platform style with Futuristic touches.

You are one of the few survivors of a zombie cat-pocalypse. With only your wits, your weapons, and a few turrets, you must defend yourself from the hordes of zombie-cats that come at night. Grenade, blast, shoot, heal, and place traps to survive each wave until safety comes with the sunlight.
WarZone Flashpoint is in an RTS in development by Dust Storm Entertainment. We're an indie team bringing you a classic RTS formula which we intend to update for a long time to come!

A local multiplayer party game that's all about the classical western stand-off. Draw faster than your opponents and prepare to catch their incoming bullets mid-air! HOT NOON is fast-paced and filled with tension. Are you skilled enough to outsmart your friends in this wits-filled stand-off?

Cargo Company est un jeu de simulation de transport où vous gagnez de l'argent en transportant des passagers, du bois, de l'acier, des marchandises, des voitures, des chars et plus encore - en utilisant des trains, des camions, des bus et même des fusées entre les planètes.
The classic version of the famous board game Mahjong Solitaire.
NOT the latest version, please check out PSF 2026!
Agent-00 is a Game of puzzles and secrecy in isometric view in which the player will have to infiltrate and uncover a secret project during the Cold War.

titre: Mountain Trap: The Manor of Memories
description: What will you do if the vacation of your dreams doesn't go as planned? If your friend is alone in a foreign country and gets into trouble, will you have enough strength and courage to help her?
Color Chaos is a twin stick shooter that delivers fun and chaotic color swapping arcade action that will keep you coming back time and time again to beat the highscores on the leaderboards.
Water is flooding the world. Build your own way to climb higher and higher. Maybe there is a chance of survival after all. Give yourself a try! Help those boars reach the highest level.
CO-OP Time survival game with roguelite elements, up to 10 players online
Aqua Boy is a deep sea treasure hunter, but his latest mission has gone drastically wrong! Explore a quirky underwater world packed with secrets in this mini metroidvania.

Edmond, qui a révélé un grand secret de l'histoire de l'humanité sans s'en rendre compte, pourra-t-il vivre avec ce secret? 13: ORIGIN est un jeu d'aventure et de puzzle à base d'histoires passionnantes et passionnantes, que vous pouvez avancer en résolvant des énigmes.

Metonymy follows the story of Colin, Enoch and Tracy as they travel across a dystopian version of limbo filled with a corrupt theocratic government known as the Choir and the unbreakable hordes of the disease that appose them.
Calvin Tucker’s Farm Animal Racing is a wacky, cartoonish kart game with loads of typical redneck, toilet humor, about eight wacky animals from a redneck farm.
Redonnez vie à un Ancien Monde !

The Exlester Continent had once been a beautiful land. But it was destroyed ruthlessly by a war between witches. At last a hero of the Archangel decedent put the war to an end by sealing the power of those witches. But it was too late, By the mighty magic, The beautiful Exlester Continent Was into the winter forever.

titre: Professor Watts Word Search: Space Voyage
description: Hello Professor Watts here and I need your help! I've been hard at work on my space voyage, collecting samples and documenting important research materials. Now that I have returned to my laboratory I find all of my research files has been jumbled about
(UNDER REWORK AND DEVELOPMENT, NOT CURRENTLY AVAILABLE) Take flight into the skies of Alsydia, a vibrant world featuring a variety of locales ready to explore, both in the sky and on land.

A collection of short and silly games from the early days of the internet. There's turn-based RPGs, shoot-em-ups, platformers, and more - updated with new quality-of-life features. Plus there's a whopping 150 achievements to collect, and a free soundtrack DLC!

Un jeu d'action / stratégie nerveux en multijoueur qui oppose les humains aux aliens dans d'immenses champs de bataille. Construisez votre base n'importe où, améliorez votre équipement, recrutez des centaines de soldats IA et participez à la plus grande guerre intergalactique.

titre: ความตายมาเยือน
description: AOD (Arrival of Dead) est un jeu d'horreur et de survie à la troisième personne dans lequel Sasha, pour une raison inconnue, est téléportée dans un endroit où le danger de mort est omniprésent. Pour survivre, il vous faudra du courage et de l'intelligence. Lorsque vous serez à ses côtés, ne paniquez

titre: 小虎传：大菠萝深渊 Diablo The Abyss
description: Diablo The Abyss is a strategic RPG full of random and roguelike elements. Within this randomized world, you can freely make strageties at your own pace and conquer formidable challenges, while shaping your unique adventure journey.
MAFIA: Family's Secret is a top-down shooting game. Kill your enemies, go through all the missions and discover the secrets of Guidice mafia family.

Spacious Snake is a short but well-crafted puzzle game where the objective is to occupy the entire floor of the level. But for that you'll have to solve 20 levels with 2 different mechanics. So you think you can.
A tank simulation game，with cartoon style，battle royale，destory everything you can see!
In the jungle at night, a journey awaits for you... are you ready to embrace the experience? Ayahuasca, the vine of the soul, and how to find your inner space.
Air Combat Arena is an arcade-style flight combat game. In the game you can pilot various planes play against other players on various maps.

Master the unique shape of your player and out-manoeuvre your opponents in this high speed local multiplayer sports game. Play 1v1 or 2v2 versus matches, or race against the clock solo in target smash.

Rejoignez "Karen La Poule" dans une aventure où une simple tâche se transforme en quête extraordinaire pour s'échapper d'une planète alien. Découvrez le mystère du rapt soudain de Karen, à travers des défis étranges. Prêt à percer le code du poulailler et élaborer un plan d'évasion ?
Casual action game Avoid obstacles by jumping Catch and accelerate cats Compete for a 60-second flight distance on the leaderboard
Bienvenue dans l'univers des courses nocturnes et des concours de lowrider !
Wall to Wall is an arcade scoring game.
An apocalyptic Visual Novel from Zombie Zone Germany for Christmas with German voice acting, lots of decisions and seven different endings. There is only a version in German language.
Feel the joy of handwork with Pottery Crafts: Hand-Made Simulator. Unlock your creativity making ceramics designed by you.

Vous aussi, vous avez parfois envie de faire quelque chose de fou? Laissez-vous emporter et lancez-vous un défi stimulant, épique et unique? Découvrir les limites de votre propre endurance nerveuse? Si oui, ce jeu est parfait pour vous.

Endless arcade action takes a modern twist, creating a uniquely challenging open space shoot-em-up experience. From brutal bosses to black holes and beyond, countless hazards await discovery. How long can you survive?

Parcourez librement à travers une magnifique prairie entourée de montagnes, inspirées des vénérables Alpes suisses. Les herbes bruissent dans la brise sur les collines tandis que vous marchez aux côtés des moutons amicaux, qui ne sont que trop heureux d'avoir votre compagnie.

We're Here, Papa is a VR horror game. In the dark depths of the sewer, you must find your way and escape on your own. But you are not alone down there. Something is pursuing you. You don’t know what it is, but one thing is certain… you must not let it catch you.

Dwelvers is a unique real-time strategy Dungeon Keeper-like with resource management, logistics, battles, magic spells, trading, crimes against humanity, labyrinths, and so much more. Are you able to eradicate the pesky humans once and for all? Of course you are. The Dark Mother wills it.

《God Souls》 is a 3D hardcore action game based on Nordic mythology. The main content of the game is invigorating and exciting combat, and it has combined a variety of elements and ability development systems.
studio: 苏州天魂网络科技股份有限公司

description: Zombie arena is a multiplayer first person shooter gamer, focused on cooperation to annihilate zombies and various monsters in a post apocalyptic world.

KNIGHT FLIGHT is a physics-based adventure game set in medieval times. Fling your heroes across the screen to smash obstacles, defeat enemies and solve puzzles. Can you solve all 30 levels and stand victorious in the final boss fight?

Fox vacation is a lighthearted nostalgia game. In the game, the player arranges all the journey of the fox through the plan, and at the same time, we can find our lost childhood. 32 weeks to complete the content of the week. Let's have a good holiday!

A music game, where you play songs. You play missing percussion, guitars, pianos, vocals, synthesizers, effects, strings and many more other instruments that change during the game. A total of 127 minutes of music you can play.

Newly-crowned King of Callahach! It's been twenty years since your father saved the world by entrapping the evil Sorcerer Sanwe. Now the spell is waning. Sanwe's malevolent force will soon consume the land, and only you can stop him!

You are Ada Frost, a lieutenant of the blue army. You find yourself deep behind enemy lines, with the stolen black army plans in your hands, you can end the war. That is, if you and your squad can make it home alive!

titre: City Legends: Le fantôme de Misty Hill Édition Collector
description: Les incidents les plus horribles se produisent souvent dans des institutions médicales, dont les portes cachent de terribles secrets et des incidents inexpliqués. Sauras-tu faire face aux secrets les plus sombres de Misty Hill ?

Steel yourself for a relentless display of might and muscle…brawn and bravery…magic and mayhem! Inspired by heroic fantasy fiction, Tiny Barbarian DX combines engaging 2D platform action and combo-based hack-and-slash combat with retro-style pixel art and a loincloth-stirring chiptune soundtrack.
Choice Chamber is a real-time, crowdsourced, procedurally generated game where your fate is in everyone else's hands.

Catch the bus and let it take you to a detailed, virtual world.Are you ready to explore a picturesque German city behind the wheel of a realistically modeled, freely accessible bus? Then take a look at “Bus Simulator 2012” by the well-known developer studio TML!Every technical detail of the original bus has been reproduced true-to-live.
Minimalist, relaxing, motion logic, interactive mind game.
Help rebuild a pet store chain with some unique inventions!

Not Alone is a single-player horror simulator in which you play the role of 45-year-old Mortie Jones. You learn that your mother is dead and your father is missing. Your task will be to spend the night in your old family home.
Pilot a starfighter in Frontiers Reach. Fight through an interstellar war and customize your way through a retro-futuristic space combat campaign.

Veil of crows is a sandbox style real-time strategy game set in a chaotic medieval world. From violent, and overtly bloody battles, to completely destructible castles, RPG style hero development, and meaningful interactions with other factions. Trade, extort, and conquer!
A magical deck-building strategy game. Train your heroes, explore a dangerous world, and overcome enemies such as wolves, giants, and ice golems on your way to a mysterious fortress.

A Walk with Yiayia est une courte aventure narrative d’une promenade avec votre grand-mère grecque qui a perdu sa confiance en elle suite à une chute effrayante. Créez des liens au travers de conversations captivantes et explorez un environnement relaxant dans cette petite aventure contemplative.

Welcome to cult action paradise. Vendetta Forever is the critically acclaimed love letter to cult action cinema that combines iconic, cinematic inspired scenes with exhilarating VR action, powered by LO-KILL-MOTION. Shoot to kill. Kill to move.
It’s the year 202X. Bosses and Landlords rule over a dying world. Something has to be done. Someone has to fight for the people!

Kitsu's Destiny is a roguelite incremental RPG made in RPG Maker. It has a dynasty mechanic, the more damage you deal, the more Gold and Experience your get try again. You have equipment and boosts to purchase, and you get more powerful insignias as you go on. It's like speedrunning grinding!

Azrael est un jeu de Détective/Horreur à la première personne dans lequel vous Incarnez un détective et revivez des scènes de crimes dans une ambiance horrifique et tentez d'élucider une affaire de meurtre au sein d'un groupe d'amis.

Toy Scrappers is a thrilling chase-based horror game that can be played with up to 16 players. Some players take on the role of a killer attempting to capture others. Escape the madness and stay alive!

Sokolor est un jeu de sokoban avec des mécaniques innovantes. Poussez les cubes colorés dans leurs positions correctes, mais d'abord vous devez vous peindre de la même couleur pour pouvoir les pousser!

titre: BDSM: Big Drunk Satanic Massacre Demo
description: BDSM est le premier RPG d’action satirique qui vous offre la chance d'incarner Lou, le fils de Satan ! Cherchez de la gnôle, tuez les traîtres, sauvez l’Enfer et délivrez la plus chaude des démones des griffes de ces sales humains et des méga-corporations !

Project UNSEEK is a 2v6 class-based asymmetrical online multiplayer horror game inspired by 80s slasher horror movies, SCP urban legend, and Science Fiction, where you compete against each other to survive the experiment as High Schoolers or Mythical Creatures.

titre: Legends of Catalonia: The Land of Barcelona
description: Entrez dans une aventure épique, voyageur. La Catalogne vous attend et vous devez aider le chevalier Sant Jordi à retrouver les secrets de son journal intime. Rejoignez une aventure entre les mains de compagnons de voyage illustres et surmontez les défis qui vous attendent dans un monde de rêves, de légendes et de fantaisie.

ROM: Extraction puts you into the role of an Extractor where you must Throw, Slow, & Shoot your way to decimate as many extraterrestrial-bots as possible. ROM: Extraction begins as an homage to the classic arcade shooter with more game modes and maps to come!
玩家将扮演一个初出茅庐的江湖小生，在战斗和历练中结识红颜知己，并与她们共同闯荡这个充满危机与机遇的江湖世界。

200 niveaux à la difficulté relevée et un grand éventail d’options promettant. L’objectif est toujours de guider la boule au point d’arrivée, mais la difficulté augmente au fil des niveaux. Vous disposez d’un grand nombre de ressourcesx – mais votre budget est limité.

Race To Mars is a turn-based, space company simulation game. Become the head of the newly established “New Space” company whose goal would be to establish a colony on Mars. You begin as a startup - develop cutting edge aerospace technologies and use them to achieve orbit and fly beyond Earth vicinity, blazing the trail of a space pioneer...
A live-action comedic courtroom thriller, where YOU are the prosecution, defense and the judge!

Chronicles of Teddy : Harmony of Exidus est un jeu d’Aventure / Action en 2D avec un rendu Retro en Pixel Art. Partez aider Tarant dans une vaste quête dans laquelle il va falloir se battre, utiliser son sens de l’orientation et son ouïe pour arriver à ses fins.
Guts 'N Goals: Preseason is an introduction to the arcade-style soccer beat 'em up that's releasing later this year. Get ready to beat your friends at a game of soccer, literally.
Perfect Inventory is an organization puzzle game that brings you to a medieval age in the role of a methodical squire trying to make his best to fit all the items perfectly into the inventory.

Expanded version of previously released Wild Romance including new UI, more features and additional never before seen in English content. Follow the adventures of Kazuma as he reconnects with four female friends who accidentally reveal that they are not mere humans.
Take to the stars and harvest precious ore from wild asteroids! ASTRALODE Freeminers is asteroid mining puzzle action with an interstellar support crew of colorful misfits.
Magic Box - interesting puzzle game with a lot of interesting and challenging levels.

Madrid Noir is a 45 minutes mystery adventure that unfolds across two acts in this VR film. With her uncle declared dead, a disenchanted young woman must delve into her memories to pick up his shadowy trail. Solving the puzzles of the past ain't gonna be easy!
FAST FPS inspired by 90s games You play as a vampire who will have to survive waves of enemies, with a cemetery as a backdrop. Fight by casting spells.
Third part of Angry bunny series. Deathly viruses and their army has conquered world. Find magic crystal and beat evil Viruses and save bunny world..
Husky's Adentures, 3D Cute Platformer Game.

In the dark forests of Duskwood town, an abandoned hospital rises ominously. Despite its closure years ago, "Sinister Hospital" harbors terrifying secrets. The player enters to follow the trail of a group of lost children from the town. There lies a dark journey and quest for justice: Judge Harlan.

A short narrative and exploration game about Zach, June, and a strange phenomenon. You're Zach and, stuck in your home, you will do everything to keep hearing June's voice messages. What is happening out there?

Imagine waking up in an unknown environment. It’s dark. You have no idea where and who you are. Only a small alarm light flashes somewhere in the room. Something seems off. The room is filled with a strange soundscape. Start your adventure now and bring light into the unknown darkness.

Expand a small middle age village into an industrialized city with skyscrapers through the means of efficient ressource management. A large map, free building and camera movement allow you to watch everything in detail and build everything the way you want!

Sabotris is a strategic, competitive, 3D block stacking game, but with a twist: you can sabotage your opponents, but be careful; you can also end up sabotaging yourself! Choose to play either by yourself to beat your own high score, against your friends or other players, or even against computer AI!

Greetings Officer-Cadet o249,Are you ready to be put to the test? If deemed worthy, you will be assigned as an officer in the shadowy halls of Facility 7C. You will remotely lead a squad of operatives on daring espionage missions to plant evidence, steal secrets, assassinate targets, and perform sabotage for the glory of the Dark Father.
SOLITUNE is a very short game about escapism. You become a shepherd and collect your flock on the way out of your old life. Solve a puzzle in every room to earn a sheep to find your way out.

Set two months after Corpse Party: Book of Shadows, Corpse Party: Blood Drive is the definitive conclusion to the long-running Heavenly Host story arc. Featuring dynamic lighting, 3D sound, detailed environments, and new gameplay systems, this is a Japanese horror experience not to be missed!

Dark Fantasy Warrior is a third-person action role-playing game in Dark Souls style. Extremely dark, deep and DIFFICULT! All of that in this super action game and prepare to die. Are you ready to fight Darkness?
Simulation World - This is a puzzle, story and open world. Feel the vanilla atmosphere as you progress through the puzzles. Rescue the simulation from a virus that wants to destroy the computer world

A survival game that simulates mechanical beasts. You can get evolution points by fighting. Mechanical beasts can evolve, mutate, deform, and alloy, which has a great impact on appearance and properties. If they are not satisfied, they can choose to degenerate.
A 2D procedurally generated top-down view sandbox set in a post-apocalyptic world in which you have to survive as the captain of a desert combat vehicle.

Loved by millions, played for centuries, backgammon is a two-player strategy game quite unlike any other. The goal is simple: race to get your checkers off the board first. The deceptively deep rules and rhythm of backgammon has secured it as a favourite among casual and veteran players alike.

DIVE: Starpath is a third-person runner set in the stratosphere of massive planets. Guide yourself through the perils of interstellar space as you pursue a mysterious traveler. Fight gravity, gather the data canisters, and don't lose orbit!

"Haunted Things" est un jeu d'horreur indépendant où vous incarnez Guna à la recherche de son frère disparu. Vous devrez survivre à des menaces effrayantes de différents mondes, avec le choix entre une vue à la troisième personne ou à la première personne.

Take control of a powerful drone and prepare to face off against hordes of enemies standing in your way. Collect currency and upgrade your drone with new weapons and skills. Are you ready for the ultimate challenge?

In this sideways scrolling shmup, take control of your spaceship and navigate through vibrant pixelated environments filled with hordes of enemy spacecraft. Upgrade your ship and weapons, dodge enemy fire while blasting through each stage. Emerge victorious as the ultimate space pilot!

Abrix 2 is an addictive puzzle game for everyone. Try over 170 different levels of puzzles and secrets and help Abrix, a tiny toy robot, to find a way out. Abrix 2 is a continuation of a hit game Abrix the robot. Now with new graphics and full of new stuff it's better than ever.

ZACH-LIKE is a book of behind-the-scenes design documents from Zachtronics. The digital version of ZACH-LIKE contains the full contents of the book, a bunch of terrible games that Zach made before SpaceChem, and some prototypes and early builds of Zachtronics games, both released and... not.
Run a candy factory. Place machines and conveyors and feed them different mixtures of ingredients to create candy

Play as our hero, Crisp, and navigate the puzzles by using the elements of electricity, ice, and fire. Ascend the castle and complete the challenge! OR Kick back and enjoy some fishing, who knows what's in those waters! Go beyond the challenge, create your own, or try challenges from others!
