Take up your trusty bow and siege weapons to repel a fairy tale assault in fully immersive VR! Did the enemies smash down your gate with their battering ram? Quick-throw your hip axes to keep them from mounting the stairs! Spend your gold wisely and you can even DUAL WIELD MAGIC STAFFS!

A VR experience for shooters to feel immersed among different competitive shooting sports (IPSC, 3gun, etc) with regular stage updates and competitions, we offer a one of a kind competitive shooting experience in the comfort of your home!

Affrontez des démons et votre propre esprit pour vous sauver d'un enfer sans fin dans ce jeu d'horreur rétro de survie sur le mystère, la psychologie et la froideur du meurtre. Bannissez les démons avec des armes mortelles et réassemblez les pièces mystérieuses d'une famille disparue dans Psychosis.

You are here to kill as many birds as you can with your bow and your HTC Vive or Oculus Rift. Skyhearth features tracked motion controller aiming for Vive and head aiming for Rift and Vive. It's easy to play and challenging to master.
Synthrun is an action-platformer where you race through an abstract world. Have you got what it takes to collect all the energy orbs?

The interface IS the game. Using your keyboard in a command prompt-style, you will engage in combat with enemy spaceships, raid planets, collect warp cores, draw space cards to obtain advantages (and disadvantages) and much more.

Xpand Rally Xtreme vous plonge dans l'ambiance des courses de voitures : circuits techniques et dangereux vous attendent au tournant. En gagnant des courses, constituez-vous une réserve d'argent qui vous permettra de faire l'achat de nouvelles voitures et de pièces détachées.
9ème Compagnie est un jeu de stratégie en temps réel orienté action qui se déroule pendant la campagne soviétique en Afghanistan.

A single player strategy game in the style of euro board games. Around 30 minutes per game. Collect resources. Explore. Recruit adventurers and fight monsters or complete quests. Improve lands. Research spells. Unlock races, adventurers, land & quest cards, spells and monsters.

Êtes-vous prêts à affronter la mort, survivre à des pièges mortels et des ennemis effrayants ? Découvrez un jeu de plateforme en 2D avec une histoire sombre ! Maîtrisez vos compétences spéciales et entrez dans une réalité alternative pour tenter de terminer les 21 niveaux du jeu !
Bobby from Team HOT GUNS has a job to locate and secure the legendary Money Tree.

Experience a world where the greats of human history collide in epic battles across time. Pick your favourite hero and assemble a team for the ages to duel it out with your friends and unleash the power of your cards to see who among you is the strategic mastermind.
Get Out is a 1-4 player online co-op psychological horror. Complete tasks and puzzles to banish the entities that have you and your team trapped, and make sure to get out, before they get you.

Save Solarus and Earth! As a Sainen seeking a new home to avoid extinction, work solo or with others to build a safe haven on a hostile planet. Discover Bineok in this sci-fi RPG where healing, not fighting — is key 🧡

NFBL is a basketball strategy-management game that I designed with pure code without using any game engine. Although it is inspired by real characters and events, it is not directly related to any person or team.

Enter the Blacksea Odyssey, a violent top-down rogue-lite space shoot ‘em up RPG brimming with colossal creatures and runic technologies. Explore dangerous, interstellar spacescapes as you hunt enormous space-behemoths with a harpoon and rune-infused spears.

Somewhere in Tokyo, in an exclusive mahjong Club. Rei is a clerk in this club. Her job is to play Mahjong with the guests. Players will operate Rei and play with 3 guests in the authentic Japanese Mahjong. Dead wall draw and Last tile from the wall... It all depends on your skills!!
A great virus has infected the Cyber Space! Is up to you initiate the protocol CHAMENEON. Surf on the neon lines in the Cyber Space and defeat the virus before is too late.

VOUS devez montrer ce que vous valez alors que la guerre au-dessus de l'Europe bat son plein.Combattez vagues après vagues d'avions et de panzers de l'Axe jusqu'à affronter les chefs ennemis – les as de ACES OF THE LUFTWAFFE.
A duel between darkness and light!
stepbystep is a minimalistic programming puzzle platformer with experimental turn-based mechanics where you must write a command sequence to complete the levels that will be run automatically.
Cherche la Pierre Philosophale !
You control three employees of a cleaning company, carrying out their jobs, but be careful, as engaging in activities outside of work may lead to undesirable outcomes.

We fused typing and strategy to provide you the best experience of a 1v1 typing game. Choose your race and lead your soldiers to break through the opponent fortress in the fingers of speed and wisdom!

Azurael's Circle: Chapter 1 is a horror-mystery adventure game where you must find the truth about your mother's death. What evils await you in the depths of the Lancaster farmhouse? The further you go, the more strange things get.

ENKI is a repeatable horror experience about escaping, featuring multiple endings that will ensure you that every playthrough will be a bit different from the previous one. In only 30 minutes find your way to freedom through occult symbolism, mysteries and discoverable secrets... Survive or die!
《TSUKUMOHIME》是一款幻想的古代東洋風遊戲，玩家扮演的「創物者」，在一個神秘的世界中，帶領化身美少女的「物靈」們展開一場不可思議的冒險旅程。

titre: Hush Hush - Only Your Love Can Save Them
description: A Visual Novel with a twist - improve skills, charm girls, and learn dangerous secrets... by any means necessary.

Pacific Storm: Allies expands upon the success of the internationally acclaimed original to deliver an unforgettable mix of real-time strategy and blistering arcade combat, recreating World War II's most heated battles.

titre: Mystery P.I.™ - The New York Fortune
description: Un milliardaire Newyorkais a caché son testament quelque part dans New York. Sa famille à 17 heures pour le localiser faute de quoi l'héritage ira à son chat et à son chien. Vous êtes un détective privé et la famille du milliardaire vous a embauché pour résoudre cette énigme. Il vous faudra passer au peigne fin 25 endroits et 2100 objets.
There are too many bugs!

Hipster Attack is a classic tower defense game with lots of humor and cartoonish graphics in which players defend the local coffee shop from massive hipster invasion with the help of corporate workers.
本作是一款多结局的AVG游戏。在一个月黑风高之夜，七个各怀目的男女集聚于一一间废弃的学校，却遭遇到一股邪恶可怕力量的侵袭，在这个扑朔迷离的惊魂之夜，玩家需要做出决定人物命运的各种选择。

Gift of Parthax est un jeu d'action dans des arènes 2D vues du dessus où les mages deviennent gladiateurs ! Armé d'un gigantesque arsenal de sorts personnalisables, affrontez les maîtres de l'arène et leurs monstres mythologiques pour sauver votre ami Veleus du redoutable mage Parthax !
After one of his friends has an accident, Mark and the group seek help in an isolated mansion, where terrible enemies and dangers await them.

A controller based, top-down, 2D physics action game for 1-4 players. Maneuver your squad of mages through four zones of dangerous encounters with the Jurisdiction in an Arena which was devised by the Wise Witch in order to train the Defiance.

Kim is a boisterous urchin from 1880s Lahore, his wanderlust will take him all over India. Branching conversations, survival, stealth and combat let you play Kim's coming of age however you choose. The enormous open world of Kipling's India awaits you!
Urak, once peaceful, is now a land of darkness, chaos and death. The people yearn for a champion to drive away the forces of evil. That champion is you.

An anthology series that serves as a Corpse Party sequel, prequel, midquel, and alternate universe tale all in one. Rejoin old friends for a deeper dive into the haunted halls of Heavenly Host Elementary...

Un jeu de stratégie au tour par tour dans un univers fantasy. Incarnez l'héritière royale et battez-vous pour Cérulée et la couronne! Plongez-vous dans la campagne solo et affrontez vos amis grâce au mode multijoueur multiplateforme. Améliorez vos compétences de commandement avec le mode défi.
Slimy Puzzle Platforming
Expelled - the adventure of a rabbit on dangerous planets, and all in order to use the only chance to get out of prison and return home to his wife and children.

A small, comedic zombie shooter that requires both twitch and strategic skills...One genetically enhanced man along with an inept, insulting, and cowardly scientist must save the World from the invading mutated hordes!
Shoot, punch, and cast to the enemies beat. Survive chaotic and dynamic tempo driven rounds. Dash to keep within tempo range or dash to avoid incoming damage.
You appear in what seems to be an abandoned Junkyard, you don't quite know how you got there... But your not alone. Try to escape the Junkyard of killer cars, if you can.
Zooicide is a casual team-based multiplayer game featuring animals fighting against humans within a playfully dangerous environment, the zoo.

Kingshunt est un jeu d’action à la troisième personne multijoueur en ligne, un savant mélange de tower-defense et hack’n’slash. Rejoignez le combat et semez la destruction à travers un champ de bataille dans un jeu mélant stratégie et combat héroïque effréné.
Death Again is a single player horror fps. Journey through a nightmarish realm that lies between dimensions in search for salvation.
A single player first-person action shooter.

After an emergency landing with a space capsule you wake up alone (?) on an unknown abandoned planet. Without knowing where you are. To survive you will have to find food, craft items, harvest, build a shelter and keep the fire lit.

Des extraterrestres géants font des ravages. Faites fonctionner les aéroglisseurs DISC. Absorbez les balles ennemies et rechargez votre arme. Il s'agit d'un jeu de tir vertical. Le bon timing de votre attaque détermine la survie ou la défaite du joueur.

Never Second in Rome is a turn-based historical game with RPG and management elements. You are a Roman centurion in the army of Julius Caesar. You will control both your character and the unit under his command.

Paddle your balls! The hypergalaxy's premiere video table tennis role playing experience. Explore the hypergalaxies in the year 3000 or so to become the ultimate paddle champion. Learn new skills, cast devastating spells and put someone's underwear on your head whist riding a swamp beast!

If there are any abnormalities in your robot at home, please send it back to the company for testing and inspection as soon as possible. Our company provides safety and other aspects of robot testing, adjustment, and repair to make your robot look brand new, just like it just left the factory.
Unbalance est un casse-tête de physique minimaliste sur la géométrie et l'équilibre

Beyond Mankind: The Awakening est un RPG d'action qui se déroule dans un monde post-apocalyptique. Le jeu a un récit mature et profond avec une exploration riche, des combats tendus et des mécanismes de RPG immersifs.
Infinite Children is a science fiction audiobook video game about life extension. Every time anyone gets a Steam achievement, the game gets longer...for everyone in the world.

VOYAGEZ DANS LE TEMPS à travers l’histoire pour DEVENIR DIEU 🚀 Chevauchez des dinosaures, construisez une colonie, assiégez des châteaux, automatisez, minez, forgez, naviguez, volez vers la lune! Une inoubliable et révolutionnaire aventure de survie et de construction de base.
This game is to let everyone understand the basic process of football betting, and at the same time warn everyone of the risk about gambling through this game.

Death lurks in every corner of this journey filled with tension and despair. The brave may not be the smartest here and those who know the time to retreat are more likely to make it out alive in the end ... Find your lost friend in a house that holds unimaginable secrets.

A free educational math RPG that caters to children. Helps in practicing basic addition skills through drills while adventuring in the land of Mathoria. Also aims to target educators and gamer parents alike, so that Mathoria can become a bonding tool between them and the children they care for.

Fhtagn Simulator is a Cthulhu Roulette Deckbuilder. Set up card slots on roulette to maximize card's value. Collect evil creatures, spells, items and environment to build your deck. Your ultimate mission is to sacrifice spirit collected by cards to unseal the ancient gods that have come to earth!
Visual novel ที่ผสมผสานความเป็น Simulation ซึ่งหน้าที่ของคุณที่จะได้รับนั่นคือการเป็นองครักษ์ส่วนตัวของเจ้าหญิงและฝึกฝนเธอเพื่อที่จะทำให้เป็นเจ้าหญิงที่ยิ่งใหญ่ในอนาคต

Travaillant dans la saisie de données dans une grande ville, vous tapez et retranscrivez les lettres perdues qui n’ont nulle part où aller. Mais alors que les jours passent, vous remarquez des choses étranges dans ces courriers, et votre réalité commence à se fissurer.
Unpossess is a 1-4 co-op exorcism simulator game set in the early 1900s. Players take on the role of exorcists responsible for addressing cases of human possession.
Frag as many other pirates vessels as possible until the time limit is reached.

Construisez une usine pour les clients les plus exigeants de la galaxie : les chats. Automatisez la production, acheminez produits et chats vers vos magasins et développez-vous en surface et sous terre. Exploitez l’apprentissage automatique pour optimiser l’activité, sans ennemis pour vous gêner.
Build the castle of your dreams

《X.A.O.C》is set in a world of exotic mythologies and legends -- the hundreds of characters who populate this universe, are a fusion of Taiwan, Vietnam, Thailand and Ryukyu cultures, resulting in an epic Oriental fantasy adventure.

The world of the arts has been invaded by a villain who hates artistic expressions and wants to destroy them. Embark on this adventure to save the world of the arts and rescue the Danditos from the clutches of Dr. Hate!

"Child Phobia: Nightcoming Fears" is a 2D psychological thriller, horror. We will tell you a story about a little boy, that has problem in family – and this problem converts in fear during the night. You will be able to explore various locations during the nightmares, and watch the family drama during the day.

titre: Alternate Jake Hunter: DAEDALUS The Awakening of Golden Jazz
description: This is the story about the creation of Jinguji Saburo and his humble beginnings.And yet, young Jinguji Saburo who is alone in the world, takes up the gauntlet for himself and for his late grandfather!
One strike can end it all. Step into multiplayer samurai duels where precision, timing, and skill decide who survives. Hone your mastery through deadly challenges.
Lovebirb is a rhythm-based dating game about finding love one date at a time. Swipe right, chat on Bumbird, and impress your dates by playing all the right words to the rhythm of the music. 🎶🐤

LE FLIPPER SUPER SPEED EST DE RETOUR ! Désormais avec des sprites plus grands, plus de méchants et PLUS DE BALLES ! DEMON'S TILT repousse les limites du jeu de flipper avec des éléments de shoot 'em up et de hack 'n' slash.
The Dragon's Prophecy is an old-school 2D RPG in the style of the early Final Fantasy and Dragon Quest. The road is long and perilous, and a Dragon waits at every corner.

The main character also dreams of becoming a billionaire, leaving behind a gloomy future that seems to be just an ordinary life on Earth, investing all the money he had in moon tickets and a moon cleaning company, and embarking on a long journey penniless.
Sanctuaries. Secrets. Serious consequences. A solo-developed psychological horror/drama visual novel.

"The Complex Tragedy" est un jeu d'horreur solo se déroulant dans un immense complexe résidentiel. En explorant différentes zones, vous ressentirez la peur en découvrant le côté effrayant et désert du complexe. Préparez-vous à une expérience glaçante au sein du complexe.

Come and visit the Roman Colosseum! This guided tour will take you through its rise and downfall, bring you face to face with gladiators, and allow you to experience the glory of roman architecture like never before. Welcome!

A retro-styled shooter that doesn't take itself too seriously. Warp between platforms and Dash through bullets. Beat up your enemies, or blast them away. Juggle your combo, and buy upgrades in the shop. Track down your corpse after you die.

Embark on Dobuki's whimsical quest across three vibrant planets. Solve clever puzzles, battle quirky enemies, and save the galaxy from the clutches of Emperor Lik Wang in this charming blend of point-and-click adventure and RPG elements blah blah thanks ChatGPT for this bland SEO filled description.

Dusk 12 is a first person shooter, full of action where the player will incarnate two heroes. One of the soldiers of the group, with unknown past and one of the infected men with the virus, who has strength, speed and fortitude beyond human limits.

Puzzle GO! is a casual jigsaw puzzle game. Players use the mouse to adjust the position of the tiles to restore the picture. As a player, this game provides multiple exquisite CGs as levels. At the same time, the game has carefully prepared a rich achievement system for players.
Use your barista and math skills to mix the perfect latte and rebuild your family home and cafe to their former glory.

Play What The Pros Play! Officially licensed by MLB, the MLB Players Inc., and KBO, Out of the Park Baseball 24 is the newest in the award-winning sports strategy series. A sports fan’s dream come true - and the only game ever to win Metacritic PC Game of the Year Award TWICE.

Welcome to another boring game! The highly anticipated sequel to The Most Boring Game Ever is here! This is designed to be a boring experience where you click your way through the days living life with no end in sight. Learn about life and death and the routine we all go through in life.
Marble Age is a turn-based historical strategy where your task is to turn a small Ancient Greek village into a flourishing Polis, powerful enough to conquer the known world!
A combination of using flashcards for learning with the classic card game Solitaire.

The official train company's authentic driving simulator is here! JR East Train Simulator" is a train driving simulator that allows you to experience live-action images and realistic driving sounds of JR East's actual train lines in your own home.
perspective illusion puzzle based on M.C. Escher drawings and impossible shapes

Three limbs ripped off, infected with a deadly parasite, you must survive. Drag yourself through the hallways of an infested arcship, fight off twisted eldritch creatures, craft vaccines and ammunition, and escape to civilization.
Five-Finger Gunslinger is a third-person online arena-battle game where players compete against their friends to become the most popular kid in the west.

Il existe un grand secret dans l'usine de construction de robots du Docteur Hugo. Quand les inventeurs ne regardent pas, les petits robots vivent de grandes aventures. Ils ne s'attendaient pas à tomber sur un complot si diabolique qu'il menace même leur existence. Avec des lasers.

See how sounds and shapes help mental health in virtual reality. The aim of Binaural Odyssey is to create and guide the user’s emotions. The virtual world reacts to the eyes of the viewer and creates visual shapes from whichever direction the user looks at.

Choose your pilot and build your own custom mecha with 17+ weapons and 55+ attachments, then jump to the battlefield against hundreds of enemies to save spacetime itself in this thrilling sci-fi bullet heaven!
FPV Air 2 is a quadcopter flight simulator for serious FPV racing pilots who want a tool for meaningful/realistic flight practice in any weather.
Entrez dans un monde fantastique à la recherche d'or et de gloire!

Super Chain Crusher Horizon is the largest, longest, most incredible PC shooting game in history with a two-player mode that is revolutionary. And, it’s loaded with game modes that solve the problems had by most shoot ‘em ups.
World War I is a real-time strategy based on the modified version of the well-known Blitzkrieg engine.
Your friend’s in the past!
《愚者之梦：零时将至》是一款由零点世界（Zero world）工作室制作并发行的视觉小说游戏。游戏通过点击鼠标来进行故事推动，以便更加沉浸的体验故事。游戏文本量为12万字左右，单线单结局。

Join the fun as adorable animals battle for athletic supremacy across a variety of fantastic arenas! Play against friends across multiple platforms over the Internet. In FurBall, you play on teams of up to 2 players on each side in noble competition, attempting to score goals for your team!

From the Ruby Forest to the fortified city of Bromure, from Baccus Farm to the snowy village of Kaldinger, meet unforgettable characters and live your adventure, discovering the multiple facets of Lumen's gameplay!
Fugo Rojo the Dragon loves to collect manmade objects and his eternal taste for treasure takes him on a journey to collect items from around the world.

Roghill Incident is an Indie storytelling/exploration/kind-of-horror game that focuses on the story, while creating the uncomfortable feeling that something bad will happen soon.Find all the locations, notes and hints to get different endings.
Mege is the childhood sweetheart of the protagonist. Lucky enough, he is able to marry Mege with everyone's blessing and lives a happy life. But the sudden news of layoffs broke his peaceful days.

Aura est le jeu de survie ultime de type Jump and Run. Courez à travers des forêts sans fin, des cavernes volcaniques, des forêts magiques et le grand froid de la toundra. Survivez le plus longtemps possible et montrez au monde que vous êtes l'ultime guerrier d'Aura ! [/b]

Innkeeper's Basement is a challenging roguelike card game mixed with minesweeper with over 5000 different character build combinations. Create your character, explore the dungeon, build your deck, drink alcohol to forget bad decisions and vanquish monsters!

Super Head Ball is an action-packed multiplayer game that pits two teams of warriors against each other as they fight to throw a decapitated head into a blazing pyre. With simple controls and 4-player local multiplayer, matches are fast, frantic, and intense.

Rising Lords est un jeu de stratégie médiéval au tour par tour avec des éléments de jeu de cartes et de société. Envoyez vos serfs mourir en votre nom... ou laissez-les prospérer, et utilisez-les à votre avantage !

Take control of the hero of the lands and guide them through the dungeons of Cavyrn as they fight to clear the infestation that has taken root. Use swords, unique items and a cunning mind to gain victory

Imprecision is a first/third person, action-adventure, rogue-lite set in The Middle Ages. In Imprecision, you play as a lone archer, Örvar, who is training to take down The Black Knights of Bjørn and their kingdom. You are determined to defeat King Bjørn the Bloodthirsty and take back what is yours.

Welcome to an apocalyptic fantasy world where humanity is on the brink of extinction, glory is valued above gold and freedom is hard earned. In the age of Great Drotus Empire, a lone mercenary accepts a contract to liberate 13 nations of The Empire in order to regain his lost "Glory".
Craft, Hunt and Survive

Déjà rêvé d'être une patate de l'espace ? Space Gladiators est un roguelite-platformer 2D dessiné à la main qui suit un groupe de captifs tentant de s'échapper d'une planète-prison. Trucidez des hordes d'extraterrestres dans les arènes de gladiateurs et gagnez votre liberté !

Psychological horror, featuring early 90's graphics and music, vast player's freedom and multiple endings! Leonard White, a professional inspector, is looking for his ex-girlfriend, Kimberly Frances, gone missing in Goodsprings, a small town near Nevada holding the darkest secrets...
Colorgrid is a puzzle game about mixing colors in a Lab. Find the correct positions for your lasers and mirrors to get the right mix of colors in each material.

This is a casual game that combines "match three + collection + dress up". With the advent of Ragnarok, the Protoss forces are insufficient, and most of the Valkyries in the Hall of Valor are living in various parts of the continent as human beings. You must lift the seal on them to summon them.
VBridger is a face tracking plugin designed for Vtube Studio and Live2D, which allows the user to make better use of IphoneX ARKit tracking on their live2D model.

Le danger, la mort et le désespoir caractérisent Black Forest. En tant que chef d'un village maudit, l’objectif est de survivre. Faites des ressources, consolidez le village, et survivez à la nuit terrifiante. Tiendrez-vous pour que les secours arrivent. Ou pas.
DuelVox - un jeu de tir à la première personne dans le style western. Battez tous les cowboys et devenez le meilleur tireur du Far West !

In the future, you must retrieve a stolen hyper-advanced CPU from the CyberQuark Corporation before they use it to create destructive AI robots. In Parkour Chief: Secret Agent, you'll use your parkour and stealth skills to infiltrate CyberQuark's headquarters and recover the CPU.

In a world corrupted by Eldritch abominations, Enzo must climb out of the hellish depths of the universe. From the Black Sea to the Planes of Neethan, it is your job to make your pilgrimage back to the Worlds above. In the black hell of this world, only Moths and demons await you.

Sand Paw is an adventurous cat who is looking for treasures! Explore the 3D dioramas, rotate the camera to find hidden locations, move blocks and platforms, solve puzzles, find and collect all the lost treasures!

La peur et l’anxiété règnent dans ce jeu d’horreur psychologique en vue subjective, dans lequel prennent vie les contes les plus sinistres du folklore japonais. Situé à l’ère féodale, Ikai est centré sur la prêtresse d’un sanctuaire, en proie aux démons de son passé et de son présent.

A VHS/PS1 Survival Horror Experience! Play as Emilia, a young woman cursed by an ancient rosary, transported into the Realm of the Inquisitor, a surreal dimension filled with the ghosts victims of the Inquisitor himself. Solve puzzles, free ghosts, and escape the Inquisitor!

In YEAR 2037, a pandemic of an unknown plague virus infection wiped out most of world animals and citizens. The world turns into a DEAD ZONE and survivors’ lives are threatened with zombies! How will you survive in this Zombie Pandemic game?

titre: Rope Cow - Rope it to The Cow
description: Vache avec une corde tente d'atteindre le Paradis des Vaches

Build a fleet and lead humanity to safety. Grow your fleet using force, diplomacy or guile... and try to stay ahead of the relentless Harvesters. Each ship you add to your fleet gives you powers but also reduces your limited resources in this challenging RTS-with-pause game.

Slay bizarre monsters and humans alike as you venture through the procedurally generated kingdom in this turn-based, rogue-like RPG. Explore the various characters and locations of the realm to find the legendary Tile shards, and seal the evil back beneath the castle!

Dans la conversion digitale du jeu Patchwork de Uwe Rosenberg, les joueurs couse leur chemin vers la victoire en utilisant des pièces de tissue de taille et de couleurs différentes. La meilleur couverture est la plus rempli et le joueur qui coud le plus e collecte la majorité de boutons gagne le jeu – pour ça il va falloir être futé et...
Solitaire Beach Season is a new card game set in exotic seaside locations. 120 summertime levels await you!
Egg Squeeze is a biological intuition test where you squeeze eggs for as long as you can without breaking them.

3 different enemy classes: Infantry, Armored and Robotic. Beat the toughest levels with the right combinations and bonus damage. Every character in the game thinks differently and your relationship with them changes with every choice you make. Make jokes about them. Spread the gossip.

A shooty, slashy, RPG-y game mixing retro and modern sensibilities. A blend of influences from Gauntlet & Smash TV to Zelda & Angband, Ampersat is a handcrafted adventure but with appeal to Roguelite fans. Battle ASCII creatures in colorful areas & free letters to return language to the village!
This is a logical game in which you need to collect puzzles on the Vietnamese theme. Be careful, do not catch flashback
This is a straightforward racing game. Race to the goal(s) before getting hit by spikes.
The assessment of the magician? Is it going to shoot a hundred big fireballs? Or going through an adventure with puzzle solving...
You find yourself in a world full of cute monster girls! The only problem is you lost your memories and all the monster girls want to eat you for nourishment! How will you survive!?

Jelly Killer - Retro Platformer The Adventures Of A Young Bioweapon. In this game you will act like the young bioweapon. You will encounter lots of traps and puzzles. You will have to possess human bodies to pass the game to the end. Good luck!
Forme une armée de héros légendaire et défends ta tour contre tous tes ennemis

Mahjong Deluxe 2: Astral Planes is an out-of-this-world Mahjong game produced by award-winning game developer EnsenaSoft, challenging you to complete increasingly complex mahjong puzzles rendered in glorious 3D.

titre: Sense - 不祥的预感: A Cyberpunk Ghost Story
description: A 2.5D horror game inspired by Clock Tower and Fatal Frame, mixing cyberpunk with traditional Cantonese folklore. With careful attention to pacing, atmosphere and storytelling, Sense hopes to return the horror genre to its roots by celebrating visceral horror and the slow, fearful creep of dread.

Get ready for the fur to fly in this wild and crazy matching game! With dozens of challenging levels, bright and colorful graphics, and a storyline that will have you squawking with laughter, Claws and Feathers will provide hours matching fun!

Un condensé d'expérience incrémentale où vous bâtissez une colonie pour récolter et fusionner des fruits toujours plus gros. Utilisez vos synergies préférées pour concevoir le build ultime qui vous rendra riche au de-la de votre imaginaire.

The Tank Lord has taken over the land. Assemble a team or tread solo to defeat his evil forces and take back what is rightfully ours. Take control of a cute animal in a tank and blast through your enemies with your bullets and bombs!
Program your Mech with cards in this turn-based roguelike. Choose your cards and upgrades wisely in order to complete your missions!

Dwarf Tower is a turn-based tactics game of tower building and spellcasting. Each turn you develop your tower by placing blocks, constructing rooms, and play various spells. Your tower can have Libraries (store spells), Crystals (generate mana), Dwarf Dwellings (give you dwarves to repair the tower) and some other rooms.

titre: Battle Royale: Survivors 究极求生:大逃杀
description: Battle Royale: Survivors est un jeu de survie pvp pour le tireur. Les joueurs sont faits prisonniers et jetés sur une île abandonnée. Les joueurs doivent se battre avec tout ce qu'ils peuvent trouver sur l'île. Celui qui reste le dernier survivant remporte la partie.
Actively developed 3D Music Visualizer - reacts in real time to the music you play, regardless of player. Free, no watermarks, no nag screens, no subscriptions. Optional DLC for more effects.

Invite your friends to an exchange of punches where up to four players can compete in the same arena in search of the glory of being the great champion. Also face the adventure mode where there are numerous mysteries, in a virtual and exotic adventure to the sound of a beautiful soundtrack.

As an artificially created being with unlimited potential, explore the Universe to find strong Enemies and good Loot! And who knows, what else you can find? Hyparxis is a turn-based, classic JRPG with unlimited character development.

Défiez la mort elle-même à travers des niveaux aléatoires pour débarrasser votre cargo spatial d'extraterrestres mutants dans un shoot-em-up de plateforme brutal regorgeant d'armes, d'explosifs, de compétences spéciales et de mesures défensives à déverrouiller.

Mahjong Club is a casual mahjong game. 30 mahjong club members from different schools meet up for different goals. Based on authentic Japanese mahjong rules, character-based ability system is added for fun. Meet with cute school girls, and enjoy playing mahjong with them!

titre: A Gay Love Story About Gay Love
description: A short story-based SRPG about two men who will eventually come to love each other. Now updated with added dialogue, new characters, different choices to make and multiple endings!
A throwback to the survival horror and mystery games of the original Playstation, Back in 1995 faithfully re-creates everything from this forgotten era of games.

SHOGUN is an arcade style shooter that emphasizes running and gunning to stay alive. Rip through waves of increasingly difficult enemies hell-bent on your doom by shooting, looting, and eluding a bullet hell of cartoonish horror. Refuse death, explode with burning rage and tear asunder!!!
Steambirds Alliance is a massively-cooperative bullet-hell shooter! Fly with dozens of your feathered friends in an open world full of cruel cat bosses and endless waves of deadly bullets.

You're trapped, alone and cold on a distant planet. Pursued by a droid with only one purpose: killing everything. You must find an escape. Explore the hostile environment, find secret upgrades and new weapons, and finally make your escape from this dark, hostile planet...

titre: 夏休みは切島邸にて(ナツキリ)
description: Your decision can mean the difference between life and death. ー A horror suspense novel with beautiful graphics!
A touching story and a unique narrative with puzzles.

Castles conte l'histoire de l'ambitieux roi Harold, dont la tour que vous construisez sera la plus grande entreprise. À mesure que la tour grandit, vous devrez faire face à des défis de plus en plus corsés.

titre: SENRAN KAGURA Bon Appétit! - Full Course
description: The busty shinobi of SENRAN KAGURA exchange their kunais for kitchen knives in this epic cooking/rhythm showdown! Culinary warfare is carried out via rhythm battles, and players who can create the ultimate Super Dish may be treated to a special feast for the eyes as well.
Lonely Trip is a 2D puzzle platformer. Unique puzzles, beautiful visuals and capturing music, experience all these by completing this lonely adventure.

Caelus Trident is the debut game from Fractured Rogue Studios LLC. Paying homage to the classic arcade shooters, you take on the role of the last ship of your armada trying to survive wave after wave of addictive space combat action.

Seiji Maruyama est un yakuza sur le retour récemment libéré de prison. Connu en tant que « Gozuki » (l’un des généraux-démons de la mythologie bouddhiste), il porte les espoirs de son oyabun. Mais il y a une chose que son aniki a perdu de vue : Maruyama vieillit.

Dr. Herman, your sci-fi journey begins. Armed only with your mind and the Manipulator that operates with different types of energy, you'll have to pass through portals, visit parallel worlds, and solve physics-based puzzles.

Home is Where One Starts... is a short, first-person exploration game in the same vein as Dear Esther or Gone Home. It’s a story about childhood, hope, and the miracle of memory. You play as a little girl from a broken home somewhere in the American South.

Embark in a chaotic quest in a fantasy world to save a small town from certain destruction. Play as the great wizard Tim in an RPG while learning powerful spells and leveling your character. Explore the world, find its secrets and unravel the story behind The Handbook.

titre: The Dark Eye : Book of Heroes
description: Experience classical role-playing together with your friends in a co-op multiplayer RPG based on THE DARK EYE license that lets you engage in party-based adventures in the fantasy world of Aventuria.

Héros malgré lui, le malicieux de Blob est le seul à pouvoir écraser les forces de l'E.N.K.R. à l'aide de ses bonds et rebonds pour ouvrir la voie à la révolution qui sauvera Chroma City de son futur sans couleur.

Ice Caves of Europa will challenge your reflexes and your mind, blending free-flowing precision flight with confronting science fiction ideas about the nature of humanity. An inquisitive flying robot exploring the hazardous caves beneath Europa stumbles upon a sinister interplanetary conspiracy.
Can't Live Without Electricity is a 3D relaxing puzzle game in which you supply electricity by connecting houses to power plants.

Aménagez les drames de votre propre hôpital et manipulez leurs conséquences pour qu'ils restent avantageux ! Votre hôpital se développe rapidement ; votre travail est de soigner vos patients avec votre armée de docteurs et infirmières tout en gérant l'infrastructure de l'endroit et les besoins de tout le monde.

In Urban Chaos, you take on the role of a seasoned mercenary in a war-torn city. The streets are a battleground, with gangs and military forces fighting for the last resources. Engage in intense battles in knockout game modes.

Evolings est un jeu d'attrape-monstres minimaliste de type roguelike proposant des combats au tour par tour. Recrutez, faites évoluer et fusionnez des créatures aussi mignonnes que redoutables pour affronter des hordes de monstres maléfiques ! Et prenez garde aux évènements aléatoires...
A beautiful woman will always catch a boy's eye. Where you look depends on your preferences. This game could be the start for you!

Fight alongside your troops in the sweltering desert heat of the Sahara or in the blustery heights of the Italian Alps. Wield your strategic prowess to gain the upper hand by the light of day and exploit the dark shroud of night to launch surprise attacks. Tanks, planes, troops, weapons - the resources are at your command.
Hargrave finds himself inside the walls of a mysterious labyrinth filled with strange robots. Find the way out, or find what's hidden deep inside.

titre: 谁说奶妈不能拯救世界！
description: 一款以探索为核心的RPG游戏！ 什么？你居然是一位被人们看不起的弱小牧师？ 通过你的智慧，收集情报，提升自我，然后去击败魔王来证明自己吧！

Piégé dans le métro par un accident soudain, vous explorez le labyrinthe de tunnels pour trouver la sortie. Le plus que vous explorez, le plus vous rendez compte qu’il a plus à ce désastre… et que les ombres menaçantes suivent chacun de vos pas.

ClearMem est une application de pointe qui fait 1 chose: Efface votre RAM. Vous exécutez simplement l'application et regardez votre consommation de RAM diminuer considérablement! ClearMem s'intègre totalement à tous les jeux Steam ainsi qu'aux jeux et applications non-Steam!

titre: The Case of the Serialized Killer
description: Delve into a devilishly delightful world of mysticism and mystery as Harold Ludicael, the disgraced demonologist. After the untimely demise of a famous illustrator, you’re tasked with solving their murder in this point-and-click visual novel.
Get your revenge on the enemy cyborg roller derby gang! Roll and fight through a beautiful neon cityscape as CB, a genetically modified cyborg, bent on getting revenge for her past...

Dans ce nouvel épisode de la célèbre série de jeux de courses de motos, l’action passe d’un milieu urbain aux plages ensoleillées et hautes en couleur de Californie, et vous met au défi de réaliser tricks, flips et combos plus spectaculaires que jamais.
Headspun est un ensemble hybride FMV/Adventure situé dans Cortex ; le monde du cerveau brisé de Theo Kavinsky.

In order to retrieve the illegal property embezzled by the evil Lord, Ricka received a mission to capture the Lord. But it was a trap. She fell into a dungeon arranged by the Lord in advance. Although the demons in the dungeon are weak, the existence of various traps makes it difficult to escape!

PROJECT UNKNOWN est un jeu d'horreur coopératif en ligne de 1 à 4 joueurs avec des personnages jouables uniques et des capacités spéciales. Exorcisez différents fantômes, utilisez une variété d'outils et plongez-vous dans une expérience pleine de visuels horrifiants et de mécanismes complexes

This is a world at the brink of destruction, but he comes from a destroyed world. Bearing the burden of changing the fate of this world and facing everything before him, especially the eminent destruction, what can he do, and what price will he pay?
A short, well balanced roguelike RPG that revolves around Norse mythology. Fighting dragons, demons. Customizing characters. Collecting treasures. Discovering strange events.

The main character is a journalist who arrived at a large warehouse to record a documentary about the warehouse operation. But instead, he is faced with a real nightmare. The warehouse turns out to be populated by hungry guards and crazy warehouse operators who turn it into a death trap.

Gem Wizard: Match gems, cast spells, and collect relics as you venture through a perilous dungeon. Battle fierce foes, build your wizard's power, and face the ultimate boss to save the realm. A fusion of puzzle-solving and RPG action!

War Wind II: Human Onslaught is a compelling must-play for any real-time strategy fan. The game offers a great variety of vehicular, mechanised and special units, intense and exciting maps, along with a combat model that offers a dynamic balance of play.

Axel et Pixel sont pris au piège dans un monde à la fois merveilleux et dangereux. Afin de s'échapper, ils devront résoudre des mystères. Dessiné à la main et rendu en très haute-définition, Axel & Pixel est un voyage unique à travers le rêve d'un artiste.

titre: 枕边少女 MOE Hypnotist - share dreams with you
description: 读睡前故事？唱摇篮曲？亲手喂安眠药？和陪睡达人枕边少女一起共度良宵吧！ 本游戏是由“橘子班”制作的枕边少女系列合集，今后或许不定期会有更多的枕边少女加入其中，尽请期待。
Mix-Sign: Girl with 3 Signs is an RPG game with a mix of adventure and thriller. It's the story of a girl named Luna. She woke up in the park and discovered that she's gained the powers of the signs.
A very fun platformer game, this is NoTheOtherMatt's first game.

titre: Angelica Weaver: Catch Me When You Can
description: Building on the successes of their award-winning Midnight Mysteries adventure series, MumboJumbo has created an all-new adventure franchise. Boasting interactive backgrounds, story-driven puzzles, an animated main character, voice acting and a rich narrative filled with twists and turns, Angelica Weaver: Catch Me When You Can is...

Dans ce classique de 2004 initialement publié par Atari Games, vous naviguerez sur 12 parcours vertigineux.Chaque parcours est semé d'obstacles différents qui bloqueront votre chemin, feront glisser votre bille hors de sa trajectoire ou les projeteront directement dans le vide sans fond en contrebas

Type: Science fiction and theology style FPS multiplayer shooting game; Topic: Discovering the Truth of the Universe in the Future of Humanity and Its Impact on the Evolution of Human Bones; Modes: PVE (Gun Shooting Battle and Summoning Flying Shuttle Battle), PVP (Gun Shooting Battle).

titre: Mountain Trap 2: Under the Cloak of Fear
description: In the exciting sequel to the Mountain Trap series, a trip to the mysterious town of Wilshere reveals that several young women have mysteriously disappeared. The local sheriff has lost all hope in solving the case, and residents are afraid to leave their homes for fear of the looming threat of abduction.

titre: The Oil Blue: Steam Legacy Edition
description: It is the future, and the world is in grave need of oil. You and a crew have set off into the ocean, reclaiming old island drilling sites for oil production as you work for the UOO, the biggest oil supplier in the world. The working conditions are dire. You have no choice.

Le roguelike le plus inexact historiquement. Affrontez des hordes en tant que Lincoln, Tesla, Cléopâtre avec des capacités uniques! Combattez à travers les époques, collectez, débloquez et améliorez le jeu via notre métaprogression.
Immerse yourself in the world of ultimate war between Terminators and Humans. Choose your hero from different playable characters. Fight and claim your victory in an epic VR death match.

Defend the fortified beach during D-day against invading forces in this WW2 FPS game as the enemy attacks you with troops, tanks, planes and more! Use the iconic WWII weapons such as MG42, Flak88 and Panzers, prepare your defenses with mines, explosives and bonuses!

One Late Night: Deadline continues the story of One Late Night, a horror/mystery game where you play the role of an office worker caught in the middle of the paranormal activity that has broken out in a seemingly ordinary office building. Freely explore the 5 story office complex that houses several different companies.
Are you ready to take on the challenge and become the best quadrober? Join us and prove that you are a true master of quadrobbing!
Horror Loop, réalisé avec un moteur de jeu de nouvelle génération avec une histoire profonde, impressionnante et originale, vous attend !
Reduce eyestrain in virtual reality during late hours or long time use.
Pour échapper au monde virtuel d'ACCEL vous devrez aller au delà de vos limites avec votre vaisseau spatial. Dans ACCEL nous vous proposons un nouveau challenge avec une maniabilité à 360 degrés.
When a mysterious package appears in his living room, Detective Walter Miles is suddenly transported to a World War II Era newspaper building. Can you solve the mystery and escape?

Take control of six unlikely heroes as they set out on a journey to discover the source of their mysterious power: The power of becoming an Umbra. Experience a full-length RPG adventure with multiple astounding mechanics and characters.

A highly modifiable top-down shooter featuring highscore-driven singleplayer challenges and online-multiplayer competition. You get arenas, racetracks, mini-games and various online-multiplayer modes. Plus powerful modding-tools to create your own levels and game-modes.
Inspired by SCP-087, step into the shoes of an unfortunate student long before the stairwell became legend. Follow the clues left by those who came before, your only choice is to descend.
In this online competitive game, you will have to do your best to survive as long as possible by dodging balls that can kill you in no time!

Nouvelle évolution du simulateur hyperréaliste du monde actuel où vous incarnez un chef d’État ou de l’opposition ! Principales nouveautés 2021 : gestion de l’UE, vaccination Covid, Biden’s challenge, coalitions politiques, négociations diplomatiques, taxe mondiale, accords de libre-échange.

Bombinator (early access - under construction) is an extremely dynamic 3d action game based on cool concepts proven in legends like Bomberman, Dyna Blaster or MegaBlast. Players choose one of many available appearances in game and start to compete with each other on beautiful and challenging arenas trying to score higher and higher rank...

one day, a portal opened for appearantly no reason, evils poured in - the devil who wants to rule the world, slime princess that's acutally kinda cute, blood-thirsting succubus, fox of mystery and sexy mermaids. I was enslaved by those beautiful monstresses and drilled day by day.

Play as a human warrior piloting a mecha-dragon in Danger Forever, a 3D shoot'em up with RPG elements. Battle mechanoids and techno-demons in a hostile world. Fast-paced action and immersive gameplay make this the ultimate shoot'em up adventure.

Bane of Asphodel is an Action-Adventure Game set in the mystical world of Asphodel. Players can play as Neith, a recently deceased normal person, and must liberate the land from the evil Keeper of the Cycle.

Welcome to Flynn Fitness, home of the Hot Squat. Prepare to undergo a rigorous test to not only your legs, but also your will to do as many squats as you possibly can. Compete against your friends, yourself, and the world to get the highest squat count.
Innoquous 5 is a huge puzzle-platformer... with a twist! Hit a gravity arrow or jump into a flipper and you can rotate gravity, opening new paths through each of the huge collection of levels!
Aidez le Père Noël à ramasser les cadeaux sur la piste ! Plus vous ramasserez de cadeaux, plus votre score augmentera !

The Outbound Ghost est un RPG d'aventure dans lequel vous aidez des fantômes à accéder à l'au-delà. Triomphez du passé et créez des badges pour gagner des compétences. Explorez une ville de fantômes en détresse et découvrez combien la vie peut être difficile, même pour les morts.
One hundred detectives compete against each other in a crime-solving competition.

Assume control of a Middle Eastern country recovering from a violent revolution. Forge alliances, grow your economy, invade your neighbors, or pacify your population. Rogue State is a geopolitical strategy game that will force you to always stay one step ahead of your rivals to survive.

Super Captain 3D is a shoot-em-up game where you become a Super Hero ready to fight the Pixel Invaders. It features an art style that combines 3D pre-renders with 2D pixel art. Use your Superpowers to protect the Universe!
[NOT THE LATEST VERSION!! See Pro Strategy Football 2022]

You are an air traffic controller at a small grass airfield in 1925. Witness the airport develop over time, into a major international airport in 1970. Experience the thrill of being an air traffic controller in any time period!

titre: Real Man Got 100 |  是男人上100层
description: It's a game of strategy & act & difficult, leisure and comedy. Perhaps in the near future, through painstaking practice You will become a real man!

Explorez un beau monde ouvert, plein de chevaux et d'autres animaux. Ou profitez simplement de la belle vue en roulant. Dans le monde de Horse Riding Deluxe, vous et vos chevaux n'ont pas de limites. Mais entraînez-vous et prenez bien soin de vos chevaux, car les différentes races exigeront tout de vous!
Control the spaceship to find the beauty! Start a journey of conversation with the beauty!

Earth-Atlantis est un jeu de tir horizontal offrant un gameplay de « chasse aux monstres » original. Cherche et chasse des monstres marins terrifiants et explore un monde sous-marin post-apocalyptique.

The Last World is a sci-fi simulation game with elements of space, adventure, survival, modding and automation. The game in which the player has to create his own empire from the ruins of the old one. Mine, build, research and produce!

titre: A Space For The Unbound - Prologue
description: Prologue chapter of A Space For The Unbound, an upcoming slice-of-life adventure game with beautiful pixelart set in the late 90s rural Indonesia that tells a story about overcoming anxiety, depression, and the relationship between a boy and a girl with supernatural powers

Survive in the deep void of the galaxy against thousands of invaders! Nebula is a challenging bullet hell, twin stick shooter where you have to face endless waves of space enemies. Additional map resources and space drones can provide you a support but be wary, they can as well become a deadly trap.

Story-rich roleplaying game mixing interactive events, strategic planning, and real-time combat. Become the guard of a medieval caravan in a journey where the social connections you make are just as important as the money.
Astrumis - Survive Together est un jeu d'horreur exclusivement coopératif conçu pour deux joueurs. Un joueur contrôle un survivant sur un vaisseau spatial abandonné et l'autre le vaisseau lui-même.
Featuring simple and satisfying drifting and nitro mechanics, Super Pixel Racers lets players race it out in numerous modes from classic Rally to pixelated mayhem in Takedown.

titre: Grim Tales: The Bride Collector's Edition
description: After your sister vanishes on her wedding day no one has any idea what happened to her, so it’s up to you to find the truth!

titre: [Chilla's Art] The Caregiver | 終焉介護
description: The Caregiver | 終焉介護 is a psychological Japanese horror adventure game about a caregiver.

LOGistICAL 2 is a large open-world, strategy, puzzle game where you transport different cargoes to complete all the towns throughout the state or country. Thousands of towns and thousands of businesses to complete across the world. Many free sub-modules to get you started.

A Space Noir Turn-based Battle JRPG homage of old-classics. In this irreverent story, you follow a crew of Space Truckers as they try to survive in a world of aliens, zombies, robots, androids, the Space Cartels, and terrible secrets, in and out of a virtual Internet that holds its own mysteries.

Probability Race is a futuristic racing game. You must use logic, math, probability and luck to win the championship. Play a great variety of minigames and compete in turn based races every day. Unlock abilities and race your way to victory in this platform/stragegy/turnbased game.
Explore looping halls, chat around the campfire with dungeoneering misfits, and learn to make the most of each turn in this JRPG dungeon crawler!
«Mumps» — This is a game about a pig called a Mumps, which should collect all the acorns for itself for the winter. Feel like a pig and survive collecting acorns. Help the pig to pass all levels.

Step into the Kozyrev Mirror to unlock your Extra Sensory Perception. Beware: dread and horror await. Investigate to find an escape from this liminal space. Are you truly alone? A short and chilling singleplayer horror game, inspired by the Kozyrev Mirror experiments.
Help Zigloton steal an old relic on his journey to infiltrate a mysterious planet, in this challenging platformer developped and hand-animated by one person.
Hardcore pixel indie platformer with puzzle elements and history. Can you get to the end?
Retro 2D collection of 4 micro games
Taiko no Tatsujin Rhythm Festival est un jeu de rythme de tambours avec des chansons d'anime et de VOCALOID™, ainsi que de nombreux modes de jeu ! Vous pouvez vous amuser en solo ou en ligne !
Strange Telephone is a 2D adventure game in which the player explores strange worlds created with merely 6 digits, and has multiple endings.

Le monde a besoin de vous, aventurier ! Vivez une aventure RPG pixélisée dans la peau de Baelin, l'humble pêcheur, contraint de devenir le héros de Honeywood. Utilisez votre adresse et des sorts pour affronter des poissons, améliorez vos capacités, vainquez le mal et reconstruisez Honeywood.

titre: LA FORET DE PAGO : LA VENGEANCE DU DRAGON
description: Premier du genre, la forêt de Pago est un jeu pédagogique : on y améliore son orthographe grammaticale à travers la découverte d'un conte de type heroic fantasy.

Classic 2D platforming that blends elements of: Nikola Tesla, puzzles, inventions, 1800's-era undead and a sprinkling of the maniacal Thomas Edison. Throw in a dash of randomly generating level sectors, a zesty squeeze of items and a pinch of indie love... Tasty!

Anthology of Fear is the first-person psychological horror, focusing on the story and solving the secrets of the game world. Discover the beginning of the first of three completely unique dark stories in this climatic prologue.

Un party game multijoueur fou où des bûcherons tentent d'abattre du travail contre les forces de la nature. Jouez contre la montre, achevez des quêtes, combattez des feux de forêt, des pirates et des singes en voyageant autour du monde et à travers le temps. Jouez en mode coop, jcj ou solo !
Casual physics puzzle

Fractured Minds est un jeu artistique court et prenant qui explore les problèmes d'anxiété et de santé mentale. Plongez dans un voyage au cœur de la psyché humaine pour découvrir les défis quotidiens liés à ces maladies.

titre: Jeux de tank Zoo War: 3v3 en ligne
description: Rejoignez les meilleurs jeu multijoueurs maintenant. Complétement gratuit!

There's nothing scarier than waking up in the middle of the forest alone... or so it seems. Taking control of Rachel in this short, story driven, exploration game, you must find out where you are, why you're there, and most importantly, how to get out. What will you uncover when you delve into the unknown?

An unsettling visual novel where every decision shapes your destiny. Face seven diverse, cunning demons in a dark, atmospheric world and uncover hidden truths through multiple branching paths, culminating in nine distinct endings.
Armoured Commander is the original World War II tank commander roguelike, released in 2017 and now available for free on Steam.
A science-fiction visual novel centered on the implications of time travel, artificial intelligence, and humanity's ascent to the stars.

titre: 晨晨力量人 Adventure of Roger
description: 晨晨力量人是一款像素風格的 2D 平台動作遊戲。你將扮演晨晨踏上成為百萬訂閱實況主的壯麗旅程，旅程中你將會在非線性的地圖中遇見熟悉的人物，並運用各式能力探索地圖的奧秘，最後根據你的選擇抵達不同的結局。

The Night Shift is a Third Person OpenWorld game, where players live their Adventure freely, in a day and night circle where wildlife became more dangerous at night. Free content updates and new random weekly quests and zones will include for keep the community rewarded.

The glass sphere burst in the night of 1996. The world of distortion opened its gates and took away from you someone very important. However, in 2005, the past emerges again to hunt you once more. An atmospheric horror about love and time.
Welcome back to 1996! This shared screen space shooter is the perfect 4-player competitive game for some casual fun!

Many years ago, Emily plummeted from an attic window to her doom. Her house now lies abandoned along with the mystery of her death. Sara has inherited this dark home, only to discover that it is not empty.

The Wizard has vanished! The clues to his whereabouts are in his workbook, but all the pages are blank. You'll need the Wizard's magic pen - and your powers of perception - to guess the image on each page. The better your guess, the higher your score, and the closer you are to finding the Wizard.
A fast action arcade game revamped into Virtual Reality. Shoot with your weapon, dodge bullets with your body, deflect bullets with your swords, and launch missiles and ultimate skills!
Dark Quest is a turn-based dungeon crawler where you command a party of heroes on an epic quest to defeat the dark sorcerer and his minions, and save the land from his dark magic.

Castle of Blackwater est un jeu de déduction sociale en 2D, riche en action, avec une touche magique. Dans ce jeu intense de confiance et de trahison, jusqu'à 10 étrangers sont piégés dans un château de danger et de tromperie, avec pour mission de compléter des tâches et de s'échapper avec leur vie.

Join the persistent open world of OZERSK! Play alone or with your friends on PvE servers, fight for precious loot and gear, and risk it all in a hostile environment. Die, lose all your gear and loot, then return to the same server in hopes of retrieving what you lost. This is your story!

The ultimate block building game. Start with nothing and build an empire. Smooth voxel worlds, settlers, crafting, vehicles, and Steam multiplayer. Survival or Just Build — every item in your inventory is also a building block.
Échappez-vous d'une tour terriblement dangereuse et générée aléatoirement dans cette aventure roguelite à l'humour burlesque, au design cartoon et aux nombreux calembours. Tchac tchac !

titre: Arkhangel: The House of the Seven Stars
description: Michael struggles with dreams of dark waters and an unknown ancient evil resting beneath the cold waves. Are these simply dreams or are they a premonition of things to come?

Terry rêve de se lancer dans l’espace au volant de sa nouvelle voiture ! Un exploit aussi cool et téméraire ferait certainement parler de lui dans toute la ville ! Courez, conduisez et planez tout au long de cette mini-épopée faite de grandes découvertes, et aidez Terry à atteindre son objectif !
Circuit Slinger is a VR rhythm game where players purge corrupted code to a beat.

Intense competitive infinite jumping in space action! Catapult from planet to planet, and use gravity to slingshot your way past danger and across the universe. Continue onwards and upwards, but most importantly, move faster than everyone else!

Autumn 1881 - deep in the Thuringian forests lies the village of Rabenfels. From here a new epidemic spread over the whole country. You are a young doctor sent by the Imperial Office of Disease to investigate the origin of this mysterious disease.

Get ready for an epic journey to defend your land against hordes of orcs, wizards, goblins and ogres using a vast arsenal of towers and spells at your command! Fight on forests, mountains and wastelands, customizing your defensive strategy with different tower upgrades and specializations!

Unsafe Express est un jeu coopératif de survie et d'horreur à la première personne pour 1-4 joueurs. Naviguez à travers les stations spatiales, collectez des matériaux et survivez à vos ennemis ! Choisissez votre objectif en fonction des niveaux de complexité, puis votez.
Dolphin Swim. A simple experience in seeing how long you can last navigating a zig zag path.

titre: Game of Crafts: VR Immersion in the World of Russian Folk Art
description: In your hands - a palette with dozens of patterns of Russian folk crafts! Discover their secrets with the magical bird Kika. Paint the world around under Gzhel or Khokhloma according to traditions or drop all the rules and form your own folk style to bring colors back to Kiki's house!

Challenge the darkness with your swift orb matching skills, mighty magical enchantments and earthshaking powerups. Match the orbs before they fall into the abyss and find your way through mysterious lands of startling beauty!
Become King of the Arena! Merge, upgrade and crush your opponents in this last-man-standing strategic online multiplayer battle arena.
Russian Test is simple test about some specific russian culture in some places

Grimmwood est un JDR multijoueur social stimulant, mêlant harmonieusement des éléments de survie, de roguelike et d'exploration. Au cœur d'une ancienne forêt mystique, avec 40 autres étrangers défendez votre Village contre les monstres impitoyables attaquant votre abri chaque nuit, vers minuit.

Your flight crashes after passing through a mysterious portal. As the sole survivor, you awaken to an unfamiliar land lit by stars you’ve never seen. This land is Escario. Quickly marked as the Chosen One, the Stranger of Sword City, you must defend this place, and choose your allegiances carefully...

Heal and reload by inhaling defeated enemies in this precision, twin-stick shooter. Solve action-oriented puzzles and explore an adorably violent world, in a thoughtful story - told through shoebox dioramas.

titre: 奇幻与砍杀2 Fantasy & Blade Ⅱ
description: 這是一款高自由度+多元素+帶兵打仗的奇幻世界動作角色扮演遊戲，你將在一個有著各種可能性的開放奇幻世界中創造屬於你的傳奇，將有輕度Rogue、技能搭配、種田跑商、領兵打仗、勢力爭奪、BOSS挑戰等許多玩法可供挖掘。整個世界都會不斷運轉，而你將加速其行程或是改變其方向——

Project Tarvotan allows you to explore the depths of the Milky Way and local universe. Use your wit and resources at hand to plan out your path through each sector. Your demise lurks around every decision. Can you survive long enough and restore balance to the universe?

In this mysterious brown maze game, players will play a brave character trapped in a lineup full of unknown dangers. The maze is filled with winding passages and hidden traps, and players need to carefully avoid the pursuit of monsters while paving the way forward.

Échoué sur une île maudite, proche de la mort, vous vous frayez un chemin à travers des donjons remplis de butin pour développer les capacités magiques de votre héros félin. ZpellCatz est un ARPG avec une campagne sombre, des combats de boss passionnants, des centaines d'objets épiques et des chats.

As a player, you become Sacabambaspis and live each day with your fellow Sacabambaspis, growing and evolving by swimming in the sea and eating plankton. Progress through the story with your companions in Sacabambaspis, and see what happens in the end.
Hidden object game in the laboratory setting. Black and white hand-drawn graphics in a cartoon style. Difficult and interesting! Very large location!

titre: COGEN: Sword of Rewind / COGEN: 大鳥こはくと刻の剣
description: Rewind, rethink, redo. COGEN is a brand-new kind of 2D action game where there's no time for death.

Signé YUKE's, AEW: Fight Forever associe le catch arcade à l'ancienne aux techniques de l'All Elite Wrestling. À cela s'ajoutent un vaste répertoire de stars AEW, de nombreux types de combats, un mode Carrière solide, des tonnes d'accessoires, plus de 40 armes, etc.

A Fresh and Insane Brawler with Roguelike elements. Lead a fellowship of jackasses abducted by angry aliens and forced to spread chaos into the most famous sports events. Instant fun, Retro Arcade style, for up to 4 players.
Le nouveau jeu de rôle et d'action ONINAKI raconte l'histoire d'un Gardien chargé de protéger la vie après la mort.

Vzerthos is a 2D isometric old-school techno-fantasy styled Top-Down Shooter. Player's arsenal includes skills of the Thunder God's heir and three types of guns - use them to slice and dice, burn and blow up your enemies!

KEEP OUT est un jeu d'aventure horror puzzle. Les joueurs explorent la colline Devota en manipulant M. M dans les vues défilantes 3D. Survivre à toutes les menaces. Vous êtes le seigneur des jouets. Avec tous vos jouets qui vous tiennent à cœur, pensez seulement à sauver le monde des jouets menacés!

titre: The Edgar Mitchell Overview Effect VR Experience
description: The Edgar Mitchell VR experience invites the world to join the Apollo 14 Astronaut on his mission to the Moon and into his most intimate moment of connection to life itself. As we journey through space, we will hear Edgar’s voice guide us through the dissolving of any and all boundaries within our consciousness to the universal...

A one-of-a-kind action puzzle RPG adventure. Players are unleashed into fast paced battles where they must balance intense real-time combat with precision rune matching in an attempt to defeat unspeakable demons.

titre: Apocalypse Hotel - The Post-Apocalyptic Hotel Simulator!
description: Can you run a successful hotel even though the world has ended? Repair, renovate, and decorate the ‘Apocalypse Hotel’ while fending off zombies, mutants and the alien Gogfang!

When Night Comes is an immersive and spine-chilling horror game. If you're a fan of survival horror games and want to test your skills against a terrifying demonic force, then this game is definitely for you. Are you brave enough to face the Entity? Play When Night Comes and find out!
Explorez des niveaux évoluant sans cesse avec trois modes de jeu différents dans Wonderputt Forever, un jeu de minigolf et d’aventure.

My Night Job envoie les joueurs dans un bâtiment abandonné habité de hordes de monstres. Ils ont plus de soixante armes à leur disposition pour se défendre et sauver le plus de survivants possibles. Attention, si trop de pièces sont détruites, la fin sera plus proche que prévu.
Nebulock is a short bullet-hell game with intense gameplay, where the player must destroy bosses made of blocks, collect resources and upgrade his spaceship.

Metal Brigade Tactics is a turn-based tactical strategy game with deep RPG elements. Control your squad of Vertical Armor giant robots on a mission to stop a small country from embroiling the world in a devastating war.

titre: Bō: Path of the Teal Lotus
description: Évoluez avec grâce dans un jeu de plateformes en 2,5D dessiné à la main qui s'inspire du folklore japonais. Battez-vous dans les airs, débloquez de puissantes capacités mystiques et explorez un monde mythique pour tenter de percer le mystère de vos origines.

Le conflit en ligne le plus féroce du 21ème siècle est maintenant disponible dans sa forme la plus définitive: en in introduction de Joint Operations: Combined Arms Gold, la plus grande collection FPS multijoueur jamais vue.
Prenant place dans une chronologie historique alternative où la Première Guerre Mondiale ne cesse jamais, vous êtes le commandant des forces alliées combattant jusqu'en l'an 2114.

Woken from a hypersleep, you find yourself alone on a drifting star cruiser, light years from home. The crew has disappeared, leaving behind nothing but a few scattered records and a strange artifact that seems to hold the key to an alien civilisation.
Markov Alg is a puzzle game where you can change the game field according to instructions that are written on the game field
immerse yourself in the world's first drowning simulator
Cragls is an online multiplayer car racing game for 2-8 players

titre: STAR WARS™: Episode I: Jedi Power Battles™
description: Reprenez le Palais de Theed dans ce jeu de sabre laser effréné. Vous aurez le pouvoir de la Force, ainsi que votre fidèle sabre laser, pour vous aider à repousser des légions de droïdes de combat, de droïdekas, d’assassins et autres créatures tirées de Star Wars, épisode I : La Menace fantôme.
A small survivors-like about a space girl fighting aliens on the moon.

titre: The Myth Seekers: The Legacy of Vulcan
description: Découvrez la vérité sur l’héritage des anciens dieux !
Cat Bait est un jeu décontracté avec de jolis graphismes en pixels. Contrôlez Chat Appât, esquivez les ennemis et utilisez les capacités uniques des chats qui vous aident.
The classic strategy game comes to VR! Challenge your mind kinda like it is 1995. This game currently features the 3 classic game modes as well as a sandbox option.

Défoncez les murs et détruisez les bâtiments dans Instruments of Destruction, un jeu d'action-démolition basé sur une physique avancée. Pilotez plus de 130 véhicules uniques dans des dizaines de missions ou concevez vos propres bolides et détruisez des mondes bac à sable hautement interactifs.

Lead your nation through the trials of the first world war in history! Play huge campaigns with 5 playable nations or fight historic realtime battles. Beside of beating the enemy on the battlefield you now have to set up a working economy to supply your troops and your people!

★ Welcome to Mythic Victory Arena! ★ Select a character and face off in the arena. Climb your way through the ranks to become the champion and achieve your greatest desire. The arena is here for you to show off your best ability. What are you waiting for?

titre: 蓝宝石般的被害妄想少女/Damsel with persecutory delusion
description: A strange letter came to the girl's hand, pointing to a vicious robbery and murder in Qinshan Port City more than a decade ago. Li Meiyuan, a 17-year-old female high school student, lives in depression and delusion all the time. She almost excludes everything around her.

Pro wrestling video games lost their classic style of fun over a decade ago, and we're bringing it back with Pro Wrestling X. This lean-and-mean, no-frills Early Access debut is made BY wrestling fans, FOR wrestling fans.

Zombie Shotgun Rampage est un jeu de plateforme d'action où vous devez combattre des hordes de zombies pour récupérer votre bière volée. Faites votre chemin à travers une vague d'ennemis avec votre fusil de chasse, évitez les dangers et ne laissez pas les zombies gagner!
Lose yourself in a vibrant and interactive psychedelic dance party brimming with joyful insanity.

Alison’s sudden illness was a shock to everyone. Doctors do not understand what was happening to her, and what caused her illness. Family and doctors are desperate, and only faithful friend never lost hope. Faithful friendfriend. An ordinary little boy named Aiden. Aiden - it's you.

Command an ancient starship and fight your way to the heart of a dying Empire. Fend off attacks from demented cultists, craven space pirates, and xenophobic Imperial soldiers. Discover powerful artifacts and use them to build your ship into a fearsome war engine.

A new FANTASY incarnation of the deep space waifu series! A casual strip 'em up action game! Travel to the fantastical kingdom of Hentalia and do some CLOTH DAMAGE to giant girls! Meet lots of waifus from fantastical races, all waiting to meet you! Be a hero! Save the Kingdom! And slay some… monsters!

Vertical Shift is a new kind of VR E-Sport. Fly through the city and arenas equipped with your Zenith Suit, an advanced movement system. Your Zenith Suit is equipped with Grapple Hooks, Jet Packs, and Gliders, giving you ultimate control over your flight. Challenge your skills with PvP and PvE.
*Early access game* Grandpa is a survival horror game. You woke up in a house you never knew. Strange things happen in the house. You have to find a way to survive and get out of the house.
The Cooking Class - First Course, is a story driven short game. A rainy, foggy night in the Nova Scotian suburbs, a girl at home, alone. What can go wrong?

Dash, evade, and smash your way to the truth as the corporate spy, Asaru; or the reckless CIA agent, Amelia! Uncover the dark secrets of the Negabot mega corporation as you save the company from a hostile takeover. Assault Spy is a stylish, fast paced, pure-action game with a dash of comedy.

Enter the pages of the hand painted world of Journal. A journey through the life of a young and troubled girl as she tries to face up to the choices and responsibilities that come with childhood. An experience that questions the reliability of how we choose to remember events and explores the truths hidden within our dreams.
Il reste peu de temps pour entrer dans l’atmosphère, mais il y a quelques problèmes. En tant qu'équipage, il faut réussir à entrer dans l'ambiance!

Un jeu de tir expérimental en 2D avec les éléments d'un jeu d'horreur. D'LIRIUM réuni quelques mécaniques classiques des années 90: Des niveaux non-linéaires, la recherche de clés, de la violence et beaucoup plus, incluant des poneys colorés.
A classic style turn-based RPG. Saya is stranded on an unfamiliar continent, surrounded by all manner of dangers. Will she make it home?
Eclatez du monstre dans ce jeu indé croisement entre HeroQuest et Dungeon Master

Utopian island. Calm and happy life. Food is synthesized from cartridges. The night comes at your will. And you don't care about life outside the island. You know exactly what is bad there - this is what the state said, and it is always right.

WSM, la nouvelle plateforme de gestion de football féminin vous permet de réaliser tous vos rêves de foot. Devenez l’entraîneur de votre club de football préféré et servez-vous de vos connaissances et de vos compétences tactiques pour faire carrière et vous imposer dans la ligue de football féminin.
Quarto est un jeu de réflexion subtil aux règles très simples. Un chef d'œuvre du jeu abstrait reconnu dans le monde entier.
Engagez des soldats légendaires, vaincre des autres gouverneurs et construisez votre Empire!

Design better buildings together. With Arkio, you can ideate, review, and present your work in a powerful, collaborative design environment for VR, desktop and mobile devices. Import projects from your favorite AEC tools and mark up, comment, sketch and visualize design ideas using AI.

Vous êtes de retour dans un Manoir sinistre, inquiétant…très différent de celui dont vous avez gardé le souvenir. Le pouvoir d'une gemme maléfique a déclenché une peste meurtrière, qui s'étend bien au delà des murs du Manoir ; et vous devez recourir à vos capacités psychiques pour arrêter cet esprit diabolique en mettant en œuvre vos...
摒弃传统三国游戏的数据对碰，实现对每个单位都进行独立的实时演算。国产单机三国游戏，尽可能在保留三国历史原貌同时还原壮观的冷兵器决战场景。

"Bondman of Traps" est un jeu de parcours de survie difficile. Résolvez les pièges, améliorez vos réflexes et passez à travers eux un par un. Les pièges vous feront du mal et vous obligeront à recommencer depuis le début. Soit vous devenez le prisonnier des pièges, soit le maître des pièges...

« Planète Pacha : renaissance » est le premier projet de Scorpio Game, un studio taïwanais indépendant de création de jeux. A travers le personnage de Bobbie, les joueurs vont explorer une ville, franchir plusieurs niveaux et résoudre l'énigme finale.

Have you ever been in a robbery and didn't have weapons to defend yourself and your house? Well now you can, with hold your houses you have a variety of weapons to use to help you defend yourself, your house and take on those unwanted robbers.
Un roguelike inspiré par lovecraft. Plongez dans des grottes sous-marines créées par génération procédurale. Trouvez de l'or, améliorez votre équipement et nourrissez les profondeurs.

Play as Brian, a slime who dreams of playing golf - with himself as the ball! Squish, jump, roll, and spin your way to glory by getting Brian to the flag on each hole. Improve your score through the use of strategic powerups and collect hats along the way that can totally change the game experience.

Une histoire d'une rudesse fascinante animée par une technologie de pointe. Découvrez un nouveau système de combat stratégique en temps réel appelé « Real Time Tactical Battle » (RTTB). La naissance d'un RPG stratégique inédit créé par une équipe de développement talentueuse et expérimentée.
Cool and addictive game in which you can compete with other players on two difficulty levels.

Êtes-vous prêt à explorer votre collection musicale sous la forme d’une incroyable galaxie pleine de merveilles ? Vivez votre bibliothèque musicale comme jamais auparavant grâce à ce jeu d’arcade intense. Chaque chanson est un niveau unique généré grâce à son rythme et ses spécificités.

This simulator is a true FPV Drone Racing simulator. The goal is to make it look and feel as similar to a standard racing drone as possible. As such, the goal is not to make the most HD/GoPro-esque visuals. Instead the focus is on simulating what pilots see through the goggles, static and all!
Kinuhime est assassinée par un démon ninja. Hayate est maintenant obsédé par la vengeance! Mais la vengeance peut-elle la ramener?
Tragedy of Prince Rupert est un jeu de tir dans une enceinte de combat en 2D au rythme effréné avec un ballon à air chaud du temps passé (une montgolfière).

Talewind is a whimsical platformer where you play as a young boy that is trying to save his village, but dont let its looks fool you, it will challenge even the most experienced platformer veterans. trailer music: bensound.com
Fright Night is a single-player horror game, where you can feel the scary atmosphere and live through the story of the main protagonist.

In a post apocalyptic future where 13G cell towers have spoiled Earth with their radiation, a worm wakes you, begging you to help him get back his family… and YOUR SKULL! In this boss-battling adventure you are a headless skeleton fighting for your bones so that you can once again rest in peace!

Strap yourself into the cockpit of a robot seven times taller than a Tyrannosaurus Rex and prepare to do battle in Vox Machinae: the ultimate giant robot combat action-simulator for both VR and standard screens.
An open-source VR software platform to help people build virtual reality spaces to host up to 500 people at once. The Internet for VR is here.
A spooky fun VR adventure for all ages.
Mène la contre-attaque afin de reprendre la Terre des mains des extraterrestres dans cet action-RPG de combats de robots.
A Tale of Terror isn’t just one horror game, it’s a chilling anthology. Each game delivers a unique and terrifying story that will keep you on the edge of your seat.
Everyday life comedy, where your choices matter.

Sparkle Unleashed is a wonderfully polished casual action puzzle game. Match like colored orbs before they fall into the abyss, unlock earthshaking powerups, and conquer more than a 100 levels! Carve a path of light through an enchanting world of mystery and magic!
男主隋必安是一名FBP 探员，接到了一项异常任务：调查六个甜心女孩中谁是AI仿生人，随着调查的深入，男主对调查对象逐渐产生了不一样的情愫。至此感情和职责开始产生冲突，他陷入了一个充满迷雾和危险的境地。这是一段既扣人心弦又充满科幻色彩的有关于爱和选择故事。。
