Enjaulados is a fantasy and fiction video game in 3d in which the protagonist Sirius will have to dive into utopian worlds and save fantastic beings to get out of the cage of screens in which she finds. But is there an even greater danger outside that stalks the planet?

Still Not Dead is a challenging roguelite FPS that merges the fast satisfying gunplay of Doom with open stages, insane weaponry, tactical choice and being pursued by death itself. The unique blessing and curse system, plus unlockable skill skulls set the game apart from everything else.

It’s a humorous project about a young parent's difficult weekdays. If you feel worried, irritated, you don’t understand what’s going on and what you must do next, so don’t worry. We want to give you exactly these feelings in our game.
Firepower Forge is a multiplayer FPS with fast paced combat, custom classes and interactive maps.
Phantom Reckoning En este juego psicológico de terror chino en miniatura, encarnarás a una enfermera de un hospital rural en los años 90, atrapada en una pesadilla que se repite sin fin.

Deal with a semi-intelligent cloud of asteroids which don't let your starship through. You have 7 ultra-hard projectiles and the ability to collect what remains after each destroyed asteroid. And djenty soundtrack will set just the right vibe.
Idle Kingdom Builder 👑 Click to create your own kingdom! Coordinate, plan, build and extend your domain. Download the idle-game now and become king!

Is there any truth to those rumours of a mysterious affliction spreading all over -In Vitra- ? The four heroes of this role-playing game with a turn-based combat system embark on an epic quest for a cure – and chance upon a far bigger mystery.
Create, share, and play visual novels without needing ANY programming skills!

Rogue Aces Deluxe - the definitive 2D aerial combat roguelike. Explosive single player balletic chaos with sophisticated flight controls. With 1-4 player Dogfight Deathmatch modes and unlockable bonus games. Fly with panache and maintain your moustache!

titre: Les deux! Seuls les enfants choisissent
description: Xiaobao ouvrit les yeux entouré de 6 beautés, plongeant dans une romance à la première personne. Geekette, danseuse torride, première amour, docteure sexy, pure cadette, riche héritière – qui choisir? Ou... sans hésiter: avec 10 cœurs, séduisez-les toutes!

Wizard War Online offers P2P connection mode and a game mechanic you are not used to. While flying with the sweeper, you will experience a different flight experience thanks to the customizable maneuver settings. Make strategic moves and pay attention to timing while fighting your enemies.
The Backrooms: Escape - c'est l'expérience d'être dans le monde liminal des backrooms. Déplacez-vous librement, explorez les secrets de la société, mais rappelez-vous-vous n'êtes pas seul.

Death end re;Quest takes the classic turn-based RPG and flips it upside-down. Switch between the RPG action of the game world and the visual novel segments of the real world. In the realm of game development, it may seem all fun and games until the lines between fantasy and reality begin to blur.

Icarus, проверенная временем MMORPG, вобрала в себя лучшие черты жанра. Драматичная история, битвы в небесах верхом на драконах, рыбалка среди редкостных красот — вечер в Мидласе понравится и новичкам, и ветеранам.
WEED - an unusual match3 game with beautiful anime graphics and interesting light casual gameplay. Move the lines! Play with match3 with a sexy anime girl. Line up and win!
Ils veulent démolir sa maison de famille !

titre: I Have Low Stats But My Class Is "Leader", So I Recruited Everyone I Know To Fight The Dark Lord
description: A comedy RPG where you play as 99 characters at once.

titre: Lost Lands: Dark Overlord Collector's Edition
description: Alors que vous étiez arrêtés sur le bas-côté de la route avec votre fils Jimmy, celui-ci se fait avaler par les racines d'un arbre. Vous plongez à votre tour dans ce monde parallèle afin de retrouver votre garçonnet. Les personnages et les paysages que vous allez y découvrir changeront votre vie à jamais...
4D Minesweeper brings the classic mechanics of Minesweeper into the fourth dimension and adds some new features to it.

titre: Darkness and Flame: The Dark Side Collector's Edition
description: Il n’y a personne dans le monde qui pourrait revenir du Côté Obscur intact... Y aller est la seule chance de rallumer la flamme, cependant. «Les Ténèbres et les Flammes. Le Côté Obscur» est un jeu d’aventure dans le genre d’Objets Cachés, avec beaucoup de mini-jeux et de puzzles, des personnages inoubliables et des quêtes complexes.

titre: And the Hero Was Never Seen Again
description: The Demon King lies defeated at the Hero's hand, but the Hero himself has changed... in more ways than one!

Race like it's 1995! Classic arcade racing action with split-screen support, a single player story mode packed with 30 tough missions and a cross-country highway with branching routes makes this one of the meanest racers around.
Shot-Online is not just an online sports game either, but it is a highly accurate simulation and a deep role-playing experience.

Retrouvez l’univers de GreedFall dans une nouvelle aventure palpitante où chaque choix a une conséquence. Arraché à votre île, parcourez le Vieux Continent rongé par la guerre et la maladie, forgez des alliances et combattez pour recouvrer votre liberté !

Master the art of deflection, execute deadly moves, and conquer challenging bosses in a Sekiro-inspired soulslike game. Choose contracts, defeat mobs for rewards, and evolve your character with an immersive skill tree

titre: Epic Dumpster Bear 2: He Who Bears Wins
description: His forest was destroyed by corporate greed, now it's Dumpster Bear's turn for vengeance. Epic Dumpster Bear 2 is an action packed platformer with gameplay that harkens back to the glory days of 16-bit platformers.
Join a group of young streamers traveling to the town of "San Juan de los Muertos" to find real evidence of the spirit of a tormented woman called "La Llorona," who haunts the villagers every night.

ISLA test - this is a casual game with elements of physics. You control a green square and must collect pink objects. But be careful, because many red objects will appear from the contact with which you will immediately lose. And how many points will you get?

titre: Gordian Rooms: A curious heritage Prologue
description: Gordian Rooms: A Curious Heritage est un jeu d’évasion victorien dans lequel vous résolvez des énigmes dans le manoir de votre oncle pour obtenir son héritage. Vous pouvez jouer au premier niveau du jeu.

The Fan est une fiction photo interactive tournée avec des décors réels et des acteurs.Vous suivez l'histoire du "Fan", un tueur en série qui kidnappe et séquestre ses victimes pour assouvir de sombres pulsions, et l'intrigue vous emmènera dans les repaires les plus obscurs des sous sols de Paris.
Four exciting worlds, twenty levels of platform action and puzzle. Four amazing mini games to discover. Great rewards await to those who venture and defeat the might and ruthless King Hong.

The day has finally come. The day that will determine on whether or not you'll be accepted as a reporter in hololive. And not just any reporter, but the exclusive reporter for Kureiji Ollie! What goes down on in the life of the zombie idol? Find out what it'll be like to spend Days with Ollie!

This game is an intense bullet hell roguelike shooter, evolve and destroy the celestial army to try to open the hell's gate. Items, references and transformations based in : Lovecraftian universe, biblical sins, and all types of angels and celestial creatures.

Depths of Fear :: Knossos, a Greek-themed, 1st Person, Roguelike stealthy action-adventure where you play as Theseus out to kill the rampaging horror the Minotaur. Succeed in the beast’s slaughter or learn the meaning of fear trying. You will run. You will hide. You will fight. You will die.

Knights and Dungeons is a single player game inspired by games like Clicker Heroes and other clickers.Knights and Dungeons is a clicker Idler game where your main goal is to defeat the enemies in the dungeon.and try to beat most levels as possible.
Tehran is in the grip of fear following a series of grisly murders. Major Afshar has been tasked with finding those responsible.

We are creating an Open, Social, Virtual Reality world. A world that will have its own economy and its own currency. A VR world with its own Marketplace, Games, Social experiences and Virtual Land ownership. A VR world which is fully interconnected and seamless.

Prends ton sac à dos, l’aventure n'attend pas ! Embarque pour un périple à bord d'une vieille roulotte. Ta mission : confectionner de savoureux repas, tenir des étals sur les marchés et distribuer tes créations. Offre ton aide dès que tu le peux et aide à préparer le Carnaval déjanté !

When a kingdom and an empire collide, the best warriors are called to battle. Join the mighty Kingdom or the glorious Empire and conquer your enemies. A team-based, 3rd person action shooter with cartoon styled, fantasy themed backgrounds. 3 classes to choose from, each with its unique set of skills.
Pour la première fois, les classiques acclamés des arcades japonaises, VASARA (2000) et VASARA 2 (2001), sont disponibles sur console sur cette collection: VASARA COLLECTION!

Que vous soyez novice ou maître aux échecs, bienvenue dans Chess Infinity—l’art de la stratégie intemporelle. Immergez-vous dans des environnements sereins, perfectionnez vos compétences avec un mentor IA adaptatif et connectez-vous à des joueurs du monde entier. Relevez des défis sans fin.

Les réplicateurs sont de retour ! Nous sommes en 2528. Les machines infectent les planètes avec des monstres génétiquement modifiés. Défiez-les et tentez d'arrêter l'assaut. Améliorez les bâtiments et les héros, exploitez les ressources, découvrez des technologies et luttez pour sauver l'humanité !

Terrain of Magical Expertise is a game about a game! Take on the role of a White-Hat Hacker in this non-linear, story-driven, RPG adventure, featuring an original turn-based combat system, hundreds of unique enemies, and a full cast of voice actors. Do all it takes to win the Campaign of Champions!

titre: Sea Legends: Phantasmal Light Collector's Edition
description: After a yacht crash in a mysterious storm, Jane finds herself on the coast of a mysterious island - and Mike is missing. Exploring the island, Jane must figure out what happened to Mike. Help them in this thrilling hidden object adventure!

With the power of the Spirit, defeat the enemies and purify the land of elves. Gain different elemental abilities and various Elf`s costumes in single play mode, or cooperate with other players and survive the horde in multiplayer mode.

L'Happy Hour est arrivée ! Incarne le NecroBouncer et dégomme tes invités bagarreurs dans le donjon nocturne dans un roguelike d'aventure. Réveiller les morts, découvrir des centaines de reliques, bannir les ennemis et dévorer leurs pouvoirs, ça va être d'enfer !
Explore, fight against enemies, collect items, cook to save the paradise. Recruit enemy monsters to your advantage

Établissez votre règne parmi les titans ! GigaBash est un jeu de combat multijoueur en arène avec des héros surdimensionnés inspirés des films de kaijū, des attaques spéciales dévastatrices et des environnements entièrement destructibles.

A hybrid factory builder / incremental clicker game. Starting from humble beginnings, master the many crafting processes to build up resources and expand your factory. Then, using your newly automated production, unlock new technology and grow ever closer to your goal of spreading to the stars.
Take control of a squadron of ships in full 3D space combat. Explore, battle and trade your way through a pirate, machine and monster-infested solar system.
Type the Bible and record your best WPM for each verse!
This is a war strategy game with the mouse control.

Construisez la ferme de vos rêves aux côtés de vos amis et animaux dans Big Farm Story. Faites pousser des cultures, occupez-vous de vos champs, fabriquez des objets et explorez le monde dans cette aventure à la ferme. Faites de nouvelles rencontres, créez votre communauté et écrivez votre histoire.

titre: Mystery Trackers: Forgotten Voices Collector's Edition
description: Attendance is down at Misthill College!
Story-driven FPP mystery thriller-horror with stealth and detective modes based on facts from the world-famous story of Zodiac, a never-captured American serial killer.

NIRO is a single-player stealth action game set in the jungles of asia. Track down and eliminate your targets deep into enemy territories and sabotage heavy guarded military bases with all the tools at your disposal. Upgrade your skills and experience this escapading campaign of shadows and fire!

« J'ai besoin d'un Dustoff ! » s'entend bien trop souvent sur les ondes en temps de guerre. Envolez-vous dès maintenant avec votre hélicoptère de sauvetage et partez à la rescousse des soldats blessés sur le terrain, bien souvent sous le feu de l'ennemi. Seul vous pouvez y arriver !

There’s a fly in your apartment! Hunt it down and squish it! Damn, that fly is fast! If a fly swat won’t get it, use furniture. If that doesn’t work, use anything you can find… just squish it! The more you smash, the more points you earn.

In this short first-person adventure game, you have to bring your friends over to the other mountain by using a tramway car. But beware! Each friend has their own agenda. You have to talk to them to decide which order they should be moved in. Based on a classic riddle.

L'héroïne pirate Nelly Cootalot part à la recherche de l'infâme Baron Grandebarbe dans ce jeu d'aventure en point-and-click. Pars à la rencontre de personnages peu ordinaires et résous des défis incroyables dans le cadre de ta quête du Trésor de la Septième mer.
Explore every floors. Find the key. Find the door. Escape. And make sure to use the safest path. Monsters are everywhere.

titre: Lost Planet: Extreme Condition Colonies Edition
description: Lost Planet: Extreme Condition Colonies Edition includes everything that made the original Lost Planet a hit on PC as well as adding tons of new features.
Explore and survive the spooky puzzling world of Little Screamies! BUT BEWARE!! Not everything is as it seems at Little Laboratories Inc...

Miasma Caves is an explorative action-adventure game. You'll explore a procedurally generated cave system hunting for treasure then try and make it back to town to restock and check in with the villagers before trying to venture deeper.

Jubeez is an innovative and unique take on the match-3 genre. Try to form groups of Jubeez while moving around the board, but be careful not to corner yourself! The faster you play the more score you earn. Can you become the best Jubeez player in the world and rank at the top of the leaderboards?

Bienvenue dans la plus immersive des simulations de poker. Entrez dans la peau d'un joueur de poker pro dans un World Poker Tour, puis intégrez un club et bâtissez votre réputation dans des tournois en ligne.
“SHOCK TROOPERS 2nd Squad”, the sequel to the NEOGEO fan favorite 2D top-down view action shooting game, returns to the missions on the Steam battlefield!
Here's a challenge from 90's arcades! The ultimate Psikyo shooter! With online rankings.
Tales of Terror est un jeu de survie d'horreur coopératif. Travaillez ensemble pour survivre, utilisez une variété d'objets, résolvez le mystère et échappez-vous... si vous le pouvez !

Your choices changes the GENRE of the story!Almost EVERY NPC LIES to you at some point in the game!Live a life of adventure or a normal life! A game with true choices!An interactive story/game where you play the role of Ryou, a seemingly normal high school student in the land of Sorayama.
The Settlers®: New Allies est un jeu de stratégie enrichi d'une expérience de construction aboutie et de batailles stratégiques en temps réel.

Devenez un pilote ! Plongez dans les combats aériens de la WW1 comme jamais auparavant dans une expérience VR captivante. Incarnez un pilote de la WW1 dans Warplanes : WW1 Fighters. Que vous soyez plus jeux d'arcade ou de simulation, le jeu saura s’adapter à vos préférences.
90's-style 2D fighting action in which real-life men fight in cosplay. The first work in the series. * This work is a secondary creation game work based on the Touhou Project.

Creusez dans la montagne, collectez des ressources pour construire votre forteresse, développez les compétences de vos héros, rassemblez et raffinez des matériaux pour fabriquer des objets puissants afin de pouvoir vaincre les nombreux monstres dangereux dans un combat tactique au tour par tour.

Solar Echoes: The Star Legation is a choice-driven cinematic Sci-Fi Visual Novel game with RPG elements. Journey through space to gather and manage an alien crew, visit new worlds, negotiate with alien leaders, and even risk romance across the stars!

Un jeu solo où se mêlent mystère et surveillance dans une forêt isolée. Enregistrez des images d'écureuils, faites part de vos découvertes... et découvrez le secret que cachent ces curieuses créatures.

Bloonz Toonz is an addictive and funny game for the whole family! Try to make the longest possible words from the colorful balloon collection and beat the high score. The longer the word, the more points are credited.

Ouvrez un bar où la créativité et le sens de l'artisanat sont de mise ! Brassez des lagers, des stouts et des IPA, et servez vos clients dans votre propre brasserie. Créez votre marque de bière et un lieu extraordinaire, le meilleur de la ville.

L'Union Mondiale est la société parfaite. La prospérité est une science, les maladies et la guerre ont disparu, le sexe est devenu un divertissement et le futur est prometteur. Ce monde idéal est cependant secoué par le meurtre d'un citoyen de l'Union ayant lieu dans l'État rebelle de Russie.

Crowman & Wolfboy is a story driven, level based, action-platformer/runner hybrid. Join this unlikely pair of shadow creatures on a bizarre journey to escape their own nature and find the mysterious beings known as "humans".

LSD is the new match 3 game with beautiful juicy anime graphics! Classic light casual gameplay in the best traditions of the genre. Explore casual match3 in company with naked anime girls It's easy to learn. Line up and win!

Ogre est un jeu de stratégie au tour par tour se déroulant au cœur d'une guerre mécanisée et mettant à l'épreuve les capacités tactiques des joueurs. Cette version développée par le studio primé Auroch Digital est l'adaptation du légendaire jeu de plateau de Steve Jackson Games.

Escape the Mazes est un jeu de puzzle où le joueur doit trouver la sortie de différents labyrinthes. Le style graphique s'inspire de façon nostalgique des jeux Nintendo. Les labyrinthes ont tous été conçus à la main de façon à jouer efficacement avec la logique des joueurs.

Battez-vous pour Septima et ses rares ressources de septonium dans ce shoot ’em up vertical qui met l'accent sur une narration immersive. Suivez l'histoire d'Alex et Margaret, deux pilotes exceptionnels, pour la première fois sur Steam.
5.84 Wing - Minimalist action-adventure game, with many levels for which you have to overcome a lot of obstacles to collect keys and open doors.
sleep_mode - is an analog horror game that we play as a guy who lives in the near future and orders AR glasses to overcome insomnia, but everything turns out to be not so simple...

Anode reintroduces the classic falling-block puzzle genre, with new twists and challenges! Link blocks back and forth across each other. Match angled couplers to create chains of multiple colors. Play Mission Mode and complete randomly-generated objectives for more challenge!
Immersive first-person parkour in a surreal, physics-driven voxel world. Every move can modify the environment. Surfaces pop in and out of existence at will.

A young woman from the 21st century with sharp swordsmanship skills finds herself in Honnō-ji during the Sengoku period! Together with a trio of newfound ninja friends, she races through the Underworld beneath Honnō-ji, confronted by enraged corpses at every turn!
Shion's fellow Demon Slayer has gone missing in an otherworldly cave, and it's up to her teammates to find and rescue her! Just what horrors await them?

Shutter 2 is a classic 3D survival horror game that combines combat, exploration, puzzles and photography. Choose between classic static CC cams or switch to the over-the-shoulder cam to navigate your surroundings and upgrade your RC to defend yourself against the ghosts of Kent Island.
Le fameux jeu d'action et d'énigmes, "Mr. DRILLER DrillLand" arrive en occident sur Steam ! Voici votre invitation pour "DrillLand", le parc d'attractions secret situé à 500 mètres de profondeur !
A kind of leisure competitive game similar to guessing boxing, which has the element of luck and tests the wisdom and strategy of players.
Meet Axyos: Battlecards, the brand new tactical card game! Experience yourself in a role of the commander. Play multiplayer with your friends. Invent and utilize different tactics in a battle!

The Umbridge Estate is a 1-4 Player Co-Op Survival Horror Game like no other. Solve the riddles of the maze, read the notes of the people who came before you but most importantly… survive the horrors within.

You will have to lead the civilization, develop the economy, enhance the technology, stabilize the people and colonize new galaxies; when encountering unknown civilizations, will you hide yourself or communicate with them in a friendly way? In this "dark forest", every decision will be crucial.

"Sunflower Code", qui utilise plus de 50 images de Van Goch, est une horreur de résolution de casse-tête à la première personne. La cryptographie basée sur les bases de la cryptographie moderne entrave la progression du personnage principal.

I met her in her penthouse, expecting payment for the freelance job-and perhaps a little more. But I got more than I bargained for. I'm now part of an exclusive fraternity that moves catlike in the night through a world of high technology and senseless violence.

Destroy hordes of ever-improving enemies and their Mothership. Alcyon Infinity is a fast shooter/bullet hell with dynamic movement and risk management with crazy electro-neo-classical music. Up to 4 Co-Op players with Controllers.
Corridor walking simulator. You can walk in the corridor. Rin and Scarlett came to Rin's grandfather's house in the country.

Isotiles is an isometric puzzle game played on a grid. The goal of the game is to turn all of the blue tiles red and then reach the exit tile. There are 50 levels to play through with increasing difficulty and added obstacles.
Vous avez toujours voulu voir si vous pouvez vivre la vie d'un producteur de TV ? Voici votre chance ! M.U.D. TV vous entraîne dans le monde étrange et sauvage de la télévision.

titre: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Cowabunga Collection
description: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Cowabunga Collection contient treize jeux classiques basés sur l'univers des Tortues Ninja. Parfait pour découvrir ces titres populaires sur Steam.

Le diabolique Dr. Urchin a kidnappé Coralline ! Il est du devoir de Glowfish de libérer sa compagne ainsi que ses amis marins par tous les moyens qui lui sont offerts dans son aventure de plateforme sous-marine.

titre: Machina of the Planet Tree -Planet Ruler-
description: Join Cram, Cronos, Retla, and Esty as they discover the secrets behind the great ruins that lie beneath their feet in this combo-based, action packed indie RPG!

Card Creator is a powerful, deep and easy to use card creation software, the best tool for games designers (amateurs or pro) and fans of card and tabletop games. Card creation made easy, fast and fun!

A physics, parkour adventure! Launch yourself up a collection of biomes to reach the summit. Compete against friends by pushing them off platforms to throw them off course. Explore a unique world as a fish out of water.
Border of her Heart is a VN about Border control.
Find over 800 cute animals and objects in a lot of levels of varying difficulty. The magical black and white world comes alive after coloring. Relax and enjoy playing.

Be a hero and find meaning in your painfully dull life! Jeebo & Jerbo is a bizarre episodic Metroidvania/party-based JRPG featuring a strange land and it's (mostly hostile) inhabitants. Download Chapter 1 and fight back against existential dread today!

titre: 救公主？救个屁！ Save the princess？Save a fart！
description: 操控勇者，经历一段狗血且处处玩梗的冒险去拯救公主，途中将会遇到不熟瓜贩、立绘画家、痔疮病人、恶臭女拳等等NPC，并最终找回成为勇者的初心做出了自己认为正确的决定
Girls X Mushroom is an indie game developed by Wild Grunt and is a third-person perspective action game. The game emphasizes intense fighting.

Heroes of Fortunia is an online multiplayer hack ‘n slash game, in which players strive to create their own dungeons, filled with monsters & traps, while at the same time attacking other players’ dungeons in an attempt to beat them.

“I’ll tell you a scary story. It’s so scary you might not be able to take it. It’s the story of the Sand Man...” This is the second title in the Strange Man series, developed by Uri Games. Unable to sleep and exhausted, Sophie wanders into a town where everything sleeps. That is where the terror begins...
Just one wrong move could spell disaster! Can you keep the wheels in motion as trains speed to their various destinations?

titre: Trash Can Dungeon - Battle Against The ZOO
description: This is a sample game created in "RPG Maker MZ" by Shitsudo Kei. Keep the peace in Neo Tokyo in this Dungeon Action RPG
Summon monsters, study them, and then evolve them!
Storms 2 combines action, progression, and loot, with generated worlds to explore. Character and loot choices change up the game as you try to survive.

Le casse du siècle vient de se produire! Vous avez été engagé par le casino pour trouver et ramener l'argent volé avant la grande ouverture dans 16 heures. Recherchez dans plus de 2300 objets bien cachés dans 25 emplacements intrigants pour résoudre le casse de Vegas. Deux façons de jouer : mode Casse de Végas et Recherche Illimitée&.

Speedgunner Ultra is a dynamic platformer in which you can transform your character into a combat aircraft by pressing a button. Use all sorts of tricks to speed up and try to complete the level faster than anyone else.

Fight enemy drones in this action-filled shooter to obtain the key to freedom! Customize your weapon by combining the powers of the four elements, collect items, and perfect your strategy to overcome the barriers constructed by your enemies.
You woke up in the middle of nowhere, the only thing you can see in the forest is a house. Solve various puzzles to get to the next rooms and accomplish objectives!

Flora is a mixed genre of action, adventure, and real time strategy. Explore the universe of Flora, a whimsical world full of vibrant colors and lovable creatures waiting to be saved by Twig, a head strong girl and her companion Red, a sapling Grand Guardian wise beyond his years.
Boxel Golf is a multiplayer golf game packed with challenging courses, custom hats, and a powerful level builder.
《泡泡三国》是一款基于三国题材的2D消除类游戏，游戏包含多个关卡。卡通的游戏画面设计，动态的视觉效果和丰富的技能选择，让玩家体验一种不一样的消除游戏。

TurnOn vous conte le fascinant recit d'une brave petite creature et son saisissant voyage à travers un monde hors tension dans un jeu de plateforme plein de couleurs et de détails mais... sans plateforme!

titre: Fille de bataille de nuit urbaine
description: À la tombée de la nuit, Yinzhi rencontre un revers majeur dans sa mission de protéger la paix de la ville. C'est à cette époque que Yinzhi vous a rencontré, mais pour elle, seriez-vous l'ange du salut ou le messager de l'enfer ?

Mettez-vous dans la peau d'un scientifique reconnu entraîné dans un jeu dangereux. Le but est de sauver l'humanité et de découvrir un secret familial. Attendez-vous à une aventure palpitante dans un monde d'expériences, de mystères et d'espionnage !

Explore the ruins, dungeons, and islands in this post-apocalyptic world through the POV of eight protagonists as they fight for survival and search for meaning in their never-ending cycles of life and death.

Jurassic Clans sets in a world where dinosaurs co-exist with humans. Ensure your people thrive in this dangerous world by surviving and evolving your tribe. Search for resources to expand your village, research technologies, defend your people from predators and prepare for the upcoming apocalypse.

Vrideo is the world's premier platform for immersive video, also known as "360° video" or "VR video." Stream videos, see trending and recommended videos, browse content categories, search for videos and channels, and explore channels.
Rollout is a multiplayer "eat-to-grow" game set in a three(technically four)-dimensional world.

The engineer has to make his way out of his dreams and defeat the boss. As time passed, bizarre and powerful monsters will appear and cause pain to the engineer. Can the engineer escape his lucid dreams?

titre: Community College Hero: Fun and Games
description: Ever wonder how heroes-in-training spend their time between epic confrontations with dastardly villains? Join the students at Speck Community College as they enjoy a tabletop roleplay game, investigate a legendary small-town monster, and endure the embarrassments of Parents’ Day.

titre: Better Off Dead - Life as a Prison Guard
description: Story driven first-person comedy-thriller where you are tasked with guarding a small prison for 7 days.

titre: Cast of the Seven Godsends - Redux
description: Cast of the Seven Godsends évoque les années où les jeux classiques de tir et d'action, de type run and gun en 2D, régnaient dans les salles de jeux vidéo. Quatre niveaux de difficulté, six mondes à conquérir, douze maîtres de milieu et de fin de niveaux, sept armures complètes à l'image des dieux, cinq armes de base et trente-cinq...

A dungeon exploration RPG specializing in hack-and-slash. The game is full of challenging elements. There are 32 characters (8 classes), skills to enjoy combos, modifiable armaments, "NEW GAME+" to enjoy playing around, etc.
Far away from the fate of the world and time, deep in catacombs and vaults of long-forgotten places, the Lyratha Order conceals his existence, without knowledge of humanity outside.
Bats-toi pour t'imposer comme le plus délicieux gâteau dans Cake Bash ! Dans ce party-game trépidant pour quatre joueurs, d'adorables pâtisseries se livrent à une véritable foire d'empoigne.
Flying battles, controlling Excalibur attacks, taming monsters, land and air battles, experiencing a different magical journey...

The Labyrinth holds mysteries unfit for mortal eyes. Mysteries of eternal life. Of sudden death. Of sorcery and betrayal. Its shadows hide deadly traps, its puzzles tantalize. And from the caverns far below, your lost master, Mordamir, calls for you to save him...

Une fois de plus, les vacances de Ben, Gwen et Grand-père Max à bord du Van sont interrompues par des super-méchants et leurs plans machiavéliques pour dominer le monde. Incarnez Ben Tennyson et sauvez le monde.
Are you sure this is reality?

Bienvenue dans un jeu de tir rétro, dynamique et fort en adrénaline dans lequel vous n'avez qu'un seul objectif. Faites couler le sang et semez le chaos parmi ces salauds d'aliens. Vous êtes coincé et cherchez une sortie? Soufflez un mur et tirez sur les gogos derrière.
Globesweeper : Hex Puzzler reprend le concept du dragueur de mines sphérique de Globesweeper et le transforme en un tout nouveau puzzle logique.

A little experimental game about making many choices quickly. Pick from 3 options, then do it again, and again, and again... Make the best out of a bad situation. Do it as quickly as you can because time is the most valuable resource at your disposal.

Devenez un mécanicien de motos chevronné. Achetez des motos de seconde main, répare-les et faites des profits en les revendant. Travaillez avec 15 types de motos différentes. Développez un atelier et attirez le plus de clients possible.
YOU WILL FEEL-A-MAZE!

Steal weapons. Improvise gadgets. Evade capture. Uncover the conspiracy.The Story:On the run and fighting for your life, you are freelance journalist Matt Carter. Twelve hours after arriving in Moscow for a routine story, you've been stripped of all possessions, beaten unconscious and thrown into the KGB's political prison.

Transported back a century by fate, you find yourself in a legendary tale of vengeance. Amidst powerful enemies in a tumultuous era, your mission is to assist those around you. Experience this immersive epic from a first-person perspective—authentic, weighty, yet brimming with hope.

Ayant écopé dès la naissance d'une peine de prison d'un million d'années, vous devrez survivre à des missions mortellement dangereuses pour espérer gagner un jour votre liberté. Mourir en prison, ou vivre sur le champ de bataille. Le choix vous appartient.
ZAR (zombie apocalypse in Russia) is an indie first person shooter made in 3D graphics.
The protagonist is a cat. To whom nothing remains but to arm himself in the fight against the army of devilish creatures and become a HellCat.
Let's go! Take off and dash around the map, jumping and collecting coins as you go! Improve your skills, master your movement, and take on the timed challenges!
Avec autant de cas de personnes disparues dans la forêt de Shepherd’s Hill, pourquoi le vôtre est-il différent ?

AppGameKit est un puissant moteur de développement de jeux, idéal pour les développeurs Hobbyist et Indie. Choisissez de coder dans l'AppGameKit BASIC facile à apprendre ou utilisez nos bibliothèques en C ++ et XCode. Rédigez votre code une seule fois et déployez-le facilement sur plusieurs plates-formes mobiles et de bureau.
Fatec's Out est une aventure épique qui montre comment un professeur de jeux numériques doit protéger la réalité de l'univers qui se construit sous ses pieds.
"Fandom" est un jeu d'horreur psychologique joué par une fille obsédée par les célébrités. Le jeu explore le côté obscur du harcèlement et montre que l'obsession a des conséquences terribles.
Escape the hostel by tricking the insane clown - psychopath

My Memory of Us représente le souvenir d’une amitié entre un garçon et une fille. Une amitié forgée pendant des moments difficiles. Des moments de terreur, de douleur, et d’exclusion dans un monde où les gens étaient forcés à vivre dans deux mondes artificiellement détachés.

In this extensive old-school RPG, explore countless unique places, defeat tons of enemies and complete richly developed quests. The game features addictive gameplay and an adventure worth about 40H of playtime.
An accident has made you the head of a lawless village...
Cybxus Hearts inspired by classic Japanese shooting games. This is a game where you control three different characters at the same time.
Slash through enemies with the Sun Blade, the most powerful weapon in Shmup's history! Overwhelm hordes of enemies with flashy on-screen effects in this super-aggressive vertical scrolling shump!

titre: Tomb Raider - The Final Hours Digital Book
description: How did Crystal Dynamics reinvent Tomb Raider? The Final Hours of Tomb Raider is a digital book that takes you inside the studio during the four year development of this franchise reboot. Journalist Geoff Keighley chronicles the team’s journey, illustrating this 11,000 word story with never-before-seen art and videos from parts of the...

Amidst the falling cherry blossoms, Asaki wishes to revitalize his grandmother's beloved cafe. With the appearance of Rira and Richer, two girls who wish to work at the cafe, this is the start of a bittersweet story that will intertwine them all.
How do you see the world when nothing is real? An experimental metafictional visual novel.
Have you ever wondered what it would be like to be a bot in a game… well now is your chance! Grab Bot Crisis now and see if you can trick actual people into thinking your a bot!
You are a pilot of the spaceship "Znkl - 177". You need to deliver a capsule with important information to the cargo spaceship.
Play as Melon Dusk the famous billionaire who finally landed on Mars. Earn ShibaCoin to buy accessories to customize your appearance !

Gérez une auberge magique avec vos amis ! L'auberge familiale de Yarrul a été volée par un magicien diabolique ! Faites équipe avec vos amis pour reprendre l'héritage de vos ancêtres. Gérez la clientèle, préparez des potions, pêchez, cuisinez et battez-vous dans cette épopée chaleureuse et survoltée
Dream of playing in the World Snooker Championship? Indulge your snooker fix, and play along with the televised version of the sport with Snooker Nation Championship
RC Mini Racers is a fast paced and explosive racing game with 20+ remote controlled mini cars, lots of missiles and mines, turbos for an extra boost as well as great hard rock music.
Simple Fish Adventure is an unusual short physics-based platformer. Jump like a fish, think like a fish, be a fish! Overcome obstacles and suffer. Also includes co-op for up to 4 players.

Welcome to Laptop Tycoon!Compete with the tech giants! You will have the opportunity to show your skills in business management. Start your own laptop company! Choose and hire the best people for your company, buy and upgrade your own office and start building your dream laptop.

titre: Rocco's Island: Ring to End the Pain
description: Rejoignez Evelyn dans une aventure parsemée de casse-têtes et sauvez une île mystérieuse et ses 30 millénaires d'histoire. Discutez avec une multitude de personnages hauts en couleur pour découvrir les secrets du passé et transformer à jamais les royaumes des Quatre éléments.
You have to find your daddy.
Une aventure point’n’click totalement délirante !
Oblitérez l’Oblitérateur ! Terrassez des boss géants, larguez des bombes et construisez un arsenal d’armes puissantes et amusantes. Réduisez les aliens en miettes !
It's a relaxed, laid-back episodic 3D point-and-click adventure game set on an island group in the middle of the pacific! Yay! Hooray! :3
Sequel to Angry Bunny game. Find bomb and explode big carrot way to home. Avoid several different enemies

L'attaque et la défense sont importantes, mais si vous voulez réussir, vous devez aller vite! Débloquez plus de 100 équipes dans la nouvelle campagne remasterisée de la Ligue EPEJSODION, perfectionnez vos compétences et dépassez vos amis ainsi que le nouveau champion du monde!
Crowd control is a game about risk & play style exploration.Up to four players spend a minute and a half attempting to make the longest Mexican wave in existence.

Êtes-vous prêt pour une aventure palpitante de défense de tour de l'armée de jouets ? Bienvenue dans le Toy Shire ! Affrontez des ennemis variés dans divers endroits, défendez votre famille et repoussez les ennemis de votre zone. Sauvez le monde en renforçant votre défense avec des tours de jouets !

Archdemon Balor has opened the Gate of Hell into the human realm and hordes of demons and monsters have flooded into your world destroying everything in their path. You must protect those who are still alive and ultimately destroy Balor to close the Gate.

It's been a few months since everyone mysteriously vanished. You find yourself driving from city to city looking for anyone and anything. But, so far your search has yielded nothing... You've got to keep looking... Keep busy... You can't let your thoughts fester.

Slime Wars is a cooperative multiplayer game that combines elements of the Top Down Shooter and Party-Games genre. The game recreates an arena capable of supporting up to 4 players simultaneously, in which players must face enemies in frenetic combat.
Avec Zombie Pinball, vous allez vous ECLATER... et éclater du ZOMBIE !
A Liminal Horror Game, Run And Figure out ways to escape and advance into the next level until you eventually return to the real world
Des ninjas, des zombies et bien d'autres s'affrontent dans Smash Up !

Emerge from the ant hill with a handful of ants and a dream... to conquer the world. Train your ants, manage their daily workload, and travel across the town in search of new land. Sharpen your pincers and be ready to fight everyone from beetles and slugs, to the town police and the army!
Battle with robots on dynamic, randomly generated battlegrounds, as you attempt to take on the world in this unique turn-based strategy game.

"Escape Memoirs: Mansion Heist" is a co-operative atmospheric reverse escape-room puzzle game. You are a master thief who has been hired to rob a mysterious mansion, filled with various puzzles. Do you think you have what it takes to conquer the challenges that await you in the mansion.

Enter the world of Steamdolls in this narrative-driven stealth-meets-action adventure, featuring a star-studded voice-cast including David Hayter. This concept demo features an introductory prologue and acts as a teaser for the wider Steamdolls universe.

The egg's great adventure, the final chapter. That fragile but brave egg has returned with even more new powers, but this time its adventure is over. A hard action adventure game in which the player rolls through various stages with sad music, aiming for the frying pan at the end.

StopTime Drive is a unique turn-based racing puzzle game that combines arcade racing with a top-down view and an opportunity to think over each move. A slightly oldschool and hardcore, with the original mechanics and different ways for passing!
Nokori is a game where you raise a hero then you go explore with said hero.
Space Yandere is a cute, dramatic story experience about love in space, featuring beautiful art and music. About 45 mins play time. One main ending, others are short gameovers.

When a longtime friend contacts you to visit him with the utmost urgency, you arrive to find a troubled man haunted by visions of his recently deceased wife. When he suddenly dies under suspicious circumstances, you become the main suspect in two inexplicable deaths.
This is a casual hang - up game, in the game you can defeat the eidolon to make your eidolons more powerful.

Suivez la vie d'Amelia Earhart à travers l'espace et le temps pour en apprendre davantage sur ses réalisations et de découvrir ce qui aurait pu réellement lui arriver lors de son dernier vol. Alors seulement vous pourrez découvrir la vérité de ce qui s'est réellement passé sur ce vol de longue durée il y a tant d'années!
Real Warfare: 1242, est un jeu de stratégie réaliste en temps réel basés sur des événements historiques authentiques.
Horreur indépendante sur les champignons tueurs géants.

B67 is a top-down roguelite shooter that finds the player struggling to descend through 67 sub-levels of ever changing chaos. Manage your ammunition as much as your fears as you descend further into the unknown.

Future Offline is an Oldschool SINGLE PLAYER Roleplaying game. It simulates a MMORPG and many mechanics are based around this design. This game may primarily appeal to those looking for nostalgia of old MMOs or RPGs from the early 2000s or before.

Command your squad to seek and destroy in this fast-paced Tactical Arena Shooter. Defend the Homeland as Druidic Eco-Warriors (Roze Blud), or consolidate power as Corporate Mercenaries (NEED). Know your friends, find your enemies, fight until the last drop!
Rencontrez Billy, un robot fatigué de son travail sur les lignes de production, qui a alors décidé de tout faire exploser et tout le monde afin de faire ses propres choix.

Le premier volet de la trilogie King Island ! Un ARPG plein d’humour et totalement déjanté. Explorez, combattez, accomplissez des quêtes et faites évoluer votre personnage dans un monde rempli de trésors, de batailles, de gags… et de vaches complètement folles !
Roll the ball to the finish pole by tilting the board with your mouse while avoiding the holes. Play and complete 15 levels.
Alien Crusader is an action packed, vertical scrolling, space shooter game, similar to classic coin-up arcade and shoot'em up games.
Take a fantastical journey across the kingdom. Solve quests, collect rare artifacts, build upgrades, and even craft new items in this innovative new match-3 experience!

Assume a lead drug development role at Mazer- the foremost pharmaceutical company in the world! Create groundbreaking drugs for your customers, work hard to impress your bosses, and try not to ruffle too many feathers...

Voxrush est un jeu FPS de survie dans le temps avec un environnement voxel entièrement destructible. Tuez des monstres, prenez des points, améliorez vos statistiques et vos armes, utilisez vos compétences et trouvez un meilleur moyen de survivre le plus longtemps possible pour devenir le meilleur!
Jenny LeClue - Detectivu est une aventure mystérieuse et passionnante grouillant de détectivation et de choisitude.
Redécouvrez le système solaire ! Solar System est un jeu détente, qui va vous permettre d'approfondir vos connaissances sur le Système Solaire en interagissant avec les planètes !

Crypt of the Serpent King is a medieval first-person hack'n'slash dungeon crawler with roguelike elements. Explore randomly generated dungeons, fighting underworld creatures along the way, all while avoiding traps and collecting loot!
My Ex-Boyfriend the Space Tyrant is a traditional point-and-click adventure which stands out for its gay cast and eye-catching visuals.

PropHunter - un nouveau représentant du genre cache-cache sur le net! Les joueurs sont divisés en deux équipes - une équipe se cache en prenant la forme d'objets, la deuxième équipe cherche à trouver des imposteurs parmi les accessoires. L'équipe qui élimine ses rivaux gagne!

Is a puzzle game in which you want to build an image (with dinosaurs) in such a way - that the picture was like the original image. Move the tiles of the puzzle wisely to collect the correct order of the pieces of images
Exploit interesting movement mechanics to chase after your teleporting cyber-corgi!

Une aventure narrative atmosphérique en vue subjective, dans un monde englouti entre glace et rochers. Suite à un accident, vous devez trouver de l'énergie, échapper aux créatures étranges et vaincre les forces mystérieuses qui veulent vous empêcher de fuir. Échappez-vous ensemble ou mourrez seul.

The lands of Mathasia are beginning to be covered in Corruption. An old legend about the Hero that will master the arts of MATHEMATICIANS and use his power to defeat the Sorcerer. Only this mysterious Hero can fight the Corruption and stop incoming Darkness!
Jeu éducatif pour les enfants. Ils apprendront les additions, les soustractions et les multiplications. Ce n'est pas seulement sur les mathématiques, c'est une véritable aventure éducative !

An Action RPG at its core, I Shall Remain combines role-playing elements with survival and strategic aspects, and creates a blend never before seen. Through complex, real-time character progression and RPG system, over a hundred abilities to learn and upgrade, dozens of weapons and enhancers, thousands of Infected, over twenty mutations,...

Xecryst Remains is an Objective-Based Party-Based Third-Personal Action-RPG "Overworld Striders". Fight through randomized handcrafted stages with a freeform Action-RPG mechanic. Including Player-Like AI, classless customization, and upgradable tier-based equipment.

titre: The Dawning Clocks of Time® Remake
description: A story of love, war and betrayal on an intergalatic scale. A epic third person shooter with both sandbox and linear story progression. Take up arms and battle for the ages, who will decide the fate for all of humanity? Now remade in HD / 4K with cinematic presentation.

Mage Mayhem is a roguelike featuring unique magic with hundreds of different styles to explore. Customize your experience through a variety of abilities and upgrades. Enjoy alongside your friends, then battle them in various other PvP game modes.
Will YOU be the Champion of Legend who defeats the Dragon King?
Un jeu-récit de style BD basé sur la Trêve de Noël qui a eu lieu pendant la première guerre mondiale.
Simple but fun... how fast can you clear the dome of blocks! Built for VR-only, and it's a great game for people who don't like a lot of motion. Requires two controllers.

Eternal is a first-person survival horror shooter where the player is trapped in a sinister mental asylum filled with terrifying entities. Your goal is to unravel the dark secrets of the asylum as you fight to escape this nightmarish place.

Plongez dans un monde mystique où la gravité s'effrite et les paysages se transforment. Matter : un jeu de plateforme onirique, un voyage contemplatif et étrange. 30 minutes de parkour serein, où vos actions résonnent avec la matière et le son. Une expérience sensorielle unique vous attend !

Operencia : The Stolen Sun comprend tout ce dont vous appréciez des classiques Dungeon crawler vue à la première personne, avec une amélioration de l’expérience RPG tour par tour avec des sensibilités modernes typiques de la vieille école .
Push colorful tiles into the grid creating fields of the same type to gain new tile types. Create different worlds such as jungle islands, wasteland volcano land or even a big city!

titre: How to Take Off Your Mask Remastered
description: L'adorable visual novel fantastique "How to Take Off Your Mask" revient en version remastérisée. Un jour, Lilia se réveille avec des oreilles et une queue de chat ! Comment est-ce arrivé ? Et comment son histoire d'amour avec son ami d'enfance, Ronan va-t-elle se dérouler ?

Begin a quest for long-lost truth on your vivid journey through a new fantasy world. This open world action RPG requires and rewards your original choices. It starts with your character, includes creativity in combat, and ends with the cultures, cities, and fate of the world.

"SameShadow: Le Voyage de Fernando" est un jeu de rôle d'action à la troisième personne qui vous plonge dans une ville ukrainienne déchue. Explorez le sombre mystère qui façonnera le monde alors que vous "éveillez" des pouvoirs extraordinaires de temps, de matière et d'espace en vous.

Par la signature du présent contrat, vous vous engagez à suivre le Protocole.* * Le Protocole est un programme aux règles strictes avec un haut degré de sécurité et de contrôle créé afin d'établir un premier contact avec une forme de vie extraterrestre qui s'est écrasée dans la région du cercle polaire.

Mechanized Corps: Rebirth drops you into the war-torn year of 2361, where Mechanized Corps fight for control of the Sol system's resources. Choose from four customizable classes, arm yourself with devastating weapons, and fight in intense squad-based combat. Battle offline or online with friends!
A retro style arcade blaster. Grab the weapons and bonuses, destroy the hostile waves and protect the enesphere.

Êtes-vous prêt à changer la direction de la mode ? Commencez à travailler avec le Prologue. Passez un accord de marque, commandez des produits, remplissez les rayons, habillez les mannequins et commencez à vendre. Pour le Prologue des produit de nombre limité vous attend.
Sorrow Asylum 2 is a looping horror game, a mix of an abandoned asylum and your mind's prison, as well as a sequel to Sorrow Asylum.
The Nightmare Cooperative is a fiendishly difficult turnbased roguelike featuring an array of characters, each with different powers to help you destroy monsters, escape levels, and collect gold.
A dark atmospheric scifi First Person Shooter. Encounter characters including Jade An A.I implanted in your head, do missions to help others and get you off Earth before the Mantis destroy it.
In a science experiment gone wrong, there's only one way to survive - traverse dynamic environments in over 1300 realistic vehicles, as fast as possible.

Us Against Aliens is a survival shooter game on a spaceship that flies towards Earth. On the ship, something is constantly happening and you need to solve these problems along the way by shooting back from aliens who are constantly hunting you
Battle your way to first place in this engaging combat racing game. It offers adrenaline pumping, high-octane action and a lot of fun!
Rescue the Prisoner: Classic meets modern in this heart-pounding FPS. Unleash tactical chaos, save hostages, and rewrite your gaming legacy.
Noise Hunters is an action stealth video game where noise is your tool, but also your enemy. Don't let them hear you, HUNT or be HUNTED.

Pepper Grinder est un jeu d'aventure en 2D bourré d'action comprenant des mécaniques classiques de plate-forme avec un mode de forage inédit qui vous permet de creuser le sol comme un majestueux dauphin qui plongerait dans des eaux turquoise.

Jouez zen ! Redécouvrez le célèbre jeu traditionnel chinois. Retrouvez les paires de tuiles identiques en ayant soin de ne jamais rester bloqué pour venir à bout de chaque niveau. Concentration et clairvoyance sont vos atouts pour terminer les tableaux somptueux imaginés pour vous.

In "Skinless The Horror Story Quest," journey through a nightmarish blend of reality and hallucination. Wake up in a haunting hospital, face your fears in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies, and confront the doctor behind the epidemic. Can you escape the darkness within and without?

A simple casual game for those who like to pass the time after a hard day, for those who do not need long battles. Bubble strike gives you the ability to shoot balls with the help of a matching color ball gun. If You will shoot down all the balls - proceed to the next level.

Challenge all your skill and quick thinking ability in this precision platform game, where you are a bitrom who controller over gravity called Newton, who is trying to escape from a deformed creature that relentlessly follows him in subspace.
Jouez comme un virus mortel infectant divers organes du corps de votre hôte tout en essayant de déjouer les cellules immunitaires qui cherchent à vous éliminer, vous et votre espèce.
Cute and bouncy platformer with big, relaxing levels! Explore and enjoy!
Décollez du sol avec ce jeu de golf aérien où l'adresse est clé. Éclatez les nuages et franchissez les obstacles pour rentrer votre balle en dessous du par.

Humankind is on the brink to discover the secret of eternal life. Fearful of their existence, angels and demons make a pact to proclaim the apocalypse enabling them to materialize on earth and fight the humans.

Terraria + MOBA + RTS. Buy weapons and armours, use potions, and construct buildings to push your opponents back and plunder their base. Manage your team's economy while also fighting on the frontlines.
Robert, atteint d'Alzheimer précoce et de paralysies nocturnes, revit des fragments de son passé. Explorez sa mémoire et aidez-le à percer les mystères qui le hantent.

Last Soul is a 2d pixel art action platformer with a compelling story about a future where mankind has lost its will. Explore and fight your way through a variety of levels, and take on awesome boss enemies.

titre: Natsu no Sagashimono ~What We Found That Summer~
description: Summer vacation is finally here, and the next few weeks promise to be anything but uneventful! Natsu has just 30 days to acclimate to life in the countryside, help the locals face their demons, find that special someone, and gain the self-confidence to return home with his head held high!

INCUBO is a side scrolling platform game with a semi-horror theme. We present many ghost from around the world in our game as enemy and bosses. You played as a child in his nightmare and discover the truth about his story.
"Project Valkyrie" is history that you have to see for youself
Explore impossible geometry and optical illusions!

Super Sonico is a cheerful, hardworking college student and amateur musician who's about to make her modeling debut. As her personal photographer, you will be responsible for Sonico's image, balancing the needs of your clients with your own vision for Sonico's future.
Start the unsafe hill driving adventure in Village Bus Driver Simulator where you will show your particular driving and parking skills by transferring tourists to their destination.

The Dawning is a first-person puzzle mystery game. Play as Detective Madison as he searches 7 beautifully crafted areas for clues to catch a killer. Use stealth to sneak past deadly enemies. Solve complex puzzles to access new areas, progress the rich storyline, and obtain key items.
Hexus is a unique game that combines Ancient Egypt mysteries: puzzles and strategy. 120 levels, 15 mini-games.
Animate your 3D models intuitively in virtual reality.
Super Rude Bear Resurrection est un jeu de plateforme maso-core ultra difficile... que n'importe qui peut terminer !
Grimshade is a party-based role-playing game inspired by JRPG of the 90s, featuring a tactical turn-based combat system and a grim story of war and personal choices.

Endless road, neon lights, palm trees. The game immerses you in the atmosphere of the 80's. Welcome to 80's Night! 80's Night is a car simulator game in which you drive along the endless road and avoid other cars.

Nobodies: After Death est une aventure d'énigmes en point-and-click vous mettant dans la peau d'un nettoyeur. Une fois la cible éliminée par les agents, intervenez dans la plus grande discrétion et faites disparaître toutes les preuves. Entre, sortez et ne laissez aucun cadavre derrière vous.

In a large star field, the Spirit flies around and absorbs stars to build up mass and take on a different appearance. But you have to be careful on the journey - there are black holes scattered around the field, and also spaceships flying at unthinkable speeds.

titre: STARBO - The Story of Leo Cornell
description: STARBO tells you the story of a dead man's journey through a mysteriously blue world filled with strange messages and beings all trying to tell you a story, the story of Leo Cornell.

Pure aim training! Sharpen flicks, tracking, reaction time and muscle memory in short focused trials, build your own with the in-game editor, publish them for other players, and see where you stand on the global rankings.
Neon Shadow is a fast paced Cyber Punk FPS inspired by classic shooters.

I Will Become a Swordsman is one of the earliest works of swordsmen of all ages. In search of a mysterious power to fight against the unknown world, the main characters seek the help of a legendary swordsman.

CRYODEATH est un survival horror VR exigeant à bord d'une station spatiale qui se réagence à chaque mort. Ingénieur, vous n'avez qu'une vie : récupérez, fabriquez, improvisez pendant que quelque chose vous traque. Le jeu est dur, et chaque pont plus bas est pire que le précédent.

This is a story about the fall of a man. Told in the form of an interactive comic book with sounds and animations, Saint Kotar: The Crawling Man follows the appalling life of Mojse, his fall from a beloved teacher to a bitter and vengeful leader of a sinister cult.

Lord of Rigel is a turn-based 4X space strategy game inspired by the classics. In a galaxy divided by two elder races, will you unite with other species or forge your own path? Navigate galactic politics and defeat threats using espionage, research, and military force. How will you shape the galaxy?

Participez à des duels contre des adversaires de plus en plus redoutables. Choisissez judicieusement vos mouvements - ultra-rapides ou esquivez comme un chat - la mort n'est qu'à un faux mouvement! Un jeu de stratégie de style arcade dans le Far West. Êtes-vous un flingueur ou juste un ventre jaune?

Three lost orphans band together to set out on a journey that transcends the boundaries of imagination and retrieve the pieces of a legendary gem, all while keeping the darkness at bay alongside a colorful cast of unique characters.

titre: 花园魔三国 -The Sacrificial Girl of the Fantasy 3 Kingdoms-
description: 游戏《花园魔三国》是以萌娘化历史上著名的三国人物为特色的剧情冒险战斗的角色扮演游戏。 玩家和刘封、刘禅姐妹在神州大陆上与各个英雄人物交互。 游戏可以选择非常简单或者较为困难的战斗，大量的探索要素将会构筑一个精密细致的幻想世界。

titre: Short Stories Collection of Class Tangerine
description: Short Stories Collection of Class Tangerine is a collection of five Visual Novels by indie-game team "Class Tangerine".
明朝初年，武林领袖朱元璋在带领武林推翻元朝后，大肆屠戮武林人士。使得代表秩序的朝廷与代表自由的武林之间的矛盾再度激化。与此同时蒙古也勾结倭寇、海盗、五毒教等外邦势力意图重夺政权。
两体是一款轻松欢乐的平台对抗游戏，采用了经典的物理炮术玩法，有着个性鲜明的战斗英雄。玩家们选择自己的阵容与伙伴，与其他队伍来一场激烈的场地争夺战！
Rubek est un puzzle game minimaliste basé sur les couleurs.

This is your first family mission, you have to arm and equip yourself and, above all, survive attacks from deadly monsters. Defeat these strong monsters, collect 4 artifacts and emerge from this hostile island as a relic hunter.

Break the besiege of various monsters! Upgrade the weapons, choose your favorite skills. Unique combination with skill and role. A 14 minutes roguelike experience, shoot with fantastic and exciting experience!! Believe yourself and beat the boss!
In the arena, the rules are simple: bring your name and your country in front of everyone else! It’s a fun, competitive, asynchronous hack-and-slash parody game.

titre: Sensei! I Like You So Much!
description: "Sensei! I Like You So Much!" is a fandom business simulation game. You will play as a fanfic author, create & release your fanzine, join comicons, gather followers, and become a legend with your fellow fans around! You can buy goods of your pairing, build itabags, and decorate your room as well!
studio: LaoO Studio (Shanghai Ou Ou Xi Network Technology Co. LTD）

description: En tant que tireuse d'élite, vous devez avoir le sens du détail et choisir le meilleur moment pour tirer. Vos cibles, qui se savent en danger mettront tout en œuvre pour tenter de se cacher. Mémorisez les informations de chaque mission et faites preuve de patience pour effectuer un tir précis.

titre: Mystery P.I. - Lost in Los Angeles
description: Recherchez et trouvez le Blockbuster d’Hollywood! La seule copie de cette année du plus gros blockbuster a disparu la veille de la première VIP de Hollywood. Vous êtes le célèbre détective privé de Mystery P.I. et êtes recrutés pour traquer et retrouver le film perdu.

Combattez les monstres qui ont détruit votre village dans ce deckbuilder roguelike inspiré de mythologies pré-romaines. Choisissez judicieusement vos cartes et sélectionnez stratégiquement vos compétences pour traverser les donjons de plus en plus difficiles et reconstruire votre village.

Exiled to a deep space mining sector, you are left with a crappy ship, a laser, and a small mining beam. It is up to you to survive by working your way through the galaxy. Mine asteroids, refine and trade the ore, buy upgrades for your ship, hunt pirates... you get it.
Can you breathe new life into a desperate city that's gasping for air and grasping for help?

Time is running out for Marine and her friends. She needs to find warriors at all costs, but all she seems to stumble into is a mermaid, a werewolf, a dragon and hordes of crazy orcs... can you get her out of trouble, in one of the best episodes of the award-winning Millennium series?

After the events of Lost Alone EP.1 - Little Sister, George continues his nightmare, awakening in a house unknown to him. The horrors he experienced and tried to drown in alcohol are coming back to the surface.
Create, manage, and guide your very own band to success!

The Chronicles of Quiver Dick is a Crude Comedy RPG that has one goal and one goal only: To make you laugh! Play as Quiver Dick, a legendary storyteller and former badass, as he embarks on one of many downright crazy and entirely messed up adventures!

Survival horror with roguelike elements. Explore randomized levels with different items and entities while trying to maintain your thirst, hunger, and sanity, ensuring a new experience every time. Play alone or with up to TEN friends online! Cross-platform multiplayer with Nintendo Switch.

eSail vous propose une expérience réaliste de simulation de navigation à la voile, incluant de nombreux tutoriaux, des modes amarrage et ancrage, l'utilisation de la carte, des défis et régates, un mode Navigation Libre, "Apprenez la voile avec eSail', et encore plus !

Bighead Runner est un "arcade endless runner" qui vous met au défi de collecter des pièces et de conquérir les classements ! Courez, sautez et glissez à travers des niveaux générés de manière procédurale, en vous efforçant de battre votre meilleur score et de débloquer des skins géniaux.

In this sci-fi puzzle adventure "short game" you are a scientist, stranded on a distant moon during an expedition to investigate alien remains. After finding a strange platform, what seemed to be a one way trip might turn into an intergalactic odyssey.

Steel Armor: Blaze of War is realistic tank simulator with tactical elements. The game models Soviet T-62 tank and US M60A1 tank in detail. Each tank has interactive cockpit with crew. Player controls a tank, and commands a tank platoon and attached forces in 4 large scale dynamic campaigns.

Nobunaga's Ambition, the first of the series, was released in 1983. Players assume the mantle of either Nobunaga Oda or Shingen Takeda and strive to conquer the entire land (17 areas in the Kansai and central Japan region). They manage their country to make it rich, then prepare their military forces.

Bosorka is an exciting action roguelike where a young witch saves the world from insidious and cruel demons. Combine runes, master a variety of brooms, and try all possible and impossible spells until you gain enough power to fight evil.
Escape your captors…and endure your rescuers, but don't be late to the ball! Take charge of your rescue, and reclaim your rightful throne.

Dans le chapitre final de Réversion, vous rejoindrez la Résistance avec pour seul objectif de mettre en état de nuire le malfaisant Sergio ! Buenos Aires est en ruines ! Aurez-vous ce qu’il faut pour sauver votre ville avant qu’il ne soit trop tard ?

Did you think this game was only about saving the world from an army of demons? No. This is a game about YOU. On the surface, it may be a new form of innovative experimental philosophical narrative RPG, but its deeper secrets could make you a god.
Tend to the intergalactic flora and fauna on a puzzling space station. This short n' weird journey takes around 2 hours to complete.
Space Scaven is a physical puzzle game about an engineer, whose job is to collect black boxes on abandoned space stations.
Prepare yourself to shoot obstacles across a electronic musical game.
DynastyDetective is a visual Novel-style mystery story game set in the fictional Joseon Dynasty where monsters appear.

VillageBlade is a dual tile-based card game and vivid city builder. Use cards to your advantage to build gameplay areas and spawn houses to reach new high scores in Frontier Mode. Create colorful landscapes and villages from a variety of tiles with no time limits or locked content in Build Mode.
Hover Ship is an arcade game in which you have to control a floating ship on an obstacle course, collect coins and set new records.
Take control of Rectangle in this puzzle platformer, where he aims to escape the cavern...
Keystones: a simple game about colors and connections.
Turn-Based RPG board-Game where you can bring varius of hero into your squad to fighting together against opponent.

Kasmo est un jeu occasionnel où des bombes apparaissent au hasard sur le terrain de jeu et vous devez lancer des roquettes pour les détruire. Si le nombre de bombes sur le terrain de jeu dépasse 20, vous perdrez. Utilisez votre précision. Combien de points pouvez-vous gagner?
Seconds to Square is a momentum-based action-platformer where players draw boxes to manipulate time.

An arena-styled FPS in which you acquire toys and fight beside them. Play as an action figure - you are a toy. Toy Kingdom is in peril—Sir Cuddles has taken reign of the room and all the toys in it. Fight in the arena, build your toy team, and defeat Sir Cuddles.
Little Monki est un jeu de type sokoban mignon et relaxant, aidez le petit singe à ramasser toutes les bananes pour satisfaire son pendury.

IronWolf VR is a roomscale submarine game playable either singleplayer or online co-op with motion controls. Built from the ground up for VR, each part of the submarine has been crafted for an optimal VR experience.
Minimalist, relaxing, motion logic, interactive mind game.

Bienvenue sur notre jeu vidéo de tir à la première personne en ligne, basé sur des classes, qui combine à la fois des mécaniques de Fast-Fps mais aussi de roguelike. Choisissez entre 3 combinaisons. Improvisez. Adaptez-vous. Surmontez vos adversaires et vos coéquipiers.
ZONEX is a 3D realtime dynamic effects showcase with both PC and VR support.

titre: Mahjong Pretty Girls Battle : School Girls Edition
description: A brand new "Mahjong Pretty Girls Battle" is now about to begin! Cute school girls gathered for a hot Mahjong battle! An extraordinary collection of Pretty School Girls is waiting for you! Authentic Japanese Mahjong rules. Including settings for some famous local rule variants.
The exclusive interactive adaptation of John Wyndham’s epic sci-fi/horror novel. Investigate a mysterious attack on the oceans of Planet Earth and discover how you can shape the story.

Sullen is a fast-paced, challenging platformer set inside of a circle. Your ultimate goal is to work through all of the levels and defeat the sullen eye that relentlessly attacks you. You assume control of a small pentagon and must dodge, jump, and shoot your way to victory.

Sunny smile, est joyeux, charmant, modeste et doux, mais les ennemis rusés ne lui laissent pas de répit. Encore et encore, vous devez apaiser les méchants, en sauvant de la conclusion de gentils oiseaux. Vous êtes attendu par la mer d'aventures et de bonne humeur. Contient 2500 succès faciles !

The Archetype is a psychological-horror where you'll be in control (or not) of Archty's psychological aspects, like Fear, Despair, Anxiety, Sadness, Jealousy, Anger, Aggression, Libido, Envy, Guilt, Depression and Solitude.

Elder Sign: Omens is a digital version of the popular board game by Fantasy Flight Games. Build a team of unique investigators and fight to keep an all-powerful Ancient One from invading our world! Explore museums, oceans, deserts and more for the arcane Elder Signs that will help seal the Ancient One away.

Play with 5 characters, find the clues and reveal the mystery of that October 24th. You will explore the places and survive terrifying rituals, the astral world is waiting for you. A story that mixes adventure and terror in equal parts.

Unification is about a cat chasing its own laser pointer into an ancient black hole engine. Unleash your cat instincts as Gumbot, tackling physics and critters alike! Leap and scramble up ledges, zoom with rocket parkour, shift gravity at will, and wield curious artifacts and dreamlike powers.

Iggy’s Egg Adventure is a prehistoric platformer 75 million years in the making. You play as Iggy, a baby Velociraptor who must rescue his mother from her evil caveman captors, while collecting as many of her eggs as you can along the way.
C'est un RPG d'aventure en monde ouvert Plus de 100 armes et 30 armures à collectionner Une opération simple libère des compétences exceptionnelles

La série de jeu de simulation Farm Frenzy fait peau neuve dans cette TOUTE NOUVELLE suite ! Choisissez et habillez votre personnage, puis mettez-vous au travail pour sauver la ferme familiale ! Cultiver virtuellement est plus amusant que jamais, enfilez donc votre salopette, retroussez vos manches et préparez-vous à passer de bons...

Set over the course of roughly a week, you play as a young girl who has been living in a shelter all her life. The outside world is infected with a deadly disease. Society is in chaos. Fortunately, your papa is protecting you.
Take a Spin with Danger to Unravel the Mystery of a Ghostly Merry-go-Round!
DarkMaus is an indie action RPG with challenging, skill-based combat that punishes careless play.

"Milk Bottle And Monster Girl" is a shooting game where you can dodge monsters and break target points. Each level has 5 monsters, and the player can control the Muko bottle to avoid the monsters and break target points to complete the level.

titre: Campfire: One of Us Is the Killer
description: Campfire is a 6 people multiplayer game where you play roles. You got to bluff, accuse and persuade others via voice chat. It is based on communication and logic. Observe others and their intentions via their vocal expression. Find the killer before everyone is dead.

titre: 地底防衛軍 ～剣と魔法と虫の群れ～
description: Swarms of giant insects has appeared in the underground world "Agartha"! Defeat swarms of mutated insect monsters with multicast weapons/spells by your own party of customized characters! This is a casual turn-based tactical RPG with a focus on exhilaration and hack-and-slash system.
好不容易成为了慕容家的贵公子，身边美人环绕，上乘武功唾手可得，却不得不投身于家仇国恨之中。正所谓人在江湖，人不由己，如何才能在不多的时间里完成爱情与霸业的双丰收呢 ？

titre: Rubber Ducky and the Rainbow Gun
description: Rubber Ducky has found a Rainbow Gun during a rainstorm of colored weaponry! The Spikies love to be zapped with Rainbow Guns - so much, in fact, that they'll teleport away to tell the other Spikies about it. Follow Rubber Ducky as he spreads laser-ed goodwill in this shooter-meets-plushie-toy romp!
KILLER: The game is a linear classic action TPS game and you need to find what will you do to finish the game. Sometimes it can be tough.

titre: Murder Is Game Over: Streaming Death
description: Embark on a thrilling pixel art adventure with Detective Guy & Cleo as they solve a mysterious murder. Explore an eerie seaside village, search for clues, interview suspects, and unravel the truth in this whodunit mystery.

Faire du vélo comme la légende du VTT Sam Pilgrim, et utilisez le système de tricks perfectionné pour faire des combos fous sur plus de 40 niveaux bien adaptés. Crée soigneusement par un artisan développeur, Shred! 2 est le jeu de VTT le plus authentique disponible!
《心动满屋》是一款以恋综为蓝本的真人互动影像游戏，你将摇身一变成为恋综嘉宾，邂逅六位独具魅力、性格各异的美女。与她们一起，你将踏入甜蜜而扣人心弦的同居生活旅程。
studio: 成都萌创科技有限公司

description: Des monstres dangereux envahissent la planète entière Il y a une crise sur la planète Vous avez reçu une tâche importante pour protéger la planète

En tant que directeur sportif, participez aux grandes courses cyclistes et amenez vos coureurs vers la victoire. Fixez vos objectifs de courses, négociez des contrats, trouvez de nouveaux sponsors et faites évoluer votre équipe au fil des saisons.
Pode est un jeu d'exploration et d'énigmes suivant un rocher et une étoile déchue coopérant pour percer les secrets d'un décor enchanteur inspiré par le folklore norvégien.
Test your knowledge of the animal world!
Weable 2 - this neon world, where you will face complex tests at dynamic levels.

Prenez le contrôle du basketball mondial avec le nouveau International Basketball Manager 22. Le jeu inclut la licence officielle de l’EuroLeague Basketball mais aussi les licences des ligues les plus importantes au niveau international.

Explore deep circular worlds in this Physicsvania with couch Co-Op combat, crafting, and ridiculous physics fails! Also bring your own game ideas to life with the powerful engine and integrated game development tools. Each Planetoid is a whole separate game mode that you can fully edit and easily share!

FlyingRock: Arena – is top-down arcade, wherein player control weapon by mouse. Goal in game – to kill enemy by weapon or rock that directed blows of weapon. This game about brutal fights with fast fencing.
本作是角色扮演系列单机游戏《幻想三国志》的第二部。本作故事约发生在一代10年前左右，时值公元196年。董卓旧部李傕、郭氾势力被灭，曹操迁献帝于许都。玩家将扮演主角楚歌——一个立志成为天下第一有钱人的穷困少年，从当时为马腾势力的西凉召德村中，展开一段乱世中的冒险。

Incarnez Demi, une jeune femme soldat qui se réveille dans la coquille vide d'un immeuble en ruine, dans un nouveau monde étrange, complètement déconnectée de son ancienne vie et de son corps physique. Avec chaque nouveau défi qu'elle surmonte, Demi reconstitue progressivement le futur qui l'attend.
Drone Wars is a simple but unique multiplayer Sci-Fi first-person shooter, where you can play as a heavily armed combat drone or as a human special task force soldier.

Become a Daimyo of the Warring States period of Japanese history in NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION, a historical simulation game of conquest and domination. It is the 30th anniversary of this series and this current release, NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION: Sphere of Influence, is the crown of the series.
Branded as a traitor for losing the princess, the young knight Luna sets out on a lonely journey to rescue the princess and clear her name.

This is a casual simulation game where you have a very rich dad. The goal of the game is to spend all the property your father left to you by eatting, drinking, playing and etc. Besides, you also need to fight with the other three opponents of your family. While playing the game, you also need to pay attention to their behavior.
An online multiplayer VR artillery shooter. Operate your cannon tower and destroy other players to grow taller. Dominate and become the tallest tower in the arena. Play online or offline with bots!

Vivez toute une aventure en tant que marin novice de Moonglow Bay, poussé par la dernière volonté de sa bien-aimée. Grâce à vos amis, votre famille et vos voisins, vous allez parfaire votre pêche et resserrer les liens d’une communauté brisée et isolée, dans ce RPG de pêche relaxant à souhait !
IRFaceRig enables you to embody awesome digital avatars in real time. IRFaceRig expression tracking is powered by Intel® RealSense™.
Test your mental arithmetic, language and cognitive abilities while you adventure through Puzzle Dungeon in an attempt to retrieve the fabled Hypercube.
Ephemerid is a tiny rock fairy tale about a tiny paper mayfly. Part rhythm game, part point-and-click adventure, and part rock opera.

3D Hardcore Cube - ce n'est pas facile jeu de plateforme dans lequel vous souhaitez rejoindre le portail et ne pas tomber dans le piège. Dans le jeu il ya des accélérateurs de mouvement, les amplificateurs de saut, anti saut, la chute des cubes, des mitrailleuses et plus encore!

Astro Lords: Oort Cloud is a free-to-play, science-fiction MMORTS combining construction management with click-and-drag Artillery style combat and strategy elements such as exploration, raiding and espionage.

Orten Was The Case - Un jeu d'aventure et de casse-tête en mouvement libre où vous incarnez un jeune coincé dans une boucle temporelle avec pour simple tâche de sauver le monde d'une destruction littérale.

Welcome to the Coregrounds: a competitive RTS game with elements of MOBA and Tower Defense. Master your micro, expand your strategic diversity and become a champion of the Coregrounds in this indie free-to-play game with cross-platform multiplayer.

Décollez dans l'éclat des néons des années 80 avec VNESIS, une odyssée d'arcade qui allie la nostalgie du gameplay 2D avec le frisson d'un univers 3D ! Naviguez à travers plus de 16 niveaux palpitants, chacun plus stimulant et richement détaillé que le précédent.

This is a third-person beautiful girl fighting zombie game. Elements such as shooting, changing clothes, and shelters are included. The heroine is a high school student in the countryside, in a constant cycle, looking for her former friends alone, and taking refuge in a small villa.

The reborn HD edition, Remastered by Siro! Set in Piova, the city of music and endless rain. Guide Chris Vertin on the path to become a master musician in a harmonious fusion of Visual Novel and Music-based gameplay.

You are Bixby, an agent within the bureaucratic metropolis known as the Ministry Of Order. As Lounge District's go-to detective, take a stroll through a retro-future so analog it'll make your head spin.
