C'était le 7 juillet 2011.Au cours d'une enquête sur un trafic d'armes en Afrique du nord, un équipe des forces de la paix se retrouve en présence d'une espèce carnivore. Les créatures se montrent résistantes aux attaques conventionnelles. 8 spécimens ont été rencontrés dans une région appelée "Ground:ALPHA"...
HOO-BOY! A platformer game about the adventures of a candy boy hailing from Candy-Land.
《Flowers in Dark》是一款3D恐怖解密的游戏，讲述了女主人公安娜为了寻求世界平等，开始研究魔法以此挑战贵族与霸权，从此走上了一条无法回头的道路。在尊严和命运面前，我们该如何抉择？

titre: Angels & Demigods - SciFi VR Visual Novel
description: VR capable sci-fi visual novel which takes place in the distant future on Enceladus.
Battle your way up 60+ floors of hand-drawn enemies in this satirical RPG!
Arson & Plunder est un jeu d'arcade de type beat'em all en 2D inspiré des grands classiques des années 90. Ce gameplay classique a su s'adapter aux dernières avancées technologiques et aux tendances!

Rapid Eye Madness is a short grim & cute collection of mini-games that are as cryptic as they are engaging. Venture into the eldritch nightmare, and stream for your life as you solve the challenges the screens throw at you. Will you survive this eerie gamescape, or become another one of its victims?

Paintings Jigsaw Puzzles - Do puzzle in a new puzzle way! Advanced puzzle layout and involving game play will help you to relax after a hard-working day.Paintings Jigsaw Puzzles is designed for adults and children.

TAPEZ POUR TUER dans cette aventure d'horreur et de survie. Seul ou avec des amis, explorez un vaste studio de cinéma. Choisissez parmi une liste de personnages, puis planifiez votre évasion de cet hommage sanglant aux films d'horreur à l'ancienne. La mort n'est qu'une faute de frappe.

Siberian Dawn is an original, solo, digital card game that combines the core soul of a deck builder with the tactical power of a war game and the strategic challenge of crisis management. Take on various objective based Missions as you defend the Union against the dangers of the cult of the Dawn.

The Nefargad is a thriller, puzzle, storytelling and horror game that offers a true first-person perspective. The game narrates the story of an archaeologist named Mert, who is kidnapped and imprisoned in a dungeon and his efforts to escape.

A word adventure game based on a long-distance relationship. On high school and college campuses, pick up memories that belong only to that time. Ideal and reality, if we can chose it again, can we not have regrets?

Based on the classic Peg Solitaire game with a variety of levels and scenarios, and one goal: find the princess! Unravel ancient riddles, take a journey through forgotten lands and find the knight's way to his lady. Will you be the champion?

Super Inefficient Golf a repris le concept du jeu le plus inefficace qui soit et a réussi à le rendre encore MOINS efficace. Abandonnez votre club de golf et utilisez plutôt des bombes pour diriger votre balle ! Placez les explosifs, faites-les détoner au bon moment et BOUM, c'est le Birdie assuré !

Puzzle a shivering jello through 48 levels of a haunted house. But beware! Scary monsters are waiting in the dark! Your only chance of survival is to scare the monsters back before the jello quivers, shivers and faints from fear. Fight evil witches, rattling skeletons and rusty knights with an arsenal of crazy weapons!
Le labyrinthe de l'appartement de Colin contient des énigmes, des dialogues et un peu d'humour sec qui vous attendent. Une aventure surréaliste d'un genre particulier.

The Desert's Rose is a Virtual Reality Adventure game created by Eddie O'Hagan. It consists of an interactable world with everyday household items and some items not so....household. This is an Early Access game that is constantly updated with 100% free content.

Ein, a simple-hearted member of an expedition sent by mankind to distant planets, tries to get romantic with a pretty but cold co-worker girl. Unfortunately, he is not the only one trying to make contact as from the abandoned and desolate alien ruins, the girl receives a message in human language.
Washed away to the island of Anatol, Alcy now must embark on a journey to escape the island and find her way to safety.

Terre post-apocalyptique, construisez base, fabriquez armes, pillez bases joueurs pour survivre, embarquez dans fusée pour échapper robots et mercenaires sur île Ararat. Manipulez météo et tremblements de terre pour réinitialisation serveur dans DYSTERRA !
Quoi de plus simple que de sauter sur un skateboard et de rouler en ligne droite jusqu'à la ligne d'arrivée ? Il en est ainsi? :)
Ton héros et les étonnants Raposa sont de retour dans Drawn to Life: Two Realms, le nouvel épisode de ta série de jeux préférée ! Perce le mystère des Ombres et sauve Mike et ses amis.
Soda Star is a competitive, single player puzzle experience where players square off for the best scores and flawless sorting by controlling multiple switch controls.

Gravity Ghost is a physics game with a twist. Run, jump, and soar around planets, using gravity to glide through the air. Explore a shattered galaxy and rescue its survivors, armed with powerups and mysterious terraforming powers. Meet the 7 magical guardians and best their challenges. There's no killing, no dying, and no way to fail.
New part for lawnmower themed game series. Pinball which has lawnmower game series style

Play as Rubin, a rose ensorcelled by the goddess Antheia and entrusted with her sacred scythe. Mushroom marauders have invaded the greenhouse, targeting the garden goddess and choking the life out of her children. It is your duty to traverse the expanse of the greenhouse and slay these invaders.

La ville de new York est tombée aux mains d’un groupe de ninja guerriers, plus connu sous le nom de Union Lizard, qui a pris des gens en otage. Kato, un ancien étudiant en arts martiaux de Joe Musashi, a été mortellement blessé au cours de son enquête, laissant derrière lui son fidèle chien Yamato.

A top-down action roguelite about catching fish, fighting them, selling their bones, and catching more fish. Upgrade your boat and weapons, hunt down sea monster bounties, delve into eldritch mysteries, and try to pay off a cosmic debt millennia in the making.

As an elite SWAT operator, think fast and put your tactics to the test to master a series of missions and save lives. Summon your team of up to four players in online and local co-op, or hone your skills solo. Don’t just be the best—be the best of the best.

The Sacred Stone has been stolen. Your parents have been killed. Learn the truth about yourself. Wield Magic, Wield a sword, Fight countless Enemies, Monsters Boss fights, explore open worlds, side quests and more. Enemy Combat is fast paced.

The "Ski Region Simulator Gold Edition" contains plenty of features and possibilities: In the career mode you enter a unique and large winter landscape and experience the workaday life in the swiss alps in a completely adapted and freely accessible world.

titre: 竹书纪年：三国志风云录
description: This is a Chinese historical story game that chronicles the dusty past of the Sima Yi family during the late Han Dynasty and the Three Kingdoms period - the unification of the Three Kingdoms.
Realm Engine is a system-agnostic Tabletop world builder that supports both building and running your choice of role-playing game.

Prenez le contrôle d'un train de banlieue souterrain et montez au sommet d'une métropole trépidante remplie de sensations fortes bon marché, de biens immobiliers de premier ordre et d'une communauté diversifiée de personnages uniques.

Challenge your skills and push your limits in Brain Damage, the intense 2D action roguelite shooter with wave-based gameplay. With each upgrade, brain damage increases, making the game more challenging as you progress. Push the game to its limits. Can you break the game before it breaks you?

titre: The Order of the Thorne - The King's Challenge
description: Be a Bard! The challenge awaits!!Join Finn the bard as he undertakes "The King's Challenge" and see if he has what it takes to not only survive, but to write the greatest song in all of the land of Uir!
A billiard game for one players

The Room of Pandora is a third-person interactive puzzle game. The little man is trapped in a strange room, you need to escape the room. Discover multiple endings, secret rooms, and Easter eggs. There are seven endings, corresponding to seven achievements. Some puzzles may totally blow your mind.

titre: Halloween Stories: Horror Movie Collector's Edition
description: It’s Only a Movie... Right?

Playing History'Vikings' is the newest chapter of the Playing History educational game series. The previous two titles in the 'Playing History-Series' have been rewarded with several awards. With 'Playing History: Vikings' we have kicked up the experience several notches by providing a fully realized 3D world to interact with, a deeper...
Dungeons Forever is not just any old platforming puzzle game. It's a possibly endless platforming puzzle game! The levels are created by you, me and everyone else!
The Alliance Army and the Group Army have almost officially broken up, and the war is imminent. I was ordered to come to the Central South Theater command, and that's where the story begins...
Awaken the COMPETITOR inside you! Destroy enemies with your strategy and skills on an island that floats in the sky.

Entre les troupes d'élite allemandes et la plage de Normandie, il y a un bunker. Votre objectif est de le défendre à tout prix. Mangez, dormez, cuisinez, ramassez des objets et tirez, mais surtout restez vigilant, ennemi intrépide merci de ne pas profiter de votre moindre faiblesse.

Aliens Attack is a short and frenetic VR game. Players will have to master their reflexes and skills to reach the goal: defend the pillars of knowledge while fending off the multiple waves of aliens that come to destroy them.
Cake Shop Simulator is an exciting cooking game. If you like to cook and want to be a chef, this is the perfect game for you!
Play as a bird in a small city called Tracadie.
Gulman 4: Still alive – is a single-player first-person shooter by Svyatoslav Gulyaev.
Horror Roguelike characterized by an experimental artstyle and storytelling, strategic gameplay and deep mysteries

Scour through the fallen foundry, obscuring enemies and creatures whilst plundering to your death, get ripped apart or circumvent through harsh environments and traps. Let the gun do the talking, so sit back, relax and blow everything to pieces.

Figment 2: Creed Valley est un jeu d'aventure qui se déroule dans l'esprit humain. Les Cauchemars sèment le chaos et ont envahi les terres paisibles. Rejoignez Dusty, le courage de l'Esprit, et avancez à travers des puzzles, des combats de boss rythmés et des décors uniques. Affrontez vos peurs.

Runers is a top-down rogue-like dungeon shooter where you explore a vast underground labyrinth and face fierce monsters and bosses. As the game advances further into the dungeon, you will gather Runes, which will be used to combine into 285 unique spells.
Live empire is a kind of simulated business game that generates revenue by simulating the live broadcast of the anchor. simulated operation free scheduling

Kingpin est l'histoire d'une revanche. Prenez le contrôle des rues et utilisant toutes les ficelles du métier pour gravir les échelons dans le monde du crime. Devenir un caïd demande beaucoup d'action. Composez votre propre gang. Si un des membres se retourne contre vous, refroidissez le et recrutez de nouveaux éléments.
Control the wasp to avoid the devil's casual game

Les légumes rouges communistes veulent dominer le monde ! Seule une équipe spéciale de rebelles peut les arrêter. Monte ta propre équipe de guerriers, effectue des missions de guerre secrètes et sauve le monde !
Minimalist style, frantic time management and equipment management game of managing a Budget Airline Tycoon. Air Dash.

titre: AcChen - Tile matching the Arcade way
description: AcChen is a simple to learn, arcade style find the matching tile game. Master the 60 different level and various bonus maps in the single player campaign. Unlock new levels by beating the clock or play in 'chill mode' without any pressure: no timer, no score just happy tile hunting.

titre: Word of the Law: Le Masque de mort Édition Collector
description: Enquêtez sur les crimes en série et les secrets du gouvernement de la ville ! Vous êtes le seul à pouvoir remonter la piste et briser la chaîne des meurtres. Êtes-vous prêt à relever le défi ?
Pastry Lovers is an adventure simulation game that sets in a fantastic Pastry Kingdom. Sakura, the main character, grows into a pastry master and gains romantic love.

Tango Fiesta est un jeu d’action pour 1 à 4 joueurs. Et si les événements de tous les films d’action des années 80 étaient vraiment arrivés à quelqu’un... Plus besoin de l’imaginer, car vous pouvez maintenant rejoindre 1 à 3 de vos amis pour trucider, exploser et découper votre prochain !

Tri6: Infinite is a fast paced endless racer in the Tri6 cyberspace. Avoid the obstacles as long as possible with your driving skills and different powerups to beat the top scores. With electrons you collect while playing you can unlock new vehicles and powerups for new challenges.

Bâtissez un monde nouveau avec les robots que vous sauvez ! Dans ce JDR d'action haut en couleur, affrontez des hordes d'ennemis en solo ou en coopération, puis utilisez leurs pièces détachées pour construire un village florissant. Formez votre équipe et renforcez-vous à chaque nouvelle aventure !

A role-playing shooter about hunting vampires in Nebraska. Take missions to patrol the streets, rescue captive humans, and weaken the undead threat. Assemble a team, hunt the vampires, and save your hometown!

RunGunJumpGun est un jeu de plateforme en 2D à vous torturer les neurones, qui vous met entre les mains une arme anti-gravité ultra puissante. Avec sa galerie de personnages complètement dingues, son gameplay tout simple, mais d'une difficulté déconcertante et sa bande-son survoltée, RunGunJumpGun est un concentré hallucinatoire et...

Les transporteurs chez C&G Inc. se déconnectent de partout sans raison apparente, et c'est la mission de l'intrépide employé grenouille de résoudre le problème. Un jeu d'action 2D à défilement horizontal plein d'aventures tout droit venu du Studio Pixel, créateur de Cave Story.
CAR TUNE: Project is a detailed car tuning simulator where every bolt, screw, and gear matters. Build your dream machine, fine-tune every parameter, and test it on the track.

Will you have what it takes to avenge your father, defeat the evil DreadSkull and save the galaxy? Collect gems and customize your ship to get through six replayable sectors, annihilate your foes and fight epic bosses in this classic styled pixel art shoot'em'up with RPG progression.

titre: METAL GEAR & METAL GEAR 2: Solid Snake
description: Les premier et deuxième titres de la série METAL GEAR qui ont posé les bases du jeu d'action/infiltration et les mécaniques de gameplay emblématiques de la licence.
Show who is in charge in this zombie saturated place! Destroy the crowds of the undead, constantly looking for a new victim. Destroy the source of infection to save humanity.

Imos lives his peaceful life helping his sister Tori run a potion shop in a quiet village. However, when an order is given for all Dracovalis to hunt down the Demon Lord, that peace is shattered forever.

Prends la tête d'une corporation spatiale ! Gère ton personnel, conçois et développe des colonies et des stations orbitales à travers tout le système solaire ! Extrais des ressources, organise la logistique, explore de nouvelles technologies, fais du commerce et accomplis des missions !
Save the past and future! Why is it called the "Mushroom Age"? You don't expect us to tell you everything now, do you?
Hex Empire 3 is turn-based strategy game where you can fulfill all of your deepest dreams of becoming a bloodthirsty dictator. All without even taking your fluffy slippers off your feet!
LE PREMIER JEU MUSICAL DE TIR À LA PREMIÈRE PERSONNE EST ARRIVÉ ! Vous avez toujours rêvé d'anéantir les ennemis en écoutant vos morceaux préférés ? C'est désormais possible !
A NEW RPG FOUND IN THIS FLAMING DUMPSTER: undo this curse of toxic masculinity upon yr college campus through the power of glitches
SPL is a genre mix of fast paced looter shooter, souls-like and 3D space sim, with realistic physics dogfights.
SokoPenguin est un jeu de réflexion de style Sokoban, dans lequel vous contrôlez un pingouin qui doit pousser des boîtes pour dégager le chemin vers son igloo confortable.
Combattez les vaisseaux extraterrestres grâce à l'arme anti-aérienne ultime KPO9 !

The main hero John Eikts wakes up in a mysterious room for supernatural creatures. Anomalies escape, wreaking havoc. Eikts must navigate the chaos while uncovering his dark past. As he approaches freedom, a shocking twist reveals that he is not a victim, but one of them.

Pick a class and blast your way through rooms of cyber enemies in this roguelite action shooter! Choose your abilities and your path wisely, because you've only got one life to make it through the gauntlet. Rack up those points and spend them on even more ways to RIOT!

Stacks:Space is a space-themed base builder card game with rogue-like elements. Buy booster packs to get new cards, discover craft recipes by stacking cards together, create structures, manufacture drones and droids, defend your base from enemies, visit distant planets, and more!

Prêt pour Overdrive ? Améliorez votre buggy à vapeur et augmentez à mort la pression en fonçant à travers des paysages époustouflants peuplés d'innombrables ennemis. De l'action Arcade frénétique vous attend dans cette nouvelle version !
Stray Path mélange aventure, stratégie, FreeCell et roguelike. Explorez avec des personnages variés un monde aléatoire, en optimisant choix et équipements pour découvrir un monde caché.

President for A Day: Floodings is a turn-based strategy game where YOU are the President of Pakistan. With two weeks to Election Day, the monsoon could not come at a worse time. And in its wake comes famine, cholera, rebels, and much more. Can you save the nation in its hour of need?

Firing Vibes est FPS multijoueur en ligne où l'on tire avec de la musique. Et des méthodes de déplacements uniques permettent d'évoluer dans un environnement avec une verticalité accentuée. Vainquez vos adversaires avec votre maitrise des déplacements, votre visée et un soupçon de rythme.

Transportez des cargaisons surdimensionnées au cours de nombreuses missions dans un monde ouvert de 175 km². Conduisez des camions très détaillés et hautement personnalisables sous des conditions météorologiques dynamiques, de jour comme de nuit.

Step into a twisted world of danger and adventure in this dark Action-RPG. Battle your way through bizarre landscapes teeming with sinister foes. Unearth lethal weapons and tackle mind-bending quests that will test your limits. Stay vigilant—you're not the only one prowling these eerie lands.

Dans un monde où les politiciens sont des animaux et où la corruption est partout, aurez-vous l’intégrité de Souris ou la rudesse de Croco ? Ferez-vous campagne sur les véritables problèmes et intérêts du peuple, ou succomberez-vous à la voie de la corruption et de la subornation ?
Uncover the secrets hidden in the shadows, confront the monstrous results of these experiments, and escape with your sanity intact.
VirtualCast is a metaverse communication service where you can share extraordinary experiences with your friends; anytime and anywhere.Start exploring the VR experience of a life lime!
Récompensé de l'Eurogamer Indie Arcade award 2011, Pineapple Smash Crew est un jeu d'action intense et tactique doté d'un style rétro-moderne unique !

The Emergency Call 112 Showroom offers you the possibility to design and implement your own textures and share them with the community via the Steam Workshop. Compare notes with other gamers and build the textures of your fire fighting station so that it is ready for the main game.

Kvark is an FPS game set in a fictional version of the 80s Czech Republic. The player finds themselves in an underground facility that is falling apart as they travel through it. They will have to navigate through dark tunnels and will encounter many obstacles and enemies that will test their skills

2D Neon Cube - C'est une belle et pas complexe dans le jeu de plateforme de passage. Des obstacles fascinants et des effets graphiques. Déplacez le personnage principal vers le portail et essayez de ne pas mourir!
Hi, I'm Joseph Karras. I'm a photojournalist specializing in documenting paranormal activities. The church sent me here to this house to collect evidence from a supposed ghost that resides here.

Sérieusement grand labyrinthe pour tous ceux qui aiment les grands défis. Ce labyrinthe est exceptionnel par le fait que vous pouvez ajouter vous-même quelques éléments intéressants, tels que des zombies et des murs mobiles.

titre: They Came From a Communist Planet
description: THEY CAME FROM A COMMUNIST PLANET is a first-person riot game where aliens reach earth and trigger a socialist revolution. Break through police lines with bricks and molotovs as you follow the aliens into a communist future!

titre: It Lurks! A Noir Horror RPG.
description: Take on the role of a hardened Private Detective in this horror themed classic-styled Role Playing Game that pits you against fearsome foes in an exciting turn-based and interactive battle-system.
Lorsque ses enfants sont kidnappés par un mystérieux inconnu, une mère n'hésite pas une seconde et embarque à bord d'un train occupé par des passagers tous plus inquiétants les uns que les autres...

Return NULL, a Point & Click Adventure, is set in a distant dystopian society under an oppressive force where you play the role of Jack Drebin; husband and soon to be father whose life is on the verge of chaos. Episode 1 sets up key characters and a plot that escalates into an intense finale.
我们是否需要探求一个所谓的答案或者真相？我们为了自已想知道的答案可以付出怎么样的代价？在这普通的一天烛即将迎来自己的命运，发现关于自己的黑暗秘密，而原本平静的生活也变得像风中的烛火一样摇摇欲坠。

Explorez un monde fantastique d’océan-punk et plongez dans les profondeurs grâce aux merveilles à vapeur. Découvrez de mystérieux trésors sous-marins, mais la pénurie et les crises écologiques mettront votre survie à l’épreuve. Construisez, combattez et survivez !

Stack World is a physics puzzle game. Place all the given blocks and make sure they do not fall off the screen before the countdown timer hits 0. Enjoy over 100 levels of gameplay and use the level editor to create your own levels. Compete for the fastest times on the leaderboards.
Buddy's Creative Quest! e dua na nabavuni lekaleka, lawaki ka yavutaki, atmospheric plat-e liu! Dolava na 50 na nabavuni lawaki me veisautaka na gameplay!
A small logic game where all levels are the same but ways to win are not
A visual novel of modern-day fantasy, bonds, and a mystery that brings misery to the children born with a strange power.

titre: Happy Marriage Project - Starting from 9 years old -
description: This is a sample game created in "RPG Maker MZ" by Photosho Shokunin. Comical love simulation RPG about a young girl hunting for the ideal husband.

Ce jeu de Match 3 enchanteur ravira les amoureux des plantes ! Créez un jardin romantique pour la princesse grâce à des niveaux de Match 3 vous permettant de jouer avec des roses, des miroirs et des bijoux royaux. Vous pourrez ainsi gagner suffisamment d'argent pour créer un parc splendide.

Vous êtes responsable de l'équipage d'un train qui parcourt des terres postapocalyptiques ravagées par la guerre et une peste mortelle. Votre objectif est de survivre assez longtemps pour découvrir le remède... ou de mourir en essayant. Le destin de l'humanité est entre vos mains!
The classic 2D side-scrolling action game has evovled! With twice the content, better controls, and higher accessibility, Steel Sword Story S is bigger and better than ever!
Cherchez le filon légendaire dans un jeu de rôle fantasy en pixel art immersif !
Create zombies in your own virus lab and try to defeat humanity.
How much of someone can you cut away before there's nothing left? Find out in this chilling kinetic visual novel - IF YOU DARE!
Trigger Tennis is a third person shooter with tennis elements where rackets are swopped for guns and tennis balls for bullets

This is a game of S·RPG, which tells the story of the of Jane .As the second work of crossing the series, there is a great leap forward compared with the previous one.You can play strategy, also can nurture your favorite roles.Everything depends on your decision!
"The Last Will" is a 3D point-and-click adventure game played from the perspective of a grieving father whose son just passed away.

The Event of 2187 left no survivors. In an instant, Earth became a barren wasteland - a lifeless rock floating aimlessly through space. Until 4129. That's when Zenith landed. Set years later, 87 Aftermath is the story of a nameless orbling on a quest to escape from Earth and return home.

An RPG in which you learn Japanese using romaji characters i.e. English letters. It is set in the 1800's and is an epic adventure that will teach you about Japanese history and the language. In a matter of hours you could be speaking Japanese.

Combien de temps pourriez-vous survivre dans un univers parallèle où la brume dicte ses règles? Seriez-vous en mesure de trouver le chemin de votre monde natal, ou vous adapterez-vous pour vivre sous le domaine Mist?

(English Version Available) A classical Monopoly-like game with 20+ Touhou characters and 10+ official maps. Custom level editor, double resource system (money & crystal), electric dispatching, SP required dice throwing and weather system bring you a whole different game experience. Original characters are waiting for your challenge!

Planet Stronghold est un jeu de rôle de science-fiction avec un système de combat au tour par tour. Vous incarnez un jeune et nouveau recrue qui est étrangement affecté au poste avancé humain le plus célèbre et le mieux défendu de toute la galaxie : Planet Stronghold.

Legends of Ellaria is a unique blend of sandbox action-RPG and real-time strategy. Build a new kingdom for your people, construct and manage its cities, command your troops in epic battles and join them fighting in third-person action, and live adventures in an immersive high fantasy world.

Smash through 50 challenging levels, unleash powerful upgrades, and chase massive high scores in this fast-paced arcade brick breaker. Master precision shots, destroy every brick, and climb the global leaderboards.

titre: Who Is Mike - A Visual Novel
description: You wake up with an aching head and the world out of focus. In front of you is a man accusing you of being “fake”. He looks exactly like you, down to the last scar and pimple, has the same memories, the same voice and the same personality. But who is lying and who is telling the truth? Who is fake and who is real?
Ma Sorcière la plus sombre est une arène de survie où vous, en tant que mage de l'Ordre de la Lumière, combattez des hordes de monstres hérétiques, essayant de nettoyer la terre de la peste.

This is the age of steam. This is the time of unprecedented technology development never seen before. This is the era of science, research, and inventions. However, this world has also another side, the side not everyone aware of. But when evil and deception grow in strength, he will appear.
Dinosaur World is a survival game about dinosaurs.
Hunter Girls is a side-scrolling action shooter featuring anime-inspired characters, fast-paced combat, and arcade-style gameplay focused on reflexes and replayability.

Vous incarnez un officier de la Flak Allemande durant la deuxième guerre mondial et vous disposez d'un arsenal très large allant du canon de DCA de 20mm au canon de calibre 88. Vous ferez face aux meilleurs bombardiers de la guerre. Serez vous à la hauteur?!

Match 3 Game, Tower Defense Game and Story driven RPG. Gems Defenders have it all! Match enchanted gems to power up your town, heal your heroes, charge powerful spells, defeat the enemies that are storming the gates of your city and uncover lore of the mysterious Aldenor!

Meta Ball, and again you get into the world of a rolling ball. Only this time there are thirty levels, and it’s fun. Easy control and insanely exciting passing obstacles with a rolling ball. Go around and jump over obstacles using only a mouse and a keyboard.

Partez à l'aventure en solo ou avec vos amis et jouez jusqu'à 4 joueurs. Coordonnez vos actions avec celles de votre équipe pour venir en aide aux victimes des catastrophes. Ne relâchez pas votre vigilance : votre réussite dépend de vos choix, alors sauvez autant de vies que possible !

Kaamos est un petit puzzle roguelike au tour par tour dans lequel les batailles se déroulent en faisant correspondre des tuiles sur une grille avec des lignes et des colonnes en boucle. Construisez votre personnage et votre jeu de tuiles en pillant l'équipement de vos ennemis.
Parkour Game is fun platformer game where you can parkour around amazing world with fitting sound track.

titre: Breath of Death VII: The Beginning: Reanimated
description: The fast-paced supernatural RPG, Breath of Death VII, has been resurrected and remastered! Embark with our undead heroes on a bone-rattling post-apocalyptic adventure through an undead world, now more vibrant than ever, to exhume the mysteries of the past.
Unravel the mystery of White Haven!
Choose One of 4 Aircrafts and start to fight against Unique Boss Enemies.

Mya of the Desert is a Puzzle Platforming game where you use earth manipulating powers, or Geomancy, to overcome obstacles, solve puzzles, and defeat foes. Elevate pillars of earth and bend rocks to your will as Mya, a desert wanderer, as she returns life to the world around her!

High in the clouds, a storm is brewing. Join the mayhem with up to 4 players in this tactical VR action game. Obliterate your foes with futuristic weapons and bring their base down around them with old fashioned artillery!

titre: Crazy The Clown's Balloon Animal Massacre
description: Crazy the Clown used to be the only one at the circus who made balloon animals for the kids. And then everything changed. Crazy told them all, more than once. He told them not to set up a balloon animal factory at the circus... but no one would listen.

Une histoire courte d'horreur psychologique. Parcourez la nature sauvage et intacte de la campagne galloise à la découverte des vestiges oubliés d'un bâtiment mystérieux et levez le voile sur la disparition des villageois de Hearth.
A hard-hitting simultaneous-turn-based tactical game from the creators of Frozen Synapse. Defeat your opponent’s plans on a randomly-generated playfield in this brutal futuresport.

Cités Millénaires VR (extrait de l'exposition présentée à Paris) ressuscite six monuments historiques. Evoluez au cœur de ces anciens sites et ressentez la splendeur majesteuse de ces lieux dont la préservation apparaît alors comme un enjeu crucial.

Read Only Memories: NEURODIVER est la suite palpitante de 2064: Read Only Memories. Vous incarnez une jeune aruspice chargée d'explorer ce monde en point-and-click à la recherche d'un mystérieux adversaire caché dans dans les souvenirs de la population.

Bishōjo Visual Novel advised by Japanese charismatic editor of young-adult fiction, Kazuma Miki. Welcome to Mikage Academy, they accept only students with Talents – special powers that border on magic, granted by the divine, said to only occur in one in every ten thousand people by the time they reach adolescence.
A relaxing puzzle game. Turn on each board by connecting all magnetic pieces to it.

Finish the hunt in this epic finale to the Turok Trilogy. Pick up immediately after the events of Turok 2: Seeds of Evil, with dual protagonists Joseph and Danielle Fireseed, of the Turok family tree, as they battle the titular antagonist Oblivion and its followers, the Flesh Eaters.

Tear of Titans is a singleplayer third person shooter bullet hell. Dodge complex bullet patterns through precision movement, dashing, and jumping to avoid an onslaught of enemy attacks. Defeat the Titans in this science fantasy boss rush adventure.

You play as Michael, an 18-Year-old College Student, who had gone camping with his friends over the weekend, although, unfortunately for them, it turned from a peaceful getaway to a fight for survival.
Face the end of the world in the sequel to The Wizards. The critically acclaimed VR spellcaster returns with a gesture-based system, challenging enemies, grand adventure, and the ever-witty narrator.
A classical FPS based on movement filled with metroidvania elements and power ups to find by exploring the interconnected levels.

PinYuAn Tales is a AVG with thematic elements of weirdness and sidekick adventures. After Bai Qiming is laid off from his company, he starts to conduct psychic live broadcasting activities, and during one of the broadcasts, he meets a strange young man, and the story of the two of them unfolds.

Runbow est désormais disponible sur Steam dans toute sa démence à 9 joueurs !Avec des tas de modes compétitifs pouvant accueillir jusqu'à 9 joueurs --localement et en ligne-- et un mode Aventure solo génial, Runbow est le jeu de plateforme démentiel basé sur les couleurs que vous attendiez.

Grav Blazer is an arcade space shooter with a focus on fast paced action. Skill based firing mechanics, rotational controlled power attacks, increasing level difficulty, and endless procedurally generated levels are some of the features players will experience.

titre: Pixel Devil and the Broken Cartridge
description: Classic platformer in the style of Pixel-art. The main character goes to the world of 8-bit games to save his girlfriend. Help him to find new abilities and find out who is behind the abduction of the girl.

Infernis Prime is a mining colony in the Outer Rim, under brutal occupation. With the help of a hacked android and the discovery of a dark secret, the rebels finally have a chance. This is the story of how the Outer Rim Coalition formed, and how they broke free...

As a RPG type TD game,player will be playing as the DEAD Knight. Defending the kindom,even the whole world from the catastrophe brought by the Devil Lord-Zypheria Die with glory on the battlefield,or Survive to the end of the doom?It's all on you !
Frigore takes place in 1995 on a post winter Soviet nation. An indie survival horror game now revamped.
Help Robbe reclaim his memories in this 2D, dungeon platformer. Search spike-filled dungeons for the exit, unlock memories, face his darkest fears - and maybe some of your own!

Manage your dream nightclub in Party Hard Tycoon, a business simulation game where you're tasked with throwing the most profitable party ever. It takes place in the same universe as tinyBuild's 2015 hit Party Hard.
A travel-sim with strategic gameplay and rogue-lite elements. Play as travelers in ancient China. Experience great views on various locations. Write travel literature that long lives in history.

Gunstorm est un jeu de tir spatial chargé de jouabilité. Vague après vague, des vaisseaux extraterrestres attaquent votre vaisseau agile. Utilisez la souris pour contrôler votre vaisseau à la vitesse de la pensée dans un jeu qui commence facilement et devient progressivement plus difficile.

Try to survive in these endless corridors and mazes, sometimes they seem the same, sometimes they seem completely different, and what if you are already going crazy? Can you survive here? You will need to look for supplies by type of water and food

Warman est un jeu d'action-aventure savamment distillé. Peu importe l'intrigue et les choix moraux : Créez votre héros et partez à la conquête d'un vaste monde procédural. Gonflez votre inventaire et vos stats, puis partez chercher de nouveaux défis, seul ou jusqu’à sept !
Run and jump! And hit the evil! Geisha stand up to unravel the mystery of Kyoto!

Incarnez un ancien guerrier chargé d'allumer les balises scellées de son Ordre millénaire. Évitez la catastrophe imminente et résolvez 50 énigmes différentes en aidant la Déesse de Jade à purifier le pays des flammes maudites du fléau.
This is a sample game created in "RPG Maker MZ" by Eiji Egenesta. Fight your way through horde of robots in this puzzle/RPG.

Betrayed by the calculated cruelty of an evil corporation, Josephine finds herself homeless, jobless and without a heart. With nothing to lose, she joins a ragtag group of rebels seeking vengeance. Choose a love interest and let them guide Josephine's heart in this capitalist hellscape.

Plongez dans une aventure originale et défiez les forces du mal dans des batailles stratégiques et bourrées d’action, où votre sens tactique fera la différence. Avec un gameplay intuitif et innovant, invoquez et contrôlez des armées de 100 Gardiens.
Play the piano, play the flute, and enjoy a ghost story as you use the profits from your street performances to buy new instruments and furniture! Let's shoot for fame and fortune!

titre: Marcella Moon: Secret on the Hill
description: Follow amateur sleuth Marcella Moon to Ireland to investigate the disappearance of a famous writer.

The loop room is a horror game from the first person point of view, and the goal is to operate 5 panels in 100 repeated rooms and escape to the emergency exit. Run away from the endless room through various equipment and items.
Fall in love with the lab members all over again in this sweet and slapstick romantic comedy!
Évadez-vous au grand air depuis votre canapé avec Laid-Back Camp - Virtual -
Slaughter hordes of zombies and challenging bosses in Bodyrain: a zombie FPS game! Accumulate money to acquire new weapons and gain experience to strengthen your character and clean up Dawn City!

titre: Business War : Simulation de bac à sable ERP
description: Un cours obligatoire à l'École de gestion économique de l'Université, un jeu de simulation ultra hardcore. Vous incarnerez le Président d'une start - up, vous engagerez dans la concurrence sur le marché et utiliserez des ressources limitées pour permettre à votre propre entreprise de survivre à la concurrence féroce du marché.

Once upon a time, there was a miserable girl in a crimson hood. Her mother was unwell, so the girl was sent away to go stay with her grandmother, who lived deep within the woods in a strange house. People say that around those parts there resides a monster called the Gobbler, who preys on the weak...

Prenez part à des combats de magie en 4 contre 4 et utilisez toutes sortes de sorts pour vaincre l'équipe opposée. Endossez un rôle parmi quatre et servez-vous des avantages et de vos sorts pour coopérer avec vos coéquipiers et remporter le combat!
Warriors of Titus is a first-person MOBA (Mutliplayer Online Battle Arena)for VR. Finally you can be immersed in a MOBA as you battle to reclaim Titus.

Vibrant Venture is a singleplayer 2D adventure platformer game featuring a quirky cast of characters! The game features four playable characters with multiple unique abilities that can be combined for extremely versatile, fluid and fun movement!

Finally, modern lightguns have become available for the PC that bring back the classic feeling of aiming down the sights. It’s time for the games to catch up! 25 lightgun challenges. Turn-based multiplayer. Online challenges and leaderboards. Customizable targets.
A Boy and His Beard is a fast-paced beard fighting experience that lets you steal the beards of your enemies! Survive waves of bearded foes as you collect as many beards and achievements as possible!

Mio is an adventurer who dived into a dungeon, dreaming of getting rich. She falls into a pit and, battered and bruised, obtains a holy sword called Aphrodite. However, the holy sword is a magical sword with special powers.
PropHunt est un jeu dans lequel vous devez devenir un accessoire ou un chasseur.

Partez à la recherche de Dyeus dans un monde ouvert primitif et cryptique ! Affrontez de mystérieux assaillants dans d'intenses et rapide combats à l'épée, et survivez face à une faune carnassière. Découvrirez-vous la vérité sur Dyeus ?
What if you could enter an object in a level and find a level inside of it? What if you could enter an object in that level and find another level inside of that?

Reap souls by besting your foes in turn-based combat, then summon them to fight by your side! Arrange souls on a 3x3 grid for battle, or attach them to loot pieces to amplify their effects! Travel through The Vault in search for rare treasure, and slay the impostors claiming to be the Soul Reaper!
Élevez une fille mystérieuse et décidez de son destin dans cette époustouflante simulation de roman vidéoludique !
Avec l'aide de ses anciens amis, ainsi que de nouveaux, Jesse se lance dans une nouvelle aventure remplie de choix difficiles, de bon temps et au moins un Llama capricieux.

Raimodula is a fast-paced arcade platformer featuring customizable characters and randomized stage layouts. Unlock abilities, battle modular enemies, and explore surreal environments through intense and polished gameplay!

An rts 1v1 battle game, the background is the sandbox simulation of modern military warfare. You can command the coordinated operations of sea, land, air and space, play tactics freely, and experience military art, to fight until the enemy's capital is destroyed to win;
Experience psychedelic and mesmerizing visuals by transforming music into equations that render into a limitless array of user-contributed visualizations.
Monster Killer - shooter, controlling the sight help the monster hunter, clear all the locations.
Découvrez une contrée oubliée dans les nuages !

Claritas est un RPG de donjon en 2D, au tour par tour, axé sur la formation d'une équipe. Assemblez votre équipe à partir de personnages divers avec des capacités uniques. Combattez à travers des donjons difficiles, gagnez de l'expérience et des butins pendant que vous vous préparez pour le test ultime de vos compétences.
Build a snowman to keep the monster at bay and throw snowballs to defend yourself in this Christmas horror game!
Rubber & Lead is a 2D Top Down Vehicle Combat RPG- Shoot your way through post-apocalyptic Arizona. Go on missions, upgrade your cars, equip your weapons, and blast away your enemies!
Perdition is a single player, first-person shooter with visceral, fast-paced combat and environmental storytelling. A story of vengeance, vindication, and survival. A story of closure.

In the waning years of the Northern Wei Dynasty, a rumor circulates about a stone statue that bestows blessings in the mortal realm. Lured by the rumor, Anu and Chu Qingqing, a Xianbei General and her Han captive, are led to Dunhuang to face their fates.

Onset is an open world Lua scripting sandbox without predefined goals. Choose from hundreds of Lua functions from our Developer Wiki to create your own scripts and gamemodes. Onset is a perfect starting point for beginners interested in learning how to program.
Outpost engineer is a first person factory automation game set on a volcanic island. Build your base, dig into the terrain, use assembly lines to automate production. Explore, study and catalogue.
"The Men of Yoshiwara" is a popular romance game for women. At the end, to whom is it that you will be talking of love? Vocal opening song/English text

In front of you are cards with different "delicious" images. The images are hidden from you. You need to find all pairs of identical images. You can open two cards at the same time. Remember the pictures, look for their pairs, and try to use as few attempts as possible.

L'expérience ultime de chasse virtuelle est de retour avec ce nouvel opusPlongez au cœur de l'action. Fini les attentes interminables dans la forêt... et puis vous ne risquez pas de rentrer bredouille. A vous les trophées et les tableaux de chasse exceptionnelsRepérez votre proie rapidement et plongez dans l'action !

Hostil est un conte interactif plein d'émotion relatant l'histoire d'un jeune astronaute s'écrasant sur une planète inconnue et pleine de dangers. Personne ne viendra à son secours, et son seul espoir est l'exploration.
Four Robots with similar intelligence, their purpose is to eliminate each other and they will do whatever it takes to do that. Four teams, the last team standing wins. Do want to join the show?

Pilotes, équipes et circuits de la saison MotoGP™ 2014 sont regroupés dans un jeu vidéo unique et complet. Avec MotoGP™14 Compact, vous trouverez des modes de jeu toujours plus passionnants pour défier vos amis sur la piste, et aussi en ligne !

Uncover the dark past of an orphanage, gather clues and evidence, solve puzzles, and unveil the truth in a gripping suspense game. Your main mission is to unravel the mystery. Get ready for shocking revelations as you immerse yourself in the intriguing and chilling atmosphere.
When the evil empire Flosein invades her kingdom, princess Eris manages to escape with her life. Seeing her castle burn, she vows to retake her beloved kingdom no matter the cost.

Those Chosen By God Is a story driven, text heavy rpg that's more story than gameplay. It follows the life of Aden. (Pronounced in game as /ah, den/ ) Born into an appalling void known as the world. Aden must fight both mentally and physically If he wishes to survive the cruelty thrown at him.

titre: 天岚行 - Through the Mist and Sky
description: Between the Kingdoms of Fenn and Leceron sits the narrow neutral zone Mount Aer. With heroes, mystical beasts, and the surrounding legends, the mountain has attracted all but the most mundane, yet has veiled itself from the world, with nothing known except the countless myths.

titre: Rome Reborn: The Basilica of Maxentius
description: In this fully immersive application that supports free roaming, the Rome Reborn team is proud to host Beth Harris and Steven Zucker of Smarthistory, who present the Basilica of Maxentius and Constantine (also known as the Basilica Nova).

titre: Adventures of Bertram Fiddle 2: A Bleaker Predicklement
description: Nous sommes en 1884 et le Londres de l'ère victorienne s'apprête à devenir le théâtre de la plus grande aventure qui ait jamais été contée... Avec ses énigmes retorses, son look dessin animé et ses jeux de mots capillotractés, Une bien fâcheuse situation a tout ce qu'il faut pour vous émerveiller !

Deer Man is a short Interactive Storytelling experience. You play as Jacob's memory, where you will have an incredible encounter with Deer Man & the dark side of his love for the wildlife. If you love animals, this is for you!
Furious Angels is a brutal score attack shooter with different waves each day. Compete on the leaderboards, transform into a flying tank and shred the skies to pieces!
Mystery detective with eye-catching pixel art graphics. Gather clues, solve riddles, and collect unexpected and interesting game endings!

Max and his girlfriend Ann are very happy together. They have no arguments, they enjoy spending time with each other, they are in love. What else can they wish? Well, Max, you will get a big surprise this evening...

titre: Sir! I'd Like To Report A Bug!
description: Bust some bugs and save the world with the most average of heroes in this retro style platformer! Overcome obstacles such as killer cars, lava floors and one seriously @!&#^% off sun, tackle the horrors of the daily commute but with more fire and randomness.

Aureve is content with making tapestries with her master—but when he dies, his family sells her to a reclusive buyer. Thrown into a world of other androids, she must find her place and above all, answer the question: how does one weave a new identity when the strings to the old have been cut?

Turn on your ghost detector and join your new pals in a funny, thrilling, and lovingly-presented interactive text adventure. Brain-teasing puzzles, a cartoon visual style, and engaging audio design - Delete After Reading weaves a delightful interactive tale.

Conte artistique né sous le signe de la coopération, Blanc suit les aventures d'un louveteau et d'un faon livrés à eux-mêmes au milieu d'une nature vaste et enneigée. Une alliance improbable devra alors naître s'ils veulent rejoindre leur famille respective.
Dr. Frank's Build-A-Boyfriend is a comedy BL visual-novel mixed with point-and-click adventure elements.

Fat Prisoner Simulator - a soccer simulator where you play the role of a prisoner. The jail managers have noticed that some prisoners, who really like to eat a lot, can hardly go through the doors, including those of their cells. So they decided to arrange a soccer game between them.
Metroidvania style action/platformer with tons of abilities, enemies and exploration.
A challenging puzzle-platformer where each jump is a puzzle!

"Blades of Jianghu: Ballad of Wind and Dust" is a single-player game that combines text adventure with turn-based combat and exploration. As someone aspiring to become a great hero, your journey through the martial arts world will not always be a solo endeavor.
Les créateurs de RIDE frappent à nouveau avec un spin-off dédié à la légendaire marque Ducati – près d'un siècle de légende contenu dans un jeu-vidéo !

Crash Override is a randomly generated action shooter with roguelike mechanics. Surf the cybernet as a hacker for hire trying to save the cybernet from a mysterious threat. Power up before the crash wave erases everything. Gain reputation, secure contracts, salvage data, upgrade, and survive.
From acclaimed boardgame designer Glenn Drover, a grand strategy game where you take the role of Napoleon Bonaparte and attempt to dominate the entire continent of Europe.
Who is This Man is an spy game with privacy and hiding. Secretly infiltrate his target's house and miss his stuff. Report them later. Buy new agent equipment
Nami - a perfect student - accepts a "special award" on her Graduation Day - but suddenly finds herself facing the horrors of a one-day nightmare.

Virtual Circuit Board is the sandbox drawing-based logic simulator where you can build, program, decorate, and simulate anything from simple monochrome circuits to complex and colorful computers. Play with digital logic in this sandbox-only experience.

Hello Professor Watts here and I have some research to do on memory skills. I have assembled a wide variety of cats to put our memory to the test. We can see how we're doing by completing matches in a specific amount of time and earning points to track our overall progress.

Telophase is a twin-stick dungeon crawler, set in Ancient Egypt. You must project and recall your character's soul in order to damage enemies, in the hopes of overthrowing Anubis, Lord of the Underworld.
For the glory of Motherland, the truth shall never be revealed. None of us expected this, Yet history is repeating itself.

Narrated by Ethan Hawke and created by the director of Madagascar, INVASION! is a colorful VR animated short about a duo of aliens with grand ambitions to take over our world. Instead, they are greeted by two adorable, white bunnies…..and you are one of them! Come experience what happens!
This is a Roguelike Horizontal Action game that players need to follow the beat to defeat opponents. Beat to follow, fist to the bone. Face the foe, and dance to kill!

titre: Bullets And More VR - BAM VR
description: Jump into an action packed multiplayer experience with up to 12 players and respawns without boring downtime. Featuring more than 40 unique maps and various game modes (BAM Royale, Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Capture The Flag, Virus Infection, Gun Game and Classic Deathmatch).

titre: We. The Refugees: Ticket to Europe
description: Un RPG textuel socialement engagé, basé sur un grand nombre de choix et de conséquences. Devenez un journaliste qui se fait passer pour un réfugié et tente de traverser illégalement la Méditerranée afin d'effectuer des recherches pour son prochain livre. Inspiré d'événements réels.

Elite Forces is a cinematic tactical shooter engineered for precision, performance, and progression. Experience high-intensity combat, intelligent enemy AI, and photorealistic environments. Now officially available on macOS with the new cinematic version.

THE LAST SURVIVOR is a survival horror shooter game for virtual reality devices. Trapped in a hospital, the player must find clues, kill or avoid attacking zombies, and investigate the truth before the incident to find the antidote and escape this horrible hospital.
Collection of jokes.
Recover, Pressure Test, Evacuate, Charge - watch a detailed process in 3D and then try it yourself hands-on using this fully interactive tool.

Survivez sept jours avec un tableau maudit représentant une jeune fille. Parviendrez-vous à finir son portrait ? Elle est extrêmement difficile à satisfaire, mais essayez de la supporter. Sept jours de morts avec le tableau d'une jeune fille.

In order to save the friend who was chosen as a victim, the girl embarked on the road alone... What will happen to this dreamy and mysterious road? What kind of role will you meet during the period? Also see the last.

Serafina’s Crown is a visual novel with elements of fantasy, adventure and romance. You play as Odell Perin, the newly-appointed regent of Darzia as she tries to solve the murder of the queen and a host of other domestic and international crises.

Onmyoji: The Card Game is an exquisite Japanese-style duel card game. as a youkai, choose 4 from more than 120 different Shikigami and build your own deck, power-up your Shikigami during the combat, and enjoy a fair and thrilling duel with brand-new original rules.

Hooking season est une approche innovatrice, chaotique et compétitive du genre «twin stick shooter», jusqu’à 4 joueurs. Utilise ton crochet pour manœuvrer/explorer les différents niveaux e attraper tes adversaires. Plus tu manges, plus tu grandisses et dans cet univers, plus c’est gros, mieux c’est.

You've got a VR headset and some cool motion controllers, but what can you really do with them? Throw some virtual axes! In Axe Throw, a virtual axe throwing range becomes your playground.. or you can see how long you can fend off a zombie apocalypse in survival mode!
《残世界的鸢尾花》是一款近未来都市废土风的RPG游戏，讲述了三个素不相识的残世界幸存者结伴逃离“沃姆市”时发生的一连串故事。
Take command of your ship, step into the arena, dominate your opponents, and put your reflexes and skills to the test!
L'aventure la plus déjantée de la galaxie !Rejoignez deux adorables bricoleurs de l'espace pas très malins dans leur quête farfelue pour réparer la galaxie !
Recapture the Castle is a third-person shooter game. The invaders have occupied the castle. Now you need to take up arms to destroy the invaders.

Concourez comme vos pilotes NASCAR Sprint Cup Series préférés sur les 23 circuits NASCAR en HD étonnant avec des environnements incroyablement détaillés. Préparez-vous à ressentir le plus gros plaisir avec un jeu NASCAR depuis des années !
Join Hoppy in this classic action platformer as you collect candies, dodge enemies and jump. After all, you are a rabbit!

Take the ultimate quest and discover the secret of the Waxworks! Embark on the fight of your life as vicious creatures, and mutants are ready to rip you apart. This gory horror game has no mercy and dares you to enter its ghastly world. Will you rise to the challenge or die trying?

Entering the World of Haiku is the first step to acquiring the critical, real-world skills needed to become a cybersecurity professional. This is the first and only gamified cyberpunk experience that teaches you real-world hacking skills and tools as you advance through the game missions.

Mothmen 1966 est un roman vidéoludique à l'écriture et aux illustrations exceptionnelle inspirées des romans de gare du milieu du 20e siècle et des images de synthèse des années 80. L'histoire se déroule en 1966, année où s'est produite une étrange pluie de météorites appelée les Léonides.

Kalymn Nox returns as the Albino Hunter (as in the hunter with albinism, not some creep who hunts albinos); even his pretentious and slightly racist title can keep him from waking up broke after a night of drinking. Join him as he takes on various jobs throughout the land.

Stile Danmaku STG. Qual è la causa dell'emergenza? Perché il manufatto è finalmente apparso? Viaggia nel tempo e nello spazio, schiva l'inferno dei proiettili, sconfiggi la maga e salva la tua linea del mondo!...

Backrooms Escape Protocol est un jeu d'horreur multijoueur où vous et vos amis explorez d'étranges backrooms, échappez à des entités terrifiantes et découvrez des secrets cachés. Coopérez pour survivre au labyrinthe sans fin et fuyez avant qu'il ne soit trop tard !

A fantasy/adventure visual novel - as Freya Fae, track down the master assassin Orick Genn before he brings ruin to your home city. Rely on faithful companions and make friends with the citizens as you encounter dangers lurking through the streets.

First-person escape game, playable solo or co-op with up to 4 people. Solve riddles of a reclusive alchemist that trapped you in his workshop. Brew potions and overcome challenges as he laughs at your failures and makes light of your successes...But what if things are not what they seem?
So you're a villain now? Let's see if you survive the experience.

titre: Legacy of Sin: The Father Sacrifice
description: Bienvenue dans le jeu original Legacy of Sin ! The Father's Sacrifice est une défense de route combinée à un scénario fantastique épique tout droit sorti d'une série télévisée des années 90. Affrontez une armée orc dans une version fantastique de la guerre moderne ! Déployez vos hommes, maintenez la ligne et défendez le royaume !
Fabulous Food Truck is an exciting time-management arcade game testing your skills and talent as Cook, Server and Manager of a busy food truck with a steady stream of demanding customers.

titre: Fall of the New Age Premium Edition
description: In the dark Medieval age a baleful cult and its adherers strived to seize the rule over the city, control its inhabitants and destroy all sources of knowledge and culture. Help Marla in this hiodden object adventure to uncover the secret conspiracy, release her kidnapped brother and save the city!
"ReLinked" is a pixelated Rogue-lite Action/PRG in a Sovietpunk setting in which you'll have to fight back against extraterrestrial intelligence and fend off countless waves of enemies!
Construisez et gérez votre propre village médiéval tout en maintenant l'équilibre entre or, armée, technologie et foi. Survivrez-vous aux bandits et à la pollution dans Medchess ?

Velvet Clouds - a story-driven game with elements of psychological horror and metroidvania. Explore locations, pick up items and destroy various enemies, and immerse yourself in an unusual story, interacting with the playable characters.

A thrilling, fast, big, very 3D, realistic, Full HD, modern and real-time 3D graphics combat game in which you are a heroic space alien starfighter pilot. You must wipe out the evil robot space alien King Nimrod, his massive military fleet and restore peace to the universe.
A powerful dictator has everything he needs to conquer the world except a grasp of basic geography. Learn country names, trivia, capitals, and flags as you achieve world domination!

Lead your band of mercenaries to victory in a procedurally generated fantasy world. Manage your resources, customise your army and wage epic battles against orc clans, barbarian hordes and legions of the undead. The art style may be cute, but this tactical roguelike is anything but forgiving.

When astronauts sent to explore mysterious structures on the surface of Mars disappear, NASA sends you to investiagte. Collect incredible articfacts and fight deadly alien creatures as you wander through the Red Planet's unexplained wonders to solve ancient mysterys.
Monster Master makes RTS fight versus FPS. Be the horde or survive together in this asymmetric reverse horror multiplayer

Inner Voices is a dark, non-linear adventure game with a pinch of horror, inspired by works of H. P. Lovecraft and E. A. Poe. Find your way through a procedurally generated maze of rooms and solve the mystery of your past.
Feel like a real Achievement hunter! Earn Achievements, upgrades and get the most Achievements on Steam!

Incarne S-44, une araignée robot qui peut marcher sur n’importe quoi !Fraye toi un chemin des quartiers les plus profonds aux buildings les plus hauts pour parvenir à sauver ton ami disparu dans la mystérieuse ville de New Bot City...

Quittez votre boulot actuel et lancez votre start-up ! Survivez à la bulle technologique, affrontez des PDG rivaux, et transformez votre bureau de programmeur en pyjama pour en faire un haut lieu du sabotage de la concurrence ! Évitez aussi de vous faire pirater... ou kidnapper.
《南栀》是一款百合向视觉小说游戏，讲述了在前作（夜永 Eternal Love）剧情发生一年半之后，聆花女子学院中的少女们成长的故事。
Multiplayer Turtles - Evil Frogs are attacking the Turtle Temple. You and Your elite team must Hack & Slash Your way to get rid of the invaders.
Physics and dynamic fighting based Action RPG

Bienvenu sur Kingsgrave, un jeu de rôle de dark fantasy. Montez en puissance et apprenez de nouvelles compétences en explorant les terres déchirées, tuez les monstres du fléau, résolvez des énigmes et reconstruisez des villages. Réclamez votre royaume !
Touch and create to solve puzzles. 3d creation puzzle side platformer.

First days at school are usually tough, but they can be even tougher if you’re helping a blind 8-year-old boy named Ian who doesn't know the terrifying dangers that lurk around in every hallway. You play as North, Ian’s lifelong canine companion. Can you help him escape alive?

Colorful bite-sized roguelike twin-stick bullet-hell dungeon crawler! Explore a procedurally generated research lab, throw black holes at monsters, dodge lasers, and fight a final boss beyond comprehension!

A fictional universe sandbox/exploration game. 🪐☄️✨ Shape your own solar system by terraforming planets. Find new species and make beautiful ecosystems . . . or breed destruction with volcanos, lightning storms and wildfires!

Corpse Keeper est un ARPG très difficile avec à la fois des éléments d'action et de stratégie. Vous devez constituer une puissante équipe de morts-vivants en collectant la chair et les os de l'ennemi en quinze jours de jeu, et enfin aller dans les profondeurs de l'église pour tuer les démons.
Spelling Quest Online is a real-time multiplayer competitive word game: flex on friends and strangers with your vocabulary and typing ability.
Green Phoenix is an on-rails arcade-like space shooter melted with a deep narrative experience which focuses on the concept of ego and the true meaning of freedom.

titre: 魔界堕ちのラズリエル
description: Lazriel, an angel of heaven, has been plunged into the demon world far below. Now her only hope of returning is for her to climb the tower. But will she succumb to the demons' powers before she makes it back alive?

Now you’re the new apprentice for Death. And it's your job to help gather souls. Only thing is, you can't just go and kill people to get the souls, it has to look natural. Like an accident. And that means setting up bottles, knives, brooms, and other regular objects in such a way as to create deadly chain reactions.

This is a novel puzzle game. It creatively asks you to control two people simultaneously. The game consists of three chapters and the levels become more and more difficult. Its a perfect game to exercise your brain.
Catsu is a student at Tokyo University. That day he was just going to prepare for exams, but suddenly ...
《Empries:The Rise》 is the a Cross-Platform Real-Time-Strategy (R.T.S.) game. Choose your nation and conquer those, who stand in your way!

Entrez dans la porte d'entrée de la prochaine étape de la musique où vous vous retrouverez face à face avec vos artistes préférés alors qu'ils créent leurs propres mondes uniques pour une expérience musicale totalement nouvelle. Artistes en vedette : Megan Thee Stallion, Zara Larsson et UPSAHL.

A digital recreation of The Bible in Kinetic Novel form! Read through and save passages in any order with an original soundtrack, or listen through the greatest story ever told in audiobook form. Featuring an extensive Trivia section to find out how well you really know the stories of Old and New.

In this classic roguelike, released in 1983 for the Commodore 64 by Epyx, search the dark depths of a twisted dungeon, teeming with fiendish enemies and dangerous traps, for the legendary Sword of Fargoal, the only thing that can defeat the evil wizard Umla.

titre: Vispo - Le jeu vidéo Trouvez les différences
description: Repérer les différences dans les vidéos. Simple. Une nouvelle version du vieux jeu favori.
Paint the ground! Paint your enemies! Paint your enemies ground! The ground is your enemy! Paint it!

Moondust utilizes all of the new inputs of Knuckles and demonstrates new game mechanics enabled by the new controller. Please note that this content was developed for Knuckles and will not work with other controllers.
Learn how a girl Lily managed to frustrate the plans of mean Duchess and to save the Crown Prince.

Step into the future with our groundbreaking VR game set in the year 2119, where humanity embarks on a historic journey into space. Join the "CCM-1" (Callisto Colonization Mission) expedition, aimed at the enigmatic moon of Jupiter - Callisto.
Warlocks Entanglement puts you into a destructible open world in a magical medieval setting. Explore and learn all this world has to offer and then open a gateway to the next world!.

Tous les héros du coin sont corrompus ! Déverrouillez des spécialistes aux compétences uniques et créez vos propres builds pour défendre vos terres contre des hordes de monstres. Trouvez des matériaux, reconstruisez votre village et décelez l'origine de la malédiction qui vous accable !

A panda who stumbles into the Lost Capital of Hell. Explore a beautiful and dangerous world with hand drawn crisp pixel art and 2.5D graphics. Face perilous foes, bosses and friendly allies. Customize yourself with abilities and outfits that will help you conquer your way through this doomed land.
Ce jeu n'est pas un dungeon crawler de type rogue-like, mais plutôt une expérience qui vous donnera finalement la réponse à la question : oserez-vous vous connaître vous-même ?
Lace up your cleats, and step onto the diamond with the pros of “BASEBALL STARS 2” on Steam!
Réaliser un casse-tête.

Celestial Force: Magical Mayhem is a beat'em up where you are in control of a Magical Girl preventing an alien invasion. Choose your favorite combatent and defeat the invaders with your elemental-adjacent powers and a lot of glitter!

Hoping to hit a big payday and pull herself from a life of poverty, Lisa heads to a town with a rumored demonic artifact. But upon arriving, she quickly realizes she has gotten herself into a dangerous situation.

"Rusty Dusty es un juego 2D donde un robot de limpieza lucha por su libertad en un edificio residencial, enfrentando temas de clasismo. Los jugadores toman decisiones importantes que afectan el destino del protagonista."

titre: Might and Magic: Heroes VII – Trial by Fire
description: Cinq ans après les événements épiques de Might & Magic Heroes VII, prenez le contrôle de la faction Forteresse pour déterminer le sort des Nains et faire la lumière sur les heures les plus sombres de leur Histoire.

titre: 女神全部锁定我 Beauties! They're All After Me
description: Dans ce jeu d'amour palpitant, les joueurs incarnent un héros ouvrier rencontrant six filles : une loli, une femme mature, une femme au foyer, une fille douce, une PDG autoritaire et une fille naïve. Le protagoniste réveille un système de triche—peux-tu le croire ?! Fais ton choix final maintenant !

Your job is to monitor live surveillance camera footage and spot anomalies in the monitored rooms. Anomalies range from furniture movement to otherworldly intruders. When you spot an anomaly you have to file a report to fix it. You will need sharp eyes and good memory to survive the entire night.
As madness and horror devour his world, can Youji find hope amid the nightmare? Experience a bond deeper and darker than love in this unforgettable visual novel.
The Mournmore Killings a story-driven, deduction based mystery game where you step into the shoes of a detective trying to solve the enigmatic riddles left behind by a serial killer.
Antisphere is a PvP competitive twin-stick shooter where you compete against other players.

Fabrication is a story-rich turn-based RPG. In an effort to uncover the truth behind their recent schemes, a rebellion rises against the ruling authority known as the Government. You will play as four individuals drawn by this common goal.
Descending is a VR horror game with puzzle elements. You play as the new owner of a house and your goal is to break the curse that was cast upon the estate.

Master the longboard as you drift through stunning mountain ranges, swerve through bustling city streets, and along the sandy beaches of Sunset Island. Train to perform epic tricks, from jumping off-ramp to longboarding backwards. Grab Your Longboard and Race to the Top in Tanuki Sunset!
Thief Town is a local multiplayer stealth action game set in a pixel-perfect rendition of the Wild West. Lurk in the crowd, emulate non-player characters, and achieve backstabbing victory.
Utilisez conflits, mythes et entraide pour créer votre propre saga épique !
Turn-based gameplay with roguelike and random elements. What could be better?

Face the challenge of catching ducks in a funny hand drawn forest. Outsmart hunters, cause a brawl between a wolf and a bear, use hideouts, move through underground tunnels, avoid traps but make enemies fall into them ! Be a sly fox !
APP HAS BEEN RETIRED!

Stikbold! est un jeu de ballon prisonnier fantaisiste en solo et multijoueur local au thème années 70 groovy, avec des arènes intenses et tordues ainsi que des événements aléatoires qui altèrent le cours de chaque manche.
A Vampire Survivor like game but first person shooter. You level up by shooting the enemy and get new skills. Upgrade your skills!

titre: Gary Grigsby's War in the East
description: War on an Epic scale from Moscow to Berlin – this is War in the East!

titre: Astronomy Lab on PC: Relativity, Lunar Landing, Space Flight, and Interstellar Travelling
description: The laboratory contains 4 sub-games. Through these sub-games, you can experience the magnificence of the universe, the beauty of the earth, the spectacle of the moon and the completely different world you see while driving a spaceship at a speed close to the speed of light.

Follow cat Catherine on her journey for the lost astrology papyri and learn more about her job as a witch assistant for bringing good vibes into this Earth! Let Catherine guide you through the zodiac wheel, showing you about features of each solar sign. You can also learn about your cat's sign!
Professor Madhouse is an adventurous game of logic for young children.

Witches Vs. Demons is a Rage Dungeon Crawler based around using SteamVR to build an immersive gameplay experience. The first edition of Witches Vs. Demons will have 10 playable levels, unique boss encounters with raid mechanics for single players, & scaling difficulty into multiplayer content.

In this game, you'll encounter a straightforward combat system and a plethora of traps and puzzles. The combat mechanics are simple yet engaging, requiring strategic thinking. Your character's success in battles depends on the comparison of Power levels.

This short but sweet game presents a polished combination of tower defense and base building. Manage your energy network to both defend from and attack foes all while enjoying a clean, zero budget art style.

"Pastelia Stories" is a turn-based JRPG. You will be summoned into Pastelia world, and here begins your wonderful journey. Explore big world just like you want, pick any out of 30 companions, chose one of the story lines and factions to find your way back home.

Ladra est un jeu d'action-aventure d'infiltration qui teste vos capacités en tant qu'ultime voleuse. Utilisez les ombres, votre vitesse et votre intelligence afin de toujours garder une longueur d'avance.
The Corruption Within is a psychological thriller first-person point & click adventure game set in the Victorian era, with an emphasis on strong narrative, intriguing characters and puzzle-solving.
Arcade platform game where every killed enemy can be picked up and thrown to kill more enemies!

Dekar is a noble warrior who has a estranged relationship with his father. After abandoning his rights to the throne and choosing to live a simple life, everything changes for him when a Winged One crashes into his village asking for his help. The fate of the world now lies on his shoulders.
We Break the Mold of online PvP games. Customize your Avatars, Draft your Abilities and Engage in 6-minute-short, free-for-all Matches in the Afterlife!

titre: Curse of the Crescent Isle DX
description: A curse has befallen the Crescent Isle and it's up to you to save it. Luckily the curse has transformed your people into helpful monsters such as drills, blobs, icicles, and gravity flipping...things. With your monster subjects in hand you'll have to drill through rocks, maneuver through spiky terrain, freeze water to pass over the sea,...

Utilisez l'équipement spécialisé à votre disposition pour localiser et enregistrer autant d'événements paranormaux que possible. Élaborez votre rituel et tentez d'exorciser les démons qui s'y trouvent. Si vous utilisez des ingrédients incorrects, vous risquez de ne jamais repartir ! 1-4 joueurs

Machine Learning: Episode is a first person arcade puzzle game built for HTC Vive. You play as an A.I. robot created in DARPA laboratory in the near future. One of the scientists is here to test your physical, perception and cognitive skills. By using the power of room-scale VR and Vive controllers

titre: Leisure Suit Larry 2 - Looking For Love (In Several Wrong Places)
description: “What’s your sign, baby?” - Larry Laffer “Wrong Way.” -any woman.

Sky Road is a casual game for all ages. It does not take much effort. In a calm atmosphere, choose an emotion for yourself and take a ride along the celestial road, collecting coins. The further you pass the more reward.
Make regrets and lose the rest of your friends in this terrifying card game

Birds high up in the sky, waves rolling in on the shore, the wind blowing through palm trees and plants that grow on your private secluded island all contribute both visually and in sound to a surreal experience that practically makes you feel the ocean breeze.

Salut ! Capitaine ! "Sea of Craft" est un jeu bac à sable de construction d'océans basé sur la physique. Vous pouvez utiliser plus de 100 matériaux pour construire un navire unique. Ouvrez votre cœur pour explorer les niveaux amusants de la planète Beela et lancez-vous dans une aventure incroyable !

A fantasy yuri visual novel filled with magic, fairies, and a ghost girl. When Maddie and her best friend, Tara, journey to a remote forest village to investigate rumors of the supernatural, they find a whole lot more than they bargained for.
🔍 Résolvez le mystère d’un meurtre choquant à l’Hôtel Noir ! 🕵️‍♂️ Cherchez des objets, trouvez des indices et révélez la vérité. Mais attention… ne faites confiance à personne !

Steamburg est un jeu d'aventure et de réflexion primé, doté d'éléments narratifs à explorer et d'un gameplay unique. Le professeur Vincent Moore affronte une invasion de robots. Sans arme, il doit utiliser toute son intelligence. Après la destruction des robots, il peut explorer les lieux pour retrouver et sauver sa fiancée.
Amber Throne is a turn-based JRPG-styled game about a girl in a desert world beneath a mysterious floating castle, and her quest to reach it.
一觉醒来？好像是醒来了，又好像是梦境，这是一个我和4名女子关于回忆的故事。
studio: 我的同居女神竟是小姨子

description: fault - StP - LIGHTKRAVTE is the latest entry in the fault series, which has shipped over 500,000 copies worldwide. LIGHTKRAVTE presents its story through the eyes of Khaji Oberg, an ordinary and unremarkable teenaged boy who finds himself reaching for a dream that slips ever further away from him.

Mineral Defense combines tower defense with roguelite elements and procedural generation. Build paths, unlock upgrades, and unleash powerful synergies to conquer evolving challenges in an ever-expanding world.

The alien invaders have launched their final offensive on an already crippled Terra. Only one brave pilot can turn the tide of war. Cyber Seraph is a boss focused vertical shoot 'em up with unlockable abilities.
A sci-fi-style rolling 3D platformer.

Rev up your rocket-powered hydro jet and put your racing skills to the test. Riptide GP™2 features dynamic racing on fully interactive water surfaces, a deep career mode with tons of upgrades, customizable riders and skills, online and local multiplayer, and fully integrated controller support.

Kaya's Prophecy est un jeu unique de construction de village avec des cartes ! Établissez votre village dans un monde vibrant et coloré. Explorez divers Biomes dans ce deck-builder haut en couleurs, tout en apaisant votre dieu pour gagner sa faveur.
Psionic Awake is a Roguelike game . Collect resources during the day and defend against monsters at night. It emphasizes any combination of weapons, talents, treasures and partners.

Create your own furry character! In "StarArc Echo" you'll meets friends, fight alongside them, and share joyful moments! With a exciting PVE challenges, thrilling PVP battles, and various unique life skills, a boundlessly free and fantastical world awaits you.

Inspired by “shmups” and shadows, Shmadow is a modern twin-stick side-scroller that nods to retro arcade gameplay. Use your light to blast through your enemies, unlock new powers, and defeat bosses before the darkness extinguishes you.
Les adorables oiseaux de Hatoful Boyfriend sont de retour dans cette suite remasterisée sur le thème des vacances.

BiblioMania is a multiplayer 2D platformer where you are a clerk in a cursed library. Work with (or triumph over) up to 3 friends while taking in and renting out books to many clients. But beware the events that happen at the library, they can change everything.

Fantasy Heroes follows the adventures of Tristan, a knight of the kingdom of Kayzerhart, and Melanie, his chance buddy. Soon both are engulfed in a massive conflict that could very well threaten the whole world.

Euclidean; a game of geometric horror; a slow descent into the dark, into madness, futility, and despair, where Things greater than you watch and wait and dream. Struggle for every second of life you have left… Even knowing you’re better off dead.

Escape from the Cursed Convent is a narrative-driven adventure game set in a medieval girls' convent, offering a rich storytelling experience, and several gameplay styles including QTE, hunting, cooking, and puzzle-solving.
You are one of the survivors with your family in a city destroyed After The War. Your goal is to keep yourself and your family alive and escape from this city.
A pure fighting game

Guns’n’Stories: Bulletproof is a dynamic VR western shooter that fully immerses players into the ambiance of weird Wild West. Stepping the tangled storyline, you will encounter many intimidating but comical enemies and fight Big Bosses.
Triangulum is a minimalist logic puzzle game. Disperse points among different types of triangles to maximize your score.
