Crosswalks in a visual novel that tells different stories when you switch among perspectives. In 2018, an explainable portal appeared under the city of Sanghville, linking two parallel universe together. On one side there are dozens of unsolvable crimes, while the other side was always peaceful...

KURSK est le tout premier jeu d'aventure documentaire inspiré de faits réels. Vous incarnez le rôle d'un espion qui s'est introduit à bord du K-141 Kursk, un sous-marin nucléaire russe. Votre objectif consiste à recueillir des informations sur un armement révolutionnaire : les torpilles à supercavitation Chkval.

"Escape First 3" est le troisième volet d'un jeu de réflexion multijoueur pour salles d'évasion en réalité virtuelle ou sur ordinateur de bureau ! Il comprend [3] différentes salles d'évasion [/] [/] au choix et peut être joué en compétition, en duo ou en solo.

This is a Sandbox game project, the simulation farm combined with defense is inspired by "Harvest moon" and "Plant vs zombie". The gameplay of Windykingdom in the top-down perspective, Player will play a character from the future and is trying to survive in a kingdom full of women and monsters.
Un drame médical intense et amusant traitant des nombreuses décisions qui peuvent changer une vie. Devenez chirurgienne en herbe à l’hôpital de Little Creek !

Libérez le magnat qui sommeille en vous et transformez votre terrain de golf d'un trou en un centre 5 étoiles. Ajoutez de somptueux fairways, créez des parcours de golf de classe mondiale, accueillez des tournois et gérez votre personnel pour attirer des golfeurs VIP venus des quatre coins de la planète.

Maîtrisez de nouveaux pouvoirs en affrontant des hordes de démons dans des combats intenses dans un jeu de tir top-down frénétique avec des éléments rogue-lite. Luttez contre les ténèbres qui envahissent la tour et découvrez des mystères capables de sauver ou de condamner tout ce qui vous entoure.
Turn-based battles.
Last Knight is over-the-top jousting action in a beautiful brutal fantasy world! It comes with bucketloads of content and is inspired by outstanding third-person platformers like Crash Bandicoot.
MOVERS IN THE WAREHOUSE is a puzzle game about workers in a warehouse with strategy and arcade elements, made in a 2D drawn style.

A story-rich, 3rd-person, investigative, psychological thriller set in a corporate dystopia where you'll help Theo Church escape from a psychiatric hospital using stealth and hacking elements to unravel the conspiracy that landed him there.
In Tomba! Special Edition, leap, bite, and throw your way across stunning 2.5D landscapes in this vastly-enhanced update to a platforming classic!
An ancient entity seeking help, a Witch, an unnamed soul and a Twisted Temple. A dark tale about inner discoveries set in a distorted and perverted world.

The player is an ordinary warrior who is turned into a pig when defeated by a water monster in battle. In order to become human again, players need to go through different levels Step by step, transform into human form and acquire skills. Defeat demons through ultimate efforts and become humans.
Construisez votre propre aéroport international et prenez votre envol !

The Den of Worms is an open world exploration game where you must enter the Astral Plane on an esoteric quest to save your dreams from being eaten. On your way you will grow plants, hatch worm eggs, restore the life to towns, battle monsters, and uncover secrets.

Forgotten Fields is a game about yearning and nostalgia. Play as Sid - a struggling writer who travels back to his childhood home one last time before it's sold off. Visit old friends, relive memories and play through sections of Sid's book in this warm game about the passage of time.
Bob's Track Builder Pro allows you to create tracks using simple mouse clicks to form the underlying track mesh ready to be imported into popular car racing games and raced on against your friends.

Please enjoy high school life in Japan.[How to game]Operate with XBOX Controller or KeyboardkeyboardA : Left MoveD : Right MoveW: Front MoveS : Back MoveF: JumpG: Grab human / Pick up itemR: Crouch / AttackT: Action ButtonQ : DashE : VisionMouse L Click + Mouse Move: Camera MoveXbox Controller A: JumpB: Grab human / Pick up itemX: Crouch...
Explore, build, harvest. Hexton is a relaxing building game where you try to create the largest city possible. Looking for a light challenge? This game's for you!

Choose the creative experience only SONAR offers: advanced technology, effortless workflow, and an inviting interface that amplifies inspiration. Fueled by 30 years in the relentless pursuit of innovation, SONAR is re-inventing the modern recording studio.

Summon: Joint Escape is a cooperative horror survival game for 1-4 players. Find a way to escape from a stalker in camouflage uniform who wants to give you a piece of paper with the inscription "Summon".
In this cosmic puzzle adventure, help a lost tribe of duck-people in their millennial quest for a stable world!

titre: Misericorde Volume Two: White Wool & Snow
description: White Wool & Snow is the second visual novel in the Misericorde series.
Attrape tes baguettes, suis le rythme et libère le Maître Taiko qui sommeille en toi !

Guo Hengyi and Yao Fengyi are childhood sweetheart. But their relationship goes far gradually after divided into different classes and the great college entrance exam pressure. Tang Haiyin and Yao Fengxi came to his life as well. An unexpected accident had involved them together.

It's time to crush the dungeons with Kiritan. Explore the various dungeons, dig the blocks, beat the enemies and blow up everything! Play with many cute pixel characters and explore the sandbox world!
A Multi-player incremental clicker game.

Unhappily ever after. That’s how it starts. The Orb resurfaces and the classic characters return. Kobbler with his mania, Princess with her endless boredom. It’s only a matter of time before Bob, our hero, shows up to put order back to madness. Three powers struggle for victory and the fate of Cloudberry Kingdom hangs in the balance.
Make your way through more than 600 rooms, and unravel the secrets of your past by finding the five elemental orbs. Cathedral features a vast world, meant for exploring!

You are a wizard and your village is under attack! Push back the enemy forces with powerful spells. Burn, freeze, shatter and crush the enemy soldiers with your magic powers. Gain XP as you kill your enemies and unlock upgrades for your spells.

titre: Secrets of Orion: Sword of Destiny.
description: A warrior who wandered in search of redemption after abdicating his post receives a call to return to his ancient continent. Explore the continent of Orion in a 2D action adventure with 3 endings according to your choices.
Timore Narhelma is a surreal experience about human mind and horrors within.

In SpellPunk you will unleash extraordinary powers and turn into a mighty magician who will cast spells by drawing magical symbols in the air with his/hers own hands. And yes, you will be immersed in a stunning, abstract world, experiencing fast-paced magical duels.
In this comedy of terrors, the fate of the spirit world is in your hands as you embark on a search for your long-lost sibling!

titre: Legends of the Universe - Cosmic Bounty
description: Cosmic Bounty est un jeu de plateforme d'action de style Metroidvania. Vous incarnez Jekt, un chasseur de primes chargé de traquer un général rebelle nommé Volgat. Explorez les zones pour acquérir de nouvelles capacités et augmenter vos statistiques afin de pouvoir vaincre de puissants ennemis.

上古年代，混沌未开，大神盘古以盘古斧劈开天地，从此日月星辰得以显现，世间万物逐渐苏生。然而，西方部落的蚩尤与东方部落的黄帝在涿鹿展开了一场旷世之战。蚩尤战败，残部逃入深山秘境。黄帝命旱神女跋追击蚩尤残部，然女跋感染了人间浊气。为了保留神力，女跋将自身一分为二。黄帝得知此事后，将女跋放逐于山海界，以避其神力的耗损。 岁月流转，蚩尤残部在深山中潜伏了千年之久，渐渐聚集成一支强大的妖魔大军，伺机而动 到了西周初年，黑暗势力从阴暗角落中悄然爬出，蠢蠢欲动，天下危如累卵！与好友一同开创属于你的英雄传奇。 探索未知的土地，击败强大的敌人，收集珍稀的宝物，这一切都在等着你！
studio: 云中屋网络科技有限公司

description: Burst Fighter is a shoot'em up game with unique customizable ship feature fused with modern graphic and gorgeous art styles. Dodge, counter, and defeat various enemies / attack patterns. Experience more than 8 challenging and intense boss battles.
!!! ATTENTION !!! DO NOT PURCHASE !!! CINEVEO has been discontinued and is no longer available! CINEVEO servers are offline! CINEVEO is being removed from Steam.
Le premier jeu d’action-aventure sans image, où l’ouïe remplace les yeux ! Découvrez une expérience sensorielle inédite et innovante du son 3D binaural, créée par DOWiNO et FRANCE CULTURE !

Build your heroes, loot the kingdom, and discover rare treasures. Corvos Dynasty is an RPG inspired by old-school classics. Will you be the legendary hero who saves the princess or the conquerer who burns the monarchy to the ground?

titre: Twin Mind: Chasseur de fantômes Édition Collector
description: Les détectives jumeaux pourront-ils résoudre une nouvelle affaire ? Vous êtes la seule personne qui puisse les aider à attraper le tueur. Êtes-vous prêt à relever le défi ?

Affalé dans votre fauteuil après une journée d'investigation, le téléphone sonne. Le conservateur du musée a besoin de vous. Un touriste a disparu et alors qu'il vous parle d'évènements paranormaux, vous souriez, car cette tâche est dans les cordes des Chasseurs de Démons.
Travel across different islands, continents and worlds while in the journey to stop a deadly threat and fulfill your duty as a Damathos!

Atmospheric slow-burn indie horror game. Walking simulator interspersed with various events, sometimes simple puzzles and a bit of running away.Student starts working as a security guard in the old abandoned factory that hides a dark secret.

Brain Sanguo is a strategy game with turn-based combat.You play as a seignior in a mythical world about Sanguo,develop your territory,employ warriors,build armies,prepare for the uprising of Huangjin.

A casual and addictive mini-strategy that gives that RTS fix in a few minutes, without taking too much time or brain power! Dominate the garden by spreading your plants - use poison, rabbits, goats and more to destroy your neighbors plants - multiplayer or against the computer.
C'est un jeu de puzzle unique et très convaincant. Une expérience avec une vue magnifique.

titre: Professor Watts Word Search: Pirates Life
description: Hello Professor Watts here and I need your help! I've been assembling a lecture on the life of pirates, collecting samples and documenting important research materials. Now that I have returned to my laboratory I find all of my research files has been jumbled about.
The orthodox horror puzzle game, at the same time, you can also experience the passionate race with the female ghost and the cool bursting magic in this game!
A new sequel of the successful Unlock The King, now with 3D boards based on Rubik's Cubes. An originally designed puzzle game inspired by chess. Move the pieces and create a path to Unlock the King.
Military valor, courage and honor – if these words mean something to you, then you are a direct road to the game Lord of the Click.
Kickshot is a first-person speedrunning game in which you utilize your tools, environment and movement abilities to complete the course as quickly as possible.

Two siblings; Oliver and Penello, answer their dying Grandma's wish and make their way to Phren Village. A seemingly peaceful village filled with tranquility. But on the inside, It is a village void of hope and on the brink of succumbing to despair and darkness.

En tant que Prospecteur dans ce chapitre de Prologue, vous prendrez votre premier contrat. Explorez de nouvelles planètes, collectez des ressources, construisez votre base entièrement automatisée et expédiez des matériaux vers des colonies lointaines.

Devenez le roi du swing ! Golf2D est un jeu d'arcade rapide et fun ! Le but du jeu est de finir un maximum de niveau sans perdre. Pour cela il suffit de tirer la balle dans le trou avant la fin du chrono et attention aux hors-limite !
Protect the lighthouse, destroy nests and complete tasks.
Oblivion is a short, story-driven first-person horror game. Uncover the truth hidden within an abandoned school — but beware, some memories were never meant to return.
RoundZ est un jeu de survie zombie en solo basé sur des manches, où chaque vague devient progressivement plus difficile à mesure que les zombies gagnent en vie et arrivent en groupes plus nombreux.

You have inherited a farm! What is waiting for you on arrival at the place ?! Huge field with a bunch of the crop? The big and vast land? Not a bit of it! Your new farm it is - an old junk! Next to that, nestled ancient cemetery! Restore and improve and protect his farm from attack undead!
You should simply try out Roboom. We have quite a long description below, you can read if you like, but experiencing Roboom yourself or as Co-op is the best.

titre: Gythol Granditti: The Crypt of Darkness
description: It's a nice sunny day in Tor Borgh and aimless lout Geoff Dandy is woken up by his best mate Dolph Dombardo raging incoherently about going to the Jiggly Swamp. Saving Dolph from doom sets in motion events that lead to one question...
Cinderella is back with a new goddess power. Ready to fight for her innocence and reveal the secret plan of the Prince. Will she get her revenge? Will she accept her destiny?
Immerse yourself in an epic space battle with alien enemies.

In order to avoid the financial failure of Kagawa Prefecture, and aim for traveling around and all-you-can-eat-gourmet, Jiro Urashima, the governor of Kagawa Prefecture, and Deputy Governor, Onohime Megi, will push forward to unify Shikoku!
studio: Flying Panjandrum / ふらいんぐパンジャンドラム

description: Venez expérimenter la marée spectaculaire de poissons de milliers de poissons. est un jeu VR occasionnel avec la chasse en haute mer. Le jeu se déroule dans une zone de mer profonde mystérieuse remplie de coraux et de divers beaux poissons.

Cyto has lost his memories, help him get them back. Fling Cyto through beautiful, other-worldly levels to collect memory fragments and piece together his story in this irresistible, cute, and challenging puzzle game.

In the early 2000s Somewhere in America, There is a serial killer who calls himself the Love Killer who likes to murder any couple indiscriminately For five years, you'll play Elijah Sanders, a private investigator whose partner is Lieutenant Anthony Williams. victim woman named Kate Hernandez.

Devenez un jeune héros et passez de donjon en donjon pour retrouver vos souvenirs perdus. En progressant dans les niveaux, vous rencontrerez des personnages de votre passé. C'est votre souci de deviner s'ils sont amis ou ennemis. Mais attention, tout le monde peuvent vous trahir dans les Donjons de la Trahison.

Have you ever wanted to know how it feels to drown in money? Say no more fam, in Geology Business you get to mine for ancient hidden gems worth a fortune, and don't forget about the spicy memes on the menu.

Bonjour Monsieur le Directeur ! Vous êtes aux commandes de cette prison privée. Ces individus sont maintenant sous votre responsabilité. Commencez avec une petite prison avant de prendre les commandes de plus grosses unités. De la construction au fonctionnement, vous devez protéger la société et dégager un bénéfice.

Un outil de production vidéo automatisé qui utilise des médias importés, des effets créés par l'utilisateur et une variété de paramètres pour sélectionner et transformer au hasard des clips en un seul rendu qui imite les styles de montage vidéo bruts rendus populaires par le genre "YTP".

In POPS, every bullet fired pushes you further into the chaos of war. The story-driven campaign throws you into the boots of an elite operative. Fight through a series of intense missions, face overwhelming odds, unexpected betrayals, and brutal firefights where only the strongest survive.

Déclenchez la guerre des voxels dans 9-Bit Armies : A Bit Too Far. Dirigez une armée moderne, construisez des bases, débloquez des unités et attaquez dans une guerre totale. Participez sur terre, sur mer et dans les airs dans plus de 30 missions, escarmouches en ligne ou en coopération.

The struggle between Good and Evil continues in this bloody action, top-down action-roguelike shooter where time moves only when you move or shoot. Tear Satan's forces to pieces, leave oceans of their blood and mountains of demon's corpses in the name of Goodness!
Steep Slopes is a snowboarding endless runner game!
The last installment of the dungeon-crawling RPG trilogy reaches its stunning conclusion! Will the Blood Maidens finally get their happily ever after?

UNITED COMMAND is a military base building real time strategy game with a 2 player co-op campaign. Drop into a mission and fight side by side with a friend against the enemy AI. Use your dozer to build out your base and gather resources to fund the construction of your tanks, infantry, and aircraft.
You play as Subject A-119, the first successful experiment in a series of clones. You wake up unintentionally and you don't know who, what or where you are.

Zugnaex is a very powerful demon. If you say its name correctly, every single little tiny syllable, you will summon the demon & bring forth the apocalypse. But Zugnaex has never faced a foe like you. Battle online with your friends to ultimately face the demon itself and decide the fate of humanity.
Explore the sea and save the killer whales in this "Endless Swimmer" game. Discover unique biomes, orcas, powerups, and more!

Au cœur de la nuit, quand les rues sont silencieuses et que le quartier dort, vous êtes en mission, livrant des colis que personne d’autre n’ose toucher. Chaque livraison est une course contre la montre—et contre les dangers qui rôdent dans l'ombre.

An acid trip back to classic vector arcade action games with the unique bullet magnet mechanic. Dodge ruthless attacks, bend your projectile trajectory, destroy waves of enemies with the massive explosion chains. Die a lot! Then try again and get yourself to top of the leaderboards
Anime Play Life: Unlimited is a cozy anime-style life simulation focused on relaxing gameplay, exploration, and the freedom to enjoy a calm, peaceful experience.

Frayez-vous un chemin à travers des hordes de monstres et essayez d'atteindre les trésors cachés dans les profondeurs du donjon de Faveg dans ce RPG Roguelike brutal. Serez-vous capable de former une équipe assez fort?

The great emperor's untimely death... Seven princesses are candidates for his succession! Who will save the empire from chaos? An online deck-growing card game where you grow your deck and fight for the Princess.

A Twisted Path To Renown est un MMO communautaire avec un shooter PvEvP, mécaniques de survie immersives, et un meta-jeu incluant minage, artisanat et commerce, situé dans l'Amérique impitoyable de 1899.

Les trois premiers jeux de la série Forgotten Hill rassemblés avec de nouveaux contenus, de nouveaux lieux, de nouvelles énigmes et des secrets révélés : suivez donc les Premiers Pas de Larson à Forgotten Hill !

we`ve all been down to our local bowling alley to play. But ended up having to wait for hours to get a lane. Don`t waste anymore more time, run the game up and play. No more waiting, just straight to the fun part. Multiplayer on one pc sharing your headset.
都市修仙+暗黑+放置摸鱼+妹子养成？这可能是一款和你想象中不太一样的刷子游戏。刷宝，筑基，放置，飞升成仙，系统开挂，这款比小说还精彩的国漫修仙都市游戏里全都有。快来开启爽文般带着妹子打怪兽的后宫养成人生吧！

GET YOUR BRAIN BUZZING with each new challenge in the latest installment of the multi award-winning wacky contraption series - CRAZY MACHINES ELEMENTS. Play with Fire, harness the power of water and control the wind to set off the most insanely creative chain reactions!
Le roi a été frappé par un sort de satiété, et n'arrive plus à manger quoi que ce soit! Apportes-lui le Burger Ultime, et ravive son appétit pour sauver le royaume!

Pendant la nuit, Dan se réveille en entendant des bruits inhabituels provenant des profondeurs de la maison. Inquiet de l'état de sa sœur, il décide d'aller la voir. En entrant dans sa chambre, il s'aperçoit qu'elle a disparu. La peur le saisit et il se met à parcourir la maison à sa recherche.

Des secrets de famille enfouis dans la nuit des temps. L’histoire d’une fortune oubliée. Tess Devine a toujours entretenu une relation complexe avec sa mère, mais les deux sont sur le point de s’engager dans un voyage vers le passé qu’elles ne sont pas prêtes d’oublier.

titre: 红魔事件簿 The Note of Red Evil
description: 在有着“超能力”、“科技”与“魔法”的架空世界中，您将扮演“侦警”展开一系列充满幻想的宏大冒险。
Will you find the end?

Skillsworn is a tactical turn based adventure game. Take on the role of a fresh party leader and embark on a journey through the wilds of Thera to stabilize the lands in the name of the King! Defeat a variety of dangerous foes and prove that you are not just another bored peasant seeking a thrill.

Unpatterned Cut est un jeu d'action-réflexe en réalité virtuelle dans lequel vous devez terminer les épisodes en tuant des ennemis pour survivre dans la simulation et peut-être sauver vos proches. De plus, repoussez-vous sur les scores et grimpez dans le classement face aux autres joueurs.
Turn Based Strategy RPG. With complex skills, sprawling world and intricate storyline.
A first-person choose-your-own adventure set in an anachronistic city.
The genre defining VR model train game. Build and ride the model train layout of your dreams without the cost and excessive model foam dust getting in your nose!

Pharaoh's Tomb is an arcade-adventure game set in a huge Egyptian pyramid. Explore 20 uniquely-dangerous levels riddled with ingenious puzzles and traps. You start with five lives and a few spears, which can he thrown at offending denizens that patrol the pyramid.

Ground Pounders is a turn-based, strategy wargame. Inspired by classic strategy games like Panzer General, and steeped in the lore of the Sword of the Stars universe, Ground Pounders offers a new generation of gamers an updated taste of turn-based strategic warfare.

titre: Streets of Red : Devil's Dare Deluxe
description: Streets of Red: Devil's Dare Deluxe est un « beat them all » multijoueur avec mort permanente confère aux joueurs les compétences de héros emblématiques du rétrogaming dans un combat contre des zombies. Frissons, adrénaline, argent et compétences vont vous transporter jusqu'à ce que chaque rue soit rouge de sang !
Open World Werewolf Hunt in Coop and Singleplayer. Prepare for the Werewolfhunt with many threats in the deep Forest of Lovengrad.

Your daily fix of the hack&slash wave attack action. Fast paced and easy to get into. Use a varied arsenal of awesome magic weapons to win that top spot on the Orc Slayer Leaderboard. Plus, it's 100% free!
Fast-paced retro shmup where space keeps shrinking. Collect energy orbs, avoid danger, unlock ships, and chase the highest score in this addictive arcade shooter.
Prenez la tête de la CIA ou du KGB dans une stratégie mondiale au tour par tour. Influencez des nations, menez des opérations secrètes et remportez la guerre froide sans tirer une seule balle.
Jeu de puzzle-action 2D en noir et blanc
Become a big pilot of a tiny spaceship. Fight bigger opponents and prove that size does not matter. Exploit weaknesses of opponents. Get the edge thanks to the range of super weapons.

Equipped with your favorite weapon of choice, a Bat, embark in a whole new adventure with this brand new arcade action game and defeat the great evil that lurks in the shadows gathering new powers along the way. Ready ? Swing Away !

It's a classic arcade shooter with rogue-lite tossed in. Tons of monsters are on the attack - can you survive if you ware unable to move? Use guns, skills and abilities to upgrade and fight until the end！
Il s'agit d'un jeu de tir roguelike très rapide, le joueur pilotera le mech, explorera la frontière extraterrestre, profitera de "Crimsonland + Vampire Survivors" et tuera sans fin !

BoltBreak is a mix between a wave shooter and a superhero game. Unlock new superpowers and climb the leaderboards as you fight through 100 waves of supervillains across 8 different earths in the BoltBreak multiverse.

"The malign spirits always try to manifest themselves". Host one of these demons through its summoning. Does finishing the ritual is the solution to your problems? 3:00 AM, the ritual begins; hide out and survive to the hide and seek game with a possessed doll. Do you dare to play?

Run for your life in a destitute city while the police try desperately to take your coin. Beat the highscore, chuck gas tanks at people, grab coins with a vacuum, step on stray dogs, unlock items to wear and don't get taxed! Run like a madman. Die like a boss.

Lost forever in the pitch black! But that's what makes it fun! The vast corridors covered in darkness change with each play. All you can do is run or hide from the frightening Apparitions. Use unique items and Karuta cards with special powers in your desperate search for an escape from the darkness!

Deadlokk is a 1-3 player co-op roguelike. Explore sectors while fighting against other factions to upgrade your ships and carrier. Find rare weapons and upgrades to make the perfect build. Research your items to make blueprints and take them on your future Expeditions!
More pulse-pounding 360° action blasting through tunnels with six degrees of freedom.

The video game that makes you a better gamer™. Retrocausal Studios brings you fun gameplay enhanced by in-depth analytics and algorithms that adapt to your skill level to help you improve faster than the competition.
Patricia is a short puzzle horror game about a girl getting stuck in a ghost town and has to find her way out before it gets too late.

Devenez membre de la suite très attendue de l'émission de science-fiction coopérative. Rassemblez une équipe de quatre amis. Plus il y a de partenaires, plus il y a de chances de survivre. Trouvez votre chemin dans un nouveau complexe de pièces mortel rempli de pièges encore plus sophistiqués.

Tsukumogami is the original Japanese version of 99 Spirits.99 Spirits is an RPG/Puzzle game that revolves around the popular Japanese folklore of Tsukumogami, everyday objects coming alive on their 100th birthday.Hanabusa is a young headstrong girl living in the Heian capital within medieval Japan.

titre: Romance of the Three Kingdoms XII with Power Up Kit
description: "Romance of the Three Kingdoms 12 with Power Up Kit" is an expanded version of "Romance of the Three Kingdoms 12," which was released in 2012 as the 12th game in the series. The stage is set. Create the story.

Forgotten Myths is a free to play online collectible card game that incorporates deck building, card collection and strategic gameplay in a fantastic historical background incorporating several civilizations, myths and legends in the same universe!

titre: La Porte des Fauconniers : Guerre Médiévale
description: La Porte des Fauconniers est un RPG/RTS simulant des batailles tactiques réalistes et hardcores dans la Normandie médiévale. Livrez-vous à des batailles solos ou multi-joueurs d'une rare intensité à la tête de votre armée personnalisée !

You are driving home to your parents' house. Suddenly, a human-like shadow jumps out and he slams on the brakes in a panic. But he fails to do so in time, and runs over the shadow. He gets out of the car and checks the road, but only a pool of blood continues to the mountain road.
Beyond the known world there is an ancient temple of great wealth. The treasure you seek is there, you are certain of it. Those who go there forfeit their lives. You have been warned.
A humorous RPG/Adventure in full 2D, filled with quirky characters, nasty dungeons, and lots of exploration!

Armageddon Empires is a computer turn based strategy game that takes the best elements of collectable card games, board games, and computer games and brings them all together to provide a unique interactive strategy war game experience.
Jim The Spy is a 2D third-person infiltration game. The player must complete a list of objectives in various levels filled with robots.
Ghostman: The Council Calmity is a Point and click adventure game set in space.
This game is a puzzle game that requires mouse control.

titre: Territoire : Agriculture et Guerre (Territory: Farming and Warfare)
description: D'un petit village d'une dizaine d'habitants à un petit royaume de milliers d'habitants. Faire en sorte que les résidents travaillent, cueillent, pêchent et chassent, cultivent et exploitent, fabriquent, commercent. Combattez avec les forces du mal et les monstres.

You are deployed to the desolate red planet to reforge humanity's hope. With no hospitable atmosphere, no nurturing water sources, only relentless storms, unknown alien creatures, you must use wit and determination to survive on this alien land and build a Mars base of your own.

You wake up lost in a maze and realize there are many items on the ground. They all seem high-valuable, so you decide to pick them all. But there are also many ghosts that don't really want you to pick the items. Not that they will try to kill you, but they'll steal and move the items...
Try to control one person with 2 people! Take the reins with your friends as you try to complete challenging and hilarious missions in this fun cooperative game of teamwork, chaos and comedy!
Shadowcrypt is an arcade-style dungeon crawler with tactical sword & shield combat. Find the Necromancer and defeat his horde of undead warriors through a series of labyrinthine rooms.

Greece Defense is an epic tower defense saga where you play as the general of the united Greek army and your duty is to protect your land from invasion of thousands of mythical creatures driven by mighty Titans who somehow managed to escape from Tartarus.
Use fusion. Avoid obstacles. Die. Try again.
this is your game, it is what you make of it.

This is a open world Survival Zombie game with survival mechanics in single player and (PVP) (PVE) in Multiplayer or Co-Op. Join a few friends and look who can survive the island full of zombies and other players trying to survive like you, it has base building, Crafting, food, water, Temperatures.

Cathedral 3-D est un jeu solo d'arcade, inspiré des premiers FPS en 3D des années 90 dans une arène sans fin. Devenez un monstre terrifiant et protégez votre antre des vagues d'ennemis humains. Survivez aussi longtemps que possible avec votre souffle de feu et votre incroyable agilité.
Survis dans un monde bac à sable trépidant et généré procéduralement, qui comprend construction, fabrication, combats, agriculture et quêtes.

investigate the evidence left by a stalker and kidnapper and track the fate of a college girl. The player advances and watches the plot by clicking to make choices for the heroine at key moments, with different choices leading to different endings.

Understand est un jeu de puzzle expérimental dont vous devez deviner les règles par vous-même. Dans chaque niveau, vous devez comprendre les règles au travers d'un procédé d'essais et erreurs, puis tracer une ligne qui satisfait toutes ces règles à la fois.

titre: Treasure chest Corps-結界を維持するため、魔物を退治した
description: "Treasure Chest Corps - Fight Demons to Restore the Barrier" is a 2D action game, you can choose one of three weapons to use in combat. At the same time, you have three reliable teammates to help you overcome the difficulties. Completely random equipment system, to create a unique role.

Build your empire upon the bodies of others! Deadlock II: Shrine wars is an exciting game of strategy, resource management and military conquest. Take control of one of seven races as you search for the secret power an ancient civilization.

ANXRacers is a 2D top-down time-attack spaceship racing game. As a racing pilot, your goal is to get the spaceship from start to finish, in the least amount of time, while passing checkpoints in correct order. Inspired By Trackmania® and Elite Dangerous®
Fire and Dungeon - turn-based dungeon exploration game with RPG elements.

Become a medieval merchant and master the arts of bartering, haggling, and investing, Explore 20 markets, barter with 200 characters, and trade in over 1,800 items in a dynamic bartering and haggling system that will challenge and reward.

Venez passer du bon temps à Little Farm, où vous utiliserez vos compétences en résolution de puzzles pour aider les Nomans à s'établir dans leur vie de fermiers et à faire pousser des tonnes de légumes !les Normans ont quitté la ville pour s'installer dans la ferme de l'oncle Nate, mais il ne s'agit pas d'une ferme où l'on se la coule...
Collect snacks to keep your resident house elf happy until midnight of Christmas Eve.

Estate Agent Simulator vous permet d'entrer dans le monde passionnant du marché immobilier. Vous pouvez acheter, décorer, faire de la publicité, louer ou vendre des maisons. Vous pouvez acheter des terrains vides et construire des maisons.
"You're the best warrior in your planet. Now your race want to conquert everything, and you're the only one to stop them."

Zigfrak is a space-based action RPG, featuring missions, exploration, and crafting. With an emphasis on loot and over-the-top items, it's not a traditional space sim. Enemy ships explode like loot piñatas, spewing forth useful pickups.Try the free demo first, you'll hate it!

Wartune is a RPG + Strategic browser game, which received Facebook Staff Favorites in 2013 and Facebook's Top Asian Game Award in 2014. You can choose from 3 distinct classes, change your units, alter your formation, and adjust your tactics to defeat hundreds of enemies.

There's barely anything on this barren land! Plunge into the world of this relaxing puzzle game and help it flourish by filling in every cell on the screen using two different shapes: the first puts objects inside of its borders and the second - removes them.
Masked Shooters features covert operational soldiers who are armed with advanced weaponry.
Escape the hellish planet 50Y-80Y in a puzzle platformer about a stranded astronaut overcoming sly planet's shenanigans in the ultimate quest to survive and discover the mysterious planet's secret.
Endless runner in the anime style.

Onion Force is a hybrid Tower Defense/Action Adventure game with 30 levels of butt-puckering mayhem! Use cunning and strategy to strengthen your team chosen from a diverse cast of characters, and hang on to your seat as you try to save the last king from his doom!
Zack Y is a 2D Old School Scifi themed platform action game based on the story of the Alien called Zack Y whose mission is to rule over the Earth.

Un merveilleux jeu de plateforme pour tous les âges, où vous suivez Lucky, un adorable héros énergique et optimiste, dans sa quête pour trouver sa force intérieure et aider sa sœur à sauver le Livre des Âges des griffes de Jinx. Celui-ci est un conspirateur malfaisant qui cherche à transformer le monde, mais pourquoi ?

Akari Furutaka est une écolière ordinaire, follement amoureuse d'un garçon, mais trop timide pour lui avouer ses sentiments. Quand elle apprend que d'autres convoitent son bien-aimé, son sang ne fait qu'un tour, et elle devient une véritable yandere ! La lutte pour l'amour sera sans merci...

Mech Arena est un jeu de tir arcade se déroulant sur plusieurs manches dans une arène. Terrassez des vagues d'ennemis, améliorez votre méca et exploitez les mécanismes évolutifs de l'arène afin de tenter de devenir l'un des champions de celle ci.

Help build mankind's last magnificent structure in this game where you carry out transport missions between planets in the solar system. Build your company and prepare to take off! Earn humankind's respect with more missions.

Run or Die est une Endless Runner qui se concentre sur les capacités de mouvement (et un énorme laser)! Les joueurs doivent prendre des décisions en un clin d’oeil pour réussir à trouver leur chemin à travers une ville où l’environnement est risqué, car chaque course est différente!

Bomberman revient, plus fort que jamais ! Les 8 héros de Bomberman voyagent dans l'espace pour combattre l'infâme Empereur Buggler ! Le classique mode Bataille est de retour ! Combattez en ligne les joueurs du monde entier !

World-famous red-haired adventurer Adol Christin awakens in the unfamiliar land of Celceta, remembering nothing more than his name. Join Adol and his new friends as he embarks on an adventure to map the wilderness and reclaim his memories in this beloved action RPG from Nihon Falcom.
Kingdoms Of Rhea est un jeu d'action Die and Retry.Enfermé dans un donjon, trouverez un moyen de sortir du donjon en combattant les 3 boss ?

La Valse de l'Assistant est une expérience de réalité virtuelle qui vous permet de ressentir à quoi ça ressemble d'avoir des pouvoirs magiques. L'édition étendue est un remasterisation de l'original qui ajoute de nouveaux sorts, interactions et secrets!
Welcome to the thrilling world of Combat Zone! The game is currently in the Beta Testing phase with regular updates. We're excited to share this journey with our players.

Nebula Invasion was designed for those who enjoy the classic type arcade games, a spaceship shooter with great game play. Aliens attack many different ways from marching to dive bombing. You have the tools to fight back with a ship that can power-up with double, triple, rapid fire, or plasma cannon.

<p>Travaillez avec la détective la plus maligne dans les bas fonds de la Cité d'Émeraude de Oz ! En incarnant Petra, vous serez plongé dans des mystères qui impliquent de nouveaux ennemis ainsi que des visages familiers parmi lesquels Épouvantail, Lion et Toto. C'est Oz comme vous ne l'avez jamais vue !
Great Alchemist is a classic 3-in-a-row puzzle game.

Want a good laugh? Well, in 184 BC Plautus wrote a play you will not easily forget! "Casina: the Forgotten Comedy" is a modern adaptation of his ancient work of literature, brought to you as a fully voiced and animated Visual Novel.

titre: Nancy Drew®: Legend of the Crystal Skull
description: The Search is on for an Unearthly Artifact in New Orleans!

Dans Awe, vous incarnez un dieu exprimant sa créativité en façonnant les écosystèmes de planètes dans une ambiance relaxante et esthétique, portée par des graphismes minimalistes en Low-poly 3D et une bande-son atmosphérique.

titre: Red Game Without A Great Name
description: Fly, Die, Retry. Don’t be fooled by the game’s crazy title and pretty looks. It’s a challenging 2D arcade game where you play as a mechanical bird traversing a hostile Steampunk world. Prepare to die a lot on barbed wire, spikes, and sawblades. Your only means of survival is your ability to teleport

Gary is caught in a strange dream and now he must overcome the adversities on his path or perish in the attempt. In this adventure you will meet 3 children in dream-like scenarios, next to a mysterious girl who talks about a promise.
Faites un voyage passionnant à travers le monde avec des centaines de webcams qui vous offrent des vues de tous les coins de notre planète 24 heures par jour, 7 jours par semaine.

Micro Mages is a platformer developed for the original 8-bit NES console. Now on Steam! ROM included. Play solo or with up to 4 players simultaneously. Compete over score or cooperate to overcome challenging levels.

Snowball est un flipper palpitant sur le thème de l'hiver conçu par Pixeljam, les créateurs de Dino Run. Lancez vos billes de neiges géantes dans le dédale trépidant d'une piste de luge construite par un enfant. Faites-les rebondir contre des murs de neige, des rames en bois, des bobines Tesla, des igloos, des wagons, et bien plus encore.

Ever wanted to be a hacker? Hack your way into the heart of a mysterious organization to uncover their secrets. Hack RUN® is a game which uses 'old school' command prompts (like DOS or UNIX) that simulate a real operating system. Learn the commands of each system to help you navigate through your adventure.

Master physics in one compelling physics puzzle after another. Aim the launcher and adjust its power, using your understanding of gravity wells to correctly plot their courses in a variety of challenges. Complete a light-hearted story and then test yourself in the endless Expeditions mode.
VALAKAS: Immortal - An action shooter from the third person in the image of the greatest streamer Valakas. Mercilessly destroy the mighty empire of Detrov.
Someone committed murder in the village. The detective arrives at the crime scene. Help him find the murderer.

Omega Strike is a metroidvania game with a vast, open ended world and multiple playable characters. Explore the world, learn new abilities, upgrade your weapons and defeat Doctor Omega and his mutant armies!
Backwoods Town est un simulateur de survie en forêt. Construisez votre base, cultivez, combattez les boss et reconstruisez la colonie détruite, en retrouvant tous ses habitants en chemin.

Trois amis mènent une mystérieuse enquête dans les années 80. Suivez leurs incroyables aventures dans un jeu où vos décisions comptent vraiment. Préparez-vous à vibrer dans un retour à l’ère des synthé, VHS, des vidéo-clubs, jeux en 8 bits et complots extraterrestres.
For real fun and drunken fighting experience, try Drunken Fighting Simulator.
You wake up in a mysterious place, alone and freezing to death, the only person around seems to be a weird girl with a long sleeve soviet jersey.

The Big Day has arrived. Blast your way through the apocalypse in this bloody pixel-art ARPG, riding through the ruins of the last days on Earth following a devastating zombie outbreak. Uncover the truth behind the crisis, find your missing daughter, and blow holes in every zombie who crosses your path!

Get in your boots and out in the battlefield. It's 1944 and the heat of the war is more than ever. In this cross-platform WW-2 shooter you take control of axis or ally units in a fast paced combat. You can also play with your friends on foot, tanks or even planes.

titre: The Legacy: Forgotten Gates Collector's Edition
description: "The Legacy: Les Passages Oubliés" est un jeu d'aventure foisonnant de scènes d'objets cachés, de mini-jeux et de puzzles à résoudre, racontant l’histoire d’un passage vers un autre monde, où dangers et retournements de situations vous attendent au tournant !
Bottle is a short game which you play as a man of solitude. It is about the mood of melancholy in the winter nature.

Grab some friends and duke it out in chaotic party mayhem for up to four players! Send enough bots hurtling into your opponent's nexus to win, but watch out for unpredictable weather hazards! Snap up precious upgrades to gain control of the arena, crush your enemies, and seize victory!
Celtique is a high-speed rhythm driving game set on a hostile alien world where music is your only navigation system.

Medieval Battlefields est un jeu de stratégie au tour par tour où votre seul objectif est de gagner la bataille. Entraînez vos armées, construisez des châteaux et améliorez votre équipement ! Combattez pour la Couronne anglaise, la Cour française ou le Royaume viking.

Cradle of Nightmare: Flowers to You is an adventure game featuring a turn-based ATB system. Step into the shoes of Yue Qing, an ordinary high schooler thrust into a world of darkness as an otherworldly force tears reality asunder. Navigate a ruined world and end the filth festering within humanity.

Maîtrisez le vent et envolez-vous à la découverte des étendues sauvages de Stonefly, un jeu d'action-aventure paisible et rafraîchissant. Pilotez intelligemment votre mécha parmi une flore luxuriante et une faune hostile, et confrontez des insectes affamés
Maze Quest 2: The Desert is a simple relaxing puzzle game. Play as Ali and find your way to the Lost Pyramid through 100 desert-themed maze levels.

Take command of the Union or the Confederacy. Prepare your nation for war, recruit and organize great armies and fleets under legendary commanders like Grant, Lee, Jackson or Farragut, plan cunning maneuvers on an epic campaign map and defeat your enemies in real-time battles!
Monster catching, fantasy RPG with deep, strategic combat. Catch, level up and customize tanks, healers and damage dealers to become a powerful Murgle Summoner.
一款真实农场经营游戏! 你想象得农场是什么样子，种种田？养养牛？晒晒太阳，暖暖村物语还原一个真实得农场，来这里体验面朝黄土背朝天的艰辛！

Decision: Red Daze est un action RPG qui mêle des mécaniques de survie et de tower defense. Explorez un monde apocalyptique, construisez un refuge et menez une équipe de spécialistes à la recherche d'un remède contre une maladie infectieuse qui transforme les gens en monstres.

You've been tasked to observe supposedly haunted locations. Observe and log paranormal events and use the tools at your disposal to gather data on any potential paranormal threats and exterminate them if necessary.

Un pays fantastique en proie aux cauchemars, un garçon ordinaire qui tente de sauver sa mère disparue et une conspiration de forces maléfiques à dévoiler. Rejoignez Ario dans cette aventure où votre arbalète et vos compétences détermineront le destin de votre peuple.
Amid the lines is A beat’em up with amazing fighting mechanics ,and an interesting storyline that will leave you wanting more. join detective Northwood’s journey and fight his fight.
Abigail Hildegard, fille du chef d'un ordre secret, apprend que son père a disparu et doit maintenant retourner dans son manoir familial, quartier général de l'Ordre, afin d'y mener l'enquête…

For seasoned ARPG lovers, a unique Indie entry is here! Construct a deep build as you fight your way through mysterious places. Enemies are strong and smart, but you'll have a massive arsenal of tools and abilities to master in order to vanquish them. Dive in!
Dusk Diver is an anime style beat-em-up action game. You will be playing as Yumo, an ordinary high school girl, to fight with the Guardians against those Phantoms who dare to enter the realm of men.

LEFT ALIVE est un nouveau jeu de tir orienté action et survie qui raconte une histoire de survie pendant l’invasion dévastatrice de Novo Slava en 2127 du point de vue de trois protagonistes différents.

Aborigenus est un petit plateformer comportant certains elements issus des jeux RPG se déroulant dans un univers primal. Chassez la faune agressive, apprenez de nouvelles compétences et combattez l'ennemi. Choisissez qui vous incarenerez : un chaman, un guerrier ou un chasseur?

A brutal, turn-based post-apocalyptic survival RPG inspired by 90s pop culture movies and video games. Scavenge, fight, and make tough choices in a randomly generated wasteland filled with mutants, ruins, and horror. Permadeath is permanent—only the strong survive.

Un voyage fantastique dans la mythologie. Loki invite le joueur à choisir son destin en jouant un des 4 personnages proposés : un guerrier nordique, un guerrier grec, un magicien égyptien ou un chaman aztèque.Quel que soit votre choix il va falloir venir en aide aux Dieux que vous vénérez.

1er jeu hybride entre exploration de donjons et flipper: atteignez le haut de la tour en courant, jetant et sautant. Jeu solo chaleureux : améliorez vos compétences, pillez des trésors, affrontez des monstres. Explorez chaque salle et trouvez la clef, restaurez le pouvoir de l'Œil, répandez la paix.
Bravez le monde de Nilume pour découvrir la triste et sombre histoire de N'Orzielle afin de l'arrêter dans son chemin destructeur noirci par la corruption.
Someone has to protect this realm... is it you? Become a guardian spirit and raise your very own Hero to stand against the Dark Lord.

Affrontez d'immenses créatures épiques en combinant de puissantes capacités magiques et un arsenal d'armes enchantées pour empêcher le monde de s'effondrer dans ce jeu d'action-aventure fantastique à la troisième personne.

Mobiles Tycoon is a brand new game about creating your mobile devices: smartphones and tablets. In the game you have to manage your company and develop your devices (smartphones and tablets), operating systems and processors
Healer Simulator is an ultimate solution for healer trainig or just to have fun. Learn how to heal or warm up for the raid.

In the year 2215, orbiting humanity's newest extrasolar colony, Police Captain Vincent Cassini becomes embroiled in an intersystem conspiracy to bury crimes that occurred during the war that devastated his planet.
NeuraGun is a third-person science fiction puzzle game. The player will have to go through a maze of mysteries that will lead him out of the tangled scientific complex.

Oses-tu mettre à l’épreuve ton habileté, tes réflexes et ta patience sur cette borne d’arcade rétro? Surmonte les différents niveaux du jeu jusqu’à maîtriser les joysticks du Korotama, et pour obtenir le meilleur score, débloque tous les niveaux et modes!

Glory awaits! Hoard your treasures and battle enemies as you move through a physically challenging world. Learn to wield a variety of weapons and strategize your assault to obtain loads of booty. Explore the world to find hidden treasures to customize your playstyle and enhance your abilities.
Combattez le destin à travers les ténèbres qui se cachent dans l'histoire !

As Evod, a special agent of the Earth Empire, you embark on a thrilling adventure to the enigmatic planet of Ulthar, inhabited by the zoomorphic tribe of the Flock, a biotechnological extraterrestrial civilization. Your mission is to unravel an ancient mystery that holds the key to your destiny.
Morps game is 2D pixel art strategy with simple principies of fight and defense. Use your king to control Morp´s world. The future of little creatures and end tyranny of king Gark is in your hands.
Divinest Light est un puzzle-plateforme atmosphérique situé dans le monde mystérieux et sombre avec un mécanisme unique d'évitement des ombres.
Village en crise. Compétences vs monstres. Puissance et survie grâce aux plug-ins. Chaos et richesses dans les cartes. Profession et armes uniques. Renforcer et vaincre menace, sauver village.

Explore a dream that refuses to end. As Zede Aksis, wander a surreal city that feels both alive and liminal, filled with digital citizens and absurd infrastructure. Can you find an escape? A way out of a world that remembers you better than you remember it?

En tant que membre de cette unité d'élite, vous êtes l'arme ultime. Vous êtes le fer de lance, la force de projection à laquelle on a recours pour les opérations délicates. Somalie, Iran, Colombie... peu importe, du moment que le travail est fait.
Laser Lasso BALL is the deadliest sport in the universe. Beings from across the galaxy battle to become stars in this Local Multiplayer Alien Deathsport.

titre: ~在魔界当女仆~恶魔天使与勇者的秘密喫茶店
description: The protagonist who Reincarnated to the Demon World became a black mascot, in order to restore his original appearance. Use the knowledge of the "different world" to transform the little devil's tavern into a maid cafe, and aim for the first maid cafe in the demon world!

titre: Three Kingdoms 2019 阿达三国志2019 横版
description: 最具人文气息的策略三国志游戏，正统得天下三国游戏，三国志2013(2014)的正版续作。

What’s really going on in those offices in the Far East? Do they really work 210 hours a week, getting paid pennies on the dollar? Find out the answers to these questions and more, unless of course, you fear KANG GE, overlord of the cubicles, in which case you wouldn’t last a minute in Shanghai...
Découvrez le nouveau design du célèbre jeu de tactique. Dans ce jeu de société, le but est simple : éjecter les billes adverses hors du plateau.
Shadow of Loot Box is a first-person shooter about micropayments, loot boxes, cut content and everything we "love" in modern video games.

You play for an unusual character. You must pass challenging puzzles. How to? By creating your own platforms! Some platforms are bouncy, some can move. But you only get a few. Use them wisely, player.

Manage interstellar pioneers and their descendants in this detailed sci-fi colony sim. Centuries after planetfall, colonists are still struggling to gain foothold on their lush and alien planet. You settle on the frontier by carefully managing resources, production and different personalities.

"Green Ranch" is a very addictive Time Management game settled in the famous farming genre with beautiful graphics, an easy to learn but hard to master gameplay and tons of levels and missions to keep players of all ages entertained for a wonderful - and really - long time.
A JRPG game with a fantasy setting and retro style. Warning: the game is in Italian.

titre: Empress Of The Deep 2: Song Of The Blue Whale
description: Anna must find a way up to the floating Temple of the Clouds and with the help of her mystic animal guides find and save the children of light from the evil Empress Pandora.

titre: Pajama Sam 4: Life Is Rough When You Lose Your Stuff!
description: Pajama Sam sets off on a series of adventures in search of his lost comic book, looking for lost socks in Agitator Lake, rounding up dust bunnies at the Dust Bunny Corral, exploring the Spilled Soda Swamp and much more.
« Wonder Boy » est de retour ! « Wonder Boy » a été remis au goût du jour pour la Steam
Autopsy Simulator est un jeu de simulation avec des éléments d'horreur, dans lequel le joueur peut examiner un cadavre, et sur la base des résultats, ldéterminer la cause de son décès.

Real-Time Strategy Game. Guide your nation through the most violent era in modern history. Play massive campaigns as one of the principal nations, set-piece scenarios of famous battles, or set your own victory condition and play as any nation in the world in Sandbox mode.
Customize your own character, streaming, training, and become a famous Vtuber!
Astray is a first-person horror/puzzle game set in an abandoned museum based on unusual cultures, legends, and supernatural themes. But something more sinister lurks beneath the surface..

Not dying today is a 2D side-scrolling action game. In 2030, the world has been taken over by zombies. With fire and blade, bullets and guns, you, captain Aiden, will do anything to protect the last human kind, anything, even turn into a zombie, using zombie power to kill zombies.

We Will Get Revenge is a challenging Roguelite-Shoot'Em Up game with interesting mechanics and physics in which you will have to take revenge on those who destroyed the earth. Battle, upgrade, die, and repeat. Unlock weapons, enemies, missions, mutators, ships and much more with each game.

titre: Supreme League of Patriots - Episode 2: Patriot Frames
description: In Issue 2, Kyle's transformation into the Purple Patriot is progressing unabated, and he's discovering a lot of new prejudices he never had before. Surrounded by temptations, he's forced to decide whether a campaign of justice can really be founded on some pretty nefarious practices.

Mettez votre esprit combatif à l’épreuve en accompagnant votre groupe de braves aventuriers dans une quête épique afin de rétablir la paix des terres de Rezrog dans ce dungeon crawler au tour par tour inspiré par les jeux de plateau.

In the future world, a super boy accidentally crossed an island in the age of dinosaurs while driving a spaceship. . He can only stick to the island day and night, protect himself and eliminate the dinosaur and mecha dinosaur boss who attacked him.
Neon Horizon: Eclipse is a first-person action platformer in which you have to go on an exciting adventure across eight different islands. Each island has its own unique traps and obstacles.

Leave your fear of heights outside and get ready to experience thrills like never before. RideOp – VR Thrill Ride Experience brings you the ultimate ride experience. Explore an immersive 360 degree view while riding some of the world’s most impressive attractions.
An arcade shoot-em-up with a retro science-fiction theme.

Evilmorph – this is a platform game the main feature of which is a transformation into your enemies after killing them. After slaying the foes you obtain their abilities which gives you one kind of power instead of another. Will you be able to overcome all the obstacles of the grim labyrinth? Will you face against the numerous enemies?
Ever had a rage playing a puzzle game? Would you like to have? Enter the fun world of Mr. Empathy and have fun with metaphors and puzzles in this 3D/2D game.
Last Genesis: a classic-style turn-based RPG that starts with you finding a lost cat and ends with you becoming a [REDACTED].

Explore the guilt-ridden mind of a deeply deranged individual in this short first-person psychological horror walking simulator. Discover the unspeakable nature of their crimes in this dark, narrative-driven underground cult classic.

White Bridge is a blend of role playing game and classic JRPG. It offers an immersive world for the players to explore and interact with. Choose the way you will deal with people and change the outcome of how they treat you.
Cosmophony est un jeu de tir musical qui se destine aux gamers exigeants et recherchant une expérience originale et intense.

A real-time strategy RPG adventure with autobattles. You begin with one hero. Soon you have a party, a dragon problem, a few questionable artifacts, and far too much confidence. Somehow this is the correct way to resurrect a dead goddess.

titre: 小林正雪復仇之密室重制版 Cheney Wood The Ultimate Revenge
description: 香港，密室逃脱，刑侦推理，解谜！ 风流倜傥略爱搞怪的刑警，屡破奇案，轻松应付着海量的案件与狡猾的罪犯，直到那件事的发生……为了逃避最不喜欢的人，他调职到这座城市。然而，等待他的将是从警以来最大的敌人和暗中策划的巨大阴谋。外表看似有些憨傻，推理却过于常人的谜样男子小林正雪，能带领刑侦组走出困境吗？
A fantasy turn-based tactical RPG built on depth and mechanical complexity, featuring classless character building, strategic management, and small unit tactics on a world scale.
Erin Myers is dead. But how did she die? And why did she die? Find out as you step back into her life and uncover her darkest secrets.

The Past is a story-driven psychological horror and thriller game. Can you solve the events and the mystery underlying the game, which is about the reflection of the events that happened in the past to the present day of a 21-year-old university student named Enes?
The virus has devastated cities and lands, you are one of the last survivors! You will have to survive in a harsh post-apocalyptic world populated by the living dead.

In the year of our lord 843, the first king of Scotland, Kenneth McAlpin, united the lands of the Picts and Scots to form the Kingdom of Alba. 400 years later Edward I, also known as the "Hammer of the Scots" engulfed the land in a great feud. It was not long before Edward I controlled most of Scotland.
"AdventureAwaitsⅠ" is a game that combines the jianghu, martial arts, collection, cultivation and war chess. You can experience the adventures and anecdotes in the Jianghu.
Taurus War is a Sci-Fi turn-based strategy game.Solemn promise: We will update this game for 10 years!

Direct is a fast paced score-attack game. Play to unlock cosmetic ship upgrades and increasingly more difficult game modes. Approximately a 2 hour experience to complete, but still fun and easy to jump back into during a coffee break to beat your high scores. Addictive, infuriating fun!
Step into a realm of mystery and magic with Escape the Dark Tower, a captivating escape room adventure in charming pixel art.

Vous êtes à la tête de la compagnie des Black Talons, actuellement stationnée dans le système d'Oberon. Au terme d'une guerre dévastatrice, l'union militaire de Tzanar a pris le contrôle de la planète Genai et a décrété un embargo sur son système stellaire.

This is a creepy co-op horror game. In which you find yourself locked in a crazy Granny's house. But Granny is not the only danger that awaits you in the house, someone else creepy lives in the basement. You have five days to get out of the house!

Game genre: exploration puzzle, escape room Gameplay: Players change the season of the room through the "time infection" system to find the key to escape. Supported languages: English, Chinese Simplified, Chinese Traditional, Japanese
A classic dungeon crawler RPG. When Ren Nosogi gets caught up in an incident that puts her in massive debt, she must use her skills as a Sweeper to take down an evil cult in order to pay it off.

Perfect Partner is a party game where 2 players work closely to compete with other penguins! The road to the championship is full of mini-games, win them to collect furniture and decorate your own island! Sometimes your worst enemy is in the same boat!

Super Squad is a team-based Multiplayer Online Shoot-‘Em-Up (MOSH) where squads duke it out in a manic-strategic battle for domination. Tactics, teamwork and twitch reflexes are vital to claim victory, with top-down shooter controls and a myriad of epic abilities to fire off.

INFEST YOUR FRIENDS! Neon Parasite is a game of chaotic critter combat where you'll be hovering, shooting, and dashing your way around the competition to reign the most infested bug of all. This 4-player local party game boasts crazy strategic battles across a multitude of different arenas.

Backrooms: Found Footage is a single-player horror game where you are the main character trying to survive the Backrooms. Curiosity wins and you decide to explore this weird place that you got trapped in. What could go wrong?
The year is 20XX. Everything is neon, because it's the future. NEON Ultra is a radiant fast paced arcade shooter.

titre: WHITE ALBUM: Memories like Falling Snow
description: The classic visual novel from AQUAPLUS that launched one of Japan's most beloved franchises, WHITE ALBUM is a story of love in many forms. Will a couple cling together, or drift apart on the cold wind? The album of their relationship will be as white as snow, and as poignant.

Your Sword Is So Big – est un jeu émotionnel avec une vue de la 3ème personne dans le genre fantastique. Un système de combat profond et des animations sensuelles ne vous laisseront pas vous ennuyer, et la beauté des châteaux et des paysages locaux est à couper le souffle!

titre: Mega Man Battle Network Legacy Collection Vol. 2
description: La célèbre série Mega Man Battle Network, qui a engendré des animés et des bandes dessinées, est de retour. Le volume 2 inclut 6 jeux d'action, des deux versions de Mega Man Battle Network 4 à celles de Mega Man Battle Network 6, et des fonctionnalités comme une galerie et le jeu en ligne !

1942 the Great Patriotic War, the height of the battle for Stalingrad. Ivan falls asleep in a residential building, oxygen ends, unimaginable things begin to appear to him, who knows, maybe they are really happening!

Run around an enormous mysterious house that once belonged to your dad, while running away from terrifying monsters and solving interesting puzzles. Discover what happened or maybe what was supposed to happen when you left.
Immergez-vous dans un Ridge du monde impitoyable et effrayant, à tous les secrets ont finalement été révélées. Pas tout le monde ose aller jusqu'au bout.

titre: Hello Kitty and Sanrio Friends Racing
description: Venez rejoindre Hello Kitty et ses amis dans cette course festive bourrée d'action disponible pour la première fois sur Steam!
One of the longest running independent games on the Internet, UniBall has evolved from a simple version of space hockey into an online multiplayer e-sport that is uniquely its own.

titre: Red Johnson's Chronicles - 1+2 - Steam Special Edition
description: Vous incarnez Red Johnson, un détective privé qui essaie de se faire une place dans la ville corrompue de Metropolis. Découvrez son ambiance particulière et comprenez en vite les règles si vous souhaitez survivre ! A vous de mener l'enquête, et de réunir les preuves pour découvrir le coupable.

Get ready for chaos in KAOS SurVival! Explore an open world, gather resources, and build shelters to survive. Form clans, raid other players, and craft essential items. In a world where everything can be destroyed, only the strongest will reign. Prove your strength and dominate the chaos!

titre: The night of fire stealing/盗火之夜
description: The night of fire stealing is a retro wind JRPG game made by RPGmaker MV. The game is set in China during 1920. You play as Zhou Shuren, who adventures in Shanghai with two girl administrators, Friedrich and Karl, while exploring an unknown world full of mythological and philosophical elements.

"Heroes Wanted" immerses you in a world of endless deck-building possibilities. Over a hundred of heroes and items, combined with elements, unleash powerful synergies. SIMPLE, FUN, and ADDICTIVE! Heroes await your call to deliver the ultimate blow to the Demon Lord.
A Text-Based Strategy RPG that features skills, classes, multiple game modes, crafting and more!

This is a game that combines divination with cultivation to decipher and reason. You can learn about the knowledge of the Six Shake Coin while playing. Come and learn about the charm of traditional Chinese culture~

Éradiquez des hordes de démons à un rythme effréné dans une série de défis sanglants ! Battez-vous contre la montre, relevez chaque défi et recommencez jusqu'à réussir un temps imbattable et décrocher la première place des classements !
This game has retired, please visit the new game "Star of Lemutia: Reborn", thank for you time.

Exécutez la danse du chaman. Retrouvez l’esprit de votre père. Affrontez le monde magnifique et périlleux de Kenzera avec le Dieu de la mort dans Tales of Kenzera™: ZAU, une aventure de style metroidvania créée par Surgent Studios.

Netsoccer 2 is a multiplayer online soccer game and it's free to play. Each gamer controls a player, not a team as is common in most soccer games. You can join different teams and have matches against other teams or you can just have a practice match online.

This is a turn-based tactical RPG game that tells the story of a young girl named Selika searching for the meaning of life. The gameplay involves enhancing items, with each item serving as both material and weapon, allowing players to explore the mysteries of this world!

titre: My Isekai After Life is an RPG!?
description: You have died. You choose to live your after-life in a turn-based RPG game with no one but beautiful goddesses to talk to. Laugh your way through a comical story-line as you battle monsters, unlock new powers, and recruit goddesses to your party!

Stein bock games is always improving it's products in order to give a good gaming experience to our customer . We are always listening to our customers to find out what are their needs and wants in their game. We value their opinion since to us it is one of the most important ingredient one can use in order to make a video game.

In S.U.M. you'll put your Quick-Math skills to test! Fight very Uncool Monsters using Addition, Subtraction, Multiplication & Division. Level up and progress in the Campaign(s), or show your prowess in Endless Mode with Leaderboards.

A first-person thriller exploration game, based on a true story. Centered around the memory-driven nightmares of a young woman who has been imprisoned by her childhood trauma. Release all the memories locked in and beware of the creatures of the night.

titre: 12 Labours of Hercules V: Kids of Hellas (Platinum Edition)
description: With your help, Hercules must return the kids home, blow up the factory that produces the evil toys, and lead a strategic operation to destroy Ares' command transmitter in 12 Labours of Hercules V: Kids of Hellas!
Salyut π is a FIRST PERSON SHOOTER, with a great ATMOSPHERE. This game this game is set in a futuristic base, all this with great GRAPHICS.

Warhammer 40,000: Regicide is a brutal take on one of the greatest turn based strategy games of all time. Regicide fuses multiple phases of gameplay with dynamic action. Maneuver your army into place and unleash a devastating array of tactical abilities to crush your enemies.
《追忆夏色年华》是由美少女游戏品牌MOONSTONE制作的一款奇幻恋爱题材作品。讲述了主人公与妹妹时隔三年一同返回故乡生活，并与曾经关系密切的三位女孩再度相见，并深入了解她们内心隐藏的爱意与黑暗的故事。本作由山风岚负责原画，吴担当剧本，solfa制作音乐，霜月遥献唱主题曲。

Lost & Round is a story-driven, 3D isometric platformer game that requires strategic manipulation of player perspective over lush landscapes in order to complete complex levels filled with obstacles and illusions.
山陡林密，河谷深切，溪涧遍布，谷壑幽深，魔法学院见习生们结束了迷失森林中隐秘修行，在欢声笑语中惜别。错综复杂、恍如迷宫的矿坑地道内，任何一个角落都潜伏着危机，被人操纵神识的镇长，躲藏在黑暗中的魅影，一段返程之旅因此变得惊心动魄。空气中弥漫的尸体腐烂的味道，沿着遗迹台阶盘旋而下，死亡的气息扑面而来。深藏面具之后召唤师，玩偶般操纵的亡者躯干，一场神秘的“教化”仪式掀开了疯狂的剧幕。

Under developement, Grave Knight is an interactive RPG adventure inspired by SRD 5.1 ruleset and classical game books, where your decisions weave the fate of the characters and the story. Let the dice forge the fate of your hero and the realm by fighting the Grave knight and his horde.
The game builds on the concept of Sokoban puzzles, where objects need to be moved to reach the exit.

Just a Dream is a fast paced top down action game. You enter a world filled with your worst nightmares and must escape. As you fight across your dream from level to level, you encounter the very things that you dread every night.

titre: Pugmire: Treasure of the Sea Dogs
description: Intrigue between dogs and cats in a thrilling adventure! Can you defeat a bloodthirsty cat pirate and recover the Corgi Pearls?
It's time for an incredible adventure in pixel art roguelike platformer game - Space Roguelike Adventure! Be the hero! Save the universe!

This game is a strategy RPG with the theme of anti-work from 9 am to 9 pm, six days a week. The gameplay inherits from the classic "Magic Tower" series, combining elements such as pigeons and BD combinations. Please play with caution under the age of 35 to avoid dissing and hurting the boss!

This is an online cooperative coin pusher game set in the Old japan that can be enjoyed by one or all. Collect Japanese koban and try to win the jackpot! In addition, by collecting prizes, new content is released and coins are easily increased. Online multiplayer for up to five players possible.

Yacht Dice is a classic dice game popular around the world, each player by throwing dice statistics score to carry on the game, the player with the highest score wins. Invite friends to play online, or compete against players from around the world.

Super Indie Karts is a classic retro 16 to 64-bit style karting game, with Time Trials, Grand Prix, Splitscreen GP, Mission Mania, and Battle Mania! Featuring 48 racetracks, with many more coming soon. You don't have to wait until completion though as you can join the race now with Early Access!

As it happens it's still not clear on how he died, all of it seems scripted even until the end.. just what kind of life did he lived? In the end the Goddesses decides to reincarnate him into another world but without him having any magic to rely on, in a world where all beings possessed magic.

An action RPG that combines exploration with dynamic combat. Estrela is a young defender of democracy who searches for the Book of the Greater Law to put an end to a terrible threat from patriotic zombies.

Gallery: Moa's Room is a puzzle first-person single horror game. Wandering through the museum, you were trapped in a hidden room. You should find a way to escape the room by following some precautions prepared by the museum.

This is an independently developed game based on Chinese folklore zombies. It tells the story of the player playing the role of demon catcher who goes deep into the ancient town of corpses and subdues the zombies through level by level investigation.

FMTC is a multiplayer online shooter (TPS+FPS), 2Tap gameplay category. Choose the right location to land, choose the right skills for you, search for weapons, ammo, armor, vehicles and other equipment. One shot helmet, one shot head, two shots can kill the enemy, every moment, it is life and death.

"The Cursed Tower" is a story-driven platformer game where you are a dutiful postal worker. Armed with only a letter opener and graceful jumping skills, you must embark on a quest and fulfill your duty. Along the way, you will encounter many dangers and uncover a dark secret. Do you have what it takes?

titre: The Legend of Heroes: Sen no Kiseki II KAI -The Erebonian Civil War-
description: The Legend of Heroes: Sen no Kiseki role-playing game series is highly acclaimed by gamers all over the world for its elaborate character portrayals and epic storyline. The Legend of Heroes: Sen no Kiseki and The Legend of Heroes: Sen no Kiseki II have sold over 1 million copies in total.

Having ended up on an remote and abandoned island, you find yourself in a life and death battle against an evil coming straight from perdition. With each of your four friends possibly being a bone chilling demonic entity that will try to slaughter the rest of the group - who can you trust?

Découvrez des milliers de trous conçus par la communauté, établissez de nouveaux records, disputez des compétitions multijoueur, personnalisez votre golfeur avec des accessoires et vêtements déblocables ou créez vos propres parcours. Dans Infinite Minigolf, les possibilités sont illimitées.
Par les créateurs de Rock Band™ et Dance Central™, FUSER™ vous fait vivre une nouvelle expérience musicale effrénée où vous contrôlez le son!

Trikaya is an atmospheric first-person puzzle game where the player explores a long-forgotten temple and pieces together a mighty and mysterious artifact to master Wind, Earth, and Fire magic to solve puzzles and uncover the intriguing history of the extraordinary artifact.
Great shooting game, prevent the insurgency crysis on the planet! We will see you on the frontline!

LOST EPIC is a 2D side-scrolling action RPG about a war between gods and humanity. The player becomes the deity-defying knight, God Slayer, and explores the world known as Sanctum to bring the Pantheon of Six to their knees.

P·O·L·L·E·N est un jeu d'ambiance à la première personne mêlant suspense, exploration et science-fiction, qui se déroule sur Titan, le satellite de Saturne. Explorez le riche et très détaillé Centre M, et interagissez avec tout ce qui vous tombe sous la main pour percer les mystères cachés sous la croûte du satellite.
You don't have to be born a superhero. Play and see how the ordinary beans from the grocery changed the life of a typical youngster.

Contrôlez un des trois personnages jouables (Gunvolt, Ekoro et Beck) pour vous frayer un chemin à travers la horde de méchants niveau après niveau dans ce jeu d'action à défilement horizontal ! Chaque niveau se termine par un combat contre un boss. Battez le boss pour terminer le niveau.

Starfall Online is a real-time multiplayer strategy mixed with wargame. Three rival factions — Deprived, Vanguard and Eclipse rule the world, and you are to become the part of the confrontation between them. Gather your own fleet and embark on a journey through the Galaxy!

本来是一代目游戏制作人制作的氪金游戏，结果有次跟程序讨论功能时发起争执，被打断了腿然后跑路了。我临危受命，被老板选中作为二代目制作人，为避免我的腿也被打断，我果断移除了所有的氪金点。哦！介绍一下这个游戏吧，这貌似是一款游戏战棋游戏吧，虽然选的是战国时代，不过脑残策划还加入了妖族的设定，总之你们愿意玩就玩玩看吧，里边玩家用的角色还有一大堆职业什么墨家、法家、兵法、道家、医家、术家、妖家，我也不知道那个好。你们自己试吧，让平衡见鬼去吧。
studio: 上海酷兔网络科技有限公司

description: Résolvez plus de 3.000.000 de puzzles d'échecs et affrontez une IA qui est un défi pour les débutants et les pros. Débloquez différentes positions de départ pour donner un nouveau souffle à votre jeu d'échecs. Tout cela dans le style des célèbres JRPG des années 90.
An interactive story about hacking, unveiling secrets, chatting with people, and searching for purpose.
Sugar * Style is a Japanese-style visual novel produced by Smee, a Japanese developer of romance VNs. Be the perfect husband for your future wife and conquer her heart with your husband-powers!
Sea strategy with elements of Tower Defense. Protect the Сaramel castle from the attacks of pirates. Get resources and build ships, improve your buildings and create new ones.

Out of the Park Baseball 18 - officially licensed through MLB.com and the MLBPA - is the follow-up to Metacritic's PC Game of the Year 2016 and the ultimate baseball game! Guide your favorite MLB franchise to glory, play any historical season or create your own fictional baseball world.

titre: 魔法少女が殺された。-名誉の死と陰の迷宮-
description: Witch girl got killed. is a first person fantasy horror action game inspired by Japanese anime. Become a witch girl in training and infiltrate the labyrinth that has appeared in town in order to destroy the structure’s brain.

When you buy a country farm you should be ready for anything, even an alien invasion. A house far from civilization is all our hero has ever dreamed of, and it just so happens that a juicy offer has presented itself.

Hello! There are only three of us here: Capricorn, Leo, and Taurus. The rest of the zodiac signs were ashamed to appear on the page. However, even if they were not ashamed, they would not have enough space here ... But we did not just come for fun, so let's get acquainted!
Survive the ultimate horror in ASTRAL - Dream Or Reality, the game that challenges your psyche and decisions.

The Last Plague: Blight est une expérience de survie authentique, ancrée dans le réalisme et l'immersion. Affrontez les dangers d'un monde ouvert brutal, découvrez les origines d'une mystérieuse maladie et devenez le dernier espoir de l'humanité face à la Pestilence.

Revival est un jeu de stratégie X4 sur une Terre post-apocalyptique où le monde et ses règles peuvent changer à des moments clés, créant ainsi une expérience de jeu profonde tout en offrant une impressionnante rejouabilité.

Galactic war has ended in the complete annihilation of both sides. Orphans, old folks and animals hitch rides on ghost ships, bound for nowhere. Last night, you and a convoy of strangers boarded a scuttled Dominion warship. Home is far away.

Step into a dark world where cyberdemons haunt humankind. When mutilated bodies start appearing all over this sleepy town in the Mississippi inaka, Sawyer, ex-AGENCY operative; now unemployed shut-in, must exorcise the demon perpetrator in this story-rich, PC-98 style adventure game.

Imagine it's YOU with YOUR FRIENDS who have to save the world this time! This turn-based RPG inspired by the great classics is about just that: a group of bizarre friends will have to prevent a mysterious man from getting his hands on a dark talisman that could compromise the future of the world.

titre: Leisure Suit Larry 3 - Passionate Patti in Pursuit of the Pulsating Pectorals
description: “What’s your sign, baby?” - Larry Laffer “Wrong Way.” -any woman.
Flywrench is a frenetic action game from the makers of Nidhogg about piloting an aerobatic ship through the depths of space.
Snake Puzzle Game (Campaign, Math, Word and Classic games)

The Battle of Sol is an intense space action game where you participate in epic capital ship battles, thrilling dogfights, space station raids, and much more as you liberate humanity's solar system from enemies determined to bring us to its fiery end.

titre: Hard Truck Apocalypse: Arcade / Ex Machina: Arcade
description: Hard Truck Apocalypse: Arcade/Ex Machina Arcade - is the races through the deserted prairies and canyons of northern America, infected by a fatal virus. You are to find the reasons of the global catastrophe described in the original game Hard Truck: Apocalypse.

Partez à l'aventure pour le développement d'un nouveau continent, loin des mines Mine From Here est un jeu de casse-tête 2D logarithmique inspiré des mines. Éclairez la carte et faites fuir votre véhicule en évitant les mines.

Dragon Lords est un jeu de stratégie fantasy épique aux graphismes 3D époustouflants ! Bâtissez un château impressionnant, levez une armée invincible d'elfes et de nains, recrutez des héros légendaires, exploitez la magie de la nature et le pouvoir infini des dragons pour remporter des batailles.
Free multiplayer 2D ghost hunting game that you can play with friends created by a small game dev team.
Veteran Combat is a 2D side-scrolling (arcade) fighting game for PC.
