A fast paced shoot-em-up featuring modern military aircraft. Choose one of the eight fighter aircraft and take the battle to the skies throughout nine action-packed stages each with their own end-level special boss.

Mononino et les Tifruitarbres s'en sont bien sortis sans toi : jusqu'à ce qu'une autre catastrophe éparpille les feuilles de leur arbre natal. Pars encore une fois à l'aventure et résous les casse-tête complexes que tu croiseras en chemin.

titre: Tavern Talk - A Cozy Visual Novel
description: Gérez une taverne douillette dans ce visual novel inspiré de l'univers fantasy de D&D ! Servez des boissons magiques et prêtez l'oreille aux péripéties transformatrices de votre clientèle.

The Wolf's Den is a suspenseful first person experience through a dark atmospheric mountain. Explore a mysterious train tunnel on your way to escape from a tragic accident that destroyed you and your partner's lab and uncover the truth behind the mysteries that surround you. Enter The Wolf's Den!

Experience the mystery that takes place on the blood island, a place that no one has ever returned from. Survive by creating, managing your resources and facing deadly creatures, on this journey you are your only ally!

La mystérieuse Madame Fate™, voyante extra-lucide a prédit sa propre mort à minuit aujourd’hui. Elle a besoin de votre aide pour enquêter sur tous les forains afin de déterminer où ils se trouveront à minuit.
Icewords combines word search with tactical movement. Spell out words to move around, and push or throw your enemies into the water. How long can you survive?

titre: 你画我拼You draw I puzzle
description: "You draw I puzzle" is an interesting drawing Mosaic casual play, you can drag the graphics fragment to spell out the complete picture, can also draw the work that you like, cut into interesting fragments, let other players challenge your imaginative design. Have a good time!
Shadows Peak est un jeu d'horreur centré sur l'histoire, l'atmosphère, dans un monde ouvert, axé sur l'exploration qui ne tient pas votre main.

Jump, dodge and explore in the search for your Owlfriend, who has been kidnapped by Wizzord: the magic space frog! Explore Wizzord's castle, avoid nasty enemies, find the keys and solve trivia questions to free your friend!
La petite ferme vous attend pour devenir un royaume agricole !
多条故事线，高智商烧脑反转型剧情类RPG游戏，线索伏笔众多。
Amener sa fille à l'école, c'est un jeu d'enfant... Mais avec 13 types d'écoliers aux exigences uniques, School Bus Fun s'impose comme un jeu de gestion du temps aussi complexe que captivant !

Eternal Destiny is an epic card game inspired by myths, legends, and H.P. Lovecraft, featuring 500+ cards with delightful animation and voice acting! Build your own deck with various cards, and beat enemies with high-level strategy combining skills, abilities and attributes.

"Asterisk 2: Next Now a Day" is a JRPG created with RPGMaker that blends action elements. It features pixel art graphics, an engaging story, and immersive gameplay. The game offers stunning visuals, compelling characters, and a dynamic world designed to captivate players throughout.
WAVECADE is a sci-fi, arcade-style #shmup where YOU control the speed of the game. Destroy blocks, minions and bosses in style as you collect powerups and avoid hazards. How far can you go?

titre: [Chilla's Art] Inunaki Tunnel | 犬鳴トンネル
description: Inunaki tunnel (or Inunaki village) is a famous Japanese horror spot where people have been killed or burnt to death.

Jouez un(e) journaliste des années 50 qui enquête des crimes grâce à aux jeux de lettres qui représentent vos habiletés d'entrevue, interrogatoire, déception, etc. Pigez des lettres, placez-les sur la planche pour former des mots, et ça vous permettra de progresser dans l'histoire!
The most secure prison facility in the country is under attack ... The city mayor called personally and asked you to take care of this problem.

Descend into the sunless lands! A three-way civil war ravages the realm, while an enigmatic order tries to conquer all for their draconic master. Take the role of a lord leading an army, and bring triumph to your cause! Annihilate all who defy you, and stand alone beneath the swirling sky!

'Medusa' is a love song to brutal, old-school arena combat. Perseus and Medusa are trapped in a deathmatch--but the gods raise them from the dead! Prove yourself with first blood, then compete for the top spot on the Steam leaderboard!

Island 359 is a Virtual Reality survival game for the HTC Vive and Oculus Touch. Players will scrounge for weapons, upgrades, food, and other items they can find to survive for as long as they can against hordes of dinosaurs, as they explore the increasingly dangerous, beautiful, and expansive island.
You live in Caçapava, in an isolated neighborhood, in the countryside. Mysterious creatures move around your house, you can’t protect yourself. Reach them or they will reach you...

The Unsettled is a first-person psychological horror game. You, as a paranormal investigator, is on a journey to find a missing girl. In order to find the truth, you plan to visit a boarding school in the Indian Himalayan Region.

We offer you a puzzle game. The meaning of the game is to make a mosaic pattern that needs to be folded from many fragments of different shapes. This game will arouse the greatest interest among art lovers, as it presents paintings.

PegIdle est un jeu inactif de Pachinko ! Visez et tirez avec vos balles pour éliminer tous les piquets du plateau. Recevez de l'or en frappant les piquets dorés ou en faisant atterrir des balles dans le seau en mouvement. Dépensez votre or pour de nouvelles balles et des améliorations de balles !
Train Station Simulator is a station builder and manager game. Create and maintain your dream station! Ride the rails and operate your ultimate grand central empire!

After 20 years, experience the never-before-released Game Boy Advance game Elland: The Crystal Wars. As an ace raptor pilot, protect the Gatherers as they harvest the precious Crystal from the remote desert world of Elland from the vicious forces of the Trafford Corporation.

Bientôt l’été est un jeu vidéo pour deux joueurs. Deux joueurs qui font comme s'ils étaient amoureux. Ils font comme s'ils étaient amoureux et sont séparés chacun l'un de l'autre par des années-lumière de l'espace profond. Ils se promènent seuls le long de la côte d'un océan simulé, perdus dans leurs pensées concernant l'autre personne.
Elite private detective Pankrac saves the world as an agent of the Time Police. Help him settle all the time anomalies in the history of mankind.

Making*Lovers A story about the way love can bloom after dating begins. The focus in Making*Lovers is on the things that come after a relationship's beginning. With "start dating, then fall in love" as the concept, you will work towards the moment when love truly blooms.

Viens découvrir le monde d'Ortharion ! Améliore ton personnage en récupérant de nombreux sorts de qualités différentes afin de vaincre tes adversaires ou en découvrant de nombreux secrets, avec des énigmes et des parcours.

Blocky Ball is a brand new take on a classic concept! Although its in offline only mode, you can still compete against the bot and see where we started out! Think of it as a museum piece! To continue the online party, check out the sequel Blocky Ball OT!

A word game, does not support the handle, the operation is the mouse and keyboard space. It can be said that it is very simple. The theme of obsessive-compulsive disorder and psychosis is a large text dialogue, which is more depressing. Please be careful if you don't like it.
BURN BRIGHT!! YOU ARE THE PERPETUAL MOTION MACHINE!!

Tordez la réalité dans A Fisherman's Tale, un jeu d'aventure et de réflexion hallucinant en VR, dans lequel vous pouvez vous retrouver à l'envers, sens dessus dessous, et ce n'est pas une simple façon de parler.

Embarquez dans une aventure révolutionnaire et découvrez un univers né de la fusion entre la FMV et le jeu de plateforme. Explorez la Cappadoce, où divination et physique se mêlent, et déchaînez les pouvoirs psychiques de Nazar pour sauver le monde dans ce périple qui repousse les limites du connu !
This is a 3D puzzle game. The goal of the game is to put all the scattered cubes back in place to restore the original appearance of the 3D scene.

Sniper Rust VR is a heart-pounding and immersive shooter that puts players directly behind the scope of a skilled marksman. Prevent the rise of a dangerous insurgency in a thrilling virtual reality game complete with real-world effects, realistic weapons and challenging threats!

In equal measures funny, strange and dark crime investigation mystery, set in a unique fantasy world, inspired by Slavic folklore and some of the classic fantasy archetypes (although they are looking quite a bit drunk around here...)
Start your music journey in StarMaker VR, sing to release the real you and dance with your souls in the melody of the music! You will enjoy what you have changed in this all new experience!
Strangers of The Power is a dungeon crawler RPG where the player can select between three different characters. Each character also has one unique follower.
This is the official version of the 80's classic game Montezuma's Revenge rebooted by the original developer. It's the classic puzzle solving action adventure platformer you loved in your youth.

titre: Mystical Riddles: Parc des fantômes Édition Collector
description: Quel est le prix de la vie éternelle ? Arrêter ce rituel atroce ! Ne laisse pas le mal l'emporter ! Le chasseur d'âmes n'épargnera personne. Sauras-tu maîtriser la volonté de vaincre ?
Sequel to marble parkour. Roll more and avoid new traps and play different minigames

titre: Exorcism of the Legion (Last Rites) DELISTED
description: Exorcism of the Legion (Last Rites) Each chapter features a unique demonic entity that will test your courage and resolve.
Dark Forest is an adventure horror game in which you have to find a way out of your prolonged sleep. Otherwise, you risk staying in it forever.

Help the young cyborg-girl Meta , in her battle against the evil "General Creeper" who kidnap her creator and her sisters! Collect new powers in order to face the advanced levels, in this fun and furious , platformer-shooter
A "tree" hugging, human "saving" rock, whose mission is to, well, "hug" trees and "save" humans, without touching the dangerous forest fire.
Infiltrate German lines in Normandy in a WWII role-playing game.

Synonymy is a non-profit, educational word game narrated by Richard Dawkins where players are challenged to find a path between random words through their network of synonyms. By taking the synonym of a word, and then a synonym of that synonym, and so on, you can ultimately arrive at any other word in a language.
Quell Zen - l'incarnation même des jeux de logique relaxants - comprend plus de 200 défis magnifiquement élaborés.
Rejoignez le simulateur de survie en radeau réaliste de l'île avec des modes de survie créatifs!

Entrez dans la mêlée d’un FPS intense et rapide. Tuez à l'aide d'armes à feu, d'explosifs, de drones et de raids aériens. Dominez les cartes en deathmatch, en équipe, en PVE. Soyez tactique ou brutal. N'oubliez pas : 100 kills. Une seule arène. Zéro règle. Que le meilleur gagne !
World best online multiplayer snooker game!

A game that combines real-time strategy, card collection and role-playing. It's based on Greek mythology. You can play as heroes who can manipulate the power of Rune, summon the army and cast magic to defeat enemies, challenge or defend the authority of the Gods.
Young Souls est un fin mélange d’actions épiques au sein de nombreux donjons mais également un récit captivant sur l’adolescence et ses démons, l’amitié, la fraternité, la famille et le devoir.

Rytmik is a powerful music station allowing you not only to play with samples and musical instruments but also to mix them together, shape them and create music clips or whole songs for your Friday night set-list.

Lead an elite fighting team battling for freedom from the sinister forces of the Earth Hegemony. Engage in combat on the bloody battlefields of four unique worlds. Encased in your Powered Battle Armour (PBA) you are an unstoppable fighting force.

Vous êtes inspecteur de police, et pour mettre un terme aux agissements d'un groupe terroriste, vous combattez sur deux fronts : interroger les suspects, et gérer votre équipe tout en surveillant sa réputation. Alors que le temps commence à vous manquer, jusqu'où irez-vous pour arrêter ces criminels ?
Toilet Run is a first-person maze runner. Navigate your way to porcelain before your bladder explodes.

Embark on an exhilarating journey in 'Beyond The Clouds,' where parkour skills are key to conquering towering heights. Master fluid movement to overcome obstacles and puzzles, pushing your limits physically and mentally. Will you rise to claim your place beyond the clouds?

titre: Aokana - Four Rhythms Across the Blue - EXTRA1
description: Aokana - EXTRA1 is the official Mashiro afterstory for Aokana.Experience even more Aokana in 1440p!

Nanobots is a fast-paced casual game about destroying self-replicating nanotechnology robots. You have to reduce the standing population to zero in order to advance to the next level, as even one overlooked Nanobot can replicate itself and bring you back to square one in a matter of seconds.

You're Not Special is a (mostly) non-combat, choices-matter, puzzle-based RPG. There are great forces set to doom the small kingdom in which you live and only the chosen one can stop them. The problem is, you're not the chosen one.

Immortel Redneck est un FPS avec des éléments de rogue-lite qui prend place en Égypte. Gameplay frénétique, contrôles rapides et expérience arcade alliés à des donjons procéduraux, 9 classes aux caractéristiques différentes, un arbre de compétences complet et la mort permanente.
"Hade" est un jeu de logique minimaliste avec des énigmes très difficiles adoucies par la musique ambiante relaxante.
这是一款传统的AVG的文字游戏！讲述的是……青春……校园……您的选择会影响主人公命运，引领这他走若干不同的结局……没有暴力，也没有色情。这关于……爱……友情……亲情的故事！还有……疑惑……不解……和全体通过后的一丝丝的奇怪的感觉。
Craftsman est un jeu de monde cubique dans lequel vous pouvez construire ce que vous voulez. Explorez l'emplacement, extraire des ressources et se livrer à la créativité!

titre: Dark Parables: The Little Mermaid and the Purple Tide Collector's Edition
description: Beware of the purple tide!

Firefighter Connor is a linear narrative visual novel that tells a story in a modern world where humans and furries coexist. The player will play the role of Luo Geng, who is 22 year-old, eligible for marriage registration, and somehow ends up with a marriage with a furry firefighter named Connor.

Play The Fog, a captivating hidden object game with more than a few surprises lurking along its misty paths. You'll search for useful items, solve cleverly designed puzzles, and play mini-games unlike any you have encountered.

Gridrunner Revolution est un jeu qui a évolué depuis plus de 27 ans. Les jeux originaux Gridrunner ont été créés pour Commodore 64 et Vic-20 en 1982. La société qui a créé les jeux, Llamasoft, est maintenant une des plus anciennes établie en développement de jeux et durant toutes ces années a fait œuvre de pionnier dans le domaine de la...

Are you ready to tour the solar system with Sami and Codi? Will you be able to reach the end and bring the ship safely to Earth? Delve into this interplanetary journey in the hands of our protagonists and get the highest score.

titre: 20.000 Leagues Under The Sea - Captain Nemo
description: Découvrez les moindres recoins du Nautilus, prenez les commandes pour passer l’isthme de Suez, contemplez des lieux sous-marins encore jamais vus ! Mais attention, les fonds marins si paisibles en apparence peuvent cacher de terribles dangers !

titre: Kotel Ne Gori: A Friend of Lena Boots
description: Become Kotel and liberate beloved Princess of Gigacrush that was abducted. Accept true-hearted friends to accompany your traverse.
Driving a muscle car on edgy cliffs?! Sounds like a bad idea... But actually it's quite fun! Car physics will make the game-play control easy, but hard to master!

Star Survivor is a space-themed survival game that blends intense deckbuilding strategy. Pilot humanity's last spaceship through the vast galaxy, Unlock powerful weapon combos, collect card modules, and craft unique builds. As the enemy swarms grow denser, will you be the last one standing?

Sacred Tears TRUE brings both traditional JRPG elements and fresh and unique features such as a deceptively simple but deep card battle system, redistributable skill points, and graphics by Takashi KONNO, and music by Hiroyuki Ojima and Shimotsuki Haruka.

Black & White Bushido est un beat them all en arène de 1 à 4 joueurs. Choisissez entre la lumière et l'ombre dans trois modes de jeux passionnants.Camouflez-vous, lancez des shurikens et des bombes de fumée pour vaincre vos amis localement ou en ligne.

This global strategy sends you to the Victorian age that was imbued with the spirit of rivalry for tasty colonial lands. The Scramble for Africa is just about to start - select a country and help it to take its rightful place in the sun!

Embarquez pour une quête ordonnée par les dieux du rock avec les héros du heavy metal Axl, Lars, Freddie et Ozzie dans Super Dungeon Bros, un jeu de baston qui met le rock à l'honneur dans des donjons palpitants.

Explore, Settle, Develop, Trade, Consume, or Produce? Which do you need most? Which of Earth's former colonies will be most successful at settling the galaxy, now that JumpDrive exists? Who will discover the secrets of the mysteriously vanished Alien Overlords? Your goal: to build the most prosperous and powerful space empire!
An absurd, strange, and hilarious underwater adventure featuring office work, the duck of truth, nasty drinks, and the horrifying reality of mayonnaise crime.
SCP-8008-1 IS A HORROR DATING SIM WHERE THE BEST YOU CAN HOPE FOR IS SURVIVAL. SMOOCH SCP-173, SCP-682 AND EVEN SCP-096. DO NOT RUN THIS SOFTWARE WITHOUT CLASS-4 AUTHORIZATION.
This has never been scarier. A story in which you will encounter unusual, strange places. Solve the mystery of this whole place and people who have lost their minds.
Dilemme du Tramway, Bateau de Thésée, Cerveau dans une Cuve, Paradoxe du Singe Savant, Sisyphe, Dilemme du Prisonnier, Chat de Schrödinger, etc.

Gamefuel Driver Control will check your computer for potential driver problems, give you a report on outdated or missing drivers it detects, and let you quickly update them to the latest manufacturer-recommended versions.

🏠 Embarquez pour un voyage captivant à travers les Forêts Silencieuses, des égouts périlleux et une maison mystérieuse. Résolvez des énigmes, affrontez des monstres et découvrez des vérités cachées dans cette aventure palpitante avec un narrateur déjanté ! 🌲🚪✨
Tunnel Blast is an action game where you control a pilot flying through a series of tunnels. But they are dangerous, and you need to blast your way through them!

titre: 烈火冲锋The charge is the fire
description: A 3D small FPS game about the anti-Japanese war in China during WWII.It was Maded by one.The player will act as a Guangxi Army soldier charged at the Japanese position with his comrades.The task of the game is to Charge the devils, and kill all the devils!This game is also a simulator of the charge.
古风悬疑推理AVG《再见断刀》——在与世隔绝的山庄之中，接二连三地发生了骇人命案。只有通过细致入微的调查，抽丝剥茧的推理，才能定一个是非清白，还一个天理公道。 然而，在逐渐浮出水面的真相之下，似乎还有暗流涌动……
Cosmo Chaser is space fighter action game which presents restless shooting battle. It demonstrates new style of vertical scroll shooter by presenting classic arcade action in 3D space.

Retrouvez le sergent Cornélius M. Chesterfield et le caporal Blutch dans ce remaster mélangeant stratégie, tour par tour et action en temps réel. Initialement sorti sur Amiga à la fin des années 1980, ce remaster ravira les fans de la 1ère heure !

It's a hot spring hotel in the mountains. Goofy hostess, greedy dog ear cook, and cat ear fisher, even the goddess of hot spring were involved, to revive this hot spring hotel! The adventure life with lovely heroines day and night, is waiting for your coming!

Explorez un monde hostile qui remet en cause jusqu'à votre existence dans ce survival horror avec une touche de RPG. Percez un mystère millénaire, risquez votre santé mentale et affrontez les Dieux extérieurs. Chaque balle, chaque décision compte. Serez-vous à la hauteur ?
Jouez à des jeux de dessins en ligne avec vos amis, GRATUITEMENT !
《大话江湖》是一款大型网页游戏，延续经典的武侠风格，与回合制的战斗方式，公测以来一直深受广大游戏爱好者的喜爱，战斗方式简单，不需过多时间就可轻松完成各种任务！适合学生、白领、上班族等！只为带给大家最好的游戏体验！！ 大话江湖是一款能够让你沉浸在武林世界进行全新冒险玩法的角色扮演类网页游戏，充满血色的武林以及各种高难度挑战剧情让你真实演绎江湖侠客人生!
To make it in Nuevos Aires, one needs nerves of silk and the filthiest of hands.
This game is physics puzzle game. Left click to place a bomb. And lead the alien to the goal with a blast.

Un nostalgique jeu d'arcade remasterisé! Conquiers des zones et sauve des jeunes filles des griffes de nombreux provocateurs. Contient 24 boss uniques et leurs histoires loufoques! Inspiré de jeux comme Volfied, Qix, Gals Panic.

A linear visual novel about the experiences and thoughts of a young boy seeking for his place to live. Animated backgrounds and character sprites will help you fully immerse yourself in the game's history. Feel the experience of the main character, will you agree with him?

EBOLA 2 is created in the spirit of the great classics of survival horrors. In this game, you will control the main character with a first-person camera which makes you feel like you’re in a real horror movie.

A psychological horror game in which you wake up in an unknown cellar with a VHS camera and a journal. In the narrated journal, the main character will be recording their thoughts. Your task will be to get out of the cellar.
Two rivaling megalomaniacs are forced to work together in hopes to survive each other's fortresses. Join Skeleman, and his rival, Dr. Dangerous, in the thrilling comedic adventure title: Meanwhile.

Survivez le plus longtemps possible face aux hordes de zombies de ZOMBIAX EVIL ! Seul ou en mode équipe, incarnez un soldat d'élite, armez-vous jusqu'aux dents et tentez de débarrasser l'Humanité toute entière de la vermine zombifiée ! Devenez une Légende de la Résistance !
A Mysterious Point & Click Adventure of Discovery, set in the world of Lost Remnant. Inspired by SCP and the 'Hero of The Kingdom' series.
Fitness rhythm game with full body engagement. Transform your living room into a personal gym on 4 square meters.

A tense stealth game with super-powers, set in the 70s, filled with glorious fat pixels. Transform into enemies, dash, teleport, slow time and super-punch your way through this moody retro stealth game.

An off-grid cabin. A tech-savvy loner. One ray of sunshine in a bleak, ruined world. Cabin Fever is a slice-of-life visual novel with meaningful player choices, multiple endings to explore, and a story that will touch your heart.

A great danger threatens the kingdom – the dragon has devastated our lands. Help a gentle Fool defeat the Dragon and become a Hero. Win the heart of the princess in this fantastic adventure tale of good and evil.
FOX n FORESTS est un action platformer incluant des éléments RPG, à la sauce 16-Bit ! Changez les saisons à la volée et résolvez le mystère de la 5ème saison.

In Gabe Newell Simulator you can manage Steam releasing and creating new games and also in the story mode you can play as Gaben and help him in his fight against other software house, talk with his employees and decide the fate of Half Life 3!
Commandez une mégacorporation galactique et engagez-vous dans des batailles intergalactiques avec vos adversaires dans ce jeu de stratégie sphérique en temps réel.

Tirez sur des hordes de zombies dans une arène roguelite en mode bullet hell. Le jour, récoltez des ressources, débloquez des zones de la carte et préparez-vous pour la nuit. Combinez personnages, armes et explorez un vaste arbre de compétences pour créer des stratégies uniques.
Explore a surreal landscape filled with unused characters from a cancelled project. Will you give them purpose, or will they be doomed to suffer?

The mighty mythological hero, Garshasp, travels into distant lands in search for the secrets hidden in the temple of the dragon, unaware of the hidden dangers and creatures awaiting him in the cursed lands.
Embark on a quest with Himari and her friends! Traverse 40+ rooms, unlock characters, and groove to chiptune tunes in this speedy platformer.

Humanity is under threat. Unknown creatures captured a space ship that moves directly to the ground. Far future. People have already mastered the flights between planets. And everything seemed to go well, until mankind met another ratio. Can you stop the alien invaders?

Draw a path to where you want your cube to go. Take care to draw by anticipating what may happen after simulating the path you have drawn. Remember, your rights to draw a path is limited. Make good use of these rights!

It's your empire... Take control! The game has it all! the depth of gameplay will have you on the edge of your seat for hours on-end. Build, manage, strategize and conquer the competition with the richest gameplay tycoon product ever offered!

'The Quiet Apocalypse' is a first-person story adventure set in a beautiful open world. Join your father on a dangerous trek through 400 km² of pristine wilderness, as you race to save the life of a very special child.

A roguelike where you automate combat. Combine skills and conditions to find your own optimal solution! No complicated controls at all!! Sit back with a coffee and watch the beautiful battles you've crafted unfold! Utilize a variety of skills, conditions, and relics to craft the ultimate build!

Prepare to journey down the rabbit hole and into a land beyond your wildest imaginings. In Alice in Wonderland, the world of the dazzling Tim Burton film bursts onto your screen, filled with all the whimsical, fantastical adventure of the movie and the classic book that inspired it.
Déjouez tous les pièges d'une immense forêt pleine de dangers secrets et de féroces créatures dans ce jeu riche aux graphismes saisissants et aussi difficile que superbe.
Mexican Train Dominoes Gold has pulled into the station! Hop aboard for a fun-filled ride based on the classic domino board game.

BIOMORPH est un jeu de type soulslike metroidvania. Combattez des monstres terrifiants et volez leurs corps et pouvoirs ! Rencontrez des personnages excentriques, reconstruisez une ville et découvrez les secrets d’une immense civilisation déchue… et de vos propres origines mystérieuses.
The FPS Adventure where you're challenged to explore God Damn's World, and ultimately become the successor of Badass Heaven.

Prêt à défier l'apesanteur ? 6180 the moon est un jeu de plateformes planétaire au gameplay orbital. Connectant le haut et le bas de l'écran, le joueur bondit tel un astronaute dans l'espace, sans jamais se préoccuper de "tomber dans le vide" en bas de l'écran.

The ultimate food fight – no cleanup required! Muffin Fight is a 4-player VR party game where you bake, throw, and battle! Challenge friends or foes in this multiplayer showdown. With wild ingredients and quick rounds, it’s a fight to be the last player standing!
A metafictional yuri visual novel about a traveller who runs across two cute nuns in an abandoned church.
Escape2088 est un jeu d'évasion à l'ancienne se déroulant dans un monde cyberpunk futuriste.

titre: The Princess, the Stray Cat, and Matters of the Heart
description: Once upon a time, after his mother passed away, a boy called Nora felt all alone in the world. He spent every day with his unique and kind hearted friends until one fateful day, he had a chance encounter with a princess from the Netherworld.
La chasse aux gnomes atteint un nouveau niveau ! Devenez un puissant chevalier et plongez dans le monde de la dark fantasy sans quitter votre domicile.

Dawn of the Mexica is a turn-based roguelike that blends accurate history and mythical fantasy. It features complex combat mechanics, tactics and skills, yet also brings you an easy to use interface. Fight your way through the procedurally generated scenarios and stop the fall of the Fifth Sun!
Hentai Temple est un jeu de sliding puzzle totalement classique mais avec une légère touche japonaise...
Don't let The RulerEye establish his new reign of terror! Eliminate all eyes, collect the rewards and achieve new records!

Metal March est la fusion ultime entre la stratégie au tour par tour inspirée des échecs et les mécaniques de jeu de cartes (CCG) ! Créez une armée selon votre style, utilisez cartes et reliques pour former de puissantes synergies et accomplir votre expédition !

Cleo is a solo-developed, top-down, pixel-art, retro, pirate adventure with a lot of nostalgic flair, humor and a linear story, inspired by the old Zelda games and the classic LucasArts adventure games.
Join exciting adventure of escaping from cops. Be tricky and use your skills to complete your missions in green town. If you’re successful, you can enjoy well-deserved vacation at the seaside.
Beyond space, beyond reason... beyond humanity. Discover a gripping tale of a dystopian future narrated by David Hewlett, star of the Academy Award-winning The Shape Of Water.

Geometry Arena 2 distills RPG depth and Roguelite elements into a unique loop of [ Meta-Progression + Endless Challenges ]. Mix and match Weapons, Bodies, Modules, and Pets to craft your game-breaking builds! Minimalist lines, vibrant colors!

Silence in Space is a point & click game with science fiction and horror themes. It presents the story from the standpoint of the character Alan Blake, who is a galactic mercenary who captured, on the radar of his spaceship, a spacecraft drifting in space.

Last Space Mission is a 3D Wave Shooter in the space where you are the pilot of a spaceship whose planet has been conquered. Fight back and show them that you are the best star pilot in the galaxy and a cunning warrior.

Vous ne contrôlez pas les mouvements de Pompom le hamster, mais vous contrôlez tout le reste. Posez des blocs, des ressorts, des canons et des parapluies, utilisez des fouets et modifiez le monde pour créer un chemin sûr qui permettra à Pompom de vaincre le diabolique Capitaine Chat.
You are a bird, you are free in this small place, but you can't get out, all you can do is fly around.

From the designer of the Incredible Machine, Puzzle Poker is a game that can be played quickly and casually or with some deeper strategic thought. Slide poker cards to make the best combination of hands before the timer runs out. Cash in early for bonus chips.

Ahlman Arcade 2018 is a collection of games made by the game industry students at Ahlman Institute.All games were made during our ten month long school year as a joint effort between the programmers and graphic designers.

Not long after Celia leaves her home to go on an adventure (and maybe, just maybe, to avoid getting married to Ced the creep) she finds herself in the village of Villageville, where she meets another runaway.

Axes and Acres is a deep and engaging single-player strategy game designed to create exciting decisions every turn. The rules are easy to learn, but every turn can be played out in many different ways in order to farm, build and survive.

Vous êtes un chasseur de trésors légendaire, à la recherche de la Pierre du Silence, un puissant artefact qui s'est perdu dans un vieux temple. Vous y trouverez une série de machines étranges pleines d'énigmes à résoudre pour gagner votre liberté !

titre: You Will Never Get This Achievement
description: Don't even try it. You won't succeed. You will never get the last achievement. I really like buttons.

Snake blocks is a colorful 3D puzzle game from Spooky Cat Games. Join the five friendly snakes as you push, pull, and twist them through dozens of challenging puzzle scenarios. Mind-bending puzzles and beautiful design come together in Snake Blocks!

Car Mechanic Simulator VR met les joueurs au défi de réparer, peindre, régler et conduire des voitures dans un monde complètement tridimensionnel. Rencontrez des voitures classiques et uniques dans le nouveau module Barn Find and Junkyard. Construisez et développez votre empire de services dans...

Nepenthe est un RPG dessiné à la main fait de blagues de père et d'effroi existentiel. Situé dans le monde étrange de Carithia, vous incarnez un mec chauve mystérieux qui a perdu la mémoire. Oui, tu l'as bien lu.

Plongez dans l'univers d'un jeu de stratégie de la vieille école au tour par tour avec de gigantesques robots de combat. Un mode JcJ extrême : deux factions, chacune aux commandes d'un seul mech et de 20 spécialisations supplémentaires ainsi qu'un système de neuro implant de pilotage.

Scrap Games is a 3D side-scrolling beat'em up game with a simple gameplay system that offers many possibilities. Choose your robot character, upgrade it and go through the next stages by defeating your enemies. Prepare yourself and let the fight begin!!! Beat them up!!!
SokoFrog est un jeu de puzzle sur le fait de pousser des boîtes, aidez votre ami grenouille à passer au niveau suivant.
** Note: The game has not been updated for a long time, please do not buy it, the author is redoing this game **
Be the dinosaur! Experience the world of dinosaurs like never before! Dinosaurs A Prehistoric Adventure is an ARPG where you could play as 15 dinosaurs in a semi-open world environment.
You're outnumbered, low on ammunition and the paranoia sets in. This is an action horror-world where enemies get power-ups and you don’t.
Dungeon Masters is a skill-based dungeon crawler without any random based gameplay mechanics.The game includes a powerful in-game level editor using which you can create your own dungeons.

From developer Whirlpool comes the 2nd mini-sequel to NEKO-NIN exHeart featuring the sub-character, Saiha! Saiha tells our protagonist that a runaway ninja has sneaked their way into town. She doesn't know what their motives are, but it may involve him.
A small arcade game about a small cube. Collect all the coins at the level to open the exit leading to the next level.

Type words quickly to destroy robots, move among lanes, and destroy all the enemy's waves on this invasion that mixes Typing & Run! The future of Robworld is in your hands, can you destroy all robots fast enough? Type for your life. Type for the future.
Entrez dans le monde détruit d'Astria, une terre ravagée par le Cataclysme sur laquelle la vie est en train de disparaitre. Incarnez Gwen, une Astrienne prête à agir avant que tout ne disparaisse.

Fall into the magically complicated world of Overture as the three main characters embark on an adventure that will shake their lives and the world around them. Will they fan the flames of the growing revolution, or will they be the key to extinguishing it?
Для выживания в постапокалипсисе вам придется сделать многое: строить, искать и мастерить. Переживете ли вы следующий день ?

Leta’s life changed in one moment. She and her friend Lina found an old music box in the mountains... and soon Lina disappeared, leaving behind only a photograph and the ominous music box. Uncover the secrets in atmospheric third-person horror game.

titre: 假如我是人工智能 Big Brother Is Shaping You
description: It's a serious game about AI, PRISM, big data, privacy, and free speech.

Academagia, the greatest of the ancient schools for wizards. Build the legend of your mage with thousands of options, emergent storytelling and endless replayability. The definitive version of the magical life simulator is at last on Steam!
Un jeu d’aventure de type « Escape Room » dans lequel vous incarnez un voleur malchanceux à la recherche d’un ouvrage plus que volubile.

"Royal Rescue" est un jeu de rôle avec un système de combat au tour par tour. De là, hors de nulle part, la princesse est kidnappée du Royaume, vous obtenez une mission secrète pour la sauver! Relevez le défi dans plusieurs quêtes, affrontez les ennemis du royaume et sauvez la princesse!

hackmud is a retro cyberpunk RPG where you play a digital persona in a chaotic, unpredictable, and often goofy abandoned internet. Enter a 90s hacker movie filled with scripts, scams, and sabotage. Explore the world of digital secrets and forge your legacy through cunning, creativity, or disruption.
Play several original minigames designed for VR. This free collection of minigames is designed specifically for VR from the start, and provides original games and experiments for people to try.

Ce jeu est un jeu d'horreur se déroulant dans un hôpital. De mignons dieux de la mort vivent dans l'hôpital où ils ont été hospitalisés. De minuit à 6 heures du matin, les dieux de la mort viennent cueillir la vie des patients. Survivez grâce à des capacités spéciales et divers objets.
Become a true hero in a battle of mythic proportions.

Découvrez une version intelligente des jeux de puzzle japonais rétro. Mordez, faites exploser et cassez votre chemin à travers 80 niveaux charmants mais difficiles. Jouez en solo dans le rôle de Dumpy ou demandez à un ami de vous rejoindre dans le rôle de Bumpy.
An Interactive Comic with PUNCHING in it.

The ultimate built-for-VR magical combat experience, designed for those who crave intense mayhem & relentless real-world physical gameplay. Catch that perfect flow as you slow time & lay waste to the hordes, all to the adrenaline-pumping beats of an original Metal soundtrack. Prepare to die. A lot.
Get yourself ready to come across ancient ruins, an abandoned city, and more to gear up and slaughter TONS of demons with nothing but your own wits, and whatever treasures you can find!

Launch into a fierce roguelite action in this top-down twin-stick shooter with bombs! In a robotic world, control Lizzy and their team of unlockable beasty bots in a quest for upgrades. But beware, needed resources are guarded by swarms of Steel Sentinels. Survive them to craft synergistic builds.

Explore, fight, and survive as an awakened sleeper, in a fallen utopian city ravaged by a horrific disease. With an array of hi-tech weapons, highly immersive UI, full-body awareness, and much more, P.A.M.E.L.A. delivers an intense and unforgiving survival experience.
Kingdom Karnage is a cross-platform, animated combat, trading card game. It's available to play on PC, Android, and Apple iOS.

Guide a young woman on her quest to become a musketeer in this thrilling arcade adventure! With lush visuals, a captivating story, and addictive time management gameplay, The Musketeers: Victoria's Quest offers an unforgettable saga of high adventure!

A completely different take on the tower defense genre. Combining it with the Puzzle genre, making for a difficult game. Buy traps, bombs, turrets and walls and place them in optimal positions to defend against enemies.

A gloomy lesbian / yuri visual novel featuring characters based on famous Romantic poets such as Coleridge, Wordsworth, and Byron. Can you help Samantha Coleridge repair her fractured relationship with Lillian Wordsworth?
No Fair Play est un jeu multijoueur basé sur la physique qui associe des mécaniques de parkour, de combat et de football afin d'offrir une grande liberté aux joueurs.

Button Tales is a breathtaking and challenging Match 3 game with innovation mechanics. This is a real fresh perspective on the Match 3 genre. Meet cute characters and explore the breathtaking environment. The wonderful music and effects will help you delve right into the game.
Un court roman visuel sur la recherche de votre nom et d'une fille dans le brouillard.
《夜永》是一款百合向视觉小说游戏，讲述了在前作（千面 Melancholy Love）剧情发生半年之后，聆花女子学院中破茧而出的少女们的故事。
The fish hid. Try to find them all! A very large location.
Play as Keiko, a socially awkward woman living in a small country village. Explore the town and help her overcome her social anxiety, so she can thrive at her university.

titre: Death Becomes You - Mystery Visual Novel
description: Who killed your best friend?! Find out the truth before 4 suspects frame you instead! Death Becomes You is a mystery visual novel where you untangle the dark secrets and relationships between your fellow magic university students.
A narrative-focused mimicry game. Observe and blend in to survive. Disguise yourself, deceive enemies, and discover the secrets of a mysterious world.
Game Machines: Arcade Casino is a simulator of playing on the game machines. Great entertainment for long hours. Check your reflex, skills, and luck. Become the master and claim the cash! Retro.

The Deer God is a breathtaking 3D pixel art adventure that will challenge your religion and your platforming skills. It's a game about survival, reincarnation, and karma; all set in a breathtaking and unique 3D pixelized world. Feast your eyes on the beautiful lighting, day and night system, and vast landscapes.
Over Wonderland glides the shadow of the Jabberwocky, a terrifying fantasy creature! Alice is summoned by the Cheshire Cat to help restore peace and harmony.

Get ready for a new experience on Windows desktop and VR, where you get to build your ultimate racing machine, tailored to your driving style and optimized for performance, or race to the finish line with a monster what makes you smile.

A 4-player multiplayer real-time / turn-based strategy game. Move armies on the board in turn-based mode and invade other armies to enter real-time strategy "skirmish" battles! Win enough small battles to take over the board and win the War!

Embarquez-vous dans une bande dessinée d'aventure avec Aliencat, à la découverte d’un monde sous le joug d'un système totalitaire. Échappez à des situations compliquées, rassemblez votre équipage et préparez votre vaisseau pour vous enfuir à travers le cosmos.

Embark on a cosmic journey with "Milky Way Jigsaw Puzzles". Solve puzzles featuring stars, galaxies, and celestial wonders while unlocking Steam Achievements. Dive deep into the universe, learn astronomical facts, and connect with fellow puzzle enthusiasts. Your galactic adventure awaits!
Adventure through Classical Antiquity as Theseus.
NeonCode is a one hour long cyberpunk-retro adventure game made by one developer. It was inspired by classics such as the Blade Runner-movies, Miami Vice, Grim Fandango and the games of Telltale.

titre: In Space No One Can Hear You Clean
description: Velocity-driven arcade action!

Battle against rival fantasy armies in this fast paced turn based strategy game. Fight powerful bosses while you hunt for treasure in dungeon mode, play through over one hundred single player missions in campaign mode, or match wits against your friends in multiplayer.

A charming management game set in an old Victorian Threatre. You are put in charge of a troupe of actors, it's your job to make sure your actors and the stage are ready to put on a perfect show! Train your actors, resolve their conflicts, dress up your troupe and set the stage for the final play!

This is an indie game made by a solo developer set in the very distant future. You are a condemned prisoner forced to destroy the monsters at a clandestine genetic research facility located on planet TYKEN. Use futuristic energy weapons in 10 unique environments.

Countless Rooms of Death is a puzzle / adventure game with a horror atmosphere. There are no weapons or real enemies; instead, we aim to bully your mind. All you, the player, have is a flashlight with which to find your way through a dark labyrinth, solving puzzles to acquire keys which will allow you to enter the next level.
Dragon World is a fun dragon game in a cartoon style. Battle other players or play cooperative in a survival game mode.

La Légende du Marchand est un mini-jeu de commerce. Jouez un marchand d'Asie ancienne, décidez comment faire de l'argent en un temps limité. Le jeu comporte une part de hasard mais vous pouvez recommencer pour tenter d'obtenir un meilleur score.

'epic maze' is a third-person shooter game in which you must find your way to the gramophone in a procedurally generated 3d maze by following its music, turn it off, and then return. remember your path, do not get lost in maze. Original new concept. One of a kind. Replayable custom game.
- An exploration rogue lite mapping game - Uncover the city's secrets through mini-games - Sell your map quickly and efficiently to purchase upgrades

Vous êtes un fameux détective privé de renommée internationale et Grand-Mère Rose vous a chargé de retrouver un ticket de loterie perdu d'une valeur de 488 millions de dollars !Reconstituez le parcours de la grand-mère et résolvez cette énigme.
Alien chickens invade and beam everything away. Greet them with your shotgun.
You're the AI of a rickety colony ship, bound for the red planet. You have limited resources, a desperate crew, and an unknown fate awaiting you. Can you survive the journey across the Big Black?

In this roguelike action-adventure, control humanoid "Labor" and giant "Arms" to uncover the mysteries of the world. Create fully-customizable robots, strengthen them, and take down hordes of enemies!

This is a psychological horror game where you will solve puzzles and explore a 90s-style house. The realistic art style enhances the eerie atmosphere of the game. (Please do not play this game before bedtime.)

Supfly Delivery Simulator - a game in which humanity is ruled by delivery service and now it's your time to become the best deliverer in the world! Deliver everything what is needed in the moment. As a robot you have one simple job - to deliver.
Idle RPG game that uses real life Time as the core mechanic and currency. Featuring offline progress, prestige, unfolding mechanics, trees, and much more!

A nostalgic collections of the chapter 1 and 2 of “Yan Loong Legend” series. Pick up your sword again, transform into Yan Loong, Zhi Loong or Shui Yan with your friends to have a battle of light and darkness with the final boss Bai Loong and regain the occupied Green Hill Lake.
Construisez et gérez votre propre arcade, attirez des clients et développez votre empire dans Arcade Empire Tycoon !
Ember est une renarde qui aime les aventures. Courez, sautez et montez à travers 30+ parcours d’obstacles colorés et trépidants dans une quête pour retrouver votre âme perdue !

Alien Arena is a furious frag fest with arenas ranging from the small, to the massive. With game modes such as Capture The Flag and Tactical, there are terrific team-based experiences to be had as well as 1v1 duels, free-for-all, and dozens of mutators to alter the game play to your liking.

You're alone in the abandoned place where great evil awaits. It's always there... sensing your every move. Deathlike: Awakening is a first person survival horror, featuring outstanding mechanics and atmospheric gameplay. Supports HTC Vive and Oculus Rift headsets.

Au pays d’Imagi vivent les personnages des contes de fées, avec leurs grands méchants et leurs princesses à sauver. Si bien que devenir prince charmant est un parcours semé d’embûches où tous les coups sont permis !

Se déroulant à l’époque mythique des Vikings, FATED: The Silent Oath est un récit de courage et de sacrifice dans lequel un père de famille doit faire l’impossible pour protéger sa famille de la destruction du monde aux mains des géants de l’ancien monde.

titre: Sengoku Jidai: Shadow of the Shogun
description: Sengoku Jidai : Shadow of the Shogun est un jeu de stratégie et de tactique en tour par tour prenant pour décor cette période agitée ; il se focalise sur la période japonaise des royaumes combattants et l'invasion japonaise de la Corée.

Something for Someone Else is a short atypical experience, a brief journey into the mind of a distressed game developer that feels haunted by a game he made. All in the form of a poorly hand drawn narrative platformer accompanied by the beautiful musics of Celluloid Jam.

Big Brain Wolf est un jeu pointez cliquez pour les amateurs d'énigmes. Le joueur prend le rôle d'un loup végétarien asmathique qui veut devenir un génie. Au cours de son aventure il rencontrera de nombreux personnages. 6 scientifiques vous proposeront des exercices qui vous feront gagner des points et évoluer.
Découvrez World Keepers - Last Resort Deluxe, une aventure d'objets cachés qui vous tiendra en haleine du début à la fin !

An interactive game show has surfaced on the web and you're the STAR OF THE SHOW! Investigate and even compete in the show! Be prepared, this show is life and death. Star Of The Show is a home invasion psychological horror game.
Shogo is an anime-inspired first-person shooter. Fight on foot or pilot a giant mech in both open and urban levels. You will know the true power of giant robots!

Forget everything you’ve learned about combat. Cobalt’s slo-mo mechanic lets you perform moves that other games can’t comprehend. Discover the secrets of a distant colony in a cosmic campaign, take on challenges and rule the leaderboards, or face off against others in local and online multiplayer.
Lancez-vous dans une aventure énigmatique avec ce jeu VR pour 1 à 4 joueurs se déroulant dans un monde western alternatif. Découvertes, dangers et fouilles attendent les aventuriers.

Hero Emblems II est un nouveau RPG de style japonais qui combine certains éléments des jeux à défilement horizontal et des jeux de match-3. Les joueurs peuvent contrôler les membres des Night Chasers,Pour protéger la paix, ils se lancent dans une aventure pour devenir des héros.
Quantic Pinball débarque sur Steam ! Retrouvez les sensations des flippers à travers de nombreuses heures de jeu.

A roguelike deck-building game where you craft a deck, spark talents, discover runes, and assemble your team with partners' cards! Play unique stories for every character and explore a world caught in the clash of gods. New Puppeteer DLC just released!

titre: ぶんまわしヒーロー / Full Swing Hero
description: It's a break, a break! ?After attacking, resting your body will cause a super recovery and your muscles will followMuscle training action RPG

Geometry Dash meets Super Hexagon, in this ONE-BUTTON "Butt-Clenching" Bullet-Hell! Experience a rollercoaster of emotions as you experience filipino hell with its unique mechanics and Philippine mythology inspired story.

Einlanzer is a full-scale, epic fantasy role-playing game. The 40+ hour story of Einlanzer is deep, thought-provoking, and emotional, while remaining light-hearted and fun at times. Expect a strategic battle system, massive scope, regularly added content, and difficult moral decisions.

The picture-book-loving Little Princess lives happily in the Castle with her best friends Little Seal and Little Sharks day after day. However, the Little Princess, long “Protected” in the Castle, has always been dreaming of seeing the beautiful starry sky depicted in the picture book.
──終わってしまった世界の夏、少女はあてのない旅をする。通話を介して終わってしまった世界を共に生きるアドベンチャーゲーム。
Dans ce jeu, vous allez vous battre avec d'autres joueurs. Trouvez un autre joueur et affrontez-le ! Soyez le dernier debout et gagnez le match !
BookyPets Legends is a videogame of adventure, exploration and collecting, whose main objective is to encourage children from 7 to 12 years to read in an easy and funny way.
FROM FEAR is a 1-4 player online co-op survival horror where you choose your fear. Collect resources, unlock new maps and tools, all while trying to stay alive.

titre: Music Inside: A VR Rhythm Game
description: The best VR rhythm game compatible with HTC Vive and Oculus Touch! Music Inside! You can choose any song from either your own music library or the never-ending list on SoundCloud. With multiplayer mode, you can play with your friends next door or with any users anywhere.
Become a phone repair technician, get the opportunity to look into the personal data of customers. Influence their destinies if you dare!

Charlie had been desperate to get off Morland after being without a ship for over a year. He’d saved every credit he could to pay the deposit on the freighter. Perhaps in hindsight, purchasing the Belanzano wasn't the greatest plan but it was a start!
Cyberpunk adventure game about orphan Drew's fight against powerful corporation.

Inspired by games like Super Monkey Ball and Marble Madness, Roll Control is a 3D balance based platformer, built to be played with your body. Using the Roll Controller App on your mobile device, players can transform their balance board into a human game controller.

시계수리공(The Clockworker)은 스팀펑크풍의 쯔꾸르 호러 어드벤쳐 게임입니다. 거대한 시계 속에서 수리공 소녀를 조종해, 멈춰버린 톱니바퀴와 기계 장치 사이에서 퍼즐을 풀고, 아이템을 사용해 전진하세요. 언제 어디서 튀어나올 지 모르는 함정이 주인공을 기다리고 있습니다. 저마다의 비밀을 품고 있는 캐릭터와 대화해 호감도를 쌓고, 세계에 숨겨진 비밀을 파헤쳐 보세요!

The Evolution of War game shows the evolution of warfare in 5 ages, starting with the age of dinosaurs, crusades, medieval, 21st century (present time) and futuristic (fiction).The game's main objective is to destroy the enemy base.
A challenging action-adventure game. Explore a foggy abandoned island, fight knights, slugs and ghosts, and make your way to an old corrupted keep.

Fight your way through 50 levels full of thrilling action with hordes of challenging enemies and tough bosses! Obludia is an old-school arcade arena action inspired by classics such as Robotron or Smash-TV with RPG elements.

Hotel Sowls is an eerie mystery adventure. You are a pharmacist who, after a long and grueling journey, finally acquires a rare and enigmatic stone; only to have it stolen overnight at Hotel Sowls. Can you recover the stone and uncover the secrets hidden within this strange and unsettling hotel?

titre: Emiline: The Ghost of White Willow
description: A gothic horror with intense spine chilling atmosphere find yourself trapped in the unrelenting haunts of White Willow Manor Hall. Find a way out or perish at the hands of a sinister family of Victorian apparitions.
Florence, the cradle of Italian Renaissance. The city is experiencing an unprecedented economic and cultural flourishing: will your family prevail and control the city?

Explorez un magnifique et énigmatique manoir victorien avec un sombre secret, dans ce jeu de puzzle et d'exploration à la première personne avec horreur narrative, secrets et énigmes mécaniques mystérieuses incarnant le dernier exécuteur du magnat des chemins de fer énigmatique Hadley Strangre.

Visit From Above is a sit-and-survive horror game (inspired by Five Nights at Freddy's) that puts you face to face with aliens. You will have to survive 3 nights using different methods to defeat the aliens including a flashlight, turning power on/off, and closing your eyes (pretend to sleep).

titre: To Be Headed Or Not To Be
description: In To Be Headed Or Not To Be, you and a friend will have to use your heads, both figuratively and literally, to solve enigmas and challenges in order to escape the mansion.

titre: The Saga of Nino's Transmigration (尼諾的異世界物語 ~ 光與影與各自的信仰 ~)
description: A Roguelike JRPG game that tells the story of Nino being transported to another world and becoming a cult leader. Due to a poor twist of fate, he ended up cursed and must break the curse within the three days he has left to live.
RAM BOE is a casual puzzle game inspired by the classic Sokoban, where you control a fluffy ram called Boe in his quest to defeat the evil Jotun Thrym and free all of his victim's souls.

Defend Your Crypt is a strategy and puzzle game, in which we will have to avoid to lose our treasure by the tomb thieves. We, as the Pharaoh, can use different traps to defeat those damn ambitious humans who are profaning your tomb.

Dyana Moto is a frenetic racing game of infinite shooter. Dyana maneuvers a powerful war motorcycle and jumps over platforms while fighting robots and enemy spaceships in an aggressive battle simulation.
Welcome to the realistic world of duck hunting. Shoot ducks , gaining experience!
tiny & Tall: Gleipnir, Part One est un jeu d'aventure classique quoique moderne, inspiré par les titres légendaires de LucasArt.
Highlands is a hand-drawn turn-based strategy game with unique characters, resource management and RPG elements where the focus is directed toward decision-making.
Cubes, panneaux, boutons et beaucoup, beaucoup de portails.

L'aventure du jeune « Piou », un poussin orphelin, qui s’embarque dans un voyage touchant à la recherche de ses véritables origines. Accompagnez cet adorable petit oiseau sautillant à la voix mélodieuse, et guidez-le à travers son épopée fantastique, faite de pixel art soigné et d’animations somptueuses qui s’adaptent à vos interactions...
You are on the night shift at the bank. You hear noises all the time. You need to find out what they are and find your partner. As you pass, you will need to find the keys and open locked rooms.
1 3D story text adventure playing game

Several months have passed since the return of the Order of Marcus from exile to the continent and their founding of the kingdom of New Tixus in this, the second official Expansion to the epic Fantasy Strategy game Elven Legacy.

1941 and the German War machine is ravaging Europe. The British intelligence obtains classified documents detailing the development of a new type of German deadly weapon. It will give the Nazis worldwide naval supremacy and a great advantage over the allies.

The Mahjong Roguelike. Aotenjo: Infinite Hands is an deckbuilder where you will use Mahjong styles all over the world to beat innate threats, play different Patterns and combos, reach the "bottom" of Aotenjo, and discover ancient secrets....
WalkinVR Driver is a software program for people with physical disabilities which aims to make Virtual Reality Games and Applications more accessible.

Tree Trunk Brook is a tiny adventure game about hiking during the pandemic. Follow trail blazes, take photos, make friends, and find lost items. The visitor center is closed, but the trail is open. Social distancing is in effect, and masks are required.

Schwarzerblitz is a love letter to '90s 3D low-poly fighters, featuring 28 playable characters, more than 30 stages, ring out mechanics, classic arcade endings, and a complete story mode. Steel your fists and ride the lightning!
Welcome to the first layer of hell! Climb out from the ever-changing abyss while you fight hordes of blood-lusting demons in this vertical platformer rogue-lite.

In this game, you will have to explore the whole city to find all the cats (and various secrets) and get closer to the goal of making this world and the lives of the cats living in it a little better, and restore their faith in people!
Eat, drink, and fall in love at Bellflower Bistro. Bistro Days is a fun, over-the-top romantic story with choice-driven plots and multiple endings.
Découvrez le mystère et sauvez votre sœur dans Bathory: The Bloody Countess, un mystérieux jeu de puzzle d'objets cachés.
Incremental Idle Breakout Japanese Anime RPG! Explore the vast map (~ 10^21 meters) through breaking many blocks and defend your base from various monsters!
The world to save or raze. Death only makes you stronger, but can you afford the cost? Aid the goddess to free the world, claim it as your own, or befriend it's inhabitants.

A beautiful puzzle game in which you have to collect the pieces of animated characters. The game provides a choice of difficulty and any available level to choose from. Time and lives are limited, so hurry up

Utilisez une caméra vidéo spéciale capable de remonter le temps pour explorer les souvenirs du passé dans TAPE: Unveil the Memories, un jeu d'aventure narratif à la première personne qui se déroule dans le nord de l'Espagne des années 1990.
Castle defender is a fast-paced defending arcade-strategy game where you must use spells to stop various enemies that will come and try to destroy your castle.

titre: Like No Other: The Legend Of The Twin Books
description: Dan est un aventurier maladroit qui risque tout pour résoudre la légende des livres jumeaux en explorant la ville abandonnée de Red Pines.
Un petit village norvégien est la cible d'un complot paranormal. Seuls un professeur de sciences occultes tétraplégique et son fidèle assistant peuvent y mettre un terme.

You will have to face hundreds of different doors, and decide which one you should go to in order to get to the main secret. You have to open the doors in many locations of this world, each of which is dedicated to its type of doors.
Wind Wind is a puzzle adventure game. Lead the souls to the top floor of the tower, avoiding robots and the black star which are in the way

Trouvez la paix intérieure dans ce petit jeu à monde ouvert. Sur ces îles conçues minutieusement dans les moindres détails, vous pourrez vous prélasser sur un monstre géant, nourrir des bébés dragons, vous occuper de la faune et de la flore…

titre: Infinite Space III: Sea of Stars
description: Sea of Stars is a starship roguelike, a sandbox adventure game of interstellar exploration and combat. Travel from star to star, upgrade your ship with new systems and weapons, build up your flotilla with allies and mercenaries, and take on a variety of alien menaces.

XXI century, Russian Empire. Kirill Yeletsky is a fifth-year student at the Saint Petersburg Academic University of Necromagic. Help him defend the honor of his noble family by winning in the grand imperial necromagic tournament.

Under Domain - Alien Invasion Simulator will surprise you with a Sci-fi turn-based game completely different from others. How about turning yourself into an Alien and planning an invasion to Planet Earth? You can secretly influence human history and build war machines to exterminate human beings.
《富甲天下5》的主公人數由7位提高至21位，全新的寵物系統、玩家可自由分配升級點數和學習技能 ，全新3vs3將戰系統，還有更多的武器裝備及兩百多位武將等你來募集！搜集資源率先打造出經典建築也能贏得勝利！參考玩家意見，展現更流暢爽快的《富甲天下5》STEAM版！支援一台電腦四人同樂！
Boxed-In is a small action puzzle game where you trap little enemies by surrounding them with blocks. Move fast or be eaten.
Introducing ClusterPuck 99, a sporty competitive sports game about sports based on athletics! Featuring 8-player local competitive action for PC, Mac and Linux.

Typefighters is a competitive multiplayer game where two players battle each other using their typing skills. Its variety of modes does not only emphasise typing speed and correctness, but also other skills like reaction time, sustained attention, creativity, tactics and anticipating the opponents moves.
Simon has some family and puberty problems.Talk, listen and try to help him.

Austen Translation is a tongue-in-cheek strategy game which borrows from the visual novel tradition. It can be played solo or as a hot-seat, party-game multiplayer match with up to five players. Randomly combined plot elements, settings, endings and rivals make each playthrough feel fresh.
Meet Zorg, an out of it barbarian who loves loads of drinks and adventures. An indie game in which your ability to type fast is the best weapon to win.
Fight inflation the American way: by shooting it in the face. Play as your favorite libertarians and destroy the Federal Reserve's control over our money!
Capture the spirit of a dead witch before she claims another victim!

When a pretty plant in Alma's garden begins to speak to her, she knows that a dark mystery is afoot! But in Victorian England, women are often dismissed as nothing more than hysterical fantasists. Can you help Alma find her power, and solve this dangerous situation before it's too late?
Help the Princess save her friends and family!
Tile-matching puzzle game based on mix of classical mechanics.

Can you make it to the end of this punishing 3D platformer or will you be stuck in the void? Back again features: Challenging levels to test your skill and patience, a unique changing soundtrack with a light narrative and creepy atmosphere. Also includes Survival Mode

"Sunrise" - an online shooter with elements of survival from the first person. Your task is to survive in the harsh conditions of the post-apocalyptic world. Explore new regions, team up with other players in groups, survive with them and create your own rules of survival!
Win duels and hearts as a swordswoman at Paris's finest luxury brothel! Fight for the honor of ladies of the night in this game of swords and seductions.
You're in the home of a psychopathic art lover. and that isn't happy about this situation.He'll scare you. You have to be careful!

Dans Ynglet, sautez, élancez-vous, glissez, bondissez et flottez à travers des ciels abstraits et débordants de vie. Fondez-vous dans ce décor sonore dynamique qui réagit à votre présence et profitez du spectacle qu’offrent ses couleurs magnifiques.

3D Organon is a multi-award-winning medical XR platform with 3D Anatomy, XR Medical Imaging, Ultrasound simulation, Custom courses, Medverse, Assessments, and AI study assistant—supporting diverse educational and clinical training needs.

Experience a fantastical take on the classic Arabian Nights tale! Using the classic ATB (Active Time Battle) combat system, six adventurers will travel across sand dunes and past colossal sandworms to uncover a treasure which may save their kingdom.
Enjoy a fun, grid tapping game that gets faster the more you play. See how long you can last tapping the flashing buttons. Now with a bunch of fun skins!
This game is a TOP-DOWN, horror RPG. Visibility is very limited... everything else pretty much isn't. Explore the map, collect power-ups, and see how high your score can get before you beat the game.
Defend against the creatures of that night! Protect yourself and your lamp by building and upgrading your base. Equip yourself with the best weapons to deal with the incoming waves.

The Basement Ritual (Le Rituel du Sous-sol) est un court jeu d'horreur indie où vous avez été enlevé et devez vous échapper des locaux souterrains d'un culte en résolvant des énigmes et en vous cachant d'une créature démoniaque.

Mirastell is a 2D Action-RPG with a unique flavor of turn-based combat, set on a mysterious, abandoned space cruise liner. Discover what lead to the fate of the passengers, and earn weapons and items by exploring, and defeating enemies.

The space station suffered an unknown infection from space, the previously unknown X virus mutates, almost the entire crew of the station is infected, you need to stop the army of mutants until they break through to Earth and the judgment day begins!

Little Nemo The Clown is a 2D Open World game inspired by good Metroidvania titles. Talk, Run, Fly, Explore. Find secret passages and characters and discover a Fantasy World full of Magic and Color. Little Nemo is a modern Maze Runner Adventure. Can you find the Clown before your Time runs out?

4 Player Plug-and-Play co-op/solo adventure. MUSICAL BOSS FIGHTS! LEVEL PROGRESSION! Unlockable abilities. A SWING ability. This is Spark, where you play as a tiny flame to fight through varieties of Marshmallow enemies to save your fellow flames!
Oh so lucky! Doctor is a hospital surgery/life simulation, which deals with many issues such as job loss, betrayal, friendship, shyness.
Dead No-Head is a third person action adventure story rich game in which Norix is brought back from the dead, with... No head! This headless hero will have quite the unexpected journey ahead of him.
Welcome to the horrific altered memories of my childhood home.

Lève une malédiction et redonne vie à Snacko, une île en ruine où les chattes de ville Mimi et Mikan commencent une nouvelle vie ! Plonge dans cette aventure chat-gricole pour cultiver la terre, élever des vaches duveteuses, pêcher, explorer, personnaliser, décorer et bien plus encore.

"Secrets of the Haunted Mansion" is an immersive interactive adventure game that transports players into the dark and mysterious world of an abandoned and haunted estate. Step into the shoes of an explorer, ready to unearth forgotten secrets and unravel intriguing puzzles.

Take the role of Agent Blair as she fights her way through Zombies, Cultists and Giant Snakes to uncover the truth about the Mother Stone. Battle challenging bosses, Collect useful power-ups to give Agent Blair an edge over the unknown monsters that plague The Thurston House.
Percez un mystère effrayant et surnaturel et sauvez un enfant innocent !

Your lonely dad has not dated for 3 years. You convince him to try a computer dating service. Unfortunately for him his date is actually a serial killer. Can you save your dad and escape with your life?

MechNest est un jeu de tir en 3D développé par une seule personne. Avancez sur une carte qui change à chaque défi, collectez des objets de renfort et battez des ennemis puissants avec des tirs flashy. Combinez librement vos compétences et faites un carnage dans la ruche des mécas !

Remake of one of the oldest arcade classics. Challenge yourself and advance through the levels filled with asteroids, power-ups and virtual bitcoins, that you can spend in the shop to get ready for what's coming. Get your friends and share the adventure together in co-op mode!

Embark on a journey of exploration in Land of Crystals! A captivating collectathon RPG through a whimsical world filled with healing crystals. Collect and cleanse your crystals to save the island from the attacking monsters and overcome your vulnerabilities!

Blacksmith Legends: Prologue is a first chapter of the upcoming game. Your job is to craft/modify your recipes, manage your workshop/employees and protect your craftsmanship against various dangers that can happen in the Kingdom!
Bienvenue au Musée de Forgotten Hill, un lieu d’exposition du passé, du présent, de la nature, de l'art et de l'inconnu!
Action shooter game with tactical combat and realistic gameplay experence.

Crystal Blast is a single-player action-adventure game that offers a visually mysterious VR experience, created with Unreal Engine 5. Our goal is to survive in this mysterious cave and witness the remnants of past events while progressing towards the exit.

Adoptez Karin ou Klaus dans ce jeu parental sombre et axé sur le récit. Aidez votre enfant à surmonter les effets de la haine et du harcèlement. Basé sur les histoires vraies des enfants Lebensborn, vous ferez des choix difficiles qui impacteront à jamais la vie de votre enfant.

Rabbit Riot est un jeu d'horreur atmosphérique dans lequel vous devez guider un lapin courageux à travers un domaine abandonné, en évitant les ennemis mortels et en révélant les sombres secrets du passé.

In this game you will need to feed the dragon with meat, using a catapult. You are waiting for exciting calculations of path for the exact entrance to the mouth of an ancient creature. 30 different levels and nice gameplay will please fans of puzzles.

A Roguelike game with Strategy and RPG elements. Play as a scavenger to collect items on the ancient battlefield for local Bastion. Build buildings, craft items and repel the siege of the undead army. Rich progression and high replayability based on roguelike systems.
In the game Fairy of the treasures you have to help a young fairy Mei to open magic chests and hidden gems, and gold! The game is a clicker with elements of visual novel.
Super Dig Man Deluxe is a digging game where you search for ores, rocks, gems and gold in order to upgrade your tools, buy ladders, and buy torches.
This story originated from a painter friend of mine.
Join Scamp, the tiny terror with an attitude on his quest to free his master. Explore the big hat mines in this quirky fantasy adventure game.

Explore un monde de paysages luxuriants, de scènes urbaines agitées et de portraits grotesques dignes des peintures de la Renaissance. Death of the Reprobate est une aventure point and click rabelaisienne signée par le créateur de Four Last Things et The Procession to Calvary.

le type de jeu trois dans une rangée avec des robots, des galaxies et des magasins. Le joueur a armé robots. Réorganiser jetons que le joueur tire sur l'ennemi. Après le tour d'un joueur - les progrès de l'ennemi.

titre: Professor Watts Memory Match: Shapes And Colors
description: Hello Professor Watts here and I have some research to do on memory skills. I have assembled a wide variety of shapes and colors to put our memory to the test. We can see how we're doing by completing matches in a specific amount of time and earning points to track our overall progress.

It's been a few months since Seiji last visited the beach. After enduring the chaos of his new daily life, another holiday with his childhood friends is just what he needs. However, the appearance of another girl whose love of space rivals his own ensures that his trip will be anything but peaceful.
Defeat pins with rapid-fire bowling balls or powerful melee strikes to avoid getting guttered in this First-Person PvE Bowling game.

Protect your small off world farm from a variety of oversized and hungry alien bugs. Gain access to a varied assortment of weaponry and equipment designed for high caliber pest control. Bring a friend or two for added firepower.

titre: 三国吞天传 幻想姬武神战记
description: This is a turn based RPG type game! Players can purchase new equipment, defeat bosses, search for hidden treasures, replace powerful equipment... as well as beautiful character portraits and dazzling magic! Welcome friends who love nostalgia to play with RPG!
Formez une équipe avec vos amis et votre famille et allez découvrir l'univers particulier d'ADIOS Amigos. Un jeu d'astrophysique de 1 à 4 joueurs dans une atmosphère comique.

titre: Outbreak: Shades of Horror Chromatic Split
description: Experience the beginning of the end of Cypress Ridge in this '90s survival horror nightmare at the dawn of the zombie outbreak.

In this project you can become an astronaut on the first moon base in human history. You can drive a rover, do some jobs with drilling devices, figure out how solar panels work and walk on the moon surface.
Colorful crazy world of a fantastic planet. Bizarre plants, strange landscapes! Under these unusual conditions there arose steam-robots civilization. But there’s no peace there - robots are at war.
Classic arena fps style gameplay mixed with modern and futuristic elements, where the only thing that matters is the skill.

When I opened the ancient scroll, I came to the forgotten island. There are medieval figures and buildings on this island. Some people are merchants and some are villagers. First I want to drink water and eat some food, and then explore the island to find a way back to the real world.
Aidez une jolie femme à chercher des objets perdus dans ce jeu d'objets cachés.
Frosty Nights is a First Person hybrid horror game that focuses on atmosphere and suspense.
Revivez la légende de Goliath et sauvez le monde de la destruction.

Once upon a time all was peaceful and serene in the far off land of Camalon, but the silence has been broken as the Orc hordes have returned to the peaceful kingdom to claim the land that they once held most sacred.

700 years from now, Agent Silverman is a renowned Exorcist on the case of a missing person. His investigation leads him to a small ghost town called "Town of Machine". Uncover unspeakable horrors and fight the grotesque monstrosities that lurk in this forsaken place.

Saddle up your Caravan Demon and journey out to explore the Land Of The Ancient King! Explore beaches, meadows, tundra and desert to buy, sell, uncover and unlock items, and become the richest merchant in the land! A classic collect-a-thon adventure RPG, from Astrarium Games.

The year is 2036. In this famine-riddled world, food-centric sovereignty has been established. Living alone inside a food-inspection booth, you are striving to find truth and peace beyond the borderline.

In this fantasy action game, you dodge obstacles and pick up treasure while falling in an endless cavern. Unlock characters with powerful movement abilities as you strive to fall deeper and deeper before the inevitable SPLAT.
Build mechas, command your squad members to victory and conquest.

titre: Tyd wag vir Niemand (Time waits for Nobody)
description: Manipulate time to your will at any moment to solve challenges, avoid deadly traps and make it to the end of this strange journey.
SYMMETRY is a VR software tool for professionals in architecture, engineering, and construction.

BIT.TRIP VOID présente le troisième volet de la série BIT.TRIPBIT.TRIP VOID est une exploration synesthésique basée sur la musique et les rythmes de notre quotidien. Avec son gameplay particulier, aujourd'hui familier pour les gamers, il est laissée une totale liberté de mouvement, intéragissant avec la musique de manière tout à fait...

BLOK DROP NEO is a simple, yet challenging, physics-based puzzle game for PC. Your goal is to guide the orange blok safely to rest on any of the normal platforms by tapping, and destroying, the grey bloks.

Demolish walls to grow stronger! DUNGEON RAZE is a high-octane top-down shooter that fuses strategic destruction with exponential power scaling. Smash through the environment with overwhelming, "hyper-inflated" firepower to rescue allies and collect power-ups.
Pour célébrer le lancement sur Mac, récupérez Faerie Solitaire gratuitement avant le 8 novembre à 19 heures, heure française !

Ah... l'amour, l'amour... Comment magnifiquement en un seul mot. Mon esprit s'agite, mon estomac bat des papillons, mon cœur bat des palpitations. Êtes-vous prêt à tout pour donner un million de cerises, collecter tous les bijoux et même sauver votre préféré?
Jude Gray, a wandering Courier, receives a request to deliver some very special cargo. This cargo turns out to be Philia, an android girl who is unaffected by the enigmatic Singularity Machines.

Silverwing is an action flight game where you build an array of powerful spaceships to combat enemies across space and a diverse array of planet landscapes. Play through a fully voiced 20+ mission campaign with multiple endings based on your mission choices.

Exécutez et tirez sur des zombies dans des niveaux de style médiéval non linéaires verticaux. Collectez des cristaux et des clés pour débloquer des chemins bloqués. Lisez les journaux et révélez une histoire de fuite de biohazard. Gagnez différentes fins de jeu en fonction de votre style de jeu.

After The Collapse est un jeu de construction de base se déroulant dans un monde post-apocalyptique mettant en scène des environnements urbains. Votre tâche consiste à gérer un groupe de survivants, les protéger contre les bandits, mutants et les autres menaces tout en veillant à leur bien-être.

Viveport Video is your portal into a newer, more immersive way to watch videos. Watch your own favorites, or explore an enormous variety of material from our media partners. Envelop yourself in everything from traditionally-shot short films to sweeping epics designed for total 360˚ views.

Gravels Of Endless War - new turn-based online strategy game. You don’t have to lvl up, grind or do quests. There are no ads or P2W elements. Build your own unique team, discover the special abilites and start your Endless War for the War Relics.

titre: Sherlock Holmes Consulting Detective: The Case of the Mystified Murderess
description: An unassuming woman has been charged with the death of a scoundrel, a fortune-squandering bounder. She was found over the body, pistol in hand but there are other avenues in this case that even the Yard refuses to set foot upon. I have the feeling that there is more to the case than meets the eye.
Your crew is on a mission to collect cargo. As you are going from moon to moon, there are creatures who will try and stop you. How long will you survive ?

The story starts when you arrive at plagued ridden land border. There is a long way ahead filled with courage and mystery. Heretic’s Lot: Prologue is a demo to the main game, presenting its basic mechanics.
