Create your fleet and army, hunt the enemy's fleet, hide your weak squadrons in protected ports until reinforcements arrive, blockade enemy trade routes, struggle for dominance over the seas! Command a battle formation and experience the power of iron and steam!
An open survival game, cartoon style of the game screen and the changing grassland day and night, bring you different game experience.
Combien de temps allez-vous survivre dans cette expérience de plongée en eau libre où vous affronterez de terrifiants grands requins blancs menaçant de vous dépecer.
A casual game that controls hippo eating bananas

Myasoid est un jeu de tir d'arène où vous incarnez un ver géant protégeant la planète des envahisseurs extraterrestres. Combattez les ennemis, améliorez les armes et le corps du ver pour vaincre la menace.
Welcome to Trazz! This is a casual, chill-out arcade game inspired by old popular brick breaker games like Arkanoid or Breakout. Lots of levels, weird power ups and upgrades.

titre: MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED BATTLE DESTINY REMASTERED
description: Devenez pilote dans le monde de Mobile Suit Gundam SEED, disponible pour la première fois avec une localisation anglaise ! Lancez-vous dans des affrontements Gundam palpitants et débordants d'action, accomplissez des missions et modifiez vos Mobile Suits fraîchement acquis !

titre: Dark Parables: Rise of the Snow Queen Collector's Edition
description: The legendary Snow Queen has risen!
BlackEye est un jeu d’aventure, où le personnage principal est un habitant souterrain. Il se rend en aventure dangereuse, en abattant les créatures souterraines et les plantes ennemis.

Hurry to encircle the growing monsters in the nest! Upgrade weapons, choose your exclusive occupation, strategy combination, a 15 minute meat pigeon experience, and directly shoot, explode, brush, explode!! You can also select the 20 minute mode!
Roam the dystopian future city of New Babel, Mankind's Last Hope, in search of crimes in progress. Use lethal weapons, non-lethal force, and diplomacy to take down bad guys.
Customize your Gun Bots to fight through 7 unique worlds with different weather conditions that become more challenging as you progress.

Lone Wolf : Un jeu de rôle beat-em-up post-apocalyptique. Ce jeu d'action et d'aventure permet au joueur d'utiliser des compétences en arts martiaux, des armes variées, et de se transformer en loup-garou pour traverser un monde dévasté par une catastrophe nucléaire.
Un action-RPG d'horreur en 2,5D dans un manoir victorien qui change chaque nuit.

A unique combination of space and racing sims. Choose between fast-paced, explosive action or more realistic simulation where drifting around every corner becomes more than just a gimmick - it's a necessity. Race around distinct locations such as the rings of Saturn or orbital city on Venus.

The Sun and Moon, the winner of Ludum Dare 29, is a platformer with a unique mechanic: you can dive into the ground. Momentum is conserved but gravity is reversed, letting you fling yourself high into the air or deep beneath the surface.

Tactical Control: the 7-minute wargame. Simplified strategy with minimalist graphics and quick, intense games. Play short matches against random opponents. Fight tense battles of stealth, anticipation and surprise. Win with strategy, deception and cleverness, not with reflexes and clicking speed.

Two Inns at Miller's Hollow is a social deduction game inspired by party games like Mafia, Two Rooms and a Boom, and Werewolf. Either protect your King from being converted to the church, or help the Pope discover his location.

Jeu de puzzle mystère inspiré de 2001 l'Odyssée de l'espace. Le métier d'électricien? Apportez la lumière là où règne l'obscurité. Année après année, des événements étranges affligent la colonie. Gérez les ressources, résolvez des énigmes difficiles et découvrez ce qui se cache sous la surface.

Captain Shika has seen all kinds of things in her adventures throughout the universe, and with her two loyal crew members by her side, she's managed to make a name for her small company of mercenaries. When Shika finds a bounty job offering an absurd amount of money, she doesn't hesitate to act: tracking hardened criminals is part of the...
Most unique top down shooter. Bring hell to insectoid robot invasion.
ÉVITER LA GRILLE

Yukumo is a young girl traversing the world in her beloved airship. Upon arriving at a certain town, her airship breaks down. She decides to explore the town to search for parts for repair; however, the town has fallen silent, with no trace of its inhabitants...
Steam's hardest perma-death platform game.

Imagine your dream date. That's what supposed to be with our hero, when he goes out with his beautiful girl. But his dream date suddenly becomes the survival game. Help him solve some riddles, pass difficult challenges, and escape the deadly laboratory.

titre: 琴葉姉妹とライサント島の伝説
description: This game is a turn-based action RPG that moves around in a 3D space where you can enjoy various scenery with cute 2D characters. Operate the Kotonoha sisters and explore a fun and mysterious island!

Don't Chat With Strangers is an experience puzzle game, mostly taking place in a single room. The main character in the middle of the night is approached by a strange girl in an online chat. Don't die and solve the mystery of the girl.

Tunche est un jeu d'action dessiné à la main et rempli de charme avec des éléments de roguelike. Faites équipe avec vos amis ou jouez seul. Choisissez parmi 5 personnages uniques et rétablissez la paix dans la forêt tropicale Amazonienne !

MITE is a horror game, with some difficulty, in which you play a hiker who has lost his family in a cursed forest... find your family and escape, while strange creatures from Japanese folklore chase you, orient yourself .
Trapped in an alien submarine, Edward's faith will be tested in a tale of trust and deceit. Bermuda is a visual novel mixed with open ended stealth puzzles.

Round 99 is a fast-paced shooter combined with a platformer that focuses on jumping around colorful environments and making a variety of enemies explode! Jump around 12 levels and bombard nearly 20 different enemies and bosses alone or with friends.
Small Sister is a game about a contest: "living in a house with strangers". The goal is to gain as many points as you can by interacting with other contestants and to be the winner at the end.

titre: Darkness and Flame: Born of Fire Collector's Edition
description: Un événement inattendu change pour toujours la vie d’une jeune fille. Dès lors, Alice devient partie prenante de l’éternel combat entre les ténèbres et la flamme.
Pioneerz make you a pioneer in a fantasy world, it's a sandbox RPG focus on town protection. Help your town, improve your ability, expand your kingdom! The road is harsh to make a peaceful empire!
Spacebase Startopia captive par son mélange original de simulation économique et de construction d'empire couplé à des escarmouches classiques de STR et d'une bonne dose d'humour.
Un jeu de tower defense et de simulation de colonies vous proposant de vivre un périple long et difficile au cœur d'une forteresse construite et portée sur son dos par un mystérieux arbre.

Race against your friends in a colorful platform world filled with colors and fun obstacles. Take boost to run faster or try to find the most efficient path to be the first little bunny to reach the goal. Choose from 8 levels. Collect those tasty carrots to rack up a high score and come out top!

titre: Adventure Chronicles: The Search For Lost Treasure
description: Find some of the greatest unsolved treasures of our time!
Dynamic tank shooter! Play on unique tanks of the future with individual abilities, mechanics and appearance. Upgrade your tank during the battle.

Le Livre de la jungle rencontre l'apocalypse. Un jeu de plateforme à l'histoire riche inspiré des classiques de SEGA, mais moderne. Traversez les ruines de l'humanité pendant que les mélodies et les histoires de l'apocalypse en révèlent plus.
Biorage is a high-intensity story-driven corridor FPS.

Cyberforge: First Light is a FREE developers build for our top-down cyberpunk adventure, Cyberforge! Control a trio of cyber-enhanced dwarves each with unique skills and weapons as the strive to survive this endless mode challenge. If you enjoy the Dev Build please Wishlist the Full Version.
PaintballX is an online mutliplayer FPS paintball game! Battle your friends in a casual paintball FPS!
Wave based Zombie FPS
Slashers est un jeu d’horreur coopératif à 1-4 joueurs, vous êtes des explorateurs de lieux abandonnés et apparemment maudits, votre but est de voir ce qui s’est passé là-bas.
Lorsqu'un éclair de lumière surprend Kali Müller, elle n'a d'autre choix que d'avancer dans les profondeurs de Rockrose pour découvrir si les légendes sont vraies.

Fabriquez des potions magiques et vendez-les dans votre propre boutique d'alchimie! Explorez le monde et récoltez des plantes pour découvrir de nouvelles recettes! Prenez soin de votre propre jardin d'alchimie et décorez la boutique comme vous le souhaitez dans ce jeu de simulation de vie!

Dans Entropy Rising, vous devrez résoudre des puzzles basés sur la physique en vue à la première personne à l'aide d'outils démesurés. Contrôlez les forces de la gravité, de l'électricité, du feu, de l'eau, et de l'acide. Si quelque chose ne se passe pas comme prévu, remontez simplement le temps.

titre: Cursed Treasure 2 Ultimate Edition - Tower Defense
description: Cursed Treasure 2 est un jeu de tower-défense addictif qui met le pouvoir des ténèbres à votre portée. En utilisant les pouvoirs des orcs, des démons et des morts-vivants, vous construirez des tours uniques et puissantes le long des chemins pour détruire tout héros qui oserait s'en approcher.

The Nanny is a short interactive horror story about the supernatural. Follow siblings Oliver and Tina in their quest to find their nanny after she disappears in the middle of the night. Welcome to a new dimension of horror. Welcome to Midnight Scenes.

You're a cat in a world of islands. You can explore, cook, build, destroy and collect drops. Don't worry about monsters, no one will attack you. But you have to care about food, stamina and economy! The game will have an update every Monday.
Control your character with different sounds, dodge traps, solve little puzzles

This is a role-playing ARPG game. The player will play Pig Bajie. The background of the plot is that Bai Gujing ate Tang Sanzang, and his skill increased greatly. Sun Wukong was killed alive. Pig Bajie seeks to revive his master and elder martial brother. The plot is rich and interesting

Become a boss of a construction company. Demolish old houses, flatten the ground, fill foundations with concrete and build new buildings - this is what you do. Sit behind the wheel of different construction machines - from trucks and diggers to huge cranes.

Hooligan James is a gangster first-person open-world set in the fictional city of "Lost Jersey". Wanna shoot guns and drive like a maniac? Got the urge to punch people and get in trouble with the cops? Look no further, this is the game for you!

Ten Days is a small game about a young man' life in city. He need to save himself in ten days by make a game or find a job or whatever could save him. You will make many choice , go through lots of stories to make it happen . It is easy to play, Most time you just move and click your mouse.

Endzone 2 est un jeu de gestion de colonie post-apocalyptique, dans lequel vous devrez assurer la survie de l'humanité après une catastrophe qui a tout détruit. Explorez les dernières terres habitables. La survie de votre peuple dépendra de votre prévoyance et de votre persévérance.
Escape the Smoky Intrigue of a Hometown Inferno!
You play the role of a black hole that has penetrated our world. Your task is to absorb as many houses, trees, cars and other objects as possible.
A girl crashed into a dark forest not knowing where to go, curiosity drives her to open a Pandora’s box that was never meant to be opened.
Combine all gemstones to complete the many different missions in this match 3 game.

titre: 不可能犯罪事件簿-Impossible Crime Book
description: This is a decryption class of interactive novel. One accident, two suicides. In order to prevent more innocent lives from being killed, you will be assigned to lurk on campus with your partner and find out the suspicious in different criminal cases.

Dans ce RPG steampunk à l'ère victorienne se jouant avec des cartes de tarot, enquêtez sur d'étranges disparitions et découvrez l'existence d'une secte mystérieuse. Incarnez jusqu'à 3 personnages différents, personnalisables en débloquant de nouvelles cartes par vos choix narratifs.

Headquarters: World War II est un jeu de stratégie au rythme effréné dans lequel tes tactiques militaires comptent autant que tes compétences logistiques. Découvre chaque camp en incarnant les États-Unis, le Royaume-Uni ou l'Allemagne. Prends d'assaut des bunkers et remporte des duels de chars.
An epic tale that begins from shooting missiles! The newest work of the Caladrius series with lots of new features that exceeds the original story!
Pizza! Giant robots! Lasers, destruction, evil cyborgs! Arcade action in a fully customizable mech with a pizzeria in its chest.

There is unease in the demonic astral plain these days. The Nothern king is dead, and the prince is about to rise to the throne. But he is a strange silent lad. Human commoners (like me) have nothing to do with the local intrigue. Yet...somehow I am now in the very epicenter of this revolution?!
Is a hidden object game in which you need to find all the cats in a large location. Seals will be located in a variety of places, from the most prominent to barely noticeable places
Can you adjust these raw images for a client? Advance your dream of becoming a colour grading professional. Beat the clock, impress your crush again! Practice today! The long awaited sequel.
Dans Seaorama: World of Shipping, gérez une entreprise de transport maritime et assurez sa prospérité.

Compete with friends or players from around the globe using some of the world's deadliest modern weapons and vehicles in this intense First Person Shooter. Play in unique environments designed for infantry, vehicle, and air combat.
A brisk, soothing action-puzzle game. At a playtime of 25-45 minutes, this game offers a condensed, yet polished and complete experience, and can be enjoyed fresh or replayed at any time of the day.

Take Command and Secure Victory in the Great War! Commander – The Great War features a Grand Campaign covering the whole war from the invasion of Belgium on August 5, 1914 to the Armistice on the 11th of November 1918 in addition to 16 different unit types including Infantry, Cavalry, Armoured Cars and Tanks, Artillery, and much more!
Welcome to Simp Simulator. Queen desires money, perhaps it's time to simp! Collect as many money sacks as you could and deliver them to your queen! Hurry though, queen does not like to wait.
Happy Numbers is a relaxing, mind-blending, minimalist puzzle game that offer over 70 hand-crafted levels to immerse your self into. The game also constain a lot of beautiful characters to unlock.

"Remuage - MeltySensation" is a unique VR rhythm game (RhythmGame) based on the operating modes of various popular rhythm games on the market. The game has been licensed by SQUARE ENIX's well-known IP "Aozora Under Girls!", so we have created a special customized "Remuage - MeltySensation" for VR users.

Benchmark your VR setup - OpenVR Benchmark is the first benchmark tool for reproducibly testing your real VR performance, rendering inside of your VR headset. See if your hardware performs correctly! VR headset required.
Professor Hunt embarks on an adventure journey from London to Lapland and Madagascar, in search of mysterious ancient board games.
Logical game with different color light rays
You uncovered the conspiracy of General Sherman and must defeat his army.

Politon : Un jeu de stratégie au tour par tour qui mettra vos compétences en stratégie et en gestion à l'épreuve ! Agrandissez votre territoire, renforcez votre économie et battez vos ennemis en planifiant soigneusement votre stratégie.
Ce jeu est un jeu d'action qui combine des éléments du jeu de tir rétro classique et du style low poly. La tâche du joueur est de détruire tous les ennemis qui se rencontrent sur le chemin.
Classic Beat 'em Up action from the creator of Gunman Clive and Mechstermination Force
Kick, throw and thrash your way to victory in this gothic multiplayer platform brawler. Explore dungeons, unlock new characters, kick butts!

Dans ce jeu de simulation de ferme paisible, découvrez l’île de Seikyu, occupez-vous de vos champs, restaurez votre maison ancestrale, tissez des liens forts avec les habitants et changez-vous en différentes formes pour explorer un monde qui vit au rythme des saisons.

Sautez, Accélérez, Récupérez des objets ! Jouez en solo ou avec vos amis! Explorez cet adorable jeu de plate-forme en 3D en incarnant Boti, un bot de données attachant et courageux. Rejoignez Boti dans cette aventure et aidez-le à sauver son cybermonde, Byteland, des bugs et des virus!
Retro Gadgets est une station de création de gadgets où vous pouvez inventer, souder, coder et personnaliser vos propres gadgets électriques, puis les partager avec le monde.
A portal inspired walking simulator horror game.

Gladiator, you are now a knight! The greatest gladiator series in the world, Swords and Sandals, has just gone medieval! Swords and Sandals moves into the middle ages in this action packed, turn-based combat RPG.
Hidden object game in the setting of a cartoon cafe. Black and white hand-drawn graphics. This is a kind game for kids.

Le jeu continue de présenter le style dessiné à la main caractéristique de CottonGame, avec un gameplay de type point-and-click. Le jeu propose également un deuxième mode de jeu, qui permet aux joueurs d'approfondir leur compréhension du jeu.
In this 2D RPG, Rollo will have to become much more than a street urchin and care for the survival of all people, instead of only his own.
Collection of a few arcade classics, remade with a fresh and friendly looking art style and a beautiful soundtrack.

Ancient demons summoned from the deep dark abyss, and brought ruin to Tiede, land of our home. You should know your towers, and use them wisely. Bring your sword, worrior, and your brave heart! Join me in this defence of the ancient...lands!

Maitrisez la force magnétique pour repousser les vagues d'ennemis dans ce jeu d'arcade nerveux et dynamique. A l'aide de deux aimants et d'un palet, vous devez contrôler votre vitesse et vos trajectoires pour détruire les agresseurs. Soyez rapides, soyez précis et survivez !

titre: Midnight Mysteries: Witches of Abraham - Collector's Edition
description: For the past few years, you've been writing bestselling novels based on the stories you've heard told by the ghosts who visit you at midnight. But tonight you have a special visitor, Abraham Lincoln, the 16th President of the United States! Go back in time and find the treasure of the Knights of the Golden Circle!
Travel through the Northern Lights, D.Tiffany's song as imagined by Jack Rothwell.

titre: Ghost Town Mine Ride & Shootin' Gallery
description: Explore an abandoned tourist attraction, test your shot at the Shootin' Gallery, then board the mine cart ride for a descent into Hell! A thrilling new horror experience for the HTC Vive. Can you make it out Alive?
Defend the planet from endless waves of alien ships in this retro arcade shooter. Craft the turret to best fend off the alien assault with shotgun, explosive and many more modifiers.

You've mysteriously awoken on an isolated island on an unknown world. A corrupting force spreads through the island, leaving only a short amount of time to learn about the islands mysteries... Who will you meet? What will you learn? Are you ready to see the world die?
A sci-fi, yuri visual novel with a dollop of mystery.

Control a melodramatic werewolf on a quest to find his missing were-wife in this retro-styled beat 'em up. Fight hordes of rope-jumping mummies, invisible men, lazy superheroes, and the Frankenstein monster (on roller skates!)
Détendez-vous et promenez-vous dans ce pays de rêve, obtenez de l'énergie positive et évitez les énergies négatives.

Kingdom's Deck est un jeu de construction de ville basé sur des cartes où vous devez construire et protéger votre Royaume contre un siège ennemi. Constituez votre deck, déployez vos carts avec sagesse, défendez vos murs, gérez vos ressources, répondez à divers événements qui façonneront votre ville.
Second Chance is a 2D, Top-view, turn-based JRPG. Based on the same planet as "The Story Of Hyk" ebooks, Skettaria. This game has been made by the one person.

Swim ashore to 22 challenging levels, finding the most streamlined way of collapsing every building on each island. Navigating your way through Hard Hitting Tanks, Turn Tracing Jet Missiles, and Tazer Death Rays to destroy them all for trying to keep you from fulfilling your passion of DESTRUCTION!

This intense simulation recreates a school shooting scenario, lasting 10 minutes. Players navigate halls representing real-life tragedies, collecting gun bills to survive. The game aims to highlight the failure to protect schools and motivate action to prevent future shootings and save lives.

Plongez dans un jeu d'exploration au tour par tour situé dans un Far West mystique. Planifiez stratégiquement vos mouvements , découvrez des artefacts magiques, prenez des risques et percez les mystères des plaines de Coldridge!
Oubliez la cybernétique et les machines à vapeur ! Plongez au cœur du Moyen-Âge, à l'époque où le BOIS constituait la principale source d'énergie !

Delta Force®: Xtreme™ vous apporte le meilleur de Delta Force pour combattre l'ennemi une nouvelle fois. Partez pour les 60 missions solo et multijoueurs que vous apporte ce jeu qui comprend de nombreuses améliorations ! Comprend Plus de 60 missions qui vont mettre vos capacités de coordination à l'épreuve.
We all have a "Daily Run" in our schools and jobs, like in every race there will be obstacles and triumphs.
Combattez sur des chars d'assaut dans une histoire de combattants de la liberté !

Vous devez entretenir un jardin le temps d'un week-end, mais plusieurs outils ont étrangement disparu… Le propriétaire est absent et sa maison fermée à clé. Vous devriez pouvoir trouver de nouveaux outils dans le mystérieux village, mais oserez-vous demander de l'aide à ses discrets habitants ?

Krumit's Tale, the second game in the Meteorfall universe, is a new take on the deckbuilding roguelike genre. Use your cards to clear dungeons, then upgrade your deck with new cards and perks to press forward. The fate of the world is in your hands.

Welcome to the world of Hoven! Join Bradley and his friends on an adventure that transforms into an epic quest! Traverse dangerous dungeons and battle fearsome foes. Discover the truth about who you are and what you have to do to save the world from the evil sage, Maluma!

Combattez et vomissez pour trouver le bon chemin dans l'un des 100 niveaux pleins d'action dans un monde coloré d'arcade-aventure ! Que se passerait-il si pac-man grossissait chaque fois qu'il mangeait ? Dans Pig Eat Ball, vous devrez manger toutes les balles pour terminer les niveaux, mais plus VOUS MANGEREZ, PLUS VOUS GROSSIREZ.

Représente le monde de l'enfer; Des mondes qui peuvent faire la navette entre les espaces, des mondes qui peuvent faire tourner les continents, des mondes qui symbolisent la rédemption… dans le futur, des mondes plus représentatifs de la création, des mondes qui peuvent créer le vôtre à l’intérieur

A quiet night turns to horror as strange lights fill the sky and Gleam City falls apart. Play as Sarah, an ex-soldier fighting to survive, searching for her missing father, and facing something the world wasn't meant to see.
Explore the center of the Milky Way like never before!
studio: Instituto de Astrofísica, PUC de Chile

description: Dice & Dungeons is a unique deck builder. You build a DICE deck (dicebuilding)! Explore dungeons, fight enemies with increasingly difficult and get new dice to your deck. A dungeon and it's challenges are never the same as before.
Play as Jake, a teen Pizza Delivery driver on the late shift - until things get BLOODY! Try to escape this DEMENTED Farm with your life! Features PS1, & OPTIONAL 80's VHS Graphics.
Protect me, and I I'll help you do it more effectively.

The Old God has left the world and the pretenders are awakening and coming out from hiding. You start the game by designing one of the pretender gods that will compete for true ascension to godhood. The type of god can range from a magically powerful arch mage to an ancient kraken or a mystic monolith that people pray to.

Dashpong est un jeu d'arcade plein d'action en multijoueurs local où vous dashez partout sur le terrain à pleine vitesse. Créez des blocs pour défendre vos buts and tapez dans la balle vers vos adversaires pour marquer. Amusez vous jusqu'à 4 joueurs en multi-joueurs local.
Use your power washer to move objects, put out fires, and clean grime away.

Gloire et aventure attendent votre retour pour sauver l’Égypte Antique de certains démons dans Luxor: Amun Rising. À mesure que les sphères colorées approchent rapidement aux portes des pyramides, c'est à vous de les stopper grâce à votre scarabée-tireur magique.
Can the cook save the ship?

Lift off into the cosmos in this stunning immersive 3D VR music video taking you on a futuristic journey into space with mesmerizing visuals of evolving sacred geometric patterns and a sense of weightlessness as you fly through the stars, all choreographed to original electronic music.
travel through the LA wasteland with josh and sid in this atmospheric interactive video novel
In the second episode of Finite State Automation Challenges, you will use finite-state automata to overcome 80 challenges from character string manipulation, computer science, and mathematics.

Born Race is an action-adventure retro-style game about four sperms who wish to win the Most Important Race of Life. An odd adventure with a different story for each one of them. Challenges, exploration and puzzles are necessary for them to reach the ovum. Are you up to the challenge?

Somewhere, in some town that may be unknown to all; there was Tarim, a sad but strong hermit that without knowing it or be waiting for it would be forced by itself to enter on a great adventure to save to the town of his childhood, a town without stains and that never had known the fear.

Il est temps de dire bonjour à votre vieux copain, Fred. Arizona Sunshine® 2, la suite nouvelle génération de l'apocalypse VR préférée des fans, offre encore plus d'action de zombies gore ! Et quoi de mieux que de braver la fin de ce p... de monde ? Survivre avec votre nouveau meilleur ami - Buddy.

Beaucoup de temps (en fonction de vos compétences, heures à jours), Jusqu'à des dizaines de musique de fond. Des niveaux de jeu bien conçus. Histoire complète, plusieurs étapes de jeu. Beau et fantastique style d'art. Des dizaines de réalisations. Plusieurs classements. C'est un jeu très difficile.

AMaze DOS est un casse-tête DOS classique dans lequel les joueurs créent des structures mécaniques dans le style de RUB Goldberg en utilisant différents objets pour atteindre des objectifs donnés. Avec chaque nouveau défi, des mécanismes de plus en plus complexes et des solutions uniques apparaissent.

Arriving on a curious planet, Vix and her toolbox Tin explore space, fixing machines with unconventional tools and eating cozy meals with kind robot locals. On an epic adventure, the duo repairs an interstellar beacon, constructs giant mechs, and unravels a cosmic mystery that transcends existence.

titre: Wyv and Keep: The Temple of the Lost Idol
description: Command treasure hunters Wyv and Keep through an ancient Amazonian temple in search of the Lost Idol! Use quick reflexes and teamwork to conquer a gauntlet of 60 fiendish puzzles and deadly traps. Unlock the secrets of the mystical Xu'hutl pygmies and their terrifying overlord, the great Quetzecola.

titre: The House in Fata Morgana: A Requiem for Innocence
description: « A Requiem for Innocence » est un complément du visual novel « The House in Fata Morgana. » Il conte le récit de la chute d'un jeune homme dépassé par ses ambitions et d'une jeune fille à la fois vénérée comme une sainte et vilipendée comme une sorcière. Pour eux, il n'y aura pas de fin heureuse.

Découvrez le combat au tour par tour ultrarapide d'AVARIAvs ! Contrôlez 16 héros uniques, utilisez de véritables malus ahurissants et déchaînez des Brûlures de Focus épiques pour décrocher la victoire. Créez VOTRE groupe, détruisez l'ennemi et GAGNEZ !

Open-world third-person game crossed with an off-road vehicle sim. Exit the vehicle in 3rd person, use character tools, collect items to sell from the pouch or collect your machines in the vehicle inventory. Mods, damage and dirtiness is progressive and lasting. Multiple stage releases.
🌸Catgirls From My Sweet Dream🌸 - un visual novel satirique simple et amusant avec un gameplay de type "Match3" dans le cadre magique japonais. Des goodies japonais et des Nekogirls !
This is a Short Clicking Adventure Game in which you Save Earth from an Alien Invasion.
Have a relationship with a charming priestess! An urban fantasy short and brisk visual novel with elements of slavic mythology.

100 Steps est un « tower crawler » roguelite dans un style jeu de société fantastique. En quête de gloire, vous avez accepté le défi perfide des dieux : gravir la Tour. Abattez votre main, aventurier. Et surveillez vos pas.
Small game in Tower Defence genre with elements of shooter. Kill Replicators all by yourself or make perfect defence with different turrets.

Mandinga: A tale of Banzo is a role-playing game inspired by the JRPG classics, with an unique dice based battle system, full of strategy and challenges. A game with an immersive history, based on a deeply important historical moment in Brazil.
Lancez votre pierre, et vous êtes obligé de vous déplacer jusqu'au point où elle s'arrête. La règle est la même que pour le golf.

Découvrez l'eXtase de l'action 2D ! Une nouvelle ère d'action 2D commence maintenant ! Préparez-vous à un jeu d'action 2D à défilement horizontal plus rapide et stylé que tout ce que vous avez connu à ce jour. Inti Creates présente le nec plus ultra de l'action 2D classique avec « Luminous Avenger iX » !
Pilot two ships to protect the last cities on Earth
NeonVoid Runner is a infinite runner in which the player will test their reaction time in a fast virtual reality race placed in a futurist synthwave neon world.

« Tandis que le dernier jour d'été s'estompe, tout s'illumine. » Découvrez le tout nouveau jeu de la série BLUE REFLECTION, avec des designs translucides somptueux réalisés par Mel Kishida et une histoire qui dépeint la jeunesse de filles réalistes qui nouent des liens et se questionnent sur leur identité !
ABRISS est un jeu de destruction et de construction atmosphérique basé sur la physique.Construis des structures à partir de différentes pièces et fais-les s'écraser sur tes cibles.

titre: Is this Game Trying to Kill Me?
description: An old shack deep in a dense forest, a strange computer and a game that's trying to kill you!
Nous vous présentons l’adaptation numérique du jeu de plateau Viticulture de Jamey Stegmaier et Alan Stone.
So obvious and typical story, just puzzle and dodge traps. (English version will be provided soon.)
Alone on a collapsing asteroid. Weave your way through 26 nail-biting, butt-clenching deep space tunnels, where victory is about deft handling of inertia and momentum. Go faster, score higher.

Kalnazar est un jeu en ligne massivement multijoueur. Incarnez des aventuriers et explorez le nouveau monde ou incarnez un gladiateur et combattez d'autres joueurs dans des arènes ou des champs de bataille.

Un tour par tour léger roguelike jeu avec 3 modes de jeu pour trouver la statue de la déesse, purifier la terre, ou équiper pour vaincre les sbires de l'empereur noir. En cours de route, vous pouvez rencontrer des chevaliers perdus, des dragons divins exotiques et combattre l'ultime monarque noir.
Fly for a spaceship and destroy enemy alien ships to return to your homeplanet – Nibiru

Une simulation de gestion de colonie de science-fiction axée sur l'exploration, l'expansion et la survie. Reconstruisez vos installations souterraines, gérez les colons et les robots et découvrez les mystères d'un monde extraterrestre à des années-lumière de la Terre.

In times of peace, a lone wanderer decides to camp for the night. He faces an unexpected attack from an orc. Trying to find out why he has been kidnapped, then learns the dark history of an outcast orc tribe. You must escape before the Crimson Rite.

Nilia is a turn-based Roguelike game. You can choose to play up to four characters at the same time. Each character can evolve with lots of abilities, skills and spells. You also rely on various items that you will find on your way.
Build and play with others with a physics based sandbox created in unreal engine 5

EnHanced is a short, story driven platform shooter game lovingly rendered in a classic retro style! Enhance your health, jump, beam range, power and more by defeating enemies and discovering secrets! Also Larank the admin is there to guide you, he finds pretty much all of it very entertaining!
Air Missions: HIND est un simulateur de combat basé sur l’hélicoptère d’assaut russe Mil Mi-24 HIND.
Une lettre d'amour aux jeux NES classiques ! Explorez un labyrinthe en constante expansion et stimulant rempli d'innombrables secrets.
Jeu de puzzle relaxant avec d'adorables filles neko.
you have an update for your operating system...
Faites appel à votre ruse pour rosser les démons des sept péchés capitaux et pour sauver l'humanité de la destruction !

Autrefois le laboratoire d'un savant fou, à présent un manoir abandonné hanté par des malotrus. Travaillez en équipe de 1 à 4 joueurs dans ce jeu d'horreur psychologique en ligne en coopération et découvrez ce qui se trouve à l'intérieur. Trouve un remède avant qu'il ne soit trop tard...

Coin Pusher World is an interactive chat game designed for Twitch. Drop coins at the comfort of your own home, and share the experience with your viewers. Climb the leaderboards, earn tickets while playing to purchase custom coin skins and more! Have Fun & Happy Dropping!

BUMPER is a casual game made on Blender Game Engine where the player must to destroy the vehicles as much as possible, trying not to get caught by the police, reach the checkpoints to get time and improve your weapons.

Control a customizable tank in a endless run, trying to get the highest rank. Random Arena Mode - With each battle an arena full of enemies will be created. Surrounded Mode - Classic mode with waves of enemies. Each level, more enemies.
One Character, One way and One Button you must never let go of.Just Walk.

This visual novel about an ordinary man with his typical problems. Suddenly, you got a report that your distant cousin died in a car crash. Fortunately, her daughter wasn't with her. You take the girl under your wing. But soon, something starts to go wrong...

titre: The Method of Hiding a Body
description: A story-driven horror puzzle game where the player takes on the role of a resentful ghost, possessing others in order to search for her own corpse.

Distant Nightmare will immerse you in a dark and mysterious world thanks to VR. The game puts you in the shoes, and on the bike, of a child in a nightmare. Your objective is to cycle through the unexplored environments of your mind in hopes to survive the night and wake up the next day.

OneShift est un jeu de plateforme de puzzle où le joueur possède la possibilité de bloquer/débloquer le temps et de passer à travers les mondes pour collecter des cubes bleus. Cependant, un seul monde peut être actif à la fois.
The Telephone - Un jeu d'horreur psychologique en vue subjective. Explore la maison et la ville mystérieuse de Lonely Plain pour trouver des indices et aider Roberta à retrouver sa mémoire

titre: 漢字でGO! 集英社マンガ祭
description: The popular kanji quiz game "Kanji de GO!" teams up with Shueisha manga in a dream collaboration! Challenge yourself with furigana quizzes featuring tricky kanji from a wide range of Shueisha's classic and modern hit manga!

“Keepers of the Trees” is a couch co-op puzzle platformer that gives you the power to control nature. Along with a friend, you will test your platforming mettle, work together to solve puzzles by growing special plants, and explore a lush, fantasy forest world.

Libérez votre habileté tactique dans ce jeu de stratégie de construction de deck innovant et obsédant. Créez des cartes avec des composants uniques pour résoudre des énigmes lors de votre voyage pour échapper à la maison hantée dans laquelle vous êtes coincé(e)!

Participez avec les Umamusume au Slapdash GP, un événement spécial du Grand Festival des Fans de printemps ! Les Umamusume, dessinées en pixel-art, vous entraînent dans une série de 4 épreuves toute plus délirantes les unes que les autres ! Quelle équipe saura tirer son épingle du jeu ?
Courir, sauter, puzzle. Les tâches que vous devez maîtriser dans Obby avec Kitty.

The Amoreon NightClub is a single player disco, where you can dance with virtual characters, challenge yourself to gain points by following the dance moves, select songs and add your own music. You can see your own VR body, use your hands and fingers with thumb sticks.

Project New Home. You will play as a teen girl that will explore the world with her drone Cassandra but encounter mysterious obstacles along the way. She has the power to open all the portals. On her adventure, you will find mystery creatures that will help you or hunt you down.
A puzzle platformer with funky physics and mind boggling puzzles requiring out-of-the-box thinking and persistence. Only a few players were able to complete the game. Can you handle it?

Hello! We want to meet you! There are different animal girls among us, we live in different biomes, and we have different habits and characters. Someone is gentle, and it is better not to get close to someone. Who do you like the most?

THE SIN COLLECTOR: REPENTLESS is a game on the border of a visual novel and a classic text RPG, set in the world of The Sin Collector, a series of books written by Michał Gołkowski. Action takes place a couple of years before the events presented in the books.
Jogue com os mascotes de Atlético MG e Cruzeiro neste jogo multiplayer de tiro em terceira pessoa!

Mobius. An idyllic world that lets people forget about the pain and problems of reality. Created by a sentient vocaloid program, μ (Mu), reality and fantasy have become blurred, allowing people to relive their high school years in bliss -- but just how real is a virtual happiness?

titre: Wild West - Cherche et Trouve Objet Caché Jeux
description: Western cyberpunk atmosphérique ! Menez l'enquête comme un vrai détective. Des personnages insolites, un gang mystérieux, un concurrent dans l'enquête et, bien sûr, une femme fatale vous attendent ! Jeu de recherche d'objets cachés.

Inheritors 2078 is an RTS/TPS/FPS hybrid game with full Multiplayer & Co-op support, taking its events in the near future where the world is being dominated by evil robotic incarnates that were once enslaved by humans.

Découvrez Swim Out, un jeu de puzzle/stratégie tour par tour à l’atmosphère relaxante et dépaysante. Nagez dans le bleu étincelant de piscines limpides, le courant rafraîchissant de rivières, ou au gré du roulis de l’océan, mais ne croisez jamais le chemin des autres nageurs !

Juego en tercera persona para niños y padres. Es un pequeño mundo abierto donde los niños pueden aprender a emprender en pequeños negocios como la venta de limonadas, pasteles y también aprender sobre finanzas, con entretenidas misiones e importantes moralejas para la vida.

Don’t Forget Our Esports Dream is a narrative game about the South Korean esports scene. Play as Bolt, a professional StarCraft: Brood War player at a flashpoint in his career. Play like a pro with guided StarCraft scenes, and see what it takes to live the dream.
you are locked inside by a creature. figure out how to escape from the estate you have been locked inside. who lived here? who are the voices haunting your every step?
In this visual novel by Studio Pork, make a strong-willed yet acquiescent, pure-hearted but rebellious housewife fall in love with you!

Welcome to Light Fields. Experience real-world reflections, depth, and translucence like never before in VR. Explore the Gamble House, Mosaic Tile House, and the Space Shuttle Discovery. These navigable stills showcase the emerging technology Google is using to power its next generation of VR content.
TTV2 is an arcade retro hardcore maze wanderer minigame, sequel to Trip to Vinelands.

Play as a contractor for a mysterious organization in a new mystery point and click. You're tasked to review tapes and complete reports about strange situations. Find clues, connect dots, choose what you want to believe and influence the world.

"This is the Gunjo Broadcasting Club. Is there anyone left out there?” CROSS†CHANNEL is now available to the whole world for the first time ever. Eight students relive an eternally looping week as tensions rise. Can they mend their broken friendships, or are they too far gone to salvage...?
Grand Dude Simulator is an open world sandbox game. This is a life simulator. The main objective is to enjoy what you are doing.
Winter Resort Simulator 2 is the extensive simulation of a ski area with all its exciting technical facilities and vehicles.

À coups de blaster, frayez-vous un chemin à travers un labyrinthe sans fin peuplé de robots meurtriers et de leur maître invincible et terrifiant : le méchant Otto. Rejoignez un ami en coop locale à cette nouvelle version à double-joystick du classique des jeux d’arcade.

As a paranormal investigator, your job is to discover the magical properties of anomalous items and find creative ways to use them against supernatural creatures. Without accidentally being abducted by a dark entity or suffering a bizarre anomalous effect, of course!

Ascendant is the unforgiving beat 'em up in which you are a demigod invading a world controlled by your rivals. Choose your fate by discovering Blessings, equipping mighty weapons and spells, and learning to survive in this brutal realm. Only the most impressive warriors have a chance of victory.

Cyndefense 2 is a well crafted, hardcore, tower defense game. While there are easier modes for those who want casual game-play, the game will test your ability to manage your resources and rely on superb tower placement in order to be capable of beating harder maps.

Dominique Pamplemousse in “It’s All Over Once The Fat Lady Sings!” is a unique and offbeat stop motion animated detective adventure game about gender and the economy. Also, all the characters frequently burst into song.

Chaque fille neko aime la propreté, veut nettoyer et prendre soin d'un maître. Et chaque bonne a un secret - l'un aime être photographié dans le miroir du maître, l'autre aime s'échapper à la plage pendant une pause-café...

Sur le chemin du retour en train, vous n'étiez pas attentif. Jusqu'à ce que vous réalisiez que le train s'arrêtait à la même station encore et encore. Faites attention aux anomalies et évitez la Sortie Anormale ! Conçu pour un joueur seul et de 2 à 6 joueurs en coopération.
Hollow's Land is relaxing game where you kill skeletons of fire who are trying to put out your bonfire. Throwing snowballs under the northern lights.

Menez un commando de scientifiques derrière les lignes ennemies pour combattre les nazis, percer des mystères insondables et manipuler des technologies expérimentales afin d'inverser le cours de la Seconde Guerre mondiale.

Pour chasser les vampires, vous aurez besoin d'armes. Beaucoup d'armes. Décimez des hordes de créatures mortes-vivantes en empilant vos armes dans des constructions exagérées et impressionnantes. Déchaînez votre puissance de feu et survivez au chaos dans ce FPS Survivors Roguelite.

Vous êtes plus qu'un coach. Vous êtes le boss incontesté du club. Que diriez-vous de dominer la ligue avec votre équipe dans cette réimagination de la franchise classique de gestion sportive ? Pourriez-vous être le prochain grand manager ? Prouvez-le !

Par les créateurs de Natural Selection nous vient Zen of Sudoku, une version PC de sudoku à la fois relaxante et facile à jouer.Des arrière-plans de style japonais, pas de chronomètre et un bruit de fond naturel pour vous relaxer.Stimule vos neurones pour vous maintenir alerte.

Program robots to solve issues around Singularity Corporation’s factory. Make sure to keep your head down and eyes focused on your work tasks that take the form of puzzles. Don’t worry, Singularity has everyone’s best interest at heart and would never be planning something sinister...

Contrôlez des hélicoptères et devenez le membre d'une véritable équipe de secours ! Sauvez et évacuez les gens, éteignez des incendies et complétez d'autres missions dangereuses. C'est votre chance non seulement de devenir un sauveteur mais aussi de maîtriser les compétences de pilotage. Soyez prêt pour le décollage !

King of the World est basé sur un gameplay RISK dans un contexte de stratégie en temps réel. Combattez jusqu'à 12 joueurs les uns contre les autres en complotant, en poignardant et en faisant des alliances ou tout simplement en conquérant pour devenir le dernier homme debout.
Emparez-vous du fromage et échappez aux chats dans cette course d’obstacles hilarante.

Live Inc. is an online 2vs2 heist game where two opposing players play in a cat and mouse scenario and their team members play as overseers of the map. Teams can use unique mechanics to interact with the map and must work together to outsmart their opponent.

The Use of Life is a multi-ending adventure book style JRPG. The main character’s various attachments change in accordance with the choices the player makes, and the ending changes depending on “the use of life” you choose through your journey.
studio: だらねこげーむず/Daraneko Games

description: apolitical
Cally’s Caves 4 is a run-and-gun action game, with tons of powerups, weapons, and levels. When your friend needs your help, there’s only one thing to do: LEVEL UP EVERYTHING!

titre: Sherlock Holmes Consulting Detective: The Case of the Tin Soldier
description: Inspector Smythe from Scotland Yard has informed Watson and me of the murder of General Armstead, a Tontine ticket holder. Something about this case intrigues me. Perhaps it ís that the General was about to publish a scintillating addendum to his infamous book on treasure.
Dinosaur Hunt First Blood is a sequel to a first Dinosaur Hunt game and is a chaotic first person shooter that confronts heavily armed players with the most horrifying dino-humans.
Faraway est un jeu d'aventure, un hommage moderne à Myst. Dans Faraway, vous êtes un aventurier explorant les ruines d'anciens temples pleins de défis et d'énigmes mystérieuses.
Welcome to Emerland Solitaire, the land of card magic! An incredible journey awaits you, in a beautiful world filled with dwarfs, elves, mermaids and many other amazing creatures.

"Kaku: Ancient Seal is our latest epic adventure game. You play Kaku, a heroic young boy who embarks on an exciting adventure with his loyal pet, in a sprawling fantasy world set in an ancient, forgotten time. Are you ready to leave your legacy in the world of Oraka?
Fight for your rights as a homeless person in this mini Metroidvania SPEEDRUNNER.

titre: Les Aventures de LinShanHai - Chapitre 2:Attentat à la bombe dans le bus
description: Le deuxième cas de Lin Shanhai. Un autobus explose soudainement, les dix personnes à bord, y compris le conducteur et le vendeur, sont mortes. Lin Shanhai enquête minutieusement pour reconstituer la situation réelle à bord du bus avant l'incident et raisonner.
Wandering Meatbags is a FPS zombie shooter. Walk around in the city, find loot and survive to the waves of zombies !
Morbid is an atmospheric psychological horror game; experienced as Senior Detective J. Taylor, unfold haunting and morbid events that will question your sanity.

titre: TT Isle Of Man: Ride on the Edge 3
description: Un tracé mythique pour tous les motards. 200km de routes ouvertes pour s'y préparer. Une physique exigeante. Une simulation pour les meilleurs.

titre: Moonstone Tavern - A Fantasy Tavern Sim!
description: With the death of your aunt you have been left the once famous Moonstone Tavern. Unfortunately the tavern has seen better days. With only two functioning rooms, crumbling architecture, and an ever-diminishing reputation there is plenty of room for improvement.

Mercs Fully Loaded is a TPS (Third Person Shooter) RPG. Start your career at Mercs-HQ as their newest recruit, help citizens of Mercs-HQ rebuild the city, play mini-games or hunt for collectibles in your spare time.
As Leon, the world’s most dangerous bounty hunter, you embark on a mission to slay the world’s weirdest creatures, and save a girl from an awful marriage.
Mine and combine gems for your defenses. Play Arcade Mode and accompany Lou on a journey to save the Star Babies.

titre: NETABOKU -A robot girl changes my life as a bedridden boy-
description: This game is a sci-fi romantic adventure(visual novel) modeled after the avatar robot cafe. Japan, circa 2040. Kanto lives in a residential facility for the severely physically disabled. One day, they meet a mysterious girl, Kanata, and their destiny changes dramatically...
EggK47™ is a retro styled, addictive, and fast paced single player shoot 'em up featuring a hero chicken and it's gun!

‘D.N.Age’ features a DNA system that will open your eyes to a new, never-before-seen world of monster merging. Improve the DNA of your monsters to create stronger specimens and form a party to complete quests!
A block hexa puzzle roguelike where you optimize hexagon puzzles by putting cities together and extending roads to help your kingdom endure. Daily leaderboards show off the greatest rulers.

SCP: EVENT CLASSIFIED est un jeu de tir d'horreur multijoueur qui permet aux joueurs de jouer le rôle d'un soldat, d'un prisonnier, d'un scientifique et même d'un monstre. Combattez d'autres joueurs dans cette installation secrète avec des sessions de jeu allant jusqu'à 120 joueurs.
A tale of a Kid who's looking for a treasure by looking for a turtle that he will have to save but first he must find.

HIVE is a multiplayer hero shooter in 2.5D side scroll with futuristic style and frenetic gameplay. Up to 10 players will have to fight in hexagon-shaped combat areas, divided into 6 zones, each one with Its own gravity direction.
Part interactive fiction, part Felis domesticus adventure, “Cats and the Other Lives” explores the reunion of a broken family from the perspective of their house cat, Aspen.
Join the CTU, arrest dangerous terrorist threats, use gadgets including the snake cam and play online with up to five player co-op

Tricks of Gods and Ghosts is a female-oriented pixel rpg game set in a hollow female background. In the game, you will play the role of Zhen Wu Si's Tiqi to move freely in the Jianghu and the imperial court. The sea of bureaucracy is full of changes. The fate of the world is yours to decide.
studio: 猫台班子工作室 Cat Caboodle

description: The Witch Eye is an indie psychological horror game . As a local hunter vicky explore valley of majuli village and try to survive long enough to discover the terrible secrets of the witch "nale ba"
Put on a magical disguise to find true love! As a changeling, will you stay among the human nobility, or join the fairy revolution?

Fuel Renegades is an epic arcade racing game REAL FREE (no DLC, no loot boxes, just fun), where your brain will produce tons of adrenaline because of the awesome races endings. Play up to four players in the same computer enjoying the polished mechanics that gives you a smooth game feel.

Arrangez les joyaux qui tombent depuis le haut de l’écran. Si au moins trois joyaux de même couleur sont placés à la verticale, à l’horizontale ou à la verticale, ils disparaîtront. Ne les laissez pas s’empiler jusqu’en haut de l’écran, sinon vous perdrez la partie.

titre: Gold Rush In The Oort Cloud
description: Welcome to the SSGMC - Solar System Gold Mining Corp. You're going to mine a gold! Gold from asteroids.

From a peaceful training village to a hell-like demon world, you become Ninja Guy, in his hilariously epic quest to prove himself to the Holy Cow Sensei and bring down an evil gargantuan Minotaur! Remember... Guns don't kill people, Ninja do!
Classic Gobang and roguelike play combined to produce a single game. To advance to the group stage, to pass the knockout, to become stronger all the way, to compete with many players!
一款回合制RPG游戏，可以鼠标点击操控，或者键盘上下左右空格操作，通过打怪升级，买装备变强，路人翻身做主角
Pour son travail, Victoria doit déménager dans une nouvelle ville en compagnie de sa famille. Mais elle ne s'attendait pas à passer une telle première nuit dans sa nouvelle demeure.

Max is in trouble. He pissed off his cat Lula and now she’s out to get him. And Lula is far from sweet. She is vicious, cold and unforgiving. More dangerous than Lula are her traps – deadly and brutal killing contraptions with Max’s name written all over them.
That evil mirror is back and it’s up to you to extinguish his power for good!
Crack cipher crossword puzzles in Ink Cipher!
Search a Darkened Movie Theater to Free a Hostage from her Captor’s Dangerous Plot!

La menace draconique est à nos portes. Des héros légendaires se dressent pour affronter les légions surgies des profondeurs. Domptez vos dragonnets, créez des builds via la Grille Ancestrale, développez votre cité et détruisez les Dragons !

ALERTE ! Vous participez à une mission où se joue l'avenir du monde entier. Assistez aux tout débuts des forces d'élite légendaires de la Seconde Guerre mondiale dans Commandos: Origins. La très attendue suite de la série Commandos vous ramène aux origines des jeux de stratégie en temps réel.
721 words. That is enough to cover 90% of conversations in English. Unscramble those words in Mini Words - a unique mix of puzzle, word search and hangman.

Moonshot is a stealth puzzle platformer that puts you in the role of a spy of a fictional country in the 'moon race' era. In competition with the USA and the Soviet Union, you will have to use espionage and sabotage to make sure that your nation will be the first on the moon.

Rosenkreuzstilette is a mega-action-platformer game in which you step into the shoes of Spiritia Rosenberg, a virtuous young woman caught on the wrong side of a revolution instigated by her closest friends.
The best adventures happen as you dream: Jump from between high ledges and buildings to explore the world above the clouds! Single and Two-player local Coop.

Un sorcier vous a piégé dans un livre d'histoire sombre, vous transportant dans la ville magique de Brookhaven. Avec des sorts, des épées et le pouvoir de l'amitié, commencez votre nouvelle vie dans ce pays étrange.

Qualia 3 is a 2D shoot-’em-up game that brings a few unique elements to the classic genre. In the unknown expanse of the deep sea, survival of the fittest is taken to a whole new level. The weak and slow perish while the strong survive.
Gelez le temps, montrez-vous plus rusé que vos adversaires, et annulez la destruction de votre foyer dans The Ambassador: Fractured Timelines, un jeu de tir fantasy à double joysticks.

Fat Prisoner Simulator 3 - a hockey simulator where you are going to play the role of a prisoner. Each team consists of three players. Your have to score as many goals in the opponent’s net as you can in order to win the match.
You finally decided to call Momo. Momo is a horror game.

Experience the frigid and relaxing atmosphere of Ski3 in this 3D rendition of a 90's classic. Ski down the unending alps and collect point by skiing over flags, but beware for you're not alone in these mountains.

Infinity: Battlescape est un simulateur de combat spatial supportant des centaines de joueurs par serveur. Rejoignez l'une des factions se battant pour la domination d'un système stellaire procédural réaliste et sans chargements. Participez à des batailles impliquant des centaines de vaisseaux.

Shovel Knight est un jeu d’action-aventure offrant un gameplay intense, des personnages mémorables et des graphismes inspirés de l’ère 8-bits. Si vous aimez les jeux de plateforme soignés, les musiques irrésistibles, l’humour et les boss délirants, Shovel Knight est fait pour vous !

Welcome to the world of the most lethal, high performance multi-role strike-fighter ever designed - a plane so classified and so advanced that before today only the U.S Navy's elite pilots have ever flown it. Now it's your turn...

titre: Yasha: Legends of the Demon Blade
description: Defeat malevolent forces in this stunning Japanese-inspired roguelite world! Become a master of the Demon Blades and combat swarms of demons in a fantasy realm set in the Edo period. Through every journey, you will unveil the hidden truths concealed within troubled times.

titre: Rise of the Triad: Dark War
description: You are part of an elite group of operatives called HUNT (High-risk United Nations Taskforce), and you must stop a maniac cult leader from killing millions of people. You are equipped with high-tech weaponry and magical instruments that defy description to invade the monastery and stop the madness.
You drive a 4x4 monster truck in 4 different races!
Be a hero. Be the Ace of Protectors. According to the legend of the Venux, you're who can save the Venux. You have to fight devils who are trying to destroy the Venux.

Pooshooter: Toilet Invaders is a 2D action comedy game packed with explosions and fun gameplay. Reminiscent of arcade classics like Space Invaders, PooShooter lets you take control of a Bum fighting against vengeful Toilets.
Jeu de tir multijoueurs avec un énorme arsenal. Joignez-vous à l'amusement !

In the farms of Abitof monsters are grown for their yield of rare items. But a successful harvest is not easy, for these crops fight back. As with all creatures their hearts yearn for tactics. Use this as your advantage, progress through the dungeon defeat their boss and reap the rewards.

Appelez un ami et devenez spongieux ! Putty Pals est le jeu de platforme coopératif ultime, mettant à l'épreuve deux joueurs à travailler ensemble et à affronter des puzzles qui utiliseront votre capacité cérébrale dans un monde coloré et enchanteur.
Le scénario s'inspire de personnages réels et d'événements historiques pour raconter une facette poignante de l'histoire taïwanaise, tout en illustrant une lutte contre les morts.

Bored of waiting for a bite? Would you like to catch some fish? You're lucky - in Ultimate Fishing Simulator, fish bite like crazy! Spinning, float fishing, ground fishing and more! Now you can feel it on your own by playing it on VR!

titre: Voodoo Whisperer Curse of a Legend
description: The entire town has been put into a deep, dark sleep by a mysterious evil force. Now young Lillian must find allies and uncover the dark secrets of voodoo in order to save her master and free her friends before it is too late.
Fight Shooting Game with Pretty Girls

Devader est un jeu de tir twin-stick qui puise son inspiration dans les années 90. Affrontez des boss à l'ancienne complètement déjantés, faites votre choix parmi de puissantes compétences pour parfaire votre stratégie, et découvrez les différentes fins.
Eat apples from the ground to add mass. Beware of being eaten by enemies larger than yourself! Try a jump. I heard Slime can get a lot faster by jumping.

“Henry’s Escape" is an immersive adventure game where you need to use your puzzle-solving skills to help Henry, who is wrongfully accused of murdering his wife, Elena, to escape from prison and uncover the true killer. The game’s realistic graphics and puzzles make for an entertaining experience.

Q: How to become a powerful hero? A: Fight! Treasure! Open Boxes! Complete quests! -----WRONG A: Have dinner on time, keep balanced diet, exercise, keep in good mood. -----RIGHT In this game, you are a explorer who explore a mysterious dungeon. You get the material from monsters, get the receipies from people, and make food.

Madeleine Valois is a prince's companion. It is her responsibility to keep him out of trouble - not to let him walk blindly into a political minefield, not to let him get arrested for a crime he didn't commit, and definitely not to let him fall in love with her...

Alwa's Legacy est un jeu rétro rempli de donjons dangereux, d'objets mystiques et d'anciens secrets. Faites évoluer votre magie et choisissez votre destinée dans ce jeu d'aventure non linéaire encourageant l'exploration.
Il est temps de péter un câble dans ce shooter arcade rempli de vagues d’insectes et d’OVNIS. Traversez 50 niveaux difficiles, attrapez des power-ups et visez le meilleur score.
Marimoth is a short shoot 'em up that puts in control of a moth whose shots bounce off the walls. Calculate your aim, evade enemy attacks by learning their patterns and collect coins to power up.
Operate a wrecking crane in VR to destroy the last remaining old building in a city of new skyscrapers, push buttons, turn wheels and make sure the ball hits its target!
Witness to the sections of BigBoy's life sucked into a vortex of crime. Is there divine justice?This is the prologue of the story.
In this classic graphical text adventure, originally released in 1985 for the Commodore 64 by the same studio that brought you The Hobbit, explore an adventure in the world of Count Dracula.

Dans ce jeu hybride de tour défense/action de haut en bas avec d'incroyables graphismes en pixel art, incarnez le Bellator, pour lutter contre les envahisseurs d'autres mondes. Posez vos pièges, équipez-vous d'armes et d'équipements puissants et récupérez le château pièce par pièce.

titre: Super Arcade Boy in Goodbye Greenies
description: Super Arcade Boy revient dans un shoot ’em up rétro : 8 niveaux, des vagues de Greenies, des power-ups et 8 gros boss. Discutez avec le chef alien, puis sauvez la planète.
A short visual novel presented with pixel art and cute animations. Chasing after a rabbit, Alice found herself in a land of talking plants. Now, it's time to go on a tiny little adventure.

titre: LA FORET DE PAGO 2 : SOUVENIR DE GLACE
description: Le premier jeu vidéo de rôle pour apprendre l'orthographe. Guerriers, mages, nains, dragons et bien d'autres créatures vous attendent.

Saga of Sins est un jeu d'action-aventure expiatoire avec un scénario mystique et un gameplay arcade gratifiant ! Plongez dans un monde de vitraux imprégné par le péché, et venez à bout des sept pêchés capitaux.

Élucidez un mystère de science-fiction palpitant dans ce roguelite de tir à deux sticks, où l'action est constante. Équipez-vous, cumulez les améliorations temporaires et persistantes, et aventurez-vous dans les profondeurs d'une base souterraine, seul ou en groupe de jusqu'à 3 joueurs.

La nouvelle collection de combat de Capcom s'invite sur le devant de la scène ! Choisissez entre des titres adorés des fans comme Capcom vs. SNK 2: Mark of the Millennium 2001 et Project Justice, et des jeux d'action 3D tels Power Stone et Power Stone 2 avec une collection de 8 super jeux de combat.
A classic 2D arcade action game animated frame by frame. Survive a fictional pandemic in a city filled with madness and denial.

titre: Unsolved Case: Au-dessus de la loi Édition Collector
description: Rien ne rapproche autant les gens qu'un crime ou un chagrin commun ! Peux-tu affronter courageusement un marionnettiste criminel sans défense légale ?

An International Affair! Play as a (male or female) American college student spending a semester abroad in London. Build a new future by living, studying, working, and dating in England. Both straight and same-sex romances are available, but not all loves may have a happy ending...

Le centre de jeux était autrefois un endroit vibrant et joyeux rempli de rires d'enfants et de jouets interactifs dernier cri. Cependant, un mystérieux accident a provoqué sa fermeture soudaine. Personne ne sait exactement ce qui s'est passé

Follow the creation and crazy antics of a cartoonist as the journey of this strange but friendly character unfolds in this monochromatic 2D adventure. In a fun game with fluid movements and simple, responsive controls. Venture between vertical and horizontal platforms, avoiding traps and cliffs.
You find yourself trapped in a dream. If you capture anomalies in the dream with a camera, you might be able to escape.
Humanity Must Perish is a short, comedic visual novel in which the fate of humanity is placed in the hands of a witty, pessimistic android.

A storytelling game that explores the stories, cityscape, and legend and lore of Chicago’s South Side ca. 1940. Encounter both heroes and scoundrels in 3D interactive scenes that transport the visitor into detailed recreations of this vanished community as it was between the World Wars.

Quarantined inside an airlock. No memories. No way out. The remaining crew thinks there’s something wrong with you, but the Voice says it’ll help you escape. Navigate volatile conversations & unravel mysteries in this narrative adventure about trust, self-destruction, & shifting identities.
Jeu de tir à la première personne brutal axé sur l'action, le sang et l'exploration. Alimenté par une musique trap-metal qui fait monter l'adrénaline.

Incarnez « Umihara Kawase », une experte en sushis japonaise de 20 ans au sac à dos d'écolière armé d'une canne à pêche, d'une ligne de pêche en caoutchouc et d'un hameçon. Évitez les ennemis sous forme de poissons, les tapis roulants, les piques, les fossés, les voyages temporels et bien plus encore.

Continue the story of the knight Grondoval in this first-person fantasy slasher. Get ready for bloody encounters with vile creatures and vicious warriors. Stop an evil witch from carrying a titular blood vengeance in revenge for him having slain her sister.

GUARDS! est un jeu FPS fantastique coopératif pour 1 à 4 joueurs qui vous met dans les bottes sous-financées et trop zélées du Gardien de la Ville. Enfoncez les portes, arrêtez les criminels et causez des dégats matériels excessifs tout en luttant pour rétablier l'ordre public dans la ville corrompue de New Alestead.
Sick Way is a hardcore game about a guy stuck in an abandoned school

Alpha Locus VR is a horror wave based shooter for the HTC Vive (PC). You can fight through various waves using both melee weapons and guns. As an immersive shooter, this game is scary and fun. This game is in the Alpha stage of production.

Situé dans un Western anachronique avec une multitude de personnages et d'aventures à découvrir, Slap Village mélange le passé et le présent dans un contexte qui est plein d’humour et mystères. Plonge dans cette folle aventure et découvre l'histoire de Lurditas et son ami inséparable, Rasta.

titre: Beat the Nightmare – Evil Dreams Simulator VR
description: One day, your life changed completely – going to sleep has become something you dread. You get a horrible nightmare every time. The only way to stop them is to find an exit out of each. 17 unique horror dreams and terrifying experiences are waiting for you. Dreams have no limits...
ICY: Frostbite Edition is a narrative-driven post-apocalyptic survival RPG set in a new Ice Age. Create your character, lead your family, make difficult choices, and try to survive in a frozen world.
Lead a band of space pirates and loot and pillage your way across the stars in this turn based tactical game!
《列传：革新战争》是灰烬游戏工作室出品的战棋游戏。游戏为SRPG类型，加入了华丽的技能演出与深度的战斗系统。游戏以幻想中世纪为舞台，编写了三十万字以上，“王道中的邪道式”新颖故事。相信喜欢日式SRPG、JPRG的玩家一定会喜欢本作。

Découvrez un monde enchanteur où de mignonnes filles neko attendent de vous voler le cœur. Plongez-vous dans une histoire de romantisme et d'émotions. C'est l'échappatoire parfaite pour passer un bon moment.

Capsule is a single-player survival game played entirely through a radar interface. Players navigate a hostile landscape, learn about their surroundings, and unravel a classic sci-fi story in the process. Best played in a dark room with headphones. NOT RECOMMENDED FOR PLAYERS WITH MISOPHONIA.

In an isolated lab beneath the earth, a childhood friend is resurrected. Amidst sealed walls, a spree of killings unfolds. In a godless abyss, parallel worlds entwine like a maze. Where does one find the path to the sole universe of bliss?
War Room est une stratégie réaliste qui vous fera découvrir les réalités de la guerre en Afghanistan.
Take on Zombies solo or with 7 friends. We're rebuilding from the ground up and updating for free this year 2024. Get ready for intense, endless action against waves of zombies
Take command of HEROCORP™ and launch a Preemptive Defence Campaign™ against parallel dimensions in OTTTD, the most outrageous Tower Defence title around.

Bienvenue dans "Delivery Point Simulator"Gérez un point de retrait de colis recevez et remettez des colis améliorez l'infrastructure, achetez des licences pour de nouveaux produits gérez le transport et investissez de l'argent à la banque. Devenez un leader dans l'industrie de la logistique!

Exploration de Donjon Mystérieux, Objets Secrets et Boss Puissants, Amélioration de Mouvement fluide. Ennemis uniques et Butin épique. Améliorez vos statistiques, enchantez vos armes et vos pièces d’armure.
PhotonVERSE is a puzzle precision 2d platformer set in a neon universe. play 100 stages through 10 themed worlds each with its own mechanics.

titre: Join Rush Attack / 加入突袭
description: Courez la foule jusqu'à ce que vous atteigniez le château à la fin du niveau. Écrasez vos rivaux dans la bataille finale et capturez la forteresse !
Customizable realistic racing quadcopter simulator: Push your FPV racing to the next level or develop real life drone flight skills for the first time.

The mayor of Rockhaven threw you down a hole into the Undercity. Why? Net worth too low. In this open-world simulation, you and up to 3 pals will steal, fight, and scheme to reclaim the city. Customise your rides, buy businesses, and take on the Mayor’s forces. Rockhaven is yours for the taking!
Build wild magnetic machines, flip poles, and watch physics lose its mind. A chaotic magnetism sandbox for tinkerers, kids, and anyone who likes things that snap, fly, and fail spectacularly.
The evil Lich King, lord of the Undead, is rising once more. It weighs upon your shoulders to do what no one before could, defeat it once and for all, and rid humanity of this ultimate evil!

Play in VR or with traditional FPS controls as you breach and clear your way through 23 handcrafted levels. Fast and Low is the only tactical shooter where a VR player and a keyboard player can team up side-by-side, locally or online, in intense co-op missions.

Search through the interrogation footage of suspects of a bizarre and horrific crime. Decide who committed the crime and see them get arrested and have their day in court. The latest interactive video experience.

titre: HUNDRED FIRES: The rising of red star - EPISODE 3
description: Prepare for the climactic finale as Montenegro returns for one last mission. Use your stealth skills to rescue your beloved daughter, Merche, and unravel the trilogy's thrilling conclusion amidst intense action and suspenseful gameplay!

Kosmokrats est le jeu d'aventure et de puzzle en zéro gravité du Peuple ! Pilote ton drone pour résoudre des puzzles dynamiques. Assemble une légendaire flotte spatiale pour coloniser l'espace. Construiras-tu une utopie socialiste ? Une technocratie post-humain ? Ou une dictature brutale ?
The Sunday is a short walkthrough horror game where the idea of being alone will hunt you, until the drakness settles in your brain. The line between reality and nightmare is razor thin.

The Culling returns to take Battle Royale to the next level. Real-world weapon ballistics. A strategically brutal melee combat system. Perks to customize your play style. Fifty contestants will drop in and compete for glory, but only one will be crowned the winner. Do you have what it takes?

Dumbass Drivers! is a cheap and cheerful arcade racing game that has you hurtling head-on towards retirement! 16 tracks and 4 missions make it time to fasten your seatbelt and leave all those other dumbass drivers behind!
Panelak is an old socialist-era building where strange things happen. Can you make it to the roof and help the helpless man?
Fight Halloween Monsters in this Idle Clicker! Upgrade your Skills! Defeat Evil!

Spacebourne is an open space exploration game with Rpg elements. Its world consists of different factions at war. You as an expert pilot need to choose your side or be on no one's side and create a force of your own. Load up your weapons, Ready your ship and warp to adventure.
Joue bien tes cartes et tu pourras échapper à l’apocalypse zombie ! Un humour mordant et plein d’action t’attendent dans Zombie Solitaire.
Psychological-surreal-analog-survival horror game. Find the smiles and get out.

SHOW MUST GO ON is an easy to play rhythm VR game. Jump onto the stage and make your music show. Feel the beat. Hit the drums. Puncture the bubbles. Play with the rhythm. Fill the stage with colors and lights. If you like energetic music, rhythm, and drums, this game will give you a lot of fun!
C.Y.S.M.A. is a third-person action about a man lost in the maze. You will die. Not just eventually, but it keeps happening often. And after every death.. it will happen again...
Metro Simulator 2 est un jeu unique recréant le Métro de Moscou et des contrôles de train réalistes.
Escape the dark by navigating through nightmares made reality. Follow the light and find your way home as you are hounded by your worst fears.
Single route visual novel. Belle is actually a boy, an accident lets him and a bright girl named Bambi begin to live together, a warm and healing friendship + love story.

Bladestar est un jeu d’action et de tir de science-fiction aux superbes effets spéciaux qui comporte des mondes graphiquement riches et des ennemis sans fin à chaque niveau. À bord de votre Manta Starfighter, défendez la galaxie et traversez des champs d’astéroïdes, de mines, et de débris en combattant des pirates, des rebelles et des...
Ce jeu est une courte idée de jeu suivant l'histoire de Hébert Grimm voulant suivre les pas de son père en devenant le meilleur dans son domaine.

titre: 伯克利家的女仆：重制版(Berkeley's Maid: Remake Edition)
description: The ghosts of the past, recounting the tragic past
Votre mission : mener un groupe de civils hors du pays dévasté par la guerre.

Chicken Feet is a first person survival-stealth horror game about a giant, angry chicken. Descend into the depths of GOOBER laboratories and uncover the horrors that lie beneath the lab's shiny façade.

Shoot in all directions to destroy legions of hostile robots. Upgrade your weapons to become the ultimate robot hunter. Challenge yourself with Hard and Arcade modes, both new to Robot Legions Reborn.

Dans la peau de Fynn le dragon, partez à la recherche de votre famille dans la mystérieuse Caverne onirique. Obtenez de nouvelles capacités, rencontrez des personnages uniques, résolvez des casse-têtes et affrontez un antagoniste mystérieux dans ce jeu de plateformes rendant hommage à la N64.

titre: The Deep Paths: Labyrinth Of Andokost
description: The Deep Paths: Labyrinth Of Andokost is a first-person, dungeon crawling RPG.

Play as the Vampire anti-hero Victor in this turn-based combat RPG adventure! Bite, slash, cast spells, buy new gear, and level-up as you grind through your enemies for experience and gold! Classic RPG feel, with a new and exciting original storyline!

Can you lead? Burden of Command is an emotionally authentic tactical leadership RPG. You’re a company Captain in the historical Cottonbalers. Fighting psychology as much as bullets, you must build respect, trust, and battlefield experience to bring your brothers safely home.

Battle your way through the levels, search for the gear you need to stay alive, and find the exit to the next level. Explore entirely new procedural levels every time, just to see how many you can get though.

Il s'agit d'un jeu de tir spatial rétro, où vous ne combattez que l'ennemi le plus puissant. Il y a 15 boss uniques dans le jeu, et les joueurs doivent utiliser différentes armes et stratégies pour les vaincre. Dédié à vous qui êtes à la fois challengers et amateurs de jeux rétro.
A challenging, winter-themed horror experience

Psi Project is a hardcore 2D shooter with elements of horror. The main character wakes up in an unknown place. Absolutely remembers nothing. Who he is and how he got here. Throughout search of answers he is strongly plagued by different kinds of hallucinations.

A vast ocean of uncertainty clouds your past, present and future. Venture forth as you struggle to find your place in the world, a Nomad, wandering from village to village attempting to unravel the mysteries of your place here in Petura. An Endgame focused ARPG full of customisation, loot and more!

Dungeon World mixes roguelike and sandbox elements while keeping simple gameplay and retro style. Explore procedural worlds, plan your journey, make a family, modify the lands, get old and reincarnate with more world knowledge.

Eye of the Temple est un jeu VR où vous allez devoir explorer un énorme temple rempli de dangers à l'aide de vos propres pieds ! Armez-vous de votre fouet et de votre torche pour vous déplacer d'un bloc à l'autre, éviter les pièges et résoudre les énigmes, sans jamais perdre l'équilibre.

titre: Poker Master - Texas Hold'em, roulette, blackjack, baccarat, Omaha, machines à sous, Teen Patti, mahjong, Landlord, Showhand, Bullfighting, Poker Chinois
description: Jetons gratuits ! Inclut le Texas Hold'em, les machines à sous, le Blackjack, le Teen Patti, l'Omaha, le Baccarat, la Roulette, Mahjong, Landlord et bien d'autres jeux de poker.

Return to the underground classic world of treasures and traps in the HD remake of Crystal Caves! Guide Mylo through puzzles and arcade challenges of your favorite episodes, then explore the whole new Episode loaded with all new puzzles, enemies, challenges, hazards and help Mylo get back home!

Choose among a knight, a witch, a minister even, and several others, and try to find out what happened to the King's daughter. Composing a well balanced party is important. Will they end up heroes, or zeros?
